Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar over arbeidsmigranten in een vleesfabriek in Groenlo die moesten doorwerken ondanks een corona-uitbraak

MPs Van Dijk and Futselaar (SP) asked whether meat-plant workers, mostly migrant workers, were forced to keep working during a COVID-19 outbreak at Vion Groenlo and why the plant closed late. The minister answered that the plant closed after a GGD sample showed over 20% infection, that closures are the responsibility of safety-region chairs, and that the labour inspectorate is inspecting slaughterhouses and enforcing workplace safety duties.
The labour inspectorate started on 8 June 2020 a project on slaughterhouse inspections for corona and will inspect a number of preselected slaughterhouses in the coming weeks.
De Inspectie SZW is op 8 juni 2020 gestart met het project «inspecties slachterijen – corona« en zal de komende weken een aantal voorgeselecteerde slachthuizen inspecteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over ‘400 miljoen voor IHC’ 2020

Two SP MPs asked why IHC, a shipbuilder with losses predating COVID-19, received state support worth about 400 million euros, questioning market logic, the absence of a state stake, management accountability, and the use of emergency procedure. The minister answered that losses began in 2016, that the state's support consists of insurance, guarantees and a bridge loan rather than a direct 400 million, and that a private consortium is taking over with governance seats for the state, while declining to disclose several financial details.
It is not for the State to disclose the amounts these parties contribute.
Het is niet aan de Staat om de bedragen die deze partijen inbrengen bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het functioneren van medezeggenschap in tijden van corona

An SP MP asked the education minister about the legal status of the COVID-19 higher-education service document, whether it may allow informing works councils only afterwards, and whether university boards may bypass works-council procedures under the WHW and WOR. The minister answers that the document is administrative agreements that leave WHW and WOR rights intact, that deviations should be limited to what is necessary, and that the inspectorate supervises works-council involvement.
The agreements in the service document on works councils leave unaffected what the WHW and WOR regulate on works council participation.
De afspraken in het servicedocument als het gaat om de medezeggenschap laten onverlet wat in de WHW en in de WOR over de medezeggenschap is geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het openstellen van de TOZO-regeling voor studentondernemers

An SP MP asks why students who run their own business are excluded from the Tozo support scheme under the Participatiewet exclusion for those eligible for student finance, and whether the scheme will be adjusted to treat them equally. The State Secretary answers that the exclusion is a legal consequence of student finance being an adequate prior provision, that the scheme cannot deviate from the Participatiewet, and that he is not willing to change it, while noting the Minister of Social Affairs is exploring a broader safety net for flexible workers.
I am not willing to do so, because other students could then, on grounds of equal treatment, also become eligible for general assistance.
Ik ben daartoe niet bereid, omdat andere studenten dan, op grond van rechtsgelijkheid, ook voor algemene bijstand in aanmerking zouden kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet en Futselaar over de gevaren van de coronabesmettingen bij nertsenfokkerijen

Three MPs asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections at mink farms, including culling, protective equipment, enforcement of the reporting duty and inspections, and the future of mink farming. The ministers answered that infections were confirmed on nine locations at six farms, that culling was decided on 3 June with a possible voluntary exit scheme still under study, that the NVWA carried out no mink-farm inspections in 2020 so far, and that the questions were answered later than planned.
Not all animals are tested, so we cannot give the precise number of infected animals.
Niet alle dieren worden onderzocht en daarom kunnen wij het precieze aantal besmette dieren niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over de onderhandelingen over visserijsubsidies

Two MPs asked the government whether it would pause WTO fisheries subsidies negotiations after 150 NGOs requested a halt due to inclusiveness and transparency concerns during COVID-19. Minister Kaag answered that talks are stalled, the government does not consider the process non-transparent, supports resuming talks by end-2020, and does not back halting all trade and investment negotiations.
The cabinet does not agree with this claim.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de kabinetsmaatregelen rondom stikstof

An MP from the SP asks the agriculture minister about nitrogen policy, including whether critical deposition values must be met everywhere in Natura 2000 areas, whether a 2030 target of 50% of nitrogen-sensitive area below critical values is legally binding, and whether ecological measures can replace deposition cuts. The minister answers that deposition reduction is needed and that the target is an effort obligation rather than a binding result, while committing to ongoing monitoring and further research.
The cabinet indeed aims to bring nitrogen deposition below the critical deposition values (KDW) on at least 50 percent of the hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature in Natura 2000 areas by 2030.

Het kabinet streeft er inderdaad naar om in 2030 op ten minste 50 procent van de hectares met stikstofgevoelige natuur in Natura 2000-gebieden de stikstofdepositie onder de kritische depositiewaarden (KDW) te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Animal Rights toont beelden van dierenleed bij konijnenfokkers door heel Nederland’

An MP asked the minister how the government will respond to footage showing dead, sick and dying rabbits at breeding farms, and whether NVWA inspections and sanctions will be increased. The minister said the footage was assessed by the NVWA but cannot itself prove an offence, referred to earlier answers on inspections and sanctions, announced inspections planned for 2020, and said a concrete, measurable plan to improve welfare is being pursued with the sector.
Sick, injured or dead animals in a cage cannot be qualified as a violation on the basis of image material.
Zieke, gewonde of dode dieren in een hok zijn niet op basis van beeldmateriaal als overtreding te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten voert betaald parkeren in’

MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked ministers whether they would intervene in or discuss with Natuurmonumenten its plan to introduce paid parking at its nature reserves, and whether it would reduce access or cause spillover parking and affect its financial health. The minister replied that the government has no view on the parking charge, that Natuurmonumenten sets its own parking policy, that no contact or talks are planned, and declined to assess the organisation's finances.
It is not for the cabinet to pass judgement on the financial management of the Natuurmonumenten association.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel uit te spreken over de financiële huishouding van de vereniging Natuurmonumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het Duitse laboratorium LPT (Laboratory of Pharmacology and Toxicology) dat jarenlang zou hebben gemarchandeerd met resultaten van proefdieronderzoek

MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the German lab LPT may have manipulated animal-test results used in approving glyphosate, and whether approval should be suspended and EU scrutiny sought. The minister said German authorities are investigating, that the LPT studies do not change the glyphosate reassessment outcome, declined to request a European study or contact TNO and Monsanto about the 2002 study, and committed only to awaiting the German results and noting that findings will be shared with supervisory bodies.
An investigation into this alleged fraud by the German authorities is currently underway.
Er loopt inmiddels een onderzoek naar deze vermeende fraude door de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Miljoenen aan rechten weggegeven voor ‘illegale’ koeien: ‘Overheid levert een wanprestatie’'

MP Futselaar (SP) asked whether millions of phosphate rights were wrongly granted to cows kept without valid permits, and whether this threatens the phosphate ceiling, state aid rules and the need for recovery. The minister rejected the claim, stated that rights were granted per the Meststoffenwet, that permit checks are the task of provinces and municipalities, and gave no overview of affected farmers.
Checking compliance with the Nature Conservation Act and other environmental permits is a task of the provinces and municipalities.
De controle op de Natuurbeschermingswet- en andere milieuvergunningen is een taak van de provincies en gemeentes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de maatregelen die beschikbaar zijn voor dierentuinen tijdens de coronacrisis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about support measures for zoos during the coronavirus crisis, including small parks relying on volunteers that cannot use the NOW wage subsidy, and whether a dedicated scheme would be created. The minister listed the general schemes available (NOW, TOZO, guarantee schemes, tax deferral, TOGS), said she is in contact with zoos and has asked them for data on costs, and said that generic measures rather than a special scheme are being pursued.
Generic measures are being deployed to help the zoos.
Er wordt ingezet op generieke maatregelen om de dierentuinen te helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de werking van economische steunmaatregelen voor sectoren die worden geraakt door kabinetsbeleid rond het COVID-19 virus

Member Futselaar (SP) asked whether small firms and sole traders excluded from the TOGS COVID support scheme by fixed-cost thresholds, SBI codes or the separate-premises requirement, and community halls and training firms, could be helped. State Secretary Keijzer answered that the scheme targets firms with substantial fixed costs, pointed sole traders to the TOZO, extended TOGS to taxis and training firms from 15 April, and widened the premises requirement, while declining new financial support for local sales platforms.
The scheme is primarily aimed at compensating businesses with substantial fixed costs, because this group is relatively the hardest hit.
De regeling is primair gericht op compensatie van ondernemingen met substantiële vaste lasten, omdat deze groep relatief het hardst getroffen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de archeologie

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether archaeology firms can access COVID-19 support schemes (TOGS, NOW), late payment rules, and heritage education funding. The minister declined to add the broad SBI code 7220 to TOGS, pointed to other support schemes, and promised to consider extensions to the archaeology quality registration.
I am in consultation with the SIKB, the CCvDA and the IOeE about which leniency measures are needed to keep the archaeology quality system functioning.

Ik ben in overleg met de Stichting Infrastructuur Kwaliteit Bodem (SIKB), het centraal College van Deskundigen in de Archeologie (CCvDA) en de Inspectie voor Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed (IOeE) over welke coulancemaatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat universiteiten met surveillance-software studenten thuis in de gaten houden

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether universities using surveillance software to proctor exams at home protect student privacy under the GDPR, what data is collected, and whether student participation rules are respected. The Minister replies that institutions must comply with the GDPR, that proctoring is a pilot-scale tool requiring careful assessment, and that student councils should be involved but may be consulted afterwards when continuity requires it.
Even in such a case, the institution makes efforts to ensure that the student council can fulfil its role, even if afterwards.
Ook in een dergelijk geval spant de instelling zich in om te zorgen dat de medezeggenschap, zij het achteraf, haar rol kan vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag en Futselaar over het uitgelekte plan voor de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

MPs Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag and Futselaar asked the minister how leaks about the nitrogen plan reached the media before parliament was informed, and when parliament would receive the plan. The minister regrets the media coverage, says parliament will be informed once cabinet decides, and states the cabinet has now concluded its decision and sent the structural approach letter to parliament.
I attach importance to informing your House once the discussions with the parties involved have taken place and cabinet decision-making is complete.
Ik hecht eraan uw Kamer te informeren zodra de besprekingen met betrokken partijen hebben plaatsgevonden en de besluitvorming in het kabinet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Futselaar en Alkaya over ondersteuning voor zelfstandigen en de culturele sector

MPs Kwint, Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about support for self-employed workers and the cultural sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including eligibility criteria, compensation for cancelled events, and a guarantee fund. The government answered that existing general measures apply, cited extra funding of 300 million euro for culture, and explained why certain sectors were included or excluded from the TOGS scheme.
On Tuesday 7 April the extension to non-food retail and a second extension were communicated to the House.
Op dinsdag 7 april jl. is de uitbreiding met non-food retail en nog een tweede uitbreiding aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Futselaar over zwangerschapsdiscriminatie bij studenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about pregnancy discrimination against students, including whether pregnant higher-education students should have maternity leave and individual exam programmes as mbo students now do. The minister acknowledged pregnancy can delay studies, said higher education lacks a statutory attendance duty so institutions handle this case by case, and committed to report after the summer on a parliamentary motion about maternity leave in higher education.
Following this debate, a motion was also adopted requesting the government to map out what is needed to make maternity leave possible in higher education.
Naar aanleiding van dit debat is ook een motie aangenomen die de regering verzoekt in kaart te brengen wat ervoor nodig is om zwangerschapsverlof in het hoger onderwijs mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht “Nieuwe megastal Knorhof stap dichterbij”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a planned 26,000-pig stable by a farmer previously sanctioned for animal welfare and environmental violations in the Netherlands and Germany, and about a possible EU black list for banned livestock keepers. The minister answered that such violations alone cannot justify refusing an environmental permit, that the provincial authority decides on the permit, that a black list is not yet achievable at EU level, and that a bill on animal abuse is expected to go to the Council of State before summer 2020.
Failure to sufficiently comply with animal welfare and environmental rules, however, cannot in itself be grounds for refusing an environmental permit for the construction of a new stable.
Het niet of onvoldoende naleven van dierenwelzijns- en milieuregels kan echter op zichzelf geen grond zijn voor het weigeren van een omgevingsvergunning milieu voor de bouw van een nieuwe stal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de wenselijkheid van het toevoegen van diergeneeskundige,- en dierverzorgende beroepsgroepen aan de lijst van cruciale beroepen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether veterinary and animal care professions should be added to the list of critical occupations during COVID-19, and why they were excluded. The minister answered that the list is deliberately limited to keep exceptions few, that animal health must not be compromised but specialist care can often be arranged locally, and that case-by-case solutions are sought.
The request to add veterinary and animal care occupations to the list of critical occupations is known to me.
Het verzoek om diergeneeskundige en dierverzorgende beroepsgroepen aan de lijst van cruciale beroepen toe te voegen is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de bomenkap voor stadsverwarming in Purmerend

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether 16,000 trees were felled in the Schoorl dunes, whether the wood fed Purmerend's district heating, and whether a Staatsbosbeheer representative's roles (Enerco, Energiehout, former FSC board) amounted to conflict of interest. The minister answers that the felling was a 2018-2019 thinning, the wood went to the wood industry, and no conflict of interest exists given functional separation and that FSC does not certify.
In response to your questions I obtained information from Staatsbosbeheer.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van uw vragen informatie ingewonnen bij Staatsbosbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de kapwerkzaamheden in Natura 2000-gebied de Schoorlse Duinen

An SP MP asked the minister about tree felling in the Natura 2000 area Schoorlse Duinen, its timeline, area affected, permits, and compliance with nature law and the forestry code. The minister answered that only about 10 hectares (Dr. Van Steijnbos) will be felled in the current plan period, the Baaknolbos will in principle be spared, and the felling is assessed as within legal exemptions, with the forestry code update still pending.
This management plan can be found via the following weblink.
Dit beheerplan is te vinden via de volgende weblink
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Apollo/Vredestein 750 fulltime-equivalent (fte) aan banen wil schrappen in de locatie in Enschede

An SP MP asks the Economic Affairs minister about Apollo Vredestein's plan to cut 750 FTE jobs in Enschede, including whether the government was informed, whether it intervened, the Hungarian factory and possible EU state aid, and eligibility for the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund. The minister answers that the reorganisation is a company strategic decision, that the government cannot prevent it but works to retain firms, that Hungarian rather than EU subsidies were involved and were found compatible by the Commission, and that an EGF application is undetermined.
However, this planned reorganisation is a strategic consideration of the company.
Deze voorgenomen reorganisatie is echter een strategische overweging van het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over de gevolgen van het coronavirus en de dalende olieprijzen op de economie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs how the coronavirus and falling oil prices will affect the economy, whether governments should act themselves, and about stimulus plans in Germany, France, Italy and Spain, mortgage relief, the investment fund and support for small businesses. The minister answered that the impact is not yet predictable, that the government is taking measures such as short-time work and liquidity support, and that further measures will follow if needed.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation so requires.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de ontstane situatie in het hoger onderwijs als gevolg van de uitbraak van het corona-virus

The MP asked how higher education institutions are coping with online teaching during the coronavirus outbreak, whether students who fall behind can be accommodated (including binding study advice, master admission, loans and tuition relief, the hardship fund, and rent flexibility). The Minister answered that she is in talks with sector bodies, that institutions must minimise disadvantage to students, and referred to a separate letter for most specifics, while pointing students to DUO loan options and online Q&As.
For the rest, I refer you to my letter on the COVID-19 approach to higher education that I sent to your House today.
Voor het overige verwijs ik u naar mijn brief over de COVID-19 aanpak hoger onderwijs die ik heden aan uw Kamer heb gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat gasbedrijven Gronings onderzoek naar duurzame energie domineren

Two SP MPs asked whether gas companies dominating the New Energy Coalition's research on sustainable energy in Groningen is problematic, including its university and subsidy links and the NAM's role. The minister defended the open involvement of fossil-fuel firms in the energy transition, said the NEC's conduct is not a government concern absent evidence of breach, and promised a study of third-party funding of research.
In accordance with this motion, a study will be carried out, with the Ministry of OCW taking the lead.
Conform deze motie zal een onderzoek worden uitgevoerd, waarbij het Ministerie van OCW het voortouw zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Futselaar over nieuwe berichten van belangenverstrengeling en corruptie in het falende Europese Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

MPs Leijten and Futselaar asked whether EU agricultural subsidies enabled fraud and oligarch enrichment, citing reports on Czech PM Babiš and Italian mafia fraud, and whether the CAP should be cut and capped. The minister called the allegations serious, said the Commission should investigate, declined to comment on individual cases, denied that CAP subsidies destroyed markets for small farmers, and said the Netherlands favours a smaller MFF and a cap on support per farm.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases under ongoing investigation.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen waarnaar onderzoek nog lopende is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat de overheid nog steeds miljarden aan investeringen in de fossiele industrie dekt

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked why the state's export credit insurance (EKV) still covers large amounts of fossil-fuel investment and whether it should be phased out, and asked the government to study the effect on climate policy. The government disputes the press figures, says about 30% of the portfolio is fossil-related, pledges to green the portfolio and measure it better, but rejects phasing out fossil cover unilaterally, citing effectiveness and jobs.
No. Phasing out in the Netherlands the granting of insurance for all investments related to fossil fuels would go too far.
Nee. Het in Nederland uitfaseren van het geven van verzekeringen voor alle investeringen die te maken hebben met fossiel gaat een brug te ver.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Slacht dreigt voor Texelse Konikpaarden: "Het pakte niet uit zoals we hadden gehoopt"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that twenty Konik horses on Texel faced slaughter after failed relocation, and whether Staatsbosbeheer could rehome them elsewhere. The minister answered that the horses can stay on Texel because mitigating measures are being taken, that relocation to private keepers or other areas is undesirable or infeasible, and that Staatsbosbeheer should be trusted to weigh the decision carefully.
The current solution makes relocation unnecessary.
De huidige oplossing maakt herplaatsing overbodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Futselaar over het rapport van WOinActie ‘Inventarisatie omvang en gevolgen van structureel overwerk aan de Nederlandse universiteiten’

Three opposition MPs asked the government about a WOinActie report on structural unpaid overtime at Dutch universities, including whether it is lawful, the government's responsibility, job insecurity and workload causes. The minister answered that the Inspectie SZW will examine the complaints in its planned inspections of the 14 universities, that the Wml, Atw and Arbowet set the legal limits, and that she will press institutions and VSNU on permanent contracts and workload reduction.
It is up to the Inspectie SZW to investigate whether this is indeed the case.
Het is aan de Inspectie SZW om te onderzoeken of dit inderdaad het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar  over medewerkers van Sandd die geen baan krijgen bij PostNL

Two SP MPs asked why most of Sandd's 16,000 staff lose their jobs when PostNL takes over, whether PostNL's job offers were adequate, and what is done for franchisee workers and those underpaid below minimum wage. The Secretary of State replies that PostNL made offers to all postal workers, that about 60% of interested postal workers accepted, that the civil courts handle franchisee contract disputes, and that the Inspectorate's fine concerned unverifiable hours.
It is not for me to intervene in individual contracts between Sandd and these franchisees.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in individuele contracten tussen Sandd en deze franchisenemers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over de berichten ‘Zelfs grote bedrijven hebben geen natuurvergunning, dus weten we niet hoeveel stikstof in de natuur terechtkomt’ en ‘Uitstoot van Gelderse bedrijven o

SP MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked about reports that thousands of businesses, including large ones, lack the nature permits required under the Wet natuurbescherming, so nitrogen emissions are unknown. The minister answered that many firms need no permit for nitrogen, that enforcement is largely a provincial responsibility with no statutory inspection deadlines, that no active enforcement occurs until a collective legalisation scheme exists, and that a decision on the Schiphol enforcement request is expected by 1 April 2020.
It is not known how many businesses wrongly lack a permit under the Wet natuurbescherming.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar inzake het bericht dat vanaf 1 januari op de Universiteit Twente alleen Engels wordt gesproken

An SP MP asks the education minister how the University of Twente's decision to use only English from 1 January squares with the Dutch language and accessibility law and the General Administrative Law Act, and whether it is desirable. The minister says the choice is for the university and its participation bodies within legal limits, that formal correspondence with students must remain available in Dutch, and that the university should consider accessibility effects for Dutch-speaking students.
Towards students, the university should therefore, as a main rule, communicate in Dutch in administrative dealings.
Richting studenten dient de universiteit in het bestuurlijk verkeer dan ook – als hoofdregel – in het Nederlands te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten aan de TU-Delft zijn opgelicht door nep-verhuurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing and the Minister of Education about students at TU Delft defrauded by fake landlords, including how many were foreign students, and about platform controls, blacklists, licensing and a quality mark. The minister answered that no standard registration or national figures exist, described information campaigns, the Wet toeristische verhuur, ACM action against intermediary fees, pilots on local landlord licensing, and said fake landlords are a criminal law matter rather than housing policy.
There is no standard registration of this available at TU Delft.
Er is geen standaardregistratie hiervan beschikbaar bij de TU Delft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over de actieve promotie van de controversiële paspoortprofessor Kochenov door de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Two SP MPs asked the Education Minister why Groningen University had not yet started its investigation into possible conflicts of interest by professor Kochenov and why it actively promoted his work. The minister answered that the external investigation had begun, that quality takes precedence over speed, that the university's publicity choices are its own responsibility, and that the government is awaiting the report and the Inspectorate's assessment before acting.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the investigation and the Inspectorate's assessment of this investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en het oordeel van de inspectie over dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat en Gelderland botsen over bomenkap A28’

An SP MP asks the ministers about Rijkswaterstaat's plan to fell trees along the A28 on the Veluwe and whether municipalities and the province were surprised, with questions on the scale of felling, compensation, consultation and residents' input. The minister replies that the fire-corridor felling is postponed pending consultation with the municipalities, safety region and province, that only a limited set of trees is now being removed for traffic safety, that no direct consultation with residents took place as is usual for such maintenance projects, and that Parliament will be kept informed.
I will inform your House about the progress of the consultation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de kosten van de gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak

MPs Futselaar and Beckerman asked where the 500 million euro nitrogen reserve comes from, whether it is sufficient, how the 1 billion euro housing boost is divided, and what the costs for municipalities and provinces will be. The minister answered that the reserve is funded from a 2019 budget underspend, that the amount's adequacy is still unknown, that the housing boost is separate and not earmarked, and that the financial impact on local governments is not yet known, with support helpdesks and a team being set up.
At this moment it is not yet clear what the exact financial consequences of the nitrogen ruling are for municipalities and provinces.
Op dit moment is nog niet inzichtelijk wat de exacte financiële gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak voor gemeenten en provincies zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Futselaar over het bericht dat hypotheekverstrekkers toegang tot studieschuldgegevens bij DUO kunnen vragen

An SP MP asks whether it is desirable that Ockto may give mortgage lenders access to students' study debt data held by DUO, how this fits the Van Meenen motion, and how it can be prevented. The minister answers that the data-sharing is at the student's own initiative with consent, that DUO is not involved, that the government will set rules for data-sharing apps, and that it cannot guarantee commercial parties will never access such data.
The cabinet will therefore develop frameworks that data-sharing applications (such as Ockto) must meet, and will anchor them in the Digital Government Act.
Het kabinet zal daarom kaders ontwikkelen waar toepassingen voor het delen van gegevens (zoals Ockto) aan moeten voldoen, en zal deze verankeren in de Wet digitale overheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over het bericht dat de SSH& voortaan haar kamers zal verhuren door middel van loting

SP MPs asked whether a housing association's switch to a lottery for student rooms breached the national student housing action plan and whether students were properly consulted. The minister answered that local parties are responsible for the consultation, that the housing association consulted its tenants' organisation as the law requires, and that the government will monitor whether student unions are included.
From central government we will keep a close eye on this.
Vanuit het Rijk zullen we vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de berichten dat studenten op camping neerstrijken

Two SP MPs asked how many students sleep in tents, hostels or bungalow parks due to housing shortages, how they are supported, and what rent protections exist. The minister said the situation is more nuanced than media reports, described municipal and institutional emergency housing arrangements, pointed to monitoring, the Huurcommissie campaigns and the Goed Verhuurderschap pilots, and promised to continue talks with partners without specifying enforceable consequences.

Regarding your questions on numbers of students in temporary emergency accommodation (campsites, hostels and holiday bungalows) and the costs for students, I made inquiries with various municipalities and educational institutions.

Wat betreft uw vragen over aantallen studenten in tijdelijke noodvoorzieningen (campings, hostels en vakantiebungalows) en de kosten voor de student, heb ik bij verschillende gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen navraag gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over oefenvluchten van Defensie boven het Waddengebied zonder hiervoor via een natuurvergunning afspraken te hebben gemaakt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why military training flights over the Wadden area increased sharply without a nature permit and whether the protection of the area would be secured. The minister answered that a permit exists for helicopter low-level flying, that regular flights above minimum altitude were assessed as not requiring a permit, and that a permit application for other military flights is in preparation for early 2020.
Regular military flying activities above the regular statutory minimum altitude have been assessed and found not to require a permit.
Gewone militaire vliegactiviteiten boven de reguliere wettelijke minimumhoogte zijn getoetst en niet vergunningplichtig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over het afkondigde onderzoek naar hoogleraar Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Two SP MPs asked whether the Groningen university's investigation into professor Kochenov over EU passport-sale advisory work is justified, and why the university had not investigated conflicts of interest earlier. The minister supports the university's independent inquiry, says it will be led by an external chair and checked against the integrity code and secondary-employment rules, and says the Inspectorate will assess its findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and any conflict of interest, and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Nederland de geldkraan van beroemd onderzoek naar zwarte gaten dicht draait

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Netherlands was cutting funding for black hole research, and how NWO assesses societal impact. The minister rejected the premise that funding was cut, explained NWO's impact criteria and funding constraints, and gave a one-off 200,000 euro grant for communication about the Event Horizon Telescope result.
I do not share the conclusion that the 'money tap has been turned off'.
Ik deel de conclusie dat de «geldkraan zou zijn dichtgedraaid» niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het duidelijk verslechterde economisch beeld van het midden- en kleinbedrijf (mkb)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the deteriorating SME business cycle shown by the CBS conjunctuurklok and how SME and large-firm conditions compare. The State Secretary answered that the business cycle has softened but remains good, that the clock covers all firms, that the MKB action plan provides specific SME support, and that domestic spending and wage policy are relevant but are for social partners to settle.
SMEs are the foundation of the Dutch economy.
Het mkb is het fundament van de Nederlandse economie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de integratie van XS4ALL door KPN en de gevolgen voor de keuzevrijheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about KPN's plan to dissolve the XS4ALL brand despite a negative works council advice, its effects on consumer choice, whether the regulator should analyse the market, and whether works councils have real influence. The State Secretary answered that market parties are free to offer services, that the regulator's wholesale access rules are being broadened, that the works council's weight is a matter for the boards, and that employment non-compete clauses are the responsibility of employer and employee.
I have no opinion on how the boards of XS4ALL and KPN weigh the advice of the Works Council; that is decision-making that lies within the respective boardrooms.
Ik heb geen mening over hoe de besturen van XS4ALL en KPN het advies van de Ondernemingsraad wegen; dat is besluitvorming die in de betreffende bestuurskamers ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Futselaar over de verkoop en levering door webwinkels van in Nederland niet erkende gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en pesticiden aan particulieren

An SP MP asked the minister whether webshops such as Bol.com and Tuinadvies.nl may sell pesticides not authorised by the Ctgb to Dutch consumers, and what enforcement and health/environment assessment would follow. The state secretary answered that such sales are not permitted, enforcement focuses on prevention and communication, supervision will be intensified in 2020 with a report promised, and EU-level cooperation exists.
For that reason I have agreed with the NVWA that supervision and enforcement of sales will be intensified in 2020.
Om die reden heb ik met de NVWA afgesproken dat in 2020 toezicht en handhaving op de verkoop worden geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar over het bericht ‘Liegen over je studieschuld lastiger: DUO komt met schuldverklaring’

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked why DUO could not adapt its systems for a debt declaration (schuldverklaring) requested by parliament, while a request from another minister could be accommodated. The minister answered that the Blauwe Knop project was small, that work has been stopped following a motion, and that DUO serves several other ministries with maintenance and replacement currently prioritised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de uitspraken van vicepremier Hugo de Jonge tijdens de jaaropening van Hogeschool Rotterdam

An MP asks whether the deputy prime minister's remarks at a Rotterdam university opening, that students should be steered with a firmer hand toward other study choices to address labour shortages, reflect government policy, and whether numerus fixus or similar measures are planned. The minister replies that students should freely make informed choices, that labour-market prospects are one consideration alongside interest, that the advisory commissions CMMBO and CDHO monitor macro-efficiency, and that no restriction of choice is planned.
It is important that pupils and students have the freedom to make a conscious study choice themselves.
Het is daarbij belangrijk dat leerlingen en studenten de vrijheid hebben zelf een bewuste studiekeuze te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Tonnen winst: saucijsjes en gehakt onterecht verkocht als biologisch’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report that a meat processor sold conventional sausages and mince as organic, and why its director was not prosecuted. The minister confirmed the practice is unacceptable, explained that criminal prosecution was not pursued due to limited NVWA investigative capacity and priorities, and said Skal withdrew the company's organic certificate in 2017.
In practice this means that the NVWA-IOD does not have sufficient capacity to criminally investigate all suspected fraud with organic food.
In de praktijk betekent dit dat de NVWA-IOD onvoldoende capaciteit heeft om alle vermoedelijke fraude met biologisch voedsel strafrechtelijk te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat veel numerus fixus-opleidingen helemaal niet vol zitten

MP Futselaar asked the Education Minister whether numerus fixus programmes are wrongly capped, whether students' choice is restricted, and whether a similar situation exists in higher vocational education. The minister attributes empty places to students not deregistering, announces a provision letting institutions over-enrol and a ministerial prior-approval requirement for numerus fixus, and provides an overview of programmes.
I want to prevent this situation and therefore I give institutions room to counter empty places in numerus fixus programmes.
Ik wil deze situatie voorkomen en daarom bied ik instellingen de ruimte om lege plekken bij numerusfixusopleidingen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de hernieuwde stijging van de postzegelprijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the postage stamp price rise after ACM allowed PostNL a 16.4% tariff increase, questioning liberalisation, dependence on post, and consolidation via PostNL's acquisition of Sandd. The State Secretary answered that rising tariffs follow from structural mail volume decline, defended liberalisation, committed to a Postal Act amendment later this year, and said a decision on PostNL's Sandd appeal would follow within 12 weeks.
I intend to submit an amendment proposal to the Postal Act to the House of Representatives later this year to secure this for the longer term.
Ik ben voornemens om later dit jaar een wijzigingsvoorstel voor de Postwet bij de Tweede Kamer in te dienen om dit ook voor de langere termijn te borgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het verdwijnen van 3G

An MP asked the state secretary about Vodafone's early 3G shutdown, its refusal to make phones 4G-compatible, and whether affected low-income customers should be compensated as with cable TV decoders. The state secretary answered that customers can still call and use 2G, that operators communicate the shutdown well in advance, and that no arrangement with Vodafone is needed because phones are personal property unlike decoders.
I therefore see no need to enter into consultation about arranging such a scheme.
Ik zie zodoende geen noodzaak om in overleg te treden over het treffen van een dergelijke regeling.

Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Futselaar over de coulanceregeling van de Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam met betrekking tot de in het  verleden te hoge collegegelden voor de Parttime Master Bedrijfskunde van de Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the Erasmus University Rotterdam's limited refund scheme for overcharged Parttime Master tuition fees adequately complies with the minister's call for compensation, and whether the law is clear enough. The minister answered that the law is clear, that the university's interpretation is incorrect, that the inspectorate found a violation, and that students can use administrative appeal routes, while stating the minister cannot force institutions to compensate.
Neither the inspectorate nor I am responsible for the content of the compensation scheme; we cannot enforce anything in that regard.
Noch de inspectie noch ik gaan over de inhoud van de compensatieregeling, we kunnen daarin niets afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het artikel in de NRC “Nederland betaalde miljoenen maar Tata bouwt in India”

Two SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister why a subsidised Hisarna blast furnace is being built in India rather than IJmuiden, and whether subsidy policy should change. The minister denies undue pressure from Tata Steel, says the scale-up plant was needed as an intermediate step, rejects leakage claims, and says the government will only take action on trade if needed.
The conversation with Tata Steel about subsidy options was not conducted in that way, and Tata Steel exerted no pressure, as is suggested here.
Het gesprek met Tata Steel over subsidiemogelijkheden is niet op die manier gevoerd en er is door Tata Steel geen druk uitgeoefend, zoals hier wordt gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de Groningse universiteit meer grip wil krijgen op het Koninklijk Nederlands Instituut Rome

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that the University of Groningen wants more control over the Royal Netherlands Institute in Rome, questioning its quality, national importance, the criticism of its outgoing director and the funding contributions. The Minister answered that the RUG has been responsible since 1991 under a transfer protocol, that the NWIB board oversees the institute, that quality is safeguarded by existing systems, and that funding is a lump-sum with no detailed budget oversight by the ministry.
I have no insight into the precise budget of the KNIR; its assessment I leave to the NWIB umbrella body.
Ik heb geen inzage in de precieze begroting van het KNIR, de beoordeling daarvan laat ik aan de NWIB-koepel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de Universiteit Groningen niet eerlijk is over het onderzoek naar studentpromovendi

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that the University of Groningen gave incomplete information to its works council on the PhD experiment and about allegedly improper influence on the interim evaluation, and whether the experiment should be stopped or compensation paid. The minister said the university should inform its works council fully and will include the survey in the next self-evaluation, that the interim evaluation's purpose is to detect serious harm, that CHEPS assured scientific integrity, that courts decide on employment status, and that the experiment will not be stopped but a second application round will open.
According to the RUG, the survey referred to in the Trouw article is part of an ongoing study and was therefore not included in the self-evaluation recently sent to the University Council.

Volgens de RUG maakt de enquête, waar in het artikel in Trouw naar verwezen wordt, onderdeel uit van een nog lopend onderzoek en is deze daarom niet meegenomen in de zelfevaluatie die recent naar de Universiteitsraad is gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen naar aanleiding van bericht dat studenten lang in de wacht staan door onderbezetting en nieuw systeem

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked whether extra DUO staff capacity was available for summer phone waiting times, what effect the new student finance system had on waiting times, and what the average waiting time was in 2019 and targeted for summer. The minister answered that extra funds go mainly to maintenance, that waiting times fell with extra capacity and the new system (about 20% fewer calls in early 2019), and that waiting times will likely exceed 10 minutes in weeks 34-37.
But in weeks 34 through 37 the average waiting time will probably exceed 10 minutes.
Maar in de weken 34 tot en met 37 zal de gemiddelde wachttijd waarschijnlijk wel boven de 10 minuten uitkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over het ontnemen van toegang van Huawei tot Google-software door de Verenigde Staten

MPs Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about the US decision to restrict Huawei's access to Google Android, its effects on Dutch users, the justification for it, and whether Dutch policy should shift. The government answered that the effects are not yet clear, that current Huawei phones keep working, that Dutch risks are assessed case by case, and that it rejects the need for a US strategy while pursuing multilateral trade reform.
The cabinet does not share this view and therefore sees no reason to draw up an American strategy.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet en ziet hierin derhalve geen aanleiding een Amerikastrategie op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de situatie op het Archimedes-instituut van de Hogeschool Utrecht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about financial and governance problems at the Archimedes Institute of Hogeschool Utrecht, including unprofitable teacher training, a flexibilisation pilot, works council disputes and reliance on project subsidies. The Minister answered most questions substantively, stating the government does not fund per programme, that the works council disputes were mediated, and that she is in contact with the Hogeschool board and will address small teacher training costs in a cost study.
Whenever there is cause for it, I am always willing to enter into discussion with Hogeschool Utrecht.
Wanneer daar aanleiding toe is ben ik te allen tijde bereid in gesprek te gaan met de Hogeschool Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat wervingsbureaus internationale studenten naar Nederland lokken

SP MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education about reports that recruitment agencies lure international students to Dutch universities, including whether universities should pay such agencies, whether school-bridging programme quality is guaranteed, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate admissions. The Minister said universities are responsible for admissions and quality, that agency costs are not tracked, and that the Inspectorate can investigate if signals arise, without committing to a new inquiry.
The institution remains at all times responsible for admitting students, even if they were recruited by a recruitment agency.
De instelling blijft te allen tijde verantwoordelijk voor de toelating van studenten, ook als deze zijn geworven door een wervingsburau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht op AnimalsToday.nl over het voornemen van een dierenverhuurbedrijf om een dierentuin te beginnen

MP Futselaar asked the minister about an animal rental company with a poor record planning a zoo in Appeltern, and about licensing, enforcement, zoning and rules for animal hire. The minister replied that no application has been filed, that a poor record would be weighed in any licence assessment, that the NVWA inspects such firms, and that no further tightening of the rules is currently planned.
The NVWA does not separately record in its systems whether a case concerns an animal rental company.
De NVWA houdt in haar systemen niet apart bij of het gaat om een dierenverhuurbedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de werkdruk aan de universiteit nog verder opgelopen is

The SP MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that workload at universities has risen further, with high stress, insecure temporary contracts and the causes of workload. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to planned sector-level measures, a forthcoming advisory report on funding and a review of accountability rules, but rejects calls for an additional investment of 1.15 billion euro.
For additional investments on top of these already substantial investments, I currently see no room.
Voor extra investeringen bovenop deze al forse investeringen zie ik op dit moment geen ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Hogeschool Utrecht het stakingsrecht ondermijnt

An MP asked the ministers whether Hogeschool Utrecht undermines the right to strike by having lessons during strikes covered by other staff, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister confirmed the right to strike is protected under the European Social Charter, said disputes are for the employer, staff and courts to resolve, and that the ministry has only raised the matter with the institution.
I explicitly brought the AOB article to the attention of Hogeschool Utrecht, but I play no role in this conflict.
Ik heb het artikel van de AOB nadrukkelijk onder de aandacht van de Hogeschool Utrecht gebracht, maar ik speel geen rol in dit conflict.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de aanleg van glasvezel en een eventuele opsplitsing van KPN

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about KPN's fibre rollout, alleged strategic building to deter smaller competitors, the pace of reaching universal 100 Mbps broadband, and whether KPN should be split or the infrastructure returned to public ownership. The State Secretary answered that competition among networks is welcome, that the 2023 100 Mbps target is expected to be met given private investment, that targeted state aid remains available for unprofitable addresses, and that she rejects public ownership of the infrastructure.
I will keep following this closely and, as promised in the Telecommunications General Consultation of 17 October 2018, will report to the House on progress annually.
Ik blijf dit nauwlettend volgen en zal de Kamer zoals toegezegd in het Algemeen Overleg Telecommunicatie op 17 oktober 2018 3 jaarlijks over de voortgang rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van der Molen over het bericht dat internationalisering Saxion moet redden voor krimp

MPs Futselaar and Van der Molen asked whether Saxion's shift to English-taught programmes to offset enrolment decline is lawful and justified, and about teacher quality, staff consultation and German-language programmes. The minister said English teaching should not be driven by finance, announced a bill to modernise the WHW language rules, judged Saxion's language code compliant, and reported no signals of insufficient teacher quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat je op de vestiging in Qatar zo een Nederlands diploma krijgt

An MP asked the Minister of Education about press reports that students at NHL Stenden's Qatar campus receive a Dutch diploma without adequate quality assurance, and about inspection oversight of such foreign branches. The minister said she is awaiting the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation before responding on substance, describes the inspection's past oversight and the accreditation rules for foreign branches, and reports no other known cases.
I am awaiting the outcomes of this investigation before responding substantively to the case.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af voordat ik inhoudelijk reageer op de casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de biggensterfte in Nederland is toegenomen in plaats van afgenomen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that piglet mortality in the Netherlands has risen despite sector agreements, and whether voluntary agreements have failed and binding measures are needed. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to a plan of action, a piglet-vitality checklist and a planned benchmark, and committed only to report on progress in spring, without announcing new binding measures.
I will inform you in spring, as promised in the debate on Animals in Livestock Farming of 24 January, about the progress of activities aimed at better care for young animals.

Ik zal u, conform mijn toezegging in het debat Dieren in de veehouderij van 24 januari jl., in het voorjaar informeren over de voortgang van de activiteiten gericht op betere zorg voor het jonge dier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over het bericht dat via CETA er gemanipuleerd voedsel de markt op komt

SP MPs Alkaya and Futselaar asked whether gene-edited (CRISPR-Cas) apples from outside the EU can enter the European market while EU farmers are supposedly barred from using the method, and whether CETA guarantees that EU food standards are respected. The minister answers that imports must meet EU GMO and food safety rules, that the CJEU ruling applies GMO rules to new breeding techniques, that CETA does not change EU standards, and that import controls may be adapted with EU-level discussions ongoing.
All exports from Canada to the EU must comply with EU standards, including EU rules on genetic modification and food safety.
Alle export van Canada naar de EU moet voldoen aan EU-standaarden, waaronder EU-regelgeving op het terrein van genetische modificatie en voedselveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten die geld lenen voor hun studie meer last hebben van psychische problemen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the student loan system contributes to performance pressure and mental health problems among students, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that multiple factors cause mental pressure, that RIVM research is ongoing, that the social repayment conditions protect students, and that DUO will run an experiment on loan behaviour.
I am waiting for the outcomes of the RIVM research now.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het RIVM-onderzoek nu af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Futselaar over het bericht dat een Oekraïense kippenmiljardair het meest profiteert van het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement lets Ukrainian poultry imports undercut Dutch producers through lower standards, state aid and EU loans to MHP, and whether the agreement should be evaluated. The ministers answered that imports must meet EU health and safety rules, that the Commission monitors implementation and is closing a tariff loophole, that the state aid cannot yet be judged compatible, and that the Netherlands opposed the EBRD loans.
Periodic evaluation of association agreements is therefore necessary to keep a finger on the pulse and to be able to intervene if needed.
Periodieke evaluatie van associatieakkoorden is daarom nodig om de vinger aan de pols te houden en in te kunnen grijpen als dit nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten weinig gebruik maken van inspraak

MP Futselaar (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she will respond to research showing few student council elections, low awareness of new powers among programme committee members, and incomplete administrative support, and whether she will press institutions and review the Wet versterking bestuurskracht. The Minister said institutions and students share responsibility, committed to a momentary review of programme committees and a broad evaluation in 2020/2021, and called on institutions to inform and support committees, while rejecting a need to challenge institutions on election practice.
I will fulfil two commitments previously made to the Senate.
Ik zal voldoen aan twee toezeggingen die eerder zijn gedaan aan de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat universiteiten op zoek moeten naar financiers

An SP MP asked the education minister about universities seeking outside financiers for real estate, including whether it makes them dependent on financial markets and whether real estate costs threaten teaching and research. The minister answered that outside financing is a positive development, that borrowing from the treasury is an option, that real estate costs are reported in annual reports and a DUO dashboard, and that institutions decide their own financing policy.
I do not have an overview of the financial risks of individual institutions, as they conduct autonomous financing policy.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de financiële risico’s van afzonderlijke instellingen, aangezien zij een autonoom financieringsbeleid voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Hul, Westerveld en Futselaar over de toename van studenten die ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit van universiteiten

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that rapid student growth at some universities is eroding teaching quality, including overcrowded lectures and shortfalls in facilities and assessment. The minister disputed a general quality decline, pointed to institution-level choices under the quality agreements, and said there are no targets for maximum lecture size.
I do not recognise the picture of a negative quality trend caused by strong growth.
Het beeld van een negatieve kwaliteitstrend door forse groei herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de RUG uit angst voor schadeclaims doorwerkt aan Chinese Branchcampus

MPs Futselaar and Van der Molen asked whether RUG continued planning a Chinese branch campus despite a no, whether the MoU is binding, how damage claims would be handled, and whether the university council was adequately informed. The minister answered that RUG did not apply for the required permission, that the MoU binds only its signatories, that the risk of claims is very low and no public funds may be used, and that council disputes go to the national complaints committee.
The Ministry of OCW was aware of this, but was not a party to those agreements.
Het Ministerie van OCW was hiervan op de hoogte, maar was geen partij in die overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten dat een bedrijf ‘post-master’-opleidingen aanbiedt in combinatie met een arbeidscontract dat uiteindelijk niet tot stand komt

An MP asked the education minister about a company offering 'post-master' courses bundled with a job contract that never materialised, and whether unaccredited providers using such terms should be regulated. The minister confirmed the company is unaccredited, declined to make these titles legally protected or to survey the unaccredited market, and pointed to existing fraud law, Inspectorate checks on the Wet bescherming namen en graden, and public information as sufficient.
I see no reason to do so, given the protection offered by the Wet bescherming namen en graden.
Ik zie hiertoe geen aanleiding, gezien de bescherming die wordt geboden door de Wet bescherming namen en graden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht over nieuwe misstanden bij corpora, in dit geval Minerva

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reported abuses at student corporations (corpora) such as Minerva, including the Groningen decision to suspend Vindicat, and whether a national approach or renewed talks with the LKvV are planned. The minister said the institutions themselves should act, noted that the LKvV condemns such conduct and that many associations have changed their hazing practices, and saw no reason to take a larger role.
As I also indicated in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, I consider it primarily the responsibility of the educational institution to act when these often humiliating incidents occur.
Zoals ik ook in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen heb aangegeven, vind ik het primair aan de onderwijsinstelling om op te treden als er dit soort, vaak vernederende incidenten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over gebrek aan handhaving door de NVWA

An SP MP asked ministers about lax NVWA enforcement against a dangerous product sold as medicine (MMS) and an unsafe inflatable play structure. The minister defended the NVWA's procedures, said enforcement against MMS is now being applied, and said the play structure was only partly unsafe and enforcement was adequate.
I see no reason to change the procedures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de procedures aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over verhuurder Camelot

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Interior and Education Ministers about the letting company Camelot and its treatment of student tenants at the University of Twente, including deposits, mandatory services, referrals and whether rules need tightening. Minister Ollongren answered that companies may choose their business, that Camelot has reduced its deposit to 1,000 euro after university consultation, that tenants can seek legal advice and rulings, and that the issues feed into the student housing action plan and a 'Goed verhuurderschap' approach, with a follow-up letter promised after a sector meeting.
I will meet the sector on 1 November about the Goed verhuurderschap approach.
Ik spreek op 1 november met de sector over de aanpak Goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten lang in de wacht staan door onderbezetting en nieuw systeem

An SP MP asked the Education Minister about reports that students face long phone waits at DUO due to understaffing and a new system. The minister says 75 extra FTE were deployed, waits fell to about 5 minutes early 2018 but rose to 15-33 minutes in summer, and a decision on further measures will only come in spring 2019 pending monitoring and budget limits.
I would like to do more to improve telephone accessibility, but I do not currently have the financial room for it.
Ik zou graag meer willen doen om de telefonische bereikbaarheid te verbeteren, maar ik heb daar nu niet de financiële ruimte voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten dat dieraantallen in de veehouderijsector veelvuldig worden overschreden

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that livestock numbers are often exceeded in intensive farming, about ammonia emission estimates, enforcement capacity, and inconsistent farm counts. The minister answered that NVWA inspections found overshoots on 68 farms in 2017 with 51 reports, that inspections are risk-based and not extrapolable, and that RIVM will correct its register and clarify the ammonia trend later.
These figures cannot be extrapolated, because there is already a risk-based selection of companies to be inspected.
Deze cijfers kunnen niet worden geëxtrapoleerd, want er vindt al een risicogerichte keuze plaats voor het controleren van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Futselaar over de bijdrage van 8 miljoen euro aan de nertsenhouderij

MPs Ouwehand and Futselaar asked the minister about reallocating 8 million euro from pig-sector funds to fur farm transition measures, the maximum compensation per location, fraud risks, shortening the transition period, NVWA enforcement and animal testing for vaccines. The minister confirmed the 8 million reservation and the compensation caps, said the extra amount is still being explored under state aid rules, refused to shorten the transition period or introduce declining compensation, and described enforcement capacity and the animal testing permit with limited detail.
However, no intellectual property rights may be infringed nor confidential information disclosed.
Er mag echter geen intellectuele eigendomsrecht worden geschonden noch vertrouwelijke informatie worden prijsgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over de alarmerende omvang van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked the ministers about the teacher shortage, including the lack of vacancy data, spending on temp agencies, overtime, and higher tuition for second degrees in education and care. The ministers acknowledged the shortage, said they do not hold current vacancy figures, pointed to schools' own choices and the work-pressure accord, and referred to a recent letter on the shortage.
The ministry does not have a current vacancy overview.
Het ministerie heeft geen actueel vacatureoverzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat een gevaarlijk product nog steeds op de markt verkrijgbaar is als medicijn

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a dangerous chlorine-based product (MMS) still sold as a medicine is acceptable, why NVWA enforcement came late despite a 2017 RIVM report, and what legislation governs it. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained the NVWA's warnings since 2010, the risk assessment process and the applicable food and medicines law, and said the existing information on warnings was sufficient.
As early as 2010 the NVWA warned consumers about MMS products because the safety of these products could not be guaranteed.
Al in 2010 heeft de NVWA consumenten gewaarschuwd voor MMS-producten omdat de veiligheid van deze producten niet kon worden gegarandeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar inzake psychische gezondheid en prestatiedruk van studenten

MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that students are psychologically breaking down under performance pressure, and whether the introduction of the student loan system causes debt-related psychological problems. The minister acknowledges the risks, denies that debt is a main cause (pointing to a combination of self-imposed demands, social media and study pressure), and promises a student-wellbeing approach and a letter, but declines new large-scale national research for now pending consultation with the health ministry.
I will of course continue to monitor this.
Ik zal dit uiteraard blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de afzet van 1 miljoen kuub mest op het spel staat door een niet-geaccrediteerde analysemethode

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that Eurofins Agro uses a non-accredited NIRS method for soil analyses, potentially invalidating manure disposal space for about 1 million cubic metres. The minister said Eurofins uses an allowed alternative method if equivalent reliability is shown, that the Commission of Experts is assessing this and a reply is expected in September, and that no other government controls exist beyond accreditation, though modernisation of the rules may be considered.
However, I have asked the Commission of Experts on the Fertilisers Act (CDM) whether Eurofins has sufficiently demonstrated the equivalence of the method it uses.
Wel heb ik de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet (CDM) gevraagd of de gelijkwaardigheid van de door Eurofins gebruikte methode voldoende door Eurofins is aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat het leenstelsel en bindend studieadvies zorgen voor psychische klachten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the loan system and binding study advice cause psychological complaints among students, and whether she would investigate student mental health and the financial effects of abolishing the basic grant. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a working group on student welfare and ongoing monitoring, but rejected a direct causal link between the abolition of the basic grant and psychological problems.
Prevention and timely intervention in case of excessive or prolonged study pressure are therefore of great importance to me.
Preventie en tijdige interventie bij een te hoge of langdurige studiedruk acht ik daarom van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen achtergesteld worden bij de aanvraag van NWO beurzen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether pregnant women applying for NWO research grants are disadvantaged, and whether regulation and data on this exist. The Minister said NWO does not intend to disadvantage pregnant applicants, offers case-by-case flexibility and will clarify this on its website, declined a separate study as unnecessary, and committed to reporting NWO's outcomes on gender balance to parliament.
NWO works towards this by pursuing gender diversity policy. NWO does not want to disadvantage women because of their pregnancy when applying for research funding.
NWO zet zich hiervoor in door het voeren van genderdiversiteitsbeleid. NWO wil geen vrouwen benadelen vanwege hun zwangerschap bij een aanvraag voor onderzoeksfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht het noodlijdende HAS in Den Bosch onder financieel toezicht staat

MP Futselaar (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that HAS Hogeschool in Den Bosch is under financial supervision, questioning plans for new locations, student protection, the board's claim of no real financial crisis, and whether growth targets or budget cuts were responsible. The Minister confirmed the supervision, deferred the Inspectorate's assessment, declined to pre-empt consequences for students, attributed growth decisions to the institution under a lump-sum system, and promised to wait for an Inspectorate study of green higher education before considering action.
At the end of July 2018 I will receive the Inspectorate of Education's assessment of HAS Hogeschool's improvement plan.
Eind juli 2018 ontvang ik het oordeel van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs over het verbeterplan van HAS Hogeschool.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de open brief aan de Minister over bestuurders die alles maar vertrouwelijke maken

An MP asked the Education Minister how she would respond to an open letter complaining that university boards classify documents and meetings as confidential, whether access to such documents matters for oversight of boards, and whether she would set rules on transparency. The minister said transparency is important under the open-unless-closed principle, that existing law (Wet Openbaarheid Bestuur) applies, that she sees no need for extra rules, and that the debate belongs within institutions.
I consider it very important that institutions of higher education operate transparently.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat instellingen voor hoger onderwijs transparant opereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat hbo’ers opnieuw niet warm lopen voor verkiezingen

Futselaar (SP) asked the Education Minister how to respond to low turnout in higher-vocational (hbo) student council elections and whether time constraints, the sector agreement minimum hours, and attendance under WHW article 10.39 are adequate. The minister said facilitation was already strengthened by law and sector agreements, that further talks were not needed beyond a national help desk, and that institutions and councils must agree attendance arrangements.

So I see no reason to enter into talks. However, I am facilitating that for specific questions from participation bodies within the quality agreements, through a national help desk set up by ISO, LSVb, the Vereniging Hogescholen and VSNU.

Ik zie dus geen aanleiding om in gesprek te gaan. Wel faciliteer ik dat voor specifieke vragen van medezeggenschapsorganen in het kader van de kwaliteitsafspraken door ISO, LSVb, de Vereniging Hogescholen en VSNU een landelijk loket wordt ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Beckerman en Futselaar over een geplande zoutwinning in de gemeente Enschede

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked why the municipality of Enschede was not informed or consulted about a German company's planned salt mining, and about the risks of subsidence. The minister replied that under the old Mining Act municipalities had no formal role, that the new Act gives them an advisory role, that the national minister must decide on mining and that the company still lacks an approved extraction plan.
I agree with the municipality of Enschede's position on the role it wishes to have in the permit processes for salt extraction.
Ik ben het eens met het standpunt van de gemeente Enschede over de door haar gewenste rol in de vergunningenprocessen voor de zoutwinning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat voor het eerst in haar geschiedenis de Universiteit van Amsterdam meer aanmeldingen heeft van studenten met een buitenlandse vooropleiding dan m

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether the University of Amsterdam receiving more applications from foreign-educated than Dutch-educated students raises student housing shortages, and asked about housing policy, corporation finances and a planned cap on international student housing. The minister answered that applications are not enrolments, that a joint action plan on student housing is being prepared, and that the government will not limit international student intake or housing, though the answers are largely general.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat scharrelkwarteleieren afkomstig zijn van een Franse legbatterij

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether scharrel quail eggs sold by Jumbo actually came from a French battery farm, about their origin, whether French welfare standards match Dutch ones, and whether egg codes should be mandatory for quail eggs. The minister confirmed the eggs came from a French supplier, explained that EU rules for quail welfare differ and that egg coding is a matter for Brussels, and said she has no data on whether farms mislabel products after setbacks.
When this comes up in Brussels, I am willing to push hard for it.
Wanneer dit in Brussel ter sprake komt, ben ik bereid mij daar hard voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het rapport van de Externe begeleidingscommissie beheer Oostvaardersplassen

An SP MP asked the minister whether she knows the Van Geel commission report on managing the Oostvaardersplassen, whether she will respond to its advice, what role the national government sees in supporting the province, and whether she will seek alternative habitats for the grazers in the Netherlands or abroad. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, declined to comment on it ahead of provincial decision-making, and said she will engage with the province on any implementation requiring her cooperation within the existing Rijk-provincie division of responsibilities, referring questions 4-6 to that answer.
Decision-making by the provincial states on the advice is expected in July 2018, and I do not think it is for me to respond to the report now.
