MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked what the government has done to promote gender diversity among government-backed start-up and scale-up investment, including at Invest-NL and the Dutch Future Fund, and whether lack of experience unfairly excludes new groups. The Secretary of State replied that female representation on EZK advisory committees rose to 41.9%, that several diversity initiatives are underway, that Invest-NL and the EIF do not treat lack of experience as a decisive rejection criterion, and that diversity is monitored but not a formal DFF selection criterion.
Invest-NL has so far rejected 58 applications that met the intake criteria for financing.
Invest-NL heeft tot heden 58 aanvragen die voldeden aan de intake criteria, afgewezen voor financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over eventuele registratie homoseksualiteit bij Defensie

MPs Bergkamp and Belhaj asked about the treatment of LGBTI personnel in the Dutch armed forces, including past S5 unfitness markings for homosexuality and whether restitution is possible. The Secretary of State answered that no current cases of discharge or refusal for sexual orientation have surfaced, that the S5 marking was used only at pre-1974 conscription screening, and that individual cases will be reviewed while awaiting ongoing historical research.
I am always willing to look at individual cases, however there is so far no reason to conduct large-scale research into this.
Ik ben altijd bereid te kijken naar individuele gevallen, echter er blijkt vooralsnog geen aanleiding te zijn om hier grootschalig onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de wenselijkheid van de legitieme portie in het hedendaagse erfrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the desirability of the forced heirship portion (legitieme portie) in modern inheritance law, citing a CNR/Netwerk Notarissen report and related surveys, including its effect on estranged parents, elder financial abuse, and abolition elsewhere in the Kingdom. The minister acknowledged the report as a contribution to ongoing debate, defended testamentary freedom as a principle balanced against family ties, stated that the portion is not a suitable anti-abuse tool but has preventive value, and declined to commit to revising the law given the caretaker cabinet, leaving any decision to a future cabinet.

Given the various partly principled legal convictions underlying the forced heirship portion, and the further weighing this requires, it is not obvious, partly in view of the caretaker status of the current cabinet, to decide now on revising the current legislation on the forced heirship portion.

Gelet op de verschillende deels principiële rechtsovertuigingen die aan de legitieme portie ten grondslag liggen, en de nadere afweging die een en ander vergt, ligt het – mede gezien de demissionaire status van het huidige kabinet – niet voor de hand om op dit moment te beslissen over herziening van de huidige wetgeving inzake de legitieme portie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Diertens over aanwijzing ex artikel 34, eerste lid, Wet publieke gezondheid

MPs Groothuizen, Bergkamp and Diertens asked the health minister about designating the UMCG as a site for forced Covid-19 isolation, how often the emergency powers under the Public Health Act have been used, and how quarantine and legal protection would be handled. The minister answered that the designation was overdue, that only six isolation orders were issued by two regions with one court extension request refused, and that quarantine powers were not used, with further legislation on quarantine announced.
With this decision, the formal situation is finally arranged so that a hospital is designated at the moment a safety region chair imposes a mandatory isolation order.
Met dit besluit wordt alsnog de formele situatie geregeld dat er een ziekenhuis is aangewezen op het moment dat een voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio een verplichte isolatie beschikking oplegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over tekortschietende toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een assistentiehond

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Medical Care about refusals of assistance dogs in supermarkets, medical settings, taxis and hospitality despite the legal duty to admit them, and proposed measures such as uniform identification and sector campaigns. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the ongoing European standardisation track and sector campaigns with business associations, and declined a national hospital protocol or a foreign comparison study.
I would point out that an assistance dog must in principle be admitted, unless this would impose a disproportionate burden, for example because safety or health is at stake.
Ik wil daarbij wel markeren dat een assistentiehond in beginsel toegelaten moet worden, tenzij dit een onevenredige belasting vormt bijvoorbeeld omdat de veiligheid of de gezondheid in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verzekering van kraamzorg bij draagmoederschap

An MP asks whether intended parents of a child born via a surrogate can claim postnatal care (kraamzorg) under the basic insurance, whether the eight-day transfer matters, and whether the Landelijk Indicatieprotocol should explicitly cover surrogacy and intended parents. The minister answers that intended parents are fully entitled, that care can be delayed or covered by supplementary insurance, that the protocol is being revised with completion expected end 2022, and that consultation bureaux are adequately equipped.
Intended parents, adoptive parents and foster parents, regardless of whether they are same-sex or opposite-sex couples, can fully claim reimbursement for postnatal care.
Wensouders, adoptieouders en pleegouders (hierna: wensouders), ongeacht of het paren van gelijk geslacht of verschillend geslacht betreft, kunnen volledig aanspraak maken op vergoeding van kraamzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over pgb-houders en hun zorgverleners en de vaccinatiestrategie

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked the health minister why paid-care (pgb) caregivers in small-scale living initiatives were deprioritised in the COVID vaccination strategy, asked for clarity on target groups and timing, and asked for consistent information across government, RIVM and GP websites. The minister explained vaccine supply constraints, gave timelines for each group, and committed to aligning communication with RIVM and to answering at the next debate.
I understand the importance of a consistent message about COVID vaccination and therefore align communication, and thus also the content of the respective websites, with the RIVM.
Ik begrijp het belang van eenduidige boodschap over coronavaccinatie en stem daarom de communicatie, en dus ook de inhoud van de respectievelijke websites, af met het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vaccinatie van bewoners en personeel in de langdurige zorg

An MP asked the health minister why residents of nursing homes without a care indication or with an indication but no treatment are not vaccinated in their own home, and for a full overview of vulnerable groups and priority rules. The minister explained the phased vaccination strategy by age, medical indication and logistics, and said he is willing to meet the LVOI on the strategy for small-scale residential initiatives.
Yes, I am willing to enter into discussion with LVOI.
Ja, ik ben bereid om met LVOI in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Nederlandse spermadonor verwekt 200 kinderen en adverteert ermee op social media’

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a Dutch sperm donor reportedly fathering around 200 children and advertising on social media, and about regulating multi-donor practices domestically and abroad. The Minister of Health answered that private donation falls outside government control, pointed to clinic rules and the planned Wdkb amendment capping donations at 12 families, and said no registration or international agreement is feasible for private arrangements.
Outside the clinics and the Sdkb, there is no visibility into the number of so-called multi-sperm donors active in the Netherlands or abroad.
Buiten de klinieken en de Sdkb om is er geen zicht op het aantal zogenaamde multi-spermadonoren dat actief is in Nederland of in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vaccinatie van dove of slechthorende zorgmedewerkers in De Gelderhorst en in het algemeen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 outbreak control at the deaf care home De Gelderhorst, whether deafness contributed to spread, and whether deaf or hard-of-hearing care staff can book vaccinations given the phone-only booking. The minister says the crisis is under control, deafness did not contribute, information is provided bilingually, and GGD is exploring accessibility solutions for all groups, including interpreters for phone booking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Kwart van de jongedokters overweegt te stoppen met opleiding’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that a quarter of young doctors consider quitting their training, citing overtime, workload and lack of supervision. The minister acknowledged the concern, said working hours are set in collective agreements and that supervision is the supervisor's call, and promised to explore workload measures with hospitals and young doctors.
Residents and assistant residents must be able to carry out their training and work in a safe environment with sufficient attention to workload and overtime.
Aios en anios moeten hun opleiding en werk in een veilige omgeving kunnen uitvoeren waar voldoende aandacht is voor werkdruk en overwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bergkamp over het ontbreken van chiropractors en osteopaten op de lijst van uitgezonderde contactberoepen

MPs Van den Berg and Bergkamp asked why osteopaths and chiropractors were left off the list of exempt contact professions during the lockdown, despite some patients needing their care. The Minister answered that exemptions follow existing law (Zvw, Wlz, Wmo, Jeugdwet, BIG), that osteopathy and chiropractic are not basic insured care and have no protected titles, and that patients can be referred to physiotherapists and GPs.

I will therefore bring this group of people to the attention of the national professional organisations of GPs and physiotherapists, so that they can help or refer these people to the right specialist where needed.

Ik ga deze groep mensen daarom onder de aandacht brengen van de landelijke beroepsorganisaties van huisartsen en fysiotherapeuten, zodat zij deze mensen zo nodig kunnen helpen of doorverwijzen naar de juiste specialist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'De indicatiepraktijk: Wijkverpleging onder druk en in de kou'

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Health about the division of responsibilities between health insurers and nurses who assess care needs, after reports that insurers revise nursing care plans without first consulting the assessing nurse. The minister answers that the nurse is responsible for the assessment, insurers check lawfulness and efficiency and should first seek clarification, disputes go to the SKGZ, and he will examine unclarities but mainly points to ongoing agreements and a planned insurer document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de mogelijkheid voor ouders in het buitenland om een levenloos geboren kind bij te schrijven in de Basisregistratie Personen

MP Bergkamp asked whether Dutch parents living abroad can register a stillborn child in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), and whether this can be made possible through legislation. The Secretary of State answered that parents who were registered residents when the stillbirth occurred can already request registration after emigrating, and that a bill submitted in November 2020 would extend registration to parents who are or become residents, regardless of nationality or residence at the time of birth.
I am willing to take into account the circumstance that there are parents living abroad who wish to have data on their live and/or stillborn children recorded in the BRP when developing it.

Ik ben bereid om de omstandigheid dat er ouders zijn die in het buitenland wonen en wensen dat gegevens over hun levend en/of levenloos geboren kinderen in de BRP worden opgenomen, bij de uitwerking daarvan mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de werking van medicinale cannabis

MP Bergkamp asked the minister whether the Zorginstituut's criteria for accepting scientific evidence on medicinal cannabis would be shared with researchers, and whether the ongoing research meets those criteria. The minister answered that the criteria are public, that ZonMw's review found mostly low-quality evidence, that the research programme will focus on applied research, and that only the Zorginstituut itself can judge whether studies meet its requirements.
This question can ultimately only be answered on the basis of assessment by the Zorginstituut itself.
Deze vraag kan uiteindelijk alleen worden beantwoord op grond van toetsing door het Zorginstituut zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen transpersonen houdt aan: ‘We moeten dit niet accepteren’’

Three MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how they will tackle violence against transgender people, whether police capacity via Roze in Blauw is adequate, and whether consultation with TNN will produce concrete measures. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited existing measures (equal treatment law, Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI, a 2021 congress, police diversity networks) and said concrete new measures would be communicated to the House if warranted.
OCW has regular contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) to see how the position of transgender people can be improved in various areas.
Vanuit OCW is er geregeld contact met Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) om te zien hoe de positie van transgender personen op verschillende vlakken verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de Nederlandse kosten door beroerten met miljarden dreigen te stijgen

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Medical Care about an Oxford report projecting stroke costs in the Netherlands rising from about 1.3 to 3.3 billion euro per year by 2040, and what measures would be taken, including on rehabilitation decline and proposals from a patient organisation. The minister acknowledged the projected rise driven by ageing, pointed to existing policy (the hospital care accord, reimbursed treatments, ZonMw research) and said implementation is decentralised to care professionals.
It is up to care professionals to determine how good stroke-related prevention and care should concretely take shape.
Het is aan zorgprofessionals om te bepalen hoe goede beroerte-gerelateerde preventie en zorg concreet vorm moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over Iconen van de Rijkshuisstijl

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the gender-normative government icons in the Rijkshuisstijl should be removed and non-gender-normative principles adopted. The minister agreed gender-normative communication should be avoided and said the Voorlichtingsraad will work on a plan for inclusive image communication that could include non-gender-normativity.
Mid-year, the Voorlichtingsraad was tasked with setting up a working group that will develop an action plan for inclusive image communication.
Medio dit jaar heeft de Voorlichtingsraad de opdracht gekregen om een werkgroep in te richten die een plan van aanpak voor inclusieve beeldcommunicatie uit zal werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de European Disability Card

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the European Disability Card, its benefits, its visibility for invisible disabilities, and whether the Netherlands should introduce it. The Minister opposed introducing the card, favouring general accessibility and the 'Onbeperkt Meedoen!' programme, while noting risks for foreign visitors without the card.
No, like my predecessor I want to work on improving accessibility for everyone, even without a card having to be shown.
Nee, net als mijn voorganger wil ik inzetten op verbetering van toegankelijkheid voor iedereen, ook zonder dat een kaart hoeft te worden getoond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht dat zorgmedewerkers met corona toch moeten komen werken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the health minister whether zorgmedewerkers with COVID-19 may still be made to work, whether they accept exceptions to isolation rules when rosters cannot be filled, and how care continuity is ensured without endangering patients. The minister answered that positive staff must not work and cannot be forced to, that narrow exceptions in FMS and RIVM guidance require documented, safe risk assessments, and that regional steering groups and staffing measures will be used; the answer to the eighth question was not given in time for the committee debate.
Staff who have tested positive may not work and may also not be forced to work.
Medewerkers die positief getest zijn, mogen niet werken en mogen ook niet worden gedwongen om te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het artikel op Zembla van 11 augustus 2020 over de toegang voor hulphonden in openbare ruimtes

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about a Zembla report that the law guaranteeing access for assistance dogs in public places is not working in practice, and about enforcement, reporting to the complaints body and courts, and awareness measures. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and courts handle complaints and criminal enforcement is possible, and said a European standardisation process is the main focus rather than an evaluation.
The College has set up the procedure to be as low-threshold as possible.
Het College heeft de procedure zodanig ingericht dat deze zo laagdrempelig mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Grapperhaus zit ernaast met verbod op gebruik softdrugs, stelt RUG-hoogleraar Jan Brouwer'

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Justice Minister whether his 19 October 2020 letter on soft drugs rested on a Supreme Court ruling, whether it wrongly implied users could be prosecuted for possession, and whether he would correct it; she also asked whether a motion on a night-time ban in public spaces adds anything to existing local powers. Minister Grapperhaus said the letter was not based on a misreading, use itself is not made punishable, the letter is clear, and municipalities already have APV powers, so the motion adds little beyond existing instruments.
No. The letter neither states nor intends that use of soft drugs is punishable.
Er is in de brief 4 niet geschreven noch bedoeld dat gebruik van softdrugs strafbaar zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Jetten over 'Wouter wilde bloedplasma doneren voor middel tegen corona, maar werd geweigerd'

MPs Bergkamp and Jetten asked the Minister of Health why gay and bisexual men are excluded from donating blood plasma against COVID-19 and what the criteria are. The minister explained that Sanquin's MSM-based selection rules rest on higher infection risks and announced that a 4-month deferral criterion will extend to plasma donations, while a RIVM study on sexual risk behaviour as an alternative criterion has been delayed.
Sanquin has informed me that the current selection criterion for whole blood donation by men who have sex with men (MSM) will soon also apply to plasma donations.

Sanquin heeft mij laten weten dat het huidige selectiecriterium voor het doneren van volbloed door mannen die seks hebben gehad met andere mannen (MSM) binnenkort ook van toepassing zal zijn voor plasmadonaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het artikel 'In adoptiezaken is verjaring ongewenst'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether he knows the European Court of Human Rights case law on limitation periods in parentage matters and how that case law will be considered in the COIA report on intercountry adoption. The minister said he knows the case law, that the Butink court ruling distinguished it, that he will not comment on the substance while appeal is possible, and that the COIA is independent and will not rule on fault or liability, though its findings still matter.
Since the Butink case is still open to appeal, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about it.
Nu de zaak Butink nog vatbaar is voor hoger beroep, past het mij niet hierover inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het artikel 'Helft minder slachtoffers moord en doodslag in 20 jaar'

Three MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a CBS report showing that over half of women killed in 2015-2019 were killed by a partner or ex-partner, and whether prior police contact existed and how police respond. The government confirmed the figures, said police and prosecution systems cannot provide case-level data on prior contact, and described existing protective measures and COVID-related steps without committing to new concrete action.

No, unfortunately I cannot. The police and the Public Prosecution Service cannot, based on the records in their systems, provide insight into the cases involving (ex-)partner violence with fatal outcomes in the period 2015 through 2019.

Nee, dat kan ik helaas niet. De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kunnen op basis van de registraties in hun systemen geen inzicht geven in de gevallen waarbij sprake was van (ex-)partnergeweld met dodelijke afloop in de periode 2015 tot en met 2019.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp, Özütok, Bouali en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over aandacht voor de kwetsbare positie van oa. LHBTI’s in de nationale en internationale COVID-19 respons

MPs asked the government about the vulnerable position of LHBTI people during the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands and internationally, including healthcare access for transgender people and UN recommendations. The Minister answered that impacts are being studied (Movisie survey due in autumn), referred healthcare questions to another minister, said the UN refugee camp reports were not confirmed, and described Dutch advocacy at the UN.
This question falls under the policy area of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport (MZS).
Deze vraag ligt op het beleidsterrein van de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport (MZS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat overheden regels voor toegankelijke websites aan hun laars lappen

Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary of the Interior why government websites still fail accessibility rules despite the 2018 decree and the 23 September 2020 deadline, and how this will be remedied, including missing accessibility statements, the politie.nl rating, and mobile apps. Knops answers that accessibility remains insufficient, explains the obstacles, and commits to contacting non-compliant bodies via accessibility teams, updating a priority top-10 list, and reminding bodies of the June 2021 app deadline.

To have all government organisations publish an accessibility statement as quickly as possible, all municipalities, water boards, provinces and national government organisations without a valid statement will be approached in the coming months by government accessibility teams and the expertise centre Digitoegankelijk.

Om zo snel mogelijk alsnog alle overheidsorganisaties een toegankelijkheids-verklaring te laten publiceren, worden in elk geval de komende maanden alle gemeenten, waterschappen, provincies en rijksoverheidsorganisaties zonder een (geldige) verklaring benaderd door toegankelijkheidsteams van de overheid en het expertisecentrum Digitoegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Özütok en Bergkamp over het voortbestaan van het Roze in Blauw politieteam

MPs Van den Hul, Özütok and Bergkamp asked whether police agents' workload threatens the Roze in Blauw LHBTI network, and what the government will do to protect it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Amsterdam unit is in talks with the network, that the government will monitor developments and stay in consultation with the police leadership, and that the network's expertise is secured through the Netwerk Divers Vakmanschap.
I consider it of great importance that the work of RiB continues in a meaningful way.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat het werk van RiB op een zinvolle wijze wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de mogelijkheid van één cao voor verplegend en verzorgend personeel

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the salary and career consequences of separate collective labour agreements for nursing and care staff, and whether a single CAO for them would be feasible. The Minister answered that CAO negotiations are a matter for employers and employees, that the government will ask the SER for an inventory of issues, and provided salary tables, scale classifications and background data.
In healthcare it is up to employers and employees to make agreements together on terms of employment and record them in a collective labour agreement (CAO).
In de zorg is het aan werkgevers en werknemers om samen afspraken te maken over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en deze vast te leggen in een collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst (cao).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over wijziging achternaam uit een oogpunt van veiligheid in geval van een traumatisch oorlogsverleden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether refugees and new Dutch citizens with a traumatic war past may feel unsafe because of their surname, and whether a name change on health grounds is available under the Besluit geslachtsnaamwijziging. The minister confirmed the concern, said safety is a general goal supported by municipalities and mental health organisations, and explained that Article 7 allows a name change if a expert statement shows non-change would seriously harm health.

Article 7 of the Besluit geslachtsnaamwijziging provides that a request for a surname change may be granted if the applicant shows, by submitting a statement from an expert, that not changing the surname would seriously harm his physical or mental health.

Artikel 7 van het Besluit geslachtsnaamwijziging luidt dat een verzoek tot geslachtsnaamswijziging kan worden ingewilligd, indien de verzoeker door overlegging van een verklaring van een deskundige aannemelijk maakt dat het achterwege blijven van een geslachtsnaamswijziging zijn lichamelijke of geestelijke gezondheid in ernstige mate zou schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Vrouw overgoten met kokend water in azc: 'Alle LHBTI-vluchtelingen zijn onveilig in hun azc'

An MP asked about an incident in an asylum centre where a woman was scalded with boiling water, the protection of LHBTI asylum seekers, and whether a 2016 motion calling for separate safe accommodation for vulnerable groups had been implemented. The State Secretary said the incident is under police investigation, declined to give details of individual care, and rejected categorical separate accommodation for vulnerable groups, arguing it stigmatises them.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Peters, Bergkamp en Diertens over het belang van ventilatie tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the health minister how seriously the government takes airborne transmission of COVID-19 and ventilation, and whether guidance and enforcement of building ventilation rules are adequate. The minister said the RIVM sees insufficient evidence for additional ventilation measures, pointed to existing guidance and to municipalities and building owners for enforcement, and noted that information has been published.
It is uncertain whether a specific ventilation (threshold) as an additional measure actually contributes to preventing or reducing SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
Het is onzeker of een bepaalde ventilatie(drempel) als aanvullende maatregel een daadwerkelijk bijdrage levert aan het voorkomen of verminderen van SARS-CoV-2-transmissie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat vrouwelijke ambtenaren op de werkvloer worden gediscrimineerd en geïntimideerd

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about reports that young female civil servants face discrimination and intimidation at work, and whether the government will act on the Sjoerdsma motion and investigate pay gaps. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem as serious, said culture change and consistency are needed rather than more measures, promised exploration of further steps with other ministries, and said a pay-gap study is underway with results expected in autumn 2020.
However, I do not have insight into how much impact undesirable behaviour has on civil servants, because no quantitative research has been done on this.
Inzicht in hoeveel impact ongewenste omgangsvormen op ambtenaren hebben, heb ik echter niet omdat hiernaar geen kwantitatief onderzoek is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over psychische mishandeling

Three MPs (Bergkamp, Van den Hul, Özütok) asked the ministers about how the government addresses psychological abuse, its criminal-law treatment, registration, and compliance with the Istanbul Convention and children's rights treaty. Minister De Jonge replied that existing law and the GHNT programme already allow action, that police and courts do not register psychological abuse separately, and that no specific problems are reported in prosecution.
It therefore cannot be determined from police registration how often a report of psychological abuse has been filed, whether or not combined with other forms of abuse.
Het is daarom niet uit de politieregistratie te halen hoe vaak aangifte is gedaan van psychische mishandeling, al dan niet in combinatie met andere vormen van mishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Kuiken over gedwongen gescheiden lange-afstandskoppels door corona

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked whether the government would relax the COVID-19 entry ban for long-distance unmarried partners, including a Danish-style exception, and clarified entry rules for EU citizens' non-EU partners and the online information. The minister answered that a temporary scheme for long-distance partners, in force since 27 July 2020, was introduced within health limits, that a marriage certificate is not the only way to prove a relationship, and that he will check the government online information.

In a letter of 16 July 2020 I informed your House that the cabinet, within the health frameworks relating to Covid-19, found a possibility to arrive at a temporary adjusted scheme for partners in long-distance relationships.

Bij brief van 16 juli 2020 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat het kabinet, binnen de gezondheidskaders met betrekking tot Covid-19, een mogelijkheid heeft gevonden om te komen tot een tijdelijke aangepaste regeling voor geliefden in een langeafstandsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over onderzoek naar de legitieme portie in het erfrecht

Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the legitimate portion (legitieme portie) in inheritance law should be abolished or revised, given family conflicts and changing family structures. The Minister defended testamentary freedom as the starting point but kept the legitimate portion, citing limited public demand for change, and declined to commission new research while a Radboud University study on public support is pending.
No broadly shared, urgent need has been shown to amend the legislation on this point.
Niet is gebleken van een breed gedragen, dringende noodzaak om op dit punt tot aanpassing van wetgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar daders van geweld tegen LHBTI’s

An MP (D66) asked ministers of Justice and of Education about a planned study into perpetrators of violence against LHBTI people, school diversity education, and online hate speech enforcement. The ministers committed to an updated study focused on the G4 municipalities, but declined to judge teaching materials and deferred to schools and the Public Prosecution Service on capacity and enforcement.
Given freedom of education and expression, the school autonomy and the professional space of teachers, the government does not consider it appropriate to judge teaching materials.
Het past de regering, gezien de vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren, niet een oordeel te geven over leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het eerder openen van coffeeshops

An MP asked why coffeeshops were not allowed to reopen with full hospitality like other catering businesses on 1 June 2020, and whether this caused nuisance or illegal trade. The minister explained that gradual reopening was needed to control the virus, that coffeeshops were allowed to reopen from 1 July under the same conditions as regular hospitality, and that no signals of nuisance or illegal trade had been received.
This means coffeeshops may also open from 1 July, including for the hospitality function, under the same conditions as regular hospitality.
Dit betekent dat de coffeeshops ook per 1 juli open mogen, ook voor de horecafunctie, onder dezelfde voorwaarden als de reguliere horeca.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bergkamp over het maximaal aantal afwezigheidsdagen in verpleeghuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the rules limiting nursing home residents to 42 leave days a year (maximum two weeks at a time) unduly restrict family care, and whether the rules could be made more flexible. The minister acknowledged the limits, said exceptions can be arranged case by case and that the NZa is willing to discuss adjusting the rules, but kept the basic principles of part-time stay unchanged.
The NZa has informed me that it is willing to discuss bottlenecks in the rules and conditions on funding of absence days with care offices and care providers and, where necessary, adjust them.

De NZa heeft mij laten weten bereid te zijn om met zorgkantoren en zorgaanbieders/ brancheverenigingen knelpunten in de regels en nadere voorwaarden rondom de bekostiging van de afwezigheidsdagen te bespreken en zo nodig aan te passen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht dat Amsterdam streeft naar nul nieuwe hiv-infecties in 2026

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care about Amsterdam's goal of zero new HIV infections by 2026, PrEP subsidy capacity and waiting lists, and whether a national plan is needed. The minister welcomed Amsterdam's ambition but said zero new infections is not achievable in the short term, rejected a dedicated national plan and expansion of the PrEP scheme for now, and pointed to a pilot evaluation and annual report later.
I do not intend to expand the scheme.
Ik heb niet het voornemen de regeling uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and Social Affairs about the economic and care impacts of the coronavirus crisis on women, including gender-impact checks on support measures. The minister answered that the evidence is mixed, that no specific gender-targeted policy is currently needed, and that the government will monitor and evaluate labour-market measures with attention to gender differences.
The cabinet will monitor and evaluate the effects of labour market measures and inform the House about them.
Het kabinet zal de effecten van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen monitoren en evalueren en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een handicap in het openbaar vervoer in het licht van de coronacrisis

MPs Schonis and Bergkamp asked how people with disabilities can keep access to public transport during the COVID-19 measures, including wheelchair space loss and assistance. The State Secretary answered that the OV protocol applies to all travellers, NS assistance is fully restored from 1 June, and the working group will report later, committing to a letter and involving disability organisations.
How this will be elaborated, I will let your House know in the letter I promised at the committee debate.
Hoe dit uitgewerkt wordt, zal ik aan uw Kamer laten weten in de brief die ik heb toegezegd bij het notaoverleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Bergkamp over de kwaliteit van mondkapjes in verpleeghuizen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether nursing homes still face shortages of protective equipment and whether the quality of masks bought outside the national LCH channel can be assured, and who is responsible for quality. The minister answered that shortages of face masks have eased, that the LCH has sufficient stock, and that manufacturers and care institutions are responsible for quality, with institutions able to have masks tested and to report quality concerns to the inspectorates.
The LCH indicates that there is sufficient stock to meet current demand for face masks, including for nursing homes.
Het LCH geeft aan dat er voldoende voorraad is om aan de huidige vraag naar mondmaskers te voldoen, ook voor verpleeghuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Tal van reformatorische scholen hanteren afwijzende verklaringen over LHBTI’s’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen (D66) asked the ministers whether reformed schools' statements rejecting same-sex marriage and LGBTI lifestyles create an unsafe climate and exclude LGBTI pupils, and what the government will do. The ministers answered that schools may state their principles but must respect pupils' rights, must ensure a safe climate, are inspected on civic education and safety standards, and that a curriculum revision is underway, without committing to specific new action against the named schools.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Van den Berge over de berichtgeving dat de politie en het OM steken laten vallen bij het afdwingen van het nakomen van door de rechter vastgestelde omgangsregelinge

MPs asked whether police and prosecutors neglect enforcement of court-ordered child contact arrangements, including reluctance to take complaints and the scope of criminal versus civil remedies. The Minister acknowledges the concern, says current reports are insufficient for firm conclusions, and points to an expert team reporting in October, with no concrete enforcement change committed yet.
I am awaiting their report before drawing further conclusions.
Ik wacht hun rapport af alvorens verdere conclusies te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het onderzoek Afstand en adoptie in Nederland, 1956 - 1984

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the registration process, data handling, verification of statements, retention and budgets for the study on forced adoption and separation in the Netherlands 1956-1984. The minister admitted that reports were not verified properly and some data handling did not meet GDPR requirements, and committed to extending registration to 31 July, having interviews run only by VJI, offering verification to all registrants, destroying retained reports and publishing clearer information.
I have had to conclude that registrants were not sufficiently actively asked whether they wanted to view and correct the report.
Ik heb moeten constateren dat aan aanmelders onvoldoende actief gevraagd is of zij het verslag willen inzien en corrigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de reportage 'Stille ramp in verpleeghuis: 'de ouderen gaan hier één-voor-één dood''

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about a Nieuwsuur report on COVID-19 deaths in nursing homes, covering infections, IGJ signals, protective equipment, testing, isolation, and care for vulnerable groups. The minister answered at length, citing case figures, outlining guidelines and testing policy, and pointing to earlier letters for many details.
No registration is available of the number of infected employees in nursing homes.
Van het aantal besmette medewerkers in verpleeghuizen is geen registratie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen al vroeg wilden testen maar werden geweigerd

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Diertens asked the health minister whether nursing homes were refused permission to test staff early in the COVID-19 crisis, and how testing and protective equipment guidelines evolved. The minister answered that nursing staff became eligible for testing from 6 April 2020, that testing was rationed due to scarcity, and that no data exists on refusals or on links between early testing and infection spread.
I have no information on this and cannot make an estimate.
Hier heb ik geen informatie over en ik kan ook geen inschatting maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over Friesland als niet-regenboogprovincie

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Friesland is the only non-rainbow province and whether the government would help it become one. The minister confirmed the situation had changed, as the provincial states adopted a motion on 27 May 2020 to become a rainbow province, and said the government welcomes this and will follow developments.
I am pleased that the province of Friesland is joining the cooperating rainbow provinces and in this way gives an extra boost to the social acceptance and safety of LGBTI persons.
Ik ben verheugd dat de provincie Friesland zich aansluit bij de samenwerkende regenboogprovincies en op die wijze een extra impuls geeft aan de sociale acceptatie en – veiligheid van LHBTI-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het bericht ‘Amsterdams homokoppel uitgescholden en bespuugd’

MPs Bergkamp, Van den Hul and Özütok asked the Justice Minister about a reported homophobic attack in Amsterdam, underreporting of hate crime, the use of specialised discrimination detectives, and the training of police officers on discrimination. Minister Grapperhaus said such discrimination is unacceptable, announced a publicity campaign and a national police coordination function, but rejected creating specialised hate crime units and left the police training curriculum largely unchanged.
I intend to conclude this process with a public campaign aimed at the willingness of LHBTI people to report and file complaints.
Ik ben voornemens dit traject af te ronden met een publiekscampagne gericht op de meldings- en aangiftebereidheid van LHBTI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Bergkamp en Van Nispen over duivelsuitdrijving bij kinderen en andere misstanden binnen religieuze gemeenschappen

MPs asked whether exorcism practices against children in religious communities, including alleged sexual abuse and threats, are harmful and criminal, and how oversight, reporting and independent research could be strengthened. The minister agreed such practices can harm children and may be criminal, pointed to Veilig Thuis and the police for oversight, declined a separate national study, and said he would consider a constitutional-law angle on restricting religious freedom by statute.

Given the extensive research agenda of the WODC and the number of studies still in the queue, I do not consider it desirable to start a separate study into the nature and extent of exorcisms in the Netherlands.

Antwoord 7 Ik acht het – mede gezien de omvangrijke onderzoeksagenda van het WODC en de hoeveelheid onderzoeken die nog in de wachtrij staan – niet wenselijk om een separaat onderzoek naar de aard en omvang van duivelsuitdrijvingen in Nederland op te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht ‘Wereldwijde toename huiselijk geweld door coronavirus’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports of rising domestic violence during the coronavirus crisis, including an Italian police app, the Fier chat function, a national 24/7 chat, BES islands provision, and safe shelter availability. The minister answered by reference to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MPs Bergkamp and Diertens (both D66) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and State Secretary Blokhuis (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06384) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 277).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens (beiden D66) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Staatssecretaris Blokhuis (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06384 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de dringende oproep van Per Saldo over de onzekerheden bij pgb-houders aangaande het coronavirus

An MP asked the minister how the government responds to Per Saldo's urgent call on uncertainties for personal budget (pgb) holders during the coronavirus crisis, covering protective equipment, continued payment of pgb care, the 40-hour norm, lost collective day care, natura care alternatives, and reassessment procedures for families. The minister answers that temporary measures were published, that pgb care providers will be paid until 1 June, that the 40-hour norm is being explored for temporary relaxation, and that agreed indication extensions and guidance apply, but gives no new legislative or structural change.
These agreements apply to care and support purchased with a pgb under the Youth Act, Wmo 2015, Zvw or Wlz.
Deze afspraken zijn van toepassing op zorg en ondersteuning die met een pgb uit de Jeugdwet, Wmo 2015, Zvw of Wlz wordt ingekocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het voorkomen van vechtscheidingen met mogelijke ouderverstoting tot gevolg

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about keeping the family home after divorce, a pilot involving children in parenting plans, the scale of parental alienation, the expert team's mandate, enforcement of custody arrangements and prosecutions under Article 279 of the Criminal Code. The minister answers that mortgage matters are a lender responsibility, the pilot results are due in May 2020, the expert team's report is delayed to autumn, and a national enforcement bureau is for the expert team to advise on.
The police have no data on the number of reports of unlawful removal from parental authority because such reports cannot be detected in police systems.

Er zijn bij de politie geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal aangiften/meldingen betreffende onttrekking aan het ouderlijk gezag omdat deze in de systemen van de politie niet kunnen worden gedetecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Veel transgenders gaan zelf aan de slag met hormonen, met alle risico’s van dien’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Medical Care about press reports that many transgender people self-medicate with hormones due to long waiting lists, and about waiting times, prevention of risks, and support initiatives. The minister condemned self-medication, described ongoing efforts to shorten waiting times and expand endocrine care, and committed to follow-up research and measures against illegal online medicine sales.
I have no more recent figures on the extent to which transgender people in the Netherlands self-medicate.
Ik heb geen recentere cijfers over de mate waarin transgender personen in Nederland aan zelfmedicatie doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Regelwoede pakt funest uit voor medisch onderzoek 'en is slecht voor de patiënt’’

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care whether strict rules for experimental medical research also apply to studies comparing existing treatments, whether these rules are in balance, why independent research has become much more expensive, and whether a clearer interpretation of privacy law (AVG) is needed. The Minister answered that the WMO applies only when extra risks or burdens are imposed, that much of the added burden stems from field standards and local interpretation rather than the law itself, that a study on lighter review for low-risk research is underway, and that a revised code of conduct for health research is being prepared by 2021 with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Hard figures on the extent of the cost increase are, however, not known to me.
Harde cijfers over om welke toename van de kosten het gaat zijn mij echter niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Acuut gevaar voor zorg door tekort aan medische hulpmiddelen’

An MP asked the minister whether the EU medical device regulation risks shortages of notified bodies and devices, and what steps were taken to prevent harm to patient care. The minister answered that capacity is sufficient for now, transition periods apply, and an exemption and prioritisation tools exist, while rejecting a reporting obligation for manufacturers.
At present I foresee no major risks in the number of designated notified bodies, but I am closely monitoring the situation to prevent the availability of devices for patients from being jeopardised.

Op dit moment voorzie ik geen grote risico’s in het aantal aangewezen notified bodies, maar ik volg de situatie nauwlettend om te voorkomen dat de beschikbaarheid van hulpmiddelen voor de patiënt in het gedrang komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Snel oplossing voor intensieve kindzorg’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that parents of children needing intensive care are losing or facing reduced personal budgets (PGB) under the Zvw, and whether this reflects a rule change or a shift to youth care. The minister answers that no regulation changed, insurers only clarified wording on network care, and agreed with stakeholders on short-term and structural steps including a clarified professional norm by 1 May.
There have been no changes in regulations.
Er zijn geen aanpassingen in regelgeving geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht ‘Financiële sector loopt miljarden mis door focus op de man als klant’

Two MPs (D66) asked the Finance Minister about a report that the financial sector misses large sums by focusing on men as customers, including gender differences in products, lending and advice. The minister said a broader focus on women is plausible and commercially sensible, noted that advisers must consider relevant life circumstances, and said he will address the issue within the Consumer Choices Action Plan.
I will also address this point within the framework of the Consumer Choices Action Plan.
Ik zal dit punt ook in het kader van het Actieplan Consumentenkeuzes adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over genderspecifieke gezondheidszorg

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Medical Care about sex differences in drug trials, dosing, side effects, and hormonal contraception, and about the knowledge programme on gender and health. The minister replied that drug registration reviews show trial populations are not always representative, that subgroup analyses and SmPC information cover sex differences where clinically relevant, and that the CBG will share its review and encourage better data dissemination, without committing to a new EMA dosing requirement.
I will ask the CBG to draw attention to the importance of better disclosing the available data on drug effects in women in the EPAR and in the SmPC, where clinically relevant.
Ik zal het CBG vragen het belang onder de aandacht te brengen om in de EPAR en in de SmPC – waar klinisch relevant – de beschikbare data over geneesmiddeleffecten bij vrouwen beter te ontsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Schonis over de inzet van crashtestdummy’s

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether crash test dummies, which vary in stiffness and flexibility, reflect differences between men and women, and whether EU rules test cars on dummies representative of women. The minister confirmed the dummy differences and said EU type approval uses average 50th-percentile male-sized dummies, that Euro NCAP adds small-adult and child dummies, that the EU will broaden testing and introduce a 5th-percentile dummy from 2022, and that the Netherlands will keep pushing for representative and diverse dummies.

The Netherlands is already actively working within the European Union and Euro NCAP for the highest possible safety level, including through the use of as representative and diverse crash test dummies as possible.
Nederland zet zich binnen de Europese Unie en Euro NCAP al actief in voor een zo hoog mogelijk veiligheidsniveau, ook door het gebruik van zo representatief en divers mogelijke crashtestdummy's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen vrouwen vergt een Nationaal Coördinator’

An MP asked ministers about a report calling for a National Coordinator on violence against women, including prevalence figures, budgets, police stalking detection and coordination between ministries. The minister answered that the figures are known, that responsibility is shared across departments and municipalities with existing programmes and budgets, and that coordination is sufficient, promising a GREVIO-related review and a stalking-training trajectory.
I am of the view that coordination between the ministries is given sufficient shape with this.
Ik ben van mening dat de coördinatie tussen de ministeries hiermee voldoende vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul en Bergkamp over de gemeentelijke basisadministratie voor kinderen van transgenders

MPs asked whether a transgender parent's gender change should also be reflected in their child's birth certificate and what children can do about the discrepancy with the BRP. The minister replied that the birth certificate is not amended after a parent's change, that the BRP may show the parent's new first name, and pointed to documentary and BRP-based ways to show the link.
Following these parliamentary questions, the government website information has been expanded to address these options.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen is in de informatie op de website van de rijksoverheid aandacht besteed aan deze mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘‘Nu Niet Zwanger’-programma moet wel vrijwillig zijn’

An MP from D66 asked the health minister whether the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, which discusses pregnancy wishes and contraception with vulnerable women and men, guarantees voluntariness and avoids coercion or stigma, and asked about protocols, target group, training and the monitor. The minister answered that the programme is voluntary, that safeguards are built in through subsidy conditions, access criteria, a regional implementation process and training, and that a separate independent monitor is being set up, but did not commit to sharing protocols because the methodology is not written as one.
The methodology itself has not been translated into a protocol, precisely to encourage and safeguard tailored work.
Deze methodiek zelf is niet door vertaald in een protocol, juist ook om maatwerk te stimuleren en te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsinformatie voor mensen met een auditieve beperking ook in crisissituaties

An MP asked the government how public information, including crisis communications and televised statements, can be made accessible to people with hearing impairments. The ministers pointed to existing accessibility rules, transcripts of press conferences, live sign-language interpretation of the PM's weekly talk, and a joint approach with stakeholders for crisis situations, promising to inform parliament shortly.
Your House will be informed of the progress in the short term.
Uw Kamer wordt op korte termijn over de voortgang geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het weigeren van een lesbisch stel voor KID door het Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam

An MP asked whether Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam refuses KID (donor insemination) to lesbian and single women, and whether this breaches equal treatment law, and what patients and government can do. The minister replied that the hospital does not offer KID and refers all women seeking it elsewhere, so no differential treatment occurs, that complaints can go to the hospital complaints officer or the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Because there is no unequal treatment in this case, I see no reason to enter into consultation with Franciscus Gasthuis.
Omdat er in deze casus geen sprake is van ongelijke behandeling, zie ik geen aanleiding om met het Franciscus Gasthuis in overleg te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Menstruatiearmoede: geen geld voor maandverband, dan maar wc-papier’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the government about reports that some young women in the Netherlands cannot afford menstrual products, and whether the government would investigate price barriers, identify at-risk groups, change VAT or adopt a free-provision policy like Scotland's. The Secretary of State answered that the government supports an integrated poverty approach, points to school sex education, a planned handreiking for schools and municipal support, and declined to commission separate price research.
Are you willing to conduct further research into the extent to which the price of menstrual products hinders access to these products for people living near the poverty line?
Bent u bereid nader onderzoek te doen naar in welke mate de prijs van menstruatieproducten de toegankelijkheid van deze producten belemmert voor mensen die rond de armoedegrens leven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘COA lijkt te stoppen met consequente beschermde opvang LHBTQ-asielzoekers’

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen asked whether the COA closed the dedicated LHBTQ unit in Ter Apel, how this squares with a 2016 motion, and whether separate shelter is still needed. The State Secretary answered that the COA does not run dedicated LHBTQ shelter, prefers not to group specific groups, but tries to place residents with similar backgrounds within a location and can transfer people when unsafe; the answers to most questions refer back to answer 2.
The COA does not have protected shelter for LHBTQ residents.
Het COA beschikt niet over beschermde opvang voor LHBTQ bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Allah verafschuwt homoseksualiteit, leren kinderen op islamitische basisscholen’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether Islamic primary schools teaching that Allah abhors homosexuality, and related lesson material, are acceptable, and whether the Inspectorate will intervene. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate is investigating, that schools have constitutional freedom within the democratic rule of law, and that teaching material must respect basic democratic values, deferring judgment on the specific material until the inspection report.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het stoppen met het herindicatie circus voor mensen met een chronische aandoening of een beperking

MPs Bergkamp, Raemakers and Slootweg asked whether the one-time diagnosis rule for chronically ill people (no repeated reassessments) would apply equally to Wmo and Jeugdwet support, and what would be done about repeated re-indication for blind people and people with disabilities. The minister answered that the Zvw change covers only health insurance, that Wmo and youth support require individual assessment, and that the VNG will survey municipal practice without a uniform legal change.
For young people with a disability, the need for help will change over time, and it is desirable to reassess the required help to best match their needs.
Voor jongeren met een beperking zal met het verstrijken van de tijd de hulpvraag veranderen en is het wenselijk de benodigde hulp opnieuw te inventariseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de (on)toegankelijkheid van speeltuinen voor kinderen met een beperking

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Health about the inaccessibility of playgrounds for children with disabilities, citing a commitment to make half of municipalities have an accessible playground, and asked for data and further steps. The minister answered that no national figures exist, pointed to VNG-led learning networks and a Handreiking Samen Spelen, and promised to report on it in the next progress report due before summer 2020.
Figures on this are not available (nationally).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het fiscaal aftrekken van de kosten voor het telen van eigen cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Supreme Court ruling that home-grown medicinal cannabis costs are tax-deductible when prescribed, and what it means for home-cultivation policy, police enforcement and local triangle agreements. The minister answered that the ruling is a tax matter only, does not change criminal enforcement or pharmacy-based medicinal cannabis policy, and that local triangles set their own priorities, and gave an update on the research motions.
The Supreme Court ruling changes nothing about the fact that cultivating cannabis is prohibited under the Opium Act.
De uitspraak van de Hoge Raad verandert niets aan het feit dat het telen van cannabis op grond van de Opiumwet is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de onbereikbaarheid van aangepaste rolstoelwoningen

Two D66 MPs asked why a patient was refused an accessible wheelchair home due to age, and about accessibility policy under the UN disability convention and related housing rules. The minister said the patient has since been offered a suitable home, that corporations may label dwellings for specific groups on objective grounds, and that no further signals of wrongful refusals were received, while promising to discuss any such cases with Aedes and stating that no national definition of a wheelchair home exists.
I have not received any further signals.
Er hebben mij niet meer signalen bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de rol die transferverpleegkundigen en transferbureaus spelen in persoonsgerichte zorg

Two D66 MPs asked about the role of transfer nurses and transfer agencies in person-centred care, including staff numbers, opening hours, and coordination with municipalities under the Wmo. The minister said there is no good overview of transfer nurse numbers, that the sector is mainly hospital-based, and that he will ask V&VN and VNG about local agreements with municipalities.
There is no good overview of the number of transfer nurses and the number of full-time equivalents.
Er is geen goed overzicht van het aantal transferverpleegkundigen en het aantal fte's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het (aankomende) tekort aan verpleeghuisplekken

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Health about the expected shortage of nursing home places, waiting lists (including for zzp 4), partner admission rules, supervision, and the 2020 tariff revision. The Minister answered most questions with figures and explanations, referred some data to earlier letters, said there is no national registration of partner-admission waits, and committed to a further letter ahead of the budget debate.
I do not have the requested information, because there is no national registration of the preferences and possible waiting times of partners wishing to be admitted.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie, omdat er geen landelijke registratie plaatsvindt van de voorkeuren en eventuele wachttijden van partners met opnamewens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verstopte route naar het verpleeghuis waardoor duizenden minder weerbare ouderen wachten op een plek

An MP asked the health minister about long waiting times for nursing-home places, the treeknorm, NZa warnings about Wlz budget shortfalls and a hospital's struggle to place elderly patients. The minister acknowledged the figures, said most actively mediated clients are placed within the norm, and promised a further letter on measures and the Wlz budget.
During the Langer Thuis debate of 25 September I committed to inform you by letter, before the budget debate, about additional measures.
Ik heb tijdens het debat Langer Thuis van 25 september toegezegd nog vóór de begrotingsbehandeling u per brief te informeren over aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de (on)mogelijkheid voor volwassenen om geadopteerd te worden

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why adults can only be adopted in exceptional circumstances, whether data on demand exist, which countries allow adult adoption, what objections exist, and when the WODC study on simple adoption will be ready. The Minister saw no reason to change the law, citing that adoption is a child-protection measure and that adult adoption could enable circumvention of rules on inheritance, nationality and migration, while noting courts have occasionally allowed it on individual grounds and the WODC study is expected by year-end.
I see no reason for a change in the law.
Ik zie geen reden tot een wetswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Hermans en Laan-Geselschap over het af en toe in een instelling kunnen verblijven van ouderen en gehandicapten

Three MPs asked the minister about respite and part-time residential care (logeerzorg and deeltijdverblijf) for elderly and disabled people, including pilot results, administrative burden, and the fixed co-payment from 1 January 2020. The minister answered in detail on pilots, bureaucracy reduction for carers, and the Wlz co-payment change, while deferring the final pilot results to November and not addressing the Wmo case fully.
For that reason, research is currently being conducted via the national panel of MantelzorgNL and ANBO into the need for structural respite care.
Om die reden wordt momenteel onderzocht via het landelijke panel van MantelzorgNL en ANBO wat de behoefte is aan structurele logeerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over een  slachtoffer van homofobe bedreigingen dat  zelf de dader moest opsporen

MPs asked the Justice Minister how police could ignore long-running homophobic threats even after the victim supplied the offender's details, and what policy will raise reporting and prosecution of discrimination and strengthen the Roze in Blauw network and LHBTI training. The minister agreed the case should have been handled more carefully, said he cannot comment on individual cases, and listed an action plan, a WODC study on hate crime, and planned police training measures.
I am of the view that this case should have been handled more carefully; the police share this view.
Ik ben van mening dat deze zaak zorgvuldiger had moeten worden behandeld, de politie deelt deze mening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van twee wietplanten uit de tuin van een ouder echtpaar door de politie

An MP asked the ministers about police removal of two cannabis plants from an elderly couple's garden, the proportionality of medicinal cannabis policy, the availability and cost of medicinal cannabis oil, and whether individual exemptions could be granted. The minister answered that policy is set within international and national frameworks, that five plants or fewer are generally not prosecuted but are seized, that no individual exemptions will be granted beyond legal needs, and that the BMC will discuss further steps with patients and analyse samples.
We cannot go into the content of an individual report to Meld Misdaad Anoniem.
Wij kunnen niet ingaan op de inhoud van een individuele melding bij Meld Misdaad Anoniem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het moeilijke wijzigen van een achternaam, zelfs voor slachtoffers van misbruik

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the difficulty and cost of changing a surname, especially for victims of incest, and about procedures, waiting times, fees and the C1 hardship route. The minister answered in detail, explained the legal criteria and fee structure, and announced a simplification of the procedure for incest victims and a possible single counter for first and surname changes.
I intend to adjust the procedure in these cases so that the victim can themselves submit medical documents showing mental or physical harm.
Ik ben voornemens de werkwijze in deze gevallen aan te passen, zodat het slachtoffer zelf medische stukken kan overleggen waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van geestelijke of lichamelijke hinder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat ruim 200 gemeenten drugsgebruik op straat verbieden terwijl het van de wet mag

An MP asked whether municipal bans on drug use in public spaces conflict with the Opium Act, which does not criminalise use, and whether a general ban is preferable to area-specific bans. The minister replied that municipalities may ban public drug use under their local ordinances without conflicting with the Opium Act, and that the choice of approach is for local authorities to make.
Municipalities are competent under articles 121 and 149 of the Municipalities Act to make (supplementary) ordinances, insofar as these do not conflict with higher regulations.
Gemeenten zijn op grond van artikel 121 en 149 van de Gemeentewet bevoegd tot het maken van (aanvullende) verordeningen, voor zover deze niet in strijd zijn met hogere regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het vreemde onderscheid tussen de burgerlijke staten ‘ongehuwd’, ‘gescheiden’ en ‘gehuwd’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why civil status categories 'unmarried', 'divorced' and 'married' are kept, and whether 'unmarried' should become 'single'. The minister answered that the distinction is needed for civil registry accuracy and legal consequences of divorce, and does not agree to change the categories.
The distinction matters because it must be possible to establish that a marriage existed from which the spouses derived rights and obligations.
Het onderscheid is van belang omdat vastgesteld moet kunnen worden dat er een huwelijk heeft bestaan waaraan de echtgenoten rechten en plichten ontleenden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat er minder festivals georganiseerd moeten worden om drugsgebruik tegen te gaan

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister whether he still stands by his remark that fewer festivals should be organised to curb drug use, and whether festivals are a municipal matter. The minister said he does not advocate fewer festivals but that organisers and local authorities should weigh whether the ban on hard drugs can be enforced before a festival is permitted, and that he will consult the parties on a more uniform approach.
I am not advocating a reduction in the number of festivals as such.
Ik pleit niet voor een afname van het aantal festivals als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Honderd Cubanen lopen illegale mars voor homorechten: 'Historisch moment'’

MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that Cuban police arrested demonstrators at an unauthorised LGBTI rights march, and whether this changes the Dutch policy that LGBTI Cubans can generally return safely, including questions on monitoring, Cuban returnees, asylum statistics and a new country report. The government regrets the arrests and violence, says there is no reason to change policy since discrimination is not systematic enough to amount to persecution, will raise the issue with Cuban authorities, and holds that sufficient reliable information exists so no new thematic country report is needed.
I therefore cannot confirm these reports.
Ik kan berichtgeving hierover dan ook niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat repressie niet meer voldoende is in drugsaanpak

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice and Health ministers how they view claims that repression alone is insufficient for drug policy, including criminal recruitment into the drug market, the normalisation of drug use, and calls for evaluation or an expert commission. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch policy balances health and justice, points to prevention measures, the ondermijning funding and a closed cannabis chain experiment, and declined to set up a commission.
Setting up a committee is therefore not, in my view, opportune.
Het in het leven roepen van een commissie acht ik dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Police Can’t  Guarantee Pride Safety Outdoors - Ministry’

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Georgian police could not guarantee security for the Tbilisi Pride march, and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns and have diplomats join the march. The minister confirmed the concerns were raised with the Georgian foreign minister and that the embassy is in close contact with authorities, and said diplomats would be willing to participate.
The Dutch ambassador in Tbilisi has already conveyed my concerns about the security of the planned Pride march at political level.
De Nederlandse ambassadeur in Tbilisi heeft mijn zorgen rondom de beveiliging van de geplande Pride-optocht inmiddels op politiek niveau overgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsinformatie voor mensen met een auditieve beperking ook in crisissituaties

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about whether government information during crises is accessible to people with hearing impairments, citing an EU resolution, the UN disability convention and a WODC study. The ministers listed steps taken on NL-Alert channels and promised a plan of action on crisis communication for deaf and hard-of-hearing people to be sent to parliament after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het kweken van medicinale wiet in het Westland

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked about cannabis cultivation for medical use in Westland and why growers cannot export more freely, including whether the government would allow multiple producers. The minister replied that the single-buyer bureau (BMC) model follows the 1961 UN convention, export is capped at 100 kg per country per year, and a second grower may be contracted via European tender.
With the Bureau medicinale cannabis (BMC), the Netherlands complies with this convention.
Met het Bureau medicinale cannabis (BMC) houdt Nederland zich aan dit verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘20 jaar terug in de tijd’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the Minister for Medical Care why the government now departs from a 2001 policy that a missing male partner can be a sufficient indication for artificial insemination, and whether non-reimbursement of insemination for single women and lesbian couples conflicts with equal treatment. The Minister replied that the 2001 position concerned admission to treatment, not reimbursement under the Zvw, which requires a medical indication, and that the government will decide around summer 2019 on the role of government in funding such treatment, with insurers asked to keep reimbursing in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Bergkamp en Raemakers over het niet van de grond komen van projecten die over schotten heen werken

MPs Diertens, Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about the Nova Me care initiative that collapsed over funding divides between care domains, and about budgets and the Wlz experiment article. The minister answered that no funding is earmarked for the experiment article, that VGZ found the care not suitable, and declined to convene a dedicated meeting on lessons learned.
I have no insight into the amount of money that parties in daily practice invest in realising appropriate cross-domain care for clients.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid geld die er in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt geïnvesteerd door partijen om passend aanbod over domeinen heen voor cliënten te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over hoe de Pauselijke Geheimhoudingsplicht seksueel misbruik in de Rooms Katholieke Kerk mogelijk in de hand werkt

MP Bergkamp asked whether the papal confidentiality obligation in the Normae de gravioribus delictis could enable a cover-up of child sexual abuse by clergy in the Catholic Church, and whether the Crimen sollicitationis still applies. Minister Dekker answered that Crimen sollicitationis was replaced in 2001, that the Normae remain in force, that canon law cannot override Dutch criminal law and requires reporting to the authorities, and that the Dutch Church applies a reporting duty and zero-tolerance policy.
The papal confidentiality obligation applies to the handling of complaints of sexual abuse of a minor under canon criminal law and procedure by the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith.

De pauselijke geheimhoudingsplicht geldt voor de behandeling van aanklachten wegens seksueel misbruik van een minderjarige volgens het canonieke strafrecht en strafprocesrecht door de Congregatie voor de Geloofsleer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het functioneren van het gezagsregister
