An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior about how the Central Gezagsregister (guardianship/parental authority register) functions, including its scope, access by the Royal Marechaussee, and its use by professionals. The government answered that the register only records authority arising from court decisions, that the Rvdr is responsible for it, and that additional documents are sometimes needed, while promising to look into better information provision.
I will investigate how the information provision can be improved.
Ik zal onderzoeken hoe de informatievoorziening verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over het artikel 'Vrouwen kunnen niet autorijden en dit is waarom'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper column claiming cars are designed for men and that women face higher injury risk, and whether test dummies and data gaps should be addressed. The minister disputed the figures, argued the data show a lower mortality risk for women largely due to driving less, said representative dummies are already used, and saw no reason for new measures.
I see no reason at this time to take measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Krol over drugsdumpingen in de natuur

MPs Bergkamp and Krol asked about drug-waste dumping in nature and residential areas, its costs, health and environmental effects, and whether a legal drop-off point should be allowed. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dumping cannot be broken down by location, costs fall largely on regional and local authorities supported by national funds, and he rejects a 'drugsluikje' as facilitating crime.
It is not possible to break these registrations down by location; on the basis of the registrations it cannot be stated how often it concerned a residential area or nature area.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze registraties uit te splitsen naar locatie; het valt op basis van de registraties niet aan te geven hoe vaak het een woonwijk of natuurgebied betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert’

MPs Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked whether the Netherlands can refuse entry to US preacher Steven Anderson and prosecute or prevent his hate speech, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary answered that entry can be refused under Schengen rules and extremist speakers can be barred under existing instruments, that Dutch criminal law cannot prosecute speech made abroad, and that contact with the municipality exists, while declining to comment on other countries' decisions.
I cannot provide information about possible refusals of entry by other countries.
Over eventuele toegangsweigeringen van andere landen kan ik geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over hoe de vergoeding en het leveren van palliatieve (terminale) zorg nog altijd niet goed loopt

MP Bergkamp (D66) asks why palliative terminal care delivered on a nurse's indication is still not fully reimbursed, why uncontracted care faces lower reimbursement and authorisation requirements, and what is being done about the 24-hour care issue. Minister De Jonge answers that contracted care is fully reimbursed, that wait times for contracted palliative care are short, that the authorisation procedure should be fast, and that ministry talks with VVN and ZN on indication ambiguities are ongoing.
I regret it if the farewell of a dying person is burdened by financial or administrative hassles.
Ik betreur het als het afscheid van een stervende wordt verzwaard door financiële of administratieve beslommeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het laten aansluiten van het aanbod van BMC bij de wensen en behoeften van gebruikers van medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether BMC's medicinal cannabis supply, expanding under a tender, could better match patient needs and whether BMC should analyse samples from dissatisfied patients. The minister confirmed the tender expansion, said only a single patient (not a group) has complained, and agreed BMC will analyse samples from patients holding self-cultivation permits and engage with patient organisations, but BMC lacks capacity for large-scale analysis.
BMC has indicated to me that it is willing to have analyses of cannabis varieties carried out on samples supplied by patients
BMC heeft bij mij aangegeven dat zij bereid is om analyses van cannabis variëteiten te laten uitvoeren met samples aangeleverd door patiënten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanbevelingen van het VN-Comité tegen Foltering (CAT) voor betere bescherming van intersekse kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether intersex children in the Netherlands undergo non-medically necessary procedures without informed consent, and related questions on the UN torture committee's recommendations, the WGBO, a broad quality standard, and whether the law should ban such procedures. The minister said no such reports are known to the IGJ, referred to existing legal remedies, stated the existing legal framework already prohibits procedures without consent and that no legal change is needed, and said a broad quality standard covering children and adults is being developed.
As I indicated in the answer to earlier parliamentary questions, no reports are known to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ).
1 2 Antwoord 1 Zoals ik in het antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 3 heb aangegeven zijn er geen meldingen bekend bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma en Van Weyenberg over vrouwelijke ondernemers

D66 MPs asked why so few start-ups led by women receive investment, whether women face harder access to credit, and what government will do about it. The ministers answered that the gap is a real underuse of talent, that causes include bias and stereotypes, that no data yet exist on credit applications by women, and that they will commission research, host a roundtable follow-up and seek SER advice on diversity.
We will consider how and within what timeframe such research will take place.
We zullen bezien op welke wijze en welke termijn een dergelijk onderzoek plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de vergoeding van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen van lesbische en alleenstaande vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the Minister of Medical Care about unclear reimbursement of fertility treatment (donor insemination) for lesbian and single women, and about the Zorginstituut's position. The minister replied that without a medical indication such treatment is not covered by the basic insurance, that a decision on government financing will come around summer 2019, and that insurers will keep reimbursing ongoing cases during 2019.
Your House will receive a cabinet position around the summer on the financing of fertility treatments without a medical indication, so that clarity arises for everyone before 2020.
Uw Kamer ontvangt rond de zomer een standpunt van het kabinet over de financiering van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen zonder medische indicatie, zodat vóór 2020 voor iedereen duidelijkheid ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het kweken van wiet als medicijn

MPs Van Nispen, Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked why home cultivation of medicinal cannabis should remain illegal for patients who cannot get adequate relief from the five pharmacy-available varieties, and about the Tilburg case and the court ruling in Jeffrey's favour. The minister answered that the five varieties largely meet need, that home-grown cannabis cannot guarantee consistent quality and dosage, that the appeal against the ruling prevents comment, and that no talks with Tilburg are planned.
An urgent appeal has been lodged against this ruling. I therefore cannot respond to it.
Tegen deze uitspraak is spoedappèl ingesteld. Ik kan hier derhalve geen reactie op geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat Friese gezinnen op straat zijn gezet om een wietplantje

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether families evicted over a single cannabis plant in Friesland were disproportionately treated and whether a zero-tolerance policy could exempt small home growers. The minister said proportionality is for the courts (kantonrechter) to judge in individual cases and that local housing corporations and municipalities decide on zero-tolerance policies, so no new national change was committed.
Prior to any eviction from a home, it is always up to the sub-district court judge to assess whether a landlord may proceed.
Het is voorafgaand aan een woningontruiming altijd aan de kantonrechter om te beoordelen of een verhuurder hiertoe kan overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het steeds ouder worden van mensen met een drugsverslaving en het toerusten van zorginstellingen hierop

Two D66 MPs asked the Health Minister about rising drug addiction among older people and whether municipalities, Wlz care institutions and prevention are adequately equipped. The minister gave prevalence figures showing rises among older users, said municipalities are responsible for quality, found no signals of insufficient expertise in elderly care, argued late-life prevention is largely ineffective, and offered to send an overview of research but saw no reason for special action.
We are willing to do so. At present, however, we see no reason to take special action on this.
Daartoe zijn wij bereid. Op dit moment zien wij echter geen aanleiding hierop bijzondere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het testen van pillen op festivals levens redt

Ms Bergkamp (D66) asked whether a UK study showing drug testing at festivals saves lives should lead to festival testing in the Netherlands. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that the Netherlands already has the DIMS monitoring and testing network with about 30 locations, that festival testing raises legal, practical, technical and financial problems and would send the wrong signal under the zero-tolerance policy, and that more test locations are expected.
In the Netherlands drugs can be tested, namely through the Drugs Information and Monitoring System (DIMS).
In Nederland kunnen drugs wel getest worden, namelijk via het Drugs Informatie en Monitoring Systeem (DIMS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de mantelzorgmakelaar in relatie tot de onafhankelijke cliëntondersteuner

An MP asked the minister whether paid mantelzorgmakelaars (caregiver brokers) conflict with the free, independent client support guaranteed by law, and how they relate to independent cliëntondersteuning. The minister answered that caregiver brokers are a specialised form of client support, that local municipalities have policy room and clients must decide whether a paid broker adds value, and that such brokers can be useful, while noting that the right to free independent support must not be undermined.
However, the emergence of the market for client support may not detract from the right to free client support.
Het ontstaan van de markt voor cliëntondersteuning mag echter geen afbreuk doen aan het recht op gratis cliëntondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Deze gastarbeiders zijn oud in een land dat een tussenstop had moeten zijn’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about reports that older guest workers face poorer health, reduced AOW pensions, and low remigration uptake, and what support or follow-up is planned. The government answered that it cannot precisely estimate pension counts, that AOW reductions average about 32.5% falling to 27.8%, that care is meant to be person-centred with programmes like Langer Thuis and Een tegen Eenzaamheid, and that remigration uptake may be affected by pension levels, family ties and health care in the origin country.
I have instructed that the knowledge gained about what works and what does not be bundled.
Ik heb opdracht gegeven om de geleerde kennis over wat werkt en wat niet te bundelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Jacques werd 2 jaar lang opgesloten om te 'genezen' van zijn homoseksualiteit’

MP Bergkamp asked whether exposing people to conversion therapy to remove homosexual feelings violates current law, whether the IGJ can supervise such providers, and whether a ban for minors is advisable. Minister Bruins answered that homosexuality is not an illness so healthcare cannot aim at curing it, that IGJ does not supervise non-medical therapies but can refer abuse to the Public Prosecution Service, and that he has no data on the scale of the practice.
IGJ therefore does not exercise supervision in situations of this kind.
IGJ houdt op dit soort situaties dan ook geen toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geen M of V, maar X: voor het eerst paspoort veranderd in genderneutraal’

Two D66 MPs asked why the government changed its stance on allowing a gender-neutral (X) passport and whether it regrets earlier expectations, and asked about timing of a plan on unnecessary gender registration, whether M/V counts as unnecessary, and why the advisory commission's view should be awaited. The Secretary of State answers that a legal change to the birth certificate would be needed, that passport sex must follow the birth certificate for reliability, that the government will examine feasibility with other ministries and report before summer.
I cannot yet commit to a legal amendment, because it must first be clear what the consequences are in legal, practical and ICT terms.
Een wetswijziging kan ik op dit moment nog niet toezeggen, omdat eerst duidelijk moet zijn welke gevolgen dit in juridische, praktische en ICT-technische zin heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Bergkamp en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bestuurder reformatorische school tekende Nashville-verklaring’

MPs asked whether a board member of a reformed school signing the Nashville Statement, which denies LGBT identities, is acceptable and whether the government would act on school discrimination duties. The minister distanced the cabinet from the statement, said schools are assessed on citizenship and social safety duties, noted the hoger onderwijs discrimination rule does not apply to primary and secondary schools, and said the board was consulted and the school will keep working on an open climate.
The cabinet has distanced itself from the Nashville Statement.
Het kabinet heeft afstand genomen van de Nashville-verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Vrouwen zoeken vaker én eerder hulp na verkrachting’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Bergkamp asked whether forensic evidence collection at Centres for Sexual Violence costs victims their own-risk payment, and how to exempt such care from it. The government answered that forensic costs are borne by the justice chain, medical care falls under the deductible, and it is piloting a one-year temporary scheme to reimburse the deductible for acute-phase victims while pointing victims to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven.

We are working towards a temporary one-year arrangement under which victims of sexual violence seeking help at the CSG in the acute phase receive reimbursement of the costs incurred for the deductible.

Zo zetten wij erop in om een tijdelijke voorziening voor één jaar in te richten waarbij slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die in de acute fase hulp zoeken bij het CSG, een vergoeding krijgen van de gemaakte kosten voor het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanbevelingen van het VN Comité tegen Foltering voor betere bescherming van intersekse kinderen

An MP asked the health minister about UN Committee against Torture recommendations on protecting intersex children and whether medically unnecessary surgery should be postponed until consent is possible. The minister acknowledged the need for better collaboration and a quality standard, but declined to commission new research or a protocol, stating that protocols are for professionals and existing guidelines and parental consent rules apply.
I do not have exact figures on how many newborns do not have an immediately clear sex, how often these children are operated on
Ik beschik niet over exacte cijfers bij hoeveel pasgeborenen het geslacht niet meteen eenduidig kan worden vastgesteld, hoe vaak deze kinderen worden geopereerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de professionele autonomie van de onafhankelijke cliëntondersteuner die onder druk staat

An MP asks the health minister about pressure on the independence of client support workers under the Wmo 2015 and Wlz, including whether they may draft care allocation decisions and whether they can work across life domains. The minister acknowledges the pressure is undesirable, points to subsidies, the koploper municipal trajectory and planned talks with care offices, but largely refers back to existing rules and ongoing initiatives without new binding commitments.

I will present the outcomes of the Christelijke Hogeschool Ede research and the BCMB vision to the care offices and ask them whether, and if so how, they can incorporate this into their development agenda.

Ik zal de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de Christelijke Hogeschool Ede en de visie van de BCMB aan de zorgkantoren voorleggen en hen vragen of, en zo ja op welke wijze, zij dat kunnen meenemen in hun ontwikkelagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vervolgstappen omtrent bevallen onder pseudoniem

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about follow-up steps on anonymous births, including how confidential births are handled across agencies, costs of protected births, and whether anonymous birth should be legislated. The minister answered that confidential birth procedures are being improved with partners, a decision on de facto anonymous birth is expected before 1 March 2019, and no absolute protection can be guaranteed.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this before 1 March.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer daarover vóór 1 maart te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geen M of V, maar X: voor het eerst paspoort veranderd in genderneutraal’

MPs Den Boer and Bergkamp asked whether a court ruling allowing an 'X' gender marker in a passport means others can get it via their municipality, and what legal changes are needed. The Secretary of State answered that an X marker is only possible for people whose sex cannot be determined at birth, requiring a court order to amend the birth certificate, and that the government sees no need for legislative change for now.
In these cases, assessment by a judge remains necessary to amend the birth certificate.
In deze gevallen blijft een beoordeling door de rechter noodzakelijk om tot een wijziging van de geboorteakte te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over betere communicatie rondom de experimenten gesloten coffeeshopketen

An MP asked the ministers whether misunderstandings about the closed coffeeshop experiment, such as the belief that it automatically ends after four years, were causing declining municipal interest, and how these would be corrected. The minister denied direct signals of declining interest, acknowledged differing municipal preferences, and promised information meetings, written information to all municipalities and a registration procedure with the VNG.
We assume that municipalities will have sufficient clarity about the design and framework of the experiment once the bill has been adopted by the House of Representatives.
Wij gaan ervan uit dat voor gemeenten voldoende duidelijkheid bestaat over de invulling en kaders van het experiment als het wetsvoorstel eenmaal door de Tweede Kamer is aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het advies van het Zorginstituut Nederland omtrent financiering hoogtechnologisch draagmoederschap

An MP asked whether the Zorginstituut advice shows that covering high-tech surrogacy from the basic insurance is a political choice and why the advice request was only submitted on 24 August 2018, 156 days after it was announced. The government answered that the institute sees a precedent only where the intended parents have a medical indication, that coverage without one would conflict with the Zvw, and that the timing followed the wider Staatscommissie process, with a cabinet response to follow later.

As indicated in the answer to your earlier parliamentary questions of 3 December, a cabinet response to the Zorginstituut advice will follow together with the cabinet response to the entire advice of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.

Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van uw eerdere Kamervragen op 3 december 3 volgt een kabinetsreactie op het advies van het Zorginstituut samen met de kabinetsreactie op het gehele advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Özütok over het bericht '53 steden tekenen intentieverklaring Regenboogbeleid'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the report that 53 cities signed the Rainbow policy letter of intent, and whether non-participating municipalities could be encouraged to join. The minister answered that the scope of the 2017 evaluation is limited, that the focus is on the G50 cities, that municipalities may join voluntarily with their own funds, and that Movisie offers guidance and events.
Municipalities must themselves make funds available for this.
Gemeenten dienen daarvoor zelf middelen vrij te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht 'Voetbal is voor iedereen!'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about an open letter from LGBT+ supporters calling for more acceptance in football, and what the government will do to promote inclusion and tackle discriminatory chants. The minister agreed more action is needed, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the Sportakkoord, and said the KNVB shares the ambition, while committing only to ongoing consultation with supporters.
Yes. Question 3: In what way are you currently promoting inclusion and acceptance of LGBT+ people in sport and especially in football?
Ja. Vraag 3 Op welke manier stimuleert u op dit moment inclusie en acceptatie van LHBT+ in de sport en bij het voetbal in het bijzonder?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over de behandeling van assistentiehonden door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked the ministers how airlines such as KLM may verify and treat assistance dogs, including the lack of an official accreditation system and differences between hulphonden and emotional assistance dogs. The minister replied that Dutch law allows refusal only for disproportionate burden or safety reasons, that no accreditation system exists yet pending a European standardisation process, and that the government will remain involved in that process.
It is therefore not an absolute right.
Het is daarmee geen absoluut recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Trump administration wants to remove 'gender' from UN human rights documents’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked the government about reports that the Trump administration sought to replace the term 'gender' with 'woman' in UN human rights documents, and the implications for transgender and intersex people's legal protection. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes these US amendments as weakening gender equality commitments, that hundreds of UN and EU texts with gender language remain in force, and that Dutch protections for trans and intersex persons are not affected.
The Netherlands is working in international fora to ensure that progress made is not reversed and that agreed language is retained.
Nederland zet zich binnen internationale fora ervoor in te zorgen dat de geboekte vooruitgang niet wordt teruggedraaid en agreed language behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het mogelijk maken van hoogtechnologisch draagmoederschap voor paren van gelijke geslacht

An MP asked the government about allowing high-tech surrogacy for same-sex couples, citing clinic plans and a new professional guideline, and about the timing of a legal framework and Zorginstituut funding review. The minister answered that clinics may offer it within existing rules, that a legal framework awaits research due early 2019, and that the Zorginstituut was asked to assess funding.
The cabinet is considering a legal framework for surrogacy as part of its response to the advisory report of the State Committee on Parenthood.
Het kabinet beraadt zich over een juridische regeling voor draagmoederschap in het kader van de kabinetsreactie op het advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht de opening van nog een vondelingenkamer in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Legal Protection about the opening of another baby hatch (vondelingenkamer) in the Netherlands, its legality under the Children's Rights Convention and the Criminal Code, and the security of records kept by Stichting Beschermde Wieg. The minister answered that the government sees no reason for further research, will focus on prevention and cooperation, and will discuss with the foundation how to safeguard parentage records so children can access them later.
I will therefore discuss with Stichting Beschermde Wieg and the other involved bodies how parentage records can be properly managed and secured so they remain accessible.
Ik ga daarom met Stichting Beschermde Wieg en de andere betrokken instanties bespreken op welke wijze de afstammingsgegevens goed kunnen worden beheerd en geborgd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de gehanteerde leeftijdsgrens voor aspirant-adoptieouders

Parliamentary questions from MP Bergkamp (D66) to the Minister for Legal Protection about the age limit of 42 (and 46) for prospective adoptive parents, asking about its basis, comparisons with other countries, pleegouders, embryo age limits and whether it should be raised. The minister answers that the limits are not absolute, rest on child-welfare grounds, have no known signals of problems, and that no increase is planned.
I see no reason to raise the age limits for prospective adoptive parents.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de leeftijdsgrenzen voor aspirant-adoptiefouders te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse cultuur rond vrouwemancipatie en deeltijdwerken achterhaald is

MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Finance about a report that Dutch culture on women's emancipation and part-time work is outdated, covering women's access to extra hours, sector shortages, McKinsey's estimate of GDP gains, parental role models, pay gaps and childcare flexibility. The minister answered that the government is studying part-time work through an interdepartmental policy review, cites measures such as tax changes and parental leave, and says concrete outcomes depend on individual employers and employees.
The cabinet has commissioned an interdepartmental policy review on part-time work (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Het kabinet heeft opdracht gegeven tot een interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek deeltijdwerk (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Helft van de promovendi is vrouw maar cum laude krijgen ze zelden’

Opposition MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that women rarely receive cum laude PhD distinctions, gender bias in committees, gendered PhD regulations and tracking. The minister could not confirm the figures, cited gender bias as a likely cause, and promised talks with universities and the VSNU on bias training and monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van het schilderij Regelrecht uit de rechtbank in Almelo

MP Bergkamp asked ministers about the removal of a nude-breasted painting from the Almelo court building, whether it undermines the court's independence, and whether the samenleving seeks to influence art more. The government answered that the court board is responsible for the building's interior, that the removal was weighed against a complaint from a sex-crime victim, and that artistic freedom remains the starting point, with no general policy on art in public buildings.

In this case it is therefore up to the court board of the Overijssel district court to assess to what extent the complaints received about the painting give cause to move it from the public to the non-public area of the Almelo courthouse.

Het is in dit geval dus aan het gerechtsbestuur van de rechtbank Overijssel om te beoordelen in hoeverre er in de ontvangen klachten over het schilderij een aanleiding moet worden gezien om het schilderij van de publieke naar de niet-publieke ruimte van het gerechtsgebouw in Almelo te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het rapport Integraal Appel over de wietteelt in Tilburg is gebaseerd op drijfzand

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers whether the report 'Integraal Appel' on cannabis cultivation in Tilburg, reportedly based on a dubious single criminal-circuit source, is scientifically sound and whether its figures still shape policy. The Minister declines to judge the report's scientific quality, says it was commissioned regionally and not by the ministries, and states that the broader picture of drug crime rests on multiple sources and that policy does not depend on this specific calculation.
This concerns a confidential report that was not drawn up by or commissioned by the Ministries of Justice and Security or of Health, Welfare and Sport.
Het betreft hier een vertrouwelijk rapport dat niet door of in opdracht van de ministeries van Justitie en Veiligheid of Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de ondertekening van CIZ-aanvragen van wilsonbekwame cliënten

MPs Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about the signing of CIZ care applications by incapacitated clients, given delays and the lack of a clear rule on who may sign. The Minister defends the current Wlz signing rules, describes an interim CIZ practice accepting proof that guardianship is being arranged, and promises talks with ActiZ, VGN and CIZ and a clear arrangement, while rejecting any change to the Wlz itself.
I am in consultation with ActiZ, VGN and the CIZ to examine how the CIZ can process applications quickly without harming clients' interests.
Ik ben met ActiZ, VGN en het CIZ in overleg om te bezien op welke manier het CIZ snel aanvragen in behandeling kan nemen, zonder afbreuk te doen aan de belangen van cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport ‘Waar een klein land groot in kan zijn. Nederland en synthetische drugs in de afgelopen 50 jaar’ van de Politieacademie

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Politieacademie report placing the Netherlands at the top of synthetic drug production rests on sound data, given that its volume and consumption figures seem implausibly high, and whether the 18.9 billion euro estimate is credible. The ministers reply that several European reports reach similar conclusions, that the authors are responsible for their own method, that a new advisory body (SBO) will advise by year-end, and that enforcement is being strengthened while the government keeps a balanced drug policy.
The report by Mr Tops and colleagues is not the first or only report pointing to the Netherlands' prominent position regarding the production of and trade in synthetic drugs.
Het rapport van de heer Tops en collegae is niet het eerste noch het enige rapport dat wijst op de prominente plek van Nederland waar het de productie van en handel in synthetische drugs betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over een mogelijk incorrect politie voorschrift en de schijnbare willekeur bij het handhaven van een omgangsregeling

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked about an internal police instruction that wrongly stated a custodial parent withholding a child from court-ordered contact does not commit an offence under article 279 Penal Code, and about perceived arbitrariness in enforcement. The Minister acknowledged the instruction was incorrect, said it was removed and revised, and denied arbitrariness, noting police must establish an offence and consult the public prosecutor.
This is incorrect and not in line with article 279 of the Penal Code.
Dit is onjuist en niet in lijn met artikel 279 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Slootweg over de wenselijkheid van initiatieven als het ‘Kindergasthuis de Boeg’

Two MPs asked the government whether initiatives like Kindergasthuis De Boeg, a family guest house near hospitals, are desirable, how many exist, their costs compared with hospital stays, and how they could be supported. The minister answered that the houses are valuable for families but not a government responsibility, offered no overview or budget, and said hospitals remain primarily responsible for medical aspects.
I have no overview of the number of initiatives.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de aantallen initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat 'de naam van de kerk boven het welzijn van de mens komt'

An MP asked the ministers whether the 'crimen sollicitationis' instruction still applies in the Dutch Catholic Church, how it relates to Dutch criminal procedure and human rights, and whether the church's secrecy could enable cover-ups, and asked for talks with the bishops. The minister answered that the instruction has not been in force since 2001, announced a WODC study on broadening the reporting duty (art. 160 Sv), said the church's procedures are subordinate to Dutch criminal law, and declined a new meeting with the bishops as unnecessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat zorgaanbieders mogelijk niet de wachttijden van casemanagement dementie willen registreren

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that care providers may not want to register waiting times for dementia case management, and about the transparency rules the NZa will introduce on 1 December 2018. The Minister confirmed the 62,000 users and 2,359 professionals, said waiting times must be visible at regional level, and stated the regulation will take effect as planned despite objections from ActiZ and BTN.
To fully curb waiting times nationwide, it is important that there is structural insight into the state of waiting lists and waiting times at regional level.
Om de wachttijden in het hele land volledig terug te dringen, is het van belang dat er structureel zicht is op de stand van de wachtlijsten en -tijden op regioniveau.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Toorenburg over onnodig confronterende vragen op evaluatieformulieren voor ouders van kinderen met zeer ernstige verstandelijke en meervoudige beperkingen (ZEVMB)

Two MPs asked whether evaluation forms that ask parents who are curators of children with severe multiple disabilities (ZEVMB) about their children's self-reliance are unnecessarily confronting, and whether the forms can be changed. The minister acknowledges the questions can be painful, reports that the form has been revised so parents can skip questions with a medical statement, and says the issue will be discussed with stakeholders and the Werkgroep Wij zien je Wel.
At the second periodic evaluation, answering the questions can be much shorter via a specific ZEVMB-targeted route.
Bij de tweede periodieke evaluatie kan de beantwoording van de vragen veel korter zijn via een «afslag», die specifiek is gericht op ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de juiste behandeling bij niet aangeboren hersenletsel

Two D66 MPs asked about the correct diagnosis and treatment of acquired brain injury, including waiting times for rehabilitation and support from municipalities. The minister answered that diagnosis is difficult, that a care standard for traumatic brain injury exists and is being implemented, that waiting times for outpatient consultations average about five weeks, and that existing initiatives to improve chain cooperation are underway.
No figures are known on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat kwetsbare ouderen die hulp nodig hebben met eten deze pas krijgen als het te laat is

MP Bergkamp asked the minister whether meal assistance for frail elderly people is being denied or delayed, and which body is responsible under which law, and urged clear agreements. The minister acknowledged the importance of nutrition, explained that responsibility depends on the Wmo, Zvw or Wlz, and committed to continued consultation with VNG and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland on clearer division of responsibilities.
Clients must not be left falling between two stools as a result.
Het mag niet zo zijn dat cliënten hierdoor tussen wal en schip terecht komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over de uitvoering van het Besluit zorgvuldig onderzoek verweesde werken

Two MPs from D66 asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how Dutch archives may reproduce and publish copyrighted works, including online, and how the orphan works decree applies, in response to reports of municipal archives taking photos offline after a court ruling. The minister answers by setting out the copyright exceptions for archives and the orphan works diligence procedure, notes that no estimate exists for Dutch archives, and points to the EU EnDOW project and a pending EU proposal for extended collective licences as ways to reduce the administrative burden.
For the online publication of copyrighted standalone photographs, archives must in principle obtain permission from the relevant rightsholders.
Voor de online beschikbaarstelling van auteursrechtelijk beschermde losse foto's dienen archieven dus in beginsel toestemming van de desbetreffende rechthebbenden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de stageomstandigheden van studenten verpleegkundige en verzorging

MPs Hijink, Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the minister about NU'91 survey findings on care students' internships: underpaid allowances, high workload, weak supervision, risky tasks beyond their competence, and interns filling staff shortages. The minister answered that CAO agreements should be respected but allowances need not meet minimum wage, that schools and care providers share responsibility for supervision, that interns should not fill staff shortages, and that he will bring the report to the attention of stakeholders.
I will bring it to attention.
Ik zal het onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het ‘Evaluatieadvies van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2018’ door de Kiesraad van 17 mei 2018

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked the Minister of the Interior about the Kiesraad's 2018 evaluation advice, which again recommends letting voters with intellectual disabilities receive help from polling-station members inside the voting booth, and about the risks raised in the earlier amendment debate. The Minister answered that the ministry will examine with organisations how such help could be provided, hold a round-table in early September, and inform parliament before the end of the year.
I expect to inform the House about the outcomes of those talks before the end of this year.
Ik verwacht de Kamer voor het einde van dit jaar over de uitkomsten van die gesprekken te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het uitblijven van een besluit over de overgangsregeling voor mbo- en inservice verpleegkundigen

MPs Bergkamp and Pia Dijkstra asked why no decision has been taken on the transitional arrangement for mbo-trained and in-service nurses, and about the planned expert committee. The minister answers that no existing body can assess these training programmes on both content and level, so an independent expert committee will be set up, with results expected in Q4 2018 and the BIG II bill to follow by end 2018.
To take a careful decision on the transitional arrangement, an independent party is needed that can assess these follow-up training programmes on both content and level.
Om een zorgvuldig besluit te nemen over de invulling van de overgangsregeling is een onafhankelijke partij nodig die deze vervolgopleidingen op zowel inhoud als niveau kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Kunstmarkt schrikt van EU-regel tegen witwassen'

An MP asked the government about the EU anti-money-laundering directive lowering the cash-and-bank threshold for art and antiques dealers' customer due diligence to EUR 10,000, the reasons, implementation room, and burden. The Finance Minister answered that the threshold lowering and extension to buyers and freeports will be implemented within 18 months with limited national room, that regulatory burden will be assessed, and that the art trade will be involved, without a quantified impact assessment.
The room for national discretion in implementing the provisions concerning the art trade is therefore limited.
De ruimte voor een eigen invulling bij het implementeren van de bepalingen die betrekking hebben op de kunsthandel is daardoor beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Twintigers en dertigers trouwen minder”

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the decline in marriage among people in their twenties and thirties, and about the purpose, access and categories of the civil registry, including whether divorce status can be avoided and whether the registry should be modernised. The Minister explained the registry's evidentiary and legal purpose, denied a separate divorce register, said civil status cannot be freely chosen because of legal consequences for others, and promised to await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap results in early 2019 before deciding on follow-up.
Entering into a marriage is one of the possibilities.
Het aangaan van een huwelijk is daarbij een van de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitspraken van korpschef Akerboom over partydrugs

An MP asked the ministers about police chief Akerboom's claims that drug-related deaths rose sharply and that drug use sustains extreme violence, and whether harder sentences raise drug prices. The government answered that the death figures are not yet reliable due to registration changes, that it knows of no evidence that harsher penalties make the market more lucrative, and that its drug policy distinguishes soft from hard drugs to protect public health.
At this moment, therefore, a reliable picture is lacking.
Op dit moment ontbreekt dus een betrouwbaar beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het verslag schriftelijk overleg inzake het rapport Werkgroep liberalisering naamrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the state of naming-law reform, whether the default surname rule for children (father's name for married parents, mother's name for unmarried parents) is compatible with equality and CEDAW, and whether to allow written name declarations, double surnames, and inclusion of the working group's recommendations. The Minister defended the current fallback rule as balanced, rejected mandatory explicit naming choices and double surnames for lack of societal consensus, and said the naming-conflict question will be included in advice on multiparenthood.
I am aware of the view of the UN Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) on the current fallback rule.
Ik ben bekend met de opvatting van de Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women van de Verenigde Naties (CEDAW) over de huidige vangnetnorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Mbo'ers lossen tekorten arbeidsmarkt niet op’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about shortages of skilled workers in care and welfare, including the share of career changers and returners, the availability and cost of BIG re-registration training and exams, and whether pass rates and exam frequency could be improved. The minister answered in detail with figures, describes Zorgpact and SectorplanPlus measures, says pass rates will be published on request to the MBO Raad, and states that digitalising the exam will be decided in autumn.
I will contact the MBO Raad to that end.
Ik zal daartoe contact opnemen met de MBO Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de publicatie "Risicomanagement voor collecties" van de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

An MP asked the ministers about the RCE publication on collection risk management, incident registration in DICE, the end of the Mondriaan Fund security grant, and the tracing of stolen art and antiques. The minister answered that collection holders are primarily responsible for security, that DICE registration is voluntary so incident numbers are likely undercounted, and that the Erfgoedinspectie oversees security in state collections.
Registration of incidents in DICE is not mandatory and not all collection managers are connected.
Registratie van incidenten in DICE is niet verplicht en niet alle collectiebeheerders zijn aangesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sazias over het bericht ‘Sterke daling van potentiële mantelzorgers in de toekomst’

MPs Bergkamp and Sazias asked the minister of Health about a report projecting a sharp decline in potential informal carers and about the availability of respite care for carers. The minister acknowledges the projected need for greater support, promises concrete proposals in the Langer Thuis programme and research on respite care in cooperation with municipalities and Mezzo.
In the Langer Thuis programme I will come with concrete proposals for better support for informal carers.
In het programma Langer Thuis kom ik met concrete voorstellen voor een betere ondersteuning van mantelzorgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht 'GGD onderzoekt verdacht letsel bij kwetsbaren'

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD Amsterdam's forensic medical examinations of injuries in vulnerable groups (intellectually disabled people, elderly, children) and whether this expertise should be safeguarded nationally. The minister agreed such expertise matters, said on-site injury examination has value, and committed to asking GGD GHOR Nederland for advice and informing the Chamber about a proposal.
I am happy to adopt your suggestion to ask GGD GHOR Nederland for advice to come with GGD Amsterdam to a proposal on how forensic medical expertise can be safeguarded regionally.
Ik neem graag uw suggestie over om aan GGD GHOR Nederland advies te vragen om met GGD Amsterdam te komen tot een voorstel over hoe forensisch medische expertise regionaal kan worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat wietolie zo populair is dat gemeenten soepelere regels overwegen

An MP asked whether rising demand for medicinal cannabis oil and a Tilburg initiative easing enforcement for home growers warrant looser rules, and whether the government would consult the VNG. The minister answered that home cultivation remains illegal under the Opiumwet, that only the VWS minister can grant exemptions, and that no consultation with the VNG is planned because the regime is already well regulated.
Only the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS) can grant an exemption from this (Article 8 Opiumwet).
Alleen de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) kan hiervan ontheffing verlenen (artikel 8 Opiumwet).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over het behoud van het religieus erfgoed

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked the minister about preserving religious heritage, including church vacancy, restoration priorities, long-term funding for large monuments and sustainability measures. The minister agreed that local church visions are important, earmarked 13.5 million euro for them, promised a new multi-year instrument for large monuments to be presented this autumn, and described existing sustainability initiatives.
I therefore endorse the Ecorys recommendation on large monuments and will work with the sector to develop a new instrument, which I will present to your House this autumn.
Ik onderschrijf dus de aanbeveling van Ecorys over grote monumenten en zal met het veld een nieuw instrument uitwerken en dit najaar aan uw Kamer presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat blindend en slechtzienden in Den Haag kunnen stemmen voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen

Two D66 MPs asked whether blind and visually impaired voters in The Hague can vote independently in the 2018 municipal elections using a template and audio support, and whether every municipality should offer this, including talks with the VNG. The minister confirmed the template is permitted for municipalities but declined to press for national rollout before The Hague's pilot is evaluated, promising to inform parliament on accessibility measures soon.
I therefore consider it still too early to discuss with the VNG before the 21 March council elections whether this approach can also be followed in other municipalities.
Ik vind het daarom nog te vroeg om al vóór de raadsverkiezingen van 21 maart met de VNG te bespreken of deze werkwijze ook in andere gemeenten kan worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht op de website nos.nl van 28 januari jl. “Zorgen over Joods cultureel erfgoed buiten grote steden”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about concerns that Jewish cultural heritage outside the big cities is hard to maintain and repurpose, and whether continuity of protection is at risk. The minister acknowledges the difficulty for religious heritage, points to existing monument status and subsidies, and says Jewish heritage will be included in a forthcoming policy letter and a heritage exploration.
I will therefore also pay specific attention to Jewish heritage in my policy letter 'Erfgoed Telt', which I will send to your House in the spring.
Ik zal daarom ook specifieke aandacht besteden aan het Joods erfgoed in mijn beleidsbrief «Erfgoed Telt», die ik in het voorjaar naar uw Kamer stuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen behandelen intensief door bij levenseinde’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister how the government views conflicting findings from a university consortium and the Zorginstituut on whether hospitals overtreat patients at the end of life, and why hospital-level practice variation was not studied. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut commissioned and published the studies, that its own analysis nuanced the consortium's findings, and that practice variation at hospital level was not requested because of legal limits on identifiable data, while saying further hospital-level research is possible only if institutions share data and declining to commission it now.
The Zorginstituut awarded the assignment on the basis of this offer, and informed the researchers that it has no legal possibility to publish information traceable to individual institutions.

Het Zorginstituut heeft de opdracht toegekend op basis van deze offerte, en heeft de onderzoekers laten weten dat het Zorginstituut juridisch geen mogelijkheden heeft om tot instellingen herleidbare informatie te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘E-healthweek 2018: ‘Opschaling is altijd gedoe’’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the slow scaling of e-health innovations, the potential of blockchain in healthcare, its obstacles, and the status of the Mijn Zorg Log prototype including its possible use for personal budgets. The minister answered that scaling is a challenge involving organisational change, listed existing support instruments, said blockchain is still early-stage with research ongoing by Zorginstituut Nederland, and described a small practice trial and the need for further study before wider use.
To deploy Mijn Zorg Log more broadly, including for personal budgets, further research is needed.
Om Mijn Zorg Log breder in te zetten, waaronder voor PGB, is nader onderzoek nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Wel hier geboren, maar géén nationaliteit: 112 Amsterdamse kinderen zijn 'staatloos'

MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that 112 Amsterdam children born in the Netherlands are stateless, including whether parents without lawful residence are denied benefits and whether a procedure to establish statelessness exists. The State Secretary replied that a bill creating a court procedure to establish statelessness and an option right for stateless children is forthcoming, and that the Koppelingsbeginsel bars benefits to unlawfully resident parents while lawfully resident stateless persons remain entitled.
The Cabinet then committed to close this gap and to develop a establishment procedure on a statutory basis.
Het Kabinet heeft daarop toegezegd deze leemte op te vullen en een vaststellingsprocedure te zullen ontwikkelen op wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht 'Rolstoelgebruikers hekelen gebrekkige assistentie op vliegvelden'

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked about reports that wheelchair users criticise poor assistance at airports, the rising demand for assistance, liability for compensation, rules on carrying mobility aids, and the funding of assistance. The minister acknowledges problems at Schiphol, states that airports bear primary responsibility under EU Regulation 1107/2006, notes the ILT supervises through inspections and complaints, and explains that the per-passenger PRM charge applies to departing passengers only.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Komt Johan van Laarhoven in 2018 naar Nederland?’

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Thai appeal against Johan van Laarhoven's conviction allows preparation of a WOTS transfer, whether the government will press Thailand to withdraw the appeal, and what other transfer options exist. The minister answered that WOTS can only start once the judgment is final, that the government does not interfere in ongoing foreign criminal cases, and that the prosecution service decides on extradition and has no plans to request it.
Once the case is final, the WOTS request of Mr Van Laarhoven, as promised in my letter of 13 December 2017 to your House, will be processed expeditiously.
Zodra de zaak onherroepelijk is, zal het Wots-verzoek van de heer Van Laarhoven, zoals toegezegd in mijn brief van 13 december 2017 aan uw Kamer, voortvarend in behandeling worden genomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de uitzending van Zembla ‘Verdachte ouders’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about a Zembla broadcast on suspected Munchausen by proxy/PCF cases, including rising Veilig Thuis reports, support for doctors, the role of the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and the need for fact-finding. The ministers answered that professionals are supported through protocols, expert centres and joint guidance, that no Dutch research exists on prevalence, and that a fact-finding action plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het onderzoek “Economische’ daklozen vallen tussen wal en schip; Zelfredzaam zonder dak’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about a report on 'self-reliant' homeless people who fall between care systems, including how many exist and how the coalition agreement's call for better-aligned care applies. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said such people are not counted, attributed implementation problems to professionals' limited discretion, and promised a multi-year agenda and an update before summer 2018.
It is up to municipalities to provide shelter to all residents of the Netherlands who need it, regardless of the specific problems involved.
Het is aan gemeenten om aan alle ingezetenen van Nederland opvang te verlenen indien zij dat nodig hebben, ongeacht de specifieke problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘De muur van Mussert maakt deel uit van onze geschiedenis’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a planned demolition notice for the 'Mussert wall' and whether it could be protected as a monument, and about the timing of a review of military and memorial heritage. The minister replied that a demolition notice was filed when no protection existed, that interim protection requests at municipal level are said to halt the demolition threat, and that the review will be ready by end 2018.
The reviews will be completed by the end of 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het vergoeden en/of verlagen van de prijs van medicinale cannabis

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Medical Care whether medicinal cannabis could be reimbursed or made cheaper, and when placebo-controlled studies and the price study would be ready. The minister answered that Leiden University Medical Center's placebo-controlled study should finish around July 2018 with results in autumn 2018, and that the price will fall from EUR 6.20 to EUR 5.80 from 1 January 2018.
The study on lowering the price of medicinal cannabis has just been completed.
Het onderzoek ter verlaging van de prijs van medicinale cannabis is net afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het Rapport ‘Naleving aanwijzing dd. 7 november 2016 Stichting Careyn’

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's report on Stichting Careyn's compliance with a formal directive, including whether confidence in care quality and safety is sufficient and what the findings mean for residents. The minister answered that the Inspectorate sees Careyn on the right track, that no acute risks were found, that organisation-wide improvements are still needed, and that the Inspectorate will intervene if risks change.
Careyn has indicated that it will do everything in its power and continue unabated with implementing the action plan for improving the quality of care.
Careyn heeft aangegeven hier alles aan te doen en onverminderd door te gaan met de uitvoering van het plan van aanpak voor de verbetering van de kwaliteit van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Rouvoet voorzitter platform Divorce Challenge’

An MP asked why a platform chair was appointed to follow up the Divorce Challenge on separation, what the government's role is, and about the Rechtspraak vision document, uniform support offers, and the role of special guardians (bijzondere curatoren). The minister answered that the platform, chaired by André Rouvoet, will report in early 2018, that the government wants a multi-party approach to reduce harm to children, and that the fee issue for special guardians awaits the Van der Meer commission.
Early 2018 Rouvoet will present the results of his Platform.
Begin 2018 zal Rouvoet de resultaten van zijn Platform presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Opinie: Maak Nederland nou eindelijk eens toegankelijk voor gehandicapten’

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for Health about the implementation of the UN disability rights convention, public transport accessibility, local inclusion agendas and toilet access for people with bowel, stomach and kidney conditions. The state secretary described the five-track implementation plan, pointed to existing public transport accessibility rules and municipal Wmo duties, and said no central data exist on local inclusion agendas or toilet accessibility.
Your House will receive, as I promised in the debate, a progress report on the approach before the end of this calendar year.
Uw Kamer ontvangt, zoals ik in het debat heb toegezegd, voor het einde van dit kalenderjaar een voortgangsbericht over de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van Engelshoven en Jetten over de berichtgeving dat de nieuwe drugstest voor automobilisten mogelijk problematisch is voor mensen met ADHD medicatie

Three D66 MPs asked whether the new saliva drug test for drivers could wrongly flag people taking ADHD medication containing dexamfetamine, and whether this risks loss of driving licences and discourages necessary medication. The minister confirms the test detects amphetamine including dexamfetamine, says medicinal users rarely show signs prompting testing and can explain their medication to the prosecutor, and announces a broader exemption for medically supervised use of dexamfetamine, morphine and medicinal cannabis to be worked out with pharmacists and implementing bodies, with Parliament to be informed as soon as possible.
They will look at an exception to criminalisation for persons who use these substances on medical prescription and under medical supervision and take part in traffic.
Wij zullen daarbij kijken naar een uitzondering op de strafbaarstelling voor personen die op medisch voorschrift en onder medisch toezicht deze stoffen gebruiken en deelnemen aan het verkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over misstanden in Sri Lanka inzake adoptie

An MP asked the government about misconduct in intercountry adoption from Sri Lanka in the 1980s and about the status of promised measures to improve adoption care and quality. The minister outlined the historical division of roles, said a fuller inventory will follow later this year, and reported some international steps taken while noting that concrete legislative changes are on hold pending the controversial-designation debate.
I expect to have a more detailed inventory ready within a few weeks. It will go into more specifically how roles and responsibilities were arranged at the time.
Ik verwacht een nadere inventarisatie binnen enkele weken gereed te hebben. Hierin zal specifieker worden ingegaan op hoe de rollen en verantwoordelijkheden destijds geregeld waren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het signaal dat de doorlooptijd voor het verkrijgen van een rolstoel in meerdere gemeenten te lang is en de kwaliteit van de rolstoel

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked when the promised analysis of the Ieder(in) signal report and recent NZN/Ieder(in) complaints, prepared with the VNG, would be ready, and whether it would cover wheelchair quality, innovative solutions such as personal budgets, and long repair waits. The State Secretary answered that the analysis is planned for spring next year, will include quality and repair-wait signals, and that he cannot yet commit to a improvement plan or its measures.
The plan is to have the analysis completed by next spring.
De planning is om komend voorjaar de analyse gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Bergkamp over vennootschapsbelasting in de jeugdhulpverlening

MPs Raemakers and Bergkamp asked whether youth care organisations fall under corporate tax and which care sectors are exempt, after a 2017 article raised confusion. The state secretaries answered that youth care providers are generally now taxable since the 2015 funding change, but may qualify for the care-institution exemption if they meet its three conditions, as other care sectors can.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Te weinig verpleging voor mensen die thuis willen sterven: 'Dieptepunt in zorg'’

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that terminally ill patients cannot get home palliative nursing care and are kept in or cannot leave hospitals or hospices. The State Secretary acknowledged 17 reported cases, attributed them mainly to staff shortages and budget ceilings, pointed to NZa oversight and planned roundtables, and promised further monitoring of palliative care while stating he sees no evidence of underfunding by insurers.
I am willing to conduct further research into the bottlenecks in palliative care along three tracks.
Ik ben bereid om langs drie sporen verder onderzoek te doen naar de knelpunten in de palliatieve zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het door DUO onnodig uitvragen van geslacht van (nieuwe) partner

Two D66 MPs asked why the student allowance form for scholieren (over-18 secondary pupils) asks for the sex of a parent's new partner, which they considered unnecessary. The minister attached the forms, explained that partner income is needed for the supplementary allowance and sex is used as a check on the citizen service number, and said DUO would assess the cost of a system change before a decision that will be left to her successor.
I have therefore asked DUO whether it is possible in the short term to adapt the system so that stating sex on the form is no longer necessary.
Ik heb dan ook bij DUO navraag gedaan of het op korte termijn mogelijk is het systeem zodanig aan te passen dat het opgeven van het geslacht op het formulier niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitgifte van een invalidenparkeerkaart voor zorginstellingen gefinancierd door een persoonsgebonden budget

MP Bergkamp asked about the status of changes needed so care institutions funded by a personal budget (PGB) can obtain a disabled parking card, and about interim options. The government answered that it is coordinating with the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment on a single comprehensive regulatory amendment to be presented in autumn, and that competent authorities can grant exemptions under article 87 RVV 1990 in the meantime.
The Minister of IenM therefore aims to present you with one comprehensive amendment of the relevant regulations in the autumn.
De Minister van IenM streeft er daarom naar u in het najaar één omvattende wijziging van de relevante regelgeving voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over ondersteuning thuis voor mensen met dementie

An MP asked how home support for people with dementia is organised, which bodies oversee municipal Wmo support, and what was done on her motion to spread effective methods via the VNG. The minister says casemanagement and home nursing cover complex needs, that the NZa has no Wmo oversight role, and lists actions on waiting lists and casemanagement.
The municipality appoints a Wmo supervisor under article 6.1 of the Wmo 2015.
De gemeente wijst een Wmo-toezichthouder aan op basis van artikel 6.1 van de Wmo 2015.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het signaal dat de doorlooptijd voor het verkrijgen van een rolstoel in meerdere gemeenten te lang is en de kwaliteit van de rolstoel ook bij aanpassingen en reparaties regelm

An MP asked the state secretary whether long waiting times and poor quality for wheelchairs in several municipalities are a long-standing problem and whether an analysis and improvement plan with the VNG will follow. The state secretary replied that a signal report from Ieder(in) was only recently received, that an analysis with the VNG of it and recent complaints will be made and reported to parliament, and described the Nationaal Keurmerk Hulpmiddelen and contractual oversight by municipalities.
I have agreed with the VNG to further analyse both the report and recent complaints received by the NZN and Ieder(in).
Ik heb met de VNG afgesproken zowel het rapport als recente meldingen die bij het NZN en Ieder(in) zijn ontvangen nader te analyseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat kinderartsen afhankelijk werden van geld van farmaceutische bedrijven

MPs Bergkamp and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that paediatricians became dependent on pharmaceutical company funding, including whether they prescribe unnecessarily expensive growth hormones in exchange for research money. The minister said the IGZ will handle the case as a report and examine it, that the Medicines Act bans inducements tied to prescribing, and that the IGZ, NZa and the Transparantieregister Zorg are the relevant safeguards, while awaiting the IGZ findings.
The IGZ has committed to handle this case as a report.
De IGZ heeft toegezegd, om deze casus als melding te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de eisen van zorgverzekeraars voor het krijgen van een assistentiehond

An MP asked the minister whether health insurers impose stricter conditions for assistance dogs, whether existing users must re-justify their need, and about costs, savings and the number of approved applications. The minister replied that she knows of no such signals, that the criteria are unchanged and reassessment happens only when circumstances change, and that exact approval figures and savings evidence are not available, while pointing to ongoing studies.
Exact figures on how many applications were approved are not known.
Exacte cijfers over hoeveel aanvragen zijn ingewilligd, zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Nispen over het niet nakomen van omgangsregelingen naar aanleiding van de uitzending 'Dwaze vaders'

MPs Bergkamp and Van Nispen ask the Minister of Justice about parents not honouring custody/contact arrangements after separation, the prosecution of parental abduction, the handling of mutual accusations in divorces by the Child Protection Board and prosecutors, and whether courts stop contact with one parent (often fathers). The Minister answers that civil enforcement tools exist, a WODC study on non-compliance is commissioned for 2018, criminal prosecution is used as optimum remedium with a prosecution guideline in preparation, and truth-finding is addressed via an action plan.
To gain more insight into the problem, I have, partly following a motion by MPs Bergkamp and Van Nispen, asked the WODC to conduct research into the non-compliance with custody arrangements.

Om meer inzicht in de problematiek te krijgen heb ik, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Bergkamp (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) 6 , het WODC verzocht om onderzoek te laten doen naar het niet nakomen van omgangsregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de financiering van bijzondere woonvormen.

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior and Health ministers about financing options for collective self-build and supported living projects, including mortgage terms, municipal support, land acquisition and loan-to-value rules. The minister answered that details are largely unknown or case-specific, pointed to municipal subsidies and a Expertteam Eigenbouw review, and described no binding obligations for the executive.
I do not have an overview of how often this happens, which types of projects are involved, or what conditions are attached to such financing.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van hoe vaak dit gebeurt, om welke type projecten het gaat, en welke voorwaarden aan een dergelijke financiering gesteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands while thriving abroad, and what the government will do to keep research and production in the country. The minister answers that the number of firms has been stable, that production is under pressure due to specialisation, that the government supports life sciences policy and IMI participation, and that it is working to attract the European Medicines Agency, without committing to new concrete measures.
The research has not declined, but there are signals that production is under pressure.
Het onderzoek is niet afgenomen, maar er zijn signalen dat de productie onder druk staat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht dat Nederlanders generieke Pre-Expositie Profylaxe (PrEP) uit het buitenland halen omdat het in Nederland nog niet verkrijgbaar is

D66 MPs asked whether generic PrEP imported from abroad because it is not available in the Netherlands is undesirable, what the medical risks of unsupervised use are, and when PrEP can be made available. The minister said reimbursement is for each country to decide, a Gezondheidsraad advice is awaited before national policy is set, and unsupervised use of the prescription-only drug is strongly discouraged.
I do not want to anticipate this advice.
Ik wil niet op dit advies vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het al dan niet verplicht aanbesteden in de zorg

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Health and the Minister of the Interior whether public tendering of care in the social domain is mandatory, given conflicting reports, and what will be done to clarify it. The government answered that tendering is not always required, depends on whether the arrangement is a procurement or a subsidy, and that a working group and PIANOo support center have been set up to clarify the rules for municipalities.
Public tendering in the social domain is not by definition and in all cases mandatory.
Een openbare aanbesteding in het sociale domein is niet per definitie en in alle gevallen verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over klachten over betalingsachterstanden van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) aan schrijf- en gebarentolken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about UWV payment delays to sign-language and written-language interpreters, including unpaid invoices, VAT burdens, and poor reachability. The state secretary answered that about 1,730 invoices were paid late due to capacity problems and internal miscommunication, that all arrears have now been cleared, and that UWV will discuss service improvements with interpreter organisations and report to parliament after the summer.
UWV will keep the Ministry of SZW informed of the outcomes. On that basis, your House will be informed after the summer about improvement measures that follow from them.
Het UWV zal het Ministerie van SZW op de hoogte houden van de uitkomsten. Op basis hiervan zal uw Kamer na de zomer worden geïnformeerd over verbetermaatregelen die hieruit voortvloeien.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat gehandicapten een verklaring van een (onafhankelijk) arts nodig hebben om in attractiepark De Efteling gebruik te kunnen maken van de voorzieningen voor mensen

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that De Efteling required doctors' certificates from visitors with disabilities to use accessibility facilities, and whether this fits the UN disability convention. The state secretary answered that Efteling has since dropped the certificate requirement after consulting disabled people, that the sector association is considering a common guideline, and that only independent doctors may issue such certificates under KNMG rules.
Inquiries with Efteling show that, after talking with people with disabilities, it has now adjusted its policy.
Uit navraag bij de Efteling blijkt dat zij, na een gesprek met mensen met een beperking, haar beleid inmiddels heeft aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen in de basisregistratie personen (BRP)

MP Bergkamp asked the ministers about progress on ICT changes and legal amendments needed to register stillborn children in the BRP, following a petition and a prior letter. Minister Plasterk answered that a recalibration of Operatie BRP revealed major delays and costs, and he will inform the Chamber after receiving a BIT advisory report and deliberating on the matter.
I can therefore only inform you of the manner and timing of registering stillborn children after that.
Ik kan u derhalve pas daarna informeren over de wijze en het moment van registreren van levenloos geboren kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er steeds meer meldingen en materiaal van kinderporno boven water komen

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising reports of child pornography online, including the causes of a 60% rise since 2015, whether police and prosecution have enough capacity, the state of international cooperation, and the conviction rate from police reports. The minister answered that reports rose mainly due to growing internet use and better detection, that capacity is under review with results promised in a summer progress report, that international cooperation works satisfactorily, and that the conviction percentage cannot be extracted from police systems.
I will report the outcomes to you in the next progress report on child pornography this summer.
Over de uitkomsten daarvan zal ik u in de eerstvolgende voortgangsrapportage kinderporno van deze zomer berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met het vervoer voor leerlingen met een zorgvraag of beperking

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that school transport for pupils with care needs or disabilities is badly arranged, including how many use it, quality and punctuality data, and whether a general administrative order (AMvB) like the one for disability transport should be made. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for school transport, that the ministry has no quality picture or punctuality figures, that satisfaction surveys show high ratings, and that no AMvB is possible under current law, pointing to a handbook for municipalities instead.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport does not lie with the Ministry of OCW but with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt niet bij het Ministerie van OCW maar bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de tolkenvoorziening
