An MP asked the state secretary about decentralising sign-language interpreter provision, including municipal expertise, client choice and quality. The government answered that the Berengroep and UWV will handle assessments centrally, client choice is balanced against practical limits, and it will inform parliament further after its letter of 8 March 2017.
The current funding method for the sign-language interpreter provision via the VNG will no longer be possible from 1 January 2018.
De huidige financieringswijze voor de doventolkvoorziening via de VNG is per 1 januari 2018 niet meer mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over de mogelijkheid voor (pleeg)kinderen om het inkomen van ouders bij een aanvullende beurs buiten beschouwing te laten

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how DUO assesses requests to disregard parental income for supplementary student grants in cases of severed contact or serious conflict, including what documentation is required and whether requiring students to describe private conflicts is acceptable. The minister answered that DUO needs a range of evidence depending on the situation, that students may need to provide personal statements, that DUO can depart from professional statements, and that decisions follow the legal framework and internal work instructions.
The framework on which DUO bases a decision consists of the legal framework, made up of statutes and regulations and their explanatory notes.
Het afwegingskader op basis waarvan DUO een beslissing neemt wordt gevormd door het wettelijk kader, bestaande uit de wet- en regelgeving en de daarbij behorende toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over nieuwe onderzoek naar de effectiviteit van medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the health minister about insurers dropping medicinal cannabis coverage, morphine side effects as an alternative, exports to Germany, and the scope of research by the Zorginstituut. The minister said insurers decide coverage, cannabis remains available on prescription, and a Zorginstituut round-table will examine whether a further advice on effectiveness is possible.
It is up to the health insurers to decide whether or not to reimburse.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars om te beslissen of zij wel of niet vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de uitvoering van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about implementation of the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), including the government's stance on a CEDAW Committee recommendation to compensate self-employed women who gave birth in 2005, sexism, intersex and transgender care, abortion pill rules, sex work registration, and a conference. The government answered most questions by restating its positions, citing pending Centrale Raad van Beroep cases, and promising to inform parliament of outcomes.
Several procedures are currently pending before the Central Appeals Tribunal. The cabinet is waiting for those rulings.
Er lopen nu enkele procedures bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep. Die uitspraken wacht het kabinet af.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bergkamp over het aanvragen van een invalidenparkeerkaart door zorginstellingen die niet onder de Wet Toelating Zorginstellingen (WTZi) vallen

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Health about care institutions not covered by the WTZi being denied disabled parking permits, and whether an exception should be created. The state secretary said the permit rules sit with the Infrastructure ministry and that he wants no distinction by funding route and will examine with that ministry whether the regulation can be amended.
I will examine together with Infrastructure and Environment whether the regulations can be adjusted on this point.
Ik zal samen met Infrastructuur en Milieu bezien of de regelgeving op dit punt kan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er te weinig aandacht is voor mannen die door vrouwen worden mishandeld en misbruikt

An MP asked the government about the lack of attention and data on men who are abused or assaulted by women, including prevalence, shelter, and prevention. The state secretary answered that a prevalence study is due end-2017, that men-specific shelter exists in 40 places, and promised to highlight male victims in an existing public campaign.
The study is expected to be completed at the end of 2017.
Het onderzoek wordt naar verwachting eind 2017 afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht: “Medewerkers van verpleeghuis De Bleerinck in Emmen slaan alarm. Constant het gevoel dat ik tekortschiet”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that staffing and care hours at nursing home De Bleerinck were cut, raising concerns about safe care, unpaid breaks, and budget cuts. The secretary said the care board is primarily responsible, the Inspectorate will monitor the situation, and the claim of major long-term care budget cuts is incorrect, citing spending figures.
When the Inspectorate is of the view that there is insufficient, or insufficiently qualified, staff available, the IGZ will intervene.
Wanneer de Inspectie van mening is dat er onvoldoende, of onvoldoende gekwalificeerd personeel beschikbaar is, zal de IGZ ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het kwaliteitskader van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming

An MP asked about changes to the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming's 2016 quality framework, including whether obligatory safeguards for parents were removed. The State Secretary denied that reporting rules were reduced, explained removed or changed provisions as giving professionals discretion, and said the Child Protection Council's client council was consulted.
It is not correct that the changes have led to a reduction in the rules to which a report must comply.
Het is niet juist dat de wijzigingen hebben geleid tot inkorting van de regels waaraan een rapportage moet voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat pleegkinderen na hun 18e verjaardag vaak in de knel komen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that foster children often struggle after turning 18, including whether municipalities may stop youth care without a conversation and how responsibility is shared between municipalities. The State Secretary answers that the Youth Act allows care to continue until age 23, that municipalities must hold timely conversations, and that a national work agenda, a Action Plan on foster care and a coordination point for complex cases are being developed.

It is up to municipalities, in consultation with foster parents, foster children, the foster care provider and possibly the family guardian, to assess what is necessary and desirable for the 18-year-old.
Het is aan gemeenten om in overleg met pleegouders, pleegkinderen, de pleegzorgaanbieder en eventueel de gezinsvoogd tot een beoordeling te komen wat nodig en wenselijk is voor de 18-jarige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat burgemeester van der Laan vasthoudt aan de sluiting van acht coffeeshops

MPs Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Amsterdam's mayor insisting on closing eight coffee shops near schools, including the legal basis of an earlier informal agreement with the minister's predecessor and whether it obliges the mayor to enforce a 250-metre distance criterion. The minister answered that the agreement was oral, concerns phased enforcement priorities, that enforcement of the residence and distance criteria lies with the mayor or municipality, and declined to judge local research or to answer on the shorter deadline.
My predecessor made an oral agreement with the mayor of Amsterdam on prioritisation in enforcement regarding local coffee shop policy.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft met de burgemeester van Amsterdam een mondelinge afspraak gemaakt over prioritering in de handhaving met betrekking tot het lokale coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake de situatie van de heer Van Laarhoven

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma ask the Foreign Minister to clarify director-level contacts with Thailand on the case of Mr Van Laarhoven, including the legal basis for transfer to the Netherlands and the reasons for his relocation within prison. The minister answers that two director-level contacts took place (by phone and in Seoul), that extradition requests are for the Public Prosecution Service and the Justice Minister rather than the Foreign Minister, and that the Thai authorities decided on the transfer despite a Dutch request to keep him in the reception unit.
Extradition requests are made by the Minister of Justice and Security, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service.
Uitleveringsverzoeken worden gedaan door de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers about the documentary 'Grenzeloos misbruikt' on online child sexual abuse, covering police undercover and honeypot powers, use of decoy personas, Philippine cooperation, detection technology like PhotoDNA, and education. The government answered that current law limits deanonymising darknet users, that pending bill Computercriminaliteit III would add powers, that decoy personas are permitted under the Tallon criterion, and described ongoing cooperation and education efforts.
Current legislation offers little to no possibility to de-anonymise users in the relevant environments on the TOR network.
De huidige wetgeving biedt weinig tot geen mogelijkheden om de gebruikers op de bedoelde omgevingen op het TOR-netwerk te de-anonimiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Swinkels over "de lange weg van Isis naar Isabella" over de moeite die het kost om controversiële voornamen te kunnen wijzigen

Two D66 MPs asked why changing a controversial first name requires a costly court procedure and whether it could be simplified as the 2009 naming-law working group recommended. The minister defended court review for minors, explained the historical and functional differences with surname changes, and declined to revisit the earlier decision, though a future cabinet might consider it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het stopzetten van internationaal draagmoederschap

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the government about reports that countries such as Cambodia are halting international surrogacy, the number of Dutch citizens affected, the legal position of intended parents and children, and whether a transitional arrangement is needed. The minister answered that no overview or data exists, that legal parentage is assessed case by case under Dutch law, and that a surrogacy regime is being considered in response to the Staatscommissie report, without committing to a transitional arrangement.
I do not have an overview of countries where international surrogacy exists, is threatened to be halted, or has been halted.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van landen waar internationaal draagmoederschap bestaat, dreigt te worden stopgezet of is stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Volp over het ‘pleidooi voor meer aandacht bij politieopleidingen voor het omgaan met slachtoffers van seksueel geweld’ van de Pimp de Troonrede-winnares

MPs Bergkamp and Volp asked the Minister of Justice and Security about calls for more police training on handling victims of sexual violence, reported sexual violence complaints, the new sexual offences directive, and whether complaints are taken seriously. The minister replied that complaints rose slightly in 2016, that police are trained and refer cases to specialised Team Zeden units, and that research on reporting reluctance is under way with results expected mid-2017.
Whether or not to file a complaint is therefore not an end in itself but must be seen within a broader package of means available to the victim.
Het al dan niet doen van aangifte is dan ook niet een doel op zich maar moet worden gezien in een breder pakket van middelen die ter beschikking van het slachtoffer staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het door de fiscus meetellen van een PGB-restant voor de vermogenstoets voor toeslagen

Two D66 MPs asked whether a leftover personal budget (pgb) owed back to a care office can count as debt under the box 3 wealth test and whether this wrongly makes some recipients lose housing benefit. The government confirmed the pgb remainder can be declared as debt above the 3,000 euro threshold, but agreed to a hardship arrangement via the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen for affected cases and to a ministerial regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het bericht over de situatie van Johan van Laarhoven en zijn vrouw Tukta

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister why he judged it not in the interest of Johan van Laarhoven to raise his detention in Thailand now, and what contact and advice the embassy provided. The minister replied that he is well informed, that the embassy visits and raises his detention and health with Thai authorities, that consular help to his Thai-national wife is not possible, and that transfer to the Netherlands cannot occur until the Thai appeal is concluded.
The Dutch embassy in Thailand proactively maintains contact with the penal institution where Mr Van Laarhoven is held.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Thailand onderhoudt proactief contact met de penitentiaire inrichting waar de heer Van Laarhoven verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over draagmoederschap

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why the NVOG position on donor-gamete assisted reproduction was linked to the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, whether more research is needed, and whether hightech surrogacy can be offered to same-sex couples. The minister answered that the NVOG position was accelerated at the commission's request, supported registration and research priorities, and saw no legal barrier for hospitals to offer surrogacy to same-sex couples, without intending to promote it.
Since I have no other information about the existing need, I see no reason at this time to generally promote that hospitals begin offering the treatment.
Aangezien ik geen andere informatie heb over de bestaande behoefte, zie ik nu geen aanleiding om in algemene zin te bevorderen dat ziekenhuizen de behandeling gaan aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het (her)indiceren, binnen de Wmo, via de computer

An MP asked whether municipalities may assess and re-assess Wmo care needs via computer instead of face-to-face 'kitchen table' interviews, and whether the minister considers this consistent with tailored care. The minister answered that clients may in some cases use a digital procedure but are not obliged to, that municipalities must still meet Wmo 2015 requirements, and that he has no overview of how many municipalities use computers for this and sees no reason to investigate.
I have no insight into the number of municipalities that use the computer to carry out the investigation set out in article 2.3.2 Wmo 2015.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal gemeenten dat de computer inzet bij het uitvoeren van het in 2.3.2 Wmo 2015 opgenomen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over problematiek rondom onveilige scootmobiels

An MP asked the State Secretaries about accidents with three-wheeled mobility scooters, whether councils wrongly issue them instead of safer five-wheeled models, and how scooters are checked for safety. The government answered that causes are multifactorial, a SWOV study is ongoing with results expected end 2017, and that scooters are not type-approved for road use, with councils responsible for individual suitability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de ramingen ontwikkeling verpleeghuizen 2016-2021

MP Bergkamp asked the State Secretary for Health about the projected development of nursing home places for 2016–2021, the sources and parties behind the projection, and timing of answers before a debate. The State Secretary answered that the projection is a technical estimate based on 2015 realisations, CPB wage and price indices, and assumed demographic growth, does not yet include extra 2016 funds, and that actual growth may differ or be higher.
The realisation of growth in the number of places may therefore differ from what the technical projection indicates.
De realisatie van de groei in het aantal plekken kan dus anders verlopen dan de technische raming aangeeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitzending van Argos waaruit blijkt dat Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant niet aan waarheidsvinding doet

Member Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary about a Argos broadcast claiming Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant does not establish the truth in custody disputes, and what steps would be taken, including forensic investigation and reviewing the family guardian's role. The State Secretary replied that the statutory duty to state facts fully applies, the bureau rectified its regional director's statement, existing complaint and disciplinary routes exist, and no further action or forensic expansion is planned, while a separate advisory process on forensic research is underway.
Certified institutions are obliged to state the relevant facts fully and truthfully in reports or petitions (article 3.3 of the Youth Act).
Gecertificeerde instellingen zijn verplicht in rapportages of verzoekschriften de van belang zijnde feiten volledig en naar waarheid aan te voeren (artikel 3.3 van de Jeugdwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het standpunt van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Obstetrie & Gynaecologie (NVOG) over geassisteerde voortplanting

Parliamentary questions from MP Bergkamp (D66) asked about the NVOG position on assisted reproduction with donor gametes, donor embryos and surrogacy, its status, and whether the government would engage to speed up a guideline. Minister Schippers answered that the position is a non-binding interim advice, that she sees no reason to talk with the NVOG, and that the NVOG proposes raising the IVF age limit for donor eggs from 45 to 50 with conditions, without changing insurance coverage.
It is up to the professional group to determine whether there is sufficient scientific basis to arrive at a guideline.
Het is aan de beroepsgroep om vast te stellen of er voldoende wetenschappelijke onderbouwing bestaat om tot een richtlijn te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over huwelijksdwang en huwelijkse gevangenschap

An MP asked the minister about forced marriage and marital captivity in the Netherlands, including figures, research gaps, effectiveness of interventions, recognition of Dutch divorces abroad, and embassy support. The minister acknowledged the problem, said no new figures or research into prevalence will be done and that prevention will be emphasised, referred prosecution figures to a later report, and said he will raise recognition of Dutch divorces with third countries and that embassies can only refer such cases to local authorities.

I am willing, in my contacts with third countries and in appropriate fora such as the Hague Conference on Private International Law, to draw attention to the importance of recognition of divorces pronounced in the Netherlands.

Ik ben bereid in mijn contacten met derde landen en in daartoe geëigende gremia, zoals de Haagse Conferentie voor Internationaal Privaatrecht, aandacht te vragen voor het belang van de erkenning van in Nederland uitgesproken echtscheidingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er een wachtlijst bestaat voor assistentiehonden voor mensen met een psychische stoornis en over het bericht dat assistentiehonden nog steeds niet overal toega

MPs asked the Defence and Health ministers about waiting lists for assistance dogs for veterans with PTSD and about hotels refusing access to assistance dogs despite legal duties. The ministers said waiting lists are undesirable but left them to the sector, pointed to pending independent research funded by Defence, and promised to consult Koninklijke Horeca Nederland and to raise awareness.
It is undesirable that hotels wrongly refuse assistance dogs.
Het is onwenselijk dat hotels assistentiehonden ten onrechte weigeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten getiteld “Request for initiating an investigation in Thailand” in de zaak-Van

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch consular conduct and detention conditions for Van Laarhoven in Thailand, the Thai money-laundering conviction linked to Dutch cannabis-shop revenue, and possible bias of the Dutch prosecutor. The government answered that Thailand receives extended consular assistance, that it cannot judge foreign rulings, that the Dutch prosecution is ongoing, and that no substantive irregularities were found in the investigation.
The Public Prosecution Service decides which instruments it considers necessary within an ongoing criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bepaalt welke instrumenten het wanneer nodig acht in het kader van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het onderzoek van rioolwater vaker leidend zou kunnen zijn bij het ijken van drugsbeleid

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether sewage epidemiology could be used to calibrate drug policy and detect drug labs, and about the privacy risks of small-scale sewage research. The minister answered that local authorities decide on usefulness, no order for drug-lab detection has been given, sewage research does not fall under the Dutch data protection act in normal cases, and the safeguards in the research code are considered sufficient.
In principle the Wbp does not appear to apply to sewage research because its results cannot be traced, not even indirectly, to individual persons.
In beginsel lijkt de Wbp niet van toepassing op het rioolwateronderzoek omdat deze resultaten niet (ook niet indirect) zijn te herleiden zijn naar individuele personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over zaken die te maken hebben met huiselijk geweld

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about domestic violence: whether Veilig Thuis quality covers households without children, which inspectorate supervises shelters and Veilig Thuis, PTSD expertise and treatment capacity, whether victims of stalking can adopt a new identity, the sharing of victims' addresses with suspects, police expertise on psychological abuse, and scheduling. The government answered that the inspectorates' scope covers all victims, that municipalities are responsible for oversight of Veilig Thuis, that existing care and a standard on trauma are relied on, that a new identity is not possible while an analysis of victim data use is ongoing, and that address restrictions and domicile choice protect victims in most cases.
Municipalities are therefore responsible for the oversight of the VT organisations.
Gemeenten zijn dus verantwoordelijk voor de controle van de VT-organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het aantal slachtoffers van sextortion dat explosief groeit

MP Bergkamp asked whether the rapid growth in sextortion victims is concerning, how victims can be supported, how stigma can be addressed, how criminal organisations can be tackled, and which criminal provisions apply. The government answered that the Help Wanted figures do not show explosive growth, outlined victim support measures, awareness and education programmes, Interpol-coordinated enforcement, and the existing legal options, while stating it will examine making sextortion with a sexual motive a sexual offence.
The Public Prosecution Service does not specifically register cases involving coercion or extortion with a sexual motive.
Het Openbaar Ministerie registreert niet specifiek op gevallen waarbij sprake is van dwang of afpersing met een seksueel motief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het DNA-verwantschapsonderzoek dat het OM laat uitvoeren bij een te vondeling gelegde baby

An MP asked whether the public prosecution service may use the national forensic DNA database to find the parents of a foundling baby, and whether a hielprik (heel-prick) register could be used. The minister answered that DNA kinship research is legally permitted here under the attempted-murder charge, that it is not available for abandonment under article 256 Sr alone, that RIVM invoked medical confidentiality, and that a court-authorised judicial-commissioner order is required, and committed to considering a legal amendment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de rechterlijke uitspraken over Schakenbosch

MPs Bergkamp and Kooiman asked the state secretary about court rulings that minors stayed without a valid legal basis at the Schakenbosch closed youth facility, and why the government did not intervene earlier. The state secretary confirmed knowledge of the rulings since November 2015, said coercive care requires a legal basis, and reported that the Inspectorate is assessing all closed youth institutions, with a final report and consequences promised within weeks.

My starting point is that coercive care requires a legal basis, whether it takes place in a closed youth care institution under the Youth Act or involves compulsory mental health or disability care under the Bopz Act.

Mijn uitgangspunt is dat gedwongen zorg een juridische grondslag behoeft, of deze nu op grond van de Jeugdwet in een instelling voor gesloten jeugdhulp plaatsvindt of dat het gedwongen geestelijke gezondheidszorg of gehandicaptenzorg betreft op grond van de Wet bopz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat Zeeuwse gemeenten medische gegevens van kinderen eisen

An MP asks whether Zeeland municipalities demanding children's medical data before funding treatment violates the temporary ministerial regulation and privacy law. The State Secretary says the regulation limits shared data to diagnosis groups with an opt-out, that the municipal board is responsible for privacy compliance, and that the data protection authority supervises, with only one complaint known and a final regulation being prepared.
The municipal board of mayor and aldermen is primarily responsible for ensuring the municipality complies with the legal requirements on information security and privacy protection.

Het college van burgemeester en wethouders is primair verantwoordelijk om ervoor te zorgen dat de gemeente voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Bergkamp over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie in Brabant heeft besloten om de ZSM-afdoening op te rekken naar zwaardere strafbare feiten en drugscriminelen niet langer

MPs Swinkels and Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Brabant police and prosecutors were expanding ZSM out-of-court settlements to more serious offences and no longer bringing drug criminals before a judge, and how this fits the ZSM purpose. The minister denied any expansion of ZSM, said case handling is the independent prosecution service's decision, and gave largely referential answers without confirming the Brabant decision was reviewed by him.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide, case by case and in light of all facts and circumstances, how a case is handled.
Het is aan het OM om per individueel geval, gelet op alle feiten en omstandigheden, te bepalen op welke wijze een zaak wordt afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bergkamp over legale wietteelt als positieve mensenrechtenverplichting

MPs Kooiman and Bergkamp asked whether international human rights law obliges the state to regulate legal cannabis cultivation, and about the budgetary and tax effects of regulation. The minister answered that the conditions for a human-rights-based space for regulation are not met, that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs or yield tax revenue as claimed, and that no change of course is warranted given the parliamentary majority against regulation.
Therefore I see no reason for a change of course.
Derhalve zie ik geen reden voor een koerswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Help! Mijn demente ouders worden beroofd’

An MP asked the minister how court-appointed professional administrators (bewindvoerders) for vulnerable people can abuse their role despite judicial supervision, whether judges are overstretched, and what research and complaint procedures exist. The minister said the 2016 law evaluation will examine supervision and information to judges, no structural abuses have been shown, a further study of growth in administration cases is under way, and complaint procedures and judicial supervision exist.

As mentioned in answer to questions 6, 7 and 9 from MP Krol, the evaluation of the law will specifically pay attention to the supervision of administrators and enforcement of quality requirements, including information provided to the judge.

Zoals onder meer genoemd in antwoord op de vragen 6, 7 en 9 van het lid Krol zal aan de controle op bewindvoerders en de handhaving van de kwaliteitseisen die worden gesteld aan professionele bewindvoerders nadrukkelijk aandacht worden besteed bij de wetsevaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat artsen die kinderen antidepressiva voorschrijven vaak niet de geldende richtlijn volgen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that doctors often do not follow the guideline when prescribing antidepressants to children and young people, including the choice of fluoxetine dose and a shift to citalopram. The State Secretary said there is no structural data on guideline adherence, noted that deviation is permitted with justification, cited supply limits on fluoxetine doses, and committed to discussing the issue with the professional associations.
There is no integral insight into the extent to which doctors prescribe antidepressants to young people in line with the guideline, because no structural data or information on this is available.
Er is geen integraal inzicht in de mate waarin artsen antidepressiva bij jeugdigen richtlijnconform voorschrijven, omdat hiervan geen structurele data of gegevens beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over mogelijke bedreigingen van heterogene woon- en werkgemeenschappen in de verstandelijk gehandicaptenzorg

The MP asks whether the decentralisations and the loss of zorgzwaartepakketten 1 and 2 threaten heterogeneous residential and work communities in disability care, and whether such combinations still exist. The Secretary of State reports no signals of a bottleneck, notes one institution's concern about its unique character, sees no reason for an investigation, and says heterogeneous housing with both Wlz and Wmo/Zvw clients exists nationwide.
I have received no signals that there are bottlenecks regarding the continuity of residential and work communities in disability care where clients live with different levels of care intensity.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat er knelpunten zijn rond het voortbestaan van woon- en werkgemeenschappen in de gehandicaptenzorg waar cliënten wonen met verschillende niveaus van zorgzwaarte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Wetgeving hoeft niet te worden veranderd om voor levenloos geboren kinderen een geboorteakte op te maken’

Two D66 MPs asked whether stillborn children can be registered and whether parents are informed of the option to receive a birth record, and whether a national register is possible. The ministers answered that a death-register record is made under art. 1:19i BW without a gestation minimum, that such children are not entered in the BRP, that the minister will study registration options and report before summer, and that the government has improved information for parents.
I would point out that the record of a stillborn child is kept in the civil registers and is therefore findable and consultable.
Ik wil erop wijzen dat de akte van een levenloos geboren kind wordt bewaard in de registers van de burgerlijke stand en daardoor vindbaar en raadpleegbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over het bericht dat getraumatiseerde veteranen op straat dreigen te belanden

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary for health and the defence minister about reports that traumatised veterans may end up on the street after funding problems at the Compound in Assen, and whether national government should take a role given its supra-regional function. The state secretary said funding is secured for 2016, that the municipality and the Compound are seeking a multi-year solution, that no national role is foreseen under current responsibilities, and that no further central involvement is planned.

Under the current allocation of responsibilities agreed between central government and municipalities, the national government has no role regarding an additional national arrangement for care and support for the facilities the Compound in Assen provides to veterans.

In de huidige structuur van verantwoordelijkheden die zijn afgesproken tussen het Rijk en gemeenten is geen rol weggelegd voor het Rijk ten aanzien van een aanvullend landelijk arrangement voor zorg en ondersteuning voor de voorzieningen die de Compound in Assen aan veteranen biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about information given to Thai authorities on the Dutch coffeeshop toleration policy, the Thai conviction of a former coffeeshop owner for laundering drug money, the prosecutor's role, and police testimony. The minister answered most questions in substance, withheld Thai and ongoing-investigation documents, and rejected the claim that the conviction exposes Dutch coffeeshop operators to prosecution.
I cannot provide any documents on this, as they are Thai documents in the Thai criminal investigation.
Ik kan eventuele stukken hierover niet verstrekken, nu dit Thaise stukken betreffen in het Thaise strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over gedragstherapieën voor Gilles de la Tourette voor jeugd

An MP asked the state secretary about reduced access to behavioural therapy for children with Tourette's after the Youth Act 2015, citing European guidelines favouring therapy over medication and possible over-medication. The state secretary said there were no signals of reduced availability, that municipalities purchase care regionally and supra-regionally without tracking availability, and that the professional decides treatment, with no research on medication trends planned.
In doing so, the availability per region or municipality is not tracked.
Daarbij wordt de beschikbaarheid per regio of gemeente niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Bruins Slot, Bergkamp, Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over een verzekeraar die wijkverpleegkundigen passeert met nieuw pgb-beleid

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's new policy limiting which home-care nurses may assess persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) eligibility, designating preferred organisations per region, and whether this restricts budget-holders' choice. The State Secretary answered that CZ's approach is within the agreed rules, budget-holders remain free to choose other providers with reduced reimbursement, the insurer has at least two providers per region, and an AMvB will be sent to parliament with a letter on the motion.
Control lies in all cases with the PGB holder.
De regie ligt in alle gevallen bij de pgb-houder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over overgangsproblemen tussen zorgdomeinen

MP Bergkamp asked about clients losing care when CIZ reclassified their indication from Wlz to other domains (Wmo, Zvw), including low-IQ referrals, lack of care continuity and CIZ conduct. The Staatssecretaris answered that transition rules were adjusted in July 2015, denied receiving signals of care gaps, and pointed to implementation tables and helpdesks, promising to report back on cooperation with VNG and ZN by end of Q1 2016.
The CIZ must always act carefully. I have no signals that clients are missing care due to careless conduct.
Het CIZ dient altijd zorgvuldig te handelen. Ik heb geen signalen dat cliënten zorg mislopen door onzorgvuldig handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren antidepressiva krijgen voorgeschreven

MP Bergkamp asked the state secretary about reports that more young people are prescribed antidepressants, including whether this reflects over-prescription, whether waiting lists in youth mental health care drive it, and what will be done. The state secretary said prescribing should follow guidelines, that professional bodies are updating advice, that data cannot show causes, and that research on youth depression will be funded, while stating waiting-list links cannot be confirmed.
I consider it important that the treating physician weighs medical necessity against the patient's interest in treatment.
Ik vind het van belang dat bij de behandeling van een patiënt door de behandelaar een goede afweging gemaakt wordt tussen de medische noodzaak en het belang van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het vonnis van de rechtbank Amsterdam in de zaak van de HIV-patiënt die zijn eigen hennep mag telen

The MP asked the Minister of Justice about an Amsterdam court ruling acquitting an HIV patient growing his own cannabis, and whether it creates a precedent, requires changes to the Opiumwet, or shows courts undermining cannabis law. The Minister answered that the ruling is exceptional and sets no precedent, that the medicinal cannabis supply is being expanded and no legal change is needed, and that the courts must apply the law as it stands.
As the Amsterdam court itself indicated, the ruling is exceptional and applies only to this individual case, so no precedent is created.
Zoals de rechtbank Amsterdam zelf ook heeft aangegeven, is de betreffende uitspraak uitzonderlijk en alleen in dit individuele geval van toepassing en wordt er dus geen precedent geschapen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over de vondst van MDMA-resten van XTC-productie in maïsplanten

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked about MDMA residues from ecstasy production found in maize plants on a Someren farm, including risks, NVWA oversight, police cooperation and whether regulation of the market would reduce risk. The state secretary replied that the detected levels pose no health risk, outlined the division of responsibilities between police, municipality and NVWA, and rejected market regulation from a public health perspective.
If the situation gives cause for it, as also happened in this specific case, the NVWA is called in.
Als de situatie daar aanleiding voor geeft, zoals ook in dit specifieke geval is gebeurd, wordt de NVWA ingeschakeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht dat ‘Eritrese meisjes moeten wegblijven uit deze kerk’ en ‘Twintig Eritrese vluchtelingen uit Oranje zwanger na bezoeken aan Rotterdamse kerk?’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked about reports that Eritrean girls should stay away from a Rotterdam church after about twenty Eritrean asylum seekers became pregnant, and what COA and Nidos did with warning signals. The government answered that COA received unverified signals, took precautionary measures such as banning unaccompanied minors from visiting the church, reported to police, and that police and prosecutors found no criminal suspicion so far, while withholding details of individual pregnancies under medical confidentiality.

The National Prosecutor's Office will explore the possibilities to examine the signals of possible abuses within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands at national level and in a multidisciplinary manner.

Het Landelijk Parket van het OM zal de mogelijkheden verkennen om de signalen van mogelijke misstanden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland op landelijk niveau en op multidisciplinaire wijze nader te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een bisschop misbruik volgens het Vaticaan niet per se hoeft te melden

An MP asked ministers whether a Vatican document saying new bishops need not always report child abuse allegations was acceptable, and whether they would seek clarification from the Dutch bishops' conference. The minister called the statement incorrect and unwise, explained it stemmed from a misunderstanding in a training course that will be corrected, and declined a meeting because the Dutch bishops confirmed that reporting to the prosecutor is required.
Accusations of child abuse must be reported and a police report must be filed.
Beschuldigingen van kindermisbruik moeten gemeld worden en er moet aangifte van worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bergkamp over een uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam inzake coffeeshops

MPs Kooiman and Bergkamp asked the Justice Minister how to view a Amsterdam district court ruling that government policy keeps cannabis trade in criminal hands, and whether experiments with regulated cannabis supply to coffeeshops should be allowed. The minister declined to comment on the judgment, maintained that regulating cultivation would not solve crime and is blocked by international treaties, and refused experiments, while noting the coffeeshop policy has been repeatedly backed by parliament.
It is for the judge to rule on cases brought before him within the framework of the law.
Het is aan de rechter om binnen de kaders van de wet te oordelen over zaken die aan hem worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a former Dutch coffeeshop owner sentenced in Thailand to 103 years (effectively 20), including whether Dutch authorities initiated the prosecution and whether the Dutch tolerance policy was explained to Thai authorities. The minister declined to judge the foreign ruling, said the Thai authorities were informed of Dutch tolerance policy, refused to share the liaison officer's letter citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and gave a partial account of embassy contacts.
Can you send this letter to the House? Answer 8: The investigation referred to is part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Kunt u deze brief aan de Kamer zenden? Antwoord 8 Het onderzoek waarnaar wordt verwezen is onderdeel van een nog lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de spelregels Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) van de ouderenbond ANBO

An MP asked whether the government shares the ANBO's view that its 'Spelregels WMO 2015' on access to Wmo services fit the call for a national quality standard, and whether it will bring these rules to municipalities' attention. The Secretary of State said the rules are a valuable operationalisation of existing quality standards, and that the VNG will involve them in a training programme for municipal Wmo conversation staff.
Yes, this spring a training programme from the VNG academy for municipalities will start, aimed at professionalising Wmo conversation staff.
Ja, dit voorjaar start een opleidingsaanbod vanuit de VNG academie voor gemeenten gericht op de professionalisering van de gespreksvoerders Wmo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een financiële stop dreigt voor de jeugd ggz

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that youth mental health institutions face large repayment demands from insurers because agreements are reinterpreted after the fact, and whether children will suffer. The State Secretary says the NZa has been asked to amend the rules retroactively and in consultation with parties, and that municipalities have a duty to provide alternative youth care if an institution fails.

She has therefore decided to ask the NZa to amend the relevant rules (on direct time with the main treating professional and residential services) with retroactive effect and in consultation with the parties.

Zij heeft daarom besloten de NZa te vragen om de betreffende regels (rond de directe tijd van de hoofdbehandelaar en verblijfsprestaties) met terugwerkende kracht en in afstemming met partijen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de “ADHD-epidemie”

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about the reported fourfold rise in ADHD medication over ten years, the risk of over-medicalisation of children, and whether psychiatrists' concerns and calls for more diagnostics were being addressed. The state secretary acknowledged the rise as worrying, pointed to the Health Council report and a 'Plan van Aanpak Gepaste Zorg' with concrete actions and a session on diagnostic pressure, but gave no independent analysis of the causes.
This strong increase in the use of medication for ADHD in recent years is worrying, although the Health Council found no clear explanation for the increase in its advice.

Deze forse stijging in het gebruik van medicatie bij ADHD de afgelopen jaren is zorgelijk, alhoewel de Gezondheidsraad in haar advies geen duidelijke verklaring heeft gevonden voor de toename in het gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over mesthuwelijken

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked whether limiting transfer of the dairy phosphate reference to relatives in the first to third degree forces farms to shrink, whether it encourages sham marriages or adoptions, and how this fits modern family forms. The government replied that the limit already applies since 1 January 2015 under the Fertilisers Act, does not force shrinkage but may raise manure-processing costs, follows the Dutch civil code definition of blood and affinal relatives, and that it has no concrete signals of 'manure marriages' or problematic adoptions.
I have no concrete signals of the occurrence of so-called manure marriages.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen over het voorkomen van zogenaamde mesthuwelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bergkamp over de continuïteit van hospicezorg

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the government about waiting lists and funding gaps at Hospice Dignitas, insurers' expenditure caps for 2016, and whether insurers meet their care duty when contracting little with regional hospices. The State Secretary answered that waiting times are undesirable, that insurers are expected to contract sufficiently and reorganise contracting, that local shortages occur but are not structural, and that the NZa transparency rule and a dispute body are being developed.
Health insurers have a duty of care; they must provide insured persons with good-quality care that is within their reach and delivered in a timely manner.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben zorgplicht, zij moeten verzekerden voorzien van kwalitatief goede zorg die binnen hun bereik is af te nemen en tijdig wordt geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over het maatwerkprofiel en de meerzorgregeling

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked why the progress report on long-term care discusses the meerzorgregeling but not the development of a maatwerkprofiel, what the difference is between the two, and how care for children with severe multiple disabilities can support their development. The Staatssecretaris answered that maatwerk is being examined through an advisory request to ZIN and NZa with results expected in 2016, that existing profiles already allow development-oriented care, and that children with multiple disabilities can receive developmental care within their zorgplan, with supplementary care where profiles are insufficient.
It is my intention that at a later stage the joint advice of the NZa and ZIN will also contribute to this discussion.
Het is mijn bedoeling dat op een later moment ook het gezamenlijke advies van de NZa en ZIN een bijdrage levert aan deze discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over over mogelijke problemen (her)indicaties jeugdhulp en informatievoorziening rondom de zorgaanvraag

An MP asked the state secretary about re-assessments of youth care under the transition to the Jeugdwet, the timeliness of information to young people and parents, waiting lists, and a monitor report on access problems. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for timely information, that central data on re-assessments is not collected, and pointed to a fact sheet, VNG communication, cooperation with GPs, and knowledge programmes for municipalities.
I am not aware of how many young people whose current AWBZ and/or Youth Act assessment must be re-assessed by municipalities in 2015, because this information is not collected centrally.

Het is mij niet bekend van welk aantal jeugdigen de lopende indicatie uit de AWBZ en/of Wet op de jeugdzorg in 2015 door gemeenten (her)beoordeeld dient te worden omdat deze informatie niet centraal wordt verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Bergkamp over het spreekrecht van stieffamilie in het strafrecht

MPs Swinkels and Bergkamp asked whether the right to speak at criminal trials should extend to non-blood relatives such as stepfamily in blended families, citing a Rechtbank Oost-Brabant call for this. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, said judges can already admit non-relatives on request, and said the issue would be considered in the 2017 evaluation of the law and a pending bill.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over informele zorg en persoonsgebonden budgetten

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health about municipalities' room to refuse personal budgets (pgb) for informal care, the 10-hour rule, exclusion of day care and treatment, the 'usual care' criterion, and whether the minister will consult the VNG given many appeals by Per Saldo. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have policy freedom but cannot categorically exclude pgb use for informal care, that blanket exclusions do not fit the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet, and that he will consult the VNG on the appeal outcomes.
Categorically excluding the first 10 hours per week of informal support or informal youth care from a pgb is, in my view, not compatible with the principles of the Wmo 2015 and the Jeugdwet

Het categoraal uitsluiten van de eerste 10 uur per week van informele ondersteuning of informele jeugdhulp middels een pgb verhoudt zich daarom in mijn ogen niet tot de uitgangspunten van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over intensieve kindzorg

Ms Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary of Health about the status and implementation of the Medical Child Care System report, the roles of coordinators, care-coordinator and nursing indication, the division between Zvw, Wlz and Jeugdwet, school-based medical tasks, and whether insurers buy enough intensive child care. The State Secretary answered that implementation is underway with a subsidy of about 460,000 euros, that the care coordinator should relieve parents without taking over, that the ministry monitors signals via meeting platforms and complaint points, and that it will talk to municipalities and insurers about clarity on care boundaries.
I will talk with municipalities, health insurers and interest organisations to make good arrangements so that this is prevented in the future.
Ik ga met gemeenten, zorgverzekeraars en belangenorganisaties in gesprek om hier goede afspraken over te maken, zodat dit in de toekomst wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over signalen dat Zorgverzekeringsindicaties uit gemeentelijke budgetten worden betaald

An MP asked whether the SVB pays provider invoices based only on the contract without checking the indication, so that municipal budgets pay for care that should be covered under the Zvw. The Secretary of State answered that municipalities check content against the indication, that an emergency fallback in early 2015 granted automatic approval to contracts not yet reviewed, and that a correction procedure has been developed with partners.
Under privacy legislation, the SVB does not have access to care indications.
Uit hoofde van privacywetgeving beschikt de SVB niet over zorgindicaties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Volp en Servaes over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de United Nations General Assembly Special Session (UNGASS) on the World Drug Problem die in 2016 zal plaatsvinden

Four MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch policy for the 2016 UN drugs special session had changed, whether the Netherlands should back regulated cannabis cultivation, and how death penalty cases for drug offences would be handled. The government answered that the Dutch position has not changed, that it opposes regulated cannabis cultivation and mayors' calls for it, and that it works to end the death penalty for drug offences while noting three Dutch nationals face such sentences.
Regulation/legalisation of cannabis cultivation is not cabinet policy, so it is not appropriate for the Netherlands to take the leading role the questioners propose at the UNGASS.
Regulering/legalisering van de hennepteelt is geen kabinetsbeleid en het ligt daarom niet voor de hand bij de UNGASS een door de vragenstellers beoogde voortrekkersrol op dit vlak te vervullen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het openbaar maken van het oordeel van de Chief Information Officer van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport én het openbaar maken van de verslagen

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked why the CIO assessment of the SVB's ICT system and the minutes of the PGB Trekkingsrecht steering group have not been made public, and why a Wob request was answered late. The state secretary replied that the CIO assessment and steering group minutes were made available to parliament confidentially, that officials' and external participants' views are not published, and that the Wob deadline was exceeded due to processing delays.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Volp en Bergkamp over het bericht dat personeel monddood wordt gemaakt in de vrouwenopvang

MPs Kooiman, Volp and Bergkamp asked whether staff at a women's shelter in Heemskerk were being silenced, whether the shelter was unsafe for staff and clients, and whether fewer and lower-qualified staff now work there. The State Secretary replied that responsibility lies with the municipality of Haarlem and the operator, that a 2014 Labour Inspectorate visit found no violations, and that a GGD emergency inspection, an improvement plan and an independent investigation are underway, with results promised for November.
The personnel policy of the Heemskerk women's shelter is primarily a matter for the employer and the municipality of Haarlem.
Het personeelsbeleid van de vrouwenopvang Heemskerk is primair een zaak van de werkgever en de gemeente Haarlem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg zorgboerderij Hoge Aard in Molenschot ongemoeid laat

MPs Bergkamp and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about media reports that youth care authorities left care farm Hoge Aard in Molenschot alone despite allegations of poor care and mistreatment of residents. The State Secretary said he was seriously concerned, that the inspectorates have conducted several supervisory activities since 2014, that they will continue the investigation jointly and inform the House of the results, and referred the remaining questions to a separate letter to the House.
The IGZ and IJZ will jointly continue the investigation.
De IGZ en IJZ zullen gezamenlijk het onderzoek voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de pgb-chaos (persoonsgebonden budget) ten koste gaat van verpleeghuizen

An MP asked whether reports that the personal budget (pgb) boom is forcing care institutions for disabled and dementia patients to cut budgets are accurate, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said the cuts are premature, expects sufficient national funds, asked care offices to redistribute, and will send an updated NZa advice to parliament in October.
I have therefore asked the care offices to actively consult with each other on redistributing the available funds.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren daarom gevraagd om actief met elkaar in overleg te gaan over de herverdeling van de beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van de Oranjezaal voor slechtzienden en slechthorenden

An MP asked why the Oranjezaal visit lacks special provisions for visually and hearing-impaired visitors, why sign-language interpreters need their own ticket and guide dogs were initially barred, how comparable museums handle this, and whether separate tours could be organised. The minister replied that companions get free tickets, professional guides and written materials are provided, guide dogs are now allowed, and that the government will lead by example under the UN disability convention.
Following these parliamentary questions, guide dogs are permitted despite the vulnerability of the room and limited physical space.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen zijn, ondanks de kwetsbaarheid van de zaal in combinatie met de beperkte fysieke ruimte, hulphonden toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat jeugdzorg niet toegerust is op Syriëgangers

Two D66 MPs asked whether youth care institutions are equipped to treat young people who attempted to travel to Syria, including the role of closed youth care, parents, foster care and monitoring. The State Secretary answered that treatment is still being developed case by case, that closed placement may be needed to prevent departure, that an Exit facility and a family support point are being set up, and that no known radicalised minors travelled to the Middle East after closed placement.
In the first place it is up to municipalities together with youth care institutions to give content to this.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan gemeenten samen met de jeugdhulpinstellingen hier inhoud aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat Amsterdam geen specifieke opvang heeft voor dementerende, dwalende ouderen terwijl deze wel vaker worden aangetroffen

MP Bergkamp asked the State Secretary about reports that Amsterdam lacks specific emergency care for disoriented elderly people with dementia, whether emergency places in nursing homes are sufficient, how often such people end up in police cells, and whether a national database of available places should be created. The State Secretary acknowledged the signal as serious, noted there is no national data on emergency place availability, pointed to regional improvement efforts by SIGRA, and declined a national database in favour of regional routing arrangements.
As far as I am aware, there is no national data on the availability of emergency places and on occupancy rates.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen landelijke gegevens over de beschikbaarheid van spoedplekken en over de bezettingsgraad.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport van het Trimbos-instituut waaruit zou blijken dat kinderen door voorlichting op het gebied van alcohol en drugs juist nieuwsgieriger naar alcohol en drugs worden

The MP asks the State Secretary to explain a Trimbos-institute finding that drug and alcohol education makes children more curious about substances, and how the government squares this with its own earlier letter. The State Secretary cites a 2011/2012 Radboud University evaluation showing some unfavourable attitude effects of primary-school prevention, and says primary-school education is now given only on request, with a shift toward parents and secondary-school prevention.
This emerges from the study the Radboud University conducted in school year 2011/2012 on De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen (DGSG) in primary education.
Dit blijkt uit het onderzoek dat de Radboud Universiteit in schooljaar 2011/2012 uitvoerde naar De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen (DGSG) in het basisonderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het objectieve verdeelmodel voor de decentralisatie uitkering Maatschappelijk Opvang

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether the objective allocation model for the maatschappelijke opvang grant should be revised and the redistribution postponed, as requested by the Federatie Opvang. The State Secretary answered that, based on the Raad voor de Financiële Verhoudingen advice, he sees no reason for a new revision now, while offering a broader discussion with the VNG.

In view of the advice of the Raad voor de Financiële Verhoudingen on AWBZ funds for women's shelters and maatschappelijke opvang of December 2014, I currently see no reason for a new recalibration or redistribution.

Gelet op het advies van de Raad voor de Financiële Verhoudingen (Rfv) betreffende de AWBZ middelen voor vrouwenopvang en maatschappelijke opvang van december 2014 zie ik nu geen aanleiding tot een nieuwe herijking of herverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over seksueel misbruik bij boeddhisten in Nederland

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Bergkamp asked the ministers about alleged sexual abuse by Buddhist monks and teachers in the Netherlands, including prevention, reporting, victim support and prosecution limits. The government said it cannot establish misconduct from police and prosecutor information but cannot rule it out, pointed to free certificates of conduct for volunteers, a 'safe church' toolkit, awareness campaigns and victim support services, and noted that statutes of limitation no longer apply to serious sexual offences against children.
Based on information from the Public Prosecution Service and the police, I cannot establish whether Buddhist monks and/or teachers have committed sexual abuse.
Op basis van de informatie van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie kan ik niet vaststellen of boeddhistische monniken en/of leraren zich schuldig hebben gemaakt aan seksueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘dat het budget voor 2015 bij een deel van de instellingen jeugdzorg al op is’

An MP asked whether youth care budgets for 2015 were exhausted at some providers, leaving children unable to be treated, and whether continuity of care is guaranteed. The state secretary answered that some municipalities have reached agreed budget ceilings, that continuity is safeguarded under transitional law, and that no national monitoring tracks children whose treatment cannot be completed, while committing to a joint work agenda on administrative burden.
The national monitoring of youth care use does not track how many young people who started a treatment in 2014 cannot complete it in 2015.
In de landelijke monitoring van het jeugdhulpgebruik wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel jeugdigen hun behandeltraject dat in 2014 is gestart, in 2015 niet kunnen afmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht van de VNG over de herbeoordeling van overgangscliënten AWBZ/Wmo

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the VNG's warning that re-assessing AWBZ transition clients under the Wmo is a major task, likely to take longer than planned, reflects real problems and what the consequences are for clients and funding. The State Secretary answered that the VNG could not substantiate the warning with a national overview, that no requests for postponement were received, and that a timetable for pgb cases and a step-by-step plan for trekkingsrechten will be discussed on 3 September, with the Chamber to be informed.
I will inform the Chamber of the results of this consultation.
Ik zal de Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de resultaten van dit overleg.

Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport van het Trimbos Instituut waaruit zou blijken dat kinderen door voorlichting op het gebied van alcohol en drugs juist nieuwsgieriger naar alcohol en drugs word

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether a Trimbos Institute report showed that alcohol and drug education makes children more curious about using them, and whether the Haarlemmermeer municipality's decision to stop primary-school education on these topics was positive. The State Secretary answered that Trimbos advises against such education in primary schools because it may make pupils more positive toward substances or more curious, cites prior studies showing no effect of primary-school education, and says secondary-school education remains important and drug education needs tailoring.
I informed you about the adjustments to De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen in spring 2013.
Over de aanpassingen binnen De Gezonde school en Genotmiddelen heb ik u in het voorjaar van 2013 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen inzake de rijkssubsidie die gaat verdwijnen voor het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked about the planned withdrawal of OCW subsidy for the deaf boarding school in Haren. The Secretary of State explained the funding history, said the OCW subsidy would be phased out from 2016/2017 pending a visit to the school, and described how care needs are now assessed and what the consequences for pupils would be.
At Mr Van Meenen's request, I have committed to first visit the boarding school before taking a final decision on phasing out the subsidy.
Op verzoek van de heer Van Meenen heb ik toegezegd eerst op bezoek te gaan bij het internaat, voordat ik een definitief besluit neem over de afbouw van de subsidie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de gevolgen van de onlangs ingevoerde aanpassing van de Opiumwet (nieuw art. 11a) voor Nederlandse ondernemers in de hennepzaadindustrie en in d

MPs from D66 asked whether the new article 11a of the Opiumwet could criminalise sales of hemp seed, whether that conflicts with legality, the economic size of the hemp seed industry, and whether seized seeds would be grown by police. The minister answered that hemp seed is excluded from the Opiumwet prohibitions but that sales can fall under article 11a when intended for illegal cultivation, that legal fibre hemp cultivation remains permitted under Green Deals, and that the claim of police growing cannabis is untrue, with seeds only undergoing DNA testing.
Yes, I know this report, but it does not match the facts.
Ja, ik ken dit bericht, maar het stemt niet overeen met de feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het bericht dat het kabinet lak heeft aan het medisch beroepsgeheim in de jeugdzorg

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked whether the 25 June 2015 agreement on a temporary ministerial regulation for youth care billing, which lets invoices carry personal and diagnostic data, respects medical confidentiality and was a proper procedural route given a pending bill. The state secretary replied that the temporary regulation, approved by the Dutch Data Protection Authority under conditions, rests on the Youth Act and will be replaced by the Veegwet, and that the regulation will take effect as soon as possible.
The Cbp has indicated it can agree to this temporary ministerial regulation under conditions, and we will honour these conditions.
Het Cbp heeft onder voorwaarden aangegeven te kunnen instemmen met deze tijdelijke ministeriële regeling en deze voorwaarden zullen door ons worden gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het toenemende aantal vondelingenkamers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why the Stichting Beschermde Wieg is opening baby hatches (vondelingenkamers) in several locations, and what legal options exist for anonymous or confidential births consistent with the Children's Rights Convention. The State Secretary said the hatches are tolerated because current law gives no basis to act before a baby is placed, while confidential birth via Fiom and Siriz is preferred and prevention outreach is being expanded.
Since current legislation offers insufficient means to act actively against the baby hatches as long as no baby has been placed in them, I cannot close them.
Nu de huidige wetgeving onvoldoende mogelijkheid biedt om actief op te treden tegen de vondelingenkamers zolang daar nog geen baby in is gelegd, kan ik deze niet sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het kabinet lak heeft aan het medisch beroepsgeheim in de jeugdzorg

Member Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary whether the cabinet plans to require youth care providers to put patients' medical data on invoices to municipalities, arguing this bypasses Parliament, lacks a statutory basis and undermines medical confidentiality despite a Data Protection Authority warning. The State Secretary replied that a temporary ministerial regulation under Article 7.3.11(5) of the Youth Act is needed for payment continuity, that the Data Protection Authority has conditionally agreed, and that municipalities need limited data to lawfully spend public funds.
Immediate entry into force of the temporary regulation is necessary to prevent youth care providers from falling into payment inability.
Directe inwerkingtreding van de tijdelijke regeling is noodzakelijk, om te voorkomen dat jeugdhulpaanbieders in betalingsonmacht komen te verkeren.
Vragen van het lid Bergkamp (D66) aan de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat tienermeisjes te laat hulp zoeken na een verkrachting (ingezonden 12 mei 2015).

An MP asked the state secretary for health how to get girls who have been raped to report faster, given a study showing many delay, and asked about awareness campaigns and medical care. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described existing youth campaigns, the sexual-violence crisis centres and the STI risk-group arrangement, and said evaluations will follow.
Both the youth campaign and the general public campaign will be evaluated for effectiveness.
Zowel de jongerencampagne als de algemene publiekscampagne worden geëvalueerd op effectiviteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over geweldsfilmpjes bij jongeren

Two MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries how to explain the reported trend of youths filming and sharing violent videos, how many youths are involved, and what measures exist to stop it. The government answered that it has no figures because filming violence is not a separate offence, that prosecution is possible where the filmers can be treated as accomplices or instigators, and that anti-bullying policy, school safety rules from August 2015 and online information campaigns are the main responses.
I do not have figures, because filming an assault or public violence is not an independent criminal offence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers, omdat het filmen van een mishandeling of openlijke geweldpleging geen zelfstandig strafbaar feit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de inzet van casemanagers binnen de zorg

MP Bergkamp asked the State Secretary for Health about case managers in care, prompted by a press case of citizens lost between new long-term care rules, and about the motion asking the government to explore the role of case manager. The State Secretary acknowledged signals of citizens being bounced between providers, pointed to the Ieder(in)/Per Saldo help line and independent client support, and said a plan on structural funding of mentorship and case management would be discussed with stakeholders and reported in autumn.
I am currently working on a plan on the structural financing of mentorship.
Ik ben op dit moment bezig met een plan over de structurele financiering van mentorschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over kunstaankopen op de veilingmarkt

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Rijksmuseum acted adequately when it bought a Jan Asselijn painting at TEFAF for 1,200,000 euro after a similar work sold for 760,355 euro at auction months earlier, and how museum purchasing and the Governance Code Cultuur are supervised. The Minister answered that museums bear primary responsibility for purchases, that the Rijksmuseum acted adequately after restoration and private fundraising, and that no extra accountability beyond regular reporting is needed.
I see no reason for extra accountability on this beyond the regular annual reporting by museums and the Mondriaan Fund.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor extra verantwoording daarvan naast de reguliere jaarverantwoording door musea en het Mondriaan Fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Hachchi en Bergkamp over de waarschuwing voor digitale dementie bij decentrale overheden

MPs Schouw, Hachchi and Bergkamp asked the ministers about warnings from local and regional officials that digital records risk being poorly preserved, and whether archive law and powers are sufficient. The government says existing archive law shows no gaps, points to a Ictu baseline study and to strategic information consultation (SIO) as the remedy, and declines to accelerate the AIDO project for lack of resources.
There are indeed no indications that the legal frameworks in archive regulations lead to shortcomings.
Er zijn inderdaad geen indicaties dat de wettelijke kaders in de Archiefregelgeving tot tekortkomingen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘verwaarloosde kinderen op basisscholen’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretaries about a report that around 1,100 children arrive at school daily without basic necessities, and that many schools feed and clothe pupils themselves, asking about detection, referral to youth care and Veilig Thuis, and coordination with the VNG and PO-Raad. The government acknowledges the problem, points to municipal responsibility, the poverty-fighting funds and the verbindingsagenda, and says it will discuss the issue with partners without committing to new legal or institutional change.
Municipalities, as stated, have the means to provide the necessary support.
Gemeenten hebben zoals gezegd mogelijkheden om de benodigde ondersteuning te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het taboe op seks in de ouderenzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary whether sexuality is still a taboo in elderly care and disability care, and whether a sexual service provider could be used for clients. The state secretary acknowledged the importance of intimacy and sexuality, said he would raise it with the sector and professional bodies, and saw no need to extend this to disability care or to endorse sexual service provision beyond leaving it to client-caregiver agreements.
At the General Consultation on quality policy for nursing home care of 18 March 2015 I indicated that I intend to discuss this topic with the field and the professional organisations.
