In het Algemeen Overleg Kwaliteitsbeleid verpleeghuiszorg van 18 maart 2015 heb ik aangegeven dat ik voornemens ben dit onderwerp te bespreken met het werkveld en de beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het waarborgen van privacy binnen de Jeugdwet

D66 MPs asked whether the Youth Act adequately protects children's privacy, given reports of unnecessary labelling and parents being forced to disclose information to get care reimbursed. The Secretary of State answered that privacy is protected within the Wbp and Youth Act, pointed to completed privacy impact assessments and training for municipal staff, and argued there is no legal gap, while adding clarifying provisions in a separate bill.
It is the responsibility of the municipal executive to handle personal data carefully within these frameworks.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W om binnen deze kaders op een zorgvuldige manier om te gaan met de persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er steeds meer geweld is in de opvang

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of rising violence in shelters, whether the 'Veilig werken in de zorg' scheme should cover the shelter sector, and about waiting lists for supported and protected housing. The state secretary said no national violence figures exist, explained the inspectorate's risk-based approach and that the sector can join the scheme this year, and said waiting-list data are not recorded nationally since municipalities are responsible.
The number of people waiting for shelter, supervised and protected housing was not and is not recorded at national level.
Het aantal wachtende personen voor opvang, begeleiding en beschermd wonen werd en wordt niet op landelijk niveau geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Bergkamp over het Filmfonds, de stimulering van de productie van televisieseries in Nederland en oneerlijke concurrentie uit het buitenland

MPs Monasch and Bergkamp asked whether TV series such as Homeland could be supported by the Netherlands Film Production Incentive and whether foreign incentives create an unfair playing field. The minister answered that series are not eligible because extending the scheme would crowd out film funding within the current 20 million euro budget, and that she will consult the Filmfonds and others after the Raad voor Cultuur advice.
Extra budget for the scheme is not available.
Extra budget voor de regeling is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een Rijksmonument in Rotterdam mogelijk onherstelbaar is beschadigd

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a Rotterdam national monument may be irreparably damaged by renovation work by an Angolan consulate contractor, including whether municipal enforcement is possible. The minister answered that diplomatic inviolability means the municipality cannot enforce against the consulate, said the government does not track which monuments house embassies or consulates, and described existing information channels for new owners.
Dutch authorities therefore cannot take enforcement action against the consulate-general, nor can the consulate be entered without the consul's permission.
Er kan dus door de Nederlandse autoriteiten niet handhavend worden opgetreden ten aanzien van het consulaat-generaal, noch kan het consulaat betreden worden zonder toestemming van de consul.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over VGP bericht: 'Chemopatiënten kweken stiekem cannabis'

An MP asks the state secretary about a report that cancer patients grow cannabis secretly because pharmacy cannabis is ineffective or unreimbursed, including a patient whose home-grown plants were seized. The secretary answers that home cultivation is banned under the Opium Act, that five pharmacy cannabis varieties largely meet need, that most insurers reimburse it, and that current policy will not be changed.

I do not rule out that there are patients who help each other by exchanging information about the beneficial effects they experience from a particular cannabis variety that is not available in pharmacies on prescription.

Ik sluit niet uit dat er patiënten zijn die elkaar helpen door informatie uit te wisselen over de heilzame werking die zij zelf ervaren door het gebruik van een bepaalde cannabisvariant die niet op doktersrecept in de apotheek verkrijgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) de noodklok luidt omdat het oplossen van misdaden in gevaar komt

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether the NFI's warning that solving crimes is at risk means the planned THC testing for the cannabis measure lacks capacity, and whether the measure should be withdrawn. The minister answered that enforcement will be funded within existing budgets, the NFI is drafting a contour plan still under discussion, and the core production and capacity for investigations will be safeguarded; the measure will not be withdrawn.
Enforcement of the measure will take place within the existing budgetary frameworks.
De handhaving van de maatregel zal binnen de bestaande budgettaire kaders plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht dat scholen blijven werken met afgekeurde antipestmethoden

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretary whether a report on rejected anti-bullying programmes exists, why it was not shared with parliament, and whether schools were being misled. The state secretary answered that no such report exists beyond the published assessment, that individual feedback to programme owners is confidential as business-sensitive, and that rejection does not mean a programme is harmful.
Regarding the individual feedback, the committee of the Dutch Youth Institute agreed with the programme owners that it would remain confidential.
Over de individuele feedback heeft de commissie van het Nederlands Jeugdinstituut met de programmaeigenaren afgesproken dat dit vertrouwelijk zou blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over de stelselverantwoordelijkheid in de jeugdzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Health who is responsible for investigating a child death in Rotterdam, and where national versus municipal responsibility lies in youth care. The State Secretary answered that the joint national inspectorates supervise the Youth Act, that Rotterdam asked the Inspectie Jeugdzorg to investigate, and that the Rijk bears system responsibility which may lead to adjusting rules if the system malfunctions.
Rotterdam's request to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg to carry out this investigation is in line with these agreements.
Het verzoek dat de gemeente Rotterdam heeft gedaan aan de Inspectie Jeugdzorg om dit onderzoek uit te voeren is in lijn met deze afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Bergkamp over het artikel ‘culturele topinstellingen worstelen met regels bij aantrekken van talent van buiten EU’

Two D66 MPs asked why cultural institutions such as the Rijksmuseum, Concertgebouworkest and Nationaal Ballet struggle to hire non-EU talent under work-permit rules, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The minister defended the EU-first principle but acknowledged that the arts need international talent, pointed to existing lower salary thresholds for performing arts, said he would consult the museum sector, and offered talks with the orchestra and ballet, reporting back to parliament.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen met betrekking tot onderwijs voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen, kinderen met forse gedragsproblematiek en kinderen met een (zware) verstandelijke beperki

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how education for severely disabled children is funded from 1 January 2015, whether their right to passend onderwijs is guaranteed, and whether there is handling difficulty among providers and municipalities. The Secretary of State gave figures, explained the shift of care funding to the Jeugdwet, Zvw and Wlz, and said the government will monitor developments, without committing to new research.
I do not recognise the handling difficulty regarding referral to (v)so schools, but I will keep following developments.
Ik herken de handelingsverlegenheid ten aanzien van het doorverwijzen naar scholen voor het (v)so dan ook niet, maar ik zal de ontwikkelingen blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de beantwoording van vragen over de intensieve kindzorg vanaf 2015

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked how care for intensive child care is divided between the Youth Act and the Health Insurance Act (Zvw), where short-term stays fall, and whether tariffs are adequate. The state secretary answered that all necessary care for intensive child care falls under the Zvw, that short stays are covered by the Zvw, and that insurers are contracting providers with maximum budgets for 2015.
All guidance a young person needs within intensive child care will be provided under the Health Insurance Act.
Alle begeleiding die een jeugdige in het kader van intensieve kindzorg nodig heeft zal vanuit de Zorgverzekeringswet worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het bericht dat het harde drugsbeleid op festivals zowel advocaten als verslavingszorginstellingen te ver gaat

D66 MPs asked whether festival-goers are adequately informed that accepting an on-the-spot fine gives them a criminal record, whether they can consult a lawyer on site, and whether strict drug enforcement at festivals helps health and safety. The Minister of Justice answered that the public prosecutor informs suspects on request, that a suspect can ask for a lawyer and the case is then postponed, and that the effects of enforcement are limited and no harder data exist.
There is no question of a specific strict drug policy at festivals.
Er is geen sprake van een specifiek streng drugsbeleid op festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat voor driekwart van de jongeren een burn-out dreigt

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that three quarters of young people risk burn-out, its causes, available treatment, and whether burn-out should be added to the national prevention programme. The secretary answered that burn-out lacks a clear definition and no trend data exist, that psychosocial problems among youth have risen, and that policy focuses on early detection through youth health care and schools rather than burn-out specifically.
Policy is therefore not specifically aimed at preventing and treating burn-outs among young people, but at the early detection of psychosocial problems.
Het beleid is daarom niet specifiek gericht op het voorkomen en behandelen van burn-outs bij jongeren, maar wel op het vroegtijdig signaleren van psychosociale problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Focus op: toegang op orde/crisisopvang"

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked the state secretary how municipal procurement agreements could conflict with the direct referral route by GPs and specialists under the Youth Act, and whether a persoonsgebonden budget could cover providers without a municipal contract. The state secretary replied that municipalities must ensure the youth care is available, that procurement cannot be a reason to refuse necessary care, that interbestuurlijk toezicht is the lever in extreme cases, and that a pgb is one option among others.
Should it appear that a municipality acts in breach of the Youth Act when procuring youth care, the instruments of interadministrative supervision under the Municipalities Act are available to me.

Mocht blijken dat een gemeente bij de inkoop van jeugdhulp in strijd met de Jeugdwet handelt, dan staat mij het instrumentarium van het interbestuurlijk toezicht op grond van de Gemeentewet ter dienst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bergkamp over het bericht dat er geen sprake is van een zachte landing voor de overheveling van zorgtaken en het bericht ‘Brandbrief gemeenten aan Kamer over cijfers’

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked whether the state secretary knew of reports that the client data handed to municipalities for the transfer of care tasks were unreliable, incomplete or unclear, and what would be done about differing figures and late data. The state secretary answered that the data are consistent with earlier policy information, that differences are explained in an information card, and that talks with municipal and care bodies on solutions are ongoing.
Following the reports, I had further analyses carried out on the data.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving heb ik nadere analyses laten uitvoeren op de gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de intensieve kindzorg vanaf 2015

An MP asked how intensive child care (IKZ) from 2015 under the Zorgverzekeringswet will be arranged, covering insurers' purchasing of supervision, pgb rates, eligibility boundaries with the Wlz and Jeugdwet, indication and appeal procedures, and ouders as caregivers. The State Secretary answered each question, asserting insurers' duty of care and confidence in adequate purchasing, and describing the Zvw indication, appeal route via insurer and SKGZ, and pgb rules.
Health insurers have a duty of care and are responsible for purchasing intensive child care, including the supervision described above.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor de inkoop van de intensieve kindzorg, inclusief de begeleiding zoals hierboven benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport naar aanleiding van de documentaire van de NCRV genaamd ‘2doc: een goede plek voor Dex’

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a documentary on a severely disabled boy who lacked a suitable care place, asking for numbers, the regulatory and financing obstacles, and whether the new Long-Term Care Act would fix them. The state secretary answered that about 60-70 clients a year wait too long for suitable care, that obstacles lie mainly in financing and permits rather than national rules, and that existing law already allows new provision, with steps set out in a separate letter to parliament.
The Centre for Consultation and Expertise indicates that there is a group of about 60 to 70 clients a year with complex care needs who have to wait (too) long for a suitable place in care.
Het Centrum voor Consultatie en Expertise geeft aan dat er jaarlijks een groep van circa 60 à 70 cliënten met een complexe zorgvraag is die (te) lang moet wachten op een passende plek in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de markt voor hulpmiddelen op slot zit

Mr. Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health whether the market for care aids is fair, whether large suppliers win tenders at unrealistic prices, and whether research into the market is needed. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must follow EU and national procurement rules, that prices of some aids have fallen without known research into the cause, that small suppliers still do well in tenders, and that no market study is needed given existing initiatives such as a model tender document and a quality mark.
In response to the report, I therefore see no reason for a market study.
Ik zie naar aanleiding van het bericht dan ook geen aanleiding voor een marktonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over Verklaring arbeidsrelatie (VAR) voor zzp’ers

MPs from D66 asked the government how the Tax Authority can grant and then withdraw VAR-WUO declarations for care freelancers working through agencies, and how many were reviewed and reclassified. The minister explained that VARs are assessed on submitted facts, that roughly 900 of about 1,500 reviewed cases were reclassified as employment, and that the pilot was extended to address the problem.
The cabinet will shortly start an interdepartmental policy study on freelancers to examine whether laws and regulations for freelancers and employees are sufficiently in balance.

Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een Interdepartementaal Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) starten met betrekking tot zzp'ers om te bezien of wet- en regelgeving voor zzp'ers en werknemers voldoende in balans zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport naar aanleiding van de GOUD-studie 2008-2013

Rep. Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for health about the GOUD study report on health of older people with intellectual disabilities, including whether more tailored care is needed and how the recommendations will be followed up. The state secretary acknowledged the need for tailored care and knowledge among care professionals, and promised to explore training integration, a role for professional bodies, and a possible national programme with a response expected in summer.
Therefore I want to examine what options there are to bring this knowledge into the care training programmes.
Daarom wil ik bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om deze kennis naar de zorgopleidingen te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over VAR-verklaringen voor zzp’ers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAR declarations for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including reports of fewer VAR-WUO grants in healthcare and revocations for 250 people tied to care intermediaries. The government replied that the criteria have not changed, that enforcement against false self-employment has increased, and that a planned joint-liability rule for clients and an online VAR module are under development.
The statutory confidentiality obligation means that no statements can be made about individual cases.
De in de wet verankerde geheimhoudingsverplichting maakt dat over individuele gevallen geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ypma over de uitzending ‘Dit is de dag – onderzoek’ en de berichten in de Telegraaf over daders van kindermishandeling

MPs Bergkamp and Ypma asked why child abuse complaints rarely lead to prosecution, how effective the policy is, and whether pleaders receive follow-up support. Minister Opstelten answered with registration figures, outlined existing protocols, a planned OM directive on forensic expertise, and promised a progress report and midterm review.
I will inform you of the outcomes in the next progress report.
Ik bericht u over de uitkomsten in de eerstvolgende voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Rebel over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren zich met een gameverslaving melden bij verslavingsklinieken

MPs Bergkamp and Rebel asked about reports that more and younger young people are seeking treatment for gaming addiction, and about causes, recognition, reimbursement and prevention. Minister Schippers confirmed the rise in treatment demand, said existing research is sufficient, noted gaming addiction is not in DSM-5 but is generally reimbursed, and pointed to parental responsibility, existing tools and school-based programmes.
I find this development worrying and will continue to monitor it.
Ik vind deze ontwikkeling zorgelijk en zal deze blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat nazorg ontbreekt na opname in de gesloten jeugdzorg

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that aftercare is lacking for young women leaving closed youth care, and whether Jeugdzorg-Plus and the decentralisation to municipalities will improve this, and whether Ireland's right to an aftercare plan should be adopted. The State Secretary acknowledged the research, argued that Jeugdzorg-Plus and the new Jeugdwet will improve aftercare, noted that international treaties limit help for young people who become adults against their will, and said he is exploring a mentor proposal.

I expect positive effects from the decentralisation of youth care, also in relation to the Participation Act and the adjustment of the WMO, on aftercare for young people who have stayed in Jeugdzorg-Plus.

Ik verwacht positieve effecten van de decentralisatie van de jeugdzorg, mede in relatie met de Participatiewet en de aanpassing van de WMO, op de nazorg aan jongeren die in jeugdzorgplus hebben verbleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Alcohol taboe voor ouders’

An MP asked the state secretary for health how a shop assistant can tell whether alcohol bought by an adult is intended for a minor under the Drank- en Horecawet, after a supermarket reportedly refused to sell alcohol to parents shopping with their children. The secretary replied that the rules have not changed, that sales to parents shopping with children are allowed, that the law only requires refusal when the minor's purchase is obvious, and that no amendment is planned.
In view of the above explanation, I see no reason to amend the Drank- en Horecawet on this point.
Gezien bovenstaande uitleg zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding de Drank- en Horecawet op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Beëindiging subsidierelaties van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport met Jeugdzorg-Plus niet gegrond”

An MP asked the state secretary why the government decided to end subsidy relations with Jeugdzorg-Plus institutions, how it responds to the Commissie Bezwaarschriften ruling that the advance notice was premature, and whether it will talk with providers. The state secretary answered that the notice was sent in anticipation of the Jeugdwet, that the decision on the objection is postponed until 1 June 2014 pending clarity on conditions, and that additional measures are being discussed with providers, with updates to follow.
Therefore I have decided to postpone a decision on this objection until 1 June 2014 at the latest.
Daarom heb ik besloten een beslissing op dit bezwaar aan te houden tot uiterlijk 1 juni 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht dat kinderen en jongeren vaker antidepressiva slikken

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about reports that children and young people increasingly take antidepressants, the progress of round-table talks on demedicalisation, monitoring, and related actions. The State Secretary says rising help-seeking reflects better diagnosis and treatment, outlines the round-table process, ongoing research, and planned follow-up without giving hard outcome data.
Before summer 2014 I will organise a third round table to keep the discussion going and to exchange experiences with demedicalisation.
Voor de zomer van 2014 organiseer ik een derde ronde tafel om de discussie gaande te houden en om ervaringen met demedicalisering uit te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Een uitdagende reis naar Azië, betaald met zorggeld'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether using personal budget (pgb) funds to pay for holiday trips abroad fits the purpose of the scheme, and whether such use is tracked or fraudulent. The State Secretary said the rules may need tightening, that data on abroad-spending is not available, and that the relevant care offices will be asked to check the specific case.
I therefore want to further examine whether adjusting the current rules is necessary to prevent unintended and undesirable situations.
Ik wil derhalve nader bezien of aanpassing van de huidige regels nodig is om onbedoelde en onwenselijke situaties te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht verslaving gaat hand in hand met ADHD

An MP asked the health ministers how they respond to reports that addicts have ADHD far more often than non-addicts, why many addicted patients were never diagnosed, and whether clinicians and addiction services should screen better and integrate treatment. The government replied that ADHD is hard to diagnose alongside addiction, pointed to ongoing guideline revision and a forthcoming Gezondheidsraad advice, and said integrated treatment programmes and a new youth guideline already exist.
In the revision of the ADHD guideline, which the professional groups are currently working on, particular attention is being paid to diagnosis and medicalisation.
Bij de herziening van de richtlijn ADHD, waar de beroepsgroepen op dit moment aan werken, wordt in het bijzonder aandacht besteed aan diagnosticering en medicalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Gouda verplicht 5-jarigen thuis de afwas te doen”

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that Gouda required 5-year-olds to do the dishes at home as part of household help assessments, and whether central criteria would be set for using the household's own social environment for domestic help. The State Secretary answered that under the Wmo municipalities are responsible, that the MO-zaak guideline is only a handreiking, that individual circumstances must be weighed, and that no national criteria are planned, while objections and appeals remain available to clients.
In that context, it is always possible for the client to lodge an objection (and appeal) against the municipality's decision on an application.
Daarbij geldt dat het voor cliënt altijd mogelijk is om bezwaar (en beroep) aan te tekenen tegen de besluitvorming op een aanvraag door de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de dreigende vernietiging van de collectie van het Tropeninstituut

An MP asks the ministers whether the KIT library collection, with nearly 70% of its post-1950 holdings at risk of destruction, is adequately protected, and questions their earlier pledge to keep the collection available to the public. The minister says the pre-1950 part, treated as heritage, will move to Leiden University Library, while for the post-1950 part insufficient interest exists to maintain a library function and KIT remains responsible for negotiating transfers.
That is why I am very pleased that the pre-1950 collection is coming under the management of Leiden University Library and will therefore remain accessible.
Daarom ben ik zeer verheugd dat de pre-1950 collectie in beheer komt bij de universiteitsbibliotheek Leiden en daardoor toegankelijk blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen over het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers als gevolg van vervuilde xtc pillen

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked about deaths linked to contaminated ecstasy, the number of drug-related deaths over 20 years, and whether on-site drug testing at festivals should be reinstated. The government answered that cause of death is uncertain, that a full testing system is impossible and on-site testing gives false security, and that it sees no reason to revise drug policy, though it asked Trimbos to address the issue with professionals.
I see no reason to reconsider the current drug policy.
Ik zie geen reden het huidige drugsbeleid te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het verdwijnen van meldingen in het Advies- en Meldpunt Kindermishandeling

An MP asked the state secretary about the Kinderrechtenmonitor finding that it is unknown what happens to a child after a report to the AMK, and about a promised fix to the reporting system. The state secretary says the data on follow-up care is hard to retrieve due to technical problems, disagrees that outcomes are unknown since every AMK records referrals, and commits to a new Kits version from January 2014 that records specific follow-up care.
From January 2014 all AMKs will use this renewed version of Kits.
Vanaf januari 2014 zullen alle AMK's deze vernieuwde versie van Kits gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Mishandeling Marokkaanse kinderen onderschat”

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked about a news report claiming child abuse among Moroccan-Dutch families is underestimated, based on a PhD study by Lahlah. The state secretary replied that the study adds knowledge to existing findings, pointed to existing prevention programmes and municipal responsibilities, and said the government will continue its approach to child abuse and juvenile crime.
The research by Ms Lahlah underlines that specific attention to intercultural differences is still needed.
Het onderzoek van mevrouw Lahlah onderstreept dat specifieke aandacht voor interculturele verschillen nog steeds nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over belangenverstrengeling bij het Fonds voor de Podiumkunsten

An MP asked the minister whether conflicts of interest at the Fonds voor de Podiumkunsten, where artists on the board or advisory committees may gain subsidy, are real and what will be done. The minister denies that the court found artists received more subsidy for sitting on these bodies, notes the 2010 court finding of insufficient safeguards, and describes the 2011 rule tightening (independent chair, stricter integrity rules, uniform scoring and fuller reasoning).
The ministry-approved house rules of the Fonds Podiumkunsten provide that an adviser does not take part in the meeting(s) of a subsidy round if he has a personal interest in an application.

In het door het ministerie goedgekeurde huishoudelijk reglement van het Fonds Podiumkunsten is geregeld dat een adviseur niet deelneemt aan de vergadering(en) in een subsidieronde als hij een persoonlijk belang heeft bij een aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de wijziging van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte

The MP asks whether the Wgbh/cz applies to assistance dogs and whether the government will promote that. The Secretary of State answers that a bill extending the Act to goods and services, including public venues, is in preparation, which would require admitting guide dogs in nearly all cases unless a justified reason exists.

Such a legislative amendment would mean that the obligation to make effective adjustments (as laid down in Article 2 of that Act) will also apply to the field of goods and services and therefore also to public venues.

Een dergelijke wetswijziging heeft tot gevolg dat de verplichting om doeltreffende aanpassingen te treffen (zoals vervat in artikel 2 van die wet) ook op het terrein van goederen en diensten van toepassing zal zijn en dus ook voor de openbare gelegenheden zal gelden.

Vragen van het lid Bergkamp (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een op de tien jongeren online wordt gepes

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education and the Justice ministry about reports that one in ten young people is bullied online and whether the anti-bullying plan covers cyberbullying outside school. The government answered that cyberbullying is addressed within the school-focused plan, that criminal-law options exist for threatening conduct, and that police and prosecution do not register cyberbullying cases separately, so no figures can be given.
As a result, it is not possible to provide a numerical overview.
Daardoor is het niet mogelijk een cijfermatig overzicht te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘dat er nog altijd veel mis is in de gehandicaptenzorg’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a broadcast claiming many disability care institutions still fail minimum norms on restraint measures, plus related questions on training, registration, and liability. The state secretary rejected the broadcast's picture as unrepresentative (based on 44 risk-selected inspections), pointed to the Zorg en Dwang bill and an action programme, and promised a uniform registration of restraints and further research.
I want research to be carried out, in line with the Denktank's recommendations, into how clients experience involuntary care and into tools for care workers to better assess this experience.

Ik wil dat er, in lijn met de aanbevelingen van de Denktank, onderzoek worden gedaan naar de beleving van onvrijwillige zorg door cliënten en naar hulpmiddelen voor hulpverleners om deze beleving van cliënten beter te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Onmacht en angst zag ik in de time-outkamer’

Bergkamp (D66) asked about care-institution managers discussing a deceased client's case in a national newspaper, and whether this breaches medical confidentiality and privacy. The state secretary answered that privacy law does not protect the deceased, that confidentiality is only breached under narrow exceptions, leaves judging any breach to the courts, and commits to asking the CIZ to examine the indication procedure and inform relatives.
I consider the scope for protecting privacy in general to be sufficient.
Ik acht de ruimte voor het beschermen van de privacy in algemene zin voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitzending 'Beveiliging Nederlandse musea weinig verbeterd'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a broadcast saying museum security has changed little since the Kunsthal art theft, and whether museums share risk-reduction discussions and budget levels. The minister answered that security is a core museum task covered by integral safety plans overseen by the Erfgoedinspectie, that sector consultations take place, and that cost shares cannot be precisely determined.
The costs of security cannot be unambiguously determined.
De kosten voor beveiliging zijn niet eenduidig te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toepassing van een zelfbedachte behandelmethode

Parliamentary questions from MP Bergkamp (D66) ask whether an institution (NOVO in Onnen) experimented with a self-devised treatment method, whether that is permitted and supervised, and how the rules on taking over a location with a Bopz indication apply. The state secretary answers that the Kwaliteitswet applies to experimental treatments with the institution board responsible and the IGZ supervising, that no separate legal regime exists for new methods, and that NOVO never applied for a Bopz designation and had no Bopz clients, so the location was not authorised for such admissions.
Yes. The Quality Act also applies to experimental treatments.
Ja. De Kwaliteitswet is ook op experimentele behandelingen van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het signaal dat steeds meer Zorgkantoren een pgb-ontmoedigingsbeleid voeren

An MP asked the state secretary whether health insurers (Zorgkantoren) discourage personal budgets (pgb) by refusing them when clients have not explored contracted care and by holding conversations meant to deter pgb use, and whether this undermines the pgb as an equal alternative to care in kind. The state secretary answered that the approach follows the 2013 budget agreement, is aimed at conscious pgb choice rather than deterrence, and that he sees no signals that clients choosing pgb-funded small-scale housing were refused, while committing to keep discussing the matter with the insurers.
I do not characterise this approach as a deterrence policy, but as a policy aimed at conscious use of the pgb.
Ik kwalificeer deze aanpak niet als een ontmoedigingsbeleid, maar een beleid om te komen tot een bewust gebruik van het pgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bergkamp over het formuleren van kritische succesfactoren ten aanzien van de Transitie Jeugdzorg

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked whether critical success factors with SMART indicators should be formulated to monitor the youth care transition and what conditions must be met by 1 January 2014 for a responsible transition on 1 January 2015. The state secretary answered that the Transitieplan Jeugd, the spoorboekje and the independent Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd, which will assess regional arrangements on three criteria, serve as the steering instruments, without publishing SMART success factors.

The Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd (TSJ) will assess the regional transition arrangements on the basis of three criteria: realisation of continuity of care, realisation of the required infrastructure and limiting the friction costs resulting from the transition.

De Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd (TSJ) zal de regionale transitiearrangementen beoordelen op basis van drie criteria: realisatie continuïteit van zorg, realisatie benodigde infrastructuur en het beperken van de frictiekosten als gevolg van de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het gegeven dat er nog steeds geleidehonden van blinden en slechtzienden worden geweigerd in openbare gelegenheden.

An MP asks the state secretary for Health about guide dogs for blind and partially sighted people being refused in public places, as shown in a TV item. The secretary acknowledges the problem, points to awareness work, Amsterdam's taxi rule and a planned amendment of the equal treatment act that would extend reasonable-adjustment duties to goods and services, which would generally oblige public places to admit guide dogs.
This bill, together with the bill approving the treaty, is expected to be sent to the Council of State for advice after the summer.
Dit wetsontwerp zal te samen met het wetsvoorstel tot goedkeuring van het verdrag na verwachting na de zomer voor advies aan de Raad van State worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport “Opgeven is geen optie” van GGMD

An MP asked the state secretary about the GGMD report on multiple problems among deaf people and whether specific groups will be addressed in the planned letter on reforming long-term care. The secretary answered that the report concerns contracting between care offices and a provider, that he will address care for sensory-impaired people in a forthcoming letter, and that he will take into account a CVZ advisory report.
In the promised letter on specific groups I will also address the positioning of care and services for sensory-impaired people.
Ik zal in de toegezegde brief over specifieke groepen ook ingaan op de positionering van de zorg en dienstverlening aan zintuiglijk gehandicapten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Twijfels over cijfers geweld tegen ouderen”

The MP Bergkamp (D66) asks the state secretary whether the estimate of 200,000 abused elderly people per year rests on a 1996 study, whether it is still realistic, and whether new research will be commissioned. The state secretary confirms the estimate stems from 1996, says the true figure is likely much higher due to a taboo, and announces an exploratory study on feasibility of quantitative research to be reported in the autumn 2013 progress letter.
I therefore first want an exploration carried out into the possibilities for such research.
Ik wil daarom eerst een verkenning laten uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheden van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Laar over de participatie van doven en slechthorenden binnen de samenleving

MPs Bergkamp and Van Laar asked about participation of deaf and hard-of-hearing people in education, the labour market and sheltered workshops over ten years. The state secretary provided enrolment figures, noted missing data on start qualifications, sheltered workshop disability types and CI status, and gave older OSA labour-market estimates.
I cannot answer the question of how the ratio is among deaf pupils with and without a cochlear implant.
Ik kan geen antwoord geven op de vraag hoe de verhouding is onder dove leerlingen met en zonder cochleair implantaat.

Vragen van de leden Keijzer (CDA) en Bergkamp (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over de toekomst van de collectie van het Geldmuseum in Utrecht (ingezonden 8 juli 2013).

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked why the Finance Ministry ended its relationship with the Geldmuseum, what the collection costs and who will fund it, why the Finance working group's plan was not pursued, and what happens to the collection and building. The minister answers that the owners are in talks on a shared vision, closure followed the conclusion that continuity was no longer guaranteed, and future costs and collection arrangements are still under study, to be reported to the Chamber later.
No statements can yet be made about the amount of savings to be realised over time, because future storage and management of the collection, and its costs, are still being examined.

Over de hoogte van de op termijn te realiseren besparingen kunnen echter nog geen uitspraken gedaan worden, omdat toekomstige opslag en beheer van de collectie, alsmede de kosten hiervan, nog nader worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Anass (13) volgens OM niet aangezet tot zelfmoord”

MP Bergkamp asked the Education and Justice ministers about a case where the prosecutor found a 13-year-old was not incited to suicide by bullying, and what lessons follow, including whether the anti-bullying plan changes and when legislation comes. State Secretary Dekker answered that the case underlines the need for the existing anti-bullying plan, which will not be changed, that the Inspectorate will investigate the school after summer, and that a bill is planned for 2014 with a target of August 2015.
In this specific case, the Public Prosecution Service informed the Inspectorate of Education about the outcomes of the investigation.
In dit concrete geval heeft het Openbaar Ministerie de Inspectie van het Onderwijs geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Als pleegouder moet je veel in je mars hebben’

An MP asks the state secretary about media reports that foster parents quit quickly, tensions with child protection guardians, screening of foster parents, and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg ignores foster parents. The government answers that it lacks data on early quitting, describes a qualitative rather than quantitative shortage, refers to a themed day and a forthcoming letter on guardian-foster parent relations, and notes new legal rights for foster parents from 1 July 2013.
I do not have figures on the number of foster parents who stop prematurely with foster care.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal pleegouders dat voortijdig stopt met pleegzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het omzetten van dagbesteding binnen de PGB naar ZIN en vice versa

An MP asked the state secretary whether clients converting full day-care from PGB to in-kind care (ZIN) or back are cut in day-part entitlement, and whether this is an improper conversion. The secretary denies any cut, explains that from 2013 PGB day-care budgets for clients with a residential indication are tied to available VPT day-care funds, and declines to change course.
I do not share your view that unequal situations have arisen.
Ik deel niet uw mening dat er ongelijke situaties zijn ontstaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp inzake de bekendheid onder docenten met het pestprotocol

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary of Education whether many teachers are unaware of their school's anti-bullying protocol and what will be done to raise awareness. The state secretary cited monitor data showing most schools have behaviour rules, pointed to a joint anti-bullying plan with the Children's Ombudsman, and committed to teacher-training modules and a mandatory school-wide anti-bullying approach including a protocol.
The action plan states that a school-wide and structural anti-bullying approach will become mandatory.
In het plan van aanpak staat dat een schoolbrede en structurele pestaanpak verplicht gaat worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er een explosieve toename is van aanvragen voor zware zorg

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for Health about reports of a sharp rise in applications for heavy care, and whether patients are being wrongly given higher care-package indications. The state secretary acknowledged the rise, attributed it mainly to longer home-living policy and ageing, said an NZa analysis is still being studied, and promised an investigation into possible abuse and a later letter on the future access rules for long-term care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanpak van pgb-fraude (persoonsgebonden budget)

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Health about the enforcement against PGB (personal budget) fraud, including recovered amounts, evaluation, cooperation with professionals bound by medical confidentiality, the 2013 PGB rules, CIZ face-to-face assessments, Inspectorate SZW investigations, and the NZa's role. The state secretary answered that about EUR 6 million has been recovered so far, many measures are underway, and several items are still being developed, with some answers deferred or referred to other responsibilities.
Currently, VWS together with the parties involved is elaborating the introduction of the trekkingsrecht.
Momenteel wordt door VWS samen met betrokken partijen de invoering van het trekkingsrecht uitgewerkt.
Antwoord vragen Bergkamp over het bericht Zorgjongeren aan hun lot overgelaten in Alverna

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that youths needing 24-hour care were left without support at Alverna after the provider's bankruptcy and staff sick leave, and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg knew but did not intervene. The state secretary confirmed the Inspectorate visited the locations and found the reports accurate, said Bureau Jeugdzorg intervened promptly once aware, and referred to planned personal-budget (pgb) reforms in a separate letter.
The situation at Sterk!zorg shows that Bureau Jeugdzorg, from the moment it became aware of the worrying situation, intervened promptly.
De situatie bij Sterk!zorg laat zien dat bureau Jeugdzorg, vanaf het moment dat men bekend werd met de zorgelijke situatie, voortvarend in heeft ingegrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de extra toelage wooninitiatief

An MP asked the state secretary whether clients of small-scale housing initiatives were unclear about how the EUR 4,000 supplement is offset against the budget guarantee, and whether calculation and communication differ across care offices. The state secretary answered that clients were not always aware of the offsetting, that all care offices apply it the same way, that clients were informed late in some cases, and that the College voor Zorgverzekeringen will be asked to address the point in its next information bulletin.
Do you consider this desirable? Answer 2: The offsetting is laid down in the Regulation on AWBZ subsidies.
Vindt u dit wenselijk? Antwoord 2 De verrekening is vastgelegd in de Regeling subsidies AWBZ.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het capaciteitsverlies van de Koninklijke Marechaussee door het handhaven van het qat-verbod

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice how enforcement of the qat ban affects Marechaussee capacity, qat use, prices, illegal trade, addiction, and local nuisance. The Minister answered that qat enforcement is incidental for the KMar, that no data yet show reduced use or rising illegal trade, and that municipalities can already act under the Opium Act and the local Public Order Ordinance (APV).
There is as yet no data showing that the qat ban leads to less qat use.
Er zijn nog geen gegevens voorhanden waaruit zou blijken dat het qatverbod leidt tot minder qatgebruik
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het niet kunnen vinden van een goede behandelplek voor kinderen/jongeren met een zorgindicatie

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary about children and young people with a care indication who cannot find a suitable treatment place, which may lead to out-of-home placement or closed youth care. The state secretary said he is not aware of concrete cases, that data collection by Jeugdzorg Nederland is underway, and that out-of-home placement requires a judge's authorisation, in which parents' arguments are weighed.
A forced out-of-home placement is carried out carefully and can only be effected through judicial intervention in order to safeguard the rights of those involved.
Een gedwongen uithuisplaatsing gebeurt zorgvuldig en kan alleen via rechterlijke tussenkomst worden bewerkstelligd om zo de rechten van betrokkenen te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het niet verlenen van het mantelzorgcompliment en de vrijstelling erfrechtbelasting

An MP asks why carers of people with an intramural care indication who live at home do not receive the mantelzorgcompliment or the higher inheritance tax exemption, and what will be done about it. The state secretary acknowledges the unfairness, says a fix is not simple technically or budgetarily, and promises to inform parliament before summer; information for carers has also been improved.
Before the summer I will inform the House further about the mantelzorgcompliment.
Voor de zomer zal ik de Kamer nader informeren over het mantelzorgcompliment.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het onderzoek naar de hulp aan kinderen die betrokken zijn bij huiselijk geweld

MP Bergkamp (D66) asks the state secretary whether the study on help for children exposed to domestic violence shows that help often does not start, children drop out at each step, and whether central registration or other measures are planned. The state secretary acknowledges children do not always get needed help, points to a forthcoming child maltreatment guideline and ZonMw research, and says the study does not show Bureau Jeugdzorg lacks oversight or that coordination is absent, while citing decentralisation of youth care to municipalities as the response.
On the question of whether the help provided is effective, no unambiguous answer can be given.
Op de vraag of de geboden hulp wel effectief is, is geen eenduidig antwoord te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat jeugdzorg steeds meer zelfstandige ondernemers krijgt

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Inspectie Jeugdzorg supervises private youth care providers only indirectly through the main contractor, and how quality and child safety are guaranteed, including for persoonsgebonden budget arrangements. The State Secretary answered that the main contractor remains responsible and must give the Inspectorate access to subcontracted private providers, that the Inspectorate has regular supervision of main contractors, and that for PGB situations the IGZ supervises under the Kwaliteitswet, with the Wcz amendment extending complaint and handling rules to sole practitioners.
The main contractor ensures that the IJZ has access to the private subcontractor where the client resides.
De hoofdaannemer draagt er zorg voor dat de IJZ toegang heeft tot de particuliere onderaannemer waar de cliënt verblijft.
Antwoord vragen Bergklamp en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van premier Erdogan

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the Prime Minister whether he would send Parliament a report on Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's visit, covering the political dialogue and the controversy over foster care in the Netherlands, within a week. The answer states that the questions were already answered in the Prime Minister's letter of 27 March 2013.
These questions have been answered in the letter of the Prime Minister, Minister of General Affairs of 27 March 2013
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij de brief van de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken van 27 maart 2013
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over voortgang jeugdzorg’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries for Health and for Justice about concrete activities and results in preparing the youth care transition, before and after November 2012. The government listed the parliamentary letters, debates and the 28 February 2013 letter, and said a transition plan will be sent to parliament after April consultations with VNG and IPO.
The Transition Plan will address the process planning, programme structure, method of steering and allocation of responsibilities.
In het Transitieplan zal worden ingegaan op de procesplanning, de programmastructuur, de wijze van sturing en de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht “Meer gedwongen opnames”

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that compulsory psychiatric admissions rose between 2002 and 2009, including whether the trend continues, regional differences, and effects on outpatient care and costs. The minister confirmed the rise (64% for court authorisations, 20% for emergency detentions), said numbers were roughly flat through 2012, and pointed to the new Wet verplichte ggz and outpatient coercion as ways to reduce compulsory admissions.
Preventing compulsory admissions has my attention and is part of the GGZ policy aimed at reducing coercive measures in mental health care.
Het voorkomen van dwangopnamen mijn aandacht en is onderdeel van het ingezette ggz beleid met betrekking tot het terugdringen van dwangtoepassingen in de GGZ.
Antwoord vragen Bergkamp over het bericht dat de jeugdzorg steeds meer zelfstandige ondernemers krijgt

Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that youth care increasingly uses self-employed foster-home operators, including quality, supervision, and the roughly 36,000 euro per child payment. The state secretary said particular providers must meet the same quality standards under a protocol with provinces and the Inspectie Jeugdzorg, but did not have data on the number of children in such homes and said the payment is income plus costs, with motives for becoming a foster parent left to subsidised providers to assess.
I do not have data on the number of children who stay in private foster homes.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over het aantal kinderen dat in particuliere gezinshuizen verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over Turkse pleegkinderen

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked about Turkish criticism of Dutch foster care for Turkish children, whether Turkey has authority over them, and whether foster parents can be excluded on religion or sexual orientation. The state secretary answered that placement follows careful rules considering the child's religious and cultural background, that Turkey has no authority over these children, and that exclusion on religion or sexual orientation is not allowed.
I am willing to report to the House on this.
Ik ben bereid hierover verslag te doen aan de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de activiteiten van de stichting Ombudsman op 1 juni a.s. worden beëindigd

MP Bergkamp asked whether the closure of the Stichting De Ombudsman's activities, after subsidies for patient and broadcast-related organisations ended, means social-legal assistance disappears, and who takes it over and how it fits the Wmo and AWBZ reforms. The state secretary answered that CG-Raad, Platform VG, NPCF and Landelijk Platform GGZ will provide legal support to their own members from April 2013 via a new joint service, that municipalities are not responsible for funding the national foundation, and that the care reform letter will address citizens' safeguards.
In my policy letter on the reform of long-term care I will go into detail on the safeguards for and position of the citizen.
In mijn beleidsbrief over de hervorming van de langdurige zorg zal ik uitgebreid ingaan op de waarborgen voor en de positie van de burger.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Bergkamp over een tax shelter voor de filmindustrie

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about introducing a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry, its prevalence in the EU, its design, and its effects on competitiveness and Dutch post-production firms. The government answered that it does not intend to introduce a tax shelter because it conflicts with its simplification agenda, and gave limited figures on foreign spending and bankruptcies while saying the effects on public finances are unknown.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to introduce a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens een tax shelter voor de Nederlandse filmindustrie te introduceren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Falende aanpak jongeren” (onderzoek van instituut Movisie)

An MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a Movisie study finding that youth policy and youth-work/police cooperation fall short, including on prevention, unemployment and reporting crime. The secretary answers that local municipalities are primarily responsible, describes good cooperation and prevention efforts, and says the study's recommendations will be shared with municipalities via the VNG.
The municipality is responsible for (steering) the approach to youth nuisance.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de (regie op de) aanpak van jongerenoverlast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about reports that more children are sexually exploited, including whether agencies under-report victims and whether the government underestimates the problem. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, saying CoMensha records age at the time of reporting, describing pilots and training to spot trafficking signals, and denying a structural shortage of shelter places.
It is being examined whether additional information on victims can be supplied to CoMensha and recorded in a new registration system.
Er wordt bekeken of het mogelijk is aanvullende informatie over slachtoffers aan CoMensha te leveren en te registreren in een nieuw registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat monumentenorganisaties de Kamer oproepen niet mee te gaan in de afstoot van monumenten door het Rijk

An MP asked the minister whether heritage organisations' concerns about the State selling Rijksmonumenten are justified and what safeguards exist after sale. The minister rejected the concerns, said heritage is adequately protected by law, and disclosed a list of 34 monuments selected for possible sale, to be published once the sale starts.
To ensure the care and transparency of the process, the overview will be made public once the public sale can begin.
Om de zorgvuldigheid en transparantie van het proces te waarborgen zal het overzicht publiekelijk bekend worden gemaakt als de openbare vervreemding van start kan gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het makkelijker aan drank komen door jongeren

An MP asked the state secretary whether the 1 January 2013 decentralisation of alcohol law enforcement to municipalities would make it easier for youths to obtain alcohol, and how enforcement was progressing. The state secretary rejected that conclusion, said some municipalities were not yet ready but a transition arrangement applies, and pointed to NVWA support and guidance for municipalities.
In the coming months I will closely monitor developments regarding the decentralisation of supervision.
De komende maanden zal ik de ontwikkelingen omtrent de decentralisatie van het toezicht op de voet volgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de eigen bijdragen WMO/ AWBZ door de Vermogensinkomensbijstelling

An MP asked the state secretary how people facing higher AWBZ/Wmo co-payments due to the capital-income add-back were informed, whether the measure was included in the CPB and Nibud purchasing-power calculations, and how chronically ill people and people with disabilities are affected. The government answered that about 238,000 clients were notified by letter, the measure was not included in those calculations, and the CAK does not record chronic illness or disability, so the number affected is unknown.
The CAK does not record whether insured persons who owe an AWBZ or Wmo co-payment have a chronic illness or a disability.
Het CAK registreert niet of de verzekerden die een eigen bijdrage AWBZ of WMO verschuldigd zijn, chronisch ziek zijn of een beperking hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toestand van het VOC-archief in Jakarta

An MP asked the education and culture minister about the deteriorating condition of the VOC archive in Jakarta and what the government would do to improve it. The minister said the archive is partly damaged by ink corrosion but stabilised since repackaging, that cooperation with Indonesia continues, and that digitisation and conservation will be pursued under a 2013-2016 programme with a new plan expected in spring.
Within the Shared Cultural Heritage programme 2013-2016, emphasis will shift to increasing accessibility and use of colonial archives through digitisation.
Binnen het programma voor Gedeeld Cultureel Erfgoed 2013–2016 komt de nadruk te liggen op vergroting van toegankelijkheid en gebruik van koloniale archieven door middel van digitalisering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Smits inzake pesten bij kinderen van 4 tot 18 jaar

Two MPs asked the state secretary about bullying programmes, budgets, effectiveness, inter-policy coordination, the government's role, school sanctions and school safety monitoring. The government answered at length, describing programmes and budgets, noting evaluations are not yet complete, promising a plan of action in March, and reporting that no clear trend in bullying has been found.
The studies from the Onderwijs Bewijs action programme have not yet been completed.
De onderzoeken uit het actieprogramma Onderwijs Bewijs zijn nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord vragen Bergkamp over ‘illegale internaten in moskeeën’

An MP asked whether unlicensed boarding schools for children, reportedly in mosques, exist, how they are enforced, and what role municipalities, the GGD and youth care bodies have in oversight. The minister answered that the national government does not know how many exist, that municipalities enforce fire-safety use permits under the Wabo, and that no formal grounds for welfare oversight exist, so he will consult municipalities on whether existing instruments suffice.
I do not know how many boarding schools there are in the Netherlands.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel internaten er in Nederland zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Filmlaboratorium Cineco failliet’

MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Finance about the bankruptcy of film laboratory Cineco, including its causes, consequences for the Dutch film industry, and whether a tax shelter is needed for a level playing field in Europe. The minister answered that the consequences are hard to judge yet, that the industry itself must look at preserving Cineco's expertise, and that it cannot yet be determined whether the lack of a tax shelter was decisive, while creating new fiscal facilities for specific sectors conflicts with simplifying the tax system.
It is up to the industry itself to examine whether there are possibilities to preserve Cineco's knowledge and expertise in the Netherlands.
Het is aan de bedrijfstak zelf om te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de kennis en kunde van Cineco in Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold en Bergkamp over de kunstroof in Rotterdam

MPs Pechtold and Bergkamp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the theft of seven paintings from the Kunsthal in Rotterdam, including whether one security guard was sufficient and whether the unit for art crime and the stolen-art database were adequately resourced. The minister regretted the theft, left security arrangements to the museum and insurer, explained that the art-crime group was expanded from three to four FTE and that the database holds about 1,700 stolen objects, and said regional art-crime contact persons are being appointed.
I deeply regret that these paintings were stolen from the Kunsthal.
Ik betreur het zeer dat deze schilderijen gestolen zijn uit de Kunsthal.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het artikel ‘Steeds meer kinderen in opvang, geen goede hulp’

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether he shares the concern that more children are ending up in homeless shelters without adequate help, and whether a guidance and safety plan such as the Veerkracht method should be introduced. The state secretary agreed that children do not belong in shelters, pointed to prevention and the decentralisations to municipalities, and said he will finance adapting and nationally implementing the Veerkracht method from 2014.
I therefore finance the adaptation of the Veerkracht method for social shelter.
Ik financier daarom de aanpassing van de methodiek Veerkracht voor de maatschappelijke opvang.

m: Amendement van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij ter vervanging van nr. 16 over extra middelen voor gedetineerdenbegeleiding buitenland
Shifts 100,000 euro within the foreign ministry budget to legal support for Dutch detainees abroad.
This can be covered from distribution article 2.4.
Dit kan gedekt worden uit verdeelartikel 2.4.
Amendement van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over extra middelen voor gedetineerdenbegeleiding buitenland
Moves 100,000 euro from security and stability to consular services to fund legal support for Dutch prisoners abroad.
This can be covered from allocation article 2.4.
Dit kan gedekt worden uit verdeelartikel 2.4.
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma over het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds in 2024
Moves €2 million from the Security and Stability budget to the Human Rights Fund to reverse the 2024 cut to the Human Rights Fund.
we ask the Minister to reverse the cuts to the Human Rights Fund for budget year 2024
vragen we de Minister om bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds voor het begrotingsjaar 2024 terug te draaien
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over de autoriteiten in Qatar oproepen om individuen uit de top van Hamas te arresteren en uit te leveren
Asks the cabinet to urge Qatar's authorities to arrest and extradite senior Hamas leaders.
requests the cabinet to urge the authorities in Qatar to arrest and extradite individuals from the top of Hamas
verzoekt het kabinet om de autoriteiten in Qatar op te roepen om individuen uit de top van Hamas te arresteren en uit te leveren
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over de revolutie van miljoenen dappere Iraniërs voor een vrije, democratische samenleving blijvend steunen
Motion asking the cabinet to continue supporting the Iranian revolution for a free democratic society.
requests the cabinet to continue supporting the revolution of millions of brave Iranians for a free democratic society
verzoekt het kabinet om de revolutie van miljoenen dappere Iraniërs voor een vrije, democratische samenleving blijvend te steunen
Motie van de leden Mutluer en Sjoerdsma over een invoeringstoets met ten minste de vraag of de NCTV zijn coördinatietaak kan uitvoeren zonder de grenzen daarvan te overschrijden
Asks the government to carry out an implementation review one year after the NCTV coordination law takes effect, checking whether the NCTV can perform its coordination task within its legal limits.
requests the government to carry out an implementation review one year after the entry into force of this bill
verzoekt de regering één jaar na inwerkingtreding van de voorliggende wet een invoeringstoets uit te voeren
Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over het afschermen van en het beperken van de toegang tot gegevens in het Kadaster
Asks the government to allow residents facing threats to shield their home address in the Kadaster and to restrict access to private addresses to professional users only.
upon request, can have their address shielded in the Kadaster
op verzoek hun adres kunnen laten afschermen in het Kadaster
Amendement van het lid Werner c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 128 over middelen voor audiodescriptie
Shifts 1.05 million euro per year from a media reserve to the public broadcaster to fund audio description for visually impaired viewers.
this amendment makes 4,200,000 euro available over 2023 to 2026 for audio description
Met dit amendement wordt voor de huidige erkenningsperiode € 4.200.000 meerjarig over de jaren 2023 tot en met 2026 beschikbaar gemaakt voor audiodescriptie
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over een onderzoek naar extra inzet voor humanitaire ontmijning in Cherson
Asks the government to investigate whether extra resources can be provided for humanitarian demining in the Kherson region.
requests the government to investigate whether extra effort can be made for humanitarian demining in the Kherson region
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er extra inzet kan worden geleverd voor humanitaire ontmijning in de regio Cherson
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over zich binnen de VN inspannen om Iran te verwijderen uit de Commissie voor de Status van de Vrouw
Motion asking the government to work within the UN to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women.
requests the government to work within the United Nations to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women
verzoekt de regering zich binnen de Verenigde Naties in te spannen Iran te verwijderen uit de Commissie voor de Status van de Vrouw
Motie van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over het versterken van de banden met Taiwan
Motion asks government to strengthen bilateral and EU ties with Taiwan and inform the House within three months.
requests the government to strengthen ties with Taiwan bilaterally and in EU context in every possible way and to inform the House within three months
verzoekt de regering de banden bilateraal en in EU-verband met Taiwan op elke mogelijke wijze te versterken, en de Kamer hierover binnen drie maanden te informeren
Motie van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over het aanmerken van Rusland als staatssponsor van terrorisme
Asks the House to declare Russia a state sponsor of terrorism, citing attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine.
declares that Russia must be designated a state sponsor of terrorism
spreekt uit dat Rusland moet worden aangemerkt als «staatssponsor van terrorisme»
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over de herijking van het buitenlandbeleid waarbij mensenrechten als kernbelang centraal worden gesteld
Asks the government to recalibrate foreign policy with human rights as a core interest and to reduce dependencies on rival powers, reporting within four months.
requests the government to recalibrate foreign policy, placing human rights centrally as a core interest
verzoekt de regering het buitenlandbeleid te herijken, waarbij mensenrechten als kernbelang centraal worden gesteld
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. over middelen voor een taskforce om moorden op journalisten op te lossen
Moves 500,000 euro from the UN crisis-management contribution to a one-off taskforce on unsolved murders of journalists.
The submitters propose to release 500,000 euro once for this purpose.
Indieners stellen voor hiervoor eenmalig € 500.000 euro vrij te maken.
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over middelen voor een taskforce om moorden op journalisten op te lossen
Moves 500,000 euro from crisis management contributions to the foreign affairs budget to fund a taskforce investigating murders of journalists.
With these funds the Netherlands, as co-chair of the Media Freedom Coalition, can make a start on an international team of legal and forensic experts
Met deze middelen kan Nederland als medevoorzitter van de media freedom coalition een begin maken aan een internationaal team van juridische en forensische experts
Amendement van het lid Piri c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over middelen voor het NFRP-Matra fonds
Shifts 1 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to the NFRP-Matra fund for rule of law and democracy in neighbouring countries.
The funds benefit article 2.5 Promotion of transition in priority areas
De middelen komen ten goed aan artikel 2.5 Bevordering van transitie in prioritaire gebieden
Motie van de leden Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over de doelstelling dat alle Nederlanders in een buitenlandse gevangenis aanspraak kunnen maken op de juridische en/of sociale ondersteuning
Asks the government to set as a goal that all Dutch nationals in foreign prisons can access legal and social support when drafting the new subsidy framework.
requests the government, when creating the new subsidy framework, to put continuity, quality, generosity and appreciation of differences in emphasis at the centre
verzoekt de regering bij de totstandkoming van het nieuwe subsidiekader continuïteit, kwaliteit, ruimhartigheid en waardering van accentverschillen centraal te laten staan
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. over grootschalige corruptie als overtreding toevoegen aan de EU-Magnitskywetgeving
Asks the government to build EU support for adding large-scale corruption as a ground for sanctions under the EU Magnitsky regime and to report to the House within three months.
requests the government to build support in the European Union to add large-scale corruption as an offence
verzoekt de regering in de Europese Unie draagvlak te creëren om grootschalige corruptie als overtreding toe te voegen
Motie van de leden Sjoerdsma en Brekelmans over volledige digitalisering van de consulaire documentverstrekking
Asks the government to fully digitise consular document issuance, including repeat applications without appearance requirement, by 2023, without unacceptable security and privacy risks.
requests the government to have fully digitised consular document issuance by 2023 at the latest
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk in 2023 de consulaire documentverstrekking volledig gedigitaliseerd te hebben
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma over nieuwe mogelijkheden voor digitalisering van producten en diensten voor Nederlanders in het buitenland
Asks the government to identify new options for digitising products and services for Dutch citizens abroad and to make a medium-term plan for this.
requests the government to identify new options for digitising products and services for Dutch nationals abroad
verzoekt de regering om nieuwe mogelijkheden te identificeren voor het digitaliseren van producten en diensten voor Nederlanders in het buitenland
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over de financiering van de beveiliging van het postennetwerk
Asks the government to investigate how embassy security costs can be financed without burdening policy and operating budgets of the diplomatic network, and inform the Chamber.
requests the government to map as soon as possible how security of the diplomatic network can be financed
verzoekt de regering op zo kort mogelijk termijn in kaart te brengen op welke wijze de beveiliging van het postennet kan worden gefinancierd
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over het ondersteunen van de Belarussische oppositie in de Baltische staten
Asks the government to contact the Belarusian opposition in the Baltic states, identify its needs for opposition work and exposing regime abuses, and support those needs.
requests the government to contact the Belarusian opposition in the Baltic states at very short notice
verzoekt de regering op zeer korte termijn in contact te treden met de Belarussische oppositie in de Baltische staten
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over een Europees wapenembargo instellen voor Ethiopië
Asks the government to introduce a European arms embargo on Ethiopia because of the conflict and export criteria.
requests the government to introduce a European arms embargo for Ethiopia
verzoekt de regering een Europees wapenembargo in te stellen voor Ethiopië
Motie van het lid Kuzu c.s. over een sanctiepakket dat direct gericht is op Milorad Dodik en zijn machtskring
Asks the government to push in the EU for a sanctions package targeting Milorad Dodik and his circle, and for the Foreign Minister to urge EU colleagues to distance themselves from his statements.
Requests the cabinet to advocate in the European Union for a sanctions package directly targeting Milorad Dodik.
verzoekt het kabinet om in de Europese Unie te pleiten voor een sanctiepakket dat direct gericht is op Milorad Dodik
Motie van het lid Kuzu c.s. over het vasthouden aan democratische en rechtstatelijke uitgangspunten bij ondersteuning en financiering van humanitaire en mensenrechtenorganisaties in Israël

Motion asking the government to keep to democratic and rule-of-law principles in funding Israeli and Palestinian human rights NGOs, so that terrorism accusations are backed by evidence tested by a judge.

considering that the government, given the gravity and possible consequences of an accusation of supporting terrorism, attaches great importance to substantiating any accusation with evidence that is accessible to the accused and their lawyers and tested by a judge

overwegende dat de regering, gezien de ernst en mogelijke gevolgen van de beschuldiging van steun aan terrorisme, «groot belang hecht aan onderbouwing van een eventuele beschuldiging met bewijs dat inzichtelijk is voor de beschuldigde en zijn of haar advocaten en getoetst wordt door een rechter»
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over middelen voor het vergroten van de sanctiecapaciteit
Shifts 1 million euro within the foreign ministry budget from a UN crisis-operations contribution to staff, to add sanctions-drafting capacity at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Motie van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over een draaiboek in verband met cyberaanvallen en voor een bondgenootschappelijke reactie
Asks the government to draw up and exercise a playbook for cyberattack scenarios, including diplomatic response, and to push for an allied response plan.
requests the government to draw up and practise a playbook for cyberattack scenarios, including a diplomatic response
verzoekt de regering een draaiboek op te stellen en te oefenen met scenario's voor cyberaanvallen, inclusief diplomatieke reactie
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over middelen voor lhbti- en vrouwenrechten in het Mensenrechtenfonds
Asks the government to allow Human Rights Fund money for 2022-2027 to be used for LGBTI and women's rights, including affordable safe abortion, in Europe.
requests the government to make it possible in the Human Rights Fund for 2022-2027 to deploy these funds for LGBTI and women's rights
verzoekt de regering om het in het Mensenrechtenfonds in de periode 2022–2027 mogelijk te maken deze middelen in te zetten voor lhbti- en vrouwenrechten
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. over geen regeringsafvaardiging naar de Olympische Winterspelen sturen
Asks cabinet not to send a government delegation to the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics given Uyghur detention.
requests the cabinet not to send a government delegation to the 2022 Winter Olympics in China
verzoekt het kabinet geen regeringsafvaardiging naar de Olympische Winterspelen 2022 in China te sturen
Amendement van het lid Ceder c.s. over middelen voor het beschermen en ondersteunen van slachtoffers van religieuze vervolging
Moves budget from the security and stability article to the international legal order article to fund a rapid response fund protecting victims of religious persecution.
The increase in article 1 benefits article 1.2 Protection and promotion of human rights.
