De verhoging in artikel 1 komt ten goede aan artikel 1.2 Bescherming en bevordering van mensenrechten.
Amendement van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over middelen voor een taskforce tegen afhankelijkheid van autoritaire grootmachten
Shifts funds within the security budget to create a taskforce reducing strategic dependence on authoritarian powers such as China.
Preparations are made to set up a Taskforce.
Daarbij worden voorbereidingen getroffen om een Taskforce in te richten.
Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over middelen voor het vergroten van weerbaarheid tegen statelijke cyberdreigingen
Shifts EUR 500 thousand within the defence and security budget from the Stabiliteitsfonds to combating international crime and terrorism, with multi-year earmarking.
In article 2 Security and stability, the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by EUR 500 (x EUR 1,000).
In artikel 2 Veiligheid en stabiliteit worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 500 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. over middelen voor het vergroten van de sanctiecapaciteit
Shifts 1 million euro within the foreign ministry budget from UN crisis-operations contributions to staff capacity for EU sanctions work.
Coverage is found by reducing article 2.4 Promotion of security, stability and rule of law internationally (UN contribution for crisis management operations) by 1 million euro.

De dekking wordt gevonden door artikel 2.4 Bevordering van veiligheid, stabiliteit en rechtsorde in internationaal verband (VN-contributie voor crisisbeheersingsoperaties) te verlagen met € 1 miljoen.
Motie van het lid Ellian c.s. over recht doen aan het leed van Julio Poch
Asks the government, as a matter of goodwill, to make maximum efforts to redress the harm suffered by Julio Poch after data sharing led to his transfer to Argentina.

requests the government not to apply binding assistance in any way
verzoekt de regering, op geen enkele wijze gebonden hulp toe te passen
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over de bestrijding van vrouwenbesnijdenis
Asks the government to name and promote combating female genital mutilation more explicitly as a political priority.
requests the government to name and promote the fight against female genital mutilation more emphatically as a political priority
verzoekt de regering, de bestrijding van vrouwenbesnijdenis nadrukkelijker als politieke prioriteit te benoemen en uit te dragen
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over afrekenbare doelen
Asks the government to inform the House by letter about the measurable goals for foreign trade and development cooperation in 2014.
requests the government to inform the House by letter about the measurable goals
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer per brief te informeren over de afrekenbare doelen
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over bestedingen uit het BIV en het DGGF
Asks the government to inform the House when spending from the DGGF and BIV was not development-relevant and why such funding was chosen.
requests the government to inform the House when spending from the Dutch Good Growth Fund and the International Security Budget was not development-relevant and why such funding was chosen

verzoekt de regering om, de Kamer te informeren wanneer bestedingen uit het Dutch Good Growth Fund en het Budget Internationale Veiligheid niet ontwikkelingsrelevant waren en waarom dan toch is gekozen voor dergelijke financiering
Motie van het lid Servaes c.s. over opnemen van mensenrechtennormen in reglementen van internationale sportfederaties
Motion asking the government to work for inclusion of human rights and workers' rights norms in international sports federations' rules for major events.
requests the government to work, both internationally and with national sports bodies, for the inclusion of human rights norms
verzoekt de regering, zich zowel in internationaal verband als in samenwerking met nationale sportkoepels in te zetten voor de opname van mensenrechtennormen
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over advies over "Responsibility to Protect" in relatie tot noodhulp
Asks the government to request an advisory opinion from the Advisory Council on International Affairs on Responsibility to Protect in relation to emergency humanitarian aid.
requests the government to ask the Advisory Council on International Affairs whether it can advise on Responsibility to Protect in relation to emergency aid
verzoekt de regering, de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken te verzoeken of hij advies kan uitbrengen over «Responsibility to Protect» in relatie tot noodhulp
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. dat  een halvering van de voorgenomen bezuiniging op het postennetwerk in het jaar 2014 bewerkstelligt
Shifts 10 million euro from the non-policy Nominaal en onvoorzien article to the Apparaat article to halve a planned cut to the diplomatic post network in 2014, keeping consulates open.
Coverage is found in non-policy article 6: Nominal and unforeseen.
Dekking wordt gevonden op niet-beleidsartikel 6: Nominaal en onvoorzien.
Amendement van het lid Voordewind c.s. over alternatieve besteding binnen de ODA-begroting
Reallocates development aid budget lines within the ODA budget to Syria emergency aid, child labour and child welfare, and other programmes.
The contribution to the Dutch Good Growth Fund is reduced by EUR 50 million in 2014 and this amount receives an alternative allocation within the ODA budget
De storting in het Dutch Good Growth Fund wordt in 2014 met EUR 50 mln verlaagd en dit bedrag krijgt een alternatieve bestemming binnen de ODA-begroting
Motie van de leden Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over versterking van de rol van vrouwen in conflictsituaties als voorwaarde
Asks the government to make use of the International Security budget conditional on strengthening women's role in conflict situations.
requests the government to attach to the use of the International Security Budget the condition that it contributes to strengthening the role of women in conflict situations
verzoekt de regering, aan de inzet van het Budget voor Internationale Veiligheid de voorwaarde te stellen dat het bijdraagt aan versterking van de rol van vrouwen in conflictsituaties
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over activiteiten uitsluiten van het budget internationale veiligheid
Asks the government to exclude from the International Security Budget activities linked to alliance obligations or defence of national territory whose development relevance cannot be guaranteed.
to exclude activities whose development relevance cannot be guaranteed and which relate to alliance obligations or defence of national territory

activiteiten waarvan de ontwikkelingsrelevantie niet kan worden gewaarborgd en die verband houden met bondgenootschappelijke verplichtingen dan wel de verdediging van eigen grondgebied, uit te sluiten
Motie Sjoerdsma over afstemming binnen de EU over het opzeggen van VN-verdragen
Asks the government to coordinate within the EU in advance before terminating UN treaties or withdrawing from UN organisations.
coordinate in advance within the European Union the termination of UN treaties and memberships of UN organisations
opzegging van VN-verdragen en lidmaatschappen van VN-organisaties vooraf af te stemmen binnen de Europese Unie
Motie Sjoerdsma over de mogelijkheid van publiek-private financiering van het lidmaatschap van UNIDO
Asks the government to discuss public-private financing of UNIDO membership with Dutch business and report to the House before terminating membership.
to report to the House on this before terminating the UNIDO membership
hierover aan de Kamer te rapporteren alvorens het lidmaatschap van UNIDO op te zeggen
Motie Omtzigt c.s. over onderzoek naar het geweld van de Turkse autoriteiten tegen demonstranten
Asks the government to press Turkish authorities for an independent investigation into violence against demonstrators and to report back to parliament.
requests the government, and the foreign minister in particular, to personally urge a member of the Turkish government for a swift and independent investigation
verzoekt de regering, en in het bijzonder de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, woensdag persoonlijk bij een lid van de Turkse regering te pleiten voor een snel en onafhankelijk onderzoek
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over een actieplan voor een duidelijke en gearticuleerde beleidsvisie
Motion asks the government to draw up an integrated action plan and inform the House in writing on strengthening political steering of the Benelux.
requests the government to draw up an integrated action plan
verzoekt de regering, een integraal actieplan op te stellen
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over de bindendheid van wapenexportbesluiten
Asks the government to seek EU-level agreement that an independent Commission gives public opinions on significant arms exports and that a member state's arms export decision binds all member states.
not the member states themselves but an independent arbiter gives advice on significant arms exports
niet lidstaten zelf, maar een onafhankelijke scheidsrechter een advies geeft over significante wapenexporten
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bijstaan van de NIMH, de  KITLV en het NIOD bij hun onderzoek
Asks the government to support the NIMH, KITLV and NIOD diplomatically and practically in their research on Dutch military action in Indonesia 1945-1949.
to assist the institutes diplomatically and practically so that the research proceeds smoothly
de instituten in diplomatieke en praktische zin bij te staan om het onderzoek voorspoedig te laten verlopen
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma over een actieve inzet voor de aansluiting van zo veel mogelijk landen bij het Internationaal Strafhof
Asks the government to actively work bilaterally and multilaterally for as many countries as possible to join the Rome Statute and the International Criminal Court.
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over de verwijdering van Europese tactische kernwapens
Asks the government to make removal of European tactical nuclear weapons a hard goal and to put it on the agenda of the Oslo conference, reporting to the House beforehand.
requests the government to formulate the removal of European tactical nuclear weapons as a hard objective
verzoekt de regering, de verwijdering van Europese tactische kernwapens als harde doelstelling te formuleren
Motie Sjoerdsma over een nulmeting naar het draagvlak voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the government to conduct a baseline survey on public support for development cooperation and repeat it annually.
carry out a baseline measurement of support for development cooperation and repeat it annually
een nulmeting uit te voeren naar het draagvlak voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking, deze meting jaarlijks te herhalen
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Shifts €10 million within the development budget from Mali budget support to the FLOW fund for women and girls in developing countries in 2013.
Coverage is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Maij c.s. over een nationaal comité van UN Women in Nederland
Asks the government to investigate options and costs for facilitating a Dutch national committee of UN Women and inform the House before the 2014 budget.
requests the government, before the 2014 budget debate, to examine the options for facilitating a national committee of UN Women in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, voor de behandeling van de begroting voor 2014 te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de vestiging van een nationaal comité van UN Women in Nederland te faciliteren
Motie Van Ojik c.s. over de bezuinigingen van het vorige kabinet-Rutte
Asks the government to study the effects of the previous Rutte cabinet's aid cuts on developing countries and report to the House before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to conduct a study into the effects on developing countries and programmes of the cuts by the previous Rutte cabinet
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek in te stellen naar de gevolgen voor ontwikkelingslanden en -programma's van de bezuinigingen van het vorige kabinet-Rutte
Motie Sjoerdsma c.s. over inzicht in de besteding van de ontwikkelingsgelden
Asks the government to give the best possible insight into how development aid funds are spent and their results, through digital publication.
requests the government to give the best possible insight into the spending of development funds and their results
verzoekt de regering, een zo goed mogelijk inzicht te geven in de besteding van de ontwikkelingsgelden en de resultaten daarvan
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Amendment moving 10 million euros to the FLOW fund for women in developing countries in 2013, financed by cutting budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Asks the government to make all development-relevant research it finances freely and digitally available and to encourage funded organisations to do the same.
requests the government to make all development-relevant research financed by the Dutch government digitally and freely available
verzoekt de regering, al het door de Nederlandse overheid gefinancierde ontwikkelingsrelevante onderzoek digitaal en vrijelijk ter beschikking te stellen
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het in 2013 eenmalig verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor UN-Women met € 2 miljoen
Increases funding for UN Women by 2 million euros in 2013 by reducing budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by reducing article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden via een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Sjoerdsma c.s. over de klimaatgelden
Asks the government to inform the House in spring 2013 on how climate funds can avoid reducing development programmes without a climate goal, including scenarios for private financing.
to inform the House in spring 2013 on how climate funds can be spent so that they come as little as possible at the expense of development programmes without a climate goal
de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2013 te informeren over de wijze waarop de klimaatgelden zo min mogelijk ten koste van ontwikkelingsprogramma's zonder klimaatdoel gaan
Asks the government to apply the FIETS sustainability criteria to the planned revolving development fund of 750 million euro.
requests the government to also declare these sustainability criteria applicable to the revolving fund yet to be established
verzoekt de regering, deze duurzaamheidscriteria ook van toepassing te verklaren voor het nog op te richten revolverende fonds
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Paternotte over het onderzoek naar het overlijden van een Nederlandse staatsburger in Gaza

D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister how long the government had pressed Israel for an explanation of the death of a Dutch national in Gaza, how many Dutch citizens remain in Gaza, and what steps were taken to evacuate them. The minister answered that Israel has promised information but not yet delivered it, that the government will keep pressing, and that evacuation efforts depend on the security situation.
Israel reportedly also draws up battle damage assessments after military operations. However, these documents are confidential and are not shared with other countries.
Daarnaast stelt Israël na afloop van militaire operaties naar verluidt «battle damage assessments» op. Deze stukken zijn echter vertrouwelijk en worden niet met andere landen gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het D66-plan ‘Toekomst van toetreding’

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister whether the government agrees that the EU enlargement process should be reformed, and to respond to the party's plan for phased accession. The minister defended the current merit-based, conditional and reversible enlargement methodology, noted some faster integration options and declined to back revising the methodology.
Although the cabinet is open to new ideas for cooperation with candidate member states, the government is not in favour of revising the methodology of the EU enlargement process.
Hoewel het kabinet openstaat voor nieuwe ideeën voor samenwerking met de kandidaat-lidstaten, is de regering geen voorstander van het herzien van de methodologie van het EU-uitbreidingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht in Russische media inzake voorbereidingen van het Kremlin op de presidentsverkiezingen van 2024 door middel van een “lijst van vertrouwelingen”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Kremlin is drawing up a list of loyalists backing Putin's 2024 re-election campaign, and whether individuals on it should face EU sanctions such as entry bans before the list is public. The minister said the government will monitor developments, that sanctions are assessed per individual on solid evidence, and that people cannot be sanctioned before the list is published, while not disclosing future sanctions plans.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanctions measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op van het lid Sjoerdsma over het persbericht van de VN over de stemmingsuitslagen met betrekking tot de resolutie die oproept tot ‘humanitair staakt-het-vuren’ in de Gazastrook

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands abstained rather than voted for the UN resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza, and how it squares with the Prime Minister's call for more aid. The minister replied that the Netherlands abstained with an explanatory statement to preserve EU unity, citing missing condemnation of Hamas and gaps on hostage release, and committed to continued advocacy for humanitarian pauses, aid access and hostage release.

For this reason the Netherlands chose to abstain with an explanatory statement setting out the points it fully supports, the points it objects to, and the points it would have liked to see in the resolution.

Om deze reden koos Nederland voor een onthouding met een stemverklaring waarin de punten zijn uitgelicht die Nederland volmondig steunt, de punten waar Nederland bezwaar tegen maakt, en de punten die Nederland graag in de resolutie opgenomen had zien worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Nederland blijft Israel F-35 onderdelen leveren ondanks waarschuwing schending oorlogsrecht'

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government approved F-35 parts deliveries to Israel despite official warnings of serious humanitarian law violations, and why parliament was not informed. The ministers answered that no new decision to supply Israel was taken, that the existing general licence NL009 was left in place for integrated foreign-policy and security reasons, and that the relevant legal advice was attached as documents.
It was decided not to intervene in the operation of the General Licence Regulation NL009.
Er is besloten niet in te grijpen in de werking van de Regeling Algemene vergunning NL009.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Kat en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat AI-sites teksten van nieuwsmedia gebruiken zonder daar bronvermelding aan toe tevoegen

MPs asked whether AI sites reusing news texts without attribution, and the scope of the copyright text-and-data-mining exception, breach copyright and should be curbed. The government answered that the exception may cover scraping even of paywalled articles if access was lawfully obtained and no reservation was made, that attribution is not a legal condition, and that the EU AI Act and copyright evaluation will be used to address the issue.
Attribution is therefore not a condition for lawfully making a reproduction within text and data mining.
Bronvermelding is dus geen voorwaarde voor het rechtmatig kunnen maken van een reproductie in het kader van tekst- en datamining.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'EU and G7 tankers facilitating Russian oil exports, report finds'

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to reports that EU and G7 tankers, including Greek-registered ones, help Russia evade the oil price cap and sanctions, and whether it will push for a lower cap or a ban on second-hand tanker sales. The minister answered that such services are permitted under the cap, that sanction breaches are criminal and investigated, that the Netherlands raises circumvention in the EU, and that a lower cap or tighter service rules are being examined in consultation with EU and G7 partners.
Signals about this are worrying and the cabinet takes them seriously.
Signalen hierover zijn zorgelijk en het kabinet neemt deze serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'VS roept Servië op om zich terug te trekken uit grensgebied met Kosovo'

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about US concerns over Serbian troop build-up near Kosovo, the release of Radoicic after the Banjska attack, KFOR and EUFOR Althea reserves, and Hungary's role. The government answers substantively on most points, notes the Kosovo police investigation is pending, and describes ongoing EU de-escalation efforts without committing to new measures.
The cabinet awaits the outcomes of this investigation.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'HRC54: Russia, China and Burundi are not fit to sit at the Human Rights Council'

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Human Rights Council seats for Russia and China, and whether the government would block their candidacies or re-elections. The minister answered that Russia failed to win a seat and that the government opposes its membership, while China was re-elected by a majority and the Netherlands will use its membership to press China on human rights.
The Netherlands and other international partners actively brought that position to the attention of other countries.
Nederland en andere internationale partners hebben dat standpunt actief onder de aandacht van andere landen gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel in Politico waarin er wordt bericht dat de civiele EU-missie aan de grens tussen Azerbeidzjan en Armenië onder vuur zou zijn genomen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Politico report that an EU civilian monitoring mission on the Armenia-Azerbaijan border came under fire, and about the risk to monitors, Azerbaijan's conduct, the Lachin corridor blockade and EU-led peace talks. The minister answered that the shooter could not be identified, outlined mitigation measures, condemned Azerbaijan's escalation and said the EU is engaged diplomatically.
EUMA could not determine who fired at the time or what the exact target was, because the distance from the shots to the monitors present was too great.
EUMA kon niet vaststellen door wie er destijds geschoten is en wat het exacte doelwit was, omdat de afstand van de schoten tot de aanwezige waarnemers te groot was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de juridische positie van Taiwan in het kader van de komende Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties (78e zitting)

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about China's aggressive stance toward Taiwan, the official Dutch reading of UN Resolution 2758, and whether Taiwanese individuals and journalists could attend the upcoming UN General Assembly. The minister said Chinese military activity is worrying and that the Dutch one-China policy rests on Resolution 2758, while supporting meaningful Taiwanese participation in international bodies only case by case and in consultation with partners.

The cabinet, while respecting the Dutch one-China policy and together with like-minded countries, favours meaningful participation of Taiwan in international organisations and meetings where this is in the interest of the international community

Het kabinet is, met in achtneming van het Nederlandse één-Chinabeleid en samen met gelijkgestemde landen, voorstander van betekenisvolle deelname van Taiwan aan internationale organisaties en bijeenkomsten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Nederlandse positie ten aanzien van de SLAPP-richtlijn

MP Sjoerdsma asks why the Netherlands supports keeping domestic SLAPPs outside the EU directive, why the directive's protection is weaker than the Commission recommendation, and whether the narrow early-dismissal mechanism and the omission of a damages provision weaken protection for journalists. Minister Weerwind replies that Dutch procedural law already offers remedies against abusive suits, that the Council position improves early dismissal, and that a general liability regime makes a specific damages provision unnecessary.

For the situation in the Netherlands, the cabinet is of the view that Dutch procedural law provides sufficient safeguards to protect journalists and human rights defenders against SLAPPs at national level.

Voor de situatie in Nederland is het kabinet van mening dat het Nederlandse procesrecht voldoende waarborgen biedt ter bescherming van journalisten en mensenrechtenverdedigers tegen SLAPPs op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Draft EU plans to allow spying on journalists are dangerous, warn critics'

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the Council's draft European Media Freedom Act, which would allow member states to deploy spyware against journalists, is acceptable, and why the Netherlands sought carve-outs for law enforcement and intelligence services. The government answered that the draft introduces the first EU-level safeguards against unlawful spyware use against journalists, that the Netherlands opposes unlawful use and does not support surveillance of journalists or their sources, and that it had supported the compromise text and will not change its position.

The current version of the proposal contains, for the first time at Union level, safeguards on the use of intrusion software by governments in relation to journalists to protect media freedom in all member states.

De huidige versie van het voorstel bevat, voor het eerst op Unieniveau, waarborgen omtrent het gebruik van binnendringingssoftware door overheden in verhouding tot journalisten ten behoeve van het beschermen van mediavrijheid in alle lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over ruimhartige subsidie voor gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland

MPs Van der Staaij and Sjoerdsma asked whether the two-year extension of subsidies for detainee support abroad, on unchanged terms, honours the November 2022 motion on continuity and generosity, and whether financial pressure on foundations and consular staff was considered. The minister answers that the extension follows the motion's continuity request, that an evaluation will precede a revised framework from 2026, that the legal support is supplementary to local counsel, and that organisations may index budgets up to 5% per year.
Any policy changes arising from the evaluation I will send to your House in writing before 1 January 2026.
Eventuele beleidswijzigingen volgend uit de evaluatie zal ik vóór 1 januari 2026 aan uw Kamer schriftelijk doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Podt over financiering van grensbewakingsprojecten in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers whether EU border-control funding in Sudan indirectly benefited the RSF militia, why projects ended only in 2019-2020, and what lessons apply to future projects. The minister denied that EU funds or equipment went to the RSF or army, said safeguards and monitoring existed, and committed to no new action beyond raising risks in Brussels.
The EU, however, provided no financial support for that security training either in 2017 or in the years after.
De EU heeft echter noch in 2017 noch in de jaren daarna financiële steun gegeven aan genoemde veiligheidstraining.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het nog steeds open zijn van een Chinees politiebureau in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why a reportedly illegal Chinese police station in Rotterdam still appears operational, whether closures were properly checked, whether the investigation into intimidation of Chinese nationals has progressed, and whether a new investigation and an approach to the Chinese ambassador will follow. The minister answered that the government tentatively concludes the stations have ceased activity, that involvement in intimidation was not established and could be briefed confidentially, that further research will start only if signals warrant it, and that the issue was raised with China.

The cabinet has not established, in the investigation, the involvement of the so-called Chinese police stations in the Netherlands in such practices. In a confidential technical briefing, the House can be informed further on this if desired.

Betrokkenheid van de zogenaamde Chinese politiebureaus in Nederland bij dergelijke praktijken is door het kabinet in het onderzoek niet vastgesteld. In een besloten technische briefing kan de Kamer desgewenst hier nader over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee, Dassen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Germany unsure if Orbán fit to be ‘EU president’'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks, Volt and VVD asked whether Hungary's upcoming EU Council presidency in July–December 2024 is acceptable given its unresolved rule-of-law and corruption problems, its Article 7 procedure, and risks to the MFF and Ukraine solidarity, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister replied that the rotation follows the agreed Council decision, that the cabinet will stress Hungary's presidency duties and keep pressing on rule of law, that it will not seek to change the rotation, and that it has no information on Germany opposing the presidency.
In the run-up to the Hungarian EU presidency, the cabinet will, together with as many like-minded member states as possible, emphasise that it expects Hungary to meet these responsibilities.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar het Hongaarse EU-voorzitterschap, samen met zo veel mogelijk gelijkgezinde lidstaten, benadrukken te verwachten dat Hongarije deze verantwoordelijkheden nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Wuite over stemregistratie voor de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen in de Caribische Landen van het Koninkrijk

D66 MPs asked how the government will make European Parliament elections as accessible in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom as in the Netherlands, how it will involve Caribbean citizens in EU engagement, and how the planned dialogues and events will reach them. The minister says a policy paper will set out options (more voting locations, abolishing the registration requirement) with consultation of the Caribbean countries, and that the dialogues and events will be digital and open to all, with extra effort for youth and hard-to-reach groups.
The policy paper will set out a number of routes to increase the accessibility of the EP elections in the countries and to facilitate voters as much as possible in casting their vote.

In de hoofdlijnennotitie wordt een aantal sporen uitgewerkt waarlangs de toegankelijkheid van de EP-verkiezingen in de landen kan worden vergroot en kiesgerechtigden zoveel mogelijk kunnen worden gefaciliteerd in het uitbrengen van hun stem.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de petitie van Yezidi-vrouwen

MPs Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg (D66) asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about justice and support for the Yezidi community, including aid in camps, missing Yezidis, evidence gathering with UNITAD, a Joint Investigation Team and the petition by Yezidi women. The government answered that it funds psychosocial aid, the Yezidi Survivors Law implementation and UNITAD, that it cannot verify figures or conditions in Al Hol, and that cooperation agreements and expertise contributions are still being explored.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine how many Yezidis are staying in the Al Hol camp.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoeveel Yezidi’s verblijven in kamp Al Hol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over VN-resolutie 2664 die humanitaire uitzonderingen mogelijk maakt in VN-sanctieregimes

A Dutch MP asked the Foreign Minister about UN Security Council Resolution 2664, which introduces humanitarian exemptions across UN sanctions regimes, including its effects, implementation via the EU and bank cooperation. The minister answered in detail that the EU has implemented the exemption in several regimes, that early signals suggest positive humanitarian effects, and that the government consults NGOs and banks on implementation.
The cabinet will continue to actively monitor the effects.
Het kabinet zal de effecten actief blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Journalist Ana van Es werd opgeroepen om te getuigen. ‘Dit schrikt bronnen af’, zegt haar advocaat'

D66 MPs asked whether summoning journalist Ana van Es as a witness, and the resulting risk to source protection, is acceptable under the Wet bronbescherming in strafzaken. The ministers said they cannot comment on individual criminal cases, pointed to the law's safeguards and its evaluation, and stated that journalists may refuse to answer questions about sources even when summoned.
It is not for me to comment on individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op individuele strafzaken.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de vele berichten van ongeregeldheden, excessief geweld en het nederzettingenbeleid van de nieuwe Israëlische regering in de bezette Westelijke Jordaanoever

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister to answer again, with urgency and separately, his earlier questions on violence and settlement policy in the occupied West Bank, given that the US had summoned Israel's ambassador. The minister referred to his earlier answers, said the government urged both sides to calm and asked Israel not to pursue planned cabinet measures, and that he had raised this personally with his Israeli counterpart.
For accountability I refer to the answers already given to these parliamentary questions.
Voor de verantwoording verwijs ik naar de reeds gegeven beantwoording van deze Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse journalisten in Rusland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Wall Street Journal reporter in Russia and about the safety of Dutch journalists working there. The minister condemned the arrest, called for release, and said journalists and media outlets decide for themselves whether to work in Russia while the ministry provides travel advice and contact.
The cabinet will continue to call for his release, and that of Russian journalists arrested for doing their work as independent journalists.
Het kabinet zal blijven oproepen tot zijn vrijlating, en die van Russische journalisten die gearresteerd zijn omdat zij hun werk als onafhankelijke journalisten deden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over wederom desinformatie verspreidt bij uitzending Ongehoord Nieuws

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government considers disinformation about COVID-19 vaccines and excess mortality broadcast by Ongehoord Nieuws a public health risk and whether the public broadcaster should tolerate it after prior NPO sanctions. The State Secretary answered that assessing content is not his task, that the government does not generally label disinformation, that the NPO sanctioned the broadcaster for insufficient cooperation, and referred to a Rijksbrede strategy letter for steps.
It is not for me to assess whether the statements made in the Ongehoord Nieuws broadcast qualify as disinformation.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de uitingen die zijn gedaan in de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws kwalificeren als desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Graaf en Gündoğan over de rol van de media bij de verspreiding van de rechts-extremistische omvolkingstheorie

MPs asked about the role of media in spreading the Great Replacement theory and whether NCTV had assessed the national security risk, as promised in June 2022. The minister says the NCTV addressed the theory in the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57, noting it has moved into mainstream debate, but that NCTV's online monitoring of open sources is currently suspended, limiting its analysis.
As described in the cover letter to the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57, with its publication, follow-up has been given to the request to elaborate on the replacement theory.
Zoals in de aanbiedingsbrief bij het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 is beschreven is met het verschijnen van het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57, opvolging gegeven aan het verzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoersma over de protesten in Georgië en de omstreden ‘Russische wet’

MPs Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about protests in Georgia against the 'foreign agents' law and whether it resembles Russia's 2012 law, along with Dutch responses. The minister confirmed the bill was withdrawn via a second-reading rejection, noted similarities to Russia's law, and said the Netherlands has voiced concerns and will raise them with Georgia.
The Netherlands will continue to closely follow this, keep speaking out against such a law, and keep supporting independent media and a strong civil society.
Nederland zal dit nauwgezet blijven volgen, zich tegen een dergelijke wet blijven uitspreken en steun blijven uitspreken voor onafhankelijke media en een krachtig maatschappelijk middenveld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de vele berichten van ongeregeldheden, excessief geweld en het nederzettingenbeleid van de nieuwe Israëlische regering in de bezette Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about violence by settlers and the army in the occupied West Bank, settlement expansion, arms licensing for settlers, and whether the government will take concrete measures. The minister condemned the violence and settlement policy, called for de-escalation and proportionality, but largely restated existing policy and offered no new concrete sanctions.
The Netherlands calls on both parties to this end, publicly and in bilateral contacts.
Nederland roept beide partijen hiertoe op, publiekelijk en in bilaterale contacten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Moldavische premier Dorin Recean bevestigt dat Rusland het internationale vliegveld van Chi?inau in handen probeert te krijgen om Russische militairen het

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia may be trying to take Chisinau airport to bring in troops into Moldova, and about the consequences for Ukrainian refugees, aid transit, EU/NATO responses and travel advice. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the reports, noted Russian destabilisation efforts, and declined to speculate on scenarios while promising to monitor the situation and adjust travel advice if needed.
The cabinet does not speculate about possible scenarios that could unfold in Moldova, or about a response by the EU and NATO.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over mogelijke scenario's die zich in Moldavië kunnen ontplooien, en over een reactie door de EU en de NAVO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de situatie in Myanmar

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked about the crisis in Myanmar: the lack of political attention, EU-UN efforts toward a ceasefire, ASEAN's role, sanctions coordination, aviation fuel sanctions, a Myanmar funding overview, a Human Rights Council resolution and an emergency summit. The minister answers that the Netherlands is active through EU, UN and ASEAN channels, supports humanitarian aid and inclusive dialogue, will lead on a strong Council resolution, and gives a funding table, while declining to publish 2021-2022 Human Rights Fund project details for security reasons.

The projects supported from the Human Rights Fund in 2021 and 2022 cannot be publicly shared, given the high security risk to the persons and organisations involved since the military coup of 1 February 2021.

De projecten die in 2021 en 2022 zijn ondersteund vanuit het MRF, kunnen gezien het hoge veiligheidsrisico dat betrokken personen en instanties lopen sinds de militaire staatsgreep op 1 februari 2021, niet publiekelijk worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Miljoenen chips Nederlandse fabrikanten belanden in Rusland ondanks sancties’

MPs Hammelburg and Sjoerdsma asked when the cabinet learned that Dutch chips were found in Russian military equipment, why the media were answered but not Parliament, what was done about Iranian drones, how sanctioned intermediaries could still supply Russia, and what measures could curb resale. The ministers answered that the government was first informed in March 2022, that the goods were added to EU sanctions after a Dutch proposal, that sanctions are being pursued via EU listings and a non-paper, and that full control over trade in these components is not feasible.
The ministry sent the relevant news editors a written response to a specific request for clarification.
Het ministerie heeft de betreffende nieuwsredacties een schriftelijke reactie gestuurd op een specifiek verzoek om verduidelijking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘VS verbieden producten Huawei en andere Chinese bedrijven: ‘Onacceptabel risico voor nationale veiligheid’

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked the minister whether the Netherlands would follow US bans on Huawei and restrict Huawei's access to Dutch banks, and how far Huawei remains in Dutch telecom networks. The minister said the government shares US security concerns, that Huawei is already excluded from the vital core network with implementation being checked, that detailed supplier information is confidential, and that the Netherlands will decide independently on any bank-access restriction.
Detailed information on who uses which supplier where, and which phase-out deadlines apply, is considered commercially confidential information.
Gedetailleerde informatie over wie waar welke leverancier gebruikt, en welke uitfaseringstermijnen gelden wordt gezien als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de medische toestand van de in gevangenschap gehouden voormalig president van Georgië Mikheil Saakashvili

MP Sjoerdsma asks the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating health of detained former Georgian president Saakashvili, including possible poisoning, Dutch contacts with Georgia, a medical evacuation and consequences for Georgia's EU candidacy. The minister confirms serious concern and that the Netherlands raises it bilaterally, but says it cannot interfere in Georgian judicial proceedings and that the EU statement holds Georgia responsible for his health.
However, the Netherlands cannot interfere in the judicial process of another country.
Nederland kan zich echter niet mengen in de rechtsgang van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sjoerdsma over een kadaster voor journalisten

Two D66 MPs asked why journalists cannot shield their home addresses in the Kadaster as threatened persons can, and why the Verhoeven motion on withholding private addresses has not been implemented. The minister answered that the Kadaster must keep object addresses public for a transparent property market, that searching by name is now limited to professional users, and that doxing should be criminalised instead, so no change to the Kadasterbesluit is planned.
I am aware that with this I depart from the line being taken for the Trade Register.
Ik ben mij bewust van het feit dat ik daarmee afwijk van de lijn die wordt ingezet bij het Handelsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Dekker-Abdulaziz over Nederlanders in het buitenland die mogen stemmen op het Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked about low registration by Dutch citizens abroad for the Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen election and what outreach is planned. The minister reports 23,427 registrations as of 22 December, describes the information campaign and notes that reasons for non-registration will be examined in the evaluation later.
As part of the evaluation of the Kiescollege election, this will be done among voters in the permanent register who have not registered for the Kiescollege election.
In het kader van de evaluatie van de kiescollegeverkiezing zal dit wel worden gedaan onder kiezers in de permante registratie die zich niet voor de kiescollegeverkiezing hebben geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de berichtgeving dat Iraanse demonstranten worden gevangengezet, gemarteld en de doodstraf wordt opgelegd.

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to reports of torture, detention and death sentences against Iranian protesters, including whether it will push for further EU sanctions and for Iran's removal from the UN Commission on the Status of Women. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the violence, has raised the issue bilaterally and at the UN, supports additional EU sanctions, helped secure Iran's removal from the CSW, and provides consular assistance to a detained Dutch national.
The Netherlands has condemned the violence against peaceful demonstrators from the outset and continues to strongly condemn all human rights violations in Iran.
Nederland heeft het geweld tegen vreedzame demonstranten van meet af aan veroordeeld en blijft alle mensenrechtenschendingen in Iran ten sterkste veroordelen.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Akkoord over beperken export chiptech naar China'

D66 MPs asked whether the cabinet agreed to export restrictions on chip-making machinery and technology to China, why parliament was not informed, and about security effects, consultation with Brussels and Dutch firms, and China's WTO complaint against the US. The ministers refused to share the content of talks with partners citing confidentiality, pointed to the 1 December letter and a confidential briefing, said no policy change is currently at stake, and declined to speculate on Chinese reactions or possible complaints against the Netherlands.
I cannot go into the content of discussions the Netherlands holds with partner countries because of confidentiality.
Op de inhoud van gesprekken die Nederland voert met partnerlanden kan ik vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat er Chinese politiebureaus in Nederland zijn

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about reports of Chinese 'overseas police service stations' in the Netherlands, including their financing, legality, and protection of the Chinese diaspora. The minister answered that the stations were closed after the Chinese ambassador was summoned, that the financing and activities were still under investigation, and that the investigation results would be shared with the House if necessary.
When the investigation is concluded, the House will be informed about it (if necessary confidentially).
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond zal de Kamer hierover (indien noodzakelijk vertrouwelijk) worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de berichtgeving dat Oeganda kampt met een nieuwe ebola-uitbraak

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked the government about reports of a new Ebola outbreak in Uganda, including flight links, airport screening, WHO response capacity and Dutch assistance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that screening protocols are being strengthened, that the WHO has an emergency programme and funding gap, and that Dutch contributions go via WHO funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de Ebola uitbraak in Oeganda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘DPG Media lanceert Seamless ads’

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked whether DPG Media's 'seamless ads', which can look like news articles, undermine trust in journalism and whether media should be required to label them. The Secretary of State answered that existing rules under the Civil Code, the Dutch Advertising Code and oversight by ACM and the Advertising Code Committee already require ads to be recognisable, that no new regulation is currently needed, and that the Press Council has no role here, but that the Advertising Code Committee will be asked what it can do.
I will ask the Advertising Code Committee what it could possibly mean in relation to seamless ads.
Ik zal aan de Reclame Code Commissie vragen wat zij mogelijk kunnen betekenen in relatie tot seamless ads.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder en Kuzu over de modernisering van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and DENK asked about the coalition agreement's plans for a private register of unwanted nationality and for revising the automatic loss of Dutch nationality after thirteen years abroad. The government answered that the register is a societal initiative the state would only support if taken up, and that it will draft a bill in the first quarter of 2023 amending the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap to revise the loss rule and add a recovery option.
I am preparing a bill that amends the Netherlands Nationality Act on these two points.
Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap op deze twee onderdelen wijzigt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de berichten dat er een superjacht van de Russische oligarch Potanin in Nederland ligt en een omstreden Rus met vastgoed in Amsterdam buiten schot van sancties blijft

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether a superyacht linked to Russian oligarch Potanin, and property in Amsterdam linked to a sanctioned Russian, could evade sanctions, and asked about ownership structures, listings and seizure. The government answered that yachts may not be sold or delivered to Russian persons, that frozen assets are not the same as seizure, and that it will not comment on individual cases, while promising to inform parliament about sanctions enforcement and the Blok report.
The cabinet does not make any statement about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sjoerdsma, Boulakjar en Boucke over het bericht dat beide Nord Stream pijpleidingen vlak na elkaar zijn stuk gegaan en dat seismologische bureaus van Denemarken en Zweden hevig

MPs from D66 asked whether the Nord Stream pipeline explosions were sabotage, whether Russia could invoke force majeure, whether the Netherlands would push the EU to phase out Russian gas, and how Dutch offshore pipelines and infrastructure would be protected. The government answered that sabotage is almost certain but attribution is not yet possible, outlined EU gas-reduction measures and infrastructure protection plans, and promised a separate letter on North Sea protection.
It is almost certain that this was a sabotage action.
Het staat vrijwel zeker vast dat het hier een sabotageactie betrof.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen van 2024 naar aanleiding van het kabinetsstandpunt over het initiatiefvoorstel van het Europees Parlement over de verk

The MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked how many non-Dutch EU residents registered to vote in the 2019 European Parliament elections, how they were informed, whether turnout was evaluated, and about the timeline and direction of the European Electoral Act reform. The Minister answered that 56,637 registered in 2019, that municipalities are legally obliged to inform them, and that the Netherlands does not track their actual turnout, while promising further outreach and noting Council negotiations on the Electoral Act have only just begun.
The Netherlands does not keep track of how many of these persons actually went to vote.
Nederland houdt niet bij hoeveel van deze personen daadwerkelijk zijn gaan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de dood van de 22-jarige Mahsa Amini na mishandeling en door de Iraanse religieuze politie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government judges the death of Mahsa Amini after abuse by Iran's religious police and the violent suppression of protests, whether it will condemn Iran and push for EU Magnitsky-type sanctions. The minister answered that the Netherlands has strongly condemned the violence, urged an impartial investigation and will repeat this at the Foreign Affairs Council, and that existing EU Iran sanctions exist but the government does not comment in advance on new sanctions proposals.
The cabinet in principle makes no statements about concrete proposals for new sanctions, so as not to undermine the element of surprise and thereby the effectiveness of such measures.
Het kabinet doet in beginsel geen uitlatingen over concrete voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties, om zo het verrassingseffect en daarmee de effectiviteit van dergelijke maatregelen niet te ondermijnen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Chinese bedrijven de Russische oorlogsmachine steunen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese firms supply Russia's military, including the role of Poly Technologies, Chinese state media propaganda, and calls for chip and dual-use export bans and sanctions on Chinese firms. The minister answered that the government works to curb Russia's military-industrial capacity within EU sanctions, that enforcement against third-country entities is legally limited, that export licences are checked for diversion risk, and that the Netherlands supports adding semiconductors to EU sanctions while keeping consultations with partners ongoing.
The Netherlands continues to work for expanding controls on electronic components containing semiconductors.
Nederland blijft zich inzetten voor het uitbreiden van controles op elektronische componenten die semiconductoren bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet en Dassen over het vastleggen van het recht op abortus in het Europees Handvest van grondrechten van de Europese Unie

MPs Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet and Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about the US Dobbs ruling restricting abortion, funding of anti-abortion groups, and whether abortion access should be anchored in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights. The minister expressed concern, said abortion is mainly a member-state competence, and noted that anchoring it in the Charter would require treaty change, which support among member states may lack.
The cabinet is closely following the discussion on anchoring the right to abortion in the Charter and will further examine the feasibility of this initiative.
Het kabinet volgt de discussie over het verankeren van het recht op abortus in het Handvest op de voet en zal zich verder verdiepen in de haalbaarheid van dit initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het Verdrag inzake de Voltrekking en de Erkenning van de Geldigheid van Huwelijken

An MP asked the government about the Hague marriage recognition convention and a case where a Dutch woman's marriage concluded at the British embassy in Beijing was not recognised under Article 10:31(2) of the Civil Code. The minister answered that the municipality applied an existing reading of that article, that its interpretation may conflict with scholarly views, and that the question will be put to the Commission of Advice on civil status, while stating the convention does not bar recognition of same-sex marriages.
This gives me reason to submit the question about that application in such cases to the Commission of Advice on civil status and nationality.
Dit vormt voor mij aanleiding de vraag omtrent die toepassing in dit soort gevallen voor te leggen aan de Commissie van advies voor de zaken betreffende de burgerlijke staat en de nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de actie van het Israëlische leger om de kantoren van zeven ngo’s te sluiten

MPs Sjoerdsma and Agnes Mulder asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's raid on the offices of seven Palestinian NGOs, the legal grounds for the designations, and whether the Netherlands would act with the EU to protest and secure the NGOs' ability to continue their work. The minister condemned the raid as a serious blow to civil society, said the underlying terrorism evidence remains non-public and unconvincing to the Netherlands and eight EU partners, and reported a joint demarche and continued EU and bilateral engagement.
As indicated in parliamentary questions 736 (member van Dijk, 27 October 2021), the information underlying these listings is not public.
Zoals aangegeven in Kamervragen 736 (lid van Dijk, 27 oktober 2021) is de informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan deze listings niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie van de Russische oppositiepoliticus Vladimir Kara-Murza

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Russian opposition figure Vladimir Kara-Murza, his prison conditions, fair trial, access for diplomats and journalists, and possible EU sanctions. The minister called the arrest a serious violation of political freedoms, said Russia denies consular access so conditions are known only from public reports, and committed to advocating for fair trial and detention conditions and supporting human rights defenders, while noting Dutch diplomatic staffing problems and not commenting on sanctions listings.
In its human rights policy the cabinet works to protect human rights defenders and promote freedom of expression, including in Russia.
Het kabinet zet zich in zijn mensenrechtenbeleid in voor de bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers en bevordering van de vrijheid van meningsuiting, ook in Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van de Europese Commissie aan Azerbeidzjan

Parliamentarian Sjoerdsma asked whether the European Commission's visit to Azerbaijan aimed at a gas deal and whether human rights and political prisoners, including Elvin Isayev, would be raised. The minister answered that the visit produced an energy MoU and that human rights concerns are raised in EU dialogues and will continue to be raised, without committing to a specific new step.
The cabinet will continue to raise concerns about the human rights situation in Azerbaijan, including that of political prisoners.
Het kabinet zal de zorgen over mensenrechtensituatie in Azerbeidzjan, waaronder die van politieke gevangenen, blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie met betrekking tot de Oeigoeren

MP Sjoerdsma asked the government about the Xinjiang Police Files, whether the Uyghur situation should be called genocide, UN and ICC follow-up, business complicity, protection of Uyghurs in the Netherlands and family reunification. The minister condemned the abuses, joined a 47-country UN statement, said genocide recognition is under EU-level review, and outlined existing measures while noting limits on information and responsibility lying elsewhere.
The cabinet has noted the visit of UN High Commissioner Bachelet to Xinjiang and the fact that the visit was not an investigative mission.
Het kabinet heeft nota genomen van het bezoek van de VN Hoge Commissaris van de Mensenrechten Bachelet aan Xinjiang en het feit dat het bezoek geen onderzoeksmissie was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Wederopbouw van Oekraïne met Russisch geld? Dat is mogelijk'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether frozen Russian assets could be confiscated for Ukraine's reconstruction, including via a UN compensation commission and national legislation on state immunity. The minister answered that international law on state immunity and the Freeze & Seize taskforce limit such options, and that the government is still exploring possibilities without identifying concrete legal steps.
For now, no concrete legal steps have been identified that would make it possible to confiscate frozen assets and use them for Ukraine's reconstruction.
Vooralsnog zijn er geen concrete juridische stappen geïdentificeerd die het mogelijk maken om bevroren tegoeden te confisqueren en deze vervolgens in te zetten voor de wederopbouw van Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Dassen over de gele kaart procedure met betrekking tot de Europese kiesakte.

MPs asked whether the eight-week yellow card deadline for the European electoral act started from the Commission's publication date (3 May 2022), which would have expired before the 5 July vote on the motion. The minister answered that the period runs from the date the proposal was transmitted to national parliaments, which was 19 May 2022, so the deadline runs until 14 July and has not expired.
This means that the period within which each of the Chambers could issue a yellow card will expire on 14 July 2022 and therefore has not already expired on 28 June.
Dit betekent dat de termijn waarbinnen elk van de Kamers een gele kaart zou kunnen trekken op 14 juli 2022 zal verlopen en dus niet reeds op 28 juni is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Strolenberg, Sjoerdsma en Sneller over de mogelijkheid tot online stemmen voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

Four MPs from VVD and D66 asked whether Dutch citizens abroad could be allowed to vote online, citing France's online voting for expats. The Minister of Interior replied that internet voting is rejected because it creates cyber risks to secrecy, freedom, and integrity of elections, that no steps are planned, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Introducing internet voting makes the electoral process vulnerable to cyber risks that put these safeguards at risk, such as ballot secrecy, freedom of voting and integrity.
Het introduceren van internetstemmen maakt het verkiezingsproces kwetsbaar voor cyberrisico's waarbij er risico's zijn voor deze waarborgen, zoals het stemgeheim, de stemvrijheid en de integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government has noted the ombudsman's finding that broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland breached the NPO Journalistic Code, and whether the conclusions can be included in answers to earlier questions. The State Secretary answered yes to both, referring to the answer to question 8.
Yes, see the answer to question 8.
Ja, zie de beantwoording van vraag 8.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Brekelmans over het indienen van een VN-resolutie bij de Emergency Special Session over Oekraïne

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Russia's blockade of the Black Sea ports, which keeps Ukrainian grain from leaving, is a deliberate form of starvation and whether the government will convene an Emergency Special Session of the UN General Assembly to adopt a resolution condemning it and declaring a humanitarian corridor. The minister condemned the blockade and said it is not yet clear the government will call such a session, pointing instead to ongoing Turkish and UN negotiations and promising to sound out other UN members.
In addition, I will explore with other UN General Assembly members whether and how convening such a session has a chance of success.
Daarnaast zal ik onderzoeken bij andere AVVN-leden of en hoe het bijeenroepen van een dergelijke sessie kans van slagen heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over over de Russische componist en vriend van Poetin, Valery Gergiev

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister why Russian conductor Valery Gergiev, reportedly a friend of Putin, is not on EU sanctions lists, how he obtained Dutch nationality and a royal honour, and whether the government will propose him for listing. The minister answered that Gergiev does not meet the listing criteria yet, that nationality of individuals cannot be discussed, that the 2005 honour was for classical music merits, and that proposing him is not opportune at present.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the nationality of individual persons.
Over de nationaliteit van individuele personen kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de moord op Al-Jazeera’s journalist Shireen Abu Aqleh

An MP asks the government how it views the killing of Al-Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Aqleh, Israel's reported refusal of an inquiry, and what concrete steps it takes toward truth-finding and accountability. The minister condemns the killing, denies that Israel refused an inquiry, and says the government supports a transparent joint investigation, without listing concrete steps beyond raising the matter with counterparts.
As I understand it, there is no question of an Israeli refusal.
Naar mijn begrip is er geen sprake van een Israëlische weigering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu , Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over straffeloosheid voor oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen after the UN Human Rights Council ended its war-crimes investigation, and whether Netherlands would push to resume an UN-mandated inquiry. The minister said the April ceasefire is holding, that Netherlands supports UN envoy efforts, but will not launch an initiative at the Council because the chance of success is very small, instead funding local accountability efforts.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of combating impunity in international fora and in bilateral talks.
Ook zal Nederland het belang van het tegengaan van straffeloosheid in internationale fora en in bilaterale gesprekken blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Activist Defending Safe Abortion Risks Jail'

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Polish activist Justyna Wydrzyńska for providing abortion medication, whether this sets a dangerous precedent and chills aid groups, and whether a Dutch diplomat would attend the trial. Minister Hoekstra said the government opposes regressive pressure on women's rights, that health care is a member-state competence, that the Netherlands promotes SRGR including safe abortion within EU frameworks, and that an embassy staff member plans to attend the hearing.
An employee of the Dutch representation in Warsaw intends to attend the hearing.
Een medewerker van de Nederlandse vertegenwoordiging in Warschau is voornemens aanwezig te zijn bij de zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Slob: Media in Caribisch Nederland helpen zichzelf te versterken'

Two D66 MPs asked whether local media on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are strong and independent enough to scrutinise local government, and what steps followed a prior study. The State Secretary answered that the media sector is relatively large but faces independence and self-censorship concerns, that a plan to professionalise journalism will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before the media budget debate.
Once the plan is ready, I will inform the Chamber about it in more detail.
Zodra het plan gereed is, zal ik de Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over het bericht dat China door middel van samenwerkingen met Europese bedrijven en universiteiten haar krijgsmacht moderniseert

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked whether China's use of technology from European firms and universities to modernise its military is undesirable, and whether reporting duties, legal blocking powers, or US-style policy should be introduced for risky cooperation. The government acknowledges the risks of unwanted technology transfer, points to existing screening, export control and knowledge-security instruments, and declines to introduce a reporting obligation for now, while noting universities' academic freedom and that no legal basis currently exists to force termination of such cooperation.
Against this background, the cabinet currently considers introducing a reporting obligation not opportune.
Tegen deze achtergrond acht het kabinet invoering van een meldingsplicht op dit moment niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Agens Mulder over de stand van zaken rondom het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces

MPs Sjoerdsma and Mulder asked about the postponed Palestinian elections, the humanitarian and water situation in Gaza, Israeli designations of Palestinian NGOs, settlements, and Dutch business involvement in settlements. The minister answered that elections remain postponed pending a new PA date, that Dutch policy on settlements and business ties is unchanged, and that a joint donor assessment of the NGO listings will be completed before the summer recess.
The cabinet aims to complete this joint assessment before the summer recess and inform the House.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om voor het zomerreces deze gezamenlijke appreciatie af te ronden en uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat een Nederlandse journalist hardhandig Oekraïne is uitgezet
