An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch journalist was forcibly expelled from Ukraine, whether this was legitimate, and whether his accreditation loss was proportionate. The minister answered that Ukrainian authorities cite wartime rules and endangering civilians, that the handling would be disproportionate if as described, and that the matter was raised with Ukraine, though the facts could not be verified.
Due to the current war situation, the Ukrainian authorities could not establish how Mr Dulmers was treated during the expulsion.
Wegens de huidige oorlogssituatie konden de Oekraïense autoriteiten niet achterhalen op welke wijze de heer Dulmers is behandeld tijdens de uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke transnationale kieslijsten in de EU

MPs Sjoerdsma and Sneller asked about the reported March 2022 deal in the European Parliament's constitutional affairs committee on transnational lists (28 extra seats, 3.5% threshold) and lowering the voting age to 16, and how it relates to the Conference on the Future of Europe and the coalition agreement. The government answered that the proposal is not yet final, that it is too early to state a Dutch position, and that the Dutch government will inform parliament once the Council receives the proposal.

Since the final initiative proposal has not yet been published, may still be amended by the EP, and must obtain a majority in the EP plenary, the cabinet considers it premature to determine the Dutch position and stance on this initiative proposal.

Aangezien het definitieve initiatiefvoorstel nog niet is gepubliceerd, het mogelijk nog geamendeerd wordt door het EP, en een meerderheid dient te halen in de plenaire van het EP, acht het kabinet het voortijdig om de Nederlandse positie en inzet ten aanzien dit initiatiefvoorstel te bepalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over een vrijwillige bijdrage aan het Internationaal Strafhof ten behoeve van een onderzoek naar oorlogsmisdrijven, misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid en genocide geple

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government knows of the ICC prosecutor's opening of an investigation into Ukraine and the prosecutor's call for extra funding, and whether it will provide extra money. The government confirmed awareness, supports the investigation, and will pay a voluntary contribution of 1 million euro to the ICC's trust fund while pushing partners for more funding.
The Netherlands will transfer a voluntary financial contribution of 1 million euros to the Trust Fund recently established for the Office of the Prosecutor.
In dat licht zal Nederland een vrijwillige financiële bijdrage van 1 miljoen euro overmaken aan het Trust Fund dat recent ten behoeve van het Parket van de Aanklager is opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het leger van Burkina Faso een staatsgreep heeft gepleegd

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the military coup in Burkina Faso, the status of ousted president Kaboré, travel advice, embassy and citizen safety, regional spillover, Wagner Group involvement, EU missions and development cooperation. The minister condemned the coup, described the transition timetable and Kaboré's release to his home, and answered the remaining questions largely on substance, with some matters left to EU-level discussions.
The cabinet condemns every seizure of power through the use of force.
Het kabinet keurt elke machtsovername met gebruik van geweld af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over mogelijk verspreiden van desinformatie door Ongehoord Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked the state secretary whether Ongehoord Nederland spreads disinformation in its programme Ongehoord Nieuws, and whether the government would seek interim assessments from the Raad voor Cultuur and the Commissariaat voor de Media. The state secretary answered that assessing individual programmes is not for the minister, that the Commissariaat and NPO Ombudsman are responsible for enforcement, and that an interim opinion from the Raad voor Cultuur was not appropriate.
However, it is not for me to judge the content of individual programmes or statements made in them.
Het is echter niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma's of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de zorgelijke toestand van etnisch-Russische studenten, docenten en onderzoekers

MPs Podt, Van der Laan and Sjoerdsma asked about the difficult situation of ethnic-Russian and Belarusian students, teachers and researchers in the Netherlands after sanctions, including financial hardship, work-hour limits, unclear visa prospects and knowledge-leakage risks. The minister acknowledged the problems, said work-hour limits will not be changed, urged institutions to support these students, and said residence rights are kept while study conditions are met.
Adjusting the number of hours students may work is not seen as a solution.
Het aanpassen van het aantal uren dat studenten mogen werken wordt niet als oplossing gezien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over de mensenrechtensituatie in Oeganda

Two MPs (Simons and Sjoerdsma) asked the ministers about the human rights situation in Uganda, including police violence, detention of opposition MPs, election observation and the use of aid conditionality. The ministers answered at length, describing EU and bilateral diplomatic pressure, a withheld EUR 850,000 payment to the justice sector, and a planned evaluation of Dutch support, while giving no details on the detained MPs' case.
Because it is an ongoing case, the Ugandan government provides no explanation of it.
Omdat het een lopende zaak betreft wordt er door de Oegandese overheid geen toelichting op gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat topfuncties op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken te vaak naar mannen gaan

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that senior posts at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs go too often to men, including whether the ABD's unanimous recommendation for the DG Political Affairs post was overridden and whether informal selection practices exist. Minister Hoekstra affirmed the commitment to diversity and gender balance and said the ABD-related selection details are personnel-confidential, while pointing to the existing procedures and planned research into women's career progression.
Regarding the considerations and conclusions within a selection process concerning employees, I do not make any statements because of their confidential personnel nature.
Over de afwegingen en conclusies binnen een selectieproces ten aanzien van medewerkers doe ik vanwege het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de oproep om Rusland uit te sluiten van INTERPOL

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government supports calls to exclude Russia from INTERPOL over fears of misuse of its systems against critics. The Minister of Justice and Security confirmed awareness of the calls, explained INTERPOL's corrective measures against Russia's National Central Bureau, and said the Netherlands requested a review, noting that measures were adopted and apply until the next Executive Committee meeting.
The Minister of Justice and Security on 4 March sent a letter asking the Secretary General of INTERPOL to assess the need for corrective measures against the Russian Federation.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heeft op 4 maart jl. per brief de Secretaris Generaal van INTERPOL verzocht de noodzaak tot het opleggen van corrigerende maatregelen ten aanzien van de Russische Federatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sjoerdsma over VN Intergovernmental Conference on Marine Biodiversity of areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ)

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction (BBNJ), including protection gaps, Dutch participation and ambition at the UN conference, and environmental impact assessment standards. The government answered that the BBNJ treaty process is ongoing, that Dutch ministerial participation is not yet appropriate at this stage, that it supports the High Ambition Coalition statement and 30% protection goals, and that it favours strategic and project environmental impact assessment in the treaty.
Participation at political level is not yet on the table at this stage of the negotiations.
Deelname op politiek niveau is in deze fase van de onderhandelingen nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht ‘Groot-Brittannië doet Aeroflot in de ban als gevolg van Russische agressie’

MPs Boucke and Sjoerdsma asked whether Britain closed its airspace to Aeroflot, how many Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports, whether the Netherlands will investigate an EU-level ban, and whether Dutch airlines still fly over Russia. The minister confirmed the UK closure, said no Russian airlines currently fly from Dutch airports due to the EU airspace closure, and said Dutch airlines no longer fly over Russia because Russia banned them.
Due to the current closure of European airspace to Russian airlines, no Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports.
Door de huidige sluiting van het Europese luchtruim voor Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen vliegen er geen Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen op Nederlandse luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht dat Rusland BUK-afweersystemen bij de grens met Oekraïne plaatst

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports that Russia placed BUK and S-300/S-400 air defence systems near the Ukrainian border and what this means for civil aviation safety, including IFALPA and ECA warnings and recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board on airspace closure criteria. The ministers answered that monitoring continues, that KLM and other airlines suspended Ukraine flights, that Dutch airspace-closure powers for airlines face legal and practical objections, and that the government is working on international criteria.
Dutch airlines did not fly there.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat politieke oppositie in Azerbeidzjan wordt mishandeld of vastgezet

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of beatings and detention of Azerbaijani opposition figures, their health, pending court cases, the embassy's access, the independence of the judiciary and EU/Council of Europe responses including sanctions. The minister answered that the government finds the reports very concerning, lacks confidential medical data, has limited capacity to monitor cases, and relies on dialogue, quiet diplomacy and Council of Europe supervision without committing to sanctions in individual cases.
Regarding whether a sanctions measure is being considered in individual cases, the cabinet cannot make statements for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de vraag of in individuele gevallen al dan niet een sanctiemaatregel wordt overwogen kan het kabinet om redenen van vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sjoerdsma over het reizen met en het verkrijgen van een Digitale Corona Certificaat

MPs Paulusma and Sjoerdsma asked the health minister about Digital Corona Certificate rules for travel to Austria, Germany and other EU states, and about obtaining Dutch or EU certificates after vaccination or infection abroad. The minister answered that member states set their own national access rules and that the EU regulation makes the issuing state responsible, acknowledging some unresolved gaps and promising to look for solutions.
I am currently looking into which solution is possible for this group.
Momenteel bezie ik welke oplossing mogelijk is voor deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie van Nederlanders in Rusland en het reisadvies van de rijksoverheid voor Rusland

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether the threat of Russian military action against Ukraine endangers Dutch nationals in Russia, how likely retaliation against Western citizens is, and whether the Dutch travel advice for Russia is adequate compared with the US advice. The minister replied that the advice was tightened (urgent call to consider necessary stay, pinning and flight uncertainties noted), that no specific threats against Dutch citizens are known, and that the advice is in line with other EU countries.
The answer to this question will be included in the reply by the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management
Het antwoord op deze vraag zal worden meegenomen in de beantwoording door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Lee en Sjoerdsma over de acties van China tegen Litouwen naar aanleiding van het openen van een Vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan in Vilnius

MPs Van der Lee and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the government supports Lithuania against Chinese economic coercion after Taiwan opened a representative office in Vilnius, and whether these measures breach WTO rules. The minister replies that the Netherlands expresses solidarity, raised concerns with China, backs the EU's WTO consultation request and the EU anti-coercion instrument, and says businesses are responsible for their own risk analysis while the government monitors the situation.
The cabinet fully supports this step by the EU.
Het kabinet staat volledig achter deze stap van de EU.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Laan over het bericht dat de Chinese app MY2022 voor de Olympische Spelen 2022 gevoelige data van o.a. de Nederlandse Olympiërs verzamelt en politiek sensitieve conten

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Chinese MY2022 Olympic app collecting sensitive data of Dutch athletes and storing politically sensitive content, including IFlytek links, university ties, a security audit, mandatory use, censorship, and raising the issue with the IOC and EU. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described the security flaws found by Citizen Lab, said athletes were not obliged to use the app but had to provide personal health data, and noted the government had raised concerns bilaterally, through briefings and with the Chinese ambassador, while answers to the questions were delayed.

Given the technical aspects of the questions asked and the interdepartmental coordination they required, it has unfortunately not proved possible to answer these questions before the start of the Olympic Games.

Gezien de technische aspecten van de gestelde vragen en de interdepartementale afstemming die deze vergden, is het helaas niet mogelijk gebleken om deze vragen voor de aanvang van de Olympische Spelen te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht van het mogelijk samenspannen van EU-commissaris voor Nabuurschap en Uitbreiding, Olivér Várhelyi, met Milorad Dodik, de leider van de Bosnische Serviërs

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU Commissioner Olivér Várhelyi may have colluded with Bosnian Serb leader Milorad Dodik, about the EU's response, and about possible sanctions. The minister said the government could not verify the reports, stated that EU sanctions proposed under the Kuzu motion did not gain support in the Council, and described diplomatic steps and a pending High Representative options paper.
The cabinet does not have information to verify the indications in the EU Observer report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie om de aanwijzingen uit het bericht van de EU Observer te kunnen verifiëren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Laan over het bericht dat de Poolse Izabela is overleden omdat zij geen abortus mocht ondergaan

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister how the government views reports that a Polish woman died after being denied an abortion, and what the Netherlands is doing about Polish abortion law, civil society funding and support for women. The minister said the government is concerned about regressive pressure on women's rights, stated it has raised concerns with Poland, and said the Human Rights Fund cannot finance individuals or abortion services, while noting Dutch healthcare is a member-state competence.
In this specific case it is unclear whether the tragic death was a direct consequence of the abortion legislation or the result of a medical error.
In deze specifieke zaak is het onduidelijk of het tragische overlijden het rechtstreekse gevolg is van de abortuswetgeving of het gevolg was van een medische fout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de zorgelijke toestand van INTERPOL

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked ministers about the election of UAE general Al-Raisi as Interpol president, alleged human rights abuse, misuse of red notices and possible measures against Interpol and its members. The ministers answered that Interpol's rules prevent undue country influence, that the election followed the formal procedure, that reforms and corrective measures against misuse are ongoing, and that suspending funds or reconsidering membership is not currently warranted.
I condemn any attempt to misuse Interpol instruments.
Ik keur elke poging tot misbruik van Interpol-instrumenten af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over het rapport 'No Forgiveness for People Like You. Executions and Enforced Disappearances in Afghanistan under the Taliban'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked the Foreign Minister about the Human Rights Watch report on Taliban executions and enforced disappearances of former Afghan government personnel, the broken amnesty, and related policy options. The minister condemned the reported abuses, described diplomatic pressure on the Taliban, and stated that aid is on hold and that UNAMA should keep full access and reporting powers.
The cabinet was aware through the media and other sources of rumours that, although there did not appear to be systematic reprisals, disappearances and executions did occur.
Het kabinet was via de media en andere bronnen op de hoogte van geruchten dat, hoewel er geen sprake leek van systematische vergeldingsacties, verdwijningen en executies wel degelijk voorvielen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de intimidatie van MH-17-advocaten

An MP asked the government about reports that lawyers representing MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and about security measures, diplomatic responses, spying offences, a foreign agents register, and countering disinformation and cyberattacks. The government condemned all interference, said it monitors the security situation closely and takes measures where needed, but declined to discuss individual cases and said no diplomatic action is currently warranted, while noting a planned bill to extend espionage offences.
For security reasons I cannot address individual cases or comment on whether investigations are ongoing.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek en kan ik geen uitspraken doen over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de escalatie van het conflict in Ethiopië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the escalation of the Ethiopia conflict, including travel advice, consular preparedness and the security of the Dutch embassy. The minister answered that the travel advice was raised to red (except Addis Ababa, orange), Dutch nationals were urged to leave via commercial flights, and the situation is continuously monitored.

The Foreign Affairs travel advice was adjusted on 4 November in connection with the security situation and has since had a red classification, except for the capital Addis Ababa, which has an orange classification.

Het reisadvies van Buitenlandse Zaken is op 4 november jl. in verband met de veiligheidssituatie aangepast en heeft sindsdien een rode classificatie, behalve voor de hoofdstad Addis Abeba, dat een oranje classificatie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Tigray (Ethiopië) en de humanitaire crisis die daar plaatsvindt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian crisis in Tigray, Ethiopia, including blockade of aid, telecommunications and banking cutoffs, and what Dutch diplomacy and sanctions could do. The minister answered that the situation is very serious, that Dutch funding of over EUR 15 million continues, that no dialogue between the parties currently exists, and that the Netherlands will push for sanctions at the next Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands will therefore again advocate for sanctions at the upcoming FAC of 18 October.
Nederland zal dan ook wederom pleiten voor sancties tijdens de aankomende RBZ van 18 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Dubieuze investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenuitvoerders in Myanmar’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch pension funds investing in companies linked to Myanmar's military should be curbed and whether participants should have more say over investments. The minister said the government advises firms and pension funds not to deal with military-controlled entities, relies on the IMVB covenant and engagement, and points to existing participant voice through boards and accountability bodies.
The cabinet is willing to specifically point pension funds, within this framework, to the lasting importance of the cited cabinet advice and its elaboration.
Het kabinet is bereid om de pensioenfondsen binnen dit verband ook specifiek te wijzen op het blijvende belang van het genoemde kabinetsadvies en de uitwerking er van.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma over de pilot voor DigiD-activeringscode ontvangen via videobellen en toegankelijkheid van het Digitaal Corona Certificaat voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma asked about extending the pilot for issuing DigiD activation codes via video call to Dutch citizens abroad, its lessons, and access to the Digital Corona Certificate for citizens without BSN or DigiD. The minister said the pilot continues until structural arrangements, targeted for early 2022, are in place, reports strong demand and satisfaction, and notes the system does not record citizens' nationality or residence, so usage by group cannot be given.
The system used for the DCC does not record, for privacy reasons, to whom the DCC is issued, and therefore also not nationality or place of residence.
Het systeem dat voor DCC wordt gebruikt slaat in verband met privacy niet op aan wie het DCC wordt uitgegeven en dus ook niet de nationaliteit en woonplaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Sjoerdsma over het verdwijnen van BVN

MPs Wuite and Sjoerdsma asked why BVN satellite broadcasting ended on 1 July 2021, leaving many Dutch citizens abroad without access to public broadcasting, and whether the government would restore it or renegotiate with Flanders. The minister answered that funding cuts forced the end of worldwide satellite coverage, that content remains available via app, website and NPO Start, and that no legal obligation requires BVN to remain fully accessible worldwide.
There is no legal obligation that BVN programming must remain fully and effectively accessible to all Dutch citizens worldwide.
Er is geen wettelijke verplichting dat de BVN-programmering volledig en daadwerkelijk bereikbaar moet blijven voor alle Nederlanders wereldwijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat experts van de Verenigde Naties melden dat er orgaanhandel plaatsvindt in China

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about UN and China Tribunal reports of forced organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, including Chinese legislation, Dutch links to the trade, and whether the issue will be raised in the EU and UN Human Rights Council. The government said it cannot verify the allegations, pointed to Chinese laws of 2007 and 2009-2011, reported no concrete Dutch links, declined a blacklist of Chinese hospitals, and promised a letter on the Council of Europe convention by end 2021.
The cabinet is unable to verify or refute these allegations.
Het kabinet is niet in staat om deze aanklachten te verifiëren noch te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het Holodomor-genocidevraagstuk

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not recognised the Holodomor as genocide, and about recently surfaced Soviet documents on the famine. The minister acknowledged the documents and scholarship but declined to label the Holodomor genocide, citing the absence of the legal norm in 1932-33 and the UN Genocide Convention definition.
For the Dutch government, when recognising genocides, rulings of international courts and tribunals, unambiguous conclusions from scientific research and findings by the UN are decisive.

Voor de Nederlandse regering zijn bij de erkenning van genocides uitspraken van internationale gerechts- en strafhoven, eenduidige conclusies volgend uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek en vaststellingen door de VN leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma over nieuwe ontwikkelingen rondom de zaak Julio Poch

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice about new developments in the Julio Poch case, including experts doubting Dutch lawfulness in sharing data with Argentina and the Machielse commission's lack of hearing the affected person. The minister largely refused to add to the commission's findings, defended its independence and procedural choices, and said the documents were returned to their originating organisations under agreed conditions.
For me, it is paramount that the report of the Commission Dossier J.A. Poch shows a thorough investigation along various lines.
Voor mij staat voorop dat het rapport van de Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch blijk geeft van een grondig onderzoek langs verschillende sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland en China twijfel zaaien over Europese vaccins

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia and China are spreading doubt about European vaccines, whether the government will push back against such disinformation in the EU and bilaterally, and about the quality and regulatory status of Sinopharm, Sinovac and Sputnik V vaccines. The minister acknowledges the disinformation is condemnable but judges its impact small, describes EU and Dutch counter-disinformation efforts and the Chinese and Russian contacts, and says Sputnik V's EMA review is still ongoing with no date for a formal application.

At the same time, the cabinet has confidence in the pluriform Dutch and European media landscape, in which the free press assesses this kind of reporting on its merits and the impact of this kind of disinformation is so far small.

Tegelijkertijd heeft het kabinet vertrouwen in het pluriforme Nederlandse en Europese medialandschap, waarin de vrije pers dit soort berichtgeving op z’n merites beoordeelt en de impact van dit soort desinformatie vooralsnog klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma  en Van Nispen over de uitvoering van motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2283) over Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the implementation of the motions on the Poch Committee archive, including whether a Cabinet minutes passage and the Omtzigt motion on article 68 of the Constitution bear on parliamentary access to documents. The minister confirmed the awareness of these matters, said the committee archive was transferred to the department on 4 June and is being reviewed under article 68, and that disclosure will happen as quickly as possible.
As I also indicated in my answers to written parliamentary questions, my starting point remains that this disclosure will take place as soon as possible.
Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in mijn antwoorden op schriftelijke Kamervragen, is mijn uitgangspunt daarbij nog steeds dat deze verstrekking zo spoedig mogelijk zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sjoerdsma over het onder de radar verdwijnen van Syriëgangers

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about Dutch Syria travellers who may have escaped Syrian camps unnoticed, including questions on numbers, monitoring, consular contact and repatriation. The government largely refused to discuss individual cases, gave aggregate figures from public AIVD data, and described existing measures and cooperation with Turkey and other European states without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Afghaanse tolken in levensgevaar komen als de coalitietroepen van de resolute support missie vertrekken uit Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about risks to Afghan interpreters who worked for Dutch forces as coalition troops leave Afghanistan, and about implementation of the Belhaj motion on relocating them. The government answered that over 60 interpreters with families have already come to the Netherlands, that the Afghan authorities are responsible for citizens' safety, and that interpreters meeting the conditions will be processed for asylum, with no specific numbers at risk disclosed.
On the numbers of interpreters who may be at risk, names and dates, we make no statements in the security interest of the interpreters.
Over aantallen tolken die mogelijk risico lopen, namen en data doen we uit veiligheidsbelang van de tolken geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee en Amhaouch over het bericht 'EU efforts to observe the Palestinian election fall flat'

MPs Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU efforts to observe the Palestinian elections had stalled, including whether the EU could still observe and support the vote, Israel's reasons for not admitting EU staff, and alternative partners. The minister replied that President Abbas postponed the elections without a new date, that the EU has urged a new date and called on Israel to facilitate elections, and that the EU will renew its observation effort once a date is set.
Once a new date for the elections is set, the EU will again work towards organising an observation mission.
Wanneer een nieuwe datum voor de verkiezingen is vastgesteld, zal de EU opnieuw inzetten op de organisatie van een waarnemingsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de demonstraties in Myanmar uit de hand lopen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about violent repression of protests in Myanmar, EU sanctions timing, humanitarian aid, protection of activists, Indonesia's role, Rohingya minorities and UN Security Council action. The minister answered most questions in substance, confirming EU sanctions on eleven military figures, humanitarian funding channels and Dutch diplomatic engagement, while giving general policy statements on some points.
The Netherlands also maintains bilateral contact with the United States and other like-minded countries about measures taken in response to the military coup, including sanctions.
Nederland onderhoudt ook bilateraal contact met de Verenigde Staten en andere gelijkgezinde landen over maatregelen die worden genomen naar aanleiding van de militaire coup, waaronder sancties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Marokkaanse journalist Maati Monjib al sinds 29 december in voorarrest zit onder discutabele beschuldigingen en inmiddels in hongerstaking is

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about the detention of Moroccan journalist Maati Monjib and his hunger strike, including whether the Netherlands will raise the case in the Media Freedom Coalition. The minister answers that Monjib is now conditionally released pending a verdict, that Morocco must ensure fair proceedings, that the Netherlands has no independent information on the money-laundering charge, and that the case is being followed within EU and international channels.
It is up to the responsible Moroccan authorities to carefully investigate the charges against Maati Monjib and to pass judgment on them.
Het is aan de verantwoordelijke Marokkaanse autoriteiten om zorgvuldig onderzoek te doen wat betreft de aanklachten tegen Maati Monjib en hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over het bericht 'Situation Report EEPA HORN No. 50' van 9 januari en 'Situation Report HORN No. 81' van 11 februari

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports on the Tigray conflict, including the killing of an aid worker, destruction of refugee camps, alleged Eritrean involvement and massacres, plus the response of the government, EU and UN. The minister answered in substance, noting Ethiopia's commitments to humanitarian access and independent investigation, Dutch calls for Eritrean withdrawal, and that details on some incidents could not be verified or discussed for confidentiality reasons.
On the use of this regime in specific situations I cannot make public statements for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inzet van dit regime in specifieke situaties kan ik omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid geen openbare uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat strafrechtdeskundigen het rapport van de commissie Machielse kraken

MPs Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Justice Minister why legal experts reached different conclusions than the Machielse commission on the Poch case, and whether the commission's underlying documents would be shared. The minister declined to change his view, deferred to the commission's own response, and said the commission's archive will be reviewed for release to parliament once transferred to his department.
Once the archive has been transferred to my department, these documents will be reviewed to assess which documents can be provided to your House under Article 68 of the Constitution.

Zodra het archief is overgedragen aan mijn departement, zullen deze documenten worden doorgenomen om te beoordelen welke documenten op grond van artikel 68 Grondwet aan uw Kamer kunnen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sjoerdsma over ‘De quota worden duur betaald‘

D66 MPs asked whether PM Rutte threatened the EU-Faroe trade relationship in 2017 to block a Faroese fisheries law affecting Dutch quota holdings, and questioned the government's intervention and the role of an honorary consul with fishing interests. The government denied an explicit threat, said it raised concerns via bilateral contacts and the EU, declined to publish conversation reports, and defended the honorary consul's appointment as serving Dutch economic interests.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked whether the government would make a humanitarian request for transfer of Mr Singh's sentence to the Netherlands, given his health and the failure of earlier clemency requests, and why it rejects the WOTS transfer procedure and continuing enforcement. The minister replied that transfer is not a humanitarian instrument, that the government is diplomatically supporting a clemency request instead, and that it sees no room for a WOTS request because of the lack of remaining sentence and binding to the Netherlands.

In my letter to the House of 21 September 2020, responding to the motion by Van Nispen et al., I indicated why I see no room for a request to the American authorities to transfer enforcement of his sentence to the Netherlands.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer d.d. 21 september 2020, in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s., heb ik aangegeven waarom ik geen ruimte zie voor een verzoek aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot overdracht van de tenuitvoerlegging van zijn straf aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat er al negen maanden vijf Nederlanders vast zitten in een gevangenis in Venezuela

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about five fishermen (four Dutch nationals, one Venezuelan resident of Curaçao) held in Venezuela since March 2020 without trial, and what the government was doing to secure their release. The minister confirmed the detention, said the case is pending pretrial with no substantive hearing yet, described consular assistance and diplomatic requests for a fair trial, and said the embassy cannot extract citizens from foreign detention.
The Kingdom of the Netherlands cannot directly interfere with a foreign legal process.
Het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden kan zich niet rechtstreeks bemoeien met een buitenlandse rechtsgang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Van den Hul, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het ter dood veroordeelde Pakistaanse echtpaar Shafqat Emmanuel en Shagufta Kausar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence for blasphemy imposed on the Pakistani couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, the repeated postponements of their appeal, and what the government would do through diplomacy, EU channels and asylum support. The minister condemned the death sentence, said the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns with Pakistani authorities without intervening in the court process, and declined to commit to attending the trial or to pre-judging any asylum request.
The Netherlands and the EU do not intervene in the legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland en de EU interveniëren niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Leger Ethiopië neemt hoofdstad van Tigray in'

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about the armed conflict in Tigray, Ethiopia, including casualty figures, alleged civilian massacres, humanitarian needs, refugee flows to Sudan, international calls for a ceasefire, and Dutch response. The minister answered that information is unreliable due to restricted access, condemned the reported violence, called for a ceasefire and access for aid workers and journalists, and described Dutch humanitarian funding.
Because humanitarian workers, media and observers lack access to the area, the cabinet does not have reliable, independent information on casualties.
Vanwege het gebrek aan toegang voor humanitaire hulpverleners, media en waarnemers tot het gebied beschikt het kabinet niet over betrouwbare, onafhankelijke informatie over slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over het bericht 'Egypt arrested its leaders, but a leading human rights group remains defiant'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of three senior staff of the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, shortly after Western ambassadors including the Dutch one had visited the group, and about whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister confirmed the arrests and their charges, said the three were released on 3 December while charges remain, and stated that the Netherlands has raised concerns with Egyptian authorities through diplomatic channels.
Both in Cairo and in The Hague, the Netherlands has engaged with the Egyptian authorities at various levels to convey our concerns and ask for clarification.
Zowel in Cairo en in Den Haag is Nederland op verschillende niveaus in gesprek gegaan met de Egyptische autoriteiten om onze zorgen over te brengen en opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Australische militairen 39 burgers en gevangenen executeerden in Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked whether the ministers knew of reports that Australian soldiers executed 39 civilians and prisoners in Afghanistan, what the Dutch government knew and when, whether Dutch soldiers worked closely with Australian forces, and whether any war crimes investigation was conducted. The minister answered that the Australian inquiry shared no information beforehand, that Dutch soldiers were interviewed only in confidential interviews in 2018, that Dutch-Australian cooperation existed within Task Force Uruzgan, and that the Netherlands conducted no investigation into possible Australian war crimes.
The record of these confidential interviews was not made available to the cabinet or to the interviewed soldiers by the Australian inquiry commission.
Het verslag van deze vertrouwelijke interviews is niet door de Australische onderzoekscommissie aan het kabinet of aan de geïnterviewde militairen ter beschikking gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de bijeenkomst van de G20 georganiseerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the Dutch UN envoy would attend the G20 meeting hosted by Saudi Arabia, and about the detention of Saudi women's rights activists and what the government has done about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not attend the G20 summit or side events, raised the activists' detention through several channels, and expressed concern about their treatment without committing to new concrete action.
The Netherlands did not take part in the G20 summit held virtually on 21 and 22 November.
Nederland nam niet deel aan de G20-top die op 21 en 22 november jl. virtueel plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Sjoerdsma, Van den Hul en Van den Niewenhuijzen over het bericht dat Palestijnse kinderen worden mishandeld en vernederd in Israëlische gevangenissen

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the ministers whether they knew of Save the Children reports of mistreatment of Palestinian children in Israeli detention, and what the government would do about military trial of minors. The minister acknowledged the reports, condemned the practices, said Nederland has raised the issue with Israeli authorities and will keep doing so, and mentioned support for NGO projects.
The Netherlands will continue to voice its concerns to the Israeli government.
Nederland zal haar zorgen blijven uitspreken naar de Israëlische regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Kuiken over het legaal naar Nederland reizen van partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Kuiken asked why partners of Dutch or EU citizens cannot travel to the Netherlands when embassies are closed, and urged measures such as cooperation with other EU embassies and digital or border-issued permits. Minister Blok replied that consular services are largely being restored, that the long-distance lovers scheme stays limited to Dutch and EU citizens, and that alternative issuance methods are incompatible with the MVV requirement.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no insight into figures on the number of partners of Dutch nationals or EU citizens who currently cannot travel.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen dat op dit moment niet kan reizen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie in kamp al Hol

An MP from D66 asked the Justice Minister about reports that Al Hol camp in Syria is a breeding ground for IS radicalisation, whether Dutch nationals are being re-recruited, the repatriation of Dutch nationals and an arrest warrant. The minister answered that some camp residents remain radicalised, that IS is regaining some activity but not its former strength, that a few Dutch women may have escaped, and that repatriation is being assessed case by case with Schengen partners.
The investigation into the possibilities of bringing the suspect to the Netherlands is ongoing. If there are new developments, this will be reported.
Het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden om de verdachte naar Nederland te brengen loopt. Indien er nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn zal hierover gerapporteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’.

MPs asked why Huawei is partly excluded from critical 5G infrastructure in the Netherlands but not from university research cooperation with UvA and VU, and what framework governs cooperation with foreign-state-influenced companies. The government replied that universities are autonomous under the WHW and that the cooperation falls outside vital infrastructure, that authorities advised universities on risks, and that an investment screening and export-control framework is being developed, without committing to new binding rules on university cooperation.

Under their autonomy pursuant to the WHW, the universities themselves are responsible for deciding whether or not to enter a particular (international) research cooperation, within the frameworks of existing laws and regulations.

De universiteiten zijn vanuit hun autonomie op grond van de WHW zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit om – binnen de kaders van bestaande wet- en regelgeving – al dan niet een bepaalde (internationale) onderzoekssamenwerking aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen vast in oorlogsgebied door sluiting ambassades’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked whether ambassador closures due to COVID-19 leave about 1,500 refugee family members stranded in war zones and what the government will do. The minister answered that no exact figures exist, that about 90% of relevant posts have resumed visa services, that the government has eased rules and reissue arrangements, but that it cannot control the safety of people in conflict areas and cannot say when the remaining closed posts will reopen.

There is no insight into the exact number of refugee families (family reunification followers) who cannot come to the Netherlands for family reunification due to restricted consular services of an embassy or consulate-general.

Er is geen inzicht in het exacte aantal vluchtelingengezinnen (nareizigers) dat niet naar Nederland kan komen voor gezinshereniging door beperktere consulaire dienstverlening van een ambassade of consulaat-generaal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Asscher, Van Otterloo, Van Ojik en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk met nieuwe wetgeving afspraken uit het uittredingsakkoord niet na dreigt te komen

Five MPs asked the government about the UK's planned Internal Market Bill, which would breach parts of the Withdrawal Agreement, and its risks for citizens' rights and Dutch nationals in the UK. The State Secretary answered that the government shares concerns, monitors citizens' rights implementation with the Commission, sees no current signs of further UK legislation undermining citizens' rights, and will consider information measures for Dutch nationals in the UK.

The government therefore monitors, together with the European Commission and in several ways, whether these rights are being honoured, including via the Joint Committee and the Dutch embassy in the UK.
Het kabinet monitort daarom samen met de Europese Commissie op verschillende manieren of deze rechten worden nagekomen, onder meer via het Gemengd Comité en via de Nederlandse ambassade in het VK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Visumplicht tussen de Schengenzone en Suriname

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Schengen visa requirement for travel to and from Suriname has exceptions, how many visa applications are filed and approved, and what steps would lead toward visa liberalisation. The minister answered that the requirement applies with limited exceptions, that visa approval rates are around 90 to 95 percent, that the EU Commission holds exclusive competence over visa liberalisation, and that Suriname must first request a study and improve readmission cooperation and biometric passports.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have figures on visa applications submitted by Dutch travellers for Suriname.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt niet over cijfers van visumaanvragen die door Nederlandse reizigers voor Suriname worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘VS zet hoofdaanklager Internationaal Strafhof op zwarte lijst’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about US sanctions placing the ICC chief prosecutor and Court staff on a blacklist, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in the EU to prevent or respond to them. The minister answered that the government repeatedly urged the US not to escalate, is pursuing EU options such as the Anti-Boycott Regulation, and is working with banks to limit the impact on the Court, while stressing the Court must keep functioning.
Over recent months close contact has been maintained with the Court, various banks and our European partners.
Afgelopen maanden is nauw contact onderhouden met het Strafhof, verschillende banken en onze Europese partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de impact van coronabeperkingen op visumverlening aan buitenlandse geliefden van Nederlanders

MPs asked the government about the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on visa processing for foreign partners of Dutch nationals, including closed embassies, cancelled civic integration exams abroad, and whether alternative routes such as online exams or post-arrival testing are possible. The minister answered that most posts now offer the basic integration exam, that online testing is ruled out to prevent fraud, that post-arrival testing is incompatible with the MVV process, and that the government will keep working with posts and EU partners but cannot quantify affected families.
There is no insight into figures on the number of Dutch nationals currently forced to live apart because their partner cannot take the basic civic integration exam abroad.
Er is geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal Nederlandse staatsburgers dat op dit moment gescheiden moet leven vanwege het niet kunnen afleggen van een basisexamen inburgering buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht over de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Legal Protection what steps had been taken after a motion to bring Jaitsen Singh, detained in a US prison for 36 years, to the Netherlands, including whether a transfer request existed, whether the discretionary power should be used to start a transfer procedure, and whether diplomatic pressure for clemency would be pursued. The minister replied that no formal transfer request exists, that the US review is ongoing, that no transfer procedure will be initiated by the Netherlands, and that diplomatic support for a clemency request by Singh himself will be provided if no societal risks are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Kuiken over gedwongen gescheiden lange-afstandskoppels door corona

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked whether the government would relax the COVID-19 entry ban for long-distance unmarried partners, including a Danish-style exception, and clarified entry rules for EU citizens' non-EU partners and the online information. The minister answered that a temporary scheme for long-distance partners, in force since 27 July 2020, was introduced within health limits, that a marriage certificate is not the only way to prove a relationship, and that he will check the government online information.

In a letter of 16 July 2020 I informed your House that the cabinet, within the health frameworks relating to Covid-19, found a possibility to arrive at a temporary adjusted scheme for partners in long-distance relationships.

Bij brief van 16 juli 2020 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat het kabinet, binnen de gezondheidskaders met betrekking tot Covid-19, een mogelijkheid heeft gevonden om te komen tot een tijdelijke aangepaste regeling voor geliefden in een langeafstandsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Rusland betaalde Afghaanse strijders om Amerikaanse militairen te doden’

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government confirmed reports that Russia paid Afghan fighters to kill US soldiers, whether US intelligence had informed the Netherlands, and whether Dutch troops in Afghanistan were at higher risk. The ministers answered that the government does not publicly comment on cooperation with foreign intelligence services or specific intelligence, that allied services would normally share information affecting each other's soldiers, and that general threat levels are monitored with precautions taken where needed.
As is well known, the cabinet makes no public statements about cooperation with and between foreign intelligence services.
Het kabinet doet, zoals bekend, in het openbaar geen mededelingen over de samenwerking met en tussen buitenlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Dreiging extreemrechts 'grote blinde vlek'” en het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 52

An MP from D66 asked the Justice Minister about reports that far-right extremism is a blind spot, the threat it poses, its networks, government responses and the farmers' protest group FDF. The minister answered that the threat is marginal and mostly from lone actors, that enforcement and prevention measures are in place, and that FDF's rhetoric is polarising.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of motives linked to criminal cases.
De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie houden geen registratie bij van motieven gekoppeld aan strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma  over het bericht 'Huiveringwekkende» agressie tegen journalisten in VS'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of police violence and rubber bullets against journalists during US protests over George Floyd's death, and whether the government would raise press freedom with US authorities. The minister condemned the violence, said the incidents should be investigated by US authorities, and reported that the Netherlands raised racism and press freedom concerns in a videoconference with Secretary Pompeo and with the US ambassador.
The cabinet cannot say whether journalists were deliberately shot with rubber bullets.
Het kabinet kan zich niet uitspreken of doelbewust met rubberen kogels op journalisten is geschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over het afsluiten van Nederlandse betaalrekeningen van Nederlanders buiten Nederland

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked the Finance Minister whether banks may close current accounts of Dutch citizens living outside the EU, and about related costs, French rules and possible legal changes. The Minister answered that banks set their own risk policy within the law, that basic payment account rights apply only to those lawfully residing in the EU, and that no further study is planned for now.
At present I see no added value in a study into the possibility of legally giving Dutch nationals outside the EU the option of a (basic) payment account.
Antwoord 17 Op dit moment zie ik geen toegevoegde waarde in een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om Nederlanders buiten de EU wettelijk de mogelijkheid te geven tot een (basis)betaalrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over het terug laten keren van Nederlanders uit Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded in Morocco, how many have returned, at what level the government is negotiating with Morocco, why Morocco is not allowing them to return, and whether the King should contact the Moroccan King. The minister answered that over 1000 remain registered, about 1300 have returned via four repatriation flights, and that contacts with Moroccan authorities continue at a level chosen for effectiveness, without addressing the reasons Morocco gives or the royal contact proposal.
The Dutch aim is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma  over de aangenomen noodwet van de Hongaarse president Orbán

Two D66 MPs asked the Dutch ministers about Hungary's emergency law allowing rule by decree without time limit and criminal penalties for disinformation, and what the Netherlands would do regarding rule of law. The government called the Hungarian law worrying, said it raised rule-of-law concerns, and described raising it with Hungary, in the Foreign Affairs Council, through the Article 7 procedure, conditionality in the EU budget and the annual rule-of-law review.
The cabinet finds the steps taken by the Hungarian government and parliament worrying.
Het kabinet vindt de door de Hongaarse regering en parlement gezette stappen verontrustend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het op 6 mei 1963 te Straatsburg tot stand gekomen Verdrag betreffende beperking van gevallen van meervoudige nationaliteit en betreffende militaire verplichtingen in geval v

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the 1963 Strasbourg convention on multiple nationality, whose first chapter now binds only Austria and the Netherlands, should be terminated given the government's plan to modernise nationality law. The State Secretary answered that the convention's limited reach has little effect on Dutch nationality law and that any decision to terminate depends on the modernisation plans, which will also take account of a 2019 EU Court ruling.
Whether it is necessary and desirable to terminate (chapter I of) the Convention depends partly on the precise elaboration of the coalition agreement's commitment to modernise nationality law.

De vraag in hoeverre het noodzakelijk en wenselijk is om (hoofdstuk I van het) Verdrag op te zeggen is mede afhankelijk van de precieze uitwerking van de afspraak in het regeerakkoord tot modernisering van het nationaliteitsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over gesloten ambassades, consulaten en EDV-kantoren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch citizens with non-Dutch partners or children cannot travel to the Netherlands because closed embassies and outsourced service offices prevent visa or MVV applications, and about help for stranded Dutch students without a Dutch address. The minister answered that family members of Dutch citizens can apply again under the exception policy where local conditions allow, and that the Bijzondere Bijstand Buitenland registration closed on 8 April 2020 while 24-hour contact remains available.

The group you mention of non-Dutch family members of Dutch citizens falls under this, and can therefore again submit a visa application or collect their MVV sticker under the current policy in order to join their Dutch family member in the Netherlands.

De door u genoemde groep van niet-Nederlandse familieleden van Nederlanders valt daar onder, en kan dus onder het huidige beleid weer een visumaanvraag indienen of hun MVV-sticker ophalen om zich bij hun Nederlandse gezinslid in Nederland te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de zaak Julio Poch

An MP from D66 asks the Justice Minister why the Machielse inquiry into the Julio Poch case is taking so long, whether a deadline will be set, who destroyed a travel report, whether the second travel report will be disclosed under Article 68 of the Constitution, and related archive questions. The Minister says the inquiry needs room to work, the travel report could not be found but other documents were recovered and handed to the inquiry, and he declines further public disclosure of documents for now while promising a progress update in June.
However, I am of the opinion that the Committee Dossier J.A. Poch must first be given room to carry out its investigation.
Ik ben echter van mening dat de Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch nu eerst de ruimte moet krijgen om haar onderzoek uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Belhaj en Groothuizen over een Nederlandse bijdrage aan een gereactiveerde ‘Sophia-missie’

MPs Sjoerdsma, Belhaj and Groothuizen asked the ministers about the Berlin Libya conference, the EU arms embargo monitoring role, reactivating the Sophia mission, humanitarian and migration effects, and a Dutch contribution. The government welcomed the Berlin outcomes, said EUNAVFOR MED Irini (succeeding Sophia) will implement the UN arms embargo, and said a Dutch contribution of staff officers in Rome is likely while further capacity decisions await military advice.
The cabinet is still considering a possible contribution with other capabilities.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op een eventuele bijdrage met andere capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over ondervertegenwoordiging van Nederlandse ambtenaren in Brussel

The MP asks why Dutch civil servants are underrepresented in EU institutions in Brussels, given the 3.9% target against 1.9% among young officials, and what steps are being taken to reverse the declining trend. The minister answers with figures per institution, notes the expected effect of Brexit and retirements, and describes the current recruitment and support measures, while saying it is too early to judge their effect.
It is still too early to see the effects of the current policy. The cabinet is monitoring the effects and will adjust where necessary.
Het is nog te vroeg om de effecten van het huidige beleid te zien. Het kabinet monitort de effecten ervan en zal waar nodig bijsturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de informatievoorziening aan Nederlanders in het buitenland rond de ontwikkelingen van COVID-19

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister what measures were taken to inform Dutch nationals abroad about COVID-19, to keep consular services running, and to protect the health of diplomatic and local staff. The minister answered that travel advice, the 24/7 contact centre, embassy social media and crisis structures were used, and that staff health measures followed Arbo rules and RIVM guidance.
The Dutch network of embassies and consulates and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs remain on standby 24 hours a day to provide consular assistance as well as possible.
Het Nederlandse netwerk van ambassades en consulaten en het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken blijven 24 uur per dag klaar staan om zo goed mogelijk consulaire bijstand te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over hulp voor Nederlandse uitwisselingsstudenten, stagiairs en instellingen voor hoger onderwijs met de situatie rond het coronavirus

Two D66 MPs asked the education and foreign affairs ministers how universities and universities of applied sciences help exchange students and interns stranded abroad by COVID-19 travel restrictions, including repatriation, study delay funding and whether countries are expelling students. The minister says institutions are supporting students, gives partial abroad counts and points to existing DUO loan and funding options, and says that contacts with foreign affairs and airlines continue, without new binding commitments.
Because developments keep changing and differ by country, it is difficult to determine at this moment exactly how many students abroad are involved.
Vanwege de steeds veranderende ontwikkelingen die ook nog eens per land verschillen is het lastig om op dit moment precies in kaart te brengen om welke aantallen studenten in het buitenland het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over de EU Battlegroup

Two MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the EU Battlegroup: whether the Netherlands leads it with Germany in 2020, why Battlegroups have never been deployed, and whether they could support UN missions. The minister confirmed the Netherlands' contribution and explained that unanimity, operational and financial obstacles have blocked deployment, while committing to explore a Battlegroup role in a UN mission before summer 2020.
I promised the House to inform it about this before summer 2020. I will keep this commitment.
Ik beloofde de Kamer hierover voor de zomer 2020 te informeren. Ik zal deze toezegging gestand doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de aangekondigde plannen van Israël om nederzettingen te bouwen in E1-gebied

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's announced plans to build settlements in the E1 area near East Jerusalem and what the Netherlands and EU would do, including responses to a US Middle East peace plan. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands and EU oppose settlement expansion as undermining the two-state solution, joined a demarche and urged Israel to refrain, but declined to commit to specific measures, saying further steps would be weighed later.
The cabinet does not wish to anticipate this.
Het kabinet wil hier niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Diks, Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het VN-rapport waarin wordt geconstateerd dat diverse landen het VN-wapenembargo tegen Libië schenden

MPs from GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about a UN Panel of Experts report finding that several states violated the Libya arms embargo, including the possible Dutch role of Van der Kamp Shipsales in a warship sale. The minister said the Netherlands raised enforcement at EU level, is investigating the company without yet deciding on measures, and sees no need for additional rules, while noting the limits of post-export controls.
Further investigation is currently ongoing, so the cabinet cannot now say whether there is cause to take measures against the company.
Nader onderzoek loopt op dit moment, daarom kan het kabinet nu geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of er aanleiding bestaat om maatregelen tegen het bedrijf te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een dialoog tussen de Spaanse en Catalaanse regering

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about the state of the Spain-Catalonia conflict and whether Spain's government would start a formal dialogue with Catalonia's regional government. Minister Blok answered that a formal dialogue started on 26 February 2020, that it is welcome, but that it is an internal Spanish matter on which the Netherlands sees no reason to intervene unless both parties request it.
Moreover, it concerns an internal Spanish affair. I see no reason for the Netherlands to get involved, unless both parties explicitly asked us to do so.
Het betreft verder een interne Spaanse aangelegenheid. Ik zie geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich hierin te mengen, tenzij beide partijen ons daartoe expliciet zouden verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Sudan’s ousted leader is sentenced to two years for corruption’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the two-year corruption sentence of ousted Sudanese leader Al-Bashir, arguing it does not reflect ICC-charged crimes, and asked whether Sudan would be pressed to extradite him and whether EU sanctions or aid should be conditioned on it. The minister answered that Sudan has pledged cooperation with the ICC and domestic prosecutions are planned, that Netherlands is pressing for extradition and accountability, but that conditioning EU aid on extradition is not desirable and sanctions will be decided later depending on developments.

Depending on the progress and outcomes, the ICC's view on cooperation with Sudan and the place of trial, I will decide in the coming months whether or not to proceed with calling for targeted sanctions at EU level.

Afhankelijk van de voortgang en uitkomsten hiervan, de visie van het ICC t.a.v. de samenwerking met Soedan en plaats van berechting meewegende, zal ik de komende maanden besluiten om wel of niet door te gaan met het in Europees verband op te roepen tot persoonsgerichte sancties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Groeiend verzet tegen Saudisch vrachtship Bahri Yanbu vol wapens’ en ‘Don't let Saudi arms ship dock in UK, say campaigners’

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether a Saudi cargo ship carrying arms bound for Yemen would be allowed to dock in EU ports, and whether EU states should refuse it under the Arms Trade Treaty and EU Common Position.
