The government said it lacks information on transit through other EU ports, would not have granted a Dutch transit licence to this ship, and will keep raising the matter with EU partners.
The cabinet continues to point EU member states on several occasions to the tightened Dutch policy and to call on other countries to adopt comparable measures.
Het kabinet blijft EU-lidstaten bij meerdere gelegenheden wijzen op het aangescherpte Nederlandse beleid en andere landen oproepen vergelijkbare maatregelen te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Annahita (22) krijgt duizenden reacties nadat ze als enige op vlucht naar VS wordt geweigerd'

MPs Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers about reports that a Dutch woman was refused boarding to the US at Schiphol, whether the US immigration liaison officers have powers on Dutch soil, and about pre-clearance negotiations. The government declined to comment on the individual case, stated that IAP officers only advise airlines and need consent for photographs, and said pre-clearance negotiations are ongoing with Dutch sovereignty and Dutch standards to be respected.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de brief die ministers oproept om van de EU een sterkere geopolitieke speler te maken

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the High Representative's December 2019 letter calling for the EU to become a stronger geopolitical player, and about the stalled Commission proposal for qualified majority voting in parts of the CFSP/CSDP. The minister largely agrees with the aim, says the Netherlands will keep raising QMV and encourages constructive abstention, but states there is no formal proposal on the table and gives no concrete timetable.
I have repeatedly called for a substantive discussion with the other 27 Foreign Ministers.
Ik heb meerdere malen opgeroepen tot een inhoudelijke discussie met de andere 27 Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de betrokkenheid van Aruba Airlines bij het uitzetten van Cubaanse mensenrechtenverdedigers, journalisten en andere activisten

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Aruba Airlines was involved in deporting Cuban activists, whether this will be investigated, and what support or compensation the Kingdom can offer. The minister said aviation is an Aruban matter, that Aruba's government and the airline deny knowing participation, and that the embassy raised the issue with Cuba, which denies the allegations.
Aviation is, under the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands, a matter for the constituent country and not a matter for the Kingdom.
Luchtvaart is op grond van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een landsaangelegenheid en geen aangelegenheid van het Koninkrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over recht op gezinshereniging

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether family reunification rights apply to Dutch children held in Syrian camps and whether their parents can be refused entry on public order or national security grounds. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult departees, that Dutch nationals have an unconditional right of entry, and that non-Dutch parents' cases require a case-by-case proportionality assessment in which national security can weigh heavily.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult departees and their possible children from the camps in Syria.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun eventuele kinderen uit de opvangkampen in Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de Zembla-uitzending ‘Doelwit Volkel’

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands has a veto over US nuclear weapons at Volkel, whether the Dutch pilots must follow a US order, and whether the government will confirm the presence of nuclear weapons. The ministers answered that NATO decisions require unanimity and Dutch consent, but that numbers, locations and procedures cannot be disclosed for security and binding alliance reasons, and that efforts to increase transparency have gained no support.

On the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe, as well as the precise procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear task, no information can be provided, on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens, alsmede de precieze procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht ‘Politie vernietigde cruciaal document in zaak oud-Transavia piloot Julio Poch’

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Justice Minister about reports that police destroyed a key report of a 2008 trip in the Julio Poch case, and whether ministers and the prosecution's advisory reports were kept from the public. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the report is possibly lost or destroyed, declined to publish advisory reports or the report, and pointed to an independent inquiry by Machielse without a fixed deadline.
No, in advisory reports the College informs the Minister of Justice and Security in full confidence about certain sensitive matters and subjects.
Nee, in ambtsberichten informeert het College de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid in alle vertrouwelijkheid over bepaalde gevoelige zaken en onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en De Roon over een rapport over mensenrechtenschendingen in het noorden van Syrië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a Human Rights Watch report on abuses by Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces in northern Syria, including whether Turkey is responsible and whether former Dutch non-lethal aid reached groups fighting with Turkey and the Syrian Kurds. The minister says Turkey bears responsibility, that Nederland raises this with Turkey, that the groups concerned cannot be named publicly, and that it cannot exclude that Dutch-supplied vehicle parts were used in Operation Peace Spring.
Because the names of the moderate armed groups previously supported by the Netherlands could be traced, this cannot be addressed publicly here.
In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de namen van de gematigde gewapende groepen die voorheen door Nederland gesteund zijn kan hier in het openbaar niet op in worden gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Zeker drie EU-lidstaten gaan Syriëgangers uit eigen lang terughalen’?

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether reports that Belgium, Germany and France would repatriate IS detainees from Syria were true, how the government cooperates with allies and the US, and whether Iraq would prosecute European fighters. The minister denied the repatriation reports, described existing measures against returning fighters, and said talks with Iraq continue on prosecution under conditions excluding the death penalty.
No. This reporting turned out to be incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het verbieden van deurverkoop

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about door-to-door energy sales, including misleading and aggressive sales tactics, the expected effects of a planned opt-in ban on unsolicited telemarketing, data on door sales, municipal powers to restrict them, and an ACM investigation into energy contract sales. The State Secretary acknowledges the signals, says misleading practices are unacceptable, rules out an opt-in ban for door sales for now in favour of talks with energy suppliers, and promises to ask the ACM to tighten supervision.
I will ask the ACM to tighten supervision of the sale of energy at the door, as the Beckerman et al. motion requests.
Ik zal de ACM vragen het toezicht op de verkoop van energie aan de deur te verscherpen, zoals de motie Beckerman c.s. verzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Karabulut, Van Oijk en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Israëlisch hooggerechtshof keurt uitzetting HRW-directeur goed'

MPs from PvdA, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked how the government responds to the Israeli Supreme Court's approval of the expulsion of Human Rights Watch director Omar Shakir, and whether it fears this chills civil society and human rights defenders. The minister says the government raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador and at senior official level, its embassy monitored the hearings, and the EU urged Israel to reverse the decision.

Because of the government's and the EU's concern about increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, and specifically this case, the Minister of Foreign Affairs emphatically raised concerns about this threatened expulsion with the Israeli ambassador on 7 November.

Vanwege de bezorgdheid van het kabinet en de EU over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, en specifiek deze zaak, heeft de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met de Israëlische ambassadeur op 7 november jl. de zorgen over deze dreigende uitzetting nadrukkelijk opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over dodelijk geweld in het Koerdische kamp al-Hol in Syrië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about lethal violence and unrest in the al-Hol camp in Syria, including the presence of Dutch women and children, conditions in the Annex section, risks of radicalisation and escape, and Dutch responsibility. The government answered that it has no control over the camps, cannot confirm Dutch nationals among the victims, raised escape risks with Turkey and NATO, and maintains its policy of not actively retrieving Dutch IS-travellers while pursuing prosecution.
The cabinet has no authority over reception and detention locations in north-east Syria and cannot exert influence over the situation there.
Het kabinet heeft geen zeggenschap over opvang- en detentielocaties in Noordoost-Syrië en kan geen invloed uitoefenen op de situatie daar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over berechting van IS-strijders in Irak

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Netherlands is negotiating with Iraq on prosecuting ISIS fighters there, on what legal basis, and about a 1.6 million euro commitment, noting Iraqi law lacks genocide and crimes against humanity. The Minister replied that talks are exploratory, with red lines on the death penalty and fair trial standards, that the 1.6 million euro funds Interpol biometric capacity-building rather than prosecution, and that Iraqi law does not criminalise genocide or crimes against humanity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Ploumen over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending 'Nederlandse regering heeft morele verplichting West-Papoea te helpen'

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a Dutch moral obligation toward West Papua, reports of deaths in Papua unrest, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia on human rights. The minister answered that at least 32 died in Wamena with casualties on several sides, that the Netherlands raises Papua in dialogue with Indonesia while fully respecting its territorial integrity, and that it sees no reason to revise its earlier position on the Drooglever report.
I see no reason to revise the position set out in the letters to parliament of 22 November 2005 and 29 April 2016.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de lijn in de Kamerbrieven van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V, en van 29 april 2016, stuk 2420, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het artikel "De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders"

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that rescued migrants struggle to disembark, a hijacked merchant ship, and EU Operation Sophia, and asked for measures on safe ports and safety. The government answered that it has no such figures, supports calls for safe ports and a structural EU disembarkation solution, and noted that Sophia's mandate targets smuggling rather than rescue and was extended unchanged for six months.
The cabinet does not have such figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de situatie op Curaçao

MPs Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma and Diertens asked about the situation on Curaçao, including the Article 3 ECHR protection procedure, detention conditions for Venezuelan migrants, border and drug and arms smuggling controls, and funding. The government answered that the procedure was revised and adopted, that detention upgrades are being funded, and that border controls and support measures are being strengthened, while stressing that law enforcement is Curaçao's autonomous responsibility.
It is primarily up to the country of Curaçao to ensure that the procedure is properly implemented and to ensure that effective legal remedies and the necessary capacity exist.

Het is primair aan het land Curaçao om erop toe te zien dat op goede wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan de procedure en zorg te dragen voor het bestaan van effectieve rechtsmiddelen en de daarbij benodigde capaciteit.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Israël oogst kritiek met bliksemsloopactie op Palestijns grondgebied’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's demolition of Palestinian buildings in Wadi al Hummus, settlement expansion, the UN report on child casualties, and the status of investigations into the 2018 Gaza protest killings. The minister answered that the Netherlands joined EU and UN condemnations, raised concerns with Israel, and is awaiting the outcome of Israeli investigations to be presented.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de VS Nederland zou willen helpen Syriëgangers terug te halen

An MP asked the government whether the US offered to help repatriate Dutch Syria travellers and why the Netherlands does not actively retrieve them. The ministers confirmed a US offer (including help with transport of 10 Dutch women and children) but said the Netherlands did not accept it, citing remaining risks and existing policy.
The Netherlands has not accepted the offer.
Nederland heeft het aanbod niet aanvaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Oeigoeren in Europese landen worden onder druk gezet door de Chinese overheid’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether reports that Uyghurs in Europe, including the Netherlands, are pressured and intimidated by Chinese authorities are true, and what protection, asylum figures, extradition practice and diplomatic action exist. The government confirms that such pressure is reported and calls unwanted foreign interference unacceptable, lists available protective tools and recent diplomatic efforts, but gives no statistics on Uyghur asylum applications (sensitive data) and no concrete new action.
Therefore this data is not registered in a way that makes it possible to generate an answer to this question from the automated information systems of the migration chain.
Daarom worden deze gegevens niet geregistreerd op een manier die het mogelijk maakt om een antwoord op deze vraag te genereren vanuit de geautomatiseerde informatiesystemen van de migratieketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Oekraïne laat belangrijke MH17 verdachte vrij”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Dam asked whether an MH17 suspect released by a Ukrainian court could still be held available for the Dutch investigation and what the government had done to prevent his release and transfer in a prisoner exchange. The minister answered that the Ukrainian court released him in an unrelated case, that diplomatic efforts were made at the highest level, and that after the exchange the Public Prosecution Service requested his detention with a view to extradition from Russia.
The Dutch Public Prosecution Service has indicated it wants Mr Tsemach kept available for the investigation into the downing of flight MH17.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft aangegeven de heer Tsemach beschikbaar te willen houden voor het onderzoek naar het neerhalen van vlucht MH17.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Palestinian Authority Bans Activities by Gay Rights Group’

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Palestinian Authority banned activities of an LGBTI rights group and threatened arrests, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister condemned the restrictions as unacceptable, said the Dutch representative in Ramallah had raised the issue directly, and noted ongoing talks with the group about further support.
The cabinet finds this worrying and unacceptable.
Het kabinet vindt dit zorgelijk en niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een bijdrage aan een veiligheidsmechanisme voor Noordoost-Syrië

An MP (D66) asked the Foreign Minister whether the US request underlying a Dutch contribution to a security mechanism for northeast Syria includes asking the Netherlands to repatriate Dutch nationals who fought in Syria. The minister answered yes, and gave the answer quickly.

Is the part of the American request underlying your notification letter of 21 June 2019 about a contribution to a security mechanism for northeast Syria that asks the Netherlands to take back Syria fighters of Dutch nationality?

Is het onderdeel van het Amerikaanse verzoek dat ten grondslag ligt aan uw notificatiebrief d.d. 21 juni 2019 over een bijdrage aan een veiligheidsmechanisme voor Noordoost-Syrië, dat Nederland wordt verzocht Syrië-strijders van Nederlandse nationaliteit terug te halen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Nederlander in buitenland moet op pad voor extra check DigiD’

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether DigiD two-step verification is safe and why Dutch citizens abroad must collect an activation code at a counter in person, often far away, and whether this is acceptable. The State Secretary defends two-step verification as safer, explains the face-to-face requirement as necessary for reliable identity checks, and promises to explore improvements such as more counters and NFC-based activation from the second half of 2020.
I recognise and regret that for some Dutch citizens living abroad who want or need a DigiD this causes inconvenience and that they experience it as a problem.
Ik realiseer mij en betreur dat dit voor een deel van de Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen en een DigiD willen of moeten hebben tot ongemak leidt en dat zij dit als een probleem ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de berichtgeving over dubbele petten van Verhagen

An MP asked whether former minister Verhagen was paid twice for overlapping work, as a Limburg province ambassador advising firms on JSF/F-35 contracts and as the state's special representative for F-35 industrial participation. The state secretary answered that the two mandates differ in nature, the Limburg role carries a fixed fee with no individual billing, and no double payment is evident, with coordination and reporting safeguards in place.
There is no question of individual advice.
Er is geen sprake van individuele adviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Berucht Chinees veiligheidsministerie gebruikt Nederlandse software die emoties leest'

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch firms supplied emotion-recognition software to Chinese public security bodies, whether such software and surveillance enable abuses in China, and whether export controls on cyber-surveillance technology should be tightened. The minister confirmed one joint delivery by two Dutch firms, acknowledged serious rights risks, said Dutch export controls cover certain cyber-surveillance goods but not facial or emotion recognition, and reported that the EU dual-use revision failed to include cyber-surveillance controls, which the Netherlands continues to support.
The Netherlands will work to ensure the subject remains on the agenda in the future.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inzetten dat het onderwerp in de toekomst op de agenda blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de brief van de minister van Justitie en Veiligheid 'Zaak Julio Poch'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the handling of the Julio Poch case, including whether travel reports from 2008 would be published and whether discussions about extradition to Argentina preceded Argentine investigation. The Minister answered that the May 2008 travel report was released to an independent investigator (Machielse) and promised to inform Parliament of his findings, while maintaining that the discussions were exploratory and not improper.
I have provided the travel report to Mr. Machielse for his investigation and informed your House about it.
Ik heb het reisverslag ten behoeve van zijn onderzoek aan dhr. Machielse verstrekt en uw Kamer erover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over hoe de sterke zekerheidsrechtelijke positie van banken alternatieve financiers belemmert

MPs Sneller, Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether banks' strong security positions in bankruptcy and the ban on pledging assets hinder alternative lenders, and whether the government will investigate, legislate or address this in the bankruptcy law revision. The minister answered that a study of Dutch financing practice will be commissioned, that the bankruptcy law revision is examining secured creditors' position, and that the bill to lift pledging bans will go to the Council of State shortly after the summer recess.
We are willing to commission a study into this, which will also address collateral provision in SME financing, in view of the motion adopted by your House on 18 June.

Wij zijn bereid om een opdracht tot een onderzoek daarnaar te geven, waarbij tevens, mede gelet op de op 18 juni door Uw Kamer aangenomen motie, 2 de zekerheidsstelling bij MKB-financiering aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse burgers die de dupe zijn van Amerikaanse regelgeving

D66 MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would press the US for a solution for Dutch citizens who are also US citizens ('Accidental Americans') harmed by FATCA, including whether banks may refuse basic payment accounts when no US SSN is held, and whether a coordinated European approach would be pursued. State Secretary Snel answered that the issue is high on the government's agenda, that a missing US TIN/SSN is not a valid ground to refuse a basic payment account, and that Netherlands is seeking a coordinated European action, with a follow-up letter promised after the summer.
The cabinet will continue to work on behalf of this group of people.
Het kabinet zal zich blijven inzetten voor deze groep mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Islamisten én overheid jagen op Pakistaanse feministe’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Pakistani security services and Islamists are pursuing activist Gulalai Ismail, and whether the government will raise her case and human rights concerns with Pakistan and in multilateral fora. The minister said her whereabouts are unclear, that the government raised her case and wider human rights concerns with Pakistan's foreign minister, and that she could qualify for the Shelter Cities programme if she wishes.

In that conversation, the Netherlands raised concerns about the situation of Gulalai Ismail, the suppression of the Pashtun Tahafuzz Movement, detained members of parliament and the situation of human rights defenders.

In dat gesprek werden onder meer door Nederland de zorgen over de situatie van Gulalai Ismail, de onderdrukking van de Pashtun Tahafuzz Movement (PTM), gearresteerde leden van het parlement en de situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “NAVO verklapt slechtst bewaarde geheim van Nederland: kernbommen in Volkel”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report claiming US nuclear weapons are stored at Volkel and whether NATO's rules on nuclear transparency are breached. The minister replied that the report is not an official NATO document, that NATO rules permit only confirming the presence of US nuclear weapons in Europe without figures or locations, and that the government will keep pushing for more nuclear transparency within NATO.
However, no statements can be made about numbers and specific locations.
Er kunnen evenwel geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en specifieke locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het Rapport van de Special Rapporteur on extrajudicial, summary or arbitrary executions: Investigation into the unlawful death of Mr. Jamal Khashoggi

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Special Rapporteur's report finding Khashoggi's killing a premeditated extrajudicial execution attributable to Saudi Arabia, and about recommendations on accountability, press safety, surveillance exports and targeted sanctions. The minister acknowledged the report's seriousness, urged Saudi cooperation and further investigation, said sanctions currently lack the needed broad support, and listed bilateral and multilateral follow-up steps.
For this reason the Netherlands and the EU continue to call on Saudi Arabia to fully cooperate with all investigations and to make all information about the case available.
Nederland en de EU blijven daarom Saoedi-Arabië oproepen om volledige medewerking te verlenen aan alle onderzoeken en om alle informatie over de zaak beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland

MPs from CDA, D66 and SP asked whether Dutch detainees abroad can receive legal aid from the Netherlands, how subsidies for detainee support were distributed, and whether DutchAdvocates refuses or redirects cases and pressures former PrisonLAW clients. The minister replied that legal aid is primarily the detainee's own responsibility with local lawyers, that subsidy was transferred to DutchAdvocates from 2019 with PrisonLAW's agreement, that clients are free to choose their lawyer, and that no misconduct exists.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over een gelijk speelveld voor alternatieve kredietverleners en banken bij de financiering van het midden- en kleinbedrijf

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked about the level playing field between banks and alternative lenders in financing SMEs, including differing SME definitions, the professionalisation of alternative lenders, implementation of a motion, and why certain subsidy schemes channel funds only through banks. The government replied that bank financing remains dominant but non-bank finance is growing, that a study on SME financing is underway with a report expected in the second half of the year, and that schemes will be reviewed for level-playing-field effects.
What matters is that SMEs have a sufficiently diverse financing landscape available that meets their legitimate credit needs.
Van belang is dat mkb'ers een voldoende divers financieringslandschap ter beschikking staat dat voorziet in hun legitieme kredietbehoeften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over lange rijen bij de Roemeense stembureaus in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether too few voting locations were provided for Romanian citizens in the Netherlands, causing long queues and a disturbance at the Hague embassy during the 2019 EP and referendum votes, and whether the government would raise this with Romania. The minister answered that Romanian authorities are responsible, that the Netherlands raised its dissatisfaction with the ambassador and Romanian counterpart, and that Romania promised improvements, so no EU-level agenda item is needed.
The Romanian authorities must in future ensure sufficient capacity, polling stations and staff so that every citizen who wishes to vote can do so.
De Roemeense autoriteiten dienen in het vervolg te zorgen voor voldoende capaciteit, stemlocaties en personeel, zodat iedere burger die dat wil kan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Nederlanders in het Verenigd Koninkrijk worden geweerd bij de stembureaus

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch citizens in the UK were turned away from polling stations in the 2019 European elections due to registration problems, and whether this was unacceptable and would be raised with the UK. The minister confirmed the reports, said elections are a UK responsibility, noted the UK Electoral Commission's review, and said the government would raise the concern in upcoming talks with the UK.
Nevertheless, the Dutch government will appropriately draw attention to the concerns of Dutch citizens in the UK regarding their participation in the British European elections.
Desalniettemin zal de Nederlandse regering op gepaste wijze aandacht vragen voor de zorgen van de Nederlandse burgers in het VK
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Police Can’t  Guarantee Pride Safety Outdoors - Ministry’

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Georgian police could not guarantee security for the Tbilisi Pride march, and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns and have diplomats join the march. The minister confirmed the concerns were raised with the Georgian foreign minister and that the embassy is in close contact with authorities, and said diplomats would be willing to participate.
The Dutch ambassador in Tbilisi has already conveyed my concerns about the security of the planned Pride march at political level.
De Nederlandse ambassadeur in Tbilisi heeft mijn zorgen rondom de beveiliging van de geplande Pride-optocht inmiddels op politiek niveau overgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VN: 1.500 migranten in levensgevaar in Libië’

Four MPs asked the government about reports that about 1,500 migrants held in detention centres south of Tripoli were in danger from fighting, and about the evacuation of detainees, reports of forced participation in the conflict, and possible Dutch action. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is following the situation closely, supports UNHCR and IOM evacuations and resettlement via the Emergency Transit Mechanism, is considering additional funding, and says forced use of civilians in fighting would violate international humanitarian law, while the forced-participation reports were not confirmed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over Koninklijke onderscheidingen aan buitenlandse staatshoofden

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked whether royal Dutch honours given to foreign heads of state can be inappropriate when controversy or human rights violations are involved, and whether revocation grounds should be widened. The minister listed nine heads of state honoured in the past five years, said honours are a diplomatic instrument, opposed widening revocation grounds, and was willing to have the standard practice evaluated.
I am of the view that broadening the revocation grounds for honours will not contribute to a better substantive discussion with the country concerned about respecting international law.

Ik ben van mening dat het verruimen van intrekkingsgronden van onderscheidingen niet zal bijdragen aan een betere inhoudelijke discussie met het betrokken land over het respecteren van het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘RIVM scherpt vaccinatieadvies mazelen aan’

MPs Raemakers, Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked about RIVM's measles vaccination advice for infants travelling to high-risk countries and whether the Foreign Ministry should adjust its travel advice accordingly. The minister answered that the advice is updated annually based on WHO data, and that the Foreign Ministry defers health information to the national travel health centre (LCR) by linking to it rather than copying the measles guidance, while examining automatic integration.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel App.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Sjoerdsma over het aanpassen van reisadviezen naar aanleiding van de uitbraak van mazelen in een Haagse kinderopvang

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Affairs Minister why travel advice does not specifically warn of measles risk in Europe and whether it should be updated, as the GGD does. The minister replied that travel advice links directly to the LCR's current health information, which covers measles, and that the ministry is not the health authority and will not copy changing health advice into its advice.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel app.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat in 2017 Nederland bijstand verleende aan Nederlandse uitreizigers in Syrië

An MP asked whether Dutch diplomats in 2016-2017 sought to retrieve Dutch jihadist travellers from Syria via the Free Syrian Army and Turkey, and how this squares with earlier answers denying any assistance policy. The minister answers that contacts were limited to verifying identity and location of four cases in non-combat areas at family request, that no retrieval was requested, and that the policy on not assisting travellers inside the combat zone was unchanged, though the answers did not disclose the 2016 internal policy note and the earlier answer's omissions are acknowledged in part.
It is not customary to share internal policy views with the House, such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs memorandum referred to in the NOS article.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om interne beleidsopvattingen met de Kamer te delen, zoals de nota van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken waaraan het NOS-artikel refereert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht dat in Brunei nieuwe shariawetten zijn ingevoerd

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about Brunei's new Sharia penal code, including stoning for same-sex relations, Dutch diplomatic response, and whether the sultan's Dutch royal honour should be revoked. The minister condemned the measures, cited diplomatic efforts and the sultan's announced moratorium and UNCAT ratification, but declined to revoke the honour, stating the law only permits revocation after a one-year prison sentence and that broadening revocation grounds would not help dialogue.
Under the law, a decoration can only be revoked if the decorated person has been sentenced to a final prison term of at least one year.
Volgens de wetgeving kan een onderscheiding alleen worden ingetrokken als de gedecoreerde persoon veroordeeld is tot een onherroepelijke gevangenisstraf van minimaal één jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel 'MKB-Nederland: Grote bedrijven betalen facturen nog steeds te laat'

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about large companies paying SME invoices late, the effects on small firms, and whether the statutory payment term should be cut to 30 days. The state secretary called the trend worrying, said the reasons are unknown, and promised an evaluation of the late-payment law with results in September and possible tightening afterwards.
This will also make clear whether the statutory payment term should be tightened to 30 days.
Daarmee wordt ook duidelijk of de wettelijke betaaltermijn moet worden aangescherpt naar 30 dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Saoedi-Arabië executeert 37 gevangenen om terrorisme’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Saudi Arabia's execution of 37 prisoners convicted of terrorism, including the use of the 2014 counterterrorism law against activists and critics, and whether sanctions were considered. The minister condemned the executions, said Nederland opposes the death penalty and raised concerns in EU and UN settings, but stated that sanctions lack the required international political consensus and gave no concrete new measures.
Imposing sanctions requires broad international political agreement.
Voor het instellen van sancties is internationaal brede politieke overeenstemming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over verschillende reisadviezen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked whether EU member states issue differing travel advice for the same countries, whether a single European travel advice is desirable, and what Netherlands has done to harmonise. The minister agrees a single European advice is desirable and says the main obstacles are national competence, differing formats and procedures, and timing, while describing consular cooperation efforts and promising continued advocacy.
I am willing to keep emphasising the importance of unified travel advice within the EU.
Ik ben bereid het belang van eensgezinde reisadviezen verder te blijven benadrukken binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het Rode Kruis Venezuela mag betreden met hulpgoederen

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knows that the Red Cross received permission from Maduro to deliver emergency aid to Venezuela, and about shortages of medicine and food, the scale of the operation and Dutch funding. Minister Kaag confirmed the crisis and noted that Dutch contributions since 2018 total over EUR 1.6 million, with an additional EUR 2 million, while stressing that aid must be neutral and reach those most in need.
The Netherlands has contributed at various moments over the past year to Red Cross relief efforts in Venezuela and the region.
Nederland heeft het afgelopen jaar op verschillende momenten bijgedragen aan de hulpverlening van het Rode Kruis in Venezuela en de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Saudi intervention team targeting dissidents, Saudi human rights abuses, detention conditions and the arrest of women's rights activists. The minister could not confirm the intervention team, said Dutch concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally including a joint UN statement, and noted that embassy access to trials had been refused four times.
I cannot provide any information on the exact content of these contacts with partners.
Over de exacte inhoud van deze contacten met partners kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over een oppositieleider die vastzit in een Tadzjiekse gevangenis

MPs from D66 asked the government about opposition leader Gadojev, detained in Tajikistan after apparently being arrested in Russia, and whether Interpol listings are being misused against political critics. The government replied that Gadojev returned to the Netherlands with consular help via the German embassy, that Interpol's rules forbid political interventions but full guarantees cannot be given, and that human rights are raised regularly in bilateral and multilateral settings.
However, I cannot speculate on the circumstances in individual cases listed on the Interpol list.
Ik kan echter niet speculeren over de toedracht in individuele casussen die op de Interpol-lijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma en Van Weyenberg over vrouwelijke ondernemers

D66 MPs asked why so few start-ups led by women receive investment, whether women face harder access to credit, and what government will do about it. The ministers answered that the gap is a real underuse of talent, that causes include bias and stereotypes, that no data yet exist on credit applications by women, and that they will commission research, host a roundtable follow-up and seek SER advice on diversity.
We will consider how and within what timeframe such research will take place.
We zullen bezien op welke wijze en welke termijn een dergelijk onderzoek plaats zal vinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over nieuw onderzoek in de zaak-Poch

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about new investigation into the Poch case, including whether earlier unanswered questions would be addressed. The Minister answered that former Advocate-General Machielse has been asked to conduct an independent inquiry with a broad mandate covering ministerial involvement, reasons for the Argentina decision and contacts with foreign authorities, but gave no timeline for its outcome.
I will forward the answers to both sets of questions to Mr Machielse.
Ik zal de beantwoording van beide sets vragen doen toekomen aan de heer Machielse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Sjoerdsma over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked why a person born in East Jerusalem is registered in the Basisregistratie Personen as born in Israel, and whether the government will change the system. The Staatssecretaris explains that the Landentabel only allows recognised states and territories, that the government will amend the table to add 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for births from 15 May 1948 onward, and admits the earlier 2014 option of 'Onbekend' was a policy choice.

I intend to amend the Landentabel (table 34) and include the designation 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for persons born in those areas from 15 May 1948 onward.

Ik ben voornemens de Landentabel (tabel 34) te wijzigen en de benaming «Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem» daarin op te nemen voor personen die vanaf 15 mei 1948 in die gebieden zijn geboren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van recente ontwikkelingen in de verhouding tussen Nederland en Iran voor het Nederlandse asielbeleid ten aanzien van Iran

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how recent tensions with Iran, including reported Iranian involvement in killings in the Netherlands, affect Dutch asylum policy on Iran, including asylum numbers, risk groups and the Ahwazi. The State Secretary answered with asylum statistics, said the policy rests on the 2017 general country report and the individual assessment, and saw no reason to change the Iran country policy now.
I expect that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will publish the new general country report on Iran in the spring.
Ik verwacht dat het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in het voorjaar het nieuwe algemeen ambtsbericht over Iran publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma (D66) aan de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid over nieuwe bevindingen in de zaak-Poch (ingezonden 28 november 2018).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether former minister Hirsch Ballin intervened in the criminal investigation into Poch, whether any written record exists, why the case was not prosecuted in the Netherlands, and how the Dutch state ensured sufficient evidence before cooperating with Argentina's extradition. The minister declined to answer the detailed questions because Poch has initiated legal proceedings against the state, referring instead to earlier letters and a letter sent alongside the answer.

I think restraint is appropriate in answering detailed questions about the course of the investigation into and prosecution of Mr Poch, now that he has chosen to take the State to court on this matter.

Mij past terughoudendheid bij het antwoorden op detailvragen betreffende de gang van zaken van het onderzoek naar en de vervolging van de heer Poch, nu hij ervoor heeft gekozen de Staat hieromtrent in rechte te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Den Boer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat een Rus waarschijnlijk de nieuwe baas van Interpol wordt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Den Boer and Van Toorenburg asked whether Russian candidate Alexander Prokopchuk would become Interpol president, whether the Netherlands would vote against him, and whether he was linked to politically motivated Red Notices against Kremlin critics. The Minister answered that Mr Kim was elected president on 21 November 2018, that Red Notice procedures are bound by Interpol's constitution, and that the questions arrived after the vote.
These questions reached me after the election of Mr KIM as the new president of the INTERPOL Executive Committee.
Deze vragen hebben mij bereikt na afloop van de verkiezing van de heer KIM als nieuwe president van het INTERPOL Executief Comité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht Saudi Arabia Allegedly Tortured Women’s Rights Activists Before Khashoggi Murder

MPs Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked whether the government knows of reports that Saudi Arabia detained eight women's rights activists for exercising free expression and allegedly tortured them, and what it will do, bilaterally, in the EU and with partners, to condemn this and seek release. The minister replied that the Netherlands raised concerns with the Saudi ambassador, in multilateral fora and through EU channels, promoted a formal EU-Saudi human rights dialogue, and works with the embassy to gather information, while weighing public versus quiet diplomacy case by case.
The Netherlands, together with partners, weighs case by case what degree of public attention is most effective, with the wishes of the persons concerned or their families being decisive.
Nederland maakt samen met partners per geval de afweging welke mate van publieke aandacht het meest effectief is, waarbij de wensen van de betrokkenen zelf, of hun families, leidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Gaddafi verdween, maar Damen bleef geliefd in Libië'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether eight Damen Stan Patrol patrol boats exported to Libya in 2013 should be classed as military goods, given mounting points that could carry heavy machine guns. The minister replied that the boats fall outside the EU military list, that the mounts are generic and not designed for 12.7 mm weapons, and that Damen now must consult the ministry before supplying unarmed patrol boats to Libya.
Since Damen is abiding by the agreement, there is no need for this.
Aangezien Damen zich aan de afspraak houdt, bestaat hier geen noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Trump administration wants to remove 'gender' from UN human rights documents’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked the government about reports that the Trump administration sought to replace the term 'gender' with 'woman' in UN human rights documents, and the implications for transgender and intersex people's legal protection. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes these US amendments as weakening gender equality commitments, that hundreds of UN and EU texts with gender language remain in force, and that Dutch protections for trans and intersex persons are not affected.
The Netherlands is working in international fora to ensure that progress made is not reversed and that agreed language is retained.
Nederland zet zich binnen internationale fora ervoor in te zorgen dat de geboekte vooruitgang niet wordt teruggedraaid en agreed language behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van Radar over zzp’ers en acquisitiefraude

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Radar broadcast on aggressive energy-contract sales to self-employed entrepreneurs, including whether the Chamber of Commerce facilitates unsolicited telemarketing by openly distributing business contact data, how privacy will be better protected, and whether the ACM should get more powers. The State Secretary says the register's openness serves legal certainty, that a balanced set of measures on direct marketing is being prepared, and that expanding ACM powers is not the solution; he declines to answer question 8 on timing.
I am considering balanced measures that limit unwanted direct marketing using trade register data while still safeguarding the openness of the trade register for its legal purposes.

Ik beraad mij op evenwichtige maatregelen die ongewenste direct marketing met handelsregistergegevens beperkt, en tegelijk de openbaarheid van het handelsregister ten behoeve van haar wettelijke doelen borgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het akkoord met Venezuela

MPs Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands' border agreement with Venezuela, signed with Vice-President El Aissami despite planned EU sanctions against him, was properly prepared and justified given alleged human rights abuses. The minister answered that the agreement was in the Kingdom's interest, that Venezuela's signatory was Vice-President Soteldo, that the EU sanctions process was separate, and declined to link the agreement to the sanctions or to human rights concerns.
The agreement was in the interest of the Kingdom.
Het akkoord was in het belang van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over het bericht dat PrisonLaw breekt met Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about PrisonLaw's decision to end its subsidy relationship, alleged pressure on the organisation over publicity, and consular assistance shortcomings for detainees abroad. The minister denied the portrayal, said the ministry and PrisonLaw are negotiating an orderly early termination, and largely referred to earlier letters while declining to share the internal integrity investigation in detail.
Because of the legal requirements on personal data protection, the investigation and handling of the complaint are confidential.
Vanwege de wettelijke eisen die worden gesteld aan persoonsgegevensbescherming zijn het onderzoek en de afhandeling van de klacht vertrouwelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat mensenrechtenactivist Gulalai Ismail werd gearresteerd door de Pakistaanse FIA (Federal Investigation Authority) toen ze het land herintrad vanuit het Verenig

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about activist Gulalai Ismail's arrest on return to Pakistan, her withheld passport and exit ban, and whether the government would act to restore her rights. The minister confirmed the case, explained that Pakistani authorities opened an investigation and that exit-control rules apply, and said the Netherlands raises human rights defenders' protection bilaterally and in the EU without interfering in Pakistan's judicial process.
The Netherlands bilaterally and within the EU works to protect human rights defenders in Pakistan.
Nederland zet zich bilateraal en in EU verband in voor bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Pakistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Raemakers over het vergoeden van de hersteloperatie na vrouwelijke genitale mutilatie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Raemakers asked the Minister of Medical Care whether female genital mutilation reconstructive surgery should be covered by the basic health insurance, given earlier promises of a working group and a draft guideline. The minister answered that evidence on effectiveness is too uncertain to include reconstruction in the basic package, that the new guideline does not address reimbursement, and that the health institute will advise once the guideline is authorised.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to carry out the necessary procedure quickly.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut verzoeken om de hiervoor noodzakelijke procedure snel uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat een Nederlandse consul voor het redden van duizenden Joden een reprimande van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kreeg

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that consul Jan Zwartendijk was reprimanded by the ministry for helping save thousands of Jews, and whether the minister would apologise to his relatives. The minister said the reprimand, if it occurred, was wholly inappropriate, that apologies are due, and that the secretary-general had written to the family to that effect.
Jan Zwartendijk did not deserve a reprimand such as the one Jan Brokken assumes in his book was given in 1964.
Jan Zwartendijk verdiende geen reprimande zoals die naar de veronderstelling van Jan Brokken in zijn boek heeft plaatsgevonden in 1964.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Den Boer over het uitzonderen van Nederlanders in het buitenland bij het kiezen van de Eerste Kamer

MPs Sjoerdsma and Den Boer asked why Dutch citizens living abroad have no say in electing the Eerste Kamer, given the coalition agreement's commitment to easier voting rights including for the Eerste Kamer. The minister replied that options for giving overseas Dutch citizens influence will be mapped and presented to parliament in spring 2019, and that the BES islands will vote for their own electoral college on 20 March 2019.
In my letter of 15 October 2018 I informed your House that in the coming months I will map out the options for giving Dutch citizens living abroad influence over the composition of the Eerste Kamer.

In mijn brief van 15 oktober 2018 heb ik uw Kamer meegedeeld dat ik in de komende maanden de opties in kaart ga brengen om Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen invloed te geven op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over terugkeer van Nederlandse vrouwen en minderjarige kinderen in slechte gezondheid in IS-gebied

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether the prosecution service asked Kurdish authorities to release three Dutch women from camps for prosecution in the Netherlands, whether returns of women and children are being actively pursued, and whether consular assistance and cooperation with Kurdish authorities will be offered. The minister answers that the government does not actively pursue return of adult travellers and their children, that arrest warrants were handed to Kurdish representatives without response, and that the government considers no obligation under the CRC to repatriate the children.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult travellers and their minor children.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van het inreisverbod van de Verenigde Staten voor werknemers van ASML

The MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the US travel ban affects ASML and other Dutch employees, whether the government will raise it with US authorities, and whether it was raised in preclearance talks at Schiphol. The minister replied that the US is sovereign over admissions, that the ministry will try to mediate if companies report problems, and that the Dutch preclearance position is conditioned on compatibility with Dutch, European and international law.
The United States, like all other countries, is sovereign in determining who it admits to its territory, subject to its international legal obligations.
De Verenigde Staten zijn, net als alle andere landen, met inachtneming van hun internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen, soeverein in het bepalen wie zij toelaten tot hun grondgebied.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de voorbereiding van voorstellen ter modernisering van het nationaliteitsrecht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security what has been done to prepare modernising Dutch nationality law, including allowing multiple nationalities, whether Dutch nationals in the UK can benefit given Brexit, and why Dutch emigrants who unknowingly lost nationality are not offered restoration. The State Secretary answered that a bill is in preparation pending a CJEU ruling, that UK-based Dutch citizens are informed through embassy channels without a fast-track change, and that the government will not add a special option regime beyond the existing rules.
A bill to that end is currently being prepared.
Een wetsvoorstel daartoe is op dit moment in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de toekenning van de mensenrechtentulp aan Zeid Ra’ad Al Hussein

MPs Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked why the Dutch human rights award was given to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein despite whistleblower allegations of cover-ups, and whether he would apologise to whistleblowers Reilly and Kompass. The minister answered that the one-off award honoured his record defending human rights defenders, that no independent committee was involved, that the whistleblower cases were handled by UN bodies with proceedings still pending, and that the government will not ask him to apologise.
No independent committee was involved in the decision-making on the award.
Bij de besluitvorming rond de toekenning was geen onafhankelijke commissie betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van Dam over de Amerikaanse steun voor het Joint Investigation Team (JIT) onderzoek naar de daders van MH17

MPs from VVD, CU, D66 and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US State Department went silent or softened its MH17 statement after the Trump-Putin summit, and whether MH17 was discussed there. The minister replied that the US fully supports the JIT and the Dutch approach, reaffirmed in the G7 statement of 16 July, while declining to share confidential allied information and calling Russia's criticism unfounded.
As the House is aware, on the basis of alliance agreements no statements can be made about information confidentially shared by allies.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over door bondgenoten vertrouwelijk gedeelde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de president van het Venezolaanse Hooggerechtshof in Nederland was

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the president of Venezuela's Supreme Court, Maikel Moreno, who is on the EU sanctions list, was allowed to attend the 20th anniversary of the Rome Statute in The Hague. The minister confirmed the visit, said Venezuela designated him as its representative, and explained that the ICC requested an exemption and the Zetelverdrag obliged the Netherlands to grant access, while stating that sanctions would be upheld and he could only attend ICC-organised activities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs explicitly told the Venezuelan authorities that it would enforce the sanctions and that Mr Moreno could only take part in activities organised by the Court.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft in contact met de Venezolaanse autoriteiten uitdrukkelijk aangegeven de sancties te zullen handhaven en dat de heer Moreno alleen kon deelnemen aan activiteiten die door het Strafhof werden georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het scheiden van ouders en kinderen door Amerikaanse grensbewakers aan de grens tussen de VS en Mexico

MPs Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister whether US border separation of children from parents is compatible with international treaties and whether he would ask the US ambassador for clarification. The minister expressed concern, said the Refugee Convention does not apply, noted the US is not party to the Children's Rights Convention, and said Dutch concerns were conveyed diplomatically while awaiting the outcome of the US debate and court proceedings.
That is how it should be in a democratic constitutional state. We are awaiting the outcome of the discussion.
Zo hoort dat in een democratische rechtsstaat. De uitkomst van de discussie wachten we af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Syrië komende maand voorzitter is van de VN-Conferentie over Ontwapening

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Syria's rotating presidency of the UN Conference on Disarmament, given the regime's use of chemical weapons, undermines UN credibility and whether the Netherlands would raise objections with the UN Secretary-General. The minister agreed Syria lacks moral authority, said the Netherlands has reduced its representation and will leave sessions if Syria misuses the chair, but declined to raise the matter with the Secretary-General because the Conference is autonomous.
The Netherlands will immediately leave the meetings when Syria uses its chairmanship position politically.
Nederland zal de vergaderingen terstond verlaten wanneer Syrië in voorzitterscapaciteit zijn positie politiek aanwendt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Israël Nederlandse projecten op de Westelijke Jordaanoever sloopt

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked whether Israel demolished Dutch-funded water systems on the West Bank, whether Israel was consulted, and what steps the government took, including on compensation and EU-funded project demolitions. The minister confirms the demolitions, says Nederland was not consulted, protested at official level and sought compensation (refused by Israel), and reports about 326 EU-assisted structures and roughly 38,600 euro of Dutch damage demolished since 2015, while condemning demolitions under occupation law.
The Netherlands and the EU consistently and at various levels make clear objections to the Israeli authorities against demolition of Palestinian property.
Nederland en de EU maken consequent en op verschillende niveaus de bezwaren duidelijk bij de Israëlische autoriteiten tegen sloop van Palestijnse bezittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van EenVandaag 'Meer homogeweld en veel zaken komen niet bij Openbaar Ministerie terecht'

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked the Justice Minister about an EenVandaag report on rising anti-gay violence and low prosecution of such cases, requesting report and prosecution figures for 2016 and 2017. The minister answered with police, ADV, CRM and OM figures, rejected the claim of an increase in anti-gay violence, but acknowledged low reporting willingness and committed to contributing to an action plan against violence towards LHBTI people.
From the police and Public Prosecution Service reports on discrimination, it cannot be concluded that there is an increase in anti-gay violence, as EenVandaag claims.
Uit de rapportages van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over discriminatie kan niet worden afgeleid dat er sprake is van een toename van homogeweld, zoals EenVandaag stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de resultaten van de topambtenaar van PvdA-huize

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the foreign minister about the results of a 'counter-thinking strategist' (scholar in residence) appointed for one year, including the advice produced and whether other ministries should adopt the role. Minister Blok answered that the scholar advised on various policy themes, commented on draft policy notes and gave lectures, and that the role is useful and worth repeating.
