He has given strategic advice on various themes, for example globalisation, populism, European cooperation, support for foreign policy and internal organisation.
Hij heeft strategische adviezen over uiteenlopende thema's gegeven, bijvoorbeeld over globalisering, populisme, Europese samenwerking, draagvlak voor buitenlands beleid en interne organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de strijd tegen corruptie in Oekraïne

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the installation of wiretapping equipment by Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau NABU in the office of the special anti-corruption prosecutor and about threats to Ukraine's anti-corruption institutions. The minister answered that Nederland raises anti-corruption reform bilaterally and multilaterally, that Ukraine itself must prevent damage to its institutions, and that EU macro-financial aid conditions include a special anti-corruption high court.
I do not have sufficient information to form a judgement on this measure.
Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om een oordeel te vellen over deze maatregel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over financiering van Nederlandse islamitische instellingen vanuit de Golfstaten

MPs Segers, Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked the ministers about Gulf state financing of Dutch Islamic institutions, including why the ministry withheld information from RAND researchers and from municipalities, and why Saudi and Kuwaiti information was kept confidential. The minister answered that the ministry fully cooperated with RAND, that the information was shared with other government bodies and municipalities, that the Saudi MoU would not be published at Saudi request, and that the government is exploring legal measures on transparency of funding flows.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to the best of its knowledge and belief, provided full cooperation to RAND during the research at the end of 2014 so that it could conduct research in complete freedom.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft naar eer en geweten tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek eind 2014 volledige medewerking verleend aan RAND om in alle vrijheid onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Van Dam en Voordewind over de persconferentie van het JIT over de ramp met MH17

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the JIT press conference on MH17, in particular Russia's failure to share information on the Buk missile's origin and whether Russia breaches UN resolution 2166. The minister agreed that the Buk belonged to the Russian military, that Russia must cooperate fully, and that he raised the matter in the UN Security Council.
In the Security Council I called on Russia to take its responsibility, to engage with Australia and the Netherlands on this, and to cooperate fully as demanded by UN Security Council Resolution 2166.

In de Veiligheidsraad heb ik Rusland opgeroepen zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, met Australië en Nederland daarover in gesprek te gaan en volledig mee te werken zoals wordt geëist door VNVR-resolutie 2166.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de VN coördinaten van Syrische ziekenhuizen doorgeeft aan Rusland

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about reports that UN OCHA shared coordinates of Syrian hospitals with Russia and Syria's narrative and programming in the 2016 Humanitarian Response Plan were adjusted at the regime's request. The minister answered that the deconfliction mechanism is voluntary, offers no guarantees, that Netherlands has no insight into onward sharing by Russia, and that it has urged the UN to share its investigation results quickly.
The Netherlands has no insight into the extent to which, or whether, the Russian government shares information with third parties.
Nederland heeft geen zicht op de mate waarin en of de Russische overheid informatie deelt met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bouali over voortdurende demonstraties in Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bouali asked the ministers about protests in Morocco, including police violence and arrests in Jerada and the Rif, and whether the government would raise these with Morocco. The ministers answered that violence and arrests had occurred, that the Dutch embassy and ministers have raised freedom of assembly and fair trial concerns with Moroccan authorities, and that Dutch programmes support socio-economic development in the north.
The right to peaceful demonstration is laid down in international human rights treaties and in the Moroccan Constitution.
Het recht op vreedzaam demonstreren is vastgelegd in internationale mensenrechtenverdragen en in de Marokkaanse Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht “U-bocht in zaak Poch”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked about Dutch police and prosecution contacts with Argentine judicial authorities in the Poch case, including an unofficial 2008 trip and the role of intermediaries. The minister answered that two working visits took place in 2008 under the Dutch investigation, with knowledge of both states, that no minutes of the talks exist, and that such exploratory contacts are not unusual in complex cases.
I do not have records of these conversations.
Ik beschik niet over verslaglegging van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de consulaire problemen die Venezolanen in Nederland ondervinden

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Venezuela's refusal to issue or renew passports at its Hague embassy, which affects Venezuelans in the Netherlands, and how the government would address the consequences. The minister confirmed the problem, said Venezuela is responsible for passport issuance, and described temporary IND arrangements that waive the passport requirement for some residence procedures.
The IND offers the following two temporary solutions to Venezuelan citizens in the Netherlands who have difficulty identifying themselves with a valid national passport.
De IND biedt de volgende twee, tijdelijke, oplossingen aan Venezolaanse burgers in Nederland die problemen hebben om zich te identificeren met een geldig nationaal paspoort
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de door Egypte geëiste doodstraf tegen fotojournalist Shawkan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death penalty sought in Egypt against photojournalist Shawkan, whether the trial was fair, and whether EU and Dutch aid to Egypt is appropriate given press repression. The minister agreed the penalty is disproportionate, said the Netherlands monitors the trial with partners and raises concerns in dialogue, and defended continued aid as conditional on monitoring and not contributing to repression.
The Netherlands, together with Germany, has worked to monitor this case within the EU framework.
Nederland heeft zich samen met Duitsland ingezet om deze zaak in EU-verband te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Ten Broeke over het betrekken van Nederlanders in het buitenland bij de verbetering van het postennetwerk en consulaire dienstverlening

MPs Sjoerdsma and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister how the government will strengthen the diplomatic network and consular services, whether it will actively involve the Dutch abroad, push digitalisation, set up a 24/7 one-stop shop, and consider an Irish-style 'Global Irish' initiative. The minister answered that a policy letter (Consulaire Canon) and a network vision will come before summer 2018, that consultations and surveys of Dutch citizens abroad are ongoing, that digitalisation aims for maximum feasible digital service by 2020, that the one-stop shop will be built stepwise over 3-4 years, and that foreign examples like Global Irish will be considered.

Before summer, the House will be further informed about the cabinet's vision on the diplomatic network and how the funds announced in the Coalition Agreement for its expansion and strengthening will be spent.

Uiterlijk voor de zomer wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de visie van het kabinet op het postennet en de wijze waarop de in het Regeerakkoord aangekondigde middelen voor de uitbreiding en versterking hiervan zullen worden besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over seksuele intimidatie binnen de Verenigde Naties

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about sexual harassment within the UN, the silence of victims, whether immunity shields perpetrators, and what the UN is doing about its internal complaints system. The minister answers that the Netherlands supports the Secretary-General's zero-tolerance approach, notes the new task force and five-point plan, explains that UN officials have functional immunity that the Secretary-General can lift, and says it is too early to judge the measures' adequacy.
The Netherlands will closely monitor the implementation of these measures and, in addition, consult with like-minded countries on additional measures the UN could take.
Nederland zal de uitvoering van deze maatregelen nauwgezet volgen en daarnaast met gelijkgezinde landen in overleg treden over additionele maatregelen die de VN zou kunnen nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sienot over protocollen op de werkvloer na meldingen van seksuele intimidatie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Sienot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Rijkswaterstaat handles reports of sexual harassment and bullying, including protocols, protection of reporters, sick-leave practices, data sanctions and use of external parties. The minister answered by describing existing integrity and complaints procedures, prevention policy and general rules, mostly without addressing specific cases or giving concrete new commitments.
The starting point is that an employee who makes a report suffers no adverse consequences from the report (Protocol Integrity Investigations Rijkswaterstaat).
Uitgangspunt is dat een medewerker die een melding doet geen nadelige gevolgen van zijn melding ondervindt (Protocol Integriteitonderzoeken Rijkswaterstaat).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over de vrijspraak van Julio Poch

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about the acquittal of Julio Poch in Argentina, his long pre-trial detention, Dutch extradition and legal assistance, compensation, and consular support. The government answered that it sees no reason to revise earlier answers, that the duration of detention is for Argentine courts to decide, that Dutch legal assistance obligations were met, and that consular support was provided, while declining to comment on the unpublished judgment.
It is not appropriate for the government to judge the substance of foreign court rulings.
Het past de regering niet om inhoudelijk te oordelen over buitenlandse rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over recente ontwikkelingen in de strijd tegen corruptie in Oekraïne

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about Ukraine's bills 7440 and 7441 creating an independent anti-corruption court, whether they meet Venice Commission advice, and how the Procurator-General's conflict with the NABU anti-corruption bureau and the dismissal of Ihor Soboliev should be addressed. The minister answered that the bills do not fully incorporate Venice Commission advice on judicial selection and case jurisdiction, that the Netherlands shares those concerns and will raise them bilaterally and in the EU and IMF, and that the Netherlands regrets the Soboliev dismissal and will monitor its effects.
The Netherlands will continue to stress, in bilateral contacts and international forums, the importance of a genuinely impartial and independent court and of following the Venice Commission's advice.

Nederland zal in de bilaterale contacten en internationale gremia het belang van een daadwerkelijk onpartijdig en onafhankelijk Hof, en het opvolgen van de adviezen van de Venetië Commissie blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Duitsers binnenkort kunnen kiezen om ‘interseksueel’ te zijn

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the German Constitutional Court's ruling allowing an intersex or diverse registration option is noted, and whether the Netherlands should follow and limit sex registration. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said the Netherlands has no ethics committee on this, is having the advisory commission consider it, and committed to further consultation and to exploring limiting unnecessary sex registration.
The Cabinet will inform the House of Representatives in the usual way.
Het Kabinet zal uw Kamer op de gebruikelijke wijze informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Nederlanders die probeerden omstreden spionagesoftware te verkopen aan Ecuador

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch honorary consul who allegedly facilitated sales of Hacking Team spyware to Ecuadorian intelligence, whether such activity should be reported, whether Dutch police or the MIVD used Hacking Team software, and about EU export-control reform. The minister condemned the sales, said honorary consuls are not required to report commercial activities, refused to disclose which spyware Dutch investigators use citing operational risks, and described the EU dual-use reform as under negotiation without committing to a new position.
The cabinet therefore cannot provide any information about this.
Het kabinet kan hierover derhalve geen informatie over verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sjoerdsma over homofobie in de voetbalwereld

MPs Diertens and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about a news report on homophobia in football, whether homosexuality remains a taboo among professional players, and how acceptance of LHBTI athletes in sport will be promoted. The minister condemned intolerance, cited a 2014 survey of players, and pointed to KNVB workshops, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the sports agreement as measures.
To further promote diversity in sport and the acceptance of LHBTI athletes, I will include this theme as a focus area in future sports policy.
Om diversiteit in de sport en de acceptatie van LHBTI-sporters verder te bevorderen, zal ik dit thema meenemen als aandachtsgebied in het toekomstig sportbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over transseksuelen en interseksuelen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports on transgender and intersex rights, funding gaps for their advocacy groups, limited health access, and support for international funds. The minister said the government funds LHBTI organisations including NNID, that intersex groups are a newer movement with limited donor attention, and that the cabinet will examine intensifying LHBTI priorities.
The cabinet is examining the possibilities for intensifying the priorities named in the coalition agreement, including equal rights for LHBTI persons.
Het kabinet bekijkt de mogelijkheden voor intensivering van de in het regeerakkoord genoemde prioriteiten, waaronder gelijke rechten voor LHBTI's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sjoerdsma over bureaucratie bij het aanvragen van een genderneutrale ov-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why applying for a gender-neutral OV-chipkaart involved bureaucracy, and whether such a card should be offered. The state secretary answered that the sector committed to dropping the m/v gender marker on all new cards from 1 January 2017, with NS cards following by 20 December 2017, and that she welcomes this and supports gender-neutral cards.
That is why I am glad that very soon, without bureaucratic obstacles, no m/v marking will be visible on any new OV-chipkaarts.
Daarom ben ik blij dat er zeer binnenkort zonder bureaucratische drempels op alle nieuwe OV-chipkaarten geen m/v vermelding meer zichtbaar is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de benoeming van een topambtenaar van PvdA-huize op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

MP Sjoerdsma asked why René Cuperus, a Wiardi Beckman Stichting staffer, was appointed as a 'scholar in residence' at the Foreign Ministry without a public vacancy or competing candidates, and whether the appointment would be reconsidered. Minister Koenders said the post was filled via a shortlist because of its specific requirements and short term, that the procedure followed the rules, and that he would not reopen the appointment.
No, given the very specific job requirements and the short duration and limited scope of the appointment, it was decided to draw up a shortlist of potentially suitable candidates.
Nee, gelet op de zeer specifieke functievereisten en de korte duur en beperkte omvang van de aanstelling is ervoor gekozen om een shortlist van mogelijk geschikte kandidaten op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de invloed van salafisten in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs from D66 asked ministers about Saudi-funded study places at the Islamic University of Medina, salafist takeovers of mosques, violence in mosque power struggles, and whether municipalities monitor foreign funding of religious institutions. The government answered that registration data are incomplete, Saudi scholarships are a voluntary choice not disclosed in Notes Verbales, it lacks data on violent incidents or lecture funding, and it promised a tri-track municipal approach and a further handling framework.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not register violent incidents at mosques in the context of the power struggle as referred to in the question.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registreren niet op gewelddadige incidenten bij moskeeën in het kader van de machtsstrijd zoals in de vraag bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over massasurveillance door de Oezbeekse overheid

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked the government about mass surveillance in Uzbekistan, its human rights implications, the role of a Dutch-headquartered telecom firm's Uzbek subsidiary, and surveillance technology exports. The ministers condemned the human rights situation, said talks at senior official level were held with Veon, and stated that no export licences for surveillance technology to Uzbekistan had been granted.
The Netherlands has not granted any licences for the export of surveillance technology to Uzbekistan.
Nederland heeft geen vergunningen verleend voor de uitvoer van surveillancetechnologie naar Oezbekistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het door DUO onnodig uitvragen van geslacht van (nieuwe) partner

Two D66 MPs asked why the student allowance form for scholieren (over-18 secondary pupils) asks for the sex of a parent's new partner, which they considered unnecessary. The minister attached the forms, explained that partner income is needed for the supplementary allowance and sex is used as a check on the citizen service number, and said DUO would assess the cost of a system change before a decision that will be left to her successor.
I have therefore asked DUO whether it is possible in the short term to adapt the system so that stating sex on the form is no longer necessary.
Ik heb dan ook bij DUO navraag gedaan of het op korte termijn mogelijk is het systeem zodanig aan te passen dat het opgeven van het geslacht op het formulier niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Venezuela

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 2017 Venezuelan constituent assembly election, its violence, legitimacy, sanctions, possible EU measures, humanitarian access, Dutch nationals and refugee flows to the Caribbean islands. The minister's reply, issued jointly with the trade and development minister, refers the MP to a separate letter on the Venezuela situation and the implementation of a motion, rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Sjoerdsma (D66), question number 2017Z10660, have been answered by letter 'Current situation in Venezuela and implementation of the Knops/ten Broeke motion'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma (D66), vraagnummer 2017Z10660 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Actuele situatie Venezuela en uitvoering van de motie Knops/ten Broeke» (Kamerstuk 29 653, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over gendergelijkheid in vergoedingen en salarissen bij de publieke omroep

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether men and women are paid equally for equal work at the Dutch public broadcasters, following reports on BBC pay gaps and DWDD guest fees, and what concrete action the government has taken. The State Secretary says equal pay is required, that no evidence of unjustified pay gaps was found, that the NPO will raise the issue with broadcasters, possibly with a voluntary quick scan, and that the Code of good governance may address it.
There is no indication that there is unjustified unequal pay between men and women at the public broadcasters.
Er is geen aanwijzing dat er sprake is van ongerechtvaardigde ongelijke beloning van mannen en vrouwen bij de publieke omroep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma c.s. inzake het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellinge

MPs Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked how Saudi Arabia and Kuwait share information via Notes Verbales about funding requests from Dutch religious institutions, when the Labour Minister was informed, and what action has been taken on earlier motions. The government answered that the information is shared confidentially, that since 2016 it goes to several agencies including SZW, and that only one case led to ended funding, with a convenant on transparency under discussion.
This information was obtained through diplomatic channels and is therefore confidential.
Deze informatie is verkregen via diplomatiek verkeer en daarmee vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de arrestatie van een Nederlander in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and travel ban imposed by Turkey on a Dutch national for allegedly insulting Erdogan, including the legitimacy of the ban, consular support, the number of Dutch nationals under travel bans, a joint EU position, and whether extradition to Turkey should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the embassy has raised these cases repeatedly with Turkish authorities, declined to give details of individual cases for privacy reasons, pointed to Turkish courts for judging legitimacy, reported about ten people still affected and seven who had left, and noted coordination with like-minded EU states and a travel advice update.
For reasons of privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with information about individual cases through this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen informatie verstrekken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over de escalatie tussen Rusland en VS inzake de strijd in Syrië

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about the US shootdown of a Syrian jet, Russia's threat against coalition aircraft, the effect on the fight against ISIS and the Dutch tanker, and reports of rising civilian deaths and changed rules of engagement. The government answered that it lacks facts to assess the shootdown, that the fight against ISIS continues, that the Dutch tanker's deployment is unchanged, that the US says its rules of engagement were not changed, and that at least 484 civilian casualties from coalition action have been acknowledged.
The cabinet does not have the necessary facts to further interpret this attack.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feiten om deze aanval verder te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Organisaties: Nederland doet te weinig voor Tsjetsjeense homo’s”

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands is doing enough for LGBTI people persecuted in Chechnya, including whether it funded shelters, how it treated an asylum-seeking journalist, and whether it will press Russia. The government answered that it has taken an international lead, funds small-scale first-line shelter in Russia, denies sending the journalist away, does not register asylum claims by sexual orientation, and will continue to raise the issue with Russia.
I cannot answer this question: the IND does not keep records of applications based on sexual orientation or ethnicity, or of applications based on conversion.
Op deze vraag kan ik geen antwoord geven: de IND houdt geen registratie bij van aanvragen op grond van seksuele gerichtheid of etniciteit dan wel van aanvragen op grond van bekering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de classificatie van transpersonen binnen de aankomende International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11)

An MP asked the ministers whether transgender classification in the draft ICD-11 should move out of the mental disorders chapter, and whether the government would support the proposal and end the categorisation of transgender identity as a mental or behavioural disorder. The minister agreed that gender identity should not be treated as an illness, said she would convey her position to the WHO-FIC and TNN and ask to be kept informed, but did not commit to a formal endorsement or a fixed position on the WHO process.
I will bring my position to the attention of the WHO-FIC with the request to convey this position to the WHO.
Ik zal mijn standpunt in deze onder de aandacht brengen van het WHO-FIC met het verzoek dit standpunt in te brengen bij de WHO

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht dat Nederlanders generieke Pre-Expositie Profylaxe (PrEP) uit het buitenland halen omdat het in Nederland nog niet verkrijgbaar is

D66 MPs asked whether generic PrEP imported from abroad because it is not available in the Netherlands is undesirable, what the medical risks of unsupervised use are, and when PrEP can be made available. The minister said reimbursement is for each country to decide, a Gezondheidsraad advice is awaited before national policy is set, and unsupervised use of the prescription-only drug is strongly discouraged.
I do not want to anticipate this advice.
Ik wil niet op dit advies vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat in Indonesië twee homoseksuele mannen vandaag 85 stokslagen hebben gekregen en 141 mannen in een 'homosauna' zijn gearresteerd

The MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knew of the caning of two gay men in Aceh and the arrest of 141 men in a Jakarta 'homosauna', what steps the government had taken, and how it would press Indonesia to stop such treatment. The minister confirmed the events, described the diplomatic steps taken (the human rights ambassador's visit, an EU demarche, and a planned EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue) and said the government would continue to raise concerns about LHBTI rights bilaterally and in the EU.
The Netherlands will bilaterally and within the EU, in regular contacts with the Indonesian government, voice its concern about the situation of LHBTI persons in Indonesia
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband in reguliere contacten met de Indonesische overheid zijn zorg uitspreken over de situatie van LHBTI's in Indonesië
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de detentie en repressie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and deportation to Saudi Arabia of human rights defenders, including Al-Otaibi, and about rising repression, asking whether Dutch action and an EU statement were planned. The minister said the Netherlands was surprised by the deportation, raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and that an EU statement proved unfeasible, so the Dutch ambassador would raise the case with Saudi authorities.
The Netherlands, like other countries, was surprised by the sudden deportation of the person concerned by the Qatari authorities to Saudi Arabia.
Nederland werd, net als andere landen, verrast door de plotselinge deportatie van betrokkene door de Qatari autoriteiten naar Saoedi-Arabië.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de luxe reizen van ambtenaren leiden tot miljoenen euro’s extra kosten

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether civil servants fly business class on official trips and what it costs, given the government's sober-government policy. The minister confirmed that flights of 6 hours or more allow business class under the harmonised travel rules, gave only partial cost data for 2012–2016, and declined to compare costs or foreign policy.
Unfortunately, the requested overview can only be provided in part.
Helaas is het gevraagde overzicht maar gedeeltelijk te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de eerder ontvangen antwoorden op vragen aangaande wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg.

MPs Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the minister to explain how transgender care waiting lists would be reduced, whether coordinated care contracting and the rejection of separate contracting is evidence-based, the stigma of certain statements, the informed consent model, and the timeline of the quality standard. The government answered with capacity expansions, a planned quality standard by April 2018, a defence of coordinated multidisciplinary care, and that waiting times of two years are not recognised from available data.
The VUmc has decided to again substantially increase the capacity of its Knowledge and Care Centre for Gender Dysphoria for 2017, by 20%.
Het VUmc heeft besloten om voor 2017 de capaciteit van het Kennis- en Zorgcentrum voor Genderdysforie (KZcG) opnieuw fors, te weten met 20%, te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Sjoerdsma en Bisschop over het bericht "Zorgeloos in Eritrea"

MPs asked whether Eritrean refugees holding asylum status who travel back to Eritrea should lose their status, how often this is checked and enforced, and whether travel can be traced. The State Secretary says such travel can trigger review or withdrawal of temporary permits, reports withdrawals of a few dozen permits, no Eritreans among checked cases, and that tracing all Eritrean travellers is not possible.
It is not possible to determine how many Eritreans from the Netherlands have travelled to Eritrea or neighbouring countries in recent years.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel Eritreeërs uit Nederland de afgelopen jaren naar Eritrea of omringende landen zijn gereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een blogger uit Bangladesh die met de dood wordt bedreigd

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to reports that Sweden refused asylum to Bangladeshi blogger Mishu Dhar, and about the threats and protection of bloggers in Bangladesh. The minister said Dutch authorities cannot intervene in another country's individual asylum decisions, described the security situation and diplomatic efforts with Bangladesh, and pointed to the Shelter City and ProtectDefenders options without committing to new action.
An application for asylum in a country falls under privacy legislation.
Een aanvraag tot asiel in een land valt onder de privacy wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de voorgestelde versobering van opvang van asielzoekers in Griekenland

Four MPs asked the State Secretary about a proposed tightening of reception for asylum seekers in Greece under the EU-Turkey deal Joint Action Plan, and Human Rights Watch's criticism. The government answered that the JAP aims to speed up asylum procedures and improve safety and reception capacity, denied that Greece is a policy laboratory, and said it expects no worse conditions or longer stays on the islands.

The government does not expect a severe deterioration of conditions for people on the Greek islands or longer stays, because the JAP also works on faster and more efficient Greek asylum procedures and more regular returns to Turkey.

Het kabinet verwacht geen grove verslechtering van de situatie voor de mensen of een langere verblijfsduur op de Griekse eilanden, omdat onder het JAP ook wordt gewerkt aan bijvoorbeeld het sneller en efficiënter verlopen van de Griekse asielprocedures en terugkeer naar Turkije op regelmatiger basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Berlijn zeer terughoudend is geworden met wapenexport naar Turkije

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked whether Germany had become very restrictive on arms export licences to Turkey after the 2016 coup attempt and what the Netherlands was doing in response. The ministers answered that licences are assessed case by case against EU criteria, that four licences were refused in 2016 on internal-situation grounds, and that no EU-wide change or unilateral embargo is planned.
The cabinet publishes a monthly overview of issued arms export licences.
Het kabinet publiceert maandelijks een overzicht van afgegeven vergunningen voor wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de toestroom van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen naar Curaçao

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked about the sudden influx of Venezuelan refugees to Curaçao, whether the government had informed parliament, its earlier claims of no mass migration, the number of registered and unregistered refugees, reception capacity, crisis scenarios, support given, and asylum legislation gaps. The government answered that there is no mass migration flow, that about 20 asylum applications were registered on Curaçao and 2 on Aruba, that the islands lack capacity for thousands, that crisis scenarios and planning exist with the islands primarily responsible, and that asylum law is an autonomous matter for Curaçao and Aruba.
There is no question of a mass migration flow towards the Caribbean part of the Kingdom.
Er is geen sprake van een massale migratiestroom richting het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse verzekeraars die nog steeds investeren in wapenfabrikanten

MPs Sjoerdsma, Servaes and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch insurers' investments in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, which may be used in the Yemen conflict, fit export restrictions, the insurance sector's sustainable investment code and international responsible business standards, and what the government has done since 2015. Minister Ploumen answered that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, that insurers themselves decide which companies to invest in, that a sector IMVO covenant is being negotiated, and that the insurers named were contacted.
Subject to these conditions, it is up to insurers themselves to decide which companies they invest in; the government in principle does not regulate this.
Met in achtneming van deze voorwaarden is het aan verzekeraars zelf om te bepalen in welke bedrijven zij investeren, de overheid reguleert dit in beginsel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over de 9e rapportage van de Europese Commissie over relocatie en hervestiging van vluchtelingen

MPs asked the State Secretary about the Commission's 9th relocation report, including the number of asylum seekers eligible for relocation from Greece and how Dutch refusals were justified. The State Secretary answered that about 20,000 relocation candidates are now present in Greece, that roughly 20 cases were refused on public order or national security grounds, and that the 10th report will clarify figures.
That is why the Cabinet considers it important to communicate about this consistently and unambiguously.
Daarom vindt het Kabinet het belangrijk om hier steeds helder en eenduidig over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de wijziging van het zetelverdrag van het Joegoslaviëtribunaal

Two MPs asked whether amendments to the host-state agreement of the Yugoslavia Tribunal extend AOW pension coverage to family members of its staff retroactively to 2009 and why not to 1994 as the UN requested. The minister confirms the 2009 retroactive date, explains it was a goodwill choice rather than a legal obligation, and declines to extend it to 1994 because family members were explicitly excluded in the 1994 agreement.
The decision on retroactive effect is not based on an (international) legal obligation but was chosen as an accommodation for the MICT.
Het besluit met betrekking tot de terugwerkende kracht is niet gebaseerd op een (internationaal) juridische verplichting, maar is gekozen als tegemoetkoming voor het MICT
Antwoord op vragen die van de leden Voordewind, Voortman , Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen (SP) over de motie inzake de Regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen

MPs asked whether the government would accept that citing the coalition agreement does not justify ignoring an adopted motion, and whether it would impose a deportation stop for long-resident asylum children until a new cabinet forms. The Secretary of State says the coalition agreement was not decisive, but declines to amend the Regeling or impose a deportation stop, citing disruption of removal procedures and raised expectations.
However, I did not want to leave out of the letter my observation that the motion is at odds with the coalition agreement.
Ik heb echter de constatering dat de motie op gespannen voet staat met het regeerakkoord niet achterwege willen laten in de brief.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de problemen die Nederlanders in het buitenland ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun stemrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about delays and problems in postal voting for Dutch citizens abroad for the 2017 election, including late ballot dispatch and the return envelope procedure. The minister referred most questions to a letter sent on 9 March 2017 and answered the dispatch-timing question by describing staggered mailing dates and the registration process.
In the evaluation of the upcoming election I will take into account the signals received from Dutch citizens abroad and also look at the suggestions made for possible improvements.

Ik zal in de evaluatie van de komende verkiezing de signalen meenemen die zijn ontvangen van Nederlanders in het buitenland en ook kijken naar de suggesties die zijn gedaan voor mogelijke verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het opheffen van de bibliotheek van het Vredespaleis

MP Sjoerdsma asked why the government planned to end subsidy for the Peace Palace library from 2019, noting its importance for international courts, and whether the Carnegie foundation's founding deed obliges the Netherlands to maintain it. The minister replied that no separate library subsidy exists, that the Foreign Ministry pays EUR 4.4 million per year to the Carnegie Foundation which manages the library, and that there is no reason to assume the library will disappear.
There is no separate subsidy for the Peace Palace library.
Er is geen sprake van een aparte subsidie voor de bibliotheek van het Vredespaleis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het illegaal de grens overzetten van migranten naar Servië

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary about reports that migrants are illegally pushed back across the border from Hungary and Croatia into Serbia, with police violence, and about reception shortfalls in Serbia, EU responsibility and safe routes. The government condemns violence against refugees, says the Commission is primarily responsible for enforcing EU law and that Serbia has enough reception capacity, and declines to start resettlement from Serbia or to take a new EU initiative.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake de situatie van de heer Van Laarhoven

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma ask the Foreign Minister to clarify director-level contacts with Thailand on the case of Mr Van Laarhoven, including the legal basis for transfer to the Netherlands and the reasons for his relocation within prison. The minister answers that two director-level contacts took place (by phone and in Seoul), that extradition requests are for the Public Prosecution Service and the Justice Minister rather than the Foreign Minister, and that the Thai authorities decided on the transfer despite a Dutch request to keep him in the reception unit.
Extradition requests are made by the Minister of Justice and Security, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service.
Uitleveringsverzoeken worden gedaan door de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over de blokkade van NOS in Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the blocking of NOS's website and app in Turkey, why it occurred, whether he had protested, and whether he would act and raise it in the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands objected and requested clarification, and noted that press and internet freedom are EU values raised regularly with Turkey, without announcing a specific new step.
In response to the blocking, the Netherlands lodged an objection with the Turkish authorities and requested clarification.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van de blokkade bezwaar aangetekend bij de Turkse autoriteiten en om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het stopzetten van internationaal draagmoederschap

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the government about reports that countries such as Cambodia are halting international surrogacy, the number of Dutch citizens affected, the legal position of intended parents and children, and whether a transitional arrangement is needed. The minister answered that no overview or data exists, that legal parentage is assessed case by case under Dutch law, and that a surrogacy regime is being considered in response to the Staatscommissie report, without committing to a transitional arrangement.
I do not have an overview of countries where international surrogacy exists, is threatened to be halted, or has been halted.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van landen waar internationaal draagmoederschap bestaat, dreigt te worden stopgezet of is stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over de verdwenen oorlogsgraven van Nederlanders in de Javazee

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked whether the government will pursue an international treaty to protect war graves at sea, what contacts with other states produced, whether wrecks of Dutch warships were towed to Surabaya and sold as scrap, and when the investigation will conclude. The minister replied that existing law already protects warship wrecks, that contacts with several states have taken place, that it is too early to confirm the scrapping report, and that no concrete timeline exists yet, though results will be shared.
Of course we will inform you about the outcome of the investigation.
Uiteraard zullen wij u informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma, Voortman, Van der Staaij en Thieme over uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether the extradition of two Rwandan-national suspects should be reconsidered in light of testimony from Witteveen about Rwandan courts, fair-trial risks and the Bandora case, and whether a broader extradition inquiry should be conducted. The minister refused to revisit the decision, stating Witteveen's findings were already weighed, the Court of Appeal found no real fair-trial risk, and the two men were extradited on 12 November 2016.
I see no reason to revisit the decision regarding the extradition.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de uitlevering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het bed, bad en brood overleg is geklapt

MP Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the lack of clarity on who cannot return to their country of origin through no fault of their own keeps rejected asylum seekers stuck in municipal bed-bath-bread shelters, how many buitenschuld (no-fault) residence permits were granted or refused in 2014-2016, and what the procedure requires and how it could be improved. The State Secretary replied that returnees generally can leave, described the evidentiary requirements and the 2013 policy, stated the policy is well balanced and will not be changed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland een Nederlandse onderzeeër op de Middellandse Zee verjaagt

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Russia drove a Dutch submarine out of the Mediterranean, whether it was in international waters, what Russia's legal basis was, whether there was diplomatic contact, and what the submarine was doing there. The ministers only acknowledged the Russian statements, declined to comment on submarine movements, and said there had been no contact with Russia.
No statements are made about the movements of Dutch submarines.
Over de bewegingen van Nederlandse onderzeeboten worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Exodus dreigt bij Internationaal Strafhof'

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that several African states, including Burundi, South Africa and Gambia, plan to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the government regrets the withdrawals, has lobbied the EU, the ICC Assembly president and African states, and will keep engaging at the Assembly of States Parties, while rejecting concessions that would compromise the ICC.

The cabinet has no indications that developments toward extending the ICC's jurisdiction over the crime of aggression played a role in the decision of Burundi, South Africa and Gambia to withdraw from the Rome Statute.

Het kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat ontwikkelingen richting uitbreiding van de rechtsmacht van het Strafhof met het misdrijf agressie een rol heeft gespeeld bij de beslissing van Burundi, Zuid-Afrika en Gambia terug te treden uit het Statuut van Rome.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het bericht over de situatie van Johan van Laarhoven en zijn vrouw Tukta

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister why he judged it not in the interest of Johan van Laarhoven to raise his detention in Thailand now, and what contact and advice the embassy provided. The minister replied that he is well informed, that the embassy visits and raises his detention and health with Thai authorities, that consular help to his Thai-national wife is not possible, and that transfer to the Netherlands cannot occur until the Thai appeal is concluded.
The Dutch embassy in Thailand proactively maintains contact with the penal institution where Mr Van Laarhoven is held.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Thailand onderhoudt proactief contact met de penitentiaire inrichting waar de heer Van Laarhoven verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de tientallen miljoenen die Assad krijgt van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asks why the UN pays tens of millions of dollars in contracts to Assad-regime-linked entities, including a Damascus hotel partly owned by a sanctioned ministry, and whether this undermines UN independence. The ministers answer that cooperation with the regime is a practical necessity for reaching millions in need, that private contracts are separate from aid, that the EU and US sanctions do not cover UN transactions, and that they raise the matter in the ISSG and with the UN.
In the discussion, the Netherlands emphasises the importance of dialogue between humanitarian organisations working in Syria and argues for preserving room to voice criticism.
Nederland benadrukt in de discussie het belang van dialoog tussen humanitaire organisaties werkzaam in Syrië, en pleit voor behoud van ruimte om kritiek te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Meenen over het bericht “meer uitkeringen door Syriërs en en Wajongeren”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Meenen asked about reports of rising benefit claims by Syrians and Wajong recipients, including data on Syrian welfare recipients, costs, language training and diploma recognition. The minister answered with CBS figures, describes pre-integration courses and volunteer training, and says a letter on the motion for language lessons from day one will follow before the budget debate.
The realised costs of increased welfare benefits for Syrians are not registered separately.
De gerealiseerde kosten van toegenomen bijstand door Syriërs worden niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Zelf taal leren en integreren mislukt”

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that self-directed language learning and integration had failed, that refugees borrow more under the new civic integration law than ROCs used to receive, and about the cost of waivers and debt forgiveness. The minister acknowledged disappointing results, said a study into the causes would report in autumn, and gave debt-forgiveness and loan figures while cautioning that the cost comparison is only a preliminary indication.
At present it is being examined what the reasons are that integration candidates fail the civic integration examination.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht wat de redenen zijn waardoor inburgeraars niet slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het landarrest van een Nederlander in India

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch citizen under house arrest in India since 2014, alleged blackmail by police, delays in his trial, and whether the ambassador was ignored. The minister answered that consular aid is provided, delays are not exceptional in India, an independent local lawyer is investigating the proceedings, and political intervention would breach judicial independence, while passport return is not possible during the trial.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Sjoerdsma, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

Five MPs asked whether the Netherlands is extraditing two genocide suspects to Rwanda despite expert doubts about fair trials there, and whether this should be suspended pending independent review. The minister confirmed the extradition proceeds after appeal courts found no real risk of an unfair trial, argued trial in the country of the crime is preferred, and refused to suspend extradition or commission new independent research.
I am therefore not willing to suspend the extradition.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid de uitlevering op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over radardata m.b.t. MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia holds raw primary radar data from the MH17 area, why it was not shared for over two years, and how the Dutch government assesses cooperation and prosecution strategy. The minister answered that Russia has promised to share the data with the JIT but has not yet handed it over, that the government has repeatedly urged full cooperation, and that prosecution options (an ad hoc tribunal or national prosecution) remain open.
For that reason we cannot inform your House in detail which information was requested or received from which party.
Om die reden kunnen wij uw Kamer niet in detail melden welke informatie van welke partij is gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over geheime beïnvloedingsoperaties door Rusland

An MP asked the ministers whether the government knows of covert Russian influence operations, including alleged efforts to influence the US election and Dutch politics, and whether it will investigate or inform parliament. The government replied it has no concrete knowledge of Russian funding or influence of Dutch parties, cannot make public statements on ongoing intelligence activities, and so cannot share details.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about alleged Russian activities aimed at influencing the US presidential elections.
Het kabinet kan geen publieke uitspraken doen over (vermeende) activiteiten van Rusland teneinde de presidentsverkiezingen in de VS te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sjoerdsma over de Turkse publicatie van een lijst met Nederlandse 'Gülen-organisaties'

MPs Van Meenen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Turkey's publication of a list of Dutch 'Gülen organisations' was unacceptable interference, and what steps the government would take toward Turkey and the Dutch-Turkish community. The government answered that it has consistently told Turkish officials that direct interference from Ankara in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to a cabinet letter on tensions in the Turkish-Dutch community.
In all talks with members of the Turkish government, the cabinet has consistently and critically made clear that Turkish tensions must not be exported to the Netherlands.

Het kabinet heeft in alle gesprekken met leden van de Turkse regering consequent en in kritische bewoordingen duidelijk gemaakt dat de Turkse spanningen niet naar Nederland moeten worden geëxporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Jemen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about Yemen's political situation, the Hadi government's control and legitimacy, and the international approach to the conflict. The minister answered that government control is patchy, that Hadi's mandate was extended pending elections, that Resolution 2216 remains the basis, and that a VN-led inclusive settlement is being pursued.
The cabinet has not expressed support for the intervention by the Saudi Arabia-led coalition in Yemen.
Het kabinet heeft geen steun uitgesproken voor de interventie van de door Saoedi-Arabië geleide coalitie in Jemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Extra veel Belgische Nederlanders bij buitenlandloket’

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked why the Brussels embassy and Antwerp consulate-general stopped issuing passports and ID cards from November 2015, how many applications and waiting times were involved, and how backlogs would be cleared. The minister answered that the change is part of a modernisation of consular services, that alternatives exist, that waiting times at some Dutch municipalities are comparable, and that capacity is being expanded and an external-provider pilot started.
It is not possible to retrieve figures from the systems on the time between application and actual issue of a travel document.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers uit de systemen op te vragen met betrekking tot de tijdsduur tussen de aanvraag en de daadwerkelijke uitreiking van een reisdocument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over de brand in het vreemdelingendetentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fire at the Rotterdam immigration detention centre, including the lack of aftercare, isolation and searches of detainees, the non-central unlocking of doors, and why the Inspectorate did not investigate earlier. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate will investigate the events, expected to finish by late November 2016, and will report to parliament afterwards, and that it has now decided to open a further inquiry since the Amnesty account covers different facts.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the course of events surrounding the fire.
Inspectie VenJ) zal onderzoek verrichten naar de gang van zaken rond de brand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de politie in Istanbul leden van de Gay Pride-organisatie heeft gearresteerd

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knew the official reason for Istanbul police arresting Gay Pride organisers, and how it would respond to Turkey's treatment of LGBTI rights. The ministers answered that Turkish authorities gave no official reason, that the government regrets the cancelled Pride but accepts possible security motives, and that it funds LGBTI projects in Turkey and raises the issue in EU accession talks.
The Turkish authorities have not given an official explanation for why these people were briefly detained.
De Turkse autoriteiten hebben geen officiële verklaring gegeven waarom deze mensen korte tijd zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “300 medewerkers bij de IND weg”

An MP asked why the IND is dismissing 300 temporary staff while asylum backlogs and waiting times remain a concern, and about the status of the five-track asylum policy and family reunification delays. The state secretary answered that lower-than-forecast inflow lets the IND manage with fewer staff, that waiting times should fall to about eight weeks from October, and provided track-distribution figures and family reunification processing times, while correcting an earlier figure.
From October, the IND expects waiting times to be reduced to about eight weeks, and the 300 externally hired staff will be phased out.
Vanaf oktober zijn naar de verwachting van de IND de wachttijden teruggebracht tot ca. acht weken en worden de 300 extern ingehuurde krachten gefaseerd afgebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Meer kinderen, minder mannen naar Nederland”

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of long family reunification procedures and whether General Comment 14 of the UN Children's Rights Committee and Articles 5(5) and 17 of the Family Reunification Directive should be explicitly applied in policy. The government answered that waiting times are being addressed through extra capacity, that no change to the assessment framework is needed, and that the current IND practice complies with the directive, the ECHR and treaty obligations.
As already indicated in my letter to the House of 29 October 2014, the implementation of the directive proceeded on the basis that explicitly naming Article 17 in the regulations is not necessary.

Antwoord 6, 7, 8 Zoals reeds aangegeven in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 29 oktober 2014 6 is bij de implementatie van de richtlijn ervan uitgegaan dat het apart benoemen van artikel 17 in de regelgeving niet noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellingen verstrekken

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Gulf states share information on financing of religious institutions in the Netherlands, including whether a list of Saudi-financed institutions exists and why it is withheld. The answer refers to the oral questions asked on the same topic, so no substantive answers to the written questions are given here.
The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) and Karabulut (SP) (question number 2016Z14749, submitted 13 July 2016) have been answered through oral questions.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) (vraagnummer 2016Z14749 , ingezonden 13 juli 2016) zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Het gebruik van in Nederland geregistreerde postbusfirma’s voor de ontwijking van internationale sancties door het Assad-regime

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch companies supplied oil to the Assad regime via Panama-registered shell companies, and what action was taken against them and against Staroil B.V. The government answered that a Customs investigation found no breach of the sanctions rules applicable at the time, so no enforcement or prosecution followed, and that it would keep pressing international partners and informing firms about sanctions.
Based on the outcome of the Customs investigation, the Public Prosecution Service decided not to take any further steps regarding enforcement or prosecution.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de Douane heeft het Openbaar Ministerie besloten om verder geen stappen te nemen met betrekking tot handhaving of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over een uitnodiging aan Saoedi-Arabië voor een Nederlandse wapenbeurs

MPs asked whether the Royal Netherlands Navy invited a Saudi delegation to the MAST 2016 defence fair, why the first question was not fully answered, and how an invitation squares with a strict arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia given the situation in Yemen and human rights. The government confirmed invitations went to 23 countries including Saudi Arabia, that no Saudi delegation attended (reason unknown), maintained its strict export licensing, and said it could not provide a central overview of past defence-fair invitations.
The Ministry of Defence does not keep a central registration of defence fairs.
Het Ministerie van Defensie voert geen centrale registratie van defensiebeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel “Ze dacht dat Nederland veilig was"

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about press reports of intimidation and threats against a human rights lawyer working with the International Criminal Court in the Netherlands, and what protection and oversight measures were taken. The government confirmed a criminal investigation has been open since February, withheld details of protection measures for security reasons, and described an activated consultation mechanism with NGOs, the Court and the host state, with follow-up meetings planned.
That investigation began in February of this year. Because of the investigation, the cabinet cannot respond with details.
Dat onderzoek is februari dit jaar begonnen. Vanwege het onderzoek kan het kabinet niet op details reageren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten getiteld “Request for initiating an investigation in Thailand” in de zaak-Van

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch consular conduct and detention conditions for Van Laarhoven in Thailand, the Thai money-laundering conviction linked to Dutch cannabis-shop revenue, and possible bias of the Dutch prosecutor. The government answered that Thailand receives extended consular assistance, that it cannot judge foreign rulings, that the Dutch prosecution is ongoing, and that no substantive irregularities were found in the investigation.
The Public Prosecution Service decides which instruments it considers necessary within an ongoing criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bepaalt welke instrumenten het wanneer nodig acht in het kader van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over gezinshereniging van broers en zussen van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP asked whether unmarried adult siblings of unaccompanied minor refugees, who are refused family reunification, should be treated like adult children of refugee parents under the May 2015 policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the omission, said it was unintended, and committed to amending the framework so such requests are assessed individually under Article 8 ECHR.
Because it is undesirable that a 19-year-old brother or sister ultimately has to remain as the only family member in a refugee camp, I will remedy this omission.
Omdat het onwenselijk is dat een 19-jarige broer of zus uiteindelijk als enig gezinslid in een vluchtelingenkamp moet achterblijven, zal ik deze omissie herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de rechten van alleen-staande minderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary about the rights of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMVs): how many special building-exception residence permit requests were made and refused, long-term prospects, the revised Dublin Regulation, the COA improvement plan, and placement procedures. The State Secretary answered that about ten such requests were filed and all refused, stressed family reunification and child-interest considerations, committed to monitoring and a possible evaluation, supported the best-interests principle in Dublin revision, and promised the COA improvement letter before the summer recess ends.
No permits have been issued ex officio under the building-exception policy either. The reason for this is not recorded in the IND's automated system.
Ook zijn er geen ambtshalve vergunningen verstrekt op grond van het buitenschuldbeleid. De reden hiervoor wordt niet in het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Sjoerdsma over mishandeling van migranten door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Voortman and Sjoerdsma asked whether the EU and Dutch support to the Libyan coast guard, including the Sophia mission, makes them complicit in abuses of migrants reported by Amnesty International, and what follow-up is planned. The minister acknowledged the situation, described Dutch-funded IOM projects and EU mandate changes, and said the EU training phase has not started and that human rights will be raised with Libyan authorities, without accepting responsibility or changing course.
The Netherlands will work to discuss international human rights standards with the Libyan authorities and to include them in the training curriculum.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor bespreking van de internationale mensenrechtennormen met de Libische autoriteiten en voor opneming ervan in het curriculum van de trainingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat het OM nu de MH17 radargegevens in Rusland opvraagt
