Two MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's request to Russia for raw primary radar data on MH17 reflected political pressure, whether an ICAO dispute should be launched, and why Russia, Ukraine and the UN had not fully complied with Security Council resolution 2166 and the victims' families' letters. The minister replied that the prosecution's independence must be protected, that the Netherlands is ready to assist on request, that no ICAO dispute will be started because the safety investigation did not need the data, and that the Russian authorities have said they are willing to cooperate.
The cabinet does not want political influence on this important criminal investigation.
Het kabinet wil geen politieke beïnvloeding van dit belangrijke strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Sjoerdsma over de situatie van jonge Syrische vluchtelingen in Libanon

MPs Van Veldhoven and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about the hopelessness and reported suicidal feelings among young Syrian refugees in Lebanon, the funding of UNICEF education centres, and what the Netherlands is doing on psychosocial care. The minister acknowledged the situation, said suicide figures could not be verified, described psychosocial care and education funding commitments, and said the government is in ongoing dialogue with Lebanese authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have its own figures on suicidal tendencies among young Syrian refugees in Lebanon or other countries in the region.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt niet over eigen cijfers ten aanzien van zelfmoordneigingen onder jonge Syrische vluchtelingen in Libanon of andere landen in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de evacuatie van Nederlanders uit Zuid-Soedan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the evacuation of Dutch nationals from South Sudan, including how many remain and whether the government actively supports them in leaving. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter on recent developments in South Sudan rather than answering the questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk en Servaes over een Saoedische delegatie die op uitnodiging van de Koninklijke Marine een Nederlandse wapenbeurs bezoekt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk and Servaes asked whether a Saudi delegation was invited by the Royal Netherlands Navy to the MAST arms fair, and how such an invitation fits with the motion on Saudi arms exports, the EU Parliament resolution and alleged humanitarian law violations in Yemen. The ministers replied that no Saudi delegation attended MAST 2016, and that the government maintains a very strict case-by-case arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia, with no export licences granted in 2016 so far.
No, no Saudi delegation was present at the Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Neen, er is geen Saoedische delegatie aanwezig geweest op de Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen, Kuiken, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat opvang wordt geweigerd aan (zieke) vreemdelingen die bereid zijn om het land te verlaten

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary whether asylum seekers willing to leave the Netherlands are being refused shelter at Ter Apel, including sick ones, and why the buitenschuld regime and the motions on voluntary return and bed-bad-brood arrangements are not reflected. The state secretary denied the premise, explained that shelter is conditional on demonstrated active cooperation with return, and stated that medically necessary care is available with a possible deferral of departure under article 64 Vw.
It is generally correct that not all foreigners who request shelter at the VBL are actually admitted to the VBL.
Het is in algemene zin juist dat niet alle vreemdelingen die verzoeken om onderdak in de VBL daadwerkelijk tot de VBL worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over belegeringen en voortdurende bombardementen in Syrië

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about sieges, market bombings and starvation in Syria, including UN Security Council resolution 2268 on humanitarian access. The minister condemned attacks on civilians, described the efforts to reach besieged areas and food airdrops, and said a full rapid answer before the Council meeting was not possible.
Unfortunately it has not proven possible to meet this request.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken aan dit verzoek te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat dertien EU-landen wapens leveren aan Egypte

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked whether thirteen EU states exported arms to Egypt despite the 2013 Council agreement to suspend licences for goods usable for internal repression, and whether the government would press for enforcement and harmonisation. The government answered that no formal embargo exists, that it lacks full export data, that EU states decide licences nationally, and that it will keep pushing for harmonisation without committing to new EU action.
However, the cabinet does not have exact information on the goods exported to Egypt, since within the EU only refusals and not approvals of export licences are shared.

Het kabinet beschikt echter niet over exacte informatie betreffende de goederen die naar Egypte uitgevoerd zijn, aangezien binnen de EU alleen de afwijzingen en niet de toewijzingen van uitvoervergunningen gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops en Grashoff over de vernietiging van Palestijnse waterbronnen door Israël

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, CDA and GroenLinks asked whether Israel plans to destroy water cisterns in Kusra built with Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands could recover damages. The government answered that the cisterns are subject to stop-work orders that owners are contesting legally, that nothing has yet been destroyed so no compensation arises, and that the Dutch representation is intensifying dialogue with Israeli authorities and following legal developments closely.
In this context the Representation has lodged a protest against the latest stop-work orders and will continue to follow the legal developments very actively.
In dit kader heeft de Vertegenwoordiging protest aangetekend tegen de laatste stop-work-orders en zal het de juridische ontwikkelingen zeer actief blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de uitzetting van een VN-functionaris door Sudan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Sudanese government's refusal to renew the residence permit of UN OCHA head Ivo Freijsen amounts to a de facto expulsion, what reasons Sudan gave, and whether the Netherlands would protest. The minister confirmed the permit will lapse, noted Sudan gave no official reason beyond alleged non-cooperation and inaccurate UN reporting, and said the Netherlands and donors have urged Sudan to reverse the decision.
The cabinet finds it incomprehensible and disappointing that Mr Freijsen has to leave the country in this way.
Het kabinet vindt het onbegrijpelijk en teleurstellend dat de heer Freijsen op deze manier het land moet verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Knops, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Abbas confirms PA still paying terrorists’ salaries’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the shift of prisoner salary payments from the Palestinian Authority to the PLO is merely cosmetic, given EU and Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands will object as Norway did. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no objection in principle to support for prisoners if transparent and proportionate, that the Dutch Pegase contribution does not fund prisoner payments and has robust verification, and that the government will keep raising the issue bilaterally.
The government has no insight into the total income or expenditure of the PLO.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzage in de totale inkomsten of uitgaven van de PLO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het niet uitvoeren van de motie Servaes inzake een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister why the Dutch delegation to the UN Open Ended Working Group did not act on the Servaes motion calling for negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, and whether it would be instructed to do so. The minister answered that the delegation had followed its existing instruction in the first week, that a nuclear ban was on the agenda only in the second week, that further instructions reflecting the motion were sent, and that Parliament would be informed in writing about the second session.
You will be informed in writing, in line with my earlier commitment, about the progress of this second session of the OEWG.
U zult conform mijn eerdere toezegging schriftelijk nader geïnformeerd worden over het verloop van deze tweede sessie van de OEWG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Zorgen om inburgering”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs when the provisional, very low civic integration pass rates were known in his ministry, and whether he would answer before the plenary debate. The minister replied that DUO supplied the figures on 1 April 2016, that they were shared with parliament in his letter of 20 April, that additional measures and a deeper investigation were started, and that he agreed to answer the questions before the debate.
I share your concern about the low pass rate, and that is also why I have taken additional measures and started an in-depth investigation into the civic integration process.
Ik deel uw zorg over het lage slagingspercentage en dat is ook de reden dat ik aanvullende maatregelen heb genomen en een verdiepend onderzoek heb gestart naar het inburgeringsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het hoge tempo waarin Palestijnse gebouwen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever worden gesloopt

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked about the rapid pace of Israeli demolitions of Palestinian buildings in the West Bank, including the number destroyed, displacement, donor-funded losses, recourse for damages, and EU action. The ministers confirmed the situation is very serious, reported 539 buildings demolished in Area C by 8 April 2016 versus 453 in all of 2015, cited €77,000 and €416,000 in damage to Dutch and EU-funded projects, and said the matter is raised in the EU and that Israel does not pay compensation.
In the case of demolition orders or confiscations, the Netherlands raises compensation.
Nederland stelt in geval van slooporders of confiscaties schadevergoeding aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het vrijlaten van gevangenen uit Guantánamo Bay

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would accept Guantánamo detainees, whether it was discussed with the US, and how the Obama closure plan should be assessed. The minister said the Netherlands opposes Guantánamo and welcomes steps toward closure, that it is not a transfer destination, that the US request is repeated at official level, and that the earlier condition of further US steps will not yet be reconsidered.

It is therefore too early to reconsider the government's earlier conclusion that the US request to accept detainees from Guantánamo will only be considered after the US has taken further meaningful steps toward closing the detention facility, including prosecution of the remaining detainees.

Het is daarmee te vroeg om de eerdere conclusie van het kabinet dat het Amerikaanse verzoek tot opname van gedetineerden uit Guantánamo pas in overweging zal worden genomen nadat de VS verdere betekenisvolle stappen heeft gezet richting sluiting van de detentiefaciliteit, inclusief berechting van de overgebleven gedetineerden, te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over de executie van een Palestijn door een Israëlische soldaat

MPs Sjoerdsma and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about a video showing an Israeli soldier executing a wounded Palestinian, and about reports of extrajudicial killings, asking whether the government had raised this bilaterally and in the EU and would press for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the government was shocked, that the EU consistently urges Israel to ensure responses are necessary and proportionate, and that Israel's Ministry of Defence has opened an investigation which the Netherlands will follow closely.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the progress of Israeli investigations into its own conduct.
Nederland zal het verloop van Israëlische onderzoeken naar eigen optreden nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over sancties tegen Rusland

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether he opposed a German minister's push to lift Russia sanctions, a proposed EU-Russia free trade deal, and the conditions for keeping sanctions tied to the Minsk agreements and Crimea. The minister replied that sanctions stay linked to full Minsk implementation and Crimea non-recognition, that lifting them is not on the table, and that a free trade deal and a High Representative visit to Moscow are not currently planned.
A possible easing of the sanctions is currently not on the agenda.
Een eventuele verlichting van de sancties is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about information given to Thai authorities on the Dutch coffeeshop toleration policy, the Thai conviction of a former coffeeshop owner for laundering drug money, the prosecutor's role, and police testimony. The minister answered most questions in substance, withheld Thai and ongoing-investigation documents, and rejected the claim that the conviction exposes Dutch coffeeshop operators to prosecution.
I cannot provide any documents on this, as they are Thai documents in the Thai criminal investigation.
Ik kan eventuele stukken hierover niet verstrekken, nu dit Thaise stukken betreffen in het Thaise strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de nijpende situatie van Lesbische, Homo-, Biseksuelen en Transgenders (LHBT's) in Indonesië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dijkstra asked the government about rising hostility toward LGBT people in Indonesia, including declarations of war by militant groups and stigmatising remarks by ministers. The minister answered that the Netherlands is monitoring the situation, raised concerns with Indonesian ministers, supports NGO and HIV programmes, and will raise human rights in the EU-Indonesia dialogue.
The cabinet shares the view that the stigmatisation of and negative statements about LGBT people are undesirable.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de stigmatisering van en negatieve uitspraken over LHBT's onwenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over luchtaanvallen in Irak en Syrië

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Dutch government about civilian casualties from anti-IS coalition airstrikes in Iraq and Syria, Dutch involvement in specific strikes, and transparency. The government said exact civilian casualty numbers cannot be determined, that Dutch involvement cannot be fully ruled out in the cited strikes, that two possible civilian-casualty cases from Dutch strikes are under investigation, and that it will press for greater coalition transparency.
For operational reasons, no details of the individual investigations are released. The House will be informed of the outcomes.
Om operationele redenen worden geen details vrijgegeven van de afzonderlijke onderzoeken. De Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het gratieverzoek van een Nederlands staatsburger gedetineerd in een Amerikaanse gevangenis

The MP asks whether the government has supported a clemency request on humanitarian grounds for a Dutch national detained in a US prison, whether that request has been filed, and whether the Prime Minister discussed it with the Californian governor. The government answers that it has repeatedly expressed Dutch support for both the parole and clemency requests, including via the ambassador and a Prime Minister letter, and declines to speculate on the timing of the US decision.
I do not want to speculate on the answer to the question of when the American authorities will decide on the requests of Mr. S.
Ik wil niet speculeren over het antwoord op de vraag wanneer de Amerikaanse autoriteiten gaan beslissen op de verzoeken van de heer S.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de opmerkingen van het OM over de vervolging van Julio Poch in Argentinië

MPs Sjoerdsma asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about remarks attributed to the Public Prosecution Service on the Argentine prosecution of Julio Poch, whether a fair trial was assured, and whether an independent trial observer would be sent. The minister replied that the quoted remark came from an anonymous source not identified as the Dutch prosecutor, that the Dutch state's cooperation was judged lawful by a civil court, and that the state does not interfere in foreign proceedings beyond routine consular assistance.
The Dutch State cooperated in the arrest of Mr Poch in Spain by providing information about his travel movements.
De Nederlandse Staat heeft meegewerkt aan de aanhouding van de heer Poch in Spanje door informatie te verschaffen over zijn reisbewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat er meer aanwijzingen zijn voor asieltolken met banden met het dictatoriale regime in Eritrea

MPs Voortman and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that IND interpreters for asylum procedures may have ties to the Eritrean regime, and about the BV&I report, prior IND investigations, AIVD involvement, handling of other interpreters, notification of other employers, and the adequacy of IND selection and controls. The State Secretary declined to share individual dossiers, said the IND followed the code of conduct in 2014, reported that other Eritrean interpreters were invited for interviews with further investigation ongoing, and announced an external review of the integrity process.

As I already explained during the committee meeting of 12 November, I do not consider it correct to share dossiers on individual persons with whom a working relationship exists or has existed with the House.

Zoals ik tijdens het AO van 12 november jl. reeds heb toegelicht, acht ik het niet correct om dossiers over individuele personen met wie een werkrelatie bestaat, of heeft bestaan, met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het vermeende Oekraïense filmpje dat op internet is geplaatst

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the government is aware of reports that a threatening Ukrainian video against the Netherlands was a forgery, and whether it would promptly investigate the video's origin and share the results with parliament. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion disavow the threats, and said the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, without committing to an investigation or disclosure.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland de Nederlandse politiek financieel beïnvloedt

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia has tried to influence Dutch politics, financially or otherwise, including the upcoming referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, and whether the Netherlands would follow up on a reported US investigation. Minister Koenders answered that the AIVD reports Russian influence efforts in general but the government has no indications of improper Russian influence on the referendum or of clandestine funding of Dutch parties, declined to comment on possible intelligence investigations, and saw no reason to ask US authorities.
No public statements can be made about any possible investigations by the Dutch intelligence services.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen gedaan worden over eventuele onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, De Roon, Van Bommel en Knops over de deelneming van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from D66, PVV, SP and CDA asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how many airstrikes against ISIS were carried out by Arab coalition partners (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Jordan) and when they last struck. The minister answered that the US publishes total coalition strike counts without a breakdown by partner, that Bahrain was omitted from earlier answers by mistake, and that the precise share of Arab partners' airstrikes is not disclosed publicly.
No public statements are made about the precise share (number of airstrikes) of Arab allies in the air campaign against ISIS.
Over het precieze aandeel (aantallen luchtaanvallen) van Arabische bondgenoten in de luchtcampagne in de strijd tegen ISIS worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht dat ‘Eritrese meisjes moeten wegblijven uit deze kerk’ en ‘Twintig Eritrese vluchtelingen uit Oranje zwanger na bezoeken aan Rotterdamse kerk?’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked about reports that Eritrean girls should stay away from a Rotterdam church after about twenty Eritrean asylum seekers became pregnant, and what COA and Nidos did with warning signals. The government answered that COA received unverified signals, took precautionary measures such as banning unaccompanied minors from visiting the church, reported to police, and that police and prosecutors found no criminal suspicion so far, while withholding details of individual pregnancies under medical confidentiality.

The National Prosecutor's Office will explore the possibilities to examine the signals of possible abuses within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands at national level and in a multidisciplinary manner.

Het Landelijk Parket van het OM zal de mogelijkheden verkennen om de signalen van mogelijke misstanden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland op landelijk niveau en op multidisciplinaire wijze nader te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de verslechtering van de situatie in Venezuela

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about Venezuela's economic emergency decree, Maduro's plan to rule by decree, the removal of parliament's control over the central bank and doubts about the Supreme Court's independence. Minister Ploumen answered that the decree curbs parliament's economic role and strengthens state control, that the Supreme Court is largely under government influence, and that the government keeps a constant dialogue with Venezuela's government and opposition, without announcing new concrete steps.
The government's decree reduces the chance of dialogue between government and parliament and the chances of constructive cooperation in tackling the severe economic crisis Venezuela is in.

Het decreet van de regering vermindert de kans op dialoog tussen regering en parlement en de kansen op constructieve samenwerking in de aanpak van de zware economische crisis waarin Venezuela zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a former Dutch coffeeshop owner sentenced in Thailand to 103 years (effectively 20), including whether Dutch authorities initiated the prosecution and whether the Dutch tolerance policy was explained to Thai authorities. The minister declined to judge the foreign ruling, said the Thai authorities were informed of Dutch tolerance policy, refused to share the liaison officer's letter citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and gave a partial account of embassy contacts.
Can you send this letter to the House? Answer 8: The investigation referred to is part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Kunt u deze brief aan de Kamer zenden? Antwoord 8 Het onderzoek waarnaar wordt verwezen is onderdeel van een nog lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over studenten die zijn opgepakt in West-Sahara

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch student and nine Norwegian students detained and escorted out of Western Sahara by Moroccan police, including the reasons, legal basis, whether a record was made, and whether the Dutch embassy was informed and provided consular help. The minister confirmed the events, said Morocco cited an unauthorised 'political visit', that no record was drawn up and no prosecution started, and that the embassy checked with the Norwegian embassy and found no need for further consular assistance, with the case to be raised in EU human rights dialogue.
If not, why not? Answer 11: This case will be taken up in the Dutch efforts to promote human rights in Morocco and Western Sahara.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 11 Deze zaak zal worden meegenomen bij de Nederlandse inzet bij de bevordering van de mensenrechten in Marokko en de Westelijke Sahara.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de primaire radargegevens van de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Public Prosecution Service told the minister that primary radar data for the MH17 investigation was no longer needed, and how such oral communications are recorded. The minister confirmed the prosecution's oral statements of 14 and 19 January that no further radar requests were needed, said oral and written briefings have equal status, and declined to have them put in writing, citing rechtshulp requests already made.
Oral information is not registered as such in the administration.
Mondelinge inlichtingen worden niet als zodanig in de administratie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het bericht 'Regering negeert referendumstem vanuit het buitenland'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked the Interior Minister how the government mobilises Dutch citizens abroad to vote, including in the Ukraine association referendum, and why postal voting and repeated registration are used. The minister answered that information was provided via websites, banners, social media, embassies and municipal registers, that internet voting was shelved for security and cost reasons, and that a bill for permanent registration is pending.
I am of the view that everything necessary is being done to enable Dutch voters abroad to vote.
Ik ben van oordeel dat al het nodige wordt gedaan om stemgerechtigde Nederlanders in het buitenland in de gelegenheid te stellen om te gaan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het zikavirus

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about Zika virus information for pregnant women, travel advice consistency with Belgium, and implementation of a motion on a medical rapid-response unit. The minister answered that information is provided via RIVM, LCR and foreign affairs channels, that the Netherlands follows WHO advice without a negative travel advice, and that Dutch contributions to the EU medical corps and WHO reform are underway.
The RIVM follows the WHO advice unless conditions in the Netherlands are so different that they justify different advice.
Het RIVM volgt de advisering van de WHO tenzij de omstandigheden in Nederland zo anders zijn dat dit een andere advisering rechtvaardigt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over ontbrekende primaire radargegevens, de ontbrekende satellietbeelden en het ontbrekende gesprek met de luchtverkeerleider in het onderzoek van de Onderzoeksraad vo

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the government about missing primary radar data, missing satellite images and the absence of an interview with the Ukrainian air traffic controller in the OVV's MH17 investigation. The minister answered that the OVV is independent, that its conclusions are not affected by the missing data, and that the government facilitated the investigation while declining to detail which information was requested from partner states.
Disclosure would give insight into the course of the investigation and could put pressure on ongoing discussions with requested states.
Openbaarmaking zou inzicht geven in de loop van het onderzoek en lopende besprekingen met aangezochte staten onder druk kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over executies in Saudi-Arabië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the mass execution of 47 people in Saudi Arabia, including whether the trials were fair and independently observed, and what the government had done bilaterally and through the EU to voice concern. The minister answered that the trials followed local law but independent verification is impossible, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns bilaterally, backed an EU High Representative statement, and will send the human rights ambassador to Riyadh.
However, this is impossible to establish independently, because, as far as is known, no evidence has ever been made public in these cases.
Dit is echter onmogelijk onafhankelijk vast te stellen, omdat er, voor zover bekend, in deze zaken nooit bewijzen openbaar zijn gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon en Voordewind over de deelname van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Arab coalition partners such as Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE and Jordan have stopped bombing ISIS, citing a US statement, and requested monthly strike figures per country. The government declined to confirm the claims or publish country-level data, citing operational classified information and the need to present the coalition as one entity, though it listed the participating countries and aggregate sortie figures and did not meet the requested deadline.
Information on who carried out which bombings and when is not shared publicly.
Informatie over wie wanneer welke bombardementen heeft uitgevoerd, wordt niet in het openbaar gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het feitenrelaas over professor Maat

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about missing documents in the Maat case, the drafting of the police chief's letter, why it went to the Director-General, and when the Wob appeal decision would come. The Minister answered that missing documents were added to the file, listed the notes received, explained the drafting changes, and said the Wob decision follows statutory deadlines with a hearing expected mid-February 2016.
The incomplete file that Professor Maat viewed on 23 November 2015 did not contain the internal memo from the Algemeen Commandanten.
Het onvolledige dossier dat professor Maat op 23 november 2015 heeft ingezien bevatte niet het interne memo van de Algemeen Commandanten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Russische luchtaanval op een Syrische markt

MP Sjoerdsma asked the government about a reported Russian airstrike on a Syrian market in Idlib, including civilian deaths, alleged cluster munitions, and whether Russia should join the Cluster Munitions Convention. Minister Koenders answered that the government cannot confirm the casualty figures or cluster munition use, supports universalisation of the convention, and favours independent investigation but notes access inside Syria is blocked.
The cabinet has no information that can confirm this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die dit kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het politieonderzoek naar professor Maat, dat de minister keer op keer op keer weigerde om openbaar te maken

MPs Omtzigt and others asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police investigation into professor Maat's MH17 role was kept confidential and heavily redacted under the Wob, and whether the termination of his cooperation was justified. The minister answered that the file was made available to parliament confidentially under article 68 of the Constitution, that redactions protected officials' personal policy views and witness cooperation, and that he apologised to Maat for reacting too emotionally.
the file, including the witness statements, has been made available for confidential inspection by your House since 2 December 2015.
het dossier, waaronder de getuigenverklaringen, vanaf 2 december 2015 ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de vergunning verleend aan Urenco voor de export van 1000 ton verarmd uranium naar Rusland

D66 MPs asked how the ANVS issued a transport permit for depleted uranium to Russia despite a text error, what risks, oversight and Russian end-use guarantees apply, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The government admits the error should not have been issued, says it was corrected by amendment, and defends the export licence as legally permissible with formal Russian guarantees, declining to withdraw it.
I regret the error made. The ANVS has in the meantime taken measures so that a strict application of the justification principle will apply from now on.
Ik betreur de gemaakte fout. Er zijn intussen door de ANVS maatregelen getroffen die er toe leiden dat voortaan sprake zal zijn van een strikte toepassing van het rechtvaardigingsbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een nieuwe Russische wet waarmee het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens terzijde kan worden geschoven

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how to view a new Russian law letting the Constitutional Court declare ECtHR judgments unenforceable, and whether Russia might invoke it more often. The minister called it very worrying, said Russia is bound to enforce ECtHR rulings, raised the issue in Council of Europe bodies, but declined to predict the law's future use and did not commit to a state complaint.
The Russian Federation is being addressed on this new law within the Council of Europe framework, including by Secretary General Jagland and in the Committee of Ministers.
De Russische Federatie wordt binnen de kaders van de Raad van Europa, onder meer door Secretaris-Generaal Jagland en binnen het Comité van Ministers, aangesproken op deze nieuwe wet.
Antwoord op vraag 3 van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over leveringen van ‘dual use’ goederen

Two D66 MPs asked whether the minister had contacted Imtech about an internal investigation showing at least 51 shipments of dual-use goods to denied entities. The minister answers that the company applied for no export licences, that the ministry did contact RH Marine Group and reviewed the investigation, and that customs has been asked to investigate while licence applications are held.
After inspection, customs was asked to conduct an investigation.
Na inzage is de douane gevraagd een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat een man al dertien jaar ten onrechte vastzit in Guantánamo Bay

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a man was wrongly held in Guantánamo Bay for thirteen years due to a name mix-up, the number of detainees never charged, whether the Netherlands would press the US to close the facility, which countries have taken detainees, and whether the Netherlands will accept some approved-for-transfer detainees. The minister said the details of the case are unknown to the cabinet, gave the detainee count and review process, reiterated that Guantánamo should close, and said no decision has been taken on the US request to accept 1-2 detainees, to be considered only after further meaningful US steps.
The details of this case are not known to the cabinet.
De details van deze zaak zijn niet bekend bij het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over een aan Urenco verleende vergunning voor de levering van verarmd uranium aan Rusland

MPs from D66 asked whether a November 2015 transport permit for up to 1,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride to Russia, and the related export licence, were justified given the sanctions climate, Russian plutonium and weapons risks, storage conditions and Euratom rules. The government answered that the permit wrongly mentions depleted uranium (only natural UF6 is covered, with a textual error to be corrected), that the export is civil and subject to Russian formal guarantees and IAEA safeguards, and that transport risks are low; several questions were answered by restating the regulatory framework.
The textual error will be corrected as soon as possible and the transport permit will be amended.
De tekstuele fout zal zo snel mogelijk worden hersteld en de vervoersvergunning zal worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van Koning Willem-Alexander aan China

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether the King's private holiday in China before the state visit, and his failure to voice human rights concerns personally, undermined the message on human rights in China. The minister replied that the King raised human rights in the banquet speech and at CELAP, that the government consistently prioritises human rights, and that a dialogue is maintained.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze opvatting niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de professor die uit het MH17 team gezet werd en het onderzoek daarna, dat totaal onleesbaar aan de Kamer gestuurd is

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked why the police investigation into Professor Maat's removal from the MH17 team was largely blacked out when released under the Wob, and why the minister had not disclosed the witness statements and the conversation report. The minister defended the redactions on Wob grounds and personal policy views, but agreed to place the investigation documents for confidential inspection by parliament from 2 December 2015.

To respond further to your Chamber's request for information, the relevant documents from the police fact-finding investigation will be placed for confidential inspection by your Chamber from 2 December 2015.
Om nader op de informatievraag van uw Kamer in te gaan liggen per 2 december 2015 de betreffende stukken van het feitenonderzoek van de politie ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Volp en Servaes over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de United Nations General Assembly Special Session (UNGASS) on the World Drug Problem die in 2016 zal plaatsvinden

Four MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch policy for the 2016 UN drugs special session had changed, whether the Netherlands should back regulated cannabis cultivation, and how death penalty cases for drug offences would be handled. The government answered that the Dutch position has not changed, that it opposes regulated cannabis cultivation and mayors' calls for it, and that it works to end the death penalty for drug offences while noting three Dutch nationals face such sentences.
Regulation/legalisation of cannabis cultivation is not cabinet policy, so it is not appropriate for the Netherlands to take the leading role the questioners propose at the UNGASS.
Regulering/legalisering van de hennepteelt is geen kabinetsbeleid en het ligt daarom niet voor de hand bij de UNGASS een door de vragenstellers beoogde voortrekkersrol op dit vlak te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de in Suriname vermiste helikopter met een Nederlander aan boord

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked about the status of Dutch assistance in searching for a helicopter missing in Suriname with a Dutch national aboard, and what Dutch help was offered. The minister replied that Dutch search-and-rescue expertise was offered and used, but the Netherlands lacks the requested foliage-penetrating radar and will consider any future Surinamese request.
The Netherlands had to conclude that the request could not be met.
Nederland heeft moeten constateren dat niet aan het verzoek kon worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over een niet-aanvalspact tussen Europa en China op het gebied van cyber

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether the Dutch cyber envoy is negotiating a digital non-aggression pact between Europe and China, and related questions on its purpose, mandate and participants. The government answered that no such negotiations took place; the envoy only joined an informal dialogue on cyber norms, and the government promised no further information on a pact.
There was no question of negotiations on a 'non-aggression treaty' during the meeting on 26 and 27 October.
Van onderhandelingen over een «niet-aanvalsverdrag» was geen sprake tijdens de bijeenkomst op 26 en 27 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Klein en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Turkije actieplan migratie

MPs Voortman, Klein and Sjoerdsma asked about the sequencing, financing, Turkish commitments, Frontex data exchange, accession talks and migration law reform under the EU-Turkey migration action plan. The minister answered that the plan sets no sequence or fixed amounts, that Dutch funding awaits further talks, and that details will be worked out later with Turkey.
Neither the action plan nor the European Council conclusions contain target amounts or worked-out agreements on financing and spending.
Het actieplan noch de ER-conclusies bevatten streefbedragen of uitgewerkte afspraken over financiering en besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over gelijke rechten voor LHBT's in de SDG's

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would challenge Saudi Arabia over reports it wanted LGBT rights removed from the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and about Saudi membership of the Consultative Group of the Human Rights Council and the Cairo Declaration. The minister answered that LGBT rights were never explicitly included in the SDGs, that the non-discrimination and Leave No One Behind principles apply to everyone, and that the Universal Declaration remains the leading standard, without committing to new action against Saudi Arabia.
It is worth stressing that there was never any explicit inclusion of equal rights for LGBT persons in the SDGs.
Daarbij is het goed te benadrukken dat er nooit sprake is geweest van expliciete opname van gelijke rechten voor LHBT's in de SDG's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van de bezuiniging op Nederlands onderwijs in het buitenland

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Education about the expected effects of ending direct subsidies to Dutch schools abroad, including school closures and falling quality, as predicted by an ITS study. The State Secretary maintained that parents are responsible for funding, pointed to temporary transitional funding and NOB support, and said effects will vary by school and that the government will keep working to minimise them.
The ITS study gives insight into schools' expectations of how they will act when the temporary subsidy to schools ends on 1 January 2017.
Het onderzoek door ITS geeft inzicht in de verwachtingen van scholen hoe zij zullen handelen wanneer de tijdelijke subsidie aan scholen op 1 januari 2017 eindigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over Dublin overdrachten naar Hongarije

MPs Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma and Voordewind asked about reports of poor reception conditions in Hungary, continued Dublin transfers there, and whether transfers should be suspended. The State Secretary answered that Dublin transfers to Hungary continue under the mutual trust principle, that the matter is before the Council of State, and that no concrete suspension is planned.
As answered to the questions from MPs Voortman, Kuiken and Maij, I maintain the principle of inter-state trust towards Hungary and see insufficient reason to suspend Dublin transfers.

Zoals geantwoord op de vragen van de leden Voortman, Kuiken en Maij houd ik vast aan het interstatelijke vertrouwensbeginsel ten opzichte van Hongarije en zie ik onvoldoende aanleiding om Dublinoverdrachten op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over “ongewenste beïnvloeding van de stemming voor de Nederlandse mensenrechtenprijs ‘De Tulp’”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the public vote for the Dutch human rights prize De Tulp was influenced by the right-wing group My Israel urging voters not to vote for B'Tselem, and what consequences follow. The minister said My Israel's call likely affected the vote, given about 50,000 of 70,853 votes came from Israel, but that it could not establish any state financing and that the government would not take further action beyond noting safeguards in the voting process.
It is unclear whether and how My Israel receives funding.
Het is onduidelijk of en op welke wijze «My Israel« financiering ontvangt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Saudi-Arabië een 21-jarige man gaat onthoofden en kruisigen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Saudi Arabia would behead and crucify a 21-year-old Shia activist, whether the Dutch embassy monitored his trial, whether the government would make a demarche or press for his release in EU channels, and about the charges and the UN Human Rights Council chair appointment. The minister said the government is shocked, the embassy followed but did not attend the trial, the EU and member states will raise concerns, and the Netherlands had no role in the appointment.
The Netherlands has consulted with other (EU) partners about this sentence and about the most effective action by the international community.
Nederland heeft zich met andere (EU-)partners beraad over deze straf en over de meest effectieve inzet door de internationale gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over de detentie van een Nederlands staatsburger in het buitenland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Berndsen-Jansen asked why the government refuses to transfer Dutch detainee Mr Singh from the US and why WOTS requests are refused for Dutch citizens abroad for more than five years. The minister answered that transfer requires sufficient ties with the Netherlands and a remaining sentence of at least four months, neither of which is met, and that the five-year rule is only an indication while medical situation is subordinate to resocialisation.
In this case neither of the two criteria is met.
In deze casus wordt aan beide criteria niet voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over het bericht van de uitzetting van twee kinderen

MPs Voortman, Sjoerdsma and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a family including two children was detained in a closed family facility, whether the children should await appeal in the Netherlands, and whether the 10-year policy for relatives of 1F persons applies to the Children's Pardon. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, noted the family has been released, said the children's pardon scheme excludes relatives of 1F persons, and said the appeal rule applies only when the claim is upheld.
Beyond that, I will not go into the considerations in individual cases.
Voor het overige ga ik niet in op (de afwegingen in) individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek dat gedaan is naar de gang van zaken rond de presentatie van een professor m.b.t. de ramp met de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Security and Justice to publish the police investigation behind the 10 June letter on the presentations by Professor Maat about the MH17 victim identification, and to clarify who was interviewed, when statements were signed, what agreements existed, and how the photos were shared. The Minister answered that large parts of the internal fact-finding report will be made public in anonymised form once personal data is protected, gave Maat access without secrecy, acknowledged the handling of photos was not careful and that formal rules are being drawn up, and declined to answer the questions one by one within the regular deadline.
Following your questions and four requests under the Freedom of Information Act (Wob) that have since been received, the police have considered the possible publication of the investigation.

Mede naar aanleiding van uw vragen en vier verzoeken op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob), die inmiddels zijn ontvangen, heeft de politie de mogelijke openbaarmaking van het onderzoek bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het farmaceutische bedrijf Mylan

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch pharmaceutical firm Mylan supplies drugs used in US executions and what it will do to prevent this. The minister answered that Mylan refused to give a guarantee, that the government expects further steps, and that EU export controls and the OECD complaint process are being pursued.

Since the answer to the parliamentary questions mentioned in question 1, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has had repeated contact on this matter with Mylan itself, investor APG, the NGO Reprieve, and the lawyer Stapert.
Sinds de beantwoording van de in vraag 1 genoemde Kamervragen heeft het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken over deze kwestie verschillende malen contact gehad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Nederland gepoogd zou hebben de immuniteit van Saoedi-Arabische ambassadeurs op te heffen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands tried repeatedly and at high level to lift the immunity of Saudi ambassadors suspected of human trafficking, and about the handling of complaints and the status of a prior immunity review. The minister declined to comment on the leaked reports and on individual cases, citing privacy and confidentiality, and referred to a separate letter on the immunity review.
The cabinet does not make statements about such requests because they may involve privacy-sensitive information.
Het kabinet doet geen mededelingen over dergelijke verzoeken omdat het om privacy-gevoelige informatie kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over recente berichten dat Palestijnse landbouwgrond is vernietigd door Israël

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether reports of Israeli forces destroying Palestinian farmland near Bethlehem and Nablus are true, what damage was done, whether Dutch-funded projects were affected and whether compensation has been paid. The government confirms destruction at the Bethlehem site, says it has protested to Israeli authorities, has no legal basis to claim compensation, and notes a recent rise in demolitions.
The cabinet does not have data on the damage caused there.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gegevens over de schade die daar is aangericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat militaire trucks zijn geleverd aan Sudan zonder exportlicentie en in weerwil van het EU wapenembargo

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether Dutch firm Van Vliet Trucks sold ex-German military trucks to Sudan without an export licence despite the EU arms embargo, and how this fits with the 2008 resale policy. The minister answered that demilitarised trucks fall outside Dutch export licensing, so no licence was needed and the buyer was private, while acknowledging an interpretation difference with Germany and promising to examine aligning Dutch policy with Germany's.
Because there was no licence requirement and the recipient was private, the transactions were not notified to the Dutch export control authorities.
Omdat er geen vergunningsplicht geldt en omdat er sprake was van een private ontvanger, zijn de transacties niet aangemeld bij de Nederlandse exportcontrole-autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de wereldwijde oproep van ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken om het Internationaal Strafhof te steunen en misdadigers te berechten

Deputy Sjoerdsma asks why the Netherlands, as host of the International Criminal Court, did not sign the 2015 joint call by 16 foreign ministers to support the ICC, and whether it will now endorse it publicly. Minister Koenders replies that the Netherlands knew of the Liechtenstein initiative, already strongly supports the ICC, and welcomed the call, but that it sought a more regionally diverse set of signatories, which did not materialise in the short timeframe.
The Netherlands regularly raises the Court in multilateral forums and bilateral talks, facilitates the annual UN General Assembly resolution on the Court
Nederland brengt het Strafhof regelmatig op in multilaterale fora en bilaterale gesprekken, faciliteert de jaarlijkse resolutie in de AVVN over het Strafhof
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de arrestatie van Carvajal en dreigende inval van Venezuela op Aruba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about the arrest of Venezuelan official Carvajal on Aruba, reports of Venezuelan warships approaching Aruba, and whether there was a military threat. The government answered that Carvajal enjoyed consular immunity under the Vienna Convention and was released, that the Venezuelan naval vessels were in Venezuelan territorial waters, that no military threats were made, and it answered most questions in substance while declining to comment on the exact words attributed to the Prime Minister.
The cabinet has taken note of the reports.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over verschillende reisadviezen door lidstaten van de Europese Unie

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister why EU member states give differing travel advice for the same countries, such as Nepal, Croatia and Israel, and whether a single EU-wide travel advice is desirable. The minister replied that consular assistance is a national competence, that Nepal's advice was relaxed on 15 July 2015, that the Netherlands seeks more EU coordination without a single European advice, but that the safety of Dutch citizens comes first.
Consular assistance to nationals abroad is a national competence for all EU member states.
Consulaire bijstand aan landgenoten in het buitenland is voor alle EU lidstaten een nationale competentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over mensenrechtenschendingen in Zuid-Sudan

An MP asked the minister about a UN report on rape and live burning of women and girls in South Sudan by government forces, and whether sanctions and abortion access would follow. The government condemned the abuses, pointed to UN Human Rights Council and Security Council sanctions steps and possible further EU listings, and committed to supporting access to medical care including safe abortion in conflict settings.
The cabinet considers it urgently necessary that these abuses be investigated and that the perpetrators be tracked down and not escape punishment.
Het kabinet acht het dringend noodzakelijk dat deze misstanden worden onderzocht en dat de daders worden opgespoord en hun straf niet ontlopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Nederlanders die klem zitten in Jemen

An MP asks why the Netherlands no longer carries out evacuations from Yemen, how many Dutch nationals remain and want to leave, and whether the government will fund IOM evacuation operations. The minister answers that the Netherlands cannot evacuate itself, that 40 Dutch nationals have left with help, six remain, and that the government relies on IOM and other states, with no new funding committed.
The Netherlands does not carry out evacuations itself, but does help Dutch nationals to leave.
Nederland voert zelf geen evacuaties uit, maar helpt Nederlanders wel om te vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht van Human Rights Watch dat Saoedi-Arabië clusterbommen gebruikt in Jemen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Saudi Arabia used cluster munitions in Yemen, as reported by Human Rights Watch, and whether the government would press parties and non-party states to renounce or join the cluster munitions convention. The minister said the government could not confirm the reports, that the UN human rights office and the US were investigating, and that Nederland would raise concerns at the June 2015 meeting and encourage non-parties to accede.

However, the Netherlands will raise concerns about this very worrying Human Rights Watch report at the next meeting of the Cluster Munitions Convention (June 2015) and ask the parties involved for more information.

Wel zullen namens Nederland naar aanleiding van dit zeer verontrustende bericht van Human Rights Watch tijdens de eerstvolgende bijeenkomst van het Clustermunitieverdrag (juni 2015) zorgen over dit bericht worden uitgesproken en de betrokken partijen om meer informatie worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat België de politiesamenwerking met Burundi en steun aan verkiezingen opschort

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Belgium's suspension of police cooperation with Burundi, including whether Dutch-trained police had shot civilians, whether the Netherlands would follow suit, and whether other bilateral aid would be suspended. The government answered that these questions had already been answered in a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163), so no new substantive answer was given here.

The written questions from MP Sjoerdsma (D66), question number 2015Z08596, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request regarding the situation in Burundi and answers to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma (D66), vraagnummer 2015Z08596 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over het bericht dat Engeland ruim vijf miljard pond heeft uitgegeven aan wapenexport naar landen die op de zwarte lijst staan wegens mensenrechtenschendingen

Two Dutch MPs asked the ministers about a UK parliamentary report criticising British arms exports to countries of human rights concern, and about how EU member states can hold each other to account on arms export policy. The government answered that licensing decisions are national competences, that the UK report lacks end-use data, and that it will consult partners on the D66/PvdA proposals for an EU arms export authority and a right to challenge, which it considers constrained by EU-national competence division.
The cabinet will nevertheless consult European partners on this idea, starting with the most like-minded on further EU harmonisation.
Het kabinet zal de Europese partners evenwel over dit idee consulteren, om te beginnen de meest gelijkgestemden op het gebied van verdere EU-harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over opgepakte Nederlandse jihadisten bij de Turks-Syrische grens door Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked how many Dutch jihadists Turkey has detained at the Syrian border, what happens to them, whether agreements or extradition requests exist, and what the Netherlands does to stop those released from returning or travelling again. The minister answers that about 10 Dutch nationals were reported by Turkey since early 2015, that Turkey deports them, that no specific agreements exist, that extradition has not been considered so far, and lists Dutch measures such as passport invalidation, alerts and a pending travel-ban bill.
On whether there is an intention to submit extradition requests, no answer can be given in view of the interests of investigation and prosecution.
Op de vraag of het voornemen bestaat uitleveringsverzoeken in te dienen, kan met het oog op belangen van opsporing en vervolging geen antwoord gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de uitgifte van Turkse paspoorten aan jihadgangers. Deze vragen werden ingezonden op 15 april 2015

MPs asked whether reports that over 100,000 Turkish passports were given to ISIS fighters, and that around 50,000 Uyghurs joined ISIS through a loophole in Turkish law, are true, and what Turkey does with detained jihadists and to prevent departures. The minister said the government has no independent information to verify the claims, that Dutch jihadists are removed from Turkey after procedures with Dutch authorities informed, and that Turkey cooperates with origin countries and in the anti-ISIS coalition working group.
The cabinet does not have independent information to verify the claims in this article.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de beweringen in dit artikel te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Servaes, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en De Roon over het nucleair akkoord met Iran

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the framework nuclear deal with Iran, covering its assessment, the timing of sanctions relief, regional effects, human rights, EU and Dutch contributions, and prospects before the 30 June deadline. The minister welcomed the framework, said sanctions relief will be tied to Iranian steps and reinstated if Iran breaches the deal, and answered several questions only in general terms while leaving the concrete sequencing and any full assessment for later.
The cabinet will send a written response on the various aspects of the comprehensive agreement to the House once it is definitively concluded.
Het kabinet zal een schriftelijke reactie op de verschillende deelaspecten van het alomvattend akkoord naar de Kamer sturen als dit definitief is gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de toegang van Nederlanders in het buitenland tot DigiD

An MP asked the Interior Minister why DigiD access for Dutch citizens abroad remains limited to few municipalities and why the Antwerp consulate pilot was stopped, and whether consultations and evaluations took place. The minister replied that the pilot was redesigned, will end on 31 May 2015 and become regular service, municipalities and selected embassies will be added in phases, and agreed that access to DigiD for citizens abroad should be facilitated.

The new process provides for a digital application (integrated in the website www.digid.nl) and a one-time visit to a participating issuing desk where the identity of the Dutch non-resident is checked and verified.

Het nieuwe proces voorziet in een digitale aanvraag (geïntegreerd in de website www.digid.nl ) en een eenmalig bezoek aan een deelnemende uitgiftebalie waarbij de identiteit van de Nederlandse niet-ingezetene wordt gecontroleerd en vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de vervolgings- en berechtingsstrategie van verdachten van het neerhalen van vlucht MH17 op 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the prosecution and trial strategy for suspects in the downing of MH17, including promised notes, possible trials in absentia, extradition, and amnesty under Minsk-2. The government said no prosecution strategy can be disclosed yet to protect the criminal investigation, but it reaffirmed that prosecution is the goal and promised to inform parliament once the investigation allows.
Releasing prosecution strategies prematurely is not in the interest of the investigation.
Het voortijdig naar buiten brengen van vervolgingsstrategieën is niet in het belang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de onderzoeken naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the authenticity and sharing of a leaked July 2014 Kiev briefing memo, ICAO and airspace warnings over Crimea, information sharing with airlines, Dutch–Ukrainian and Minsk arrangements for the crash site, and the state secrecy of MCCb MH17 minutes. The government largely refused to release the briefing memo and MCCb minutes on confidentiality grounds, while describing remedial steps such as the ICAO website pilot and planned consultations with airlines.
For the same reason, the cabinet will also not share the document with which the essence of the briefing was shared with other departments.
Om diezelfde reden zal het kabinet ook het document waarmee de essentie van de briefing is gedeeld met andere departementen niet delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sjoerdsma over de Amerikaanse sancties tegen Venezuela

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would respond to US sanctions on Venezuela, join calls for release of political prisoners, and impose person-targeted sanctions or adjust relations with Venezuela. Minister Koenders answered that the US measures concern a bilateral matter, the EU has voiced concern over detained opposition members and students, and diplomatic channels should be kept open to promote dialogue.
It is in the interest of the Kingdom that diplomatic channels function well, that incidents are prevented and interests can be served.
Het is in het belang van het Koninkrijk dat de diplomatieke kanalen goed functioneren, dat incidenten worden voorkomen en belangen kunnen worden behartigd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes en Sjoerdsma over De ontvoering van tenminste 150 Syrische christenen

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the reported abduction of at least 150 Syrian Christians by ISIS, about Dutch military and material support to Kurdish forces in Iraq, how minority protection is built into the anti-ISIS strategy, and how the international community could secure the hostages' release. The minister answered that Dutch support (helmets, vests, instructor teams, humanitarian aid) is aimed at training Peshmerga who protect all civilians, that inclusiveness and minority protection are addressed in training and EU policy, and that no ground options exist for freeing the hostages, while about twenty had been released.
Yes. Question 2: What material and military support has the Netherlands by now given to the Kurds in Iraq?
Ja. Vraag 2 Welke materiële en militaire steun heeft Nederland inmiddels gegeven aan de Koerden in Irak?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over een AOW-korting voor niet-werkende gezinsleden van Nederlandse werknemers bij diverse internationale organisaties in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch family members without their own income of staff at various international organisations in the Netherlands build no AOW pension rights because of host-state agreements, and whether this is fair. The Secretary of State answered that these exclusions follow from the seat agreements, that the organisation's wishes are decisive, that recent agreements no longer exclude resident family members, that fewer than 20 persons are affected, and that courts found the exclusion justified.

As indicated above, the exclusion from the Dutch social security system follows from the correct application of applicable seat agreements that the Netherlands has concluded with international organisations established in our country.

Zoals hierboven aangegeven vloeit de uitsluiting van het stelsel van Nederlandse sociale zekerheid voort uit de correcte toepassing van geldende zetelverdragen die Nederland heeft gesloten met in ons land gevestigde volkenrechtelijke organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse informatiepositie in aanloop naar de MH-17 ramp

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Foreign Affairs and Defence about the Dutch government's information position before the MH-17 downing, including what was known about downed aircraft, Ukrainian airspace warnings, the July 2014 Ukraine briefing and the role of the OVV and CTIVD. The government answered most questions by pointing to the ongoing OVV and prosecution investigations, stating it had no validated list of downed aircraft and that Ukraine gave no warnings beyond NOTAMs, while committing to share the briefing report and correspondence with the OVV.
We consider it of the utmost importance that the Public Prosecution Service can continue its investigation unhindered.
Wij achten het van het grootste belang dat het OM het onderzoek ongehinderd kan blijven verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Bommel over het bericht dat het vonnis van de Saoedische blogger Raif Badawi uitgevoerd zal worden

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Saudi blogger Raif Badawi would receive public flogging, and what the EU and the Netherlands were doing to prevent it. The minister said the EU and the Netherlands have repeatedly raised the case and condemned the punishment, but that it has not yet led to a revision of the sentence, and that the case was referred back to the Supreme Court.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work, both bilaterally and within the EU, to improve the situation of human rights defenders in Saudi Arabia.
Nederland zal zich zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband actief blijven inzetten om de situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Saoedi-Arabië te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de vervolging van een Nederlandse coffeeshopeigenaar in Thailand
