Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service informed Thai authorities about a Dutch coffeeshop owner's case, and why, given the Dutch gedoogbeleid and recent court rulings on back-door supply. The Minister confirmed a Dutch investigation into four Noord-Brabant coffeeshops, said the information sharing aimed to speed up a mutual legal assistance request, and stated that the case goes beyond back-door issues and that the suspect's nationality is not decisive.

The purpose of informing the Thai authorities was therefore to promote and expedite the execution of the legal assistance request in view of the progress of the criminal investigation in the Netherlands.

Het doel van het informeren van de Thaise autoriteiten was dan ook de uitvoering van het rechtshulpverzoek te bevorderen en te bespoedigen met het oog op de voortgang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over onderhandelingen met rebellen inzake MH17

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch forensic team's project leader negotiated with separatist leader Borodai over MH17 victims' repatriation, whether this contradicted the cabinet's no-direct-negotiation principle, and whether there were other such talks. The government answered that contact was via the OSCE with the embassy informed, that there was no direct negotiation, and that all contact went through the OSCE.
No. There was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Nee. Er was geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het aantal neergeschoten helikopters en vliegtuigen boven Oost-Oekraïne voorafgaand aan de ramp van 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the government how many aircraft and helicopters were shot down over eastern Ukraine before the MH17 disaster, what the cabinet knew on 17 July 2014, and related questions about Dutch monitoring, a 14 July briefing, and prosecution timing. The government answered that the numbers were unverified and no validated list could be provided, that no specific airspace consultations took place, and that prosecution options cannot yet be disclosed because the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Both the number and the causes are unclear and not validated.
Zowel het aantal als ook de oorzaken zijn onduidelijk en niet gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over gaten in de huidige ebola-hulpverlening

MPs Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about gaps in Ebola aid in West Africa, including delayed deployment of pledged UK hospital beds and whether a more flexible approach is needed. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps, points to labs, flexible NGO funding and a new NGO financing facility, but rejects the claim that aid is misaligned with needs and says there is no EU biological disaster team.
I do not share that view. WHO and UNMEER continuously analyse needs on the ground.
Ik deel die visie niet. WHO en UNMEER maken een doorlopende analyse van de noden ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the composition of the Joint Investigation Team on MH17, Malaysia's role, Ukraine's veto and non-disclosure arrangements, and who is examining the flight route decisions. The government answered that Malaysia is already formally involved and will join as a member, that the JIT agreement is confidential because it contains operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation, and that the Dutch Safety Board is examining route decisions without addressing liability.
We therefore cannot make the agreement regarding the JIT public.
De overeenkomst met betrekking tot het JIT kunnen wij daarom niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de richtlijn aangaande registratie van het geboorteland van in Palestina geboren personen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked why the civil registry directive records people born in East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip or West Bank after 14 May 1948 as birthplace 'Onbekend' rather than Palestine, and whether this causes problems. The Minister replied that the Palestine mandate ended on 14 May 1948, the territories are treated as occupied under international law, and the Netherlands has not recognised a Palestinian state, while acknowledging no problems are known and that other EU states use different practices.
For that reason, the birthplace 'Unknown' was chosen.
Om die reden is gekozen voor geboorteland «Onbekend».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over achterblijvende resultaten om meer vrouwen te betrekken bij militaire vredesmissies

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked why women remain underrepresented in the Dutch armed forces and UN peacekeeping missions, and whether further research and a revised national action plan on UNSCR 1325 are planned. The ministers answered that quality is the main criterion, that gender is treated as operationally relevant, that further research is not opportune, and that a February 2015 conference and the 2015 UN review will inform the next action plan.
Further research is not considered opportune at this time.
Nader onderzoek achten wij nu niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Schouw over Brandpunt uitzending "De lange arm van Kagame"

MPs Sjoerdsma and Schouw asked the government to respond to a Brandpunt broadcast alleging that a Rwandan whistleblower's asylum-related reports were manipulated and questioning Rwandan fair-trial guarantees. The government rejected the claims, said the matter was handled through the proper channel with the court, declined further investigation, and described Rwanda's judicial standards.
Because his statements concern individual asylum cases, the cabinet is bound by confidentiality and cannot go into concrete details.
Omdat zijn uitspraken individuele asielzaken betreffen is het kabinet gebonden aan vertrouwelijkheid en kan niet ingaan op concrete details.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het wapenembargo tegen Rusland, de Franse Mistraldeal en samenwerking tussen Europese wapenleveranciers en Russische strijdkrachten

Two MPs asked whether the Mistral helicopter carrier deal would be delivered to Russia despite the arms embargo, how Europe's arms makers could cooperate with Russian forces, and about the embargo's status and enforcement. The minister replied that France decides on delivery, that the government shares France's view that conditions are not right for delivery, that the embargo does not cover pre-August 2014 contracts, that it runs until 31 July 2015, and that the Netherlands will raise enforcement issues in Brussels.
The government has no insight into deliveries above 1 million euros from EU member states based on contracts concluded before 1 August 2014.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in leveringen van boven de 1 miljoen euro vanuit EU-lidstaten op basis van voor 1 augustus 2014 gesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over MH17 (opnieuw en nu met nagezonden bijlagen)

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about evidence on the MH17 downing, access to satellite and radar data, OSCE safety assessments, NOTAMs, shelling of the crash site, and Ukrainian search logs. The government answered that it cannot pre-empt the independent OVV and criminal investigations, declined to detail information requests for investigative reasons, and gave brief factual replies on the NOTAMs, OSCE contacts and search documents.
The Cabinet cannot anticipate the conclusions of these independent, international investigations by making statements about indications and the manner of verification.
Het Kabinet kan niet vooruitlopen op de conclusies uit deze onafhankelijke, internationale onderzoeken door uitspraken te doen over aanwijzingen en de wijze van verificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Oeganda nieuwe anti-homowetgeving voorbereidt

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a new, stricter Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill and how the Netherlands would respond, including whether it would support an EU blacklist of officials and fund legal challenges. The minister said the draft's status is unclear but that the Netherlands opposes it, is pressing Uganda diplomatically with donors, funds human rights defenders and the Democratic Governance Facility, and is open to reconsidering legal aid if the issue returns.
The cabinet does share the view that it would be highly undesirable if such a bill were adopted.
Wel deelt het kabinet de opvatting dat het zeer onwenselijk zou zijn als een dergelijk wetsvoorstel zou worden aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over de Isla raffinaderij in relatie tot de EU-sancties

Two MPs asked whether processing Russian crude at the Venezuelan-run Isla refinery on Curaçao complies with EU sanctions against Russia, and how the Curaçao government is held to EU sanctions. The minister replied that the energy sanctions do not ban imports of Russian oil, that the refinery's dealings fall under Curaçao's autonomy, and that Curaçao's cooperation is being pressed via the Kingdom's Rijkssanctiewet.
The Cabinet has no information on economic cooperation between the Isla refinery on Curaçao and Russian companies.
Het Kabinet heeft geen informatie over economische samenwerkingsverbanden tussen de Isla raffinaderij op Curaçao en Russische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Bontes over Satellietbeelden/MH17

Five MPs asked the government about reports that the Netherlands holds satellite images showing who is responsible for the MH17 downing, including whether intelligence from the US and Germany has been verified and what political conclusion the cabinet draws. The government answered that it does not comment publicly on verification of foreign intelligence and will not give a political verdict on the cause while the Dutch-led investigations are ongoing, to protect their independence.
The Cabinet cannot draw conclusions without undermining the independence of these official investigations.
Het Kabinet kan geen conclusies trekken zonder de onafhankelijkheid van deze officiële onderzoeken aan te tasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de ‘trendbreuk van Nederland als voortrekker in het agenderen van taboedoorbrekende onderwerpen’

An MP asks whether the minister's UN ICPD speech signalled a break from the Netherlands' progressive stance on sexual and reproductive rights, and why she did not explicitly endorse the ICPD reports. The minister rejects any break, says Dutch advocacy is consistent, and that dialogue with less progressive partners such as the Vatican is needed.
There is therefore by no means a break in trend, which would also be strange given my years of personal commitment and involvement in the subject.
Er is dus geenszins sprake van een trendbreuk, hetgeen ook vreemd zou zijn gezien mijn jarenlange persoonlijke inzet en betrokkenheid bij het onderwerp.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over het Israëlische nederzettingenbeleid

An MP asked why the Netherlands did not join five larger EU states in a formal protest against Israeli land expropriations on the West Bank. The minister replied that the Netherlands is not part of that group, that an EU statement was issued partly at Dutch instigation, and that the government condemned the expropriation publicly and through the embassy in Tel Aviv.
The Netherlands does not belong to the 'Quint' of these five larger EU member states.
Nederland behoort niet tot de «Quint» van deze vijf grotere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de vordering van het sleep- en bergingsbedrijf Multraship op de Roemeense overheid

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Romania's unpaid debt of around 13 million euro to the Dutch salvage firm Multraship, for clearing a wreck blocking the Danube, is a scandal, why it remains unpaid, and what measures the government will take to secure payment. The minister answered that the Dutch government is in intensive dialogue with Romania, which has acknowledged the debt, that the matter was raised at ministerial level and with the EIB, and that she cannot disclose other company cases for confidentiality reasons.
This concerns commercially confidential information that I do not make public.
Dit betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die ik niet openbaar maak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke fraude bij de productie van de motor van de F-35

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked the Defence Minister about possible fraud involving titanium of uncertain origin, possibly from Russia, in the F-35 engine, and how Defence would prevent unsafe or illegally sourced materials. The minister replied that US authorities are investigating, affected parts are being replaced, Defence has raised the matter with the Joint Program Office, and she cannot rule out problems until the inquiry ends, but will inform the House of the outcome of the case against A&P Alloys.
I cannot make any statements on this at the moment because the American authorities are conducting an investigation.
Ik kan daarover op dit moment geen uitspraken doen omdat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten onderzoek doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Bommel over bericht dat de Saudische blogger Raif Badawi in beroep is veroordeeld tot duizend zweepslagen, 10 jaar gevangenisstraf gevolgd door een 10-jarig uitreisverbod

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Bommel asked whether the minister is aware of the appeal sentence against blogger Raif Badawi (1,000 lashes, 10 years prison, travel ban and fine) and what steps the government will take, including public pressure on Saudi authorities and an EU statement. The minister confirmed awareness and said the government prefers to raise individual cases within the EU, noting a demarche in May 2014 and that the Netherlands will keep pressing for action to prevent enforcement.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts within the EU for new action towards the Saudi authorities to prevent enforcement of the sentence.
Nederland zal zich in EU-verband blijven inspannen voor nieuwe actie richting de Saudische autoriteiten om uitvoering van het vonnis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat elf vliegtuigen zijn verdwenen van het vliegveld van Tripoli

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether eleven aircraft had disappeared from Tripoli airport, who holds them, and what is being done to verify this, plus concerns about terror use and lawlessness in Libya. The minister answered that the government sees no reason to believe the reports are true, that Libyan and US authorities deny them, and outlined support for a UN-led political process and ceasefire.
The cabinet sees no reason to assume that the rumour about missing aircraft is correct.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om aan te nemen dat het gerucht over vermiste vliegtuigen juist zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht «Nederland weigert eigen tolk asiel»

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about press reports that the Netherlands refused asylum to a former Dutch interpreter from Uruzgan, whose claim was rejected by Norway, and about the wider treatment of Afghan interpreters. The government answered that Norway is responsible under Dublin, that no individual circumstances justified taking over the claim, that individual talks and compensation payments to a group of 25 Afghan interpreters are under way, and that a referral route via the IND exists.
As the Chamber is aware, I am reticent about providing information on an individual case.
Als uw Kamer bekend, ben ik terughoudend met het verstrekken van informatie over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over een foutief uitzetbericht van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary why a deportation notice for a man was wrongly sent, how the error occurred and how recurrence will be prevented. The State Secretary answered that a human error from an incomplete holiday handover caused a mistaken flight booking, that the flight was cancelled, and that safeguards exist, but said he cannot guarantee such errors will not recur.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to provide information from individual files.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht informatie te verstrekken uit individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over Repatriëringsmissie MH17

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked about the MH17 repatriation mission, the joint investigation agreements with Ukraine, Belgium, Australia and Malaysia, and the scope of the local search operation in the crash area. The ministers largely answered by citing operational agreements, confidentiality requests from partner states and the separation of investigative responsibilities, while providing limited detail on search areas and maps.
The nature of such information is not suitable for disclosure.
De aard van dergelijke informatie leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over de strijd tegen Ebola

MPs Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about the international Ebola response, the WHO's budget cuts and alleged poor choices, and what the Netherlands would contribute. The minister rejected the claim that the international community failed, described the logistical challenges, and announced 15 million euros from the emergency fund plus 1 million for practical support.
I do not share the view that the international community, including the WHO, has failed in its handling of the Ebola epidemic.
Ik deel de mening niet dat de internationale gemeenschap, inclusief de WHO, steken heeft laten vallen in de aanpak van de Ebola-epidemie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het gebruik van artikel 7d van de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked how often since WWII the cabinet has used article 7d of the treaty approval act to exempt confidential treaties from parliamentary approval, and asked for the titles and texts. Minister Timmermans answered that the provision dates from 1994, that confidential treaties were notified to parliament under confidentiality, and that a list of notification letters will be shared confidentially; titles for 1945-1994 are available online.
As usual, you will shortly be sent an overview of these notification letters for confidential inspection.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal u op korte termijn een overzicht van deze mededelingsbrieven ter vertrouwelijke kennisneming worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht dat de beoogde Venezolaanse consul generaal voor Aruba, Hugo Carvajal, is vrijgelaten

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hugo Carvajal, designated Venezuelan consul-general for Aruba, was released, alleged Venezuelan naval threats, and the basis for granting him immunity and declaring him persona non grata. The minister answered that the Venezuelan navy sighting was routine transit with no threats, that immunity rested on Article 13 of the Vienna Convention given Venezuela's reasonable reliance on a non-diplomatic designation note, and that persona non grata status requires no reasons.
It concerns an autonomous decision of mine that was not coordinated with the US.
Het betreft een autonoom besluit van mij dat niet is afgestemd met de VS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Congolese getuigen van het Strafhof ondanks zorgen toch uitgezet zijn

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would act on reports that Congolese detainee witnesses for the International Criminal Court were returned to the DRC despite concerns about torture, unfair trial and the death penalty, and whether Netherlands would monitor them or contact Congolese authorities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Council of State and the ECHR found no obstacle to return, that the ICC bears responsibility for witness protection and monitoring under its own agreements with the DRC, and that Netherlands will not monitor individuals after return.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Servaes, Van Ojik over de Egyptische strafeis tegen een Nederlandse journaliste

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Egypt seeking maximum prison terms against about 20 journalists, including Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether Egypt kept its promise of a fair trial. The minister answered that the Netjes sentence of ten years in absentia is not a fair process, that the Netherlands raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and referred to a separate letter for further measures.
The Netherlands informed the Egyptian authorities that it deeply regrets that, due to the course of events in Egypt, Ms. Netjes is denied the possibility of returning safely and doing her work there.
Nederland heeft de Egyptische autoriteiten geïnformeerd dat het zeer betreurt dat mw. Netjes door de gang van zaken in Egypte de mogelijkheid wordt ontzegd om veilig te kunnen terugkeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over seksueel geweld tegen (Dalit) vrouwen in India

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would raise caste discrimination and impunity for sexual violence against Dalit women in India and Bangladesh at UN forums, co-sponsor a side event, and raise the issue bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness and past discussions, noted India's announced zero-tolerance policy and Dutch UN resolution work, but declined to co-sponsor the side event and could not answer before the deadline.
To increase the effectiveness of this event it is important that not only European countries co-sponsor it, but especially countries from other parts of the world.
Om de effectiviteit van dit evenement te vergroten is het van belang dat niet alleen Europese landen dit evenement co-sponsoren», maar juist ook landen uit andere delen van de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk, Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over het Moederdagrapport

MPs Van Dijk, Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Save the Children Mothers Day report on maternal and child mortality in fragile states, education in conflict countries, reproductive health, and the effects of reduced aid to transition countries. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports SRGR and education programmes in conflict settings, backs the Lucens Guidelines, and will shift some public health investment to the private sector in transition countries without a clear picture yet of who will fund it.
In the medium term, Dutch public investments in SRGR in the named countries will decrease.
Op middellange termijn zullen de Nederlandse publieke investeringen in SRGR in genoemde landen afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het het bericht “UN backlash as Uganda’s ‘anti-gay’ minister heads for human rights top job”?

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the candidacy of Uganda's foreign minister Sam Kutesa, who opposes LGBT rights, for President of the UN General Assembly, and what tools Netherlands and the EU have to influence it. The minister condemned Uganda's LGBT policy but said national policy does not bind the Assembly president, that Kutesa pledged to respect non-discrimination, and that NL and the EU have no instruments beyond stating principles.
The cabinet nevertheless assumes that Uganda's national policy on this matter has no influence on Mr Kutesa's exercise of the office of President of the General Assembly.
Het kabinet gaat er evenwel vanuit dat het nationale, Oegandese beleid terzake geen invloed heeft op de uitoefening van de functie van Voorzitter van de Algemene Vergadering door de heer Kutesa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over religieuze spanningen in Birma/Myanmar

An MP asked the foreign minister about the exclusion of the Rohingya from Myanmar's census, the violence against them, aid access in Rakhine, and whether the Netherlands should strengthen human rights capacity in Myanmar. The minister condemned the census exclusion, described Dutch diplomatic efforts on aid access, and argued that current human rights capacity, including the new Yangon office, is adequate.
The cabinet currently considers the human rights capacity with regard to Myanmar sufficient.
Het kabinet acht de huidige mensenrechtencapaciteit met betrekking tot Birma/Myanmar op dit moment toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Na weken van desinteresse wil de wereld dat Nigeriaanse meisjes thuis komen'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the abduction of Nigerian schoolgirls, whether the Netherlands and the EU offer search support, whether the abduction counts as terrorism, and whether Boko Haram should be listed on the EU terrorism list. The minister answered that the government is concerned, offered help if Nigeria requests it, said the EU urged release and prosecution, and confirmed the Netherlands again pressed for listing Boko Haram.
At the Foreign Affairs Council of 12 May 2014, the Netherlands again argued for listing Boko Haram on the European terrorist list.
Nederland heeft tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van 12 mei 2014 opnieuw gepleit voor het opnemen van Boko Haram op de Europese terreurlijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Europese investeringsbank geen openheid van zaken geeft

An MP asks whether the European Investment Bank withheld findings of its investigation into alleged tax evasion by Mopani and why member states were not informed. The minister answers that EIB anti-fraud policy keeps investigation material confidential, that member states were last informed in January 2014, and that the Netherlands will encourage the EIB to communicate the general outcome.
The Netherlands will encourage the EIB to communicate in some way about the general outcome of this case, partly because the start of the investigation was also made public.
Nederland zal de EIB aanmoedigen op enigerlei wijze te communiceren over de algemene uitkomst van deze casus, mede gezien het feit dat ook de start van het onderzoek publiekelijk bekendgemaakt werd.
Antwoord op vragen vann de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de voorwaarden voor het laten overkomen van gezinnen naar Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the criteria for exempting nationalities from the provisional residence permit requirement, and about the availability and telephone-based administration of the Dutch language test abroad. The government answered that exemptions rest on old agreements (South Korea added for economic reasons in 2007), that the test is available at more locations than claimed, that it will not be offered at all posts, and that candidates get a free retake if the phone connection fails.
With the exception of South Korea, this exemption is based on agreements or treaties concluded with these countries in the (distant) past.
Met uitzondering van Zuid-Korea is deze vrijstelling gebaseerd op afspraken of overeenkomsten die in het (verre) verleden met deze landen zijn gemaakt of afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.

Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de informatie voor grensarbeiders over het doolhof aan regelgeving

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked about complex cross-border rules for frontier workers, the shift from personal to electronic service at the Bureaus Belgische/Duitse Zaken, and funding for a central back office. The state secretary said digital information is adequate, that personal services are a regional responsibility, and that a back office at the SVB will be funded through 2018 at EUR 700,000 per year.
We will therefore ensure that a back office run by the SVB through the Bureaus is possible until the end of 2018.
Wij zullen er daarom voor zorg dragen dat uitvoering van een back office door de SVB via de Bureaus tot eind 2018 mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de snelle slijtage van de nieuwe helikopters (NH-90)

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister whether the NH-90 helicopter is made by a sister company of the Fyra train manufacturer, whether this prompted a review of production and maintenance, what the financial consequences of rapid wear are, and what the operational consequences are for anti-piracy, Caribbean and future operations. The minister answered that the parent company Finmeccanica owns both Agusta Westland and AnsaldoBreda, that production and maintenance were not changed because of the Fyra, that a working group will report on financial and operational effects by end of April, and that 2014 operations proceed as planned.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform you further.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over discriminerende LHBT wetgeving in Kansas en Arizona

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether bills in Kansas and Arizona allowing businesses to refuse services to LGBT people on religious grounds conflict with international human rights treaties, and what the government would do. The minister replied that both bills failed (Kansas Senate rejected it, Arizona governor vetoed it), that such a law would breach the non-discrimination norm in the ICCPR, that the US is responsible for compliance with its treaty obligations, and that no steps are planned since the bills were not adopted.
The bill mentioned in the US state of Kansas was rejected by that state's Senate.
Het genoemde wetsvoorstel in de Amerikaanse staat Kansas is verworpen door de senaat van die staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over voorlichting voor kiezers buiten Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked how voter registration for the 2014 European Parliament election among Dutch citizens abroad is being promoted, including direct outreach and EU-national outreach. Minister Plasterk answered that registration numbers are lower than in 2009 mainly due to the absence of local campaigning in Aruba, that information campaigns are comparable to 2012, and that municipalities were advised to actively approach EU nationals in the Netherlands.
Organising the elections is a national matter, and so is informing voters about the voting process.
Het organiseren van de verkiezingen is een nationale aangelegenheid en daarmee ook het informeren over het stemproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het «Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt» van de EU ten aanzien van Cuba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked why Cuba was absent from the minister's travel schedule, whether the EU Common Position on Cuba would be changed, and why a Memorandum of Understanding with Cuba and a debt repayment deal were not sent to parliament earlier. The minister answered that the Cuba trip was not yet confirmed in early December, that the Common Position remains in force until a new mandate-based agreement exists, that MoUs are departmental and not routinely sent to parliament, and provided the main terms of the Cuban debt repayment agreement while withholding the full contract as commercially sensitive.
This agreement contains commercially sensitive information and therefore cannot be made fully public.
Dit akkoord bevat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en kan derhalve niet volledig openbaar worden gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het bericht dat onder dreiging van een rechtszaak de minister en Coolcat een gezamenlijke verklaring hebben opgesteld over de inspanningen van Coolcat in textie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the minister knew of CoolCat's threatened lawsuit over her remarks on Bangladesh textile factories, whether the joint press release was a settlement, and why she named CoolCat in an interview. The minister confirmed the lawsuit was withdrawn after a joint statement, denied speaking of a blacklist or linking CoolCat to child labour, and said her remarks concerned signing the safety accord.
In the future too I will continue this dialogue, about the need to improve working conditions in the textile sector.
Ook in de toekomst zal ik deze dialoog, over de noodzaak om arbeidsomstandigheden in de textielsector te verbeteren, blijven voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat bij de Olympische Spelen grootschalig gegevensopslag plaatsvindt van aanwezige sporters en andere geaccrediteerden

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government whether Dutch Olympic visitors' communications data stored by Russia (three-year retention, accessible to the FSB and other unnamed agencies) could reach Dutch intelligence services and what was being done to inform and protect Dutch citizens. The government answered that Dutch intelligence services have no access to the database, that Dutch visitors are covered by a travel advisory and the Oranje Boekje, and that it cannot exclude storage of delegation members' data for security reasons.
Dutch intelligence and security services have no access to the said database.
Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen toegang tot de genoemde database.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse reputatieschade in het buitenland

MPs Pechtold and Sjoerdsma asked the government to reconcile Foreign Minister Timmermans' remarks about damage to the Dutch reputation abroad with earlier statements by his predecessor and the previous cabinet's position, and whether the earlier government should have commissioned a study. The government answered that Dutch reputation is good, that differing views with partners are normal, that the cabinet invests in dialogue and explanation of policy, and that no study was needed.
The Dutch reputation abroad is good and rooted in a long tradition of international cooperation.
De Nederlandse reputatie in het buitenland is goed en gestoeld op een lange traditie van internationale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Visserijakkoord met Marokko

MPs Ten Broeke and Sjoerdsma asked whether the new EU-Morocco fisheries protocol covers occupied Western Sahara, whether EU rules bar spending in occupied territories, and how the deal fits EU and international law. The minister answered that the protocol does not name Western Sahara but does not exclude application there, that economic activity is lawful provided it benefits the local population, and that the Netherlands will press for concrete safeguards.
The protocol contains no direct reference to Western Sahara, but in practice it does not exclude its application there.
Het protocol bevat geen rechtstreekse verwijzing naar de Westelijke Sahara, maar sluit toepassing op de Westelijke Sahara in de praktijk niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over bericht dat homo's in Oeganda voortaan levenslang krijgen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to Uganda's anti-homosexuality law providing life imprisonment, and what steps it has taken and funds LGBT projects there. The minister called the law contrary to fundamental human rights, described diplomatic pressure via EU and bilateral channels, said no consequences have been decided yet since the law is not yet in force, and listed Dutch-funded LGBT and human rights programmes in Uganda.
It is too early to decide on consequences upon the law's introduction.
Het is te vroeg om te besluiten over consequenties bij de invoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat etnische segregatie plaatsvindt binnen een VN-kamp in Zuid-Sudan

Rep. Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of ethnic segregation in a UN camp in South Sudan, whether separate housing of Dinka and Nuer was acceptable, and whether the UN should avoid emphasising tribal differences. Minister Timmermans answered that the UN does not pursue segregation policy, that the arrangement was informal and the sign was unauthorised and removed, that the cabinet understands separate housing, that no Dutch soldiers are present, and that no further action is planned.
No, the UN has itself already taken the necessary action.
Nee, de VN heeft zelf al de benodigde actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Nigeriaanse president de anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands would respond to Nigeria's anti-gay law and reported arrests of gay men in Bauchi. The minister called the law disappointing, described past quiet diplomacy and EU statements, said the response is still being considered, and noted a Dutch-funded LGBT rights programme.
The Netherlands and like-minded countries are currently considering possible follow-up steps.
Nederland en gelijkgezinde landen beraden zich op dit moment over mogelijke vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat zeemansgraven worden geschonden

D66 MPs asked whether the wreck of Dutch submarine O-16 in the South China Sea, possibly disturbed by a Cambodian salvage vessel, constitutes grave desecration, what happened to the crew's remains, whether international criminal prohibition should be pursued, and for an overview of sunk WWII Dutch ships. The government said the disturbance would be unlawful, that criminalisation exists via international legal assistance, that Cambodian authorities have not yet replied, and that it would not publish a wreck overview for fear of provoking further incidents.
Moreover, making such an overview public is not expedient, as it could precisely provoke more incidents.
Daarbij is het openbaar maken van een dergelijk overzicht niet opportuun, omdat daarmee juist meer incidenten zouden kunnen worden uitgelokt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van Bureau Buitenland over foute regimes die Interpol misbruiken

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government about a Bureau Buitenland broadcast alleging that Interpol notices are misused to arrest recognised refugees and human rights activists in Europe, and how Dutch checks on such notices work. Minister Opstelten answered that Interpol itself makes no arrests, that Dutch notices are screened against refugee status and persecution grounds before any extradition, that data on arrests from notices cannot be retrieved from police systems, and that Interpol removes notices that breach its constitution.
It cannot be derived from police systems how many or which arrests have taken place following an Interpol notice.
Uit de systemen van de politie kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel of welke aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden naar aanleiding van een Interpolsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het artikel ‘Asscher ziet wel iets in boud plan Cameron’

Two D66 MPs asked the Social Affairs and foreign ministers about Cameron's plan to delay free movement for new EU members until they reach a certain economic level, and whether Minister Asscher's reported openness to it conflicts with EU free movement. The government calls the idea a potentially interesting contribution to building support for free movement, citing exploitation of lower-income workers, and says reciprocity depends on future accession negotiations while transitional restrictions are compatible with free movement.
Whether the possibility of reciprocity will also be included in the accession treaties with new members depends on negotiations with those countries, which is not yet on the agenda.

Of de mogelijkheid tot wederkerigheid ook in de toetredingsverdragen met nieuwe toetreders wordt opgenomen, hangt af van de onderhandelingen met deze landen, hetgeen voorlopig nog niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de VN geen inzage krijgt in misbruikdossiers van Vaticaan

Two D66 MPs asked why the Holy See refuses to give the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child detailed information on child abuse cases by clergy, and whether it should do so under the Convention. The Foreign Minister answered that the Convention requires cooperation but not detailed case information, that the Holy See does assist foreign mutual legal assistance requests, and that Nederland will not press the Holy See on the matter.
Given the answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, however, it is not reasonable for the Netherlands to confront the Holy See on this.
Gezien het antwoord op de vragen 1, 2 en 3 ligt het echter niet in de rede dat Nederland de Heilige Stoel hierop aanspreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de 21-jarige Nederlander die al bijna drie jaar in een Turkse cel wacht op uitlevering naar Nederland

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked why a 21-year-old Dutch national had been held for nearly three years in Turkey awaiting extradition, and whether the government had withdrawn the request. Minister Opstelten answered that the extradition request was withdrawn effective 1 December 2013 because proceedings had taken so long that detention would exceed the likely Dutch sentence, and that the man was released that day after consular assistance.
At the last contact Turkey was asked that, if the extradition request was still under consideration on 1 December 2013, the extradition procedure be terminated as of that date.

Bij het laatste contact is aan Turkije verzocht om, wanneer het uitleveringsverzoek op 1 december 2013 nog steeds in behandeling zou zijn, de uitleveringsprocedure met ingang van die datum te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, van Bommel en van Ojik over Nederlandse steun voor bedrijven in nederzettingen

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP and GroenLinks asked whether Dutch support for Israeli companies in settlements, including a planned Dutch-Israeli business forum, conflicts with the Netherlands' discouragement policy and whether the forum's reach would extend to occupied territories. The government answered that the discouragement policy applies to the forum, that Israeli settlement firms are not invited and are monitored, that the Palestinian Authority and Israel were informed of the policy, and that a fully watertight system is not possible.
It is technically not feasible to set up a filter that excludes Israeli companies located in settlements.
Het is technisch niet haalbaar een filter in te stellen die Israëlische bedrijven gevestigd in nederzettingen uitsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Area C en de levensvatbaarheid van de twee-statenoplossing

An MP asked the foreign minister how the government responds to a World Bank report on restrictions in Area C of the West Bank, the planned economic use of that area, settlement expansion and home demolitions, and what Dutch and EU action is taken to support the two-state solution. The minister answers that the findings are serious but not new, that Nederland has urged Israel to lift restrictions and freeze settlements, that EU Heads of Mission reports are internal and cannot be discussed, and that Dutch funding supports land development and water projects in Area C.
The EU Heads of Mission reports are internal EU documents intended for internal policy-making and are not published.
De EU «Heads of Mission» rapporten zijn interne EU-documenten bedoeld voor interne beleidsvorming en worden niet gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Duitse plannen om tol te heffen op buitenlandse auto’s

An MP asked the minister whether German plans to charge tolls only to foreign drivers would disadvantage Dutch road users, especially border residents, and what international rules apply. The minister replied that tolls must apply to all users in the EU, that no concrete German plan exists yet, that she has raised Dutch concerns with her German counterpart, and that she will inform parliament once concrete plans appear.
When concrete plans are presented by the German government, I will inform the House of Representatives about them.
Wanneer er concrete plannen voorliggen van de Duitse regering, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de activiteiten en het toezicht op de Europese geheime dienst IntCen

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how the EU intelligence body IntCen receives and shares intelligence, its legal basis and status, and what oversight applies, including whether it processes personal data. Minister Plasterk answered that IntCen only produces strategic analyses from voluntary member-state contributions, now sits within the EEAS under the same legal controls as other EU institutions (Ombudsman, Court of Justice, data protection supervisor), and that Dutch oversight of its AIVD input rests with the CTIVD.

Given that SitCen produces only strategic analyses, processes no personal data, acquires no intelligence of its own and receives information from member states only on a voluntary basis, the Council considered that no special legal basis was required to establish SitCen.

Gelet op het feit dat SitCen uitsluitend strategische analyses opstelt, geen persoonsgegevens verwerkt, geen eigen inlichtingen verwerft en dat informatie uit de lidstaten slechts op basis van vrijwilligheid wordt verstrekt, was de Raad van mening dat voor de oprichting van SitCen geen bijzonder rechtsbasis was vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht in een recent rapport van Amnesty International dat honderden Syrische vluchtelingen niet zijn toegelaten tot Jordanië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report that hundreds of Syrian refugees were refused entry at Jordan's border, and about Dutch efforts on burden-sharing and reception. The minister acknowledged the concerns, confirmed the border categories and the funding given, and said the government would keep raising the issue with Jordan and the EU.
The Netherlands raises this issue in various contacts with the Jordanian authorities.
Nederland brengt deze problematiek in diverse contacten met de Jordaanse autoriteiten onder de aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de geschillenbeslechting tussen Zimbabwe en Nederlandse ondernemers

An MP asked ministers about the unresolved arbitration award owed by Zimbabwe to Dutch farmers whose land was expropriated in 2001-2002, including progress, the route for dispute settlement, and whether Dutch engagement with Zimbabwe is consistent with the unpaid compensation. The minister replied that Zimbabwe was ordered by an ICSID tribunal in 2009 to pay compensation, that payment has not yet followed despite repeated pressure, that the case remains a priority, and that development cooperation has not resumed while Dutch firms decide on investments themselves.
The Netherlands will continue to request attention, both publicly and on the margins, at appropriate moments for this recognised claim of Dutch investors.
Nederland zal op gepaste momenten zowel openlijk als en marge aandacht blijven vragen voor deze erkende claim van de Nederlandse investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de omstandigheden van Rohingya-vluchtelingen in Thaise detentiecentra

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about poor conditions for Rohingya refugees in Thai detention centres, Dutch-funded camps being inaccessible to them, EU emergency aid, and human trafficking. The minister agreed detention is undesirable, explained that the Thai authorities do not recognise Rohingya as refugees so they cannot access the camps, and described EU-funded improvements and raising of the issue with Thailand.
It is undesirable that male Rohingya refugees are held in Thai detention centres.
Het is onwenselijk dat mannelijke Rohingya-vluchtelingen in Thaise detentiecentra worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over mensenrechtenbeleid met betrekking tot Saudi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the government agrees with Amnesty's finding that Dutch and EU support for persecuted Saudi human rights defenders has been weak and whether quiet diplomacy should be replaced. The minister agrees the human rights situation is serious, defends quiet diplomacy with EU coordination, and says it will consult partners on Amnesty's recommendations, noting some are already practiced.
As promised during the Human Rights Policy consultation on 30 September, the cabinet will consult other member states on this and inform the House of the outcomes.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Notaoverleg Mensenrechtenbeleid op 30 september jl. zal het kabinet zich hierover verstaan met andere lidstaten en de Kamer over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht dat de minister “persoonlijk sorry” heeft gezegd tegen haar Indonesische collega

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether the defence minister apologised personally to her Indonesian counterpart over the handling of the Leopard tank deal, what that means versus formal apologies, whether the cabinet agreed to it, and whether it changes arms export policy. The minister said she personally regretted how the matter went, that formal apologies are not at issue, and that the statement does not change export policy, but declined to answer each question separately.
When asked, I said during the press meeting that I personally regret the course of events surrounding the planned delivery of tanks to Indonesia.
Ik heb desgevraagd tijdens de ontmoeting met de pers gezegd de gang van zaken rondom de voorgenomen levering van tanks aan Indonesië persoonlijk te betreuren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over mensenrechtenschendingen in Rusland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked what Dutch and EU action has been taken against Russia's anti-gay propaganda and NGO laws, and whether a state complaint, suspension under Council of Europe Article 8, or a UN resolution is warranted. Minister Timmermans answered that Nederland and the EU have raised concerns repeatedly and will pursue dialogue, UN statements and bilateral initiatives, but judged a state complaint, suspension and a UN resolution not appropriate or lacking support.
The Netherlands wants to focus on broad international attention and dialogue on the legislation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia rather than initiating a bilateral process.
Nederland wil inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de wetgeving en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland in plaats van een bilateraal proces te entameren

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de zorgen die een Duitse deelstaatpremier en de Senaat en het Huis van Afgevaardigden van Michigan hebben geuit over de sluiting van Nederlandse consulaten

An MP asked the ministers of General Affairs and Foreign Affairs about concerns raised by a German state premier and US Michigan legislative bodies over the closure of Dutch consulates-general in Munich and Chicago. The government answered that consulate closures are necessary to cut about 100 million euro from the network budget, that consular and economic functions will be taken over by alternatives, and that it will not postpone closures pending a full cost-benefit analysis.
The cabinet wants to maintain a worldwide network and keeps as many embassies open as possible.
Het kabinet wil wereldwijd een netwerk behouden en houdt zoveel mogelijk ambassades open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de discriminatie van homoparen bij interlandelijke adoptie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch intercountry adoption practice through Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions tolerates discrimination against same-sex and non-Christian couples in South Africa, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary replied that the South African discrimination investigation is ongoing, that Abba Adoptions has removed discriminatory criteria, that the Central Authority acted adequately, and that the government is open to a second intermediary and to a possible European working group, without committing to a new discrimination-free alternative.
As I have already shared with your House, there are no longer any discriminatory conditions in the cooperation between Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions.
Antwoord 5 Zoals ik al eerder met uw Kamer heb gedeeld 3 , zijn er geen discriminerende voorwaarden meer in de samenwerking tussen Wereldkinderen en Abba adoptions.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over persvrijheid in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the UK government infringed press freedom in the Guardian/Miranda affair, including alleged pressure to suppress documents, destruction of computers and the detention of a journalist's partner under anti-terrorism powers. The minister confirmed the reported facts in part and said that the UK's democratic oversight mechanisms, including an independent reviewer and parliament, will assess the police conduct, without the Netherlands taking a position.
The democratic control mechanisms function in the British system.
De democratische controlemechanismen functioneren in het Britse systeem.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Homorechten in de Verenigde Republiek Tanzania

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether they were aware of the Human Rights Watch report on discrimination against sexual minorities in Tanzania and of Zanzibar's president rejecting LGBT rights linked to aid, and what the government would do about criminalisation and abuse of LGBT people, including raising it with President Shein and coordinating EU action. The government said it shares the concerns, will monitor enforcement through the embassy, raised rule of law and human rights in talks with Zanzibar's leaders, and will answer for the upcoming Human Rights policy debate.
As usual, no statements are made about the conversation with the King.
Over het gesprek met de Koning worden zoals gebruikelijk geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over glycol

An MP (Sjoerdsma, D66) asked the minister whether the earlier promise to investigate what happened to glycol exported from the Netherlands to Syria could be carried out. The minister answered that such an investigation is not currently feasible because of the security situation and the closed embassy, while navigating existing inquiries with the exporter, intelligence services and customs yielded no new information.
Due to the current crisis situation in Syria, further Dutch investigation into the end use in Syria is currently not possible.
Vanwege de huidige crisissituatie in Syrië is nader Nederlands onderzoek naar het eindgebruik in Syrië op dit moment niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over LHBT-gezinnen in Rusland

An MP asked the foreign minister about the Russian anti-gay propaganda law, including fines, child removal from LGBT families, the safety of LGBT families and how the Netherlands will defend their family life rights. The minister answered that no fines or convictions were known nationally yet, that child removal is not in the law, and that the government is concerned and will raise LGBT issues with Russian authorities.
The cabinet is of course concerned about this remark and will follow developments on the matter.
Het kabinet is vanzelfsprekend bezorgd over deze opmerking en zal de ontwikkelingen ter zake volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het niet terugkeren van Afghaanse diplomaten naar Afghanistan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about media reports that Afghan diplomats in Germany are not returning to Afghanistan, and whether Afghan officials visiting the Netherlands have applied for asylum or disappeared. The government said it has no clear evidence of a trend, that the IND does not register professions so the figures cannot be generated, and that there is no specific EU policy beyond visa rules.
The IND does not register the profession of an asylum applicant in its systems.
Door de IND wordt de professie van een asielaanvrager niet in de systemen geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de moord op een homo-activist in Kameroen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister how the government would respond to the murder of gay rights activist Eric Lembembe in Cameroon, including pressing for investigation, decriminalisation, and monitoring and protecting LHBT people. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands is acting mainly through the EU since closing its Yaoundé embassy, and that the EU High Representative called on Cameroon to prosecute the perpetrators, with monitoring to continue.
At the Dutch request, High Representative Ashton called on the Cameroonian government to track down and prosecute the perpetrators.
Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton heeft op Nederlands verzoek de Kameroenese regering opgeroepen de daders op te sporen en te berechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de inperking van de internetvrijheid in Singapore

An MP asked the foreign minister about Singapore's new licensing requirement for news websites with at least 50,000 visitors and the 24-hour takedown rule, and whether the Netherlands would act. The minister answered that the content standards are unchanged, the impact is limited, and the embassy will monitor the matter with EU partners but no direct step to Singapore is planned.
The impact of the new regulations is limited.
De impact van de nieuwe regelgeving is beperkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie van Niet-Gouvernementele Organisaties (NGO's) en NGO-medewerkers in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about Egypt's crackdown on NGOs, including a court ruling against foreign NGO staff and a restrictive draft NGO law. The minister expressed serious concern, said the ruling violates freedom of association, and described diplomatic efforts with Egypt and EU statements, while stating no EU measures are yet warranted because the draft law is not adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nevertheless become law, I will raise it in the EU as soon as possible.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over afgeluisterde EU-diplomaten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the government would raise with the US the reported NSA surveillance of EU diplomats in Washington, Brussels and New York. The government said it had raised the matter at high level, that European and American experts will examine intelligence gathering and data protection together, and that next steps will follow from their findings.
European and American experts will jointly examine the issues of intelligence gathering and data protection.
Europese en Amerikaanse experts zullen zich gezamenlijk buigen over de problematiek van inlichtingenvergaring en dataprotectie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de anti-homowet in Rusland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about Russia's anti-gay law, the safety of LGBT people and NGOs, foreign-agent rules, EU human rights strategy, and Dutch steps taken. The minister said he is concerned about the law's signal effect, will monitor NGO court cases in EU framework, and raised the issue with Russian officials.
The intention is to continue following the court cases against NGOs under the foreign agent legislation within the EU framework, if the NGO concerned wishes this.
Het voornemen is om de rechtszaken tegen NGO's n.a.v. de «foreign agent»-wetgeving te (blijven) volgen in EU-verband, indien de betreffende NGO dit wenst.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht “Afghaanse tolk vreest bijltjesdag”

D66 MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether Afghan interpreters working for the Dutch mission in Kunduz face danger after the withdrawal, how many are employed, whether asylum claims are expected, and whether a lighter regime or contact with Germany is planned. The ministers replied that the situation is unforeseeable, some safety measures and an inventory have been made, four monitors and sixteen interpreters are under German contracts, asylum claims are assessed individually without a special collective scheme, and contact with Germany exists.
We see no reason for a special (collective) arrangement.
We zien geen aanleiding voor een bijzondere (collectieve) regeling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how acquitted ICC suspect Ngudjolo could be released on Dutch soil, whether the ICC met its host-state duties, and how witnesses or acquitted suspects excluded from asylum under Article 1F would be handled. The government answered that the ICC must arrange transfer after acquittal, Dutch authorities facilitate it, structural arrangements with the ICC registry are being developed, and detained witnesses' cases are discussed in that context without individual details.
Regarding the status of the procedure, I maintain the principle that I do not comment on individual cases.
Wat betreft de stand van de procedure hanteer ik het uitgangspunt dat ik niet inga op individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over het gezag van het Internationaal Strafhof in Afrika

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the government how it responds to African Union accusations that the ICC targets Africans, to the AU call to refer the Kenyatta and Ruto cases to Kenyan courts, and to the effects on the ICC's standing, and what the Netherlands did at the AU summit. The minister rejects the AU claims, notes the ICC acts independently and that half of African situations were referred by states or the UN Security Council, says the Kenyan admissibility challenge was rejected, and describes bilateral and EU efforts to support the ICC in Africa without committing to a new report on the summit.
The cabinet disagrees with the statements of the African Union chairperson, Hailemariam Desalegn, which imply that the ICC is biased.
Het kabinet is het oneens met de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Afrikaanse Unie, Hailemariam Desalegn, waarin wordt geïmpliceerd dat het ICC vooringenomen zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over een werkbezoek aan het Internationaal Strafhof

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the ICC's staffing shortage, the consequences of closing the Scheveningen prison for detainees, and whether witnesses are admitted to the Netherlands long enough. The minister said the Netherlands is in dialogue with the ICC and supports strengthening its investigative capacity, referred the prison question to the Justice State Secretary's earlier answer stating detention for international tribunals continues in Scheveningen, and said he was unaware of witness admission problems, pointing to the host-state agreement.
The Netherlands is aware of the ICC's concerns about limited staffing capacity and is in dialogue with the ICC about it.
Nederland is bekend met de zorgen van het ICC over de beperkte personele capaciteit en is hierover met het ICC in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de ILGA-Europe Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People in Europe 2013

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about the Netherlands dropping in the ILGA-Europe 2013 rankings, the human rights situation of LGBT people in Europe, and whether the government would back an EU action plan and anti-discrimination directive. The minister answered that the rankings methodology changed, that the Netherlands remains a leader on LGBT rights, and that the government supports the proposed EU initiative.
The cabinet supports the COC proposal.
Het kabinet steunt het voorstel van het COC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Voordewind over de mensenrechtennota

MPs asked when the human rights note would reach parliament, whether the old note still guides policy, and how much was spent from the human rights fund since the new cabinet took office. The minister replied that the letter will be sent after cabinet approval, that it will state continuity and new emphases, and that ongoing commitments from the fund have been honoured.
The human rights letter will be sent to the House immediately after the Council of Ministers has approved it.
De mensenrechtenbrief wordt direct nadat de Ministerraad deze heeft goedgekeurd aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bonis, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van Ojik over het rapport "Detainee Treatment"

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about the 2013 Constitution Project report on US detainee treatment at Guantanamo, including torture allegations, indefinite detention without trial, and medical personnel involvement. The minister called the allegations worrying, said the US must determine whether torture occurred, and reiterated that Guantanamo should close, without committing to a new concrete step beyond continued diplomatic contacts.

It is now up to the American authorities to determine, in light of the Constitution Project report, whether torture and inhuman treatment within the meaning of the aforementioned conventions has indeed occurred.

Antwoord 3 Het is nu aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om, gezien het rapport van het Constitution Project , vast te stellen of inderdaad sprake is van foltering en onmenselijke behandeling in de zin van bovengenoemde verdragen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over correcte etikettering van producten uit bezette gebieden

Sjoerdsma (D66) asks the foreign minister whether the government still supports correct labelling of products from occupied territories, when a binding legal duty to prevent consumer misinformation applies, when Dutch consumers will see correct origin labelling, and why a draft guideline was accidentally published online. Minister Timmers answers that the government supports correct implementation of the May 2012 EU decision, that EU rules forbid misleading consumers about origin, that technical coordination with other member states takes time, and that the draft was published by mistake and will not be sent to the Chamber.
Once this consultation is concluded, the Chamber will be informed of its outcomes, as well as of the cabinet's view on the report 'Trading away peace'.
Zodra dit overleg is afgerond, wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten hiervan, evenals over de kabinetsvisie op het rapport «Trading away peace».
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over het oppakken van een homorechtenactivist in Zambia

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about the arrest and trial in Zambia of LGBT rights activist Paul Kasonkomona, the legal basis for his prosecution, the impact of closing the Dutch embassy on LGBT support, the safety of LGBT people, and whether the minister would press for decriminalisation. The minister confirmed the case under section 178(g) of the penal code, said the penalty is not yet known, outlined the worsening situation for LGBT people, and said Dutch efforts would continue via the EU and in ministerial contacts without a concrete commitment to a specific public intervention.
After the embassy closes in July 2013, Dutch efforts for LGBT rights in Zambia will continue within the EU framework.
Na de sluiting van de ambassade in juli 2013 zal de Nederlandse inzet in Zambia ten behoeve van LHBT-rechten in EU-verband worden voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Russische spionnen erg actief zijn in Nederland

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russian and Chinese espionage in the Netherlands, including targeting of military-technological knowledge, is adequately understood and countered. The minister answered that intelligence services (AIVD, MIVD) investigate, disrupt operations, advise on security and screen defence contractors, while acknowledging that not all operations can be detected and no further public details can be given.
No further information on this can be provided publicly.
In het openbaar kunnen hierover verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over over de politieke participatie van vrouwen in de MENA-regio (Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika)

An MP asked the minister about the Women on the Frontline fund for women's political participation in the MENA region, including its aims, country choice, evaluation, FLOW budget use and the Know Me Initiative. The minister answered that the fund strengthens women's organisations in seven countries through tailor-made support, with annual and final reporting, and pledged to raise women's participation in EU and bilateral talks.
Yes, Hivos provides the ministry with an annual financial and substantive report on expenditure and results achieved.
Ja, Hivos levert jaarlijks een financiële en inhoudelijke rapportage (over de bestedingen en behaalde resultaten) aan het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Bonis over de arrestatie en vervolgens vrijlating van de Nederlandse journaliste Rena Netjes in Cairo

MPs from VVD, D66, SP and PvdA asked the foreign minister about the arrest and release of Dutch journalist Rena Netjes in Cairo, including whether a citizen's arrest could fuel a witch-hunt against Western journalists. The minister confirmed no formal charge was filed, described ambassador contact with the Egyptian prosecutor leading to her release, and said the Egyptian authorities found the citizen's arrest unlawful.
As far as the embassy in Cairo could verify, there was no official charge against Ms Netjes.
Er is voor zover door de ambassade in Cairo kon worden nagegaan geen officiële aanklacht tegen mevrouw Netjes geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een Chinees veiligheidssysteem in Tibet

An MP asked the foreign minister about China's GRID surveillance system in Tibet, arbitrary house searches and police posts, and how China's unratified ICCPR and the EU-China dialogue could be used to press for change. The minister said the Netherlands is concerned, has repeatedly urged China in EU and UN settings to respect rights and resume dialogue, pushes for ratification of the ICCPR, and will keep raising Tibet in the EU-China human rights dialogue, while noting no major policy change yet.
The Netherlands is concerned about the restriction of freedoms of Tibetan citizens
Nederland maakt zich zorgen over de inperking van vrijheden van Tibetaanse burgers
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het sluiten van het Institut Néerlandais in Parijs

Sjoerdsma (D66) asks the foreign minister why the Institut Néerlandais in Paris is being closed despite earlier promises to keep it open, why the Raad voor Cultuur was asked for advice, and whether irreversible steps should wait for a postennet vision.
