The minister replies that the subsidy ends for a cheaper embassy-based cultural programme, that the building stays Dutch-oriented via Fondation Custodia, and that no reduction in cultural presence is expected.
Question 7: Have you calculated the long-term effects of this reduced Dutch cultural presence in France? Are you willing to share these figures with the House?
Vraag 7 Heeft u doorgerekend wat de langetermijneffecten zijn van deze verminderde Nederlandse culturele aanwezigheid in Frankrijk? Bent u bereid deze cijfers met de Kamer te delen?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het recht op veilige abortus voor verkrachte vrouwen in oorlogsgebieden

An MP asked the government whether raped women and girls in war zones have a right to safe abortion under humanitarian law, whether they should be a public champion of this (including in National Action Plan 1325), and whether the US 'no abortion' clause should be challenged. The minister answers that humanitarian law requires necessary medical care that may include abortion, that the Netherlands will press this in the EU and UN, and will urge the US to interpret the Helms amendment to allow funding for safe abortion for rape survivors.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked the foreign minister about Palestinian detainees Samer Issawi and Ayman Sharawneh in Israeli custody, including administrative detention, alleged mistreatment and the death of Arafat Jaradat. The minister replied that there is no administrative detention in these cases, that the Netherlands and the EU monitor the situation and raised it with Israel, and that an independent inquiry into Jaradat's death should follow with findings made public.
There is no question of administrative detention.
Er is geen sprake van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de toename van het aantal vluchtelingen vanuit Syrië

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked about the rising number of Syrian refugees, EU strategy, family reunification and visa policy for Syrians. The state secretary replied that the EU has seen asylum applications from Syrians rise sharply, that EASO and emergency funds exist for member states, that the Temporary Protection Directive is not yet triggered, that Netherlands issues no visas on protection grounds, and that EU and member states have committed substantial humanitarian funding.
The Netherlands does not issue visas for reasons of international protection.
Nederland verstrekt geen visa om redenen van internationale bescherming.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over sluiting van het Institut Français

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Institut Français's move out of its Amsterdam building and the closure of the Institut Néerlandais in Paris were linked, and about the cultural ties with France. The minister regretted the move, attributed it to high maintenance costs, denied any link with the Dutch subsidy decision and any French signals, and said cultural relations remain important.
No. France does not intend to close the Institut Français; the activities will continue at another location in Amsterdam.
Nee. Frankrijk is niet voornemens het Institut Français te sluiten, de activiteiten gaan door op een andere locatie in Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen Bergklamp en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van premier Erdogan

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the Prime Minister whether he would send Parliament a report on Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's visit, covering the political dialogue and the controversy over foster care in the Netherlands, within a week. The answer states that the questions were already answered in the Prime Minister's letter of 27 March 2013.
These questions have been answered in the letter of the Prime Minister, Minister of General Affairs of 27 March 2013
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij de brief van de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken van 27 maart 2013

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

D66 MPs asked the State Secretary about a Congolese person acquitted by the International Criminal Court who was detained by Dutch authorities for removal, questioning whether this ignored the court's ruling and whether the ICC assessed his safety. The State Secretary answered that acquittal does not confer a right to remain, that the host state must facilitate transfer to a third state under the seat agreement, that his asylum/protection request is pending, and that structural arrangements with the ICC are being discussed.
The Netherlands deprived the person of his liberty within the framework of the aforementioned immigration law procedure.
Nederland heeft betrokkene zijn vrijheid ontnomen in het kader van genoemde vreemdelingrechtelijke procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over Turkse pleegkinderen

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked about Turkish criticism of Dutch foster care for Turkish children, whether Turkey has authority over them, and whether foster parents can be excluded on religion or sexual orientation. The state secretary answered that placement follows careful rules considering the child's religious and cultural background, that Turkey has no authority over these children, and that exclusion on religion or sexual orientation is not allowed.
I am willing to report to the House on this.
Ik ben bereid hierover verslag te doen aan de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de verkiezingen in Kenia en de processen van het International Criminal Court (ICC) tegen Uhuru Kenyatta en William Ruto

An MP from D66 asked the foreign minister about the outcome of an AU/COMESA/IGAD delegation visit to Kenya, Dutch support for the ICC Kenya cases, and reports that witnesses were disappearing or being influenced in the Kenyatta and Ruto trials, asking about witness protection. The minister described the delegation's recommendations, listed Dutch diplomatic, logistical and financial support to the ICC and civil society, said he was concerned about witness interference, and deferred details of witness protection to the ICC.
Because of the sensitivity of the matter, I cannot provide further details on witness protection.
Ik kan vanwege de gevoeligheid van de kwestie geen nadere details over getuigenbescherming verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over investeringen in bedrijven die communicatieapparatuur aan Syrië leverden

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch banks and pension funds investing in firms that supplied communications equipment to Syria could pressure those firms to stop such exports, and about EU-level export controls on repressive technology. The minister answered that corporate responsibility rests with the financial sector under OECD guidelines, outlined Dutch proposals for an EU human-rights export clause and existing sanctions on monitoring equipment for Syria, and said Nederland supports the European Parliament's Digital Freedom resolution.

The Netherlands has proposed at EU level adding a provision to the dual-use regulation that would allow banning the export of goods and technology where there is suspicion they will be used for human rights violations.

Nederland heeft in Europees verband voorgesteld om een bepaling toe te voegen aan de dual-useverordening die het mogelijk maakt om de export van goederen en technologie te verbieden indien het vermoeden bestaat dat deze zullen worden ingezet voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Bonis, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over sluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de regering van Sudan

MPs from PvdA, CDA and D66 asked the Dutch government whether it shares EU concerns about Sudan's closure of civil society organisations, whether it will press Khartoum to reverse this, and how it supports the closed groups and threatened rights defenders. The government answered yes to each point, said the EU and member states will raise the closures with Sudanese authorities, and described ongoing contact and programme support for civil society and rights defenders.
The closure of the civil society organisation will be raised with the Sudanese authorities shortly, jointly by the EU and a number of EU member states present in Sudan, including the Netherlands.

De sluiting van de maatschappelijke organisatie zal op korte termijn gezamenlijk door de EU en een aantal in Sudan aanwezige EU-lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, bij de Sudanese autoriteiten worden aangekaart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het rapport “Kenya’s 2013 Elections” van de International Crisis Group (ICG)

An MP asked the foreign minister how the government responds to an ICG report on Kenya's 2013 elections, the risk of political violence, what it does to protect the electoral commission's independence, and when international observer missions start. The minister said Netherlands supports the report's recommendations on electoral commission, judiciary and observer coordination, acknowledges the risk of violence, and gave the observer mission dates.
The Netherlands supports the fight against impunity, the implementation of the new constitution and contributes to the credibility of the democratic process.
Nederland ondersteunt de strijd tegen straffeloosheid, de implementatie van de nieuwe grondwet en draagt bij aan de geloofwaardigheid van het democratisch proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de Russische anti-homowet

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign and education ministers about a Russian bill banning public speech on homosexuality, and whether the Netherlands would protest and protect LGBT rights. Minister Timmermans said the bill is discriminatory and harmful, that the concern was conveyed to the Russian ambassador, raised at the EU level and in a planned visit, and that Dutch funding for LGBT projects in Russia continues.
On 1 February I had my concerns conveyed to the Russian ambassador.
Op 1 februari heb ik mijn zorgen aan de Russische ambassadeur laten overbrengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de mensenrechtensituatie in Bahrein

An MP asked the foreign minister about human rights in Bahrain, including support for a European Parliament resolution, EU sanctions, arms export restrictions, implementation of the BICI report and a pending prosecution of an activist. The minister condemned rights violations and said he backs the implementation of BICI recommendations and an EU approach, but does not support sanctions for now and gave no firm commitment on the individual trial.
The Netherlands therefore condemns, in line with European Parliament resolution 2013/2513, the continued human rights violations by the Bahraini authorities and security forces.
Nederland veroordeelt dan ook, in lijn met resolutie 2013/2513 van het Europees Parlement, de doorgaande mensenrechtenschendingen door de Bahreinse autoriteiten en veiligheidstroepen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de discriminatie van niet-gelovigen

The MP asked the Foreign Minister about a 2012 report on discrimination against non-believers and what the government would do about it. The minister said the Netherlands promotes freedom of religion and belief including non-belief, has pushed for protection of non-believers in EU guidelines, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU circles, and will inform the House.
I will raise this with EU partners when the occasion arises and then inform the House.
Ik zal daar bij gelegenheid aandacht van EU-partners voor vragen en de Kamer vervolgens informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Mensenrechtenactivisten in Noord- en Zuid-Amerika

An MP asked the foreign minister about Amnesty's report on human rights defenders in the Americas, Dutch support for the IACHR, whether Nederland would fund a specific IACHR defender unit, Brazil human rights raised at the EU-Brazil summit, and a trade mission report. The minister described Dutch funding of EUR 500,000 and EUR 250,000 a year for the IACHR, declined a dedicated unit, and argued against raising Brazil defenders explicitly at the summit.

No. Due to increasing administrative pressure on the organisation and to improve the effectiveness of human rights initiatives in the region, the IACHR asked donors at the launch of its Strategic Plan 2011–2015 to limit themselves to general, non-earmarked support.

Nee. Vanwege toenemende administratieve druk op de organisatie en ter verbetering van effectiviteit van mensenrechteninitiatieven in de regio, heeft de IACHR bij de lancering van het Strategische Plan 2011–2015 donoren verzocht zich te beperken tot algemene, niet geoormerkte steun.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Syrië en Internationaal Strafhof

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would back a Europarliamentarians' call for an ICC investigation into violence in Syria, and whether it would fund evidence gathering and raise the issue internationally. The minister answered that Syria is not an ICC state party, so a referral by the UN Security Council is needed, which the Netherlands supports, and that it funds Syrian documentation efforts and raises impunity in international forums.
The Netherlands favours such a referral by the UN Security Council and will, together with about 50 countries, issue a call to that effect.
Nederland is voorstander van een dergelijke doorverwijzing door de VN-Veiligheidsraad en zal daartoe samen met ca 50 landen een oproep doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

Two D66 MPs asked the government about a proposed Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill carrying the death penalty, its likely passage, diplomatic steps, and whether deportations of Ugandan LGBT asylum seekers should be suspended. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns, that the EU ambassadors raised them with Uganda's prime minister, that further steps are premature, and that asylum seekers are assessed individually rather than as a group.
A careful individual assessment is therefore carried out, taking into account the worrying situation of homosexuals in Uganda.
Er vindt derhalve een zorgvuldige individuele toets plaats met inachtneming van de zorgelijke situatie van homoseksuelen in Oeganda.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het rapport “Trading Away Peace: How Europe helps sustain illegal Israeli settlements”

An MP asked the foreign minister for a response to a report claiming EU policy helps sustain Israeli settlements, whether he supports correct labelling of settlement products, and the Dutch position on twelve recommendations. The minister replied that the report and its recommendations are being studied, that settlement products must not receive EU tariff preference, that EU labelling rules should be correctly enforced, and that concrete steps will be communicated later.
As soon as it is clear which steps the Netherlands can take, we will inform your House of Representatives about this.
Zodra duidelijk is welke stappen Nederland kan nemen, zullen wij uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de inperking van internetvrijheid in Rusland

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government is aware of Russia's November 2012 law enabling DPI-based internet surveillance, what its impact on human rights and Dutch firms will be, whether EU technology exports could be barred from use in rights violations, and what the government will do to support digital freedom in Russia. The minister acknowledges concern about misuse of the law, says Dutch dual-use export controls cannot exclude such use, and states the government will raise digital freedom in EU and bilateral channels and push for an expanded dual-use regulation.

The Netherlands has for some time been working to expand the EU dual-use regulation so that companies can be subject to an ad hoc licensing requirement if there are indications that technology could (partly) be used for human rights violations.

Nederland zet zich reeds geruime tijd in om de EU- dual use verordening uit te breiden, zodat bedrijven een ad-hoc vergunningplicht kan worden opgelegd indien er aanwijzingen zijn dat technologie (gedeeltelijk) kan worden gebruikt voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Nederland het Internationaal Strafhof in een moeilijke positie brengt

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Dutch host-state policy is putting the International Criminal Court in a difficult position over its housing costs, and whether the Netherlands should bear extra costs. The minister answered that the Netherlands will cover the 2012 second-half housing costs and half of 2013-2015 costs up to 9 million euro, about 12 million euro in total, while noting that housing costs are now a shared responsibility of all member states.

Moreover, the Netherlands has recently committed to also reimburse half of the temporary housing costs for the period 2013 through 2015 (completion of new construction) to the Court, up to a maximum of 9 million euro.

Bovendien heeft Nederland onlangs toegezegd ook de helft van de kosten van de tijdelijke huisvesting in de periode van 2013 tot en met 2015 (gereedkomen nieuwbouw) aan het Strafhof te vergoeden tot een bedrag van maximaal 9 miljoen euro.

m: Motie van het lid Wilders c.s. over alle boetes voor het overtreden van de avondklok intrekken
Asks the government to withdraw all fines issued for breaking the curfew, which is unlawful, and refund fines already paid.
withdraw all fines issued for breaking an unlawful curfew and refund as quickly as possible all fines already paid
alle boetes die zijn uitgeschreven voor het overtreden van een onrechtmatige avondklok in te trekken en alle boetes die reeds zijn betaald, zo snel mogelijk terug te storten
Motie van de leden Wilders en Krol over pas na de uitspraak van het Hof in hoger beroep stemmen over het wetsvoorstel
Asks the House not to vote on the COVID outdoor gathering restriction bill until the appeal court has ruled.
declares that it will only vote on the bill restricting outdoor stays after the appeal court's ruling
spreekt uit pas te stemmen over het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet beperking vertoeven in de openlucht covid-19 ( 35 732 ) na de uitspraak van het hof in hoger beroep
Motie van de leden Krol en Van Raak over altijd een referendum bij herindelingen
Asks the government to legislate so that inhabitants of merged municipalities are always consulted by referendum.
requests the government to come with a legislative amendment to establish that inhabitants of merged municipalities are always consulted via a referendum
verzoekt de regering, met een wetswijziging te komen om vast te leggen dat inwoners van herindelingsgemeenten altijd worden geraadpleegd via een referendum
Motie van het lid Krol over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de herindeling van Groningen, Haren en Ten Boer
Asks the government to commission an independent investigation into the process before the merger of Groningen, Haren and Ten Boer, including the role of top officials and administrators.
requests the government to organise an independent investigation into the process preceding the merger of Groningen, Haren and Ten Boer
verzoekt de regering, een onafhankelijk onderzoek te organiseren naar het proces voorafgaand aan de herindeling van Groningen, Haren en Ten Boer
Motie van het lid Graus c.s. over een integraal plan voor de doorontwikkeling van VDL Nedcar
Asks the government to help VDL Nedcar with an integrated plan for its further development in Born, including national co-financing options.
requests the government, with VDL Nedcar and regional bodies, to help with an integrated plan for the further development of VDL Nedcar
verzoekt de regering, met VDL Nedcar, de provincie Limburg, betrokken gemeenten, kennis- en onderwijsinstellingen te helpen met een integraal plan voor de doorontwikkeling van VDL Nedcar
Amendement van het lid Krol over vervallen van het leeftijdscriterium en voorkomen dat huizenbezitters gebruik kunnen maken van de vrijstelling

Amends the client advocate provision in healthcare law so that the cliëntvertrouwenspersoon works independently of the care provider, care coordinator and assessment body.
The client advocate performs his work independently of the care provider, the care coordinator and the assessment body.
De cliëntvertrouwenspersoon verricht zijn werkzaamheden onafhankelijk van de zorgaanbieder, de zorgverantwoordelijke en het indicatieorgaan.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 47 over het stellen van regels over het register bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.

Moves the rules on the compulsory care register from a ministerial regulation to a general administrative order (AMvB) and adds a four-week wait before the AMvB is submitted, a pre-consultation of parliament.
This amendment also provides for a pre-consultation provision.
Tevens voorziet dit amendement in een voorhangbepaling.
Amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 41 over het stellen van regels over het register bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
Changes the rules on the involuntary care register from ministerial regulation to a general administrative order (AMvB), aligning it with the Wet verplichte ggz.
Rules shall be set by general administrative order on.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over.
Amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over het stellen van regels over het register bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
Amends a bill so that rules on the register of involuntary care are set by general administrative order (AMvB) rather than ministerial regulation, aligning with the Wet verplichte ggz.
Rules are set by general administrative order.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over.
Motie Omtzigt c.s. over onderzoek naar het geweld van de Turkse autoriteiten tegen demonstranten
Asks the government to press Turkish authorities for an independent investigation into violence against demonstrators and to report back to parliament.
requests the government, and the foreign minister in particular, to personally urge a member of the Turkish government for a swift and independent investigation
verzoekt de regering, en in het bijzonder de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, woensdag persoonlijk bij een lid van de Turkse regering te pleiten voor een snel en onafhankelijk onderzoek
Motie Keijzer en Krol over het verzachten van de onbedoelde effecten van de bijtelling
Asks the government to soften unintended effects of the AWBZ income-related contribution for elderly and disabled people, by raising the box 3 exemption or lowering contributions meanwhile.
calls on the government to ensure unintended effects are softened for elderly and disabled people.
roept de regering op, te bewerkstelligen dat voor ouderen en gehandicapten de onbedoelde effecten verzacht worden
Motie Keijzer en Krol over het vrijstellen van de eigen woning in box 3
Asks the government to ease higher AWBZ contributions for elderly and disabled people by exempting the owner-occupied home from box 3 and lowering contributions meanwhile.
calls on the government to ensure that for elderly and disabled people the unintended effects are softened by exempting the owner-occupied home in box 3

roept de regering op, te bewerkstelligen dat voor ouderen en gehandicapten de onbedoelde effecten verzacht worden door de eigen woning, daar waar deze het enige vastgoed is dat in bezit is en te koop, vrij te stellen in box 3
Motie van het lid Karabulut c.s. over inzichtelijk maken van de cumulatie van maatregelen
Asks the government to make the cumulative effect of its coalition-agreement measures visible for specific vulnerable groups such as pensioners, tenants, students and single parents on benefits.
requests the government to make the cumulation of measures transparent for specific groups in society
verzoekt de regering, de cumulatie van maatregelen inzichtelijk te maken voor specifieke groepen in de samenleving
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Krol over compenseren van het koopkrachtverlies van ouderen en gepensioneerden
Asks the government to compensate older people and pensioners for loss of purchasing power in 2013.
requests the government to compensate the loss of purchasing power of older people and pensioners in 2013
verzoekt de regering, het koopkrachtverlies van ouderen en gepensioneerden in 2013 te compenseren
Motie van het lid Karabulut c.s. over compensen van het koopkrachtverlies van mensen met lage inkomens en uitkeringsgerechtigden
Asks the government to compensate low-income people and benefit recipients for purchasing power loss in 2013 through a tax measure on millionaires.
requests the government to compensate the loss of purchasing power of people with low incomes and benefit recipients in 2013
verzoekt de regering, het koopkrachtverlies van mensen met lage inkomens en uitkeringsgerechtigden in 2013 te compenseren
Motie van het lid Krol c.s. over onderzoek naar mogelijkheden om inkomensverslechtering van gepensioneerden tegen te gaan
Asks the government to investigate ways to stop the income decline of pensioners caused by the Wet uniformering loonbegrip and inform the Kamer.
requests the government to examine the possibilities to counter this income decline of pensioners
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om deze inkomensverslechtering van gepensioneerden tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Voortman c.s. over het inzichtelijk maken van de koopkrachteffecten voor huurders
Asks the government to make the purchasing-power effects for tenants visible through an affordability check and to use it in the debate on the landlord levy and rent increases.
requests the government to make the purchasing-power effects for tenants visible with an affordability check and to involve them in the debate on the landlord levy
verzoekt de regering, de koopkrachteffecten voor huurders inzichtelijk te maken met behulp van een betaalbaarheidscheck en deze te betrekken bij het debat over de verhuurderheffing
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Shifts €10 million within the development budget from Mali budget support to the FLOW fund for women and girls in developing countries in 2013.
Coverage is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Amendment moving 10 million euros to the FLOW fund for women in developing countries in 2013, financed by cutting budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het in 2013 eenmalig verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor UN-Women met € 2 miljoen
Increases funding for UN Women by 2 million euros in 2013 by reducing budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by reducing article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden via een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie van het lid Krol over het nationale gelijkbehandelingsrecht
Asks the government to add sanctions to the General Equal Treatment Act so that they meet EU requirements of effectiveness and deterrence.
requests the government to amend Dutch legislation so that the possibilities to impose sanctions are included in the General Equal Treatment Act
verzoekt de regering, de Nederlandse wetgeving op dit punt aan te passen, in de zin dat de mogelijkheden tot het opleggen van sancties in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling worden opgenomen
Motie de leden Van Vliet en Krol over het onverkort in stand houden van de huidige WW
Asks the government to keep the current unemployment benefit (WW) unchanged and to make proposals to that effect.
requests the government to maintain the current WW unchanged
verzoekt de regering, de huidige WW onverkort in stand te houden
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Krol over leeftijdsbewust personeelsbeleid
Asks the government to pursue ambitious age-conscious personnel policy in the social agreement and to break up age-based pay and leave arrangements in collective agreements.
requests the government to pursue ambitious agreements on age-conscious personnel policy
verzoekt de regering, daarbij in te zetten op ambitieuze afspraken over leeftijdsbewust personeelsbeleid
Motie van het lid Krol over een voorkeursbeleid op grond van leeftijd
Asks the government to legally allow preferential hiring based on age, as already permitted for women, ethnic minorities and disabled people.
requests the government to make this legally possible also on the ground of age
verzoekt de regering, dit juridisch tevens mogelijk te maken voor de grond leeftijd
Motie van de leden Krol en Ulenbelt over de preventieve ontslagtoets
Asks the government to keep the preventive dismissal review by both the UWV and the judge, rather than replacing the UWV review with a mandatory advice request.
requests the government to maintain the preventive dismissal review at both the UWV and the judge
verzoekt de regering, de preventieve ontslagtoets bij zowel het UWV als de rechter in stand te houden
Motie van het lid Krol over de voorgenomen wijziging van de WW-duur
Asks the government to refrain from shortening the WW benefit duration until the labour market has recovered.
requests the government to refrain from the planned change to the WW duration until the labour market has recovered
verzoekt de regering, af te zien van de voorgenomen wijziging van de WW-duur totdat de arbeidsmarkt zich hersteld heeft
Motie van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over de informele zorg en mantelzorgers
Motion asks government to have the SCP study the state of informal care and family caregivers and their role in long-term care reform.
requests the government to have the Social and Cultural Planning Office investigate the current state of informal care
verzoekt de regering, het Sociaal Cultureel Planbureau te laten onderzoeken hoe de huidige stand van zaken is van de informele zorg
Motie Van Tongeren c.s. over het vaststellen van iemands onschuld in hoger beroep
Asks the government to research how often innocence is established only on appeal or cassation and to propose initiatives to reduce the need for such appeals.
requests the government to conduct research into the number of criminal cases in which the innocence of the suspect is established on appeal or cassation
verzoekt de regering om, een onderzoek te doen naar de omvang van het aantal strafzaken
Motie Schouw c.s. over de bezuinigingen op het College bescherming persoonsgegevens
Asks the government to reconsider the extra 10% budget cut to the Data Protection Authority and to fund its tasks, reporting to the House by 1 March 2013.
requests the government to reconsider the cuts to the Data Protection Authority
verzoekt de regering, de bezuinigingen op het College bescherming persoonsgegevens te heroverwegen
Motie Berndsen-Jansen c.s. over  het capaciteitsprobleem bij de politie
Asks the government to name five top priorities for the police for the next two years and not expand them until capacity problems are solved, and to inform the House.
requests the government to name five top priorities for the police for the next two years
verzoekt de regering, voor de komende twee jaar vijf topprioriteiten voor de politie te benoemen
Motie Schouw c.s. over Ugandese LHBT-asielzoekers
Asks the government, if the anti-homosexuality law passes in Uganda, to inform the Chamber promptly about a possible moratorium on removing Ugandan LGBT asylum seekers.
immediately inform the Chamber about a possible decision and departure moratorium for all Ugandan LGBT asylum seekers
direct de Kamer te informeren over een mogelijk besluit- en vertrekmoratorium voor alle Ugandese LHBT-asielzoekers
Motie Van Tongeren c.s. over Ranov-vergunninghouders
Asks the government to ensure Ranov permit holders who were exempt from the passport requirement are not refused naturalisation for lacking a legalised birth certificate or valid passport.
requests the government to ensure that Ranov permit holders who submit a naturalisation request and were exempted from the passport requirement are not now held against them
verzoekt de regering om, ervoor te zorgen dat Ranov-vergunninghouders die een naturalisatieverzoek indienen en waren vrijgesteld van het paspoortvereiste, nu niet krijgen tegengeworpen
Motie Van Tongeren c.s. over verruimde gezinsmigratie
Motion asks the government not to block family migration possibilities for dependent grandparents and adult children in cases where the extended family migration may be abolished.
requests the government, in the cases mentioned, not to stand in the way of the possibility of family migration
verzoekt de regering, in de genoemde gevallen de mogelijkheid tot gezinsmigratie niet in de weg te staan
Motie Van Tongeren c.s. over kindersekstoerisme
Asks the government to lead international efforts against child sex tourism and examine how Dutch criminal cases can improve, informing the House.
requests the government to take the lead in the international professionalisation of prevention and combating of child sex tourism
verzoekt de regering om, het voortouw te nemen in de internationale professionalisering van de voorkoming en bestrijding van kindersekstoerisme
Amendement van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. over de voortzetting van de bestaande regeling tegemoetkoming adoptiekosten
Shifts budget within the Youth article to continue the adoption cost allowance scheme after 31 December 2012 on the same conditions.
This amendment aims to allocate the money reserved in the budget for the adoption cost allowance so it can continue to be used under the same conditions.
Dit amendement beoogt het op de Begroting gereserveerde geld voor de tegemoetkoming adoptiekosten te bestemmen om het onder dezelfde voorwaarden te blijven aanwenden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitvoering van de Wet tot samenvoeging van de gemeenten Groningen, Haren en Ten Boer

MP Krol asks the Minister of Interior about the 2019 Groningen-Haren-Ten Boer merger: whether an evaluation of another merger applies here, whether solar parks planned by Groningen breach the merger agreement, how local taxes rose for former Haren residents, and whether an investigation into official bias is warranted. The Minister answers that the evaluation does not apply, that solar park planning is a matter for regional energy planning and the municipality, that cost increases are largely not caused by the merger, and that she again declines an independent investigation.
I am therefore again not willing to start such an investigation, because I do not see its added value.
Ik ben dus wederom niet bereid een dergelijk onderzoek op te starten, omdat ik de meerwaarde ervan niet zie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het rapport Onderzoeksrapport Feitenrelaas verkoop pand Noordeinde 64/64a van de Auditdienst Rijk

An MP asks, after the Auditdienst Rijk report on the sale of Noordeinde 64/64A, whether integrity breaches, conflicts of interest, favouritism or a non-market price occurred, and whether the sale should be annulled. The State Secretary answers that the report shows no integrity breaches or insider-knowledge abuse, that he sees no need for further research, and that the valuations and the sale price were market-conform, rejecting annulment and declining to answer questions on the Hague city council and mayor.
I therefore see no reason for further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het ophalen van ondersteuningsverklaringen voor nieuwe partijen

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities that failed to let voters sign support declarations for new parties without an appointment should be re-instructed, and whether the collection period should be extended. The minister says she has reminded all mayors, contacted the municipalities concerned, and sees no need to extend the period because the covid-era extension already applies and the candidacy deadline is fixed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Krol over schrijnende quarantaine in verzorgingshuis

Krol asked the minister about an elderly woman quarantined for two weeks in a Nunspeet care home with only a commode and no shower, questioning why testing was not used instead and whether the facility should be inspected. The minister said the woman has since moved to a new location, that testing cannot replace quarantine, and that the facility considers the situation undesirable, without committing to a quality inspection.
Are you willing to subject the location to a quality inspection?
Bent u bereid de locatie aan een kwaliteitsonderzoek te onderwerpen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de Ierse kleurcodes voor gedragsmaatregelen om de verspreiding van het coronavirus tegen te gaan

An MP asks the Health Minister about Ireland's colour-coded alert system for scaling up behavioural COVID-19 measures, whether it is too simple, and whether clear communication and a similar scheme can be introduced urgently. The minister confirms awareness, says a public version of a route map inspired by the Irish model has been published, and refers back to earlier answers without committing to a new scheme.
This public version contains different colours for different levels and is inspired by the Irish model.
Deze publieksversie bevat verschillende kleuren voor verschillende niveaus en is geïnspireerd op het Ierse model.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een WOB-verzoek met betrekking tot de correspondentie herindeling Groningen, Haren en Ten Boer

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew that a Wob request for correspondence behind written answers on the Groningen, Haren and Ten Boer municipal merger had been delayed beyond the promised decision date, and why. The minister confirmed the facts, said the decision was issued on 6 October 2020 after a third party objected and internal coordination caused further delay, and agreed to answer quickly.
Due to the summer recess, the request could not be handled within the usual period.
In verband met het zomerreces kon het verzoek niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn behandeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over mogelijke integriteitsschendingen bij de verkoop van het pand Noordeinde 64/64a te Den Haag

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about possible integrity violations in the sale of Noordeinde 64/64a in The Hague, including former Rijksvastgoedbedrijf staff involvement, a former senior official starting a commercial firm, and whether the ADR audit was delayed. The Staatssecretaris answered that no involvement of former staff was observed, that no known cases of breached confidentiality exist, that the sale was not a tender so the Scheiding van belang rules do not apply, and that the ADR report is expected in November with a government response.
Furthermore, I am awaiting the final ADR report; see the answer to question 7.
Verder wacht ik het definitieve rapport van de ADR af; zie het antwoord op vraag 7.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het aanstellen van een directeur voor het stafbureau van het Nationaal Groeifonds

MP Krol asks the Finance Minister why a director was appointed to the Nationaal Groeifonds staff bureau before the 2021 budget for the fund was approved by parliament, and questions the appointee's track record and the fund's oversight. The minister answers that preparatory work must start now, that the appointment followed a profile and a selection conversation, that costs will fall under the fund's budget from 2021, and declines to discuss individual officials' past contributions while refusing to stop the preparations.
It is for the House to decide whether or not to approve the budget of the Nationaal Groeifonds.
Het is aan de Kamer om al dan niet goedkeuring te geven aan de begroting van het Nationaal Groeifonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitlatingen van de minister-president tijdens het debat over de uitkomst van de Europese Top inzake het herstelfonds

An MP asked the Prime Minister, through written questions, how the Recovery Fund relates to eurobonds, the coalition agreement's ban on joint debt, and President Macron's 'common debt' remark, and whether monetary experts were consulted. Finance Minister Hoekstra answered that the instrument is a temporary, bounded EU bond issuance with joint liability proportional to GNI shares rather than joint and several guarantees, and that the Dutch government has sufficient expertise in-house.
With the recovery instrument, there is no structural joint financing or guaranteeing of member states' debts and deficits.
Er is met het herstelinstrument geen sprake van het structureel gemeenschappelijk financieren of garanderen van schulden en tekorten van de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de opslag van ammoniumnitraat in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about ammonium nitrate storage in the Netherlands, its safety, inspection history and incidents after the Beirut explosion. The government answered in detail, stating that storage is regulated under Brzo 2015 and PGS7, inspections are conducted annually, and no ammonium nitrate incidents are known.
I have answered the questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb de vragen zo snel als mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over herindelingen in het algemeen en de herindeling Groningen, Haren, Ten Boer in het bijzonder

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the procedural rules and assessment frameworks for a province-initiated municipal merger (Groningen, Haren, Ten Boer) bind the province and protect municipalities, and whether the ministry adequately supervised the process. The Minister answers that the procedural rules give clarity, the framework binds the Minister rather than provinces, the Minister judges whether the process was careful when the advice is received, and that the process was assessed as careful, though support in Haren was more limited.
Only I therefore account for their conduct.
Alleen ik leg dan ook over hun handelen verantwoording af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de verkoop van het pand Noordeinde 64/64A te Den Haag

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Interior about the sale of Noordeinde 64/64A in The Hague to a bag maker below its later-valued price, asking about the valuations, secrecy, the sale process and integrity. The State Secretary answered that the sale followed the reallocation procedure at the valuation of Frisia, that the MVGM valuation was unknown to the seller, and that an ADR investigation is ongoing, with the reallocation procedure to be adjusted later.
I also wish to inform you that I am currently having an ADR investigation carried out into the sale of this property, the results of which I expect before the summer.
Tevens wil ik u in dit verband melden dat ik momenteel een ADR-onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de verkoop van dit pand, waarvan ik voor de zomer de resultaten verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het wetsvoorstel Samenvoeging van de gemeenten Appingedam, Delfzijl en Loppersum (Kamerstuk 35344)

An MP from 50PLUS asked whether the COVID-19 lockdown would hamper preparations for the November 2020 municipal elections in the new Eemsdelta municipality, and whether elections could be postponed. The minister said there is currently no reason to expect serious problems, that postponement is legally possible by the provincial executive for weighty reasons, and that further postponement would require a specific statutory regulation.

However, I will maintain contact with the municipalities concerned in the coming months if restrictive COVID-19 measures remain in force and possible bottlenecks in organising the (election) process need to be addressed.

Ik zal evenwel in de komende maanden contact onderhouden met de betrokken gemeenten indien beperkende maatregelen rond het COVID-19 virus van kracht blijven en mogelijke knelpunten moeten worden geadresseerd in de organisatie van het (verkiezings)proces.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Krol over het melden van mogelijke coronadoden door huisartsen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether GPs must report suspected COVID-19 deaths to the GGD and to be included in RIVM figures, since only test-confirmed cases are reported. The minister answered that suspected cases no longer need reporting under the current policy, that the Wpg is effectively set aside pending formal change, and that RIVM will only publish confirmed COVID-19 deaths, with excess mortality used as a proxy.
Pending a formal amendment of the reporting obligation, only confirmed cases therefore need to be reported to the GGD.
Vooruitlopend op een formele wijziging van de meldplicht geldt daarom dat alleen bevestigde gevallen gemeld hoeven te worden aan de GGD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Wilders, Krol, Van der Staaij en Baudet over COVID-19 patiënten aan boord van vluchten uit coronabrandhaard New York

Five MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about the lack of temperature checks and symptom screening for passengers on flights from COVID-19-affected New York, and whether the government should ban such flights. The answer is a referral: the questions are answered in a separate letter on tourism during Easter and the May holiday and measures for New York flights, with the answers to questions 15-19 due on 8 April 2020.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Asscher over de berichten inzake Nederlanders die vastzitten op het cruiseschip Costa Luminosa

MPs Krol and Asscher asked the Foreign Minister why dozens of Dutch elderly passengers remained aboard the Costa Luminosa when other countries had evacuated theirs, what was being done, and whether consular capacity and information were adequate for Dutch citizens stranded abroad. The minister replied that Dutch passengers disembarked in Savona on 23 March and were flown home, that a convenant 'Bijzondere Bijstand Buitenland' was set up to help stranded travellers, and that consular services were reorganised and information channels were in use.
The ministry has no figures on the total number of Dutch travellers abroad.
Het ministerie heeft geen cijfers over het totale aantal Nederlandse reizigers in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over straatgeweld en het toenemend aantal steekincidenten

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Education ministers about rising street violence and knife incidents, including data, reporting by victims, camera technology and a plan of action. The minister answered that knife incidents are not separately registered, that targeted analyses are under way with results expected mid-2020, that police see hardening rather than increase in street violence, and that a broader plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2020.
Knife incidents and street violence are not registered as such in the police systems.
Steekincidenten en straatgeweld worden niet als zodanig geregistreerd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij WA- en VC-autoverzekeringen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance and Justice ministers about age-based surcharges and age limits in car insurance, citing evidence that older drivers cause less damage yet pay more premiums, and asked whether this is unlawful age discrimination and what action will be taken. The minister said insurers set their own risk models, that insurance is cancellable so consumers can switch, that the government will not judge insurer contracts or prescribe discounts, and that the discrimination question is for civil courts, Kifid or insurers' complaint procedures, not the Human Rights Commission.
It is not for me to assess whether there is unjustified distinction in car insurance.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of er bij autoverzekeringen sprake is van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Helvert over de kranslegging op het oorlogskerkhof te Margaten

MPs Krol and Van Helvert asked why wreaths of balsam fir from the United States may stay on war graves in Margraten only 72 hours, and whether this could be changed given the tradition's importance to families. The Minister answered that the short period reflects EU plant health rules and pest risks, that the permit was granted exceptionally, and that a new risk analysis would be needed for any future request, while offering talks on alternatives.
If desired, I am happy to discuss with the initiators how we can meet the wishes regarding American wreath-laying traditions in an alternative way.
Desgewenst ga ik graag in gesprek met de initiatiefnemers hoe we op alternatieve wijze aan de wensen rond Amerikaanse kransleggingstradities tegemoet kunnen komen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over het plenaire debat inzake het bericht dat het UWV ten onrechte uitkeringen verstrekt aan gevangenen (d.d. 4 september 2019)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked why fully non-accountable tbs patients in forensic care can keep their social security benefits, how many receive them, and whether the government will fix this. The minister says current law and Centrale Raad van Beroep case law require continuation in such cases, the number is not recorded, and the absence of a co-payment will be included in the evaluation of the Wfz, with a possible solution if unjust situations are found.
This is not known / cannot be determined.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht 'De Goudse goochelt met getallen in beleggingsverzekeringen'

MP Krol asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging that insurer De Goudse used misleading illustrations and flawed actuarial assumptions in investment insurance offers, and whether consumers face an unequal fight and whether collective redress should follow. The minister stated that the AFM supervises compliance with the Wft and may enforce, that consumers can turn to Kifid or the civil courts, that the government has introduced consumer-protection rules, and that insurers offer ongoing aftercare and case-by-case coulance, while declining to comment on individual cases.
For completeness, I note that the AFM, given its duty of confidentiality, cannot make statements about individual cases.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik hierbij op dat de AFM gelet op haar geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen kan doen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het schrappen van gemeentelijke hondenbelasting

MP Krol asked the Minister of Interior whether dog tax, a relic originally aimed at rabies and stray dogs, should be abolished and whether the Minister would consider scrapping the legal basis in the Gemeentewet. The Minister answered that municipalities may freely decide on dog tax, that the Rfv advised abolition, and that abolition is being examined in an interdepartmental working group whose final report is expected in early 2020.
Under the chairmanship of BZK an interdepartmental working group has been set up to examine the revision of the municipal tax area.
Onder het voorzitterschap van BZK is een ambtelijke werkgroep ingericht waarin de herziening van het gemeentelijk belastinggebied wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over Brabantse boeren die worden lastiggevallen door drugscriminelen maar geen aangifte doen

MP Krol asked the Minister of Justice and Security why Brabant farmers harassed by drug criminals do not file reports, whether police have been withdrawn from rural areas, whether reports will be prioritised, and whether the army and a multidisciplinary pilot could help. Minister Grapperhaus denied police withdrawal, described existing prevention and reporting channels and a funded anti-undermining offensive, rejected a military role, and promised a later letter on the army proposal.
No, the claim that the police have largely been cut back in rural Brabant is not correct.
Nee, dat de politie grotendeels is wegbezuinigd op het Brabantse platteland klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Van Otterloo, Van Brenk en Sazias over "de Augustusraming van het CPB"

Four 50PLUS MPs asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister why the CPB's August forecast cut pensioners' purchasing-power gains sharply, whether pension cuts were included, why the share of households gaining or losing was dropped from the table, and the size of interest-rate windfalls. The Minister answered that the changes stem from updated inflation and interest-rate assumptions, that the presentation was changed to avoid misreading, and that interest windfalls feed into the budget decision on Budget Day.
The percentage of households with a positive or negative purchasing-power development has been removed from the boxplot.
Het percentage huishoudens met een positieve of negatieve koopkrachtontwikkeling is geschrapt uit de boxplot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over de grenseffecten van de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked about cross-border social security effects of the Wnra civil service law reform, including how many civil servants would switch social security regimes, sick-pay obligations, Article 16 agreements, and notification of Belgian and German authorities. The minister answered that effects depend on individual circumstances, estimated 450 to 550 university staff might face a switch, explained the applicable rules, and said the SVB will handle Article 16 requests under existing policy and foreign authorities will be informed via the Administrative Commission.
The Minister of Education, Culture and Science is in contact with the employers' organisations and will follow developments.
De Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is in contact met de werkgeversorganisaties en zal de ontwikkelingen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat de uitvaartpolis vaak zoek is

Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Interior whether a comprehensive insurance overview for heirs is technically feasible, whether the pension portal and BRP data could show funeral policies, and whether the GDPR and insurers' communication are obstacles or need action. The State Secretary answered that the Verbond van Verzekeraars says a full overview is currently not feasible, that the BRP legal framework does not allow automatic death signals to insurers, that the GDPR is no obstacle, and that a publicity campaign is unnecessary as the insurers already promote their search service.
I am willing to enter into discussion about that.
Ik ben bereid daarover in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Geleijnse en Krol over leeftijd-onderscheid bij verzekeringen

Three MPs from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Finance Ministers about a 75-year age ceiling in an American Express travel insurance policy linked to Flying Blue, and whether it amounts to age discrimination and insufficient disclosure. The government declined to judge the contracts, noted that American Express has removed the age ceiling, and pointed to complaint routes and the AFM's supervisory role over information duties.
It is not for me to pass judgement on the assessment of contracts.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat een NPO-topman bestuurder was van een brievenbusfirma en het bericht over de declaraties van de NPO-directeur

MP Krol asked whether the NPO director concealed directorship of a UK company, whether the board should have probed his restaurant ownership, whether a jubilee dinner in his own restaurant breached governance rules, and how the minister views NPO's handling and integrity enforcement. The minister answered that the restaurant ownership was disclosed at hiring and judged not conflicting, that CIPO found the code applied adequately, and that integrity is primarily the organisations' own responsibility with the Commissariaat supervising.
This was therefore known to the NPO at hiring on 1 May 2014 and was subsequently included in the 2014 compliance declaration.
Dit was dus bij indiensttreding op 1 mei 2014 aan de NPO bekend en is nadien opgenomen in de complianceverklaring over 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken, Krol, Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Minister in de strafzaak tegen het lid Wilders

MPs from D66, SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice about possible contacts between his predecessor Opstelten or ministry staff and the Public Prosecution Service over the case against MP Wilders, including a timeline of contacts and why ambtsberichten are kept confidential. The Minister says he cannot vouch for all contacts, will not comment on individual prosecutions, and provides a partial timeline with confidentiality grounds for withholding the advisory reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het binnen korte tijd neerstorten van twee gevechtsvliegtuigen van het type F35 (Joint Strike Fighter)

Krol (50PLUS) asked whether the two F-35 crashes (US Marines F-35B in 2018, Japanese F-35A in 2019) warranted grounding flights like the Boeing 737 MAX, and how the Netherlands would be involved in the investigations and whether deliveries would be delayed. The Secretary of State answered that the US crash cause was identified and fixed via fuel line replacement, the Japanese cause is still under investigation with Japan grounding its fleet, and the Netherlands sees no reason to halt operations or expects delivery delays, being kept informed under programme arrangements.
There is currently no reason to assume that the cause of the accident with the Japanese F-35A is related to the cause of the crash of the American F-35B.
Er is momenteel geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat de oorzaak van het ongeluk met de Japanse F-35A verband houdt met de oorzaak van het neerstorten van de Amerikaanse F-35B.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Krol over drugsdumpingen in de natuur

MPs Bergkamp and Krol asked about drug-waste dumping in nature and residential areas, its costs, health and environmental effects, and whether a legal drop-off point should be allowed. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dumping cannot be broken down by location, costs fall largely on regional and local authorities supported by national funds, and he rejects a 'drugsluikje' as facilitating crime.
It is not possible to break these registrations down by location; on the basis of the registrations it cannot be stated how often it concerned a residential area or nature area.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze registraties uit te splitsen naar locatie; het valt op basis van de registraties niet aan te geven hoe vaak het een woonwijk of natuurgebied betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel ‘35.000 ton bommen uit WO I lekken springstof vlak voor kust in Knokke’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Defence Minister about reports of WWI munitions leaking explosives off Knokke, Belgium, and about the risks of Dutch offshore munitions dumps, including whether recovery would be safer. The government answered that it is in contact with Belgian authorities, describes four Dutch dumps of mainly WWII conventional munitions, and states that studies found no spontaneous explosion risk or measurable environmental harm, with the monitoring to be repeated in 2019.
I cannot make further statements about the situation in Belgium; that is a matter for the Belgian government.
Over de situatie in België kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen; dat is aan de Belgische overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Krol over het bericht 'Raadslid: Jongeren gooiden mij in de sloot'

MPs Van Dam and Krol asked the Justice Minister why a councillor reporting an assault had to wait two weeks to file a complaint, and whether such delays hinder investigations. The minister answered that police aim for fast, low-threshold reporting, offer aangifte within 48 hours, and that the individual case cannot be discussed while the service is being improved.
I cannot go into the circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de Nederlandse zuinigheid tegenover de Franse spilzucht

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the Dutch versus French fiscal stance, including whether the Netherlands would reward citizens with a comparable gesture to France's 10 billion euro concessions to yellow-vest protesters. The Finance Minister replied that the Dutch and French contexts are not directly comparable, that the government is pursuing tax cuts and higher public spending, and that EU fiscal rules favour building buffers in good economic times.
The Dutch and French contexts are not directly comparable, so it is not possible to attach an amount for the Netherlands.
De Nederlandse en Franse context zijn niet direct te vergelijken, waardoor het niet mogelijk is hieraan een bedrag te koppelen voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de bijna-ramp rond het vreugdevuur Scheveningen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether an independent investigation into the near-disaster at the Scheveningen New Year's bonfire would be requested from the Dutch Safety Board. The minister replied that he understood the Safety Board would start an investigation at the request of The Hague's mayor and declined to comment further at this stage.
I understand that the Dutch Safety Board, within the framework set by the Kingdom Act, will start an investigation into this local situation at the request of The Hague's mayor.

Ik heb begrepen dat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, binnen de kaders die de Rijkswet hiervoor geeft, op verzoek van de burgemeester van Den Haag een onderzoek zal opstarten naar deze lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de coldcase kalender 2018

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the 2018 cold case calendar distributed in prisons, including why it targets detainees, the criteria for cold cases and for calendar inclusion, and why the Chris van de Werken murder was chosen. The minister confirmed the calendar's purpose and criteria in general terms but declined to discuss individual cases and offered only general information on new forensic techniques.
As your House is aware, I in principle do not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga, zoals uw Kamer bekend is, in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de regeling van het openbaar ministerie met Volkert van der Graaf

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister for Legal Protection about costs of the Public Prosecution Service's deal with Volkert van der Graaf, any financial support including emigration or living costs abroad, and whether emigrating convicts receive such aid. The minister declined to give cost details or information on individual financial support, referred to the ongoing special (v.i.) regime running to May 2020, and said such support is not customary.
I will not go into the procedural costs incurred in an individual case.
Ik ga niet in op gemaakte proceskosten in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Vader van omgekomen Dascha start petitie voor camerabeelden’

An MP asked whether closed criminal investigations into possible homicide and sexual offences should be reopened when new facts emerge, whether a Dutch duty to investigate like Germany's should exist, and how the government views the lack of an external oversight body for prosecution and police. The Minister replied that Dutch prosecutors have discretion under the opportunity principle, so reopening is decided case by case with a court authorisation needed where a suspect was already notified, and that oversight is being considered in the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, while Article 6 ECHR protects the accused rather than relatives.
Legally prescribing in general terms that the public prosecutor must start or stop an investigation does not fit within our criminal justice system.
Antwoord 2, 3 en 4 Het (wettelijk) in algemene zin voorschrijven dat de officier van justitie een onderzoek moet starten of stoppen past niet in ons strafrechtelijk systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over malafide slotenmakers

Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about malicious locksmiths who overcharge locked-out customers, including data on scale, victims, prosecution, a mandatory quality mark and a maximum tariff. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police and prosecutors do not register such cases separately, that only some conduct qualifies as fraud, that he opposes a mandatory quality mark in a free market, and that a maximum tariff is not the solution.
The police do not register specifically on the profession of suspects and therefore have no figures available on this.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op het beroep van verdachten en heeft hierover dan ook geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de leeftijdsopbouw van het nieuwe DJI personeel

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister for Legal Protection for the age breakdown of the 800 new DJI staff, how many applicants aged 50 and over were rejected and on what grounds, and for a faster reply. The minister gave a rough age split (60% under 30, 30% aged 30-50, 10% over 50) but said DJI does not record age in selection, so applicant-level age data and rejection grounds cannot be provided.
I therefore cannot state how many of the applicants for the 800 vacancies were 50 or older, how many of them were rejected, and on what grounds.
Ik kan dan ook niet aangeven hoeveel van de sollicitanten voor de 800 vacatures 50 jaar en ouder waren, hoeveel van hen werden afgewezen en op welke gronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over de berichten: 'Discriminatie ouderen in vacatureteksten' en 'vacature sluit ouderen uit'

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the government about reports that job advertisements still exclude older workers through age-related wording, and about enforcement, sanctions and possible criminal law. The State Secretary answered that age-related wording can be direct or indirect discrimination, pointed to the Inspectie SZW review, the 2018-2021 action plan and voluntary tools, and declined to commit to criminal prosecution or to a separate letter before Prinsjesdag.

As announced in my letter on tackling labour market discrimination in the temporary employment sector of 1 May 2018 and in the outline letter on the 2018-2021 Action Plan of 19 July 2018, among other effective alternatives, the possibilities to strengthen the enforcement role of the Inspectorate SZW in supervising discrimination in recruitment and selection are being explored.

Zoals is aangekondigd in mijn brief «Aanpak arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie in uitzendsector» 7 van 1 mei 2018 en in de «Hoofdlijnenbrief Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie 2018–2021» 8 van 19 juli 2018, wordt, naast andere effectieve alternatieven, verkernt wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de handhavende rol van de Inspectie SZW met betrekking tot toezicht op discriminatie bij werving en selectie te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Rooijen over het bericht “Riet Zaal gecompenseerd, volgens pensioenfonds PMT alleen vanwege verkeerde communicatie”

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension fund PMT compensated Riet Zaal only because of miscommunication, and whether other members could be similarly harmed, including by a confidentiality clause and a lost-records issue. The minister answers that PMT says the case is specific to Zaal, that pension funds should be transparent but confidentiality is a matter for the parties, that funds handle complaints first with the Pensions Ombudsman and courts as fallback, and that the 1980s fire had limited effects.
According to PMT, this concerns the specific situation of Mrs Zaal, and there is no reason to assume a comparable situation exists for other pension fund participants.

Volgens PMT betreft dit de specifieke situatie van mevrouw Zaal en is er geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat een vergelijkbare situatie aan de orde zou zijn voor andere deelnemers van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over het bericht ‘Rijbewijs honderden ouderen onterecht ingenomen’

MPs Van Brenk and Krol asked the Minister of Justice and Security how licences could be seized on the spot and how a driver found fit after examination could have had his licence taken, and about the marechaussee making medical judgements. The minister answered that the listed grounds for on-the-spot seizure are alcohol, speeding, dangerous driving and suspected insufficient fitness, but declined to address the specific case because it is an ongoing criminal investigation.
The case mentioned in the reporting concerns an ongoing criminal investigation.
De in de berichtgeving genoemde casus betreft een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over onlineoplichting via datingsites

MP Krol asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about online fraud via dating sites that use fake profiles, including the size of the problem, consumer disclosure duties, and protection of vulnerable users. The state secretary said data on the number of operators, victims and damage is unavailable, pointed to consumer law and ACM supervision, and to fraud prevention, Slachtofferhulp and the Veilig Daten keurmerk, while no registration of identity fraud via dating sites exists.
However, I do not have data on the basis of which I can estimate the number of companies operating dating sites with fake profiles.
Ik beschik echter niet over gegevens op basis waarvan ik een schatting kan maken van het aantal bedrijven dat dating sites met onechte profielen exploiteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht 'Verdachte verpleeghuismoord had verklaring van goed gedrag'
