MP Krol asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a suspect in the nursing-home insulin murders held a certificate of good conduct (VOG) despite a prior conviction, and for five-year VOG statistics and measures to make the VOG more reliable. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy and the ongoing judicial process, said the statistics are not available, and saw no reason for new measures, calling the VOG a momentary check that supports recidivism reduction.
The right to privacy means I am extremely reticent about information on individual cases.
Het recht op privacy maakt dat ik uiterst terughoudend ben met informatie over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Krol over mededelingen in de Troonrede en media over de voor 2018 verwachte koopkrachtontwikkeling

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister-President whether the Throne Speech claim that all groups, including social minima and the elderly, keep their purchasing power in 2018 is nuanced enough, citing budget figures showing many workers, benefit recipients and pensioners losing ground, plus municipal tax effects and the Wajong cut. Minister Asscher answers that median household purchasing power rises, that averages cannot be read as guarantees for individual households, that municipal effects are excluded from national projections yet small in aggregate, and that the government is open about these limits.
It is always good to nuance the purchasing power figures.
Het is altijd goed om de koopkrachtcijfers te nuanceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht 'Nederland tweede op lijst online illegale wapenhandel'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that the Netherlands ranks second worldwide in online illegal arms trade, asking about oversight, strategy and criminal law. The state secretary acknowledged the trend, said the report does not allow hard conclusions on location, and pointed to intensified enforcement, specialised police teams and a pending computer-crime bill.
The approach is being intensified through stronger investigative and digital expertise and the setting up of public-private partnerships with postal and parcel services.
De aanpak wordt met de inzet van de versterkte opsporings- en digitale expertise en het opzetten van publiek-private samenwerkingsverbanden met post- en pakketdiensten geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de tijdelijke opvang van ouderen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about a reported explosive growth in temporary care for elderly patients after hospital discharge, and about insurers paying less than the full cost of a 'recovery hotel' stay. The state secretary disputed the claimed doubling of demand, explained the insurance rules and maximum tariffs for first-line stays, and said the NZa as regulator is responsible for enforcing the duty of care, with a future NZa report possibly prompting talks with insurers.
The NZa quick scan sent to the House on 22 December 2016 shows no signs that insufficient care was contracted for 2016 and 2017.
Antwoord 6 Uit de quikscan van de NZa 3 , die uw Kamer op 22 december 2016 is toegestuurd, blijkt dat er geen signalen zijn dat er voor 2016 en 2017 onvoldoende zorg is ingekocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending van Kassa inzake onveilige sleutelkluisjes

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about unsafe key lockboxes used with elderly home care, raised by a Kassa broadcast, and about actions taken since 2014, cooperation with stakeholders, public information, safe alternatives, a Putten subsidy and the government's duty to help the elderly live safely. The state secretary said such lockboxes are undesirable, pointed to an ongoing cross-ministerial track with sector parties and CCV research into alternatives, said the product concerned was removed from the Politie Keurmerk list, and stressed shared responsibility of clients, professionals, municipalities and insurers.
Under the responsibility of the Minister of Security and Justice, a track was started in 2016 to promote safe access to homes of vulnerable groups.
Onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie is in 2016 een traject ingezet om veilige toegang voor woningen van kwetsbare groepen te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Oudere kankerpatiënt krijgt andere behandeling dan jongere”

An MP asked the Minister of Health about an IKNL report finding that older cancer patients receive different treatment than younger ones, with large hospital variation. The Minister says care should be tailored, that variation should be examined through regional Comprehensive Cancer Networks, and sees no reason to start separate talks with parties.
At this moment I see no reason to enter into separate discussions with parties about this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier apart over met partijen in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Maximaal 3 plassen in verpleeghuis Careyn'

An MP from 50PLUS asks the state secretary for health about a report that residents of nursing home Careyn may only use the toilet three times a day, and whether this is an isolated incident given the IGZ has placed Careyn on its blacklist and sent an intervention team. The secretary calls it an incident that the provider must handle, says the IGZ maintains intensive supervision and support, but gives no specific new action on this case.
The IGZ advice to deploy an intervention team means there is considerable problematic situation at Careyn.
Het advies van de IGZ om een interventieteam in te zetten betekent dat er sprake is van een aanzienlijke problematiek bij Careyn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht: te veel bacteriën in thuisbezorgmaaltijden ouderen

MP Krol asked the ministers whether they were aware of a Nutrilab study finding high bacteria levels and salt concerns in home-delivered meals for elderly people, and whether extra inspection and measures would follow. The government answered that the NVWA will treat the results as a signal in hygiene supervision and perform extra checks at the companies concerned, while noting no legal nutritional standards exist for these meals.
The NVWA will take the results of the study as a signal into account in supervising hygiene and temperature control at the producers concerned.
De NVWA zal de resultaten van het onderzoek als signaal meenemen in het toezicht op de hygiëne- en temperatuurbeheersing bij de betrokken producenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een vermeende geheime fiscale compensatieregeling voor het Koninklijk Huis

An MP from 50PLUS asked the ministers of Interior and Finance about an alleged secret tax compensation arrangement for the Royal House, covering ten questions on its legitimacy, legality, parliamentary knowledge and possible recovery of benefits. The government's answer, given by Prime Minister Rutte, refers the MP to an earlier letter answering a related request from another MP, rather than answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “McGregor werkt oudgedienden eruit: 200 ontslagen” en “Een zaak waar je zo wordt ingeruild”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the dismissal of about 200 senior staff at McGregor after bankruptcy and replacement with cheaper temporary workers amounts to age discrimination, and whether bankruptcy law should be tightened to protect older workers. The minister said assessing the specific case is for the curator and possibly the courts, that older workers should have a place in a restart, and that the employment position of workers in bankruptcy is being studied with stakeholder consultation to follow.
It is not for me as Minister of Social Affairs and Employment to assess this specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid om deze specifieke praktijksituatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Oudere werknemers de dupe bij doorstart door nieuwe wet'

Krol (50PLUS) asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wwz makes older workers more costly in a doorstart after bankruptcy, and whether McGregor staff with 7+ years' service were excluded and how workers' protection can be improved. The minister says the Wwz keeps accrued service through successor-employer rules, that the choice was deliberate, and that he will consult stakeholders on the curator's role in protecting workers' interests.
I am aware that a company bankruptcy can have considerable consequences for employees, even when the bankrupt company makes a doorstart.
Ik ben me ervan bewust dat een faillissement van een onderneming aanzienlijke gevolgen kan hebben voor de werknemers, ook wanneer de failliete onderneming een doorstart maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel ‘Meer dan honderd regelingen voor ouderen slecht benut’

MP Krol asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that companies miss out on large sums of premium discounts and subsidies for older and disabled workers, and asked how the government would ensure firms know about and can navigate these schemes. The minister declined to judge the unseen Aon study, said existing schemes are already communicated through several channels, and stated that unused funds generally return to the treasury.
I cannot give a judgement on findings that I do not know.
Ik kan geen oordeel geven over bevindingen die ik niet ken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten dat gemeenten de weg naar schuldhulpverlening blokkeren en slechts 1 op de 5 gemeenten een juiste beschikking schuldhulp geeft

An MP asks whether municipalities have become stricter in admitting people to debt assistance, leaving problem debtors without help, and whether decisions lack proper motivation and remedy information. The State Secretary responds that the evaluation finds municipalities strive for broad access but results are hard to measure, promises an Inspectorate investigation and a possible tightening of the Wgs, and states that Awb requirements for motivation and remedy clauses are sufficiently guaranteed.
Anticipating this, I am preparing a possible tightening of the Wgs to remove the identified access blockages.
Daarop vooruitlopend bereid ik een mogelijke aanscherping van de Wgs voor om geconstateerde blokkades betreffende de toegang weg te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel "Negen op de tien ouderen zien zorgverleners te kort"

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Health about a Nationaal Ouderenfonds finding that home-care workers increasingly neglect their signalling duty for loneliness, malnutrition and dementia, and who bears responsibility. The State Secretary agreed signalling is important, called it a shared responsibility of care providers, the social domain and the client's environment, and welcomed the Fund's initiative to propose improvements.
An agreement has been made with the Ouderenfonds that they will send me a proposal for this.
Met het Ouderenfonds is de afspraak gemaakt dat zij mij hiervoor een voorstel doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Wijkverpleging noodgedwongen soms ook poetshulp”

Krol (50PLUS) asked the state secretary about a report that district nurses sometimes do cleaning work and that many carers are overburdened. The state secretary said nurses should not do routine household work but may incidentally do small tasks, pointed to respite care and municipal responsibility for carers, and said capacity should be used effectively.
I am aware that carers are often heavily burdened and that overburdening must be prevented as much as possible.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat mantelzorgers vaak zwaar belast worden en dat overbelasting zo veel mogelijk moet worden voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het oordeel van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens ‘VU-VUMC discrimineerde twaalf oudere medewerkers op grond van leeftijd bij de ontslagaanzegging in het kader van een reorg

MP Krol asked the ministers about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that VU-VUmc discriminated against twelve older employees by age in dismissal notices during a reorganisation, including a chairman's remark about cheaper younger researchers and the government's response to the ruling. The minister declined to give a substantive judgment, stressed that discrimination assessment is for the courts and the College, noted that College rulings are not binding and that the VU is a private law body where UWV preventive review applies since July 2015, and took no concrete action.
It is not for me to pass a substantive judgment on this.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Krol en Van Klaveren over "het behandelvoorbehoud op het EU-voorstel inzake bedrijfspensioenfondsen"

MPs Omtzigt, Krol and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would present the negotiated text on the EU occupational pensions (IORP) directive in time for Parliament to instruct its voting position, and by when. The State Secretary replied that the consolidated negotiation text was sent to Parliament on 24 June and made available via the Council extranet, that COREPER would discuss it on 30 June, and that Parliament could still state its view before the Council decision.
The consolidated text of the negotiation result will be submitted to COREPER
De geconsolideerde tekst van het onderhandelingsresultaat zal worden voorgelegd aan COREPER
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de complexiteit van het belastingstelsel en mogelijke verbetering van voorlichting en informatievoorziening aan belastingplichtigen

An MP asks whether the complexity of the Dutch tax system, illustrated by the elderly tax credit (ouderenkorting) and the partner income-allocation rules, can be simplified and whether taxpayers receive adequate information. The Secretary of State confirms the rules' effects, explains the allocation options in the tax return software, says simplification is taken seriously, and reports that the Belastingdienst is improving information provision and examining simplifying the income averaging procedure.
The cabinet takes the need for simplification very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de noodzaak tot vereenvoudiging zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten over een tekort aan seniorenwoningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about reports of a shortage of senior-suitable housing and about ANBO research showing many municipalities lack insight into suitable homes for seniors. The Minister answered that the government sees municipalities, housing corporations and regional partners as responsible, with the national government in a facilitating role, and committed to monitoring Woonvisies and prestatieafspraken and evaluating them before the budget debate.
The national government has a facilitating and supporting role, for example by removing uncertainties in implementation or offering room for experimentation.
Het Rijk heeft een faciliterende en ondersteunende rol, bijvoorbeeld door onduidelijkheden in de uitvoering weg te nemen of experimenteerruimte te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Help! Mijn demente ouders worden beroofd”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that professional guardians (bewindvoerders) exploit dementia patients, including the low share who belong to a branch association, the lack of a protected title or professional chamber, and whether oversight by overburdened sub-district judges is adequate. The minister replied that guardianship is supervised by judges with mandatory annual accounts, quality requirements and a central quality bureau since 2016, that no protected title or order is planned, and that the 2017 evaluation of the law will examine enforcement.
In light of this, I believe sufficient safeguards already exist to monitor the appointment and work of guardianship administrators.
In het licht hiervan meen ik dat reeds voldoende waarborgen bestaan om het aanstellen en het werk van beschermingsbewindvoerders te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de waterschapsbelasting 2016

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the fairness of water board taxes in 2016, including regional tariff differences, the flat 3-unit charge for multi-person households, and whether to fund flood safety fully nationally. The minister defended the mixed national/regional financing, attributed tariff differences to local conditions and democratically elected water boards, and said an ongoing OECD follow-up study would be reported to parliament in mid-2016.
Your House will be informed around mid-2016 about the progress of the study.
Uw kamer zal medio 2016 worden geïnformeerd over de voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de niet-reanimerenpenning

MP Krol asked the Minister of Health about the delayed update on talks to have the do-not-resuscitate pendant issued neutrally, and about the timeline. The minister said private parties were reluctant, the NPCF is considering the request pending an impact analysis, and she expects to report this spring, with full transfer by 1 January 2017 if the NPCF agrees.
As soon as I have more clarity, I will inform you about this.
Zodra ik meer duidelijkheid heb, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over verzekeringen tegen internetfraude

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about insurance products offering a safety net against internet fraud, whether consumers should bear losses, and whether banks and online sellers are shifting losses onto consumers. The minister answered that such insurance is a private market choice, that banks must prove gross negligence to pass losses to consumers under Dutch civil law, and that he sees no shift of losses onto consumers.
I do not observe such a development.
Ik neem een dergelijke ontwikkeling niet waar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de mogelijke veiligheidsrisico's van pinpassen waarmee contactloos betaald kan worden

An MP asked the Finance Minister about security risks of contactless payment cards, including whether amounts above €50 can be charged unnoticed and whether banks should be pressed to supply protective sleeves. The minister answered that the €50 cumulative limit applies (customers may raise it to €250 at some banks), that fraud is hard and unlikely, and that banks themselves must implement any risk measures, while he will discuss risk reduction with them.
Ultimately it is up to the banks themselves to respond to this and implement any risk measures.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de banken zelf om hier gehoor aan te geven en eventuele risicomaatregelen te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Pieter Heerma, Verhoeven, Jasper van Dijk, Thieme en Kuzu over de behandeling van de Mediawet in de Eerste Kamer

MPs asked the State Secretary about appointments to the supervisory boards of the NOS and NTR and the NPO, including alleged political favouritism and whether a board chair's position at UWV made the appointment incompatible with the Mediawet. The State Secretary denied any legal incompatibility, said the NPO appointment followed an independent advisory committee, and refused to reverse it.
I regret the impression that has arisen and do not consider it consistent with the actual course of events.
Ik betreur het beeld dat is ontstaan en vind dat ook niet in overeenstemming met de feitelijke gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Minder ziekenhuisopnames door casemanager palliatieve zorg'

MPs asked the state secretary for Health about a study finding that palliative case managers reduce hospital admissions, and about funding, reach beyond cancer patients and follow-up on a motion. The state secretary said the model adds value, that the Health Insurance Act allows such roles to be funded through nursing care, and that palliative care is being broadened beyond cancer, though no new obligation is created.
I am currently examining how I can implement the adopted motion submitted by member Bruins Slot et al.
Ik ben momenteel aan het onderzoeken hoe ik uitvoering kan geven aan de aangenomen motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Controle op medicijngebruik schiet tekort”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the health minister about a report that medication checks for elderly patients fall short, including whether outcome-based payment, higher tariffs, and more information would help. Minister Schippers said responsibility for tariffs lies with providers and insurers, that the IGZ is inspecting medication reviews from July 2015 under a growth model, and that she will consult KBO and the sector on the bottlenecks.
I take this signal seriously and will therefore shortly consult with Unie KBO and healthcare providers and insurers about the report and the bottlenecks described in it.
Dit signaal neem ik serieus zal daarom op korte termijn samen met Unie KBO in overleg treden met zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars over het rapport en de knelpunten die daarin beschreven staan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over inzake de berichtgeving op de website van het Centraal Administratiekantoor (CAK) over de eigen bijdrage van het Modulair Pakket Thuis (MPT) en de informatie die gebruikers van he

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Health about the CAK's communication on the switch from four-weekly to monthly co-payment for the Modulair Pakket Thuis, the delayed first bill, and whether a payment-arrangement option should be sent by letter. The State Secretary explained the delay as a one-off effect of aligning the system with the iWlz, and said the payment option will be mentioned in a flyer sent with the decision in late February or early March.
The CAK has indeed already stated on its website that it is possible to pay the first invoice in instalments.
Het CAK heeft inderdaad op de website al vermeld dat het mogelijk is om de eerste factuur gespreid te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘In 2020 veel meer mensen gekort dan ufr-rapport veronderstelt’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about press reports that pension funds may need to cut benefits by 2020, questioning the assumed funding ratios, premium coverage and the revised ultimate forward rate (ufr) method. The State Secretary answered that about 700,000 participants could face an average cut of around 3% in 2020 under fund recovery plans, that the outcome depends on economic developments, and that the ufr is set by the independent supervisor DNB on the advice of an independent committee.
The cabinet considers it important that the interest rate pension funds must use is shaped as realistically as possible.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat de rente waar pensioenfondsen mee moeten rekenen zo realistisch mogelijk wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de 70ste Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties (AVVN)

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked why older-persons organisations were not invited to the political-civil society delegation to the UN General Assembly, and how demographic change could be raised there. The minister replied that delegation members are chosen by participating organisations without age limits, and outlined Dutch efforts on sexual and reproductive health, gender equality and population data within UN bodies.
Parliament and the participating organisations, except the youth organisation, set no age limits themselves when nominating a delegation member.
Het parlement en de deelnemende organisaties, met uitzondering van de jongerenorganisatie, trekken zelf geen leeftijdsgrenzen als het gaat om het afvaardigen van een delegatielid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Vaccins ouderen bewust verzwegen”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Health Minister about a newspaper report that effective vaccines for elderly people (shingles, pneumonia) are not offered, including questions on timing of Gezondheidsraad advice, standard offering, and information campaigns. The minister answered that the Gezondheidsraad advice on shingles is pending, that a joint vaccination assessment body is being set up, that RIVM will improve public information, and that she considers prevention for the elderly a priority.
I do not wish to anticipate the Gezondheidsraad advice on shingles and pneumonia.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de adviezen van de Gezondheidsraad over gordelroos en longontsteking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Staking ambulancepersoneel, tientallen boze medewerkers demonstreren op het Spui”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Health about the nationwide ambulance staff work stoppage of 2 September 2015, the expired ambulance collective labour agreement, its differences from hospital staff terms, and special arrangements for older workers. Minister Schippers acknowledged the news and declined to comment on the cao, stating that collective agreements in healthcare are the responsibility of social partners.
I cannot and will not interfere in the responsibility of the social partners.
In die verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners kan en wil ik niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Bewoners aanleunwoning flink gedupeerd door sluiting verzorgingshuizen”

An MP from 50PLUS asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views reports that residents of care-home annexes lose services after nursing homes close, and whether the state should ensure enough facilities for elderly people living independently. The state secretary responds that responsibility for support now lies with municipalities, housing corporations and care providers under the Wmo 2015, that the government is promoting independent living through an advisory team, and that municipal councils or local supervisors can address shortcomings.

If municipalities do not carry out this task sufficiently, it is first of all up to the local municipal council to discuss this with the relevant municipal executive, or up to the local supervisor to establish it.

Als gemeenten deze taak onvoldoende uitvoeren, is het in eerste instantie aan de lokale gemeenteraad om hierover met het betreffende college van B&W in gesprek te treden of aan de lokale toezichthouder om dit te constateren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de voorlopige raming van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) gepubliceerd op 11 augustus 2015 ten behoeve van de afronding van de besluitvorming over de ontwerpbegroting en het belastin

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked why pensioners and benefit recipients must bear purchasing-power losses in 2016 while workers do not, whether at least 1 billion euro can be found for pensioners, and what can be done about long-term unemployment among over-45s. The minister answered that the CPB projection is preliminary and that the cabinet will weigh the full purchasing-power picture in August decision-making, presenting outcomes on Prinsjesdag, and listed existing measures and unemployment statistics for older workers.
The overall purchasing-power picture for the coming year is then weighed and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Daar wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ulenbelt en Krol over de aanpassing in de Ultimate Forward Rate (UFR) voor pensioenfondsen

MPs Omtzigt, Ulenbelt and Krol asked the state secretary about the change to the Ultimate Forward Rate for pension funds, including its effects on contributions, wages, recovery plans and transfers of value. The state secretary answered that the UFR was set by DNB following the advice of an independent committee, and gave estimates of effects while stating that many outcomes remain uncertain.
I expect that I can inform you at the end of September about the outcomes of this study.
Ik verwacht dat ik u eind september over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek kan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de artikelen “ANBO: Het gaat mis met de thuiszorg”, en “Thuiszorg wordt zorgenkind”

Krol (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about reports that many municipalities cut or abolish domestic help under the Wmo 2015 without the required individual investigation, and about the VNG's view that kitchen-table interviews are not feasible everywhere. The state secretary replies that individual assessment is legally required, that citizens can object and appeal, that municipal councils must supervise their executive, and that he sees no reason yet to use his supervisory powers.
Reducing or ending (an existing, ongoing) domestic help provision is only possible when it has been preceded by a carefully prepared individual assessment.

Het versoberen of beëindigen van (een bestaande, doorlopende voorziening van) huishoudelijke hulp is slechts mogelijk wanneer dat vooraf is gegaan door een zorgvuldig voorbereide individuele afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Senioren: het systeem zélf mishandelt ons!'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how to assess a study finding that elderly people feel hurt by society's institutions and seen as a burden, and about related issues such as bureaucracy, lack of information and the definition of elder abuse. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the SCP report on elder abuse, referred to ongoing information efforts and the Action Plan, and committed to follow-up research and to involving older people more actively in policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol naar aanleiding van de vele berichten van uitstel beantwoording schriftelijke vragen

An MP asked why the health ministry postponed answers to 35 written parliamentary questions in July 2015 and whether it would try to answer faster. The minister confirmed the delays, linked them to holiday schedules, said answers would come before the new parliamentary year, and promised faster answers only for urgent questions.
This is related to the holidays of the ministers and the holiday staffing at the department.
Dit hangt samen met de vakantie van de bewindslieden en de vakantiebezetting op het departement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat de vereiste dekkingsgraad van pensioenfondsen tot één procentpunt te hoog is door een weeffout Financieel Toetsingskader'

An MP asked whether the Financial Assessment Framework (nFTK) contains a design flaw inflating pension funds' required coverage ratios, citing Aon Hewitt's claim that the UFR introduction led to excessive buffers. The State Secretary rejected the claim, arguing the buffer treatment is consistent and that changing it would cause coverage ratios to fall sharply.
This approach is consistent, so it is certainly not a "design flaw".
Deze handelwijze is consequent, dus beslist geen «weeffout».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichtgeving ‘Pensioen verdampt door lage rente’

Krol (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about pension annuity losses from low interest rates, insurer communication, and the delayed premium-scheme bill, and asks for interim relief. The secretary acknowledges the problem, points to a temporary Pensioenknip reopening and an AFM investigation, and says the bill is delayed to late 2015 with consultation planned for July.
I intend to open the draft bill for internet consultation in July.
Ik ben voornemens om het concept wetsvoorstel in juli open te stellen voor een internetconsultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Betalingsachterstand zet zorgaanbieders klem'

The MP asks about reports that municipalities are late paying care providers, threatening their liquidity and continuity of care, and whether municipalities are shutting out providers as too expensive. The State Secretary answers that municipalities and providers must resolve payment issues locally, points to a joint information agenda and digital infrastructure, and denies recognizing providers being kept out for cost reasons.
I will monitor progress on the actions named therein.
Ik zal toezien op de voortgang van de daarin benoemde acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij subsidieverstrekking voor zonnepanelen naar aanleiding van het artikel “Te oud voor subsidie” in de Telegraaf

Krol (50PLUS) asked whether a couple from Goor was denied a solar-panel loan purely because of age and whether this constitutes age discrimination. The minister answered that the SVn loan is a consumer credit with an age limit of 75, that lenders may apply credit criteria, and that no age discrimination occurs.
In my view there is no age discrimination, since a lender may apply criteria when granting a loan to ensure repayment of loans to the lender.

Naar mijn mening is er geen sprake van leeftijdsdiscriminatie aangezien een geldverstrekker bij het afgeven van een lening criteria kan hanteren om zekerheid te houden over de terugbetaling van leningen aan de geldverstrekker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending van TijdvoorMeldpunt bij omroep MAX

MP Krol asked the State Secretary for Health about a broadcast on fall accidents among elderly people living at home, including calls for a nationwide safety adviser and a uniform home-adaptation subsidy regardless of municipality. The State Secretary answered that fall prevention is primarily a local matter, pointed to existing national support tools and Wmo 2015 obligations, rejected a nationwide safety adviser and a uniform subsidy, and promised continued monitoring.
I therefore do not want to impose a national blueprint by making a safety adviser available to everyone.
Ik wil daarom geen landelijke blauwdruk opleggen door een veiligheidsadviseur voor iedereen beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending van het programma Kassa waarin de ANBO een Hulpfonds Woningaanpassingen heeft gelanceerd

Krol (50PLUS) asks the State Secretary about a Kassa broadcast in which ANBO launched a housing-adaptation fund, citing surveys showing strict municipal criteria and low budgets. The State Secretary says the Wmo 2015 legal framework and appeal rights are sufficient, so a fund is unnecessary, that variation between municipalities is intended, and that concrete cases of non-compliance will be discussed with those involved.
If I have concrete examples of situations where municipalities do not comply with the law, I will discuss this with those involved.
Indien ik concrete voorbeelden heb van situaties waarbij gemeenten zich niet aan de wet houden, ga ik daarover met betrokkenen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “Gewonden bij brand seniorenflats Wijchen” en “Seniorenflats moeten een stuk veiliger”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the government about fire safety in senior housing complexes after press reports of fires and deaths among elderly residents, and whether building rules, drills, inspections and resident education should be tightened. The minister answered that the government is studying how to better protect elderly residents from fire with stakeholders, with results due in autumn 2015, while stating that drills and inspections are largely a matter for residents, owners and municipalities.
It is up to each municipality individually to intensify inspections at senior housing complexes if desired.
Het is aan iedere gemeente afzonderlijk om controles bij seniorencomplexen desgewenst te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol inzake het bericht "Teveel oude kijkers? Programma weg"

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about reports that the NPO may adapt or cancel programmes that attract many older viewers, and whether older viewers are being served proportionately. The State Secretary answered that the public broadcaster serves all ages, that the NPO may adjust programming when targets are missed, and that he sees no need to consult the NPO now.
Following the cited NRC Handelsblad article, I see no need to consult with the NPO at this time.
Naar aanleiding van het aangehaalde artikel in het NRC Handelsblad zie ik geen noodzaak om nu met de NPO in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over calamiteitenzender NPO1

An MP from 50PLUS asked why the government website once named NPO1 and Radio 1 as national disaster broadcasters, and why the wording was later changed to refer to regional broadcasters. The minister replied that the Minister-President may requisition broadcast time in extraordinary circumstances, that the website wording was too narrow and has been corrected, and that the change is a clarification rather than a policy shift, while acknowledging the need for interdepartmental coordination on the answer's timing.
The sentence on the website, "In the event of a national disaster the disaster broadcaster is Nederland 1 or Radio 1", was an overly narrow formulation.
De zin «Bij een nationale ramp is de rampenzender Nederland 1 of radio 1» op de website betrof een te beperkte formulering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over "Drama oude werklozen"

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a newspaper piece on rising long-term unemployment among older job seekers, and whether a dedicated agenda, wage-cost relief, or ICT training should be adopted. The minister replies that existing measures such as the mobility bonus, proefplaatsing and the 50pluswerkt action plan are effective, promises to monitor them and report in autumn, but rejects the wage-cost reduction and broad ICT training as ineffective and costly.
In the autumn I will inform the House again about the progress of these measures.
In het najaar zal ik de Kamer opnieuw informeren over de voortgang van deze maatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht “Luchtalarmsirenes gaan verdwijnen”, en het bericht “7 redenen waarom NL-alert de sirenes niet kan vervangen”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether NL-Alert can replace the air-raid sirens, given outages during disasters, phone ownership and night-time reach, and the vulnerability of elderly and dementia patients. The minister answers that all crisis communication channels can fail, that NL-Alert is supplemental and reaches people entering an affected area, and that the WAS siren system becomes redundant, while promising further development of the crisis communication package.
In the mentioned further development of the crisis communication package, I will in the coming years pay attention to how vulnerable groups can best be reached for all incident types.

In de genoemde doorontwikkeling van het pakket crisiscommunicatiemiddelen besteed ik de komende jaren aandacht aan de wijze waarop kwetsbare groepen het beste bereikt kunnen worden bij alle incidenttypen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Gemeente ondermijnt thuiszorg’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about a report claiming municipal home-care tariffs fell sharply and home-help budgets were cut, raising questions on access, subsidy adequacy, sham contracts and worker conditions. The state secretary disputed several claims, argued that the Wmo 2015 obliges municipalities to provide individually tailored support, and promised further discussions and a separate letter.
At national level, from the CAK administration, there is only insight into individual provisions granted for which a personal contribution is owed, and the number of persons concerned.

Op landelijk niveau bestaat, vanuit de administratie van het CAK, alleen inzicht in de toegekende individuele voorzieningen waarvoor een eigen bijdrage verschuldigd is en het aantal personen dat dit betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de televisieuitzending over de ‘portemonneetest’

Rep. Krol asked the Interior and Justice ministers how the government views a TV test in which wallets handed in to police or municipal offices went missing, with 640 euros gone from five of them. The minister said the government expects careful conduct, reports that a municipal employee was dismissed and a police investigation is ongoing, but declined to commission nationwide research, saying municipalities are responsible for their own operations.
It is therefore up to the council to judge how the task is carried out in its own municipality.
Het is derhalve aan de raad om een oordeel te vellen over de wijze waarop in de eigen gemeente uitvoering wordt gegeven aan deze taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Luchtalarmsirenes gaan verdwijnen'

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about plans to phase out the air-raid siren system (WAS) and whether this excludes people without internet or mobile access, older people, and the hearing-impaired. The minister confirms the planned phase-out from 2018, points to a package of alternatives (NL-Alert, social media, regional broadcasters) and says the siren is used only once or twice a year, with the phase-out still to be worked out with the Veiligheidsberaad.

Together with the Security Council I want to look, in the run-up to 2018, at the further development of the above package of crisis communication tools, with attention also to the reach to vulnerable groups.

Samen met het Veiligheidsberaad wil ik in aanloop naar 2018 kijken naar de verdere (door)ontwikkeling van het bovengenoemde pakket aan crisiscommunicatiemiddelen, waarbij ook het bereik van kwetsbare groepen aandacht zal krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel ‘Ouderen in problemen door budgetpolis’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about reports that older people with budget health insurance policies can only order medicines online, causing problems for less mobile and less internet-capable patients, especially outside cities. The minister says insurers must ensure adequate care access and inform policyholders, that the NZa is investigating budget policies, and that transparency will be improved.
An insurer providing care in kind must have contracted sufficient care for policyholders who choose the budget policy to meet its duty of care: within reasonable distance and a reasonable time.

Een zorgverzekeraar die zorg in natura levert moet voor de verzekerden die kiezen voor de budgetpolis voldoende zorg hebben ingekocht om aan zijn zorgplicht te kunnen voldoen: binnen redelijke afstand en redelijke termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Sociale Dienst eist van huisartsen dossier op

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister how she assessed reports that a municipal social services department in Eindhoven pressured GPs and patients to hand over medical files, and what steps would be taken. The minister answered that the matter is primarily the responsibility of the municipality, referred to the municipality's answers to council questions, and stated that the municipal council considers its conduct to be within current law.
This matter is primarily the responsibility of the municipality of Eindhoven.
Deze zaak is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Eindhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Gemeente Dronten vraagt geld voor politiek flyeren’

An MP asked whether the municipality of Dronten may charge fees for political flyering, which its bylaws restrict in certain shopping areas, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister answered that the restriction is a permissible, limited regulation under Article 7 of the Constitution and that the fee is lawful, so no intervention is planned.
In my view, there is therefore no question of an impermissible restriction of freedom of expression.
Naar mijn oordeel is hier dan ook geen sprake van een ontoelaatbare beperking van de uitingsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “CBS: Werkgelegenheid trekt aan”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS reports that unemployment fell mainly among under-45s while long-term unemployment among over-45s rose, and about whether the Work-Beyond-AOW bill and the 50pluswerkt action plan would cause displacement and whether the plan would be extended. The minister answered that the recovery is positive, that rising long-term unemployment is normal in recovery, that the bill is expected to raise older employment without long-run displacement, that the plan will not be extended, and that the relevant age-group figures are published and will be included in progress reports.
The figures for this age group will also be included in the next progress report on the 50pluswerkt action plan.
Ook in de volgende voortgangsrapportage over het «Actieplan 50pluswerkt» zullen deze cijfers meegenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Gemeenten koersen af op miljardentekort’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a COELO forecast that municipalities face a large deficit by 2018 driven by decentralised social-domain tasks, and whether cuts and reserve use would follow. The Minister rejected the deficit projection, said municipalities have sufficient budgets and discretion, and pointed to existing financial indicators and monitoring, while leaving local tax expansion for a separate study.
I have every confidence that municipalities will make the right choices regarding their local circumstances.
Ik heb er het volste vertrouwen in dat gemeenten de juiste keuzes maken met betrekking tot hun plaatselijke omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Oudere werklozen geen prioriteit voor gemeenten”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Trouw report, based on a Divosa survey, that municipalities give low priority to older long-term welfare recipients for wage-subsidised jobs. The State Secretary said municipalities hold the responsibility and discretion under the Participatiewet, that the survey covered only about a quarter of municipalities, and that she did not recognise claims about budget-driven prioritisation.
It is up to the municipal council to set the policy and to oversee its implementation.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om het beleid vast te stellen en op de uitvoering er van toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat het aantal daklozen stijgt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about reported rises in homelessness, particularly among young and elderly people, and whether municipalities are equipped to handle it. The government answered that the figures reflect more people receiving support rather than more homeless people, referred debt-collection questions to the Finance State Secretary, and noted that municipalities are responsible and adequately equipped.
For answering this question I refer to the reply letter of 13 January 2015 from the State Secretary of Finance.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vraag verwijs ik naar de antwoordbrief van 13 januari 2015 van de Staatssecretaris van Financiën
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “Mantelzorger niet in beeld”en “Mantelzorgers voelen zich soms zwaar belast”

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that many municipalities do not identify informal carers and that carers, including older ones, face overload. The secretary answers that the Wmo 2015 requires integral assessment of carers' capacity, cites guidance and a new respite care handbook, and states that municipalities will receive extra funds for carer support.
No current figures are available on the extent of informal care provided by people aged 50 and over.
Er zijn geen actuele cijfers beschikbaar omtrent de omvang van informele zorg die door 50-plussers wordt verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Eind van blauwe envelop is nabij’

Rep. Krol asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority will phase out paper correspondence, including for income tax, benefits and motor vehicle tax, and how elderly citizens without digital access would be protected. The State Secretary answered that digital correspondence is the goal, to be introduced gradually after legal changes, with proxy arrangements and a safety net for citizens unable to use digital channels.
It will also remain possible in individual cases, where truly necessary, to provide a paper copy of an electronic message.
Het zal ook mogelijk blijven om in individuele gevallen, waarin dat echt nodig is, een papieren kopie van een elektronisch bericht te verstrekken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten ‘pensioenpot van gemeenten maar voor de helft gevuld’ en ‘pensioenpot gemeenten komt half miljard tekort: tikkende tijdbom onder toekomstige begrotingen’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that municipalities, provinces and water boards underfund pensions of political office-holders, and why the Deloitte report was withheld until a FOI request. The minister confirmed the shortfall is a structural consequence of budget-financed pensions, said the Deloitte report was withheld while cabinet deliberations were ongoing, and committed to informing parliament on the outcome of cabinet talks on fund financing.
The findings of the study are part of the consultation on determining a cabinet position on fund financing.
De uitkomsten van het onderzoek zijn deel van het overleg over het bepalen van een kabinetsstandpunt over fondsfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat de Schenkingsvrijstelling nieuwbouw volgens NVB-bouw in feite nu al verlopen is

MP Krol asked the minister whether the temporarily expanded gift tax exemption for new-build homes effectively expired before 1 January 2015 because payments in instalments fall outside the window, and whether the government would show flexibility. The minister acknowledged the strict wording, said the exemption will not be extended but that a flexible approach will be taken for homes under construction, with conditions to be published in a policy decision.
The cabinet has decided not to extend the temporarily expanded exemption, but considers it desirable to apply the rules flexibly for homes under construction.
Het kabinet heeft besloten de tijdelijk verruimde vrijstelling niet te verlengen maar acht het wel wenselijk om soepel om te gaan met de regels waar het gaat om een woning in aanbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer, Dik-Faber en Krol over de publicatie ‘Over(-)behandelen. Ethiek van de zorg voor kwetsbare ouderen’

Members of parliament asked the health minister about a publication on over-treatment of frail elderly patients, including whether over-treatment should be curbed, adopting decision-making methods and ethical frameworks, and cost limits. The minister answered that shared decision-making, professional standards set by stakeholders, and a new 'intensive consultation at end of life' activity code are the preferred routes, with no binding new rules or cost ceilings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Pensioenbeheer veel duurder’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that ABP paid €650m in performance fees to external asset managers while cutting pensions, and about the cost development at pension funds. The government answered that the fees reflect higher-than-benchmark returns that did not avert the cut, declined to provide a list of funds under recovery plans citing the Pensioenwet's confidentiality ban, and explained the collective structure of fund choice.
The Pensioenwet prohibits anyone from disclosing supervisory data traceable to individual pension funds.
De Pensioenwet verbiedt een ieder om bekendheid te geven aan toezichtgegevens die herleidbaar zijn naar individuele pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Krol en Klein over het ontbreken van bereidheid bij banken om boeterente  bij vervroegde aflossing van hypotheken te laten vervallen

MPs Krol and Klein asked the Finance Minister whether banks should drop early-repayment penalty interest on mortgages, given negative equity and the expanded gift-tax exemption. The minister answered that the penalty is a legitimate compensation for lost interest, that some banks (SNS, ABN AMRO) are considering waiving it when the exemption is used, and that he has asked banks to do so.
As is known, I have asked the banks to waive the penalty interest when use is made of the expanded gift exemption.
Zoals bekend heb ik de banken gevraagd de boeterentes te laten vervallen indien gebruik wordt gemaakt van de verruimde schenkingsvrijstelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Zorgverzekeraar kan verplichte mantelzorg contracteren

Krol asks whether insurers can require care institutions to demand family caregiving from residents' relatives, whether institutions may refuse clients without it, and what happens to elderly people without nearby relatives. The State Secretary denies mandatory caregiving is possible, says zorgkantoren may only stimulate network participation (e.g. via tariff premiums), and sees no need for new measures given the encouraging Vierstroom experiment.
I want to emphasise again that there is no question of, and there can be no question of, mandatory informal care.
Ik wil nogmaals benadrukken dat er geen sprake is en kan zijn van verplichte mantelzorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending Zwarte Zwanen, gokken met uw pensioenpremie’

MP Krol asked the state secretary about pension fund oversight of outsourced investment, cost transparency, executive pay at outsourcing partners and fund risk-taking, after a broadcast on pension investment. The state secretary answered that fund boards, supervisory boards, DNB and AFM oversee outsourcing, that transparency measures are being considered including a possible bill, and that the government leaves pay policy largely to funds while noting regulations on remuneration.
At present I am considering whether this should be legally established.
Op dit moment wordt door mij bezien of dit juridisch vastgelegd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht: ouderen slikken teveel of te weinig pillen

An MP asks the health minister about a RIVM report finding that elderly patients are often over- or under-medicated (polypharmacy), poor prescriber and patient communication, and insufficient implementation of guidelines. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the 2012 guideline, planned 2014 financing changes, IGZ supervision, and patient safety agreements, without new binding obligations.
The IGZ will supervise in particular the implementation of periodic medication review based on the guideline.
De IGZ zal gaan toezien op met name de uitvoering van periodieke medicatie-beoordeling op basis van de richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht "Arme ouderen laten medicijnen liggen"

Krol (50PLUS) asks whether the minister is aware of reports that poor elderly people leave prescribed medicines at the pharmacy because they cannot pay the co-payment, and whether this poses health risks and undermines equal access to medication. Minister Schippers replies that prescription drugs are almost always available without co-payment, that co-payments apply only exceptionally above reference prices, and that the effects of the own-risk scheme on low incomes will be reviewed after the summer.
After the summer I will inform your House in more detail about how this will be shaped.
Na de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer nader over hoe dit wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht "Kamer te snel leeg bij overlijden"

MP Krol asks the minister whether it is acceptable that some care homes clear a deceased resident's room within one or two days, and what will be done to enforce the seven-day term and inform relatives. The state secretary says the seven-day term is set in general conditions agreed with sector bodies and consumer groups, that undisclosed early clearance wrongs relatives, and that the ministry will raise non-compliance with the sector at regular meetings, without a concrete new measure.
I am of the view that relatives are wronged if a room must be emptied within 7 days without their explicit consent.
Ik ben van mening dat nabestaanden dus onrecht wordt gedaan als een kamer zonder hun expliciete instemming binnen de 7 dagen leeggemaakt moet worden.
Vragen van het lid Krol (50PLUS) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Twaalf keer geen vervolging in landsbelang» (ingezonden 18 juli 2013).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a report that twelve cases were dropped on national-interest grounds, and how such decisions are made and reviewed. The minister answered that the OM had wrongly registered the 'landsbelang' code in twelve 2012 cases where the true ground was 'onvoldoende nationaal belang', that similar miscoding occurred in earlier years, and that complainants can seek judicial review under article 12 Sv while the officer of justice decides under the chief prosecutor.
In the twelve cases concerned in 2012, the discontinuance ground 'onvoldoende nationaal belang' was confused with 'landsbelang'.
In de betreffende twaalf gevallen in 2012 is verward met de sepotgrond «landsbelang».
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Thieme, Krol en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse zaadbedrijven in India

Four MPs asked the minister about child labour and low wages at Dutch seed companies Bejo Zaden and Nunhems in India, and about the sector's due diligence and CSR commitments. The minister responded that the government wants child labour eliminated, that Bejo Sheetal did not join the FLA, that Plantum will evaluate members' policies, and that Bejo and Nunhems will introduce new measures including monitoring and minimum wage commitments.
In the meeting with Plantum, the implementation of the Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour was discussed.
In het gesprek met Plantum is de uitvoering van de « Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour» aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol ver het artikel “Verzekeraars zetten ouderen op straat”

MP Krol asked the state secretary whether health insurers' letters ending funding for residents of care homes after three years would force elderly people out of institutions, and whether that is acceptable. The state secretary replied that existing clients keep their right to institutional care, that no one will be forced to live independently, and that he is talking with care offices and provider associations about the purchasing of care.
There is no question of existing clients being forced to live independently.
Er is geen sprake van dat bestaande cliënten gedwongen worden om zelfstandig te gaan wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de hack op het Groene Hart Ziekenhuis

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Security minister about the hack of Groene Hart Hospital, the journalist Brenno de Winter being invited as a witness, press source protection, the NEN-7510 security norm for healthcare, and priorities for responsible disclosure and enforcement. The minister answered that the witness invitation was voluntary and that journalists keep source protection, that the Voskuil ruling was not relevant here, that ethical hacking can still be prosecuted, that IGZ and CBP supervise healthcare information security, and that the investigation is ongoing so no figures on capacity can be given.
The investigation into the hack of the Groene Hart Hospital has not yet been concluded. For that reason I cannot say anything about the amount of investigative capacity deployed.
Het onderzoek naar de hack op het Groene Hartziekenhuis is nog niet afgerond. Om die reden kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de hoeveelheid opsporingscapaciteit die is ingezet
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Kosten door onbegrepen ziekten kunnen omlaag’

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the health minister whether costs of unexplained illnesses could be reduced, as suggested in a newspaper article on a PhD study, and whether extra research or mapping of avoidable healthcare costs is warranted. The minister answered that the study did not examine cost reduction, that no further research is planned, and pointed to a new platform on waste in healthcare.
There will therefore be, for example, a platform on waste in healthcare.
Er komt daarom bijvoorbeeld een platform verspilling in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Krol over dodelijke aanvallen op Hazara’s in Pakistan

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about deadly attacks on Hazara Shia communities in Pakistan, including whether perpetrators have been prosecuted and whether Pakistan should investigate independently. The minister confirmed the attacks, attributed most to Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, said Pakistan pledges to pursue perpetrators while noting recent arrests, and said the Netherlands and EU raise the issue of minorities bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the position of (religious) minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rondom de positie van (religieuze) minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de gevolgen van de verhoging van de eigen bijdrage voor de ABWZ en WMO als gevolg van de introductie van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling

Member Krol (50PLUS) asks the minister about the income effects of the higher own contributions for AWBZ and Wmo care caused by the capital income levy, and whether the law should be corrected or implementation suspended. The state secretary replies that the previous letter was not misleading, explains how homes and deposits are treated under the levy with timing relief, and says he will first consult the House on which effects it considers undesirable before deciding on changes.
I consider it proper first to consult the House on which effects it evidently considers undesirable.
Ik acht het zuiver eerst met de Kamer in overleg te treden over de vraag welke gevolgen kennelijk door de Kamer ongewenst worden geacht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het toezicht van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) op de ouderenzorg

Mr Krol (50PLUS) asked the minister whether the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) made about 100 inspection visits to elderly care in 2012, whether its target is being met, and what complaints it received on unqualified staff, hygiene and medication. The state secretary denies the 100-visit figure, reports 507 visits to 1 November 2012, says the target will be completed in early 2013, and reports 2,200 complaints, mostly about falls.
In 2012 the IGZ carried out a total of 507 inspection visits in elderly care up to 1 November 2012.
In 2012 heeft de IGZ tot 1 november 2012 in totaal 507 inspectiebezoeken afgelegd in de ouderenzorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Tongeren, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about reports that Somali asylum seekers whose applications were rejected were put back on the street after leaving a tent camp in Amsterdam, and whether this could have been avoided under the earlier motion and the Bestuursakkoord; they also asked how this squares with a Raad van State ruling on detention and how many Somalis had returned voluntarily. The state secretary answered that about 50 were sent away, that only a shelter conditional on cooperating with return was offered and not taken up, that conditional shelter remains policy, and that about 25 Somalis returned voluntarily since 2010, with forced return to all of Somalia now possible again.
I am willing to offer shelter to these foreigners, on condition that they cooperate with return.
Ik ben bereid om onderdak te bieden aan deze vreemdelingen, onder de voorwaarde dat wordt meegewerkt aan terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks, D66 and 50PLUS asked whether most residents of the former Amsterdam tent camp were put on the street on 30 November, whether this is responsible in winter, and whether it could have been prevented under the Gesthuizen motion and the 2007 agreement with the VNG. The State Secretary answered that most were sent away after arrest, that the alternative shelter required cooperation with return, and that he sees no need for structural emergency shelter by municipalities.
It is true that the majority of the foreigners were sent away after their arrest.
Het klopt dat het merendeel van de vreemdelingen na hun aanhouding is heengezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Eenzaamheid onder ouderen neemt toe’

An MP asked the government about reports that loneliness among older people is rising, its health effects, support for local initiatives, the role of internet use, and whether cuts threaten efforts against loneliness. The state secretary answered that combating loneliness is primarily a local matter, that central government will stimulate and facilitate through funding a coalition, tools and a national debate, and that municipalities will be given more room under decentralisation.
Combating loneliness is primarily a local matter.
Bestrijding van eenzaamheid is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Krol over de stopzetting van de uitzendingen van Wereldomroep op de Antillen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the education and culture minister whether the stop of Wereldomroep broadcasts to the Antilles was known, whether BES residents need a Dutch public broadcaster to take over its role, and whether a new regional broadcaster could be promoted on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. The minister confirmed the stop, said the concerns are unfounded because the national public broadcaster will provide Caribbean media services, and said no regional broadcaster is planned, though local initiatives remain possible.
There are no plans for a regional broadcaster for the Caribbean islands.
Er bestaan geen plannen voor een regionale omroep voor de Caribische eilanden.

Requires a monitoring system including field measurements for nitrogen programme effects and stops allocating development space if measured effects fall short.
This amendment provides that a monitoring system is set up in which field measurements form part.
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat een monitoringssysteem wordt opgesteld waar praktijkmetingen een onderdeel van zijn.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Dik-Faber en Smaling ter vervanging van nr. 27 over de beschikbaarheid van een rijksbijdrage voor een regionale pilot van gecombineerde implementatie van ERTMS en ele
Shifts 50 million euro within the rail budget to allow a national contribution to electrification of a regional line as part of a pilot combining ERTMS and electrification.
With this amendment 50 million euro becomes available for electrification
Met dit amendement komt voor de elektrificatie 50 miljoen euro beschikbaar
Motie van het lid Van Tongeren c.s. over een herberekeningscheck voor de Big Five-asfaltprojecten
Asks the government to show with a recalculation check at the low growth scenario that five asphalt road projects yield a positive societal return.
requests the government to show, with a recalculation check at the low growth scenario
verzoekt de regering, met een herberekeningscheck bij het lage groeiscenario te laten zien
Motie van het lid Smaling c.s. over zekerheid over medefinanciering van het verbeteren van de Maaslijn
Asks the government to give the province of Limburg certainty about national co-financing of improving the Maaslijn rail line before re-tendering.
requests the government to give the province of Limburg short-term certainty on national co-financing
verzoekt de regering, op korte termijn zekerheid te geven aan de provincie Limburg over de medefinanciering door het Rijk
Motie van het lid Smaling over afzien van nieuwe tolwegen over afzien van nieuwe tolwegen
Motion asks the government to refrain from introducing new toll roads to fund new infrastructure.
requests the government to refrain from introducing new toll roads
verzoekt de regering, af te zien van het invoeren van nieuwe tolwegen
Motie van het lid Smaling over een lagere minimumtemperatuur voor tapwater
Asks the government to study energy savings from lower hot tap water temperature and allow pilots in offices and housing associations.
requests the government to research the savings potential of a lower minimum temperature for tap water.
verzoekt de regering om, onderzoek te doen naar het besparingspotentieel bij een lagere minimumtemperatuur voor tapwater
Motie van het lid Bisschop c.s. over meer ruimte voor projectontwikkeling in de waterkeringszone in Centraal Holland
Asks the government to investigate how to allow more room for property development within the water defence zone in Centraal Holland, ahead of an expected change to the Noord-IJsseldijk standard.

requests the government to investigate quickly how, in anticipation of an expected change to the standard for the Noord-IJsseldijk, more room for property development in the water defence zone can be offered in Centraal Holland

verzoekt de regering, op korte termijn te onderzoeken hoe, vooruitlopend op een verwachte aanpassing van de normering voor de Noord-IJsseldijk, in het gebied Centraal Holland meer ruimte geboden kan worden voor projectontwikkeling in de waterkeringszone
Motie van het lid Smaling over scholing voor gemeenteraadsleden op het gebied van grondexploitatie
Asks the government to urge the VNG that incoming municipal councillors receive training enabling adequate control over land development (grondexploitatie).
requests the government to urge the VNG that incoming councillors receive good training leading to adequate control over land development
verzoekt de regering, bij de VNG te bepleiten dat de in 2014 aan te treden gemeenteraadsleden goede scholing kunnen genieten die leidt tot adequate controle op de grondexploitatie
Motie van de leden Smaling en Albert De Vries over oplossingen voor de verliezen op grondexploitaties
Asks the government to propose solutions helping municipalities cope with land development losses while sparing citizens as much as possible.
requests the government to propose solutions enabling municipalities to cope with the problems that have arisen
verzoekt de regering, oplossingen aan te dragen die gemeenten in staat stellen de ontstane problemen het hoofd te bieden
Motie van de leden Smaling en De Rouwe over oplossingen voor de onrechtmatige bewoning van recreatiewoningen
Asks the government to work creatively with municipalities on workable, amicable solutions to illegal residential use of recreational homes, aiming to end it by end 2014.
Requests the government to seek workable and, where possible, amicable solutions creatively with the municipalities involved.
verzoekt de regering, met betrokken gemeenten creatief naar werkbare en zo veel als mogelijk minnelijke oplossingen te zoeken
Amendement van de leden Smaling en Dijkgraaf over vrijstelling van de verwerkingsplicht voor veehouders die hun bedrijfsoverschot regionaal af kunnen zetten
Exempts livestock farmers from the manure processing obligation if they transfer their surplus within 20 km under a prior written contract and conditions set by ministerial regulation.
