the surplus produced on the farm is fully and directly transferred, as shown by a written contract concluded in advance, under conditions to be set by ministerial regulation

het op zijn bedrijf geproduceerde bedrijfsoverschot geheel en rechtstreeks, blijkens een schriftelijke en vooraf gesloten overeenkomst, onder bij regeling van Onze Minister te stellen voorwaarden overdraagt
Motie van het lid Smaling over een studie naar verkleining van de veestapel
Asks the government and PBL, LEI and RIVM to conduct a study weighing the economic harm of shrinking the livestock herd against alternative activities and social and ecological gains.
requests the government to have PBL, LEI and RIVM carry out an integral study
verzoekt de regering, PBL, LEI en RIVM een integrale studie te laten verrichten
Motie van het lid Smaling over een bouwstop voor de veehouderij
Asks the government to introduce a nationwide building stop for livestock farming, allowing permits only for farms exceeding standards on sustainability, health and animal welfare.
requests the government, analogous to the recent Brabant decision, to introduce a nationwide building stop for livestock farming
verzoekt de regering, analoog aan het recente Brabantse besluit, een landelijke bouwstop in te voeren voor de veehouderij
Amendement van het lid Smaling over het in het wetsvoorstel opnemen van een bepaling voor het bij amvb stellen van nadere regels over de omgang met meststoffen bij de bedrijfsvoering
Amendment adds a power for general administrative orders (AMvB) to set rules on handling manure in farm operations for public health purposes.
By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules may be set for public health purposes on handling fertilisers
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen met het oog op de volksgezondheid nadere regels worden gesteld over de omgang met meststoffen
Amendement van het lid Smaling over het ontzien van veehouders die op hun bedrijf geproduceerde mest in een straal van 20 kilometer weten af te zetten
Exempts livestock farmers who can sell their own manure within 20 km from the mandatory manure processing obligation.
to exempt livestock farmers who can sell manure produced on their farm within a 20 km radius from the mandatory manure processing
veehouders die op hun bedrijf geproduceerde mest in een straal van 20 kilometer weten af te zetten te ontzien van de verplichte mestverwerking
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de verscheping van giftige olie vanuit Rotterdam naar Afrika

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the government would respond to a CIEL report claiming illegal export of toxic diesel from Rotterdam to Africa and prosecute Trafigura and Vitol. The Minister rejected the claim of Basel Convention violation, said no legal basis for enforcement exists, promised ILT inspections and dialogue on cleaner fuel standards, but could not guarantee an end to the practice.
The cabinet will continue to call on all parties involved to contribute to a transition to cleaner fuels in African countries.
Het kabinet zal alle betrokken partijen blijven oproepen bij te dragen aan een transitie naar schonere brandstoffen in de Afrikaanse landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de reikwijdte en gevolgen van het Kustpact voor Zeeland

An SP MP asked the minister about a protest against the Brouwerseiland plan, whether the Kustpact is breached by coastal holiday-home developments in Zeeland, the scale of Noord-Beveland plans, the secret Veerse Meer agreement with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, holiday-home supply and occupancy, and the Kustpact's geographic reach. The minister answered that the plans fall under the Kustpact's pre-existing category and are primarily the municipality's responsibility, granted a Barro exemption for Brouwerseiland, declined to publish the Veerse Meer letter citing business-sensitive content, and said PBL monitoring will follow.
The letter is not public because it contains business-sensitive information.
Deze brief is niet openbaar omdat er bedrijfsgevoelige informatie in staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de beschikking wind Drentse Monden Oostermoer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how SDE+ subsidy decisions for the 45 turbines of the Drentse Monden Oostermoer wind park should be read, and why they add up to 189 MW when the agreed maximum is 150 MW. The minister explained that subsidy is capped by maximum subsidisable MWh rather than MW, that the MW figures are the permitted capacities submitted by applicants, and that the choice of turbines is left to the initiators within permit bandwidths.
As I have already indicated, the subsidisable production in MWh is capped.
Zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven is de subsidiabele productie in MWh gemaximeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de waarborgsommen bij energielevering

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about rising security deposits (waarborgsommen) charged by energy suppliers, including possible cartel behaviour, use of credit checks and data on arrears, and whether the practice is lawful. The minister answered that no signals of a rise were received, that the ACM supervises deposits and that new general terms from 1 April 2017 allow deposits to be adjusted, while stating that the ACM would be informed and could investigate.
I have received no signals that there is an increase in the number or height of the security deposits that energy suppliers ask consumers for.
Tot nu toe heb ik geen signalen ontvangen dat er een toename is in het aantal of de hoogte van de waarborgsommen die energieleveranciers aan consumenten vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat NS dreigt met afbraakbeleid tweede KLM te worden

MP Smaling asks whether NS's plan to divest its shop and retail activities, and withdraw from regional rail tenders, is justified, and how it affects staff, dividends, station offerings and political pressure. Minister Dijsselbloem answers that the strategy is NS's responsibility, that shop activities are profitable but profit figures are confidential, that dividends are expected to stay stable, and that no political pressure was applied, while declining to give some financial details.
Information on the amount of profit per business unit is commercially confidential and for that reason cannot be provided.
Informatie over de omvang van de winst bij bedrijfsonderdelen is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan om die reden niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er nog steeds Europese schepen op Aziatische sloopstranden belanden

An SP MP asked the government how it responds to reports that European ships are still dumped on Asian breaking beaches, why the Hong Kong Convention is not yet ratified, how Dutch shipowners are obliged to ensure responsible scrapping, and whether it will agree hard sector agreements with the KVNR. The government condemns the practice, points to EU waste rules requiring prior consent for recycling, refers to ongoing IMVO talks with the KVNR and an expected covenant this year, and refers to earlier answers on the convention.
The cabinet is in talks with the KVNR within the framework of agreements on International Corporate Social Responsibility.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de KVNR in het kader van de afspraken over Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over een mogelijke onjuiste uitvoering door Nederland van de Europese Richtlijn Industriële Emissies (RIE)

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch implementation of the Industrial Emissions Directive lets waste incinerator operators deduct the maximum permitted measurement uncertainty from continuous emission readings, as advised by InfoMil, rather than the actual measured uncertainty. The state secretary replied that the implementing rules conform to the directive, that the uncertainty correction is legally anchored, and that the Commission has not put the Netherlands in default.
The European Commission has not put the Netherlands in default under the Industrial Emissions Directive.
De Europese Commissie heeft Nederland niet in gebreke gesteld voor de Richtlijn industriële emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de gasboring in Heerenveen

MP Smaling asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about gas extraction at Langezwaag near Heerenveen, including whether production continues under a modified, unapproved winning plan and how municipal consent and communication work under the new Mining Act. The Minister replies that production continues under the 2012 plan, that the amended plan is under statutory advisory procedure with municipal advice, and that there is no gap in the law, though extra communication is needed.
Following these advices, I will draft a draft decision, which will then be made available for public inspection.
Naar aanleiding van deze adviezen stel ik een ontwerpbesluit op, dat vervolgens ter inzage wordt gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over bescherming van natuurgebied ’t Merske

SP MPs asked the state secretary about chicken barns planned on the Belgian side of the Mark near natural area 't Merske, including nitrogen emissions, water quality, EU Water Framework Directive effects, and buffer zones. The government replied that the province of Noord-Brabant and Brabantse Delta water board are primarily responsible, that they raised concerns with Flemish authorities leading to extra permit conditions and an agreement to inform each other earlier, and that the buffer zone motion does not apply since the area is not a Natura 2000 site.
The natural area 't Merkske is not a Natura 2000 area. Therefore the Smaling motion (parliamentary document 31 038, no. H) does not apply to this natural area.
Het natuurgebied ’t Merkske is geen Natura2000-gebied. Derhalve is de motie Smaling (Kamerstuk 31 038, nr. H ) niet van toepassing op dit natuurgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake de ‘asbestpaniek’ bij bewoners in Landsmeer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about asbestos found in homes in Landsmeer, including whether inventory and air/tape sampling followed the rules, why residents were informed late, whether exposure is being studied, and the renovation plan. The government answered that asbestos was found in 31 attic spaces, no free fibres exceeded norms, communication was timely, no exposure study is planned, and attic remediation has started with a renovation plan due in April 2017.
It is very understandable that residents are alarmed by an asbestos finding in their home and worry about it.
Het is zeer begrijpelijk dat bewoners schrikken van een asbestvondst in hun woning en zich daarover zorgen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de astronomische ontslagvergoeding voor NS-managers

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why two former NS managers received multi-million-euro severance payments, whether state ownership allows preventing such excesses, and whether NS should become a ZBO like ProRail. The minister replied that the severance agreements were concluded by NS's board, that as shareholder he only controls appointment, dismissal and pay of board and supervisory members, and that the current NS company structure is preferred over ZBO status.
In my role as shareholder I have no involvement in that.
In mijn rol als aandeelhouder heb ik daar geen betrokkenheid bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over een mogelijk tekort aan accountants die gemeentelijke jaarrekeningen controleren

MPs Merkies and Smaling asked whether a shortage of accountants auditing municipal annual accounts threatens timely audit opinions, and whether decentralisations and the Omgevingswet strain municipal staff. The government acknowledges some tender failures and capacity pressure, relies on market forces and new entrants, and says municipalities bear responsibility for their own staffing.
The equipping of the civil service is, within the administrative relations, the responsibility of municipalities as independent tier of government.
Het toegerust zijn van het ambtenarenapparaat is binnen de bestuurlijke verhoudingen de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten als zelfstandige bestuurslaag.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Smaling over het bericht 'OV-kaart is geldmachine'

MP Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary about reports that the OV-chipkaart is a money machine, including whether Translink's profits should lower card costs, why the Translink director's pay exceeds the Wet normering topinkomens, and where profits go. The state secretary said a company should recoup investments, that a decision on card price and lifespan will come from the Nationaal OV Beraad before summer, that the topincome law does not apply because Translink is wholly owned by the COV, and referred back to the earlier answer on profit use.
Before summer the Nationaal OV Beraad will come with its decision on this.
Voor de zomer komt het Nationaal OV Beraad met haar besluit hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht ’11.000 handtekeningen tegen Wildlife Crime’

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about wildlife crime in the Netherlands following a broadcast and a petition, including its scale, enforcement levels, transit controls and inter-departmental coordination. The State Secretary said data on the scale of wildlife crime is lacking, that enforcement is adequately organised, that customs uses risk-based controls, and that existing training and cooperation arrangements are in place, without committing to a new programme.
I do not have figures on which animals are illegally killed or removed from nature in the Netherlands each year, or in what numbers.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over welke dieren in welke aantallen jaarlijks illegaal worden omgebracht in Nederland of uit de natuur worden weggehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies en Smaling over de mate waarin Nederlandse verzekeraars zich inzetten voor toegang van mensen in arme landen tot medicijnen

SP MPs asked why Dutch insurers score poorly on health and access to medicines in responsible investment rankings, and what the government will do about it. The minister said several insurers have not signed the Access to Medicine Index investor statement, but that the sector is being engaged through a planned IMVO covenant and that DNB oversees insurers' prudential risk management without setting investment policy.
The investment policy of insurers is primarily the responsibility of those insurers themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid van verzekeraars is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van die verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de asbestproblematiek

An MP asked the state secretary about asbestos risks, including protection of homeowners removing small asbestos roofs, contaminated soil in Harderwijk, asbestos in drinking water pipes, talc and gemstones, mineral wool and nanomaterials, enforcement by environmental services, mandatory asbestos inventories for schools and hospitals, and enforcement of removal and imports. The state secretary answered that information will be provided to citizens via Milieu Centraal, that no further research is deemed necessary on several points, that the ILT will warn buyers of asbestos gemstones and inspect sellers, and that enforcement responsibilities lie with municipalities, the police and the ILT.

I have committed to inform your House that, in addition to communication on asbestos roofs under the programmatic approach, private individuals will also be informed about the safe and responsible removal of asbestos.

Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd in aanvulling op communicatie over asbestdaken in het kader van de programmatische aanpak ook particulieren te informeren over het veilig en verantwoord verwijderen van asbest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat vrachtautochauffeurs hun wagen uitrusten met apparatuur om uitstoot te verdoezelen

Member Smaling (SP) asked about reports that truck drivers fit devices to switch off AdBlue systems, hiding excess NOx emissions, and asked how widespread this is and what will be done. The State Secretary condemns the practice, estimates that manipulated trucks emit roughly Euro-I levels of NOx, says the number of affected trucks on Dutch roads is unknown, and commits to studying enforcement options with TNO and ECN and reporting back.
I am currently in discussion with TNO and ECN about roadside inspection options for switching off AdBlue systems.
Ik ben momenteel met TNO en ECN in gesprek over controlemogelijkheden langs de weg voor het afschakelen van AdBlue-systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het feit dat de slimme energiemeter fors minder energiebesparing oplevert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the smart meter's weak energy savings, a PBL report, the investment payback, and whether a display should be standard. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, pointed to a planned covenant with energy partners and marketing measures, and declined for now to make in-home displays standard.
I am currently in discussion with the parties to the Energy Agreement about a binding covenant.
Momenteel ben ik in gesprek met de partijen bij het Energieakkoord over een taakstellend convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over aanhoudende problemen met de Intercity Direct en het stranden van reizigers in een donkere tunnel

MP Smaling asks the state secretary about a two-hour stranding of Intercity Direct passengers in a dark tunnel, compensation, rising cancellations and delays on the HSL corridor, the new Breda–Den Haag service, and whether the Traxx locomotive supplier can be held responsible. The secretary answers that NS and ProRail evacuated passengers within the ILT's two-hour norm (last passengers after 2h47m), that GTBV compensation and assistance are sufficient, that cancellations rose from 5.1% to 10.1% between October and January, and that an improvement programme and a 60 million euro infrastructure reserve are in place, while declining to assign responsibility to the manufacturer beyond ongoing warranty and repair processes.
I will continue to closely monitor this.
Ik zal dit scherp blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over verzekering voertuig bij medische testrit CBR

An MP asked whether a driving school vehicle is uninsured during a CBR medical driving test when the person lacks a valid licence, and whether such tests must be supervised by a holder of a Wrm-pas. The minister replied that insurers do pay out, the CBR knows of no such cases, the CBR and insurers will clarify the matter, and no change in regulation is needed.
Therefore the CBR and the Verbond van Verzekeraars will, at my request, ensure that the unclarities are removed.
Daarom zullen het CBR en het Verbond van Verzekeraars op mijn verzoek ervoor zorgen dat de onduidelijkheden worden weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Vliegers Air France KLM op ramkoers”

MP Smaling asked the state secretary about reports of a dispute between Air France and KLM pilots over productivity, whether existing government agreements with Air France-KLM still hold, and whether a pilot deal could harm KLM growth and jobs. The state secretary replied that the pilots' dispute is a matter between Air France and French unions, that the agreements remain in force, that no deal is known that would conflict with them, and that the Perform 2020 strategy of growth through productivity has not changed.
I have no indication that an agreement with the Air France pilots is forthcoming that could potentially conflict with the agreements the Dutch government has made with Air France KLM.

Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat er een overeenkomst met de Air France piloten op komst is die mogelijk in strijd zou zijn met de afspraken die de Nederlandse overheid met Air France KLM heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over een mogelijke maas in de wet inzake de vergunningplicht voor reclameverlichting

An SP MP asked whether illuminated advertising behind glass facades, such as The Sting in Utrecht, is exempt from permit requirements and whether the government will close this gap. The minister replied that regulation lies with municipalities and the Activiteitenbesluit, that Utrecht's advertising rules require no permit for this sign, and that a defective dimmer was replaced, so no statutory loophole exists.
In short, there is no loophole in the law.
Kortom, er is geen sprake van een maas in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de gevolgen van vislood op mens en milieu

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the health and environmental effects of fishing lead, citing claims that far more lead enters the water than assumed. The state secretary relied on Deltares 2013 estimates, said a Green Deal with stakeholders is being developed first, and would only examine a ban if voluntary agreements fail.
My first priority is to reach voluntary agreements in the Green Deal.
Mijn eerste inzet is gericht op het maken van vrijwillige afspraken in de Green Deal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de verzelfstandiging van de onderhoudsdivisie van AirFrance-KLM van de baan is

MP Smaling asked whether the spin-off of AirFrance-KLM's maintenance division is off the table and whether its independence under KLM is guaranteed. The state secretary confirmed Air France KLM dropped the planned study, stated no concrete plans are known, and pointed to the company's commitments on KLM's independent position.
No concrete plans are known to me at this time.
Er zijn mij thans geen concrete plannen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het zoutwinplan bij Kiel-Windeweer van Nedmag

An SP MP asked the Economics Minister about public anger over Nedmag's salt-mining plan near Kiel-Windeweer, the number of damage reports from gas extraction, whether a baseline survey by an international expert team could be required, and how damage from gas and salt extraction would be distinguished and settled. The minister said the 440 figure is not recognised, that about 10,000 damage reports exist for the municipality, that a baseline survey obligation could be attached to an approval decision once a plan is submitted, and that the NCG would mediate in complex damage cases.
I will put the question of whether land subsidence caused by gas and salt extraction can damage houses to the scientific panel.
Ik zal de vraag of de bodemdaling, die veroorzaakt wordt door gas- en zoutwinning, schade kan veroorzaken aan huizen voorleggen aan het wetenschappelijk panel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Dik-Faber, Ouwehand, Smaling en Jan Vos over het WOB-verzoek van Milieudefensie over gaswinningsbesluit 2016

Five MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's influence on the 2016 Groningen gas extraction decision, including a pre-sent expectations letter, consultations with NAM and Shell, and the withholding of an SodM advice from parliament. The minister answered that a draft expectations letter was shared with NAM only to test interpretation and feasibility, that the SodM advice was not actively sent but was later provided and published, and that the extraction ceiling was set on safety grounds at 24 billion m3 per year.
Since the SodM advice only confirmed that the process communicated to your House could proceed, I did not find it necessary to actively inform your House about it.
Aangezien het advies van SodM slechts bevestigde dat het met uw Kamer gecommuniceerde proces doorgang kon vinden, heb ik het niet nodig gevonden uw Kamer hier actief over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de laatste berichtgeving in het dieselschandaal en de rol van het RDW

An SP MP asked the government about recent reporting on the diesel emissions scandal, whether the ministry knew about fraud earlier, and whether the RDW's dual role as public regulator and commercial testing body is problematic. The minister answered that the ministry knew of software fraud only from autumn 2015, that the RDW's testing is part of its public task with minimal commercial revenue, and that it will not separate those tasks.
I am therefore not willing to remove those tasks from the RDW.
Ik ben daarom niet bereid om betreffende taken bij de RDW weg te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Help we verzuipen in de vochtige doekjes’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about persistent sewage blockages and damage caused by flushed wet wipes, including the cost to water boards, weaknesses in the 2007 EDANA self-regulation, the need for a stricter ISO norm, labelling, and whether producers should bear extra costs. The minister acknowledged the problem, said self-regulation has not yet delivered a satisfactory solution, committed to a stricter norm developed by stakeholders and to reviewing EDANA's improved labelling, but rejected charging extra costs to manufacturers.
Given the problems described by sewer and treatment managers, it must be concluded that these agreements have not yet led to a satisfactory solution.
Gezien de door de riool- en zuiveringsbeheerders beschreven problematiek moet echter worden geconstateerd dat deze afspraken nog niet hebben geleid tot een bevredigende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Nispen over de asbestzaak in Dodewaard

MPs Smaling and Van Nispen asked how hundreds of visitors to an event in a contaminated former brick factory in Dodewaard were exposed to asbestos in 2011, why the building was not closed, and whether the Public Prosecution Service was fully informed. The government called the exposure reprehensible, said the owners were convicted, explained the closure and communication history, and said it had asked the municipality and province to inform visitors jointly.
The answer to how large the chance of actual health problems is depends on the specific circumstances of the case.
Het antwoord op de vraag hoe groot de kans is dat daadwerkelijke gezondheidsproblemen ontstaan, is afhankelijk van de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en De Boer over toegankelijkheid van het spoorvervoer en persoonlijke assistentieverlening op NS-stations

MPs Smaling and De Boer asked about NS station assistance for wheelchair users, expansion of assisted stations, costs and punctuality, ProRail's station upgrade timeline, and when all stations will be accessible. The Staatssecretaris answered that NS is extending assistance to 45 more stations, that 90% accessibility is targeted by 2020 and all stations by 2030, and declined to accelerate works for reasons of disruption and contractor capacity.
I want to work with NS and ProRail to examine how independent accessibility is developing in the Netherlands and, on that basis, decide whether there is reason to further expand assistance.

Ik wil samen met NS en ProRail bekijken hoe de zelfstandige toegankelijkheid zich in Nederland ontwikkelt en op grond daarvan besluiten of er aanleiding is om de assistentieverlening nog verder uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving dat de veiligheidscultuur van de kerncentrale Doel ver onder de maat is

MP Smaling (SP) asked the minister about reports that the Belgian regulator FANC raised serious concerns about safety culture at the Doel nuclear plant, including whether Dutch neighbouring municipalities were informed and whether the minister would urge closure. The minister answered that the ANVS informed local authorities, that closure is solely a Belgian regulator decision, that a letter was sent to Belgian minister Jambon, and that the FANC letters would be provided to parliament.
The assessment of whether a nuclear plant should be shut down or closed for nuclear safety reasons is a competence of the national authorities of the country where the plant is located.
De beoordeling óf een kerncentrale vanwege de nucleaire veiligheid zou moeten worden stilgelegd of worden gesloten, is een bevoegdheid van de nationale autoriteiten van het land van de kerncentrale.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Smaling over het bericht dat het sporten op kunststofgrasvelden mogelijk gevaarlijk is voor de gezondheid

MPs Van Nispen and Smaling asked the health minister about reports that playing sport on artificial turf with rubber granulate may harm health, and about the government's position in EU REACH classification. The minister answered that RIVM still finds no health effects on current evidence, that RIVM is analysing new studies and literature, and that results are expected before year-end.
I have asked RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in the granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat giftige olie vanuit Rotterdam naar Afrika wordt verscheept

Mr. Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary and the minister whether they knew that diesel was being contaminated before export from Rotterdam to Africa, what volumes are involved, whether this is a criminal offence, whether they will raise it at the IMO, and what has been done with the SP's 2013 'Oliezwendel' recommendations. Minister Ploumen replied that the government was unaware of this specific practice, has few details on the trade, sees no current breach of law (the EU fuel quality directive does not cover exports and the waste regulation does not apply), will work through UNEP and regional West African initiatives, deems the IMO inappropriate, and points to earlier letters on fuel adulteration.
Few specific details are available on the import, export and transit (such as origin) of diesel coming from outside Europe.
Er zijn weinig specifieke details beschikbaar over de in-, uit- en doorvoer (zoals de herkomst) van diesel die van buiten Europa afkomstig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de verlenging van de zoutwinning van Frisia tot 2052

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Frisia salt-mining permit under the Wadden Sea was extended to 2052, whether this conflicts with the motion protecting the Wadden area, and whether the decision should be reviewed by an independent expert team and capped at 2036. The minister answered that the extension is conditional on five-yearly updates of the sea-level scenario under the 'Hand aan de Kraan' principle, that existing strict conditions remain, and that no further expert review is needed given the involvement of KNMI, Deltares and TNO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over schade in Groningen door stijging van grondwater door aardbevingen

An SP member asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that rising groundwater caused by earthquakes is damaging properties in Groningen, asking about a geologist's report, the number of damage claims, and whether an international expert team should assess the cause. The minister answered that he does not have the report, that no damage claims linked to groundwater rise are on record, and that he would have the report verified by an independent body if it were made available.
However, I do not have that final report.
Ik beschik echter niet over dat eindrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over dodenweg A59 Hooipolder

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment how dangerous the Hooipolder junction on the A59 is, after a TV programme on it, and whether it should be fully redesigned and funded jointly with the province. The Minister replied that accident figures show no elevated risk, that some warning measures already exist, and that a partial redesign is part of the planned A27 Tracébesluit, with a regional proposal still under discussion and a promise to inform parliament once clear.
When there is definitive clarity on this, I will inform your house of it.
Wanneer hierover definitieve duidelijkheid is, zal ik uw kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over oplichting door taxichauffeurs op Schiphol

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how she would respond to broadcasts about taxi touts defrauding passengers at Schiphol, how a legal change she had signalled could be achieved, and how talks with Haarlemmermeer on amending the local APV are progressing. The State Secretary condemns the practice, says public order is a municipal responsibility and the Passenger Transport Act is unsuitable for it, and says talks with the municipality on an APV amendment are ongoing with the aim of a quick solution.
Haarlemmermeer and my ministry are currently jointly examining whether a further amendment of the APV is a solution.
Haarlemmermeer en mijn ministerie bekijken op dit moment gezamenlijk of een verdere wijziging van de APV een oplossing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de overlast van het spoor nabij America (gemeente Horst aan de Maas)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about train noise nuisance near America (Horst aan de Maas), including a resident survey, a proposed reduction of freight wagons, and a planned freight terminal near Venlo-Blerick. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said America is among the areas under the noise-remediation programme with prioritisation in 2018 and sanitation plans by 2020, and declined to give a train-frequency conversion or to predict the effects of the terminal yet.
In 2018 the first prioritisation takes place for which measures can be taken where.
In 2018 vindt de eerste prioritering plaats voor welke maatregelen waar getroffen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat DuPont honderden kilo’s formaldehyde heeft gelekt

Two SP MPs asked the government about a reported leak of 2,730 kg of carcinogenic formaldehyde at DuPont, whether it was allowed to keep using the substance despite a claimed European ban, what the effects on workers, residents and the environment are, and how the company's safety culture would be addressed. The state secretary answered that no ban exists but a minimisation duty applies, that a criminal complaint and joint provincial and Inspectie SZW investigations are underway, that an initial indication shows no harm to health or environment, and that some production lines were halted at the province's urging, while declining to pre-judge the investigation outcomes.

Because a criminal complaint about this incident has been filed with the Public Prosecution Service on behalf of the province of Zuid-Holland, the competent authority for this company, I do not consider it appropriate to give a further judgment at this time.

Omdat er van dit incident namens de provincie Zuid-Holland, het bevoegd gezag voor dit bedrijf, aangifte is gedaan bij het Openbaar Ministerie acht ik het niet gepast op dit moment een nader oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over ernstige klachten van bewoners door de aanleg van extra rijstroken en een tunnel op de A9 (Gaasperdammerweg) in Amsterdam

MP Smaling asked the minister about severe resident complaints over noise, vibration, compensation and damage from the A9 Gaasperdammerweg tunnel works in Amsterdam, including night work, delayed compensation and monitoring. The minister answered that the nuisance is significant but mitigated through measures, that compensation and damage claims are handled by an independent commission and a building inspection process, and that noise monitoring and a 24-hour complaints line exist.
I am willing to start settling damage claims this year in the neighbourhoods next to the parts of the tunnel whose foundation works are being completed this year.
Ik ben bereid om dit jaar reeds te starten met het afhandelen van de schadeclaims in de wijken gelegen naast die delen van de tunnel waarvan de funderingswerkzaamheden dit jaar reeds worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de gevolgen van de vrijhandelsverdragen met Canada (CETA) en de VS (TTIP) voor asbesthoudende producten

MPs Van Dijk and Smaling asked whether CETA and TTIP could let asbestos-containing products enter the EU market and whether the precautionary principle is weakened. The minister answered that REACH bans asbestos imports, that mutual recognition does not apply to asbestos, that inspection services have adequate powers, and that the precautionary principle is secured in CETA, while Dutch government asked the Commission for a binding declaration.
To clarify matters, the Netherlands has asked the European Commission to also include the precautionary principle for future safety and health measures in a legally binding declaration.

Ter verduidelijking heeft Nederland de Europese Commissie verzocht om het voorzorgsprincipe voor toekomstige veiligheids- en gezondheidsmaatregelen ook op te nemen in een juridisch bindende verklaring
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het uitblijven van het onderzoek van het Agentschap Telecom naar de plaatsing van windturbines bij Lofar

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs minister why the Agentschap Telecom study on wind turbines near the LOFAR radio telescope was not sent to Drenthe after the recess, whether a meeting with the provincial deputy was cancelled, and whether the minister would reconsider the Drentse Monden wind park and delay decisions pending a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answered that the study was finished on 19 September and published after additional mitigation research, that the meeting was cancelled because the impact was not yet clear, and that he would not reconsider or postpone the wind park decision.

A meeting between provincial deputy Stelpstra of Drenthe and myself was scheduled for 25 August. I cancelled that meeting because at that time I did not have sufficient insight into the effects of the wind park on the LOFAR radio telescope to take a position on it.

Op 25 augustus jl. stond een gesprek gepland tussen gedeputeerde Stelpstra van de provincie Drenthe en mijzelf. Ik heb dat gesprek geannuleerd, omdat ik op dat moment niet voldoende inzicht had in de gevolgen van het windpark op de radiotelescoop LOFAR om hierover een standpunt te kunnen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ruimtelijke inpassing van windpark De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment about the spatial planning of the Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farm, covering objections handling, compensation and participation, the Energy Agreement, the Crisis- en herstelwet, the Aarhus Convention and ECHR compliance, LOFAR interference, and the rule of law. The minister answered that objections were handled in a Nota van antwoord, that a gebiedsfonds and planschade rules exist, that the plan meets good spatial planning and the ECHR/Aarhus standards, and that the process was carefully conducted.
In view of the foregoing, I am of the opinion that the decision is compatible with the ECHR and the Aarhus Convention.
Gelet op het vorenstaande ben ik van oordeel dat het besluit zich verdraagt met het EVRM en het Verdrag van Aarhus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over het bericht “Nederland faciliteert omstreden bouwproject”

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch-based shell companies facilitate HKND's Nicaragua canal project that allegedly violates human rights and harms the environment, and what the government did about warnings. The government answered that tax authorities cannot assess human rights, that trust offices must screen integrity risks and DNB supervises them but cannot share its findings, that concerns were shared with Nicaragua and Dutch firms, and that Dutch firms should apply due diligence.
Whether TMF Group adequately performed its gatekeeper function in this case is supervisory-confidential information and therefore cannot be shared by DNB.
Of TMF Group in dit geval zijn poortwachterfunctie adequaat heeft uitgevoerd, is toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie en kan derhalve niet door DNB worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat huishoudens veel meer milieubelasting betalen dan de vervuilende industrie

An SP MP asked why households pay far more environmental tax than heavy industry, the relative burden of energy costs across income groups, and whether consumers will really benefit from the 2016 energy tax changes. The state secretary provided indicative tables showing that energy tax is set by consumption rather than income, that the average household energy bill falls by about 100 euro in 2016, and that the government aims to decarbonise housing without committing to new measures on the household-industry gap.
The costs of energy – and also the tax payable on it – do not depend on income, but are determined by consumption.
De kosten voor energie – en ook de te betalen belasting daarover – hangen echter niet af van het inkomen, maar worden bepaald aan de hand van het verbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat bewoners de rekening betalen bij mogelijke uitbreiding van Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that residents would bear the cost of a possible expansion of Rotterdam The Hague Airport, and whether the growth figures and regional consultations were sound. The State Secretary replied that independent reviews of the airport's environmental report and economic case found them plausible, that an independent facilitator is running a regional consultation with a decision expected in 2017, and that the ministry will assess any formal permit request later without pre-judging the outcome.

I will await that application and will then make a substantive assessment based on all the information available, and subsequently draft a draft airport decision that will be submitted to your House for prior review.

Ik wacht die aanvraag af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken op basis van alle informatie die er ligt en vervolgens een ontwerp luchthavenbesluit opstellen dat in voorhang aan uw Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het door de NAM opzeggen van het vertrouwen in Leekster contra-expertisebureau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the NAM may end its cooperation with the contra-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, whether NAM is delaying payment of invoices, and whether NAM should be kept further at arm's length from earthquake damage settlement in Groningen. The minister answered that the termination is a private decision by NAM outside government control, that NAM will resume contra-expertise commissions once reports meet standards, and that NCG will take a supervisory role over the Centrum Veilig Wonen.
The cooperation between NAM and Vergnes concerns a collaboration between two private parties in which the government is not a party and cannot simply intervene.
De samenwerkingsrelatie tussen NAM en Vergnes betreft een samenwerking tussen twee private partijen waar de overheid geen partij in is en niet zonder meer in kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het toegenomen geweld in de Angolese provincie Cabinda

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about rising violence in Angola's Cabinda province, including reported military deaths, the conflict's background, Chinese involvement, Angolan de-escalation efforts, mediation prospects and Dutch activities. The minister denied the reported incident could be confirmed, outlined the conflict history, saw no direct reason for Dutch mediation, and largely answered on substance without addressing parliamentary scrutiny of the Dutch government itself.
The incident mentioned in the article cannot, however, be confirmed.
Het in het artikel genoemde incident kan echter niet bevestigd worden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de inzet van Europees ontwikkelingsgeld ten behoeve van buitenlandse krijgsmachten in Afrikaanse landen

MPs asked whether EU development funds would be used to finance foreign armies in African countries, including Sudan's, and whether this is acceptable. The government answered that the Commission proposal would only allow non-ODA funds under the IcSP in exceptional cases, that ODA cannot be used to strengthen foreign armies, that Sudanese army support is not on the table, and that the Netherlands will push to keep development money for development.
Your House will be further informed about this proposal in September via a BNC fiche.
Uw Kamer zal in september nader worden geïnformeerd over dit voorstel via een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht 'Recreatieplassen in de uitverkoop, bedrijven nemen exploitatie over’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about municipalities handing recreational lakes to commercial operators, including whether this is legal, its scale, access and parking costs, the role of recreation boards, and the salary of Leisurelands' director. The minister answered that decentralised authorities are free to set recreation policy, that no national overview exists, that the matter belongs to local democracy, and that Leisurelands' supervisory board and shareholders are responsible for monitoring spending.
There is no national insight into the accessibility of recreational lakes or how any local parking tariffs are set at recreational lakes.
Er is op landelijk niveau geen inzicht in de toegankelijkheid van recreatieplassen of hoe eventuele lokale parkeertarieven worden vastgesteld bij recreatieplassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de bij- en meestook van biomassa

An SP MP asked the minister whether 1.5 billion euros of SDE+ subsidy for co-firing biomass in coal plants is justified and whether policy will change after a motion; the minister replied that co-firing is a Energieakkoord target, defended the sustainability criteria, and said the KNAW advice is being integrated into the circular economy programme. The minister refused to change course but promised to inform parliament after the summer.
I will inform the House on this after the summer when sending the circular economy programme.
Ik zal zoals gezegd uw Kamer hierover na de zomer met het verzenden van het programma circulaire economie informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Smaling over de kwetsbare positie van vrouwen bij landregistratieprojecten in onder andere Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Smaling asked whether a Dutch-supported land registration pilot in Ngozi, Burundi, left women with fewer land claims, whether gender analysis should precede such projects, and how gender inequality features in land registration projects. The minister acknowledged Dutch support, said about 95% of registered parcels in Ngozi are in men's names and that some customary women's rights risk erosion, and argued that gender analysis must be integral to such projects and that Nederland continues to support land registration where women's inheritance rights are not legally codified.
It is estimated that before the registration process, about 10% of parcels in the area were subject to such a right exercised by a woman.
Naar schatting werd voorafgaand aan het registratieproces op ongeveer 10% van de percelen in het betreffende gebied een dergelijk recht uitgeoefend door een vrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Nederlandse kust wordt volgebouwd

An SP MP asked the minister whether the surge in coastal recreational construction revealed by a Natuurmonumenten inventory was a surprise, whether it breaches the building ban, whether the minister will issue a reactive directive to coastal municipalities, and whether irreversible steps will be avoided before a new National Environmental Vision. The minister replied that the inventory is a first step to be deepened with parties in the Kustpact, that no breaches of the Barro rules are reported, that a reactive directive is not warranted at present, and that current coastal rules will remain unchanged.
I have given my response there in broad outline and in line with the above answers.
Ik heb daar op hoofdlijnen en in lijn met bovenstaande beantwoording mijn reactie gegeven.

Vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de actieagenda Schiphol de problemen niet oplo

MPs Smaling and Karabulut (SP) asked whether unfair competition from Gulf and Turkish carriers, social premium evasion, sham self-employment, slot allocation and Schiphol security threaten Schiphol and KLM and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that the position of Schiphol and KLM is still strong, pointed to EU mandates for aviation agreements and existing EU rules, and declined new legislation or changes to Schiphol's public status.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the current status.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de huidige status te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Smaling over ‘gevaarlijke stoffen op het spoor’

MPs Van Helvert and Smaling asked why reports showing that risk ceilings for hazardous goods on the rail network will be exceeded were not sent to parliament sooner, and about registration failures and the enforcement response. The state secretary answered that the quarterly reports were delivered in April and used for policy reflection, that the exceedances are being analysed with results expected in July, and that stricter enforcement by the ILT is being expanded, while declining to publish a list of offenders due to ongoing criminal prosecution.
Criminal prosecution is ongoing against the offenders of the statutory obligation to register hazardous substances, and public disclosure of such a list is not among the options.
Tegen de overtreders van de wettelijke verplichting tot registratie van gevaarlijke stoffen loopt een strafrechtelijke vervolging waarbij dergelijke openbaarmaking niet tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Visser over overschrijding van geluidsnormen op de A8 bij Zaanstad

MPs Smaling (SP) and Visser (VVD) asked whether noise and air-quality limits are exceeded along the A8 near Zaanstad, residents' concerns, screen adequacy, traffic and modelling methods. The minister answers that legal noise production ceilings are not exceeded, air quality meets limits, screens are adequate, and a Schinkelbrug-based noise measure study will be checked for the Coenbrug, with several technical follow-ups.

Although the noise production ceilings are not exceeded, I have committed to examining whether the measures proposed from the noise reduction study on the comparable Schinkelbrug are also applicable to the Coenbrug.

Hoewel de geluidsproductieplafonds niet overschreden worden, heb ik toegezegd om te onderzoeken of de maatregelen die aangedragen worden uit het onderzoek naar geluidsreductie aan de – vergelijkbare – Schinkelbrug, ook toepasbaar zijn voor de Coenbrug
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst een bom legt onder gratis OV voor ouderen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether the Tax Authority should bring free public transport for elderly residents under the VAT compensation fund and why it targets Capelle aan den IJssel. The state secretary replied that providing free transport is a municipal choice, that the VAT compensation law excludes benefits given to individual third parties such as transport cards, and that the Capelle audit was routine supervision.
Whether or not to provide public transport free of charge is a decision made by decentralised governments.
Het al dan niet gratis verstrekken van OV is een afweging, die door decentrale overheden wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de toename van ronselende taxichauffeurs rondom Schiphol

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the rise in taxi drivers recruiting and defrauding passengers around Schiphol, including whether licences can be revoked and whether bans can be imposed. The State Secretary said the problem is primarily a municipal public-order matter, that the ILT can suspend or withdraw driver cards for relevant offences, and that the parties involved are cooperating without committing to new national measures.
Whether there is recruiting can only be established by observing it on the spot.
Of sprake is van ronselen kan alleen worden vastgesteld door het ter plekke te constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over windmolens in Kenia

An SP MP asks the minister about the Lake Turkana wind park in Kenya: Dutch financing, recognition of nomadic land rights and indigenous status, consultation, jobs, the power purchase price, the World Bank's exit, and possible corruption. The minister answers that FMO and a Dutch ministry subsidy are involved, that the lease is registered and was confirmed by the national land commission, that the World Bank judged the risk too high, and that no signs of corruption were received.
The cabinet has received no signals from the parties involved in the Lake Turkana Wind Project that this is the case.
Het kabinet heeft van betrokken partijen bij het Lake Turkana Wind Project geen signalen ontvangen dat dit het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht ‘Zwangerschapsproblemen bij oud-medewerkers DuPont’

MPs Ulenbelt and Smaling asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of pregnancy problems among former DuPont workers, the role of the company health service and the labour inspectorate, whether to commission investigations, and whether to ask the Safety Board to investigate. The minister said the situation is serious, that he wants the facts laid out first with the Audit Dienst Rijk involved, and that a Safety Board investigation is not currently appropriate.
I now want to lay out the facts and will involve the Audit Dienst Rijk (ADR) in this.
Ik wil nu de feiten op een rij zetten en zal de Audit Dienst Rijk (ADR) daarbij betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht “dat er onderzoek komt naar de Arbeidsinspectie inzake DuPont”

MPs Ulenbelt and Smaling asked the minister whether the Labour Inspectorate's handling of the DuPont Lycra plant is being investigated and what the inquiry covers. The minister answered that the inquiry examines the use of DMAC, work processes and risk controls from the 1970s until the substances were no longer used, with the Audit Dienst Rijk involved and results due in November 2016.
In November 2016 you will receive the results of the investigation.
In november 2016 ontvangt u de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Smaling en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat er door een drugs-lab giftige stoffen zijn vrij gekomen in een woonwijk in Tilburg

MPs asked the government how harmful the toxic release from a Tilburg drug lab was, how residents are being informed and trained to spot drug labs, and how many labs are dismantled and what resources are assigned. The minister answered that methanol and sulphuric acid were present, residents were informed by letter, training and a smell map are being rolled out in the south, and labour conditions at the dismantling unit were investigated and improved.
In any case it is an undesirable situation when a drug laboratory is found in a residential area.
Het is hoe dan ook een onwenselijke situatie als een drugslaboratorium in een woonwijk wordt aangetroffen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het voorstel van het college van burgemeesters en wethouders aan de Raad van de gemeente Arnhem over het voorstel voor mogelijke woningbouw in het uiterwaardengebied van de Ned

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Arnhem's proposal to allow 250-350 homes in the Meinerswijk floodplain of the Nederrijn before any river hydraulic assessment, and whether this conflicts with flood-safety goals and the Barro. The Minister answered that the plan is only permissible if it creates more room for the river and meets Bgr and Barro conditions, which are not yet verified because the required river study is incomplete.
At present, from Rijkswaterstaat's perspective, there is no insight yet into whether the plan for Stadsblokken Meinerswijk is permissible under the Barro and the Bgr.
Op dit moment is er vanuit het perspectief van Rijkswaterstaat nog geen zicht op het al dan niet toelaatbaar zijn van het plan voor Stadsblokken Meinerswijk via het Barro en de Bgr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over miljardeninvestering in nieuwe verkeersprojecten

An MP asks the minister whether the Infrastructure Fund top-up commits money a future cabinet should spend, whether there is a long-term mobility vision, why modal shift from road to inland waterways is not a goal in itself despite EU policy, and about emissions comparisons, the EU 30% modal shift target, success cases and cost-benefit of the Twente-Mittelland canal. The minister defers the spending question to the budget debate, points to existing energy and climate agreements, shows road share falling only slightly to 66% by 2014, and concludes the canal project is not socially profitable.
On Prinsjesdag I will inform you about the draft budget 2017.
Op Prinsjesdag informeer ik u over de ontwerpbegroting 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een BTW- constructie bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a VAT construction in compensation for Groningen earthquake damage, where NAM allegedly deducted VAT on property purchases and payments went to a NAM-chosen notary. The State Secretary answered that tax confidentiality (art. 67 AWR) prevents answering the case-specific questions, while answering general VAT rules on compensation, invoicing and the Supreme Court ruling of 2015, and announced withdrawal of a 2011 tolerance decision.
Given the tax confidentiality obligation, it is not possible to give you information about a specific taxpayer.
Gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht is het niet mogelijk aan u informatie over een specifieke belastingplichtige te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over handel in praktijkroutes van het CBR

An SP MP asked the minister about a website selling exam routes for the practical driving test, and about a driving school with suspected fraud still operating, and whether entry requirements for driving schools should be tightened. The minister said there are no fixed exam routes, that the CBR terminated its contract with the driving school in question last year, and that rules for driving schools will not be tightened since SMEs are not regulated in the Netherlands.
I believe good information about choosing a driving school is important and I have strongly advocated for it.
Ik ben van mening dat goede voorlichting over de keuze van een rijschool belangrijk is en heb ik mij sterk voor gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het energiezuinig maken van huurwoningen en het voordeel voor huurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing about the Amsterdam audit office's recommendation on energy-saving measures in social rental housing, the gap between expected and actual energy savings, and whether tenants financially benefit from energy renovations and an energy performance fee. The minister said the audit office did not recommend reconsidering specific measures, that municipalities have discretion and tools, declined to give a general figure on tenant costs, and rejected a mandatory rent-cost guarantee.
I cannot state in general terms what the financial advantage or disadvantage is for tenants when their home is made energy-efficient.
Ik kan niet in algemene zin aangeven wat het financiële voor- of nadeel is voor huurders wanneer hun woning energiezuinig wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) drie casemanagers heeft aangenomen die eerder voor NAM de schadeafhandeling hebben gedaan

MP Smaling asked whether the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) hired three case managers who previously handled damage claims for NAM, and whether their independence is guaranteed and whether they handled the same complex cases earlier. The minister answered that the NCG hired them for their expertise on complex cases, that they were contracted via an external agency, that a list of 195 complex cases was identified with NAM and reassigned cases will go to other case managers, and that no one is excluded on the basis of prior clients.
If a damage case arises that is connected to a matter in which they were involved on behalf of NAM, it will be assigned to another case manager.
Indien zich een schadegeval aandient dat verband houdt met een zaak waar zij namens NAM bij betrokken zijn geweest, dan wordt deze toegewezen aan een andere casemanager.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving van Luchtvaartnieuws en Russia Today over oververmoeidheid en intimidatie bij het personeel van de vliegtuigmaatschappijen Emirates en Flydubai

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that Emirates and Flydubai pilots are overfatigued and intimidated, and whether this affects aviation safety. The state secretary answered that the UAE authorities are responsible for oversight of these airlines, that ILT spot checks found no verifiable fatigue incidents, and that an independent investigation into the Flydubai crash is ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over te weinig capaciteit van beunschepen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the shrinking capacity of sand and gravel barges, the effects of CCR technical rules (ROSR) on small vessels, and whether small vessels should be exempted. The minister largely defended existing policy, citing the Panteia study and the CCR transition periods, and said exemptions from CCR rules are not within the government's power.
I therefore do not have the possibility to make exceptions.
Ik heb dus niet de mogelijkheid om uitzonderingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht dat zwanen massaal worden afgeschoten in het Groene Hart

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass shooting of swans in the Groene Hart, including the justification for provincial permits, whether the permits are dubious, measures against the hunt, and legal options against mistreatment shown on television. The State Secretary replied that about 1100 swans were killed this winter, in line with the average, that provinces are responsible for permits under the Flora- and faunawet and he will not intervene, that the courts remain open, and that enforcement bodies oversee permit conditions while a possible criminal investigation is being considered and cannot be discussed.
Under the Flora- and faunawet, it is the responsibility of the provinces to approve fauna management plans and grant permits based on them.
Het is ingevolge de Flora- en faunawet de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om faunabeheerplannen goed te keuren en daarop gebaseerde ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichten rondom de veiligheid van de kerncentrale in Doel

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that Belgium's Hoge Gezondheidsraad found a serious nuclear accident at Doel possible and that Belgian crisis plans were inadequate, and what Dutch citizens' safety is. The minister answered that the Belgian council assumed an accident could occur and assessed preparedness, that Dutch preparation zones were extended to 100 km and food-chain measures cover all of the Netherlands, and that safety is governed by strict international standards and independent oversight.
On 24 March you received a letter from me going into detail on the advice of the Belgian Hoge Gezondheidsraad.
Op 24 maart jl. heeft u van mij een brief ontvangen waarin ik uitgebreid in ga op het advies van de Belgische Hoge Gezondheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er sprake is van het overtreden van de wet bij het verkopen van energiecontracten door Essent

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Essent's door-to-door sales of energy contracts, including withholding the 14-day cooling-off period and deducting a gift card on cancellation, violated the law, and whether the minister would order Essent to inform consumers. The minister said compliance is for the ACM and courts to judge, noted that the ACM had already made Essent's commitments binding in November 2015, and said Essent accepts unused gift cards back without charge.
However, it is not for me to assess whether companies comply with applicable laws in a specific case.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te beoordelen of bedrijven geldende wetten in een concreet geval naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de werkdruk voor de beveiligers op Schiphol is toegenomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment, on behalf of the Justice Minister, how the government responds to union warnings that rising workload for Schiphol security staff creates safety and health risks, and why the new security system has not reduced pressure. The government says a TNO study on the workload is nearly finished, the Marechaussee sees no safety concerns in its oversight, and the employers and unions are responsible for working conditions with the results to be discussed in April.
It is the employer's task, i.e. the security companies, to ensure good working conditions and to shape the prevention of occupational risks, with the consent of the employees.
Het is de taak van de werkgever, i.c. de beveiligingsbedrijven, te zorgen voor goede arbeidsomstandigheden en om -met instemming van de werknemers- de preventie van arbeidsrisico’s vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mondengebied monddood’

MPs Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder and Smaling asked why the ministry's wind park information sessions require barcode registration, ban phones-recording and filming, and whether the personal data register complies with privacy law and was reviewed by the privacy authority. The minister defended the restrictions as protecting privacy and openness, said data will be destroyed after the sessions, acknowledged the registration form lacked a controller notice, and did not seek the privacy authority's advice.

I have noted that the online registration form for the sessions does not state that the Ministry of Economic Affairs is responsible for processing the personal data and for what purpose the data is requested.

Ik heb geconstateerd dat het online registratieformulier voor de spreekuren niet vermeldt dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken verantwoordelijk is voor de verwerking van de persoonsgegevens en met welk doel de gegevens worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanpak van geluidoverlast en fijnstof bij de Coenbrug

An SP MP asked whether the Coenbrug on the A8 amplifies traffic noise for residents, what measures will reduce it, and whether residents' health concerns about fine particulates are justified, and whether noise screens should be replaced with ones that also capture fine dust. The minister replied that the bridge's steel construction causes a rumbling noise, that noise and air quality levels meet legal norms, that Rijkswaterstaat shared study results with residents and will keep them informed, and that replacing the screens is not being considered.
The fine particulate concentrations around the A8 at the Coenbrug, however, fall within the set limit values.
De concentraties fijnstof in de omgeving van de A8 ter hoogte van de Coenbrug vallen echter binnen de daarvoor gestelde grenswaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over rijscholen laten met trucjes tienduizenden cursisten slagen voor theorie-examen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment how rijscholen teach trucs and mnemonics that help candidates pass the driving theory exam, why this has not been stopped, and what oversight exists. The Minister condemns the practice, lists CBR anti-fraud measures such as new exam questions, external review and enforcement by police, ILT and the Belastingdienst, but says no data exist on how many candidates use such methods.
The CBR has commissioned an external expert firm to examine all exam questions for known and possibly new systematic predictabilities without substantive basis.
Het CBR heeft opdracht gegeven aan een extern deskundig bureau om alle examenvragen te onderzoeken op bekende en mogelijk nieuwe systematische voorspelbaarheden zonder inhoudelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de wens van Rotterdam The Hague Airport om ze snel mogelijk uit te breiden

Member Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary how she views Rotterdam The Hague Airport's push for rapid, substantial expansion, whether talks with the airport director took place, and what noise and fine-particle impacts are expected. The state secretary replied that the airport's environmental impact report and economic analysis are being reviewed, that she expects a regional consensus before an airport decision application, and that she will assess the plans only once the application is filed, with the environmental report to be tested by the Commission for Environmental Assessment.
I will await the application for the airport decision and will then make a substantive assessment.
Ik wacht de aanvraag voor het luchthavenbesluit af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie jarenlang te makkelijk nieuwe bestrijdingsmiddelen heeft toegelaten

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's lax approval of pesticides, flagged by the European Ombudsman, endangers health and environment and what the Netherlands will do about it, including holding producers liable. The State Secretary answered that there is no reason to believe safety is at risk, that the Ctgb assessed the confirmatory data positively, that the Commission has accepted the Ombudsman's recommendations, and that no further tightening of authorisation policy is currently needed.
I consider this ruling a reason to tighten the current procedures.
Ik vind deze uitspraak aanleiding om de huidige procedures aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “dat er meer onderzoek nodig is naar een alternatieve variant van 380 kV verbinding van het toekomstige windpark Borssele”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Westerschelde cable alternative to the new 380 kV Borssele connection was not studied, and about costs, land access and residents living between two lines. The minister replied that the new line is needed for grid security and capacity, that undergrounding a long stretch or upgrading the existing line is not feasible, and that no further independent study is planned.
I am of the view that societal interests are best served by the new 380 kV connection.
Ik ben van mening dat de maatschappelijke belangen het best worden gediend met de nieuwe 380 kV-verbinding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de investeringsplannen van TenneT bij de 380kV-verbindingen in Zeeland en de aansluitingen van het toekomstige windpark Borssele

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether TenneT plans 5-7 billion euro in Zeeland grid investments, whether those plans are secret, and how necessity, route choice, cost-efficiency and conflicts of interest are overseen, including the Algemene Rekenkamer criticism and the stalled STROOM bill. The minister denied the 5-7 billion figure for Zeeland (that is the national programme, with about 1.2 billion for the Zuidwest 380 kV link), said only commercially confidential parts are secret, and pointed to ACM and ministerial reviews, promising a new bill after the summer.
Only these parts of TenneT's investment plans are secret.
Slechts deze delen van de investeringsplannen van TenneT zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat 2.000 chauffeurs in het streekvervoer dreigen met stakingen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether drivers' threatened strikes over volunteers replacing paid bus drivers in regional transport are justified, and how provinces handle the Brede doeluitkering and bus line cuts. The State Secretary says provinces are responsible for public transport concessions, that volunteer arrangements are possible where no employment relationship or cao applies, and that she will consult provinces and metropolitan regions before reporting back to parliament.
Specifically regarding public transport, the provinces are responsible for the supply and the concession contract.
Specifiek met betrekking tot het openbaar vervoer (OV) zijn de provincies verantwoordelijk voor het aanbod en het concessiecontract.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de toekomst van vracht op Schiphol en de rol van de KLM hierin

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the future of air cargo at Schiphol, KLM's role, the reduction of Martinair's freighter fleet and possible unfair competition from Gulf carriers. The State Secretary answered that air cargo remains core for Air France KLM, that fleet reduction reflects global overcapacity, that cargo access is assessed case by case rather than open skies, and that Schiphol's cargo strategy and Smartgate project aim to keep handling quality high.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Hoogland, Smaling en Van Helvert over het sluiten van overwegen door ProRail

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about ProRail's closure of level crossings, including the Laantje van Alverna private crossing, the status of a QuickScan on 100 unsupervised crossings, and how recreational interests are weighed. The State Secretary answered that ProRail follows the agreed procedure with the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking, that recreational interests are weighed in the Omgevingswet process, and that clarification on definitions will follow in spring 2016.
Nevertheless, I note that there is uncertainty between ProRail and the other members of the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking about some definitions in the procedure.
Niettemin constateer ik dat er tussen ProRail en de overige leden van de Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking over sommige definities uit de procedure onduidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een mogelijke btw-deal bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked whether a VAT integration-supply or other VAT arrangement applies to earthquake damage settlements in Groningen, why NAM routes payments via notaries, and how VAT treatment works for the Groninger Forum. The minister declined to comment on any specific VAT ruling, citing the tax inspector's exclusive competence and secrecy, described the general VAT deduction rules, and said NAM follows a standard settlement and deposit procedure without commenting on individual cases.
The tax inspector has the exclusive, statutorily established competence to rule on this arrangement.
Het is de exclusieve, wettelijk vastgelegde bevoegdheid van de belastinginspecteur om een uitspraak te doen over deze constructie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het traineren van een afgesloten overeenkomst bij een complexe schade in Groningen

An SP MP asked the minister whether NAM's delay in paying a signed damage settlement in Bedum, its reopening of the agreement with a depot arrangement, and its claims on VAT and construction control were acceptable. The minister largely referred to earlier answers, said the trust of Groningers is promoted by swift damage repair, and stressed the need for agreement between the victim and NAM.
For swift damage repair it is necessary that the victim and NAM agree on the chosen solution.
Voor voortvarend schadeherstel is het noodzakelijk dat gedupeerde en NAM overeenstemming hebben over de gekozen oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de haven Rotterdam verdwijnt als groene omschakeling uitblijft

An MP asked the minister how she views a report warning that Rotterdam port may lose its position without a green transition, and what the state as shareholder will do to make the port greener. The minister answered that the transition is underway, that the port has the largest biobased cluster in Europe, and that the state supports it through several programmes, without committing to new binding steps.
I recognise the importance of a transition to a biobased and circular economy, including in the Rotterdam port.
Ik onderken het belang van een transitie naar een biobased en circulaire economie, ook in de Rotterdamse haven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over overheden die ondanks milieubeloften vieze energie inkopen

An SP MP asked why municipalities and provinces that pledged green electricity still buy cheapest, often grey, power, and what this says about the value of their pledges. The minister replied that green power is guaranteed by the EU certificate (gvo) system, that the cities' purchases are compliant, and declined to assess companies' green image or to support small green suppliers in tenders.
The European guarantee-of-origin system guarantees that the electricity consumed comes from a renewable source.
Het Europese systeem van gvo’s garandeert dat de stroom die wordt geconsumeerd uit een duurzame bron afkomstig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat AkzoNobel zoutholtes in Twente wil vullen met onder meer vliegas
