An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to fill unstable salt caverns in Twente with fly ash, and about risks of subsidence, liability, monitoring and cost. The minister answered that the caverns are monitored under a protocol, liability rests with the mine operator under civil law, and fly ash has been dropped as filler after public opposition.
AkzoNobel has indicated that the recent public debate showed that there is no support for this.
AkzoNobel heeft aangegeven dat uit de recentelijke maatschappelijk discussie is gebleken dat het draagvlak hiervoor ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de inzet van de Nederlandse regering bij de OESO Development Assistance Committee (DAC) High Level Meeting

An SP MP asked the minister how the Netherlands would approach the OECD-DAC High Level Meeting on modernising ODA, including asylum reception costs, military spending, private sector finance and countering violent extremism. The minister outlined the Dutch position on each point, stated that reporting first-year asylum costs as ODA is an OECD-DAC agreed practice, and answered the questions on substance.
The Netherlands will be represented at the High Level Meeting by the Director-General for International Cooperation and the Ambassador for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation.
Nederland zal bij de High Level Meeting worden vertegenwoordigd door de Directeur-Generaal Internationale Samenwerking en de Ambassadeur Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er sprake is van belangenverstrengeling bij het Energieonderzoek Centrum Nederland (ECN)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of conflict of interest at ECN, where a former director privately owned and ran wind turbines subsidised under the MEP scheme, and about related pay and investment matters. The minister answered that ECN's management found no conflicting interests but that an appearance of conflict arose, that the screening framework will be tightened with independent advice, and that no subsidy misuse was found, while refusing a freeze on onshore wind.
ECN does acknowledge that the appearance of a conflict of interest has arisen and that this is undesirable.
ECN constateert wel dat de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is ontstaan en dat dit onwenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat bewoners in Wateringen nog steeds blootgesteld worden aan asbest

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that residents of Wateringen remain exposed to asbestos a year after a major fire, and about whether municipalities are equipped to handle such incidents, including a rapid response force, asbestos removal certification and insurance. The State Secretary answered that the GGD judges health risks as negligible, the province sees no need for further supervisory steps as the municipality has a plan of action, an updated national asbestos fire plan is due around September 2016, a rapid response force is not considered useful, and certification compliance has improved; on insurance she will consult the insurers' association.
The province currently sees no reason to take further steps from its supervisory role.
De provincie ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding om verdere stappen te zetten vanuit haar toezichthoudende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de drinkwaterbron van 1,3 miljoen huishoudens is vervuild

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that a drinking water intake serving 1.3 million households in the Randstad was contaminated with the pesticide dimethoate, asking how it happened, whether health was at risk, the ecological effects and what measures would prevent recurrence. The government answered that the source is not yet identified, that intake was halted and treatment prevents health risks, that ecological effects cannot be excluded, and that the regular pesticide policy stands without new measures.
Regarding progress in establishing the cause, Waterschap Rivierenland, in the interest of the investigation, does not wish to make further statements.
Over de voortgang ten aanzien van het achterhalen van de oorzaak wil het Waterschap Rivierenland in het belang van het onderzoek verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over aanhoudende problemen bij de kerncentrale bij Doel

An SP MP asked the minister about repeated shutdowns and incidents at the Doel nuclear plant in Belgium, including whether the Netherlands should urge closure and how residents were informed. The minister answered that the shutdowns stemmed from non-nuclear components with no safety consequences, that Belgium's independent regulator FANC confirms safety, and that joint inspections and information arrangements are in place, but declined to call for closure.
The independent Belgian Federal Agency for Nuclear Control (FANC) supervises the safety of these reactors.
Het onafhankelijke Federaal Agentschap voor Nucleaire Controle (FANC) houdt toezicht op de veiligheid van deze reactoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de gemeente Amersfoort overgaat tot grootschalige kap en het gebruik van Roundup in parkbos Nimmerdor

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Amersfoort's large-scale felling and use of Roundup in the Nimmerdor park forest, questioning whether alternatives were used and whether public health was at risk. The State Secretary said the pesticide rules are being tightened, that the municipality's approach fits current policy, and that the ministry has no competence over the municipal management decision, so no talks with the municipality would change it.
The ministry has no competence or responsibility in this matter.
Het ministerie heeft daarin geen bevoegdheid of verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat glyfosaat gaat gebruiken op de kribben in de IJssel

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Rijkswaterstaat would use glyphosate on river groynes in the IJssel, and whether this was assessed against drinking-water and water-quality rules. The minister answered that glyphosate is currently legally permitted for treating tree stumps, that its use is targeted and limited to dry weather in the growing season with negligible water impact, and that no permit is required for this maintenance.
For this type of maintenance work there is no permit requirement, but there are rules for safe and sustainable use.
Er is bij dit type beheer en onderhoudswerk geen sprake van een vergunningsplicht, wel zijn er voorschriften voor veilig en duurzaam gebruik
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de implicaties van het bericht volgend jaar op meer wegen 130 kilometer per uur

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the 2016 raise of speed limits to 130 km/h on motorways was justified given extra nitrogen and CO2 emissions, how PAS nitrogen headroom is monitored, and how Urgenda and emissions data were considered. The government answered that the PAS already accounts for the 130 km/h limit, that the increase is part of existing policy, that monitoring and evaluation are planned, and that it does not expect new NO2 exceedances.
With the annual monitoring of the NSL, however, the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment keeps a close eye on the situation.
Met de jaarlijkse monitoring van het NSL houdt de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu echter een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het nieuwsbericht “Kampen denkt na over extra bypass naast Reevediep”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the government accepts that Overijssel and Kampen are seeking alternatives to a navigable Reevediep after the Council of State ruled it may not be a through shipping route, and about related zoning annulment. The minister answered that recreational shipping is part of an integrated area development, that the channel's construction does not depend on a shipping route, and that no concrete bypass plan yet exists.
As far as I am aware, there is (as yet) no concrete plan.
Voor zover mij bekend is er (nog) geen sprake van een concreet plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het afschaffen van het bouwverbod aan de kust

An SP MP asked the minister why the general building ban on the coast is being lifted before the Omgevingswet debate, and why the Grevelingen initiative was used to force legislation. The minister answers that the Nationale Visie Kust shows a safe coast allowing less strict water-safety rules, that the draft Barro amendment will be pre-tabled to parliament and published for four weeks of comment, and that parliament can debate it before entry into force.
The draft decision will be pre-tabled to your House and the Senate and published in the Government Gazette.
Het ontwerpbesluit wordt voorgehangen bij uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer en in de Staatscourant bekendgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Deskundigen zetten vraagtekens bij KNMI-kaart”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the KNMI's October 2015 PGA hazard map underestimates the Groningen reinforcement task, whether the NPR earthquake-resistant building standard will be written into the Building Decree, and about the Meijdam committee's safety norm. The minister answered that the new map uses only Groningen measurements, that the NEN committee found further calculations are needed for NPR use, that SodM prefers the NAM production-driven method and that talks on independence are ongoing, and that the 10^-5 safety norm applies regardless of cost.
Currently in talks with SodM, TNO and KNMI to examine how this can take shape in the short term (before 1 April 2016).
In gesprek met SodM, TNO en KNMI om te bezien hoe dit op korte termijn (voor 1 april 2016) vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Deskundigen zetten vraagtekens bij KNMI-kaart”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about expert doubts over the KNMI's Groningen PGA earthquake-hazard map, whether SodM reviewed it, why the KNMI statistical map was chosen over NAM's production-based model, and whether that choice affects the gas-extraction decision. The minister answered that SodM had internationally reviewed the map, that both methods are needed for mutual verification, that SodM prefers the NAM-derived method, and that he is working with SodM, TNO and KNMI to institutionalise an independent production-based method by 1 April 2016.
To secure the independence of this production-based method for the PGA map, I am now in discussion with SodM, TNO and KNMI to consider how this can take shape in the short term (by 1 April 2016).

Om de onafhankelijkheid van deze productiegestuurde methodiek voor de PGA-kaart te borgen, ben nu ik in gesprek met SodM, TNO en KNMI om te bezien hoe dit op korte termijn (voor 1 april 2016) vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over Gelderland megastallenland

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the growth of mega-stables in Gelderland, the number of applications, monitoring, and a promised law letting authorities cap stable sizes on public health grounds. The State Secretary reported rising numbers of large stables, said that permit applications are handled by provinces and municipalities and that the central government does not track them, declined to monitor numbers structurally, and promised to inform the House in early 2016 on the proposed animal numbers law.
Applications for permits to build new stables are submitted under spatial planning, environmental and nature legislation for which municipalities and provinces are the competent authority.

Aanvragen voor vergunningen voor de bouw van nieuwe stallen worden ingediend in het kader van de wetgeving op het vlak van ruimtelijke ordening, milieu en natuur waarvoor gemeenten en provincies het bevoegd gezag zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het onderzoek van de respectievelijke ministeries naar het ‘te strikte beleid’ van de provincie Zuid-Holland inzake de vestiging van megawinkels

MP Smaling asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Economic Affairs about their review of whether Zuid-Holland's restrictive retail-location rules for megastores are too strict, and about the status of the Raad van State advice, the national retail structure vision and the Bro provision. The minister answers that the review concerns a request by Decathlon for annulment of provincial rules, that a partial suspension of article 2.1.4(3)(a) is proposed, that the Bro provision does not restrict provinces, and that the government will not draft a national retail structure vision, relying on the Retailagenda instead.
It has been decided, prior to that decision and for the reasons given in the previous paragraph, to propose suspension of one part of article 2.1.4, third paragraph, of the provincial regulation.
Besloten is om voorafgaande aan die beslissing, om redenen genoemd in de vorige alinea, een onderdeel van artikel 2.1.4, derde lid, voor te dragen voor schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat rechtsbijstandsverzekering taboe is voor Groningers in aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asks whether insurers excluding residents of the Groningen earthquake area from legal expenses insurance, citing an ongoing dispute, is acceptable, and raises related questions on subsidised legal aid, the WAG foundation arrangement and the NCG's proposed arbiter. The minister replies that insurers say residents can still obtain cover for future claims depending on each insurer's policy, that no equivalent exclusion areas are known elsewhere, and that the NCG has been asked to investigate whether insurers' conditions are disproportionate.
The Dutch Association of Insurers has informed me upon request that the claim that residents of the Groningen earthquake area cannot take out legal expenses insurance is not accurate.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat de stelling dat bewoners uit het Groningse aardbevingsgebied geen rechtsbijstandsverzekering kunnen afsluiten, niet accuraat is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de uitspraken van de topman van Emirates dat steun voor KLM schadelijk is voor Schiphol

An SP MP asked the state secretary to react to Emirates' chief executive's claims that support for KLM harms Schiphol, and whether the second daily A380 flights should be blocked pending state-aid checks. The state secretary declined to comment on the CEO's remarks, found no grounds under the bilateral air agreement to stop the second A380, and said the EU mandate for Gulf negotiations could include fair-competition safeguards.
I had the request from Emirates for a second A380 tested against the provisions of the agreement.
Ik heb de aanvraag van Emirates voor een tweede A380 laten toetsen aan de bepalingen van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de relatie met Ethiopië

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a newspaper article on drought in Ethiopia, climate-smart solutions, lessons from Kenya, food security funding (EUR 33.7 million), water management projects, the UN food aid request, and structural measures against future famine. The minister answered each question, describing Dutch-funded programmes, the bodies involved, and the reallocation of EUR 9 million to the Productive Safety Net Programme, with a project table provided as an annex.
The Netherlands contributes 5 million euros to OCHA's Common Humanitarian Relief Fund (CHF) in Ethiopia.
Nederland geeft een bijdrage van 5 miljoen euro aan het Common Humanitarian Relief Fund (CHF) van OCHA in Ethiopië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht «Weer hoge bijensterfte in Nederland»

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about rising winter bee mortality, the link to neonicotinoid pesticides such as thiacloprid, calls for a total ban, usage data, legal grounds for not banning them, and the timing of reassessments. The State Secretary answered that Dutch winter mortality is below the ten-year average, that multiple factors are involved, that a ban decision awaits the CTGB advice, and that further information will follow before the end of the Christmas recess.
I will inform the House about this by letter before the end of the Christmas recess.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het kerstreces informeren per brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Smaling over de verdere besluitvorming inzake Pallas

MPs Van Tongeren and Smaling asked about the province of Noord-Holland withholding the second tranche of the Pallas reactor loan, the business case, go/no-go milestones, isotope supply, state aid and the Petten contamination. Minister Kamp answered that the bestuursakkoord would be shared, but declined to share the business case or provincial correspondence, and gave general answers on timetable, isotopes and the cleanup.

Given the importance of efficient and well-considered implementation of the decision-making on the project, in particular the Foundation's task of attracting private financing for the construction of the Pallas reactor, I do not consider it desirable to share the business case with the House of Representatives, whether confidential or not.

Gelet op het belang van een efficiënte en weloverwogen uitvoering van (de besluitvorming over) het project, in het bijzonder de taak van de Stichting voorbereiding Pallas-reactor om private financiering voor de bouw van de Pallas-reactor aan te trekken, acht ik het niet wenselijk om de business case – al dan niet vertrouwelijk – te delen met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de vervuiling door bandengruis

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how she would respond to reports that tyre wear particles are a major source of microplastic pollution, whether international differences exist, how winter and summer tyres compare, and whether she would investigate, consult sectors, introduce an eco-label or raise the issue in Europe. The state secretary answered that a RIVM study is pending (due February 2016), explained the drivers of tyre wear, noted the EU tyre label does not cover wear, and said she would await the RIVM study before any follow-up action.
For any follow-up actions I am awaiting the RIVM study.
Voor eventuele vervolgacties wacht ik het onderzoek van het RIVM af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de Hoogwatergeul Varik-Heesselt

An MP (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the design flow of 18,000 m3/s at Lobith, alternatives to the Varik-Heesselt high-water channel, and cost and public support. The minister answered that the basis is the best available knowledge, referred to an annex on peak discharge, explained that climate change is applied only once in the GRADE model, and defended the channel as the only realistic alternative to dike raising, promising a further MIRT exploration.
Following questions raised in the June 24, 2015 Water committee meeting, I committed to send the Chamber the report on determining the Rhine river discharge.

Naar aanleiding van de vragen die in het AO Water van 24 juni 2015 (Kamerstuk 31 710, 43 ) gesteld zijn heb ik toegezegd de rapportage over de bepaling van de rivierafvoer van de Rijn aan de kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

The MP Smaling asked whether the Volkswagen emissions-software fraud undermines the national air quality programme (NOx) and the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen (PAS) and AERIUS model, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that air quality policy need not be changed because it is already based on real-world emission measurements, that the latest data will be incorporated in the annual model update, and that extra measures for cities will be sent to parliament in November.
Air quality policy does not need to be adjusted as a result of the software fraud at Volkswagen.
Het luchtkwaliteitbeleid hoeft naar aanleiding van de softwarefraude bij Volkswagen niet te worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving dat bedrijven worden gestimuleerd gas uit de Noordzee te winnen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs to explain his statement that companies should be encouraged to extract more gas from the North Sea, and how this fits with his claim that fossil fuels are not subsidised, including through tax measures. The minister referred to a parallel letter on the review of the 25% investment deduction for marginal gas fields, and argued that the deduction is a stimulus that enables otherwise unprofitable investment rather than a subsidy, noting prior EU state-aid approval.
I am examining whether the current 25% investment deduction for exploration and extraction of marginal gas deposits on the Dutch continental shelf should be extended, adjusted or replaced after 2016.

In mijn brief geef ik aan dat ik momenteel onderzoek of de huidige investeringsaftrek van 25% voor investeringen in de opsporing en winning van marginale gasvoorkomens op het Nederlands deel van het continentaal plat na 2016 moet worden verlengd, bijgesteld of vervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat grensgemeenten moeten kunnen meepraten over de kerncentrales in het Belgische Doel

An SP MP asked the government about calls for neighbouring Dutch border municipalities to use consultation rights over extending the lifetime of the Belgian Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants, including whether an environmental impact assessment is needed. The minister answered that the Belgian regulator FANC decides independently on safety, that no environmental impact assessment is required, that contacts and joint exercises exist, and that she will inform the Chamber of new developments.
It is up to the Belgian government to give a judgement on the extension of the operating life.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om een oordeel te geven over de levensduurverlenging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de NS nachttrein naar Noord-Brabant schrapt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary why the NS night train to Noord-Brabant was cut, whether a €700,000 annual price is reasonable, and whether the government will mediate with NS and the province. The State Secretary replied that the concession sets late-train rules, that the cut night services were province-funded outside the concession, that NS and the province must agree financing, and that the province and municipalities can have the price independently reviewed.
This is a matter between the province and NS.
Dit is een zaak tussen de provincie en NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de mogelijke gevolgen van de productie van teflon in Dordrecht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about health and environmental risks of PFOA from teflon production at DuPont (now Chemours) in Dordrecht, including the split of oversight among several bodies, whether authorities knew of the hazards, and whether an independent study would be done. The government answered that PFOA use stopped in 2012, that oversight is coordinated under the Brzo framework, and that it will ask RIVM to study what emissions could have meant for health, but it did not provide the answers in time for the debate.
Therefore I will ask the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to prepare a study examining to what concentrations of PFOA in air and water the emissions could have led.

Daarom zal ik het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) vragen om een onderzoek voor te bereiden waarin uitgezocht wordt tot welke concentraties PFOA in lucht en water de emissie kan hebben geleid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichten dat er een beter plan moet komen voor asbestsanering

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about reports that a better plan is needed for asbestos removal, including whether removal is on schedule, whether subsidies of 75 million euro are adequate, and whether a national plan with partners is possible. The State Secretary answered that at current pace removal would take until 2044, so a stimulation scheme from January 2016 aims to speed it up, and agreed to examine a structured timeline with external partners.
Yes, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment is willing to cooperate in such a study carried out by the named external parties.
Ja, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu is bereid om mee te werken aan een dergelijk onderzoek dat wordt uitgevoerd door de genoemde externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de normering van pyrazol in de Maas en Rijn

An SP MP asked the minister why the temporary maximum concentration of pyrazol in the Maas and Rijn was raised from 1 to 15 microgram per litre, whether this weakens pressure on polluters, and what happens after two years, among other questions. The minister explained the 15 microgram limit is a temporary intake maximum based on a conservative expert calculation pending a toxicological standard, said the regional water board has enforced against the polluter, committed to a protocol and review of the rules, and to raising the issue at European level.
Therefore I have set a temporary maximum concentration of 15 μg/l for water intake for drinking water production.
Daarom heb ik een tijdelijke maximale concentratie van 15 μg/l aangegeven voor de inname van water voor de drinkwaterbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de verdere besluitvorming inzake Pallas

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the second tranche of the 80 million euro loan to the Pallas reactor foundation would be paid out, whether private financing and sound operations were required first, and what the consequences of absent private investment would be for the state budget. The minister confirmed the imminent decision, said private financing is only expected after the first phase ends around 2018/2019, admitted the state bears the risk if no private investment follows, and promised to inform parliament of major decisions.
Naturally, I will inform your House in the interim on important decisions.
Vanzelfsprekend zal ik uw Kamer bij belangrijke besluiten tussentijds informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het ligplaatsenbeleid van de Rijksbinnenhaven in IJmuiden

An SP MP asked the minister about complaints from inland shipping skippers over mooring policy in the Rijksbinnenhaven at IJmuiden, safe run-off berths, forced empty sailing after maximum mooring times, and planned measures. The minister said there is no reduction in official berths, that the eviction of two vessel owners aims at efficient port use, that she will investigate extra run-off facilities and possible bottlenecks, but that providing long-term berths is not the state's responsibility.
I will investigate whether it is possible to make better use of the existing mooring places by installing extra run-off facilities.
Ik ga onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om door het aanbrengen van extra afloopvoorzieningen de bestaande ligplaatsen beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat Nederland meer CO2 uitstoot dan vorig jaar in dezelfde periode

The MP Smaling asked the government about reports that Dutch CO2 emissions were higher than a year earlier, how this fits the 25% reduction target for 2020, and whether firmer agreements would be made. The state secretary answered that cold weather and coal use caused the rise, that the EU obligations will still be met, that additional measures are needed beyond 18-21% for 2025, and that the government will send its position on the IBO CO2 study in the first half of 2016.

The IBO CO2 is expected to be completed at the end of 2015. The cabinet will send you its position on the outcomes of the IBO in the first half of 2016 and will also indicate which follow-up steps will be taken.

Het IBO CO 2 wordt naar verwachting eind 2015 afgerond. Het kabinet zal u in de eerste helft van 2016 zijn standpunt toesturen over de uitkomsten van het IBO en daarbij tevens aangeven welke vervolgstappen zullen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat het slecht gaat met weidevogels als grutto’s, scholeksters en veldleeuweriken

MP Smaling (SP) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the decline of meadow birds, their causes, and the government's plans to reverse it. The State Secretary answered that a new agri-environment scheme from 2016 and talks with provinces are the main response, and committed to inform parliament on the outcomes of the discussions and on the neonicotinoid reassessment.
I will inform your House of the outcomes thereof.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten daarvan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het doden van wilde dieren door trofeejagers

An SP MP asked the ministers about trophy hunting of protected wildlife such as the lion Cecil, the share of hunting revenue reaching local communities, enforcement against illegal trophy trade and online wildlife sales. The government said hunting can be permitted under conditions, that it lacks data on local benefit shares, promised an exploration of limiting trophy imports in October 2015, and described NVWA/Douane enforcement and ongoing talks with Marktplaats.

The State Secretary for Economic Affairs will send the House in October 2015, as promised in the committee debate on nature policy and biodiversity of 28 May, an exploration of options to further reduce or prohibit the import of hunting trophies.

De Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken zal in oktober 2015, zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuurbeleid en Biodiversiteit van 28 mei jl., een verkenning naar de Kamer sturen van de mogelijkheden om de invoer van jachttrofeeën verder te verminderen of te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Consumentenbond boos over ‘dubbele’ energierekening’ op de NOS nieuwssite

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs Minister about energy supplier NLE switching customers to payment in advance, causing a one-off double bill, and about losing a welcome bonus when cancelling. The minister acknowledged the one-off double charge, said payment plans are available, referred the complaints about information to the regulator ACM, and saw no need for further action on debt.
I have forwarded the complaints about the information provided on the forfeiture of the welcome bonus to ACM.
De klachten over de informatievoorziening ten aanzien van het vervallen van de welkomstbonus heb ik doorgegeven aan ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de eindberging van kernafval

An SP MP asked why the government requested an extension for its national nuclear waste disposal programme, how public consultation will be ensured, how the disposal fund will cover costs, and whether postponing a final solution to later generations is acceptable. The minister explained delays from supporting studies, promised public consultation this autumn and a Tweede Kamer submission, and defended interim surface storage with a final decision around 2100.
The draft programme will be made available for public inspection this autumn for citizens to comment on.
Het ontwerp programma wordt dit najaar ter inzage gelegd voor burgers voor inspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het incident bij Urenco

An SP MP asked the minister about a radioactive contamination incident at Urenco, including exposure of workers, aftercare, how Urenco concluded there was no threat, who is responsible for such incidents, and whether independent parties are involved. The minister answered that no workers were exposed beyond regular work, that environmental measurements found no threat, that the license holder bears responsibility under ANVS supervision, and that the ANVS, an independent inspectorate, and RIVM are involved.
Is it correct that no third parties are involved in the further investigation, such as an independent inspectorate?
Klopt het dat er bij het verdere onderzoek geen derden worden betrokken, zoals een onafhankelijke inspectie?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de uitzending van VPRO Zomergasten van 16 augustus 2015

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a VPRO television programme criticising the visual quality of the Dutch landscape, roadside 'viewing locations', and the influence of short-term market interests on public space. The minister largely rejected the criticism, saying there is no 'wildgroei', pointing to existing instruments such as the ladder for sustainable urbanisation, the College van Rijksadviseurs, and a forthcoming National Environmental Vision, while declining to take specific action on individual projects.
No, I do not think there is any question of 'wildgrowth'.
Nee, ik vind niet dat er sprake is van «wildgroei».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Leijten over gegijzelde patiënten in Kenia

MPs Smaling and Leijten asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of patient hostage-taking, moonlighting staff and resale of equipment in Kenyan hospitals, and about the scope of Dutch aid and corruption risks. The minister acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, described existing zero-tolerance rules and risk assessments (including for the ORIO hospital project), and promised to check the adequacy of risk analysis and to press partner embassies to stay alert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Merkies, Smaling en Van Bommel over het bericht “Afspraken VN-top stellen arme landen teleur”

MPs from the SP asked why no international tax body was created to combat tax avoidance, how much developing countries lose to profit shifting, and what the UN Addis Ababa conference means for aid and Dutch policy. The minister answered that BEPS and a compromise on the UN tax committee are the main routes, that loss estimates are unreliable, and that the outcome supports the SDGs without new pledges.
Owing to the lack of unambiguous data, it is currently impracticable to give a ratio between total development aid and the taxes developing countries lose through tax avoidance by multinationals.

Bij gebrek aan eenduidige gegevens is het thans ondoenlijk om een verhouding aan te geven tussen de totale ontwikkelingshulp en de belastingen die ontwikkelingslanden mislopen als gevolg van belastingontwijking door multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het artikel ‘Worden we de melkvee-industrie ingerommeld’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the proposed phosphate rights system for dairy farming harms grounded farms, whether it risks turning dairy into industrial production, and whether a quick scan, a rule change, an enquiry into the KringloopWijzer, a legal liability route, and reporting on grounded production should follow. The State Secretary answers that details are still being worked out with sector organisations, that no outcome for specific farm types can yet be stated, that the dairy sector remains largely grounded, that a quick scan would not change the conclusion, and that she will inform parliament once the system is clearer.
I will inform your House as soon as more clarity exists on how the phosphate rights system will be filled in.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren zodra er meer duidelijkheid bestaat over de wijze waarop invulling gegeven wordt aan het stelsel van fosfaatrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat toekenning van DLO-gelden via de topsectoren een hoog ons-kent-ons-gehalte heeft

SP MPs Smaling and Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether allocation of DLO research funds via the top sectors shows an 'old boys network' bias, questioning transparency, SME access and the balance of research topics. Minister Kamp answers that the calls are open and transparent with predefined criteria, that government is substantively involved in the top sector agendas, that multiple roles held by individuals are disclosed, and that conflict-of-interest and complaint procedures apply.
The assessment of the proposals proceeds transparently.
De beoordeling van de voorstellen verloopt transparant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de praktijk van 'landjepik in Europa'

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about large-scale farmland acquisition by foreign investors in Europe, its effects on local populations, food security, land prices, EU subsidies, and whether EU or national rules can restrict it. The government answered that local populations are not generally harmed, the TNI report's effects are insufficiently substantiated, existing EU rules allow only non-discriminatory and proportionate restrictions, and it sees no reason to raise the issue at EU level.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise this at European level.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit op Europees niveau aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over externe veiligheid in Zuid-Nederland

An MP asked about safety at the Shell Moerdijk plant, the hazard-control record of the Moerdijk site, rail transport of dangerous goods in West-Brabant and the naphtha tank incident in Geleen. The state secretary promised to inform parliament before the hearing on the Shell investigations, gave inspection and incident data, and said the rail risks remain within legal limits while acknowledging local concern and committing to more transparent information.
I will inform you more fully about the investigations into the Shell Moerdijk incident before the External Safety committee hearing of 30 September 2015.
Ik zal u vóór het AO Externe Veiligheid van 30 september 2015 nader informeren over de onderzoeken naar het incident bij Shell Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het spoorproject in Delft

An SP MP asks whether the government's refusal of interest-free deferral of 32 million euro and waiver of 5 million euro in extra costs on the Delft rail tunnel pushes the municipality toward an article 12 financial-emergency status, and asks about the government's role in the housing development and response to the 'Grond, geld en gemeenten' report. The Staatssecretaris replies that the refusal is not IenM's to assess, that the state has already contributed 552 million euro, that the municipality's 5 million euro obligation stands, and that the grondbeleid recommendations will be addressed in a forthcoming policy letter and BBV revision.
The municipality's desired interest-free deferral of payment and partial waiver of contributions owed to the rail tunnel project are not possible.
Het door de gemeente gewenste renteloze uitstel van betaling en gedeeltelijke kwijtschelding van door de gemeente verschuldigde bijdragen aan het spoortunnelproject zijn niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Merkies over de mogelijke verkoop van QBuzz door de Nederlandse Spoorwegen

MPs Smaling and Merkies asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the NS plan to sell bus company Qbuzz, its reasons, effects on staff and the HTM joint venture, and whether a Dutch bus firm should go to a foreign state company. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that NS's strategic reorientation must finish first, so no comment on the sale is possible yet, while information is exchanged and the government will send an analysis this autumn.
I consider it important that this reorientation is first completed before decisions are taken.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat deze heroriëntatie eerst wordt afgerond alvorens er besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Smaling over de enquête onder architecten en de toepassing van de Europese regels bij aanbestedingen

An SP MP asks about a survey of architects who say EU procurement rules disadvantage them: unpaid design phases, strict reference requirements and unexplained decisions. The Minister of Economic Affairs replies that the 2012 Procurement Act's proportionality measures are working but need better application, that unpaid preliminary designs are contrary to the Gids proportionality guidance unless justified, and that a bill to be sent to parliament in autumn will allow longer reference periods.
As announced in the letter, I am focusing on promoting better procurement.
Zoals aangekondigd in de brief zet ik in op het stimuleren van beter aanbesteden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Smaling over het beter aanbesteden van architectuuropdrachten

An MP asks whether selection criteria in architecture tenders should be monitored independently, whether the Proportionality Guide can be evaluated, whether tenders can be made fully public, and whether structural funding for the Architectuur Lokaal/PIANOo advisory support should be restored. The minister declines independent monitoring and binding sanctions, notes the Commission of Tender Experts is non-binding by design, refuses to publish submitted bids, and routes the funding question to PIANOo.
Publishing submitted tenders is not permitted under Article 2.57 of the Public Procurement Act 2012 and is undesirable from a competition-law standpoint.
Het openbaar maken van ingediende offertes mag op grond van artikel 2.57 van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 niet en is vanuit mededingingsrechtelijk oogpunt onwenselijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving inzake de certificering van Maleisisch hout

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about media reports questioning whether Malaysian timber certification (MTCS) meets Dutch procurement standards, the reliability of NGO motives, and an EU complaint against FSC-only municipal policies. The government replied that MTCS improvements are visible, that TPAC will be asked for a final check, and that the complaint concerns exclusion of other certification schemes rather than FSC purchasing itself.
To establish whether the previously identified points at MTCS have been resolved, the Timber Procurement Assessment Committee (TPAC) is being asked to carry out a final check.
Om vast te kunnen stellen of de eerder geïdentificeerde punten bij MTCS zijn opgelost wordt de Toetsingcommissie Inkoop Hout (TPAC) gevraagd een laatste check te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de drinkwaterinname uit de Maas is stopgezet

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that chemical substances from the Chemelot industrial site entered the Maas in July 2015, halting drinking water intake, and about overlapping responsibilities between national, provincial and water board authorities. The minister answered that responsibilities are clearly allocated, that cooperation led to an adequate approach, that a new incident approach was agreed with drinking water companies, and that no increase in incidents at Chemelot was found.
Together with the drinking water companies I have been working on drawing up an approach to respond more quickly to such incidents involving new substances.
Samen met de drinkwaterbedrijven ben ik bezig geweest een aanpak op te stellen waarmee sneller op dergelijke incidenten rond nieuwe stoffen kan worden ingespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de Nederlandse geluidsnormen voor windturbines die slechter zijn dan die van de buurlanden

An SP MP asked the government whether Dutch noise standards for wind turbines are weaker than those in neighbouring countries, whether residents have appeal rights, and whether averaging allows peaks to be offset. The state secretary rejected the claim that Dutch rules are the most flexible, pointed to available appeal routes and maatwerk, and said no revision of the norms is planned.
The noise standards that onshore wind turbines must meet are set out in section 3.2.3 of the Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer.
De geluidsnormen waaraan windturbines op land moeten voldoen, zijn opgenomen in paragraaf 3.2.3 van het Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Smaling over het gebrekkige toezicht en de handhavingsaanpak bij zwanendriften

MPs Thieme and Smaling asked whether police and NVWA enforcement against swan-harassment is inadequate, whether the NVWA emergency line works, and whether a ban is needed. The minister rejects claims of inadequate enforcement, says NVWA and police coordinate well, and promises to investigate a legal ban by autumn.
There is no question of deficient enforcement.
Er is geen sprake van een gebrekkige handhavingsaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat sporters en scholieren zijn blootgesteld aan gifgrond

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that athletes and pupils were exposed to contaminated soil at a former dump in Ouderkerk, and why earlier 2008 reports and the GGD advice did not prevent use of the site. The State Secretary answered that the province and municipality are the competent authorities, that no risks existed for the passive use at the time, that the municipality has commissioned additional research and will publish its results, and that the responsibility allocation is set in law.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake het bericht dat er asbest is vrijgekomen bij brand in een schoolgebouw

An SP MP asked the state secretary about asbestos released by a school fire in Rijswijk, the GGD's reassurance, and whether mandatory asbestos inventories and faster asbestos removal are needed. The state secretary answered that air measurements found no asbestos fibres, that the municipality handled the clean-up, that asbestos inventories are already required before renovation or demolition, and that risk-based policy is maintained without a mandatory school inventory.
An inventory obligation already applies when renovation or demolition is planned.
Er geldt reeds een inventarisatieplicht bij het voornemen tot verbouwen of sloop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de alarmerende staat van de Duitse dijken net over de grens

An SP MP asked the minister about the poor condition of German dikes near the Dutch border and the risk of flooding in the Netherlands, including the flood-probability gap, cooperation with Germany and investment in the Bislicher Insel retention area. The minister replied that the German dikes are being reinforced, that a joint Dutch-German study will assess cross-border flood risk, and that cooperation is positive, but gave no commitment to new action beyond that study.

Together with North Rhine-Westphalia, the Netherlands has this year started a study aimed at gaining insight into current and future flood risk on both sides of the border, based on the new Dutch methodology and new insights into flood probabilities and consequences.

Samen met Nordrhein-Westfalen is Nederland dit jaar een studie gestart met als doel op basis van de nieuwe Nederlandse methodiek en nieuwe inzichten over kansen en gevolgen van overstromingen inzicht te krijgen in het huidige en toekomstige overstromingsrisico aan beide zijden van de grens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het energielabel van woningen dat volgens makelaars niet werkt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that the new home energy label is not working, including sector complaints, low uptake of Nationaal Energiebespaarfonds loans, and problems with DigiD and letter delivery. The minister rejects the critique, cites industry sources and uptake figures, and says he will keep monitoring the system and fix remaining problems.
Of course I am monitoring where the system can still be improved.
Uiteraard monitor ik waar het systeem nog kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over de gebrekkige informatie bij het vervoeren van gevaarlijke stoffen over het spoor

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked the state secretary about inadequate information on hazardous-substance rail transport, including the ILT's findings, a GPS track-and-trace proposal, emergency capacity on the Brabant route and the VeZA curve. The state secretary said the IGS information system has improved information, the ILT enforces registration duties, a 2.0 IGS and possibly GPS tracking are under study, no extra emergency capacity is currently needed, and the VeZA curve will not be reconsidered.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht van Energieonderzoekscentrum Nederland (ECN) dat de zware industrie nu het energiegebruik moet aanpakken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether heavy industry will fail to contribute to the energy transition if competitiveness remains the leading concern, and whether targeted incentives or feed-in tariffs should be used. The minister replied that energy efficiency benefits competitiveness, pointed to the Energy Agreement and bilateral agreements with industry, and said a decision on new instruments would wait for the 2016 evaluation of the Energy Agreement.
Should the evaluation show that energy-intensive industry is not on track to meet the Energy Agreement's targets, I will consult the parties to the Energy Agreement on how to resolve this.

Mocht uit de evaluatie blijken dat de energie-intensieve industrie niet op schema ligt om de doelstellingen van het Energieakkoord te halen, dan zal ik overleggen met de aangesloten partijen bij het Energieakkoord hoe dit op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over de controle op illegaal hout

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement against illegal timber under the EU Timber Regulation, including staffing, inspection numbers, the use of warnings rather than fines, and due diligence. The State Secretary answered that 3 FTE are deployed, 101 inspections and 29 written warnings have been issued, that enforcement is warning-first and has been effective, and that the NVWA follows EU-coordinated practice on due diligence and document verification.
The NVWA has 3 FTE available for combating illegal timber and this appears sufficient given the required deployment.
De NVWA heeft 3 fte beschikbaar voor het bestrijden van illegaal hout en dit blijkt gezien de benodigde inzet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over mogelijke gasboringen bij Woudsend

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he knew of the province of Friesland's opposition to new gas drilling, whether the Woudsend drilling was necessary, and how he would handle the case once municipalities gain more influence under the Mining Act. The minister answered that the province's stance does not affect national legal powers, that the drilling fits the small-fields policy subject to legal requirements, that the project is not yet in an approval procedure, and that the ministry already acts in line with the planned reform.
The province's position leaves the legal provisions, tasks and powers of both the national government and the province unaffected.
De stellingname van de provincie laat de wettelijke bepalingen, taken en bevoegdheden van zowel het Rijk als de provincie onverlet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het Convenant Bodem en Ondergrond

An MP asked the state secretary about soil contamination remaining after the priority-site cleanup under the soil covenant, including whether groundwater and drinking water sources are adequately protected and whether the drinking water sector should be involved. The state secretary answered that remaining sites are inventoried through area dossiers and cleanup is the responsibility of competent authorities, while largely referring to existing instruments and future Omgevingswet arrangements without committing to new concrete steps.
The figure of 200,000 is a rough estimate of locations where substance concentrations may exceed the background value.
Het aantal van 200.000 is een grove inschatting van locaties waar de concentratie van stoffen boven de achtergrondwaarde kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake de asbestbrand in Wateringen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether, given residents' lasting worry about the asbestos fire clean-up in Wateringen and differing insurance cover, he would use his influence on the province and municipality to ensure a thorough collective clean-up before summer. The State Secretary replied that the province has been told in writing that trust must be restored, and that the province has started an inter-governmental supervision inquiry that is still at the information-gathering stage and will be concluded as quickly as possible, with possible follow-up steps.
The province will conclude the inquiry as quickly as possible and then take any necessary follow-up steps.
De provincie zal het onderzoek zo snel mogelijk afronden en dan eventueel nodige vervolgstappen ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over sponsoring van de klimaattop Parijs door fossiele bedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers whether sponsorship of the Paris climate summit by fossil fuel firms (EDF, Engie, Air France) undermines its credibility and whether they would demand a verifiable sustainability step from these companies. The state secretary answered that involving business strengthens the summit, that sponsorship fits UNFCCC guidelines, and that companies must contribute to the EU 40% CO2 reduction target by 2030.
The cabinet does not believe that the financial contribution of these companies to the Paris climate summit undermines its credibility.
Het kabinet vindt niet dat het leveren van een financiële bijdrage van genoemde bedrijven aan de klimaattop in Parijs de geloofwaardigheid ondergraaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over meer doden door aardverschuivingen in Nepal

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they knew of further deaths from landslides in Nepal, the risk of dammed rivers and flash floods for the Terai, and whether Dutch integrated water management expertise and preventive disaster risk reduction could be deployed there. The minister answered that Dutch involvement is focused on humanitarian aid, that prevention is mainly Nepal's responsibility with Dutch expertise available on request, and that the government has no plans for a specific programme for mountainous earthquake regions.
Nepal is therefore not among the countries with which cooperation on integrated water management takes place.
Nepal behoort daarom niet tot landen waarmee op het onderwerp integraal waterbeheer wordt samengewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de stijging van rioolbelasting door klimaatverandering

An SP MP asks the minister whether rising sewer charges caused by more intense rainfall from climate change are a problem, and whether municipalities and water boards lack funds. The minister acknowledges the link to climate change, rejects the claim of insufficient funds, says rising sewer charges are unavoidable but a local matter, and points to existing cost-saving agreements and adaptation programmes.
I therefore assume that municipalities will keep a close eye on this themselves.
Ik ga er daarom vanuit dat gemeenten dit zelf goed in het oog zullen houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de onduidelijkheid van cijfers bij inzameling en verwerking van PET-flessen en Plastic Heroes

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Environment about conflicting figures on PET bottle collection, sorting, recyclate content and processing losses under the Plastic Heroes and deposit systems, and about whether bottlers meet the 25% recyclate norm. The State Secretary answered most questions by saying the data is unavailable, that the ILT only audited steps up to the recycler's weighbridge, or that the market is international, while confirming volumes, the 90/10 quality standard, and that the 2014 recyclate share was above the norm.
No research has been conducted into this stream. For that reason this information is not available.
Naar deze stroom is geen onderzoek gedaan. Om die reden is deze informatie niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat een falende directeur van een waterschap bijna een miljoen euro heeft meegekregen

An SP MP asked ministers about a Hefpunt water-board tax-collection director receiving a severance package of about EUR 950,000 despite WNT pay-cap rules, including prior suspension, the timing of informing the water board, the legality of in-house unemployment benefits, and possible reclaim. The minister answered that the severance (EUR 905,000 provision) is under WNT investigation, that the WNT was reported as not exceeded, that nullity and reclaim are possible if non-compliant, and that no separate policy for water boards will be pursued.
I am currently having it examined whether all these components, assessed under the WNT, were rightly and on the correct basis granted, and will inform you once this examination is completed.
Ik laat momenteel nader onderzoeken of al deze componenten – beoordeeld in het kader van de WNT – terecht en op de juiste grondslag zijn toegekend en zal u informeren zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over het bericht ‘TTIP tast gezondheid EU aan’

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether TTIP would lower import tariffs on unhealthy US products, raising health costs and inequality, and whether the government's red lines on food safety hold. The minister replied that EU food safety standards remain fully in force, that tariffs are not linked to healthiness, that no list of affected products exists, and that the WRR food policy report is answered separately.
Such a list does not exist and is also not necessary.
Een dergelijk lijst is er niet en is ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat drugsafval het riool overspoelt

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Environment ministers about drug waste dumped into sewers and on land, including incident counts, lab takedowns, enforcement capacity, prevention, BOA safety and who pays the cleanup costs. The government answered that no national dumping figures are kept, cited 24 lab takedowns and doubled LFO capacity, said the polluter should bear costs, and pointed to a one-million-euro amendment-funded contribution and a Brabant cleanup protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de financiële strop van 5 miljoen euro voor het Rotterdamse Warmtebedrijf

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a reported 5 million euro financial squeeze on Warmtebedrijf Rotterdam from paying full price for residual heat from AVR, and about risks from single-source supply, coal plants and waste reduction. The minister answered that a court summary ruling was complied with, the parties are negotiating, and that heat sourcing is left to regional parties, with the energy route to be set out later.
It is up to the local and regional parties to work this out.
Het is aan de lokale en regionale partijen om dit uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij subsidieverstrekking voor zonnepanelen naar aanleiding van het artikel “Te oud voor subsidie” in de Telegraaf

An SP MP asked whether the age limit of 75 for the SVn Duurzaamheidslening (a consumer loan for solar panels) amounts to age discrimination against over-75s. The minister replied that SVn offers loans, not subsidies, that the age limit is a creditworthiness criterion for SVn to decide, and that he will take no action and does not consider it discrimination.
In my view there is no age discrimination, since a lender may apply criteria when granting a loan to be sure of repayment.

Naar mijn mening is er geen sprake van leeftijdsdiscriminatie aangezien een geldverstrekker bij het afgeven van een lening criteria kan hanteren om zekerheid te houden over de terugbetaling van leningen aan de geldverstrekker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling naar aanleiding van een artikel in NRC Handelsblad over de uitkomsten van een IMF-rapport inzake wereldwijde subsidies voor fossiele energie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about IMF figures on global fossil fuel subsidies, whether Dutch fossil energy is subsidised including tax advantages, whether the minister supports IMF calls for higher fossil fuel taxes, and whether a Green GDP should be introduced. The minister answered that most of the IMF amount reflects unpriced externalities, that fossil fuels are not subsidised in the Netherlands though some excise exemptions stem from international treaties, that he agrees with removing artificial pump prices in developing countries but sees no reason for a specific Dutch fossil tax, and that no Green GDP will be pursued due to lack of international consensus on measuring environmental damage.
Fossil fuels are not subsidised in the Netherlands, including through fiscal measures.
Fossiele brandstoffen worden in Nederland niet gesubsidieerd, ook niet via fiscale maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling naar aanleiding van een artikel in De Volkskrant van 6 mei jl. onder de titel “Energierekening dit jaar 200 euro lager”

MP Smaling asked whether household energy bills fall by about 200 euro this year due to lower oil prices and European grid integration, and whether fossil energy will stay cheaper than renewables. The minister confirmed the drop is mainly driven by lower crude oil and fuel prices, explained gas and electricity price drivers, and said renewable subsidies via SDE+ bridge the gap while expected future price trends remain uncertain.
As indicated in the newspaper article, the decline in the average energy bill is mainly caused by the sharply fallen prices of crude oil.
Zoals in het krantenartikel is aangegeven, wordt de daling van de gemiddelde energierekening vooral veroorzaakt door de scherp gedaalde prijzen voor ruwe olie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over bericht Miljoenen mensen ontheemd door projecten Wereldbank

An SP MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about press reports that millions were displaced by World Bank-financed projects, including whether rules were broken, compensation, monitoring and the revised safeguards. The minister denies the 3.4 million figure, says land acquisition and resettlement are not in themselves rule violations, admits some monitoring gaps, and promises to raise concerns with the Bank and report after meetings.
The bank's policy is that all affected persons are compensated.
Het beleid van de bank is dat alle betrokkenen worden gecompenseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het miljoenenverlies bij het Afval Energie Bedrijf in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary about EUR 89 million in losses at Afval Energie Bedrijf Amsterdam, whether these were foreseeable before its privatisation, and about the balance between waste supply, incineration capacity, imports and energy use. The state secretary largely answered on waste-market policy, said the municipality's reasons and the loss question fall outside his remit, and affirmed that continued import of foreign waste is acceptable.
It is further not for me to explain the reasons that played a role at the municipal government, nor to pass judgment on whether the losses could have been prevented.

Het is verder niet aan mij om een toelichting te geven op de redenen die bij het gemeentebestuur speelden, noch om een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of de verliezen voorkomen hadden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het aardbevingengebied

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake damage claims in Groningen falling outside NAM's contour map, NAM's self-assessment of claims, reinforcement of homes and dikes, confidentiality in settlements, and related housing market and compensation issues. The Minister defends the contour-based approach, says NAM will now send experts to all claims and expand monitoring, and states that the Tcbb and a national coordinator will handle disputes and reinforcement.
Naturally, consultation has taken place on this with the province and municipalities.
Vanzelfsprekend heeft hierover afstemming plaatsgevonden met de provincie en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake de impasse bij de asbestcalamiteit in Wateringen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary to respond to residents' claims that Wateringen remains contaminated with visible asbestos despite the municipality declaring the neighbourhood asbestos-free, and to treat the case as an example of municipal supervision. The State Secretary answers that an independent lab found no loose asbestos, that residents should contact the municipality, and that supervision of municipalities lies with the provinces, so he will not assess the municipality's conduct.
No, interadministrative supervision of municipalities is vested in the provinces.
Nee, het interbestuurlijk toezicht op gemeenten is neergelegd bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over subsidiering van biomassa bijstook

Four MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidising biomass co-firing (including 15% cheaper residual streams such as animal meal) risks over-subsidisation, and questioned the basis of the SDE+ base amounts and the withheld ECN/DNV GL reports. The minister answered that the NGO agreement does not fix the SDE+ rate, that the price effect is within calculation margins, and that the preliminary ECN note will not be published though the final version was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over verantwoordelijkheid bij bodemonderzoek door de overheid

An SP MP asked the Minister whether the province of Noord-Holland and municipality Stede Broec were negligent in delaying soil investigation and informing residents about groundwater contamination in Bovenkarspel, and who is liable for resulting damage. The state secretary replied that the national government has no competence under the Soil Protection Act in this case, cannot judge civil liability, and offered financing of investigation and remediation as a goodwill gesture while the province committed to remediation.
Under the Soil Protection Act the national government is not competent with regard to this specific case.
Op grond van de Wet bodembescherming is het Rijk niet bevoegd met betrekking tot deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanwezigheid van asbestdeeltjes in de openbare ruimte

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the asbestos clean-up after the Wateringen fire was properly handled, who is responsible for residual asbestos, and whether the municipality acted lawfully and can recover costs. The State Secretary answered that a post-clean-up check found no loose asbestos, that the municipality acted correctly, and that cost recovery from the property owner is still being pursued without final cost figures.
That conclusion indicates that the municipality of Westland has acted correctly under the statutory rules.
Die conclusie geeft aan dat de gemeente Westland correct is omgegaan met de wettelijke regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over het niet naleven van de meldplicht voor incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Inspectorate (ILT) fails to enforce the duty to report hazardous-substance incidents, whether reporting is too cumbersome, whether carriers are unaware of the duty, whether human error incidents rose, and whether hazard markings should be required for mixed small-package transports. The state secretary denied under-enforcement (eight enforcement actions in 2014, seven reports to prosecutors), described the single reporting desk and outreach, and rejected new marking rules as already covered by international rules.
No, this is not correct. All incidents involving hazardous substances must be reported immediately to the ILT.
Nee, dit is niet juist. Alle incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen moeten direct worden gemeld bij de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het verbod op asbestdaken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the planned ban on asbestos roofs, enforcement structures, soil contamination costs and funding, and asbestos in earthquake-damaged Groningen homes. The State Secretary defended the 2024 ban and funding approach, said enforcement is being strengthened through pilots and shared tools, and said the soil contamination question awaits provincial reports.
For this I am awaiting the letter from the provinces that will explain these research reports.
Hiervoor wacht ik de brief van provincies af waarin duiding wordt gegeven aan deze onderzoeksrapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Bashir en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

MPs of the SP asked the government about reports that it squeezes the construction sector, including cost overruns on A15 and A2 projects, the risks of a Ballast Nedam bankruptcy, and whether lowest-price awarding and design-build-finance-maintain contracts cause sector losses. The minister answered that cost overrun figures are confidential, that Rijkswaterstaat compensates responsibly-caused extra costs, that EMVI (best value) is the main award criterion, and that the Aanbestedingswet evaluation will be sent to parliament by summer.
Financial information from contractors, insofar as I have it, I cannot make public.
Financiële informatie van opdrachtnemers, voor zover ik hierover beschik, kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over onduidelijkheden in vergunningaanvragen en het Besluit omgevingsrecht bij onderhoud

An MP asked whether routine maintenance and certain alterations to buildings (roof covering, window frames, render) can proceed without an environmental permit, and whether permit-free changes should be limited to parts not facing public space. The minister answered that maintenance must keep detailing, profiling and appearance unchanged, that building plans and repressive welfare supervision still apply to permit-free changes, and that no further restriction is needed.
Such a restriction is not necessary in my view.
Een dergelijke inperking is naar mijn oordeel niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over energievergelijkingssites

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether energy comparison sites mislead customers seeking green electricity, whether intermediary fees undermine their independence, and whether GvO certificates allow coal power to be sold as green. The minister replied that the ACM as regulator judges misleading practices, that comparison sites may choose their own revenue models, that GvO trade does not remove the incentive for domestic renewable production, and that declined to start a new investigation itself.
It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) as supervisor to assess whether in this specific case there is misleading conduct contrary to legal provisions.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) als toezichthouder om te beoordelen of in dit specifieke geval sprake is van misleiding die in strijd is met wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over mogelijke oversubsidiëring van biomassa bijstook

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the SDE+ subsidy for co-firing biomass in coal plants could over-subsidise plants that use up to 15% low-cost alternative fuels such as animal meal and pits. The minister answered that the ECN/DNV GL note shows effects within uncertainty margins, that no specific scenario was calculated for animal meal, and that the cumulative subsidy is about 3 billion euro, while not committing to notifying the 15% rule separately to the European Commission.
On the basis of the note, I therefore conclude that the use of 15% alternative fuels does not lead to over-subsidisation.
Op basis van de notitie concludeer ik dan ook dat het gebruik van 15% alternatieve brandstoffen niet leidt tot oversubsidiëring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over berichtgeving omtrent het schandaal bij AquaPurga in Den Bosch

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, health risks, subsidies, and liability at manure processor AquaPurga following press reports. The government answered that it cannot disclose individual inspection or bankruptcy information, found no known health risks to residents, and stated that liability for workplace health damage lies between employer and employee, with courts deciding if they disagree.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make the results of an inspection at an individual company public.
Inspectie SZW maakt de resultaten van een inspectie bij een individueel bedrijf niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Leegte over de strijd tegen ivoorhandel

MPs Smaling and Leegte asked the government about China's temporary ivory ban, NGO claims of window dressing, poaching trends, and how to combat wildlife crime. The state secretary welcomed China's steps, outlined poaching trends, and described the planned use of funds and CITES follow-up without committing to new oversight mechanisms.
I see the measure, a temporary ban on the ivory trade, as a recognition by China that destination countries also bear a great responsibility for combating wildlife crime.
Ik zie de maatregel, een tijdelijk verbod op de handel in ivoor, als een erkenning van China dat ook destinatielanden een grote verantwoordelijkheid hebben om wildlife crime tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over diverse plannen voor Factory Outlet Centres in Zevenaar

An SP MP asks the minister about competing factory outlet centre plans in Zevenaar, the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, a new A12 slip road, and regional retail planning. The minister answers that the BAT-site decision lies with the municipality, that a joint province-municipality fact-finding study was completed, and that talks on improving the Ladder are ongoing without planned test cases.
The responsibility for deciding whether to allow a Factory Outlet Centre (FOC) in Zevenaar lies with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het nemen van een besluit over het al dan niet toestaan van een Factory Outlet Centre (FOC) in Zevenaar ligt bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Aanhoudingen na dumpen afvalstoffen in brandstof’

An SP member asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about arrests after illegal mixing of hazardous waste into heating oil, whether this reflects structural enforcement, how long the practice persisted, and which company is involved. The Minister answered that a criminal investigation led to arrests of four managers of a West-Brabant waste firm, that the company name and details cannot be disclosed for investigative reasons, and that a blacklist of substances for heating oil and a related motion are being implemented.
I cannot make any statements about the name of the suspected company.
Over de naam van het verdachte bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de website ruimtelijkeplannen.nl

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about outdated address data (ACN from 2011) used on ruimtelijkeplannen.nl, delays in connecting to the BAG, how residents can find new plans, whether objection rights were missed, the tax service's indirect use of BAG data, system readiness for the Omgevingswet, and digitalisation of permitting. The minister acknowledged the ACN is outdated, promised BAG connection via PDOK in 2015, and largely deferred other matters to responsible bodies or future digital plans.
I expect to be able to realise the connection of Ruimtelijkeplannen.nl to the BAG via the connection to the national PDOK facility in 2015.
Het aansluiten van Ruimtelijkeplannen.nl op de BAG via de aansluiting op de Landelijke Voorziening Publieke Dienstverlening Op de Kaart (PDOK) voorzie ik in 2015 te kunnen realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het verkopen van statiegeldloze flessen van Coca Cola door de supermarkt Gekke Gerrit

An MP asked the state secretary about a discount shop selling Polish cola in non-deposit PET bottles, undermining the deposit system, and how compliance by non-members of the Afvalfonds is checked. The state secretary confirmed the concern, explained the StAV surcharge of EUR 0.25 per bottle for non-members above 50 tonnes, said enforcement of the old rules was via the Economische Controledienst, and declined to make deposit mandatory, pointing to the existing framework agreement.
I do not have exact figures on the quantities that fall outside the StAV system as a result.
Ik heb geen exacte cijfers over hoeveelheden die hierdoor buiten het systeem van StAV vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de onrust rond het energielabel

The MP Smaling (SP) asked the minister about confusion over the new home energy label, including a spokesperson's remark about discarding the letter, the number of complaints and helpdesk contacts, the number of incorrect labels, and a step-by-step plan for reliability by end 2015. The minister answered only by referring to a separate letter to the House (Kamerstuk 30 196, nr. 295), without addressing the questions in substance.
The written questions from MP Smaling (SP), question number 2015Z01575, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to implementation of energy label for homes'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Smaling (SP), vraagnummer 2015Z01575 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op uitvoering energielabel voor woningen»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over de brand in Roermond van 16 december, waarbij asbest is vrijgekomen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked the state secretary about the Roermond fire that released asbestos, including responders' protective equipment, the lack of a dedicated asbestos disaster plan, and whether the Netherlands should systematically become asbestos-free. The state secretary replied that the safety region judged the response adequate, that evaluations are underway, that a 2006 asbestos fire plan is being updated, and that policy stays risk-based with a planned 2024 ban on asbestos roofs.
The plan of approach is currently being updated by the Institute for Physical Safety.
Het plan van aanpak wordt momenteel geactualiseerd door het Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het achteraf regelen van vergunningen voor reeds uitgevoerde projecten door het Waterschap Roer en Overmaas

An MP asked the minister whether the Roer en Overmaas water board routinely granted permits retroactively for its own projects, and what oversight and action would follow. The minister relied on the National Ombudsman's finding that retroactive permits occurred in two cases, were undesirable but not harmful to citizens, and that the water board will now grant overarching permits in advance and has appointed an external integrity contact.
The National Ombudsman's report indicates that it has not been shown that citizens were harmed by the water board's practice or that their legal protection was reduced.
