Het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman geeft aan dat niet is gebleken dat burgers door de werkwijze van het waterschap zijn benadeeld of in hun mogelijkheden van rechtsbescherming zijn gekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het instortingsgevaar van balkons en galerijen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked the minister about collapse risks of balconies and gallery walkways in flats, including the Escamp flat in The Hague, and about owners' payment problems and government guarantees. The minister said building owners and municipalities are responsible, pointed to the 2012 inspection protocol and a new inspection duty instrument, opposed a mandatory APK for buildings, and described loan options for owners' associations.
Responsibility for safety lies with building owners and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de veiligheid ligt bij de gebouweigenaren en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of anti-slavery activists in Mauritania, including their treatment, fair trial prospects and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister replied that the activists remain detained awaiting trial, that Biram Abeid is treated well, that the EU, UN and US press for a fair trial, and that the EU and the Netherlands have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities.
The European Union has expressed its serious concerns about this to the Prime Minister of Mauritania and continues to follow this matter very closely.
De Europese Unie heeft zijn ernstige zorgen hierover uitgesproken bij de Premier van Mauritanië en blijft deze zaak zeer nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht over het negeren van draagvlak voor windmolens op land in de provincie Friesland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Friesland's provincial government would drop small village wind turbines in favour of large projects, whether the 530 MW target should be a maximum, and how the province's wind target and public support were weighed. The minister said wind-permitting responsibilities are shared with the province, that the national RCR process for large projects is under his regime with a 250 MW minimum for Windpark Fryslân, and that support is one factor but the province decides on smaller projects.
The framework for the decision-making is the wind energy on land structural vision (SvWOL) submitted to the States General on 31 March 2014.
Het kader voor de besluitvorming is de op 31 maart 2014 aan de Staten Generaal aangeboden structuurvisie windenergie op land (SvWOL) 2 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Smaling over Vluchtelingensituatie in Turkije

MPs Gesthuizen and Smaling asked the government to respond to Amnesty International's report on Syrian refugees in Turkey, including alleged shootings of refugees at the border and forced returns. The government denied structural forced returns, attributed the incidents to a period before the Kobani surge, and pointed to Dutch humanitarian funding of EUR 30 million and EUR 12 million for 2015 with a resettlement quota of 250 Syrians.
The cabinet does not believe there are structural problems regarding forced return of Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat er sprake is van structurele problemen met betrekking tot gedwongen terugkeer van Syrische vluchtelingen uit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over koolmonoxidevergiftigingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about carbon monoxide poisonings from faulty home heating, and whether installers are qualified, whether installations are checked, whether mandatory inspections and a periodic APK-style check should be introduced. The minister said installer competence is left to industry certification, that owners are responsible under the Woningwet, that building-quality assurance is being tightened from 2016, and that a mandatory inspection for existing homes is too burdensome for now, with a study of the Woningwet duty-of-care article and results promised for spring 2015.
I am awaiting the report of the Dutch Safety Board on carbon monoxide poisonings before determining my position further.
Ik wacht overigens het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid naar koolmonoxidevergiftigingen af
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Smaling en Ouwehand over het bericht dat de EU ervan afziet om teerzandolie te labelen

MPs Jasper van Dijk, Smaling and Ouwehand asked whether the EU's dropping of a separate label for tar sands oil, its impact on climate ambitions, CETA and TTIP, and possible import bans or labelling are acceptable. The State Secretary answered that tar sands oil is still legally importable, that no import ban or consumer labelling is feasible given traceability limits, and that EU climate targets are not weakened.
I have no plans to exclude tar sands oil from the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen plannen om teerzandolie te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst geen btw-voordeel geeft aan bewoners die gezamenlijk zonne-energie willen betrekken

Smaling (SP) asked why cooperative neighbourhood solar projects under the postcoderoos scheme receive no VAT benefit, and whether a VAT advantage will be introduced. Staatssecretaris Wiebes replied that EU-based VAT rules offer no special regime, that such cooperatives are treated as entrepreneurs with input-VAT deduction, and that officials have discussed the matter with sector groups.
The tax authority grants no VAT benefit to projects falling under the so-called postcoderoos scheme.
De belastingdienst kent geen BTW-voordeel toe aan projecten die binnen de zogenaamde «postcoderoos-regeling» vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het tekenen van de deal ‘Stroomversnelling’

Smaling (SP) asked the minister about the signing and financing of the 'Stroomversnelling' energy-renovation deal for owner-occupied homes, including cost figures, targets, evaluation and planned legal changes. The minister answered that the deal is a private initiative of 175 parties, that the Rijk only facilitates it through the Energiesprong programme, and that evaluation and regulatory changes are being pursued, though the answers largely restate programme details and defer to initiators.
The Rijk is not a co-signatory, but facilitates via the Energiesprong innovation programme.
Het Rijk is geen medeondertekenaar, maar faciliteert wel via het innovatieprogramma Energiesprong.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het uitblijven van informatie over de nadere vormgeving van ketenverantwoordelijkheid in de chemische sector

Mr Smaling (SP) asked why the Veiligheid Voorop chemical sector partnership was given more time than agreed to produce a vision on supply-chain responsibility, and asked for a substantive letter before the 2015 budget debate. State Secretary Mansveld answered that primary responsibility lies with industry, that a sector-wide vision is being prepared and will be published soon, and that he will inform the House in the first quarter of 2015.
I will inform you in the first quarter of 2015 about the vision advocated by industry, assuming it has then been completed.
Ik zal u in het eerste kwartaal van 2015 over de door het bedrijfsleven voorgestane visie informeren, er van uitgaande dat deze dan is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Gelderlander dat de gemeente Neder-Betuwe dumping van drugsafval hard gaat aanpakken

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked how many drug waste dumpings occur, how much police and inspection capacity is devoted to them, and who pays for clean-up. The government answered that no national figures exist, that Brabant recorded about 150 dumpings in 2013, and that dedicated police capacity and cost recovery from offenders are being pursued.
As I set out in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, I do not have national figures on drug waste dumpings.
Antwoord 1, 2 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 2 uiteen heb gezet beschik ik niet over landelijke cijfers over dumpingen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mogelijk chloortrein van AkzoNobel door Overijssel vanwege staking Rotterdam’

Two SP MPs asked whether AkzoNobel's planned chlorine train transport through Overijssel, during a strike at its Rotterdam Botlek plant, is permitted under a 2002/2006 convenant and amounts to strike-breaking, and whether the government will intervene or press the employer on labour conditions. The Secretary of State answered that the convenant allows incidental transport to meet contracts, that the strike is a matter between employer and employees for the courts, that there is no legal basis to stop the transport, and that the ministry does not deal with labour relations.
In such cases it is for the court to rule on whether this constitutes strike-breaking.
Het is in voorkomende gevallen aan de rechter om een uitspraak te geven of dit stakingsbreking betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Smaling inzake het wonen op antikraakcontracten

Two SP MPs asked why people on low incomes increasingly live without legal protection under anti-squatting (antikraak) contracts, and what the government will do about asbestos risks, oversight, the Wet Kraken en Leegstand, and tenant protection. The minister answers that he will not impose statutory requirements on antikraak contracts, sees the choice as voluntary, will evaluate the squatting and vacancy law in early 2015, and points to a voluntary keurmerk for vacancy managers.
For that reason I will not develop proposals to impose further statutory requirements on antikraak contracts.
Om die reden zal ik geen voorstellen ontwikkelen om verdere wettelijke eisen te stellen aan antikraakcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over de milieueffectenanalyse van de Raamovereenkomst Verpakkingen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the environmental impact analysis of the packaging framework agreement, supported by the KIDV funded by industry, can be considered independent, given industry ties and the KIDV director's prior role in drafting the agreement. The state secretary replied that he formulated the assignment himself, the KIDV only supports and tenders the research, an advisory group with NGOs will be set up, the board is balanced between industry and government, and he will cover part of the costs.
Following the request by Ms Cegerek during the committee meeting of 18 June, an advisory sounding-board group will also be established.
Naar aanleiding van het verzoek van mevrouw Cegerek tijdens het AO van 18 juni jl. zal er ook een klankbordgroep opgericht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het statiegeldsysteem van Aldi en Lidl

The SP MPs asked whether the Stichting Afvalfonds Verpakkingen may use waste-management levies to compensate supermarket chains Aldi and Lidl for ending their own deposit systems, and whether deposit packaging reduces litter. The state secretary answered that levies are used only for the declared purposes under the AVV, that no compensation is currently in play since no national deposit abolition has been decided, and that the deposit system is one of several litter-reduction instruments.
The board of the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen adopts the budget and ultimately checks the final settlement.
Het bestuur van het Afvalfonds Verpakkingen stelt de begroting vast en controleert uiteindelijk de eindafrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Nog even en de olifant is uitgestorven’

An SP MP asked the government about reports of rapid declines in wildlife populations, poaching and illegal ivory trade, and what Dutch development and enforcement efforts are doing about it. The government answered that it funds about one million euro a year for anti-poaching projects, supports international enforcement cooperation, and raises the issue in CITES, UNEP and EU forums, while noting that most measures are still being prepared.

For the next four years, one million euro per year has been set aside within the Ministry of Economic Affairs budget to finance specific programmes and projects combating poaching and illegal wildlife trade.

Voor de komende vier jaar is binnen de begroting van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, één miljoen euro per jaar vrijgemaakt om specifieke programma's en projecten te financieren in de strijd tegen stroperij en de illegale handel in wilde dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Smaling over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Smaling and Klaver asked whether the government had properly examined using German brine instead of salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether that option was included in the environmental permit and appropriate assessment. The minister answered that German brine is economically unviable due to lower salt concentration, high transport costs and supply risks, so no renewed talks with Frisia are planned, and that the permit cannot be revoked while objection proceedings are pending.
I see no reason to question this conclusion.
Ik zie geen reden om deze conclusie in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht dat Lidl en Aldi afgekocht zijn

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether industry offered Lidl and Aldi compensation to stop collecting PET bottles, whether this lobbying aimed to abolish the deposit system, and whether competition law applies. The state secretary answered that compensation, if any, would come from the packaging industry's own fund (StAV), that the deposit system is not being abolished now, that parliament's review is planned for June 2015, and that competition-law assessment is for the companies themselves.
Making arrangements about offering compensation for possible financial disadvantages that Aldi and Lidl may suffer, I see as a private matter in which the government has no role.

Afspraken maken over het aanbieden van een compensatie voor de mogelijke financiële nadelen die Aldi en Lidl kunnen ondervinden, zie ik als een private aangelegenheid, waar de overheid geen rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Kooiman en Van Gerven over de publicatie ‘Verstand op veilig’

MPs Smaling, Kooiman and Van Gerven asked whether the government shares concerns from a Rathenau Instituut report that marketisation has strained the core tasks of national-security knowledge institutes, and whether it will convene stakeholders, examine horizontal cooperation and review inspectorates' reliance on these institutes. The minister denied that marketisation is a problem, cited existing funding and statutory safeguards, and declined new round-tables, new horizontal structures or a review, saying existing forums suffice.
The cabinet sees no reason in the report to sit down with the institutions concerned and other relevant parties outside existing forums where this already happens.
Het kabinet ziet in het rapport geen aanleiding om met de betrokken instellingen en andere relevante partijen om tafel te zitten buiten verbanden waarin dat al gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat IKEA de Nederlandse wet omzeilt met Slowaakse chauffeurs

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on reports that IKEA circumvents Dutch law using Slovak drivers, and whether the inspectorate will check the Slovak carrier's operations. The minister says the inspectorate supervises Dutch carriers, has met the FNV about its reports, and cannot itself investigate a foreign company but could request action from the foreign authority.
The ILT has no authority to conduct its own investigation at a company established abroad.
De ILT heeft geen bevoegdheid om zelf onderzoek te doen bij een in het buitenland gevestigd bedrijf.

Vragen van de leden Smaling, Van Nispen, Bashir en Ulenbelt (allen SP) aan de Minister en de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie vanwege berichten «Inspectie kondigt be

SP MPs asked whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport announcing inspections in advance, and the resulting internal discontent, is acceptable, and about related questions on inspector status, coordination among inspectorates, budgets and merging supervision. The minister defended announcing routine inspections as efficient under a trust-unless approach, said unannounced inspections happen where warranted, attributed staff tensions to reorganisation, and rejected merging inspectorates for now.
Where there is reason to suspect that rules are repeatedly or deliberately violated, companies can be inspected unannounced.
Waar aanleiding bestaat om te veronderstellen dat regels herhaaldelijk of moedwillig worden overtreden, kunnen bedrijven onaangekondigd geïnspecteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht 'Loom-gekte over, dan plasticberg in afval'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Loom bands, made of non-recyclable or biodegradable plastic, should be sold, whether product requirements or collection schemes are needed, and whether producers can be pressed toward sustainable materials. The State Secretary said waste prevention is the market's responsibility, saw no need for product requirements or collection at present, and promised talks with retail and the toy sector on materials and end-of-life disposal.
I will consult with parties from retail and the toy industry about the materials used and how toys can be disposed of in an environmentally friendly way at the end of their life.

Ik zal met betrekking tot dit dossier met partijen uit de detailhandel en de speelgoedbranche in overleg treden over de gebruikte materialen en de wijze waarop speelgoed aan het eind van de levensduur milieuvriendelijk kan worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de precaire situatie wat betreft de energievoorziening in België

Smaling (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Belgium's precarious energy supply, possible Dutch help if shortages arise, gas and electricity trade with Belgium, the safety of Belgian nuclear plants near the border, and public information. Minister Kamp answered that the Belgian situation is being monitored and that interconnection capacity and cooperation are being expanded, that no nuclear incident has occurred and the FANC supervises safety, and that residents need no extra information for now.
At this moment two reactors in Doel and one reactor in Tihange are safely shut down.
Op dit moment zijn twee reactoren in Doel en één reactor in Tihange veilig afgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over ernstige wateroverlast op maandag 28 juli 2014

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the July 2014 extreme rainfall, damage estimates, and whether the Delta Decision on Spatial Adaptation could enforce water-resilient planning. The minister answered that damage figures are not fully known, that the Delta Programme relies on voluntary interbestuurlijke cooperation rather than enforceable measures, and that implementation will be monitored.
The extent of the damage from 28 July and its distribution across sectors or objects is not known to me.
De omvang van de schade van 28 juli jl. en de verdeling daarvan over sectoren of objecten is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht over parkeergarages

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Grontmij report claiming most parking garage designs are unsafe and inaccessible, and about whether national norms such as NEN 2443 should be written into the Bouwbesluit. The minister answered that Grontmij had no national study, that preventing car damage is not a national government task, that the Bouwbesluit protects persons rather than cars, and that no new parking dimension rules will be added.
It is not the task of the national government to prevent damage to cars in parking garages.
Het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om schade aan auto’s in parkeergarages te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de belastingvoordelen voor Nederlandse havens

An MP asked when the minister knew that tax advantages for Dutch ports could be seen as illegal state aid, why the impression arose that Germany and Belgium favour their ports, and why the European Commission started its investigation. The minister answered that the Commission invited measures in May 2013, opened a formal procedure in July 2014 covering all non-corporate-tax-paying public companies, and that the government opposes subjecting Dutch ports to corporate tax before neighbouring countries.
I am opposed to the Netherlands subjecting its seaport operators to corporate tax earlier than the surrounding countries.
Ik ben er op tegen dat Nederland eerder dan de ons omringende landen zijn zeehavenbeheerders aan vpb onderwerpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies, Smaling over Toegang tot Medicijnen

SP MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she would hold Dutch insurers and pharmaceutical firms accountable for poor medicine access in poor countries, and whether insurers should use their investments to push for better access. The minister said investment policy is primarily the companies' own responsibility, pointed to voluntary initiatives and OECD/IMVO standards, and said she would invite the insurers' association to discuss the Access to Medicine Index.
Investment policy is primarily the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over rotte-eierenlucht bij Deurne

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked about H2S (rotten-egg) gas near Deurne, the expert panel's findings on health risks, pyrite and fertiliser causes, and whether fertiliser levels should be reviewed. The government answered that exposure effects are temporary, that more regional and local pyrite knowledge is needed, and that the nitrate action programme and a manure-fermentation evaluation are under way, with results promised for early 2015.
A policy evaluation on manure fermentation is under way, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and I will send you the results in the first quarter of 2015.
Ten aanzien van mestvergisting is een beleidsevaluatie gaande, waarvan de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en ik u in het eerste kwartaal van 2015 de resultaten zullen doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het afsluiten van de waterlevering door drinkwaterbedrijven in geval van wanbetaling

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about water cut-offs for non-payment by Limburg water company WML, including high salaries, human right to water, the 50-litre minimum, and whether the rules should be evaluated. The minister answered that the cut-off rules are being followed correctly, that the Inspectorate supervises them, that a new arrangement with debt-relief services is in place, and that no evaluation is needed yet.
This supervision shows that the Regulation is well complied with by drinking water companies.
Uit dit toezicht blijkt dat de Regeling door drinkwaterbedrijven goed wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat dieren gedood worden als gevolg van de vondst van het verboden antibioticum furazolidon op diverse kalverhouderijen

Two MPs (SP) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the discovery of the banned antibiotic furazolidon on calf farms, the health risk, the investigation capacity, testing and culling of animals, and liability. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA and Public Prosecution Service are investigating, that no consumer health risk is expected, that the EU rules require culling of positive animals, and that she will discuss private liability with industry.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het bericht “Geen doorstart luchthaven Twente”

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked whether the Twente airport decision procedure should be halted after the regional initiator stopped pursuing a commercial airport, and whether the military airport designation and regulation could still apply. The state secretary replied that talks with the region are ongoing, that the procedure's consequences will be reviewed, and that military designation of Twente will be extended to 1 November 2016 for existing users.
I will consult with the region about the situation that has arisen.
Ik ga met de regio in overleg over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het schrappen van de laatste trein tussen Hoorn – Enkhuizen

MP Smaling asked why the last two trains between Hoorn and Enkhuizen were cut for track maintenance, whether alternatives like single-track operation or buses were considered, and whether the minister would talk with NS and ProRail. The state secretary answered that low ridership justified cutting the late trains, that single-track alternatives do not apply on this single-track line, and that he sees no need for further talks since the timetable is NS's responsibility.
I do not consider it necessary to talk with ProRail and NS about this.
Ik vind het niet nodig hierover met ProRail en NS in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de Global Partnership for Education Replenishment Meeting

MPs Smaling, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the Netherlands was absent from the Global Partnership for Education replenishment meeting, whether it supports investment in education and urges other donors including the EU to contribute, and whether it will push for the Lucens Guidelines protecting schools from military use. The minister answered that the Netherlands was not represented because its basic education support is being phased out, that it has urged other donors to keep funding education, and that it could not raise the Lucens Guidelines at the meeting.
Given the phase-out of basic education policy and therefore also the phase-out of Dutch support to the GPE, the Netherlands is not represented at this meeting.
Gegeven de afbouw van het beleid voor basisonderwijs en hiermee ook de afbouw van de Nederlandse steun aan het GPE is Nederland niet vertegenwoordigd op deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over de mishandeling van spoorwegpersoneel

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked the government about the assault on rail staff, prevention measures, operator practices and court sentencing. The state secretary answered that the case is under investigation, outlined a Veilige Publieke Taak programme and existing measures, and said regional operators' cost and measure details would follow later.

I have asked the relevant subnational governments and PT authorities, as responsible concession grantors toward the regional rail operators, to provide insight into measures and costs regarding social safety.

Ik heb aan de betreffende decentrale overheden en OV- autoriteiten als verantwoordelijk concessieverlener richting de regionale spoorvervoerders (Arriva, Connexxion, Syntus en Veolia) gevraagd om inzicht te geven in maatregelen en kosten op het gebied van sociale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over schaliegas in het vrijhandelsverdrag TTIP

Two SP MPs asked the minister about leaked TTIP texts that would deem energy exports automatically compliant with US export licence conditions, and whether this would boost imports of shale gas and tar sands oil, undermine renewable energy and reduce transparency. The minister answered that US export rules remain strict and that more imports are possible but unquantified, denied that EU climate regulation is being weakened, offered confidential briefings to parliament and said TTIP can support global energy governance.
As previously promised to your House, the House can, if desired, be confidentially informed before each new round and given confidential access to the EU negotiating documents.

Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer toegezegd, kan de Kamer – indien gewenst – voor elke nieuwe ronde vertrouwelijk worden geïnformeerd en vertrouwelijk inzage krijgen in de onderhandelingsdocumenten van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Sluiswachter keert terug in Zeeland”

MP Smaling asked why remote control of four Zeeland locks was suspended, whether there were incidents, and whether camera-based remote operation is unreliable. The minister explained inspection-found emergency-stop defects, listed three communication incidents without danger, rejected the camera criticism, and agreed to send the inspection report.
Yes, I am willing to do so. The adopted report of the findings of this investigation into the emergency-stop facility is attached to this answer.
Ja, daartoe ben ik bereid. Het vastgestelde rapport van de bevindingen van dit onderzoek naar de noodstopvoorziening is als bijlage bij deze beantwoording gevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en van Tongeren over de mogelijkheid om een spoorverbinding tussen Utrecht en Breda te realiseren langs de A27

MPs Smaling and van Tongeren asked why the government chose to widen the A27 between Utrecht and Breda for over 800 million euro rather than a rail link, and whether a rail line was studied, including its jobs and benefits. The State Secretary answered that the widening addresses a capacity problem on a national freight and traffic corridor, that the rail link was studied and rejected on a cost-benefit score of 0.05 with investment costs above 4 billion euro, and that infrastructure investment will continue to support jobs.
From these studies the conclusion was drawn that it is not justified to take further steps regarding this possible new railway line.
Uit deze onderzoeken is de conclusie getrokken dat het niet verantwoord is verdere stappen te ondernemen ten aanzien van deze mogelijke nieuwe spoorlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ladder voor duurzame verstedelijking

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether Venray municipality and Inalfa had examined redeveloping the existing site and applied the ladder for sustainable urbanisation before approving a relocation, and how the ladder fits with reports that it is often skipped. The Minister answered that the municipality applied the ladder only after a public objection to the draft plan, that the ladder is a motivation requirement enforced via objections and appeals to the courts, and that how regional need is determined is left to the competent authority.
The requirement in the Bro is a motivation requirement, not a substantive norm.
De eis in het Bro is een motiveringseis, geen inhoudelijke norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht ‘vergunningen veehouderij gebaseerd op rekenfouten’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that livestock odour permits rest on calculation errors, including the legal consequences, the province of Noord-Brabant's requests, health effects, and whether the odour law and maximum odour loads should be tightened. The government says the V-Stacks model works in most situations, that existing permits are unaffected, and that a targeted model adjustment and guidance for municipalities will follow, but it declines to tighten the law now and leaves cumulative odour checks to municipalities.
I will ensure a solution for the short term.
Ik zal zorgen voor een oplossing voor de korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de afname van het aantal verkeersslachtoffers en de aanpak om deze dalende lijn te continueren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the 2013 fall in road deaths, how the downward trend will be sustained, which municipalities have the most casualties relative to population, and measures for cyclists including senior training and path maintenance. The minister confirmed the fall, said no clear cause could be identified, pointed to a package of 23 road safety measures with SWOV monitoring, and referred to a model local cycling safety approach that municipalities must adopt, while noting that per-capita rankings fluctuate yearly.
I therefore have the development of road safety monitored annually by SWOV.
Ik laat de ontwikkeling van de verkeersveiligheid daarom jaarlijks monitoren door SWOV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘dat mensen die gezakt zijn, wel een rijbewijs ontvangen van het CBR’

An SP MP asked the minister about RTL reports that the CBR issued driving licences to 137 candidates who had failed their practical exams, and whether it would recover them and address repeated CBR problems. The minister disputed the scale of the reported errors, said the CBR found no unlawfully issued categories in its database checks, cited correction and new control measures, and declined to take further action.
With the recognisable driving school owners interviewed by RTL, the CBR held conversations about the cases they named, from which no need for recovery emerged.
Met de herkenbare rijschoolhouders die zijn geïnterviewd door RTL zijn door het CBR gesprekken gevoerd over de door hen genoemde gevallen waaruit geen noodzaak tot terugvordering is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanpak van de overschrijding van luchtkwaliteitseisen op de ’s-Gravendijkwal in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether closing the 's-Gravendijkwal to heavy traffic is insufficient to meet EU air quality limits, what is needed structurally, whether the Maastunnel renovation could address it, whether the national government shares responsibility, and whether ring-road 'inprikkers' were studied and what they would cost. The state secretary confirmed closure alone is insufficient, said primary responsibility for local measures lies with the municipality of Rotterdam, referred to the NSL programme, and said no concrete proposals for the ring-road approach were known.
The primary responsibility for measures to improve air quality along the 's-Gravendijkwal lies with the municipality of Rotterdam.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor maatregelen om de luchtkwaliteit langs de 's-Gravendijkwal te verbeteren, ligt bij de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over Aalt Dijkhuizen als boegbeeld van de topsector Agri&Food

MPs Van Gerven and Smaling asked why former Wageningen UR executive Aalt Dijkhuizen was chosen as figurehead of the Agri&Food top sector, given his public opposition to organic farming, and how the biological sector's share of funding and the 2013 amendment were implemented. The minister answered that he was chosen for his sector knowledge and networks, that his remarks were personal, that the sector's budget and amendment implementation are described in earlier letters, and that no second figurehead is needed.
Mr Dijkhuizen's statements were made in a personal capacity, and he indicated that he is absolutely not an opponent of the organic sector.
De uitspraken van de heer Dijkhuizen zijn op persoonlijke titel gemaakt, waarbij hij heeft aangegeven dat hij absoluut geen tegenstander van de biologische sector is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smalling over het bericht ’10 euro voor 780 meter trein’

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether a Belgian senior train ticket being invalid at the border, while a Dutch ticket was valid up to it, was confusing for passengers, and how many fines were issued on the Essen-border stretch. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the confusing ticket conditions, said the fine figures were requested from NMBS and not yet available, and committed to asking NS to seek a solution with the Belgian operator and to inform the Chamber.
NMBS has been asked whether it has this information.
Aan NMBS is gevraagd of zij beschikt over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Paulus Jansen inzake het voornemen dienstregeling Uithoflijn door het BRU

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the Uithoflijn tram, built with 110 million euro in national subsidy, will not run in evenings and at weekends, and whether the national government agreed service hours with the regional authority BRU. The state secretary replied that no specific service-hour agreements were made, that service levels are the responsibility of the regional authority under the Wet Personenvervoer, and that he will not intervene in that responsibility.
Investigating traveller needs in the Utrecht region and determining a suitable public transport offer is primarily a responsibility of the decentralised authorities (Passenger Transport Act).

Het onderzoeken van de behoeften van reizigers in de regio Utrecht en het bepalen van een daarbij passend OV-aanbod is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden (Wet Personenvervoer).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat transportbedrijven zwarte lijsten hanteren voor parkeerplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether they know transport firms keep blacklists of unsafe lorry parking places, whether the government will act on the rise in cargo theft, and for statistics and an action plan. The minister confirms ongoing talks with the sector, says the government lacks those blacklists, outlines public-private prevention efforts and cargo theft figures, and promises to inform parliament before summer.
I expect to be able to inform the House about this this summer.
Ik verwacht Uw Kamer hierover deze zomer te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het ontwerp luchthavenbesluit luchthaven Twente

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked the state secretary about the draft airport decree allowing Twente airport to grow to 22,000 aircraft movements, including the absence of a European Commission state-aid ruling, the withheld business plan and financial figures, passenger forecasts, the operator's inexperience, and the 6-km nature restrictions. The state secretary answered that the decree rests on a tendered concession and a verified low-growth scenario, that the business plan and parts of the financial report are withheld as commercially sensitive, and that the decree will only be finalised after a positive Commission state-aid decision.
The business plan for Twente airport was drawn up by the operating company.
Het businessplan voor luchthaven Twente is opgesteld door de exploitatiemaatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de ‘s Gravendijkwal in Rotterdam de smerigste straat is van Nederland

An SP MP asked the minister about air quality on 's Gravendijkwal in Rotterdam, whether the city can solve it alone, and whether the government will help realise a covering of the street. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said both national and municipal measures are needed, and noted that Rotterdam has decided against covering the road but will ban heavy traffic.
To improve air quality, both national and municipal measures are needed.
Om de luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren zijn zowel rijksmaatregelen als gemeentelijke maatregelen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanpassingen aan de sluis Eefde

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about objections from the municipality of Lochem to the electrification of the pumping station and the choice of location for a second lock at Eefde, and whether an alternative site and independent costing should be reconsidered. The Minister replied that no objections to the lock itself are known, that renovation is necessary, that the cost difference remains large, and that the commission for environmental impact assessment found the information sufficient, so no new study will be done.
The final advice of the commission for environmental impact assessment gives me no reason to revise my preferred decision.
Het definitieve advies van de commissie m.e.r. geeft mij geen aanleiding mijn Voorkeursbeslissing te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over bedrijventerreinen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the large gap between supply and demand for business sites, the vacancy and financial costs of unused land, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that provinces and municipalities bear responsibility, notes that available land is 25 times annual take-up though much is not immediately developable, and states that the Rijk has not withdrawn from the convenant and that the SER-ladder is a binding motivation requirement, while declining to provide a municipal breakdown.
Business park policy is after all a decentralised responsibility.
Bedrijventerreinenbeleid is immers een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Smaling over de fusie van woningcorporaties Ymere en De Woningbouw (Weesp)

MPs Jansen and Smaling asked the minister whether the merger of Ymere and De Woningbouw (Weesp) followed the 'nee-tenzij' principle, what alternatives and public-value tests were used, and whether merger benefits are monitored. The minister answered that the merger was approved on the basis of the 2002 merger criteria, that no separate public-value test or alternatives study is required, that monitoring of benefits is primarily the corporation's responsibility, and that he will strengthen merger rules through new legislation.
I also intend, through the Revision Act for approved housing institutions, to require that it be demonstrated that a merger is preferable to other forms of cooperation.

Ik ben bovendien voornemens via de Herzieningswet toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting te regelen dat aannemelijk gemaakt moet worden dat een fusie te prefereren is boven andere vormen van samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over grote weerstand tegen het gevoerde afvalbeleid voor de binnenvaart

An MP asked the minister about strong opposition to the new waste policy for inland shipping, including the low number of subscriptions, the double payment, the flat tariff, and risks of litter and dumping. The minister defended the subscription system as cost-recovering under the polluter-pays principle, noted the subscription is optional, and committed to consultation with shipping organisations on the collection network.
I do not have exact data on the full waste streams generated by the sector.
Van de volledige afvalstromen die de sector genereert heb ik geen exacte gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Spoorwegen vast personeel van de fietsenstallingen wil vervangen door werklozen

MPs Smaling and Karabulut asked whether NS was replacing permanent bicycle-parking staff with unemployed re-integration workers and whether it was negotiating with Halfords; the state secretary replied that the reports were largely inaccurate, NS had terminated nine parking contracts with a planned uniform national formula, and expects new operators to take over existing staff. The answers rely on NS's account and refuse to exercise any power over private operators' personnel policy.
I have no relationship with these operators and no authority to enforce that one operator rehires the staff of another operator in such cases.

Ik heb geen enkele relatie met deze exploitanten en ik heb geen bevoegdheid om af te dwingen dat de ene exploitant in voorkomende gevallen het personeel van de andere exploitant opnieuw in dienst neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over winkelleegstand

An SP MP asked the minister about rising shop vacancy in city centres, the role of out-of-town retail, who bears the costs, and whether a national retail structure plan should be made. The minister answered that vacancy is mainly local and regional, that out-of-town retail plays only a limited role, that municipalities are primarily responsible, and that regional authorities should prepare retail visions with a report to parliament by summer 2014.
It is clear that this should mainly be tackled at local and regional level.
Duidelijk is dat dit vooral lokaal-regionaal aangepakt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ontsporing van een goederentrein bij Borne

An MP asked the state secretary to find the cause of a freight train derailment near Borne, whether equipment quality standards should be tightened, how residents are to be reassured, whether alternatives to rail freight through East Netherlands exist, and whether highly dangerous substances can be excluded from this line. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate is investigating (preliminary finding: a broken wheel tyre), will report before summer 2014, that tighter EU rules can only be pursued at European level, that alternatives were studied in 2012 with limited potential, and that dangerous goods transport cannot be fully excluded.
The Inspectorate aims to complete its investigation before summer 2014.
De Inspectie streeft er naar haar onderzoek vóór de zomer van 2014 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de Buitenring Parkstad Limburg

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Buitenring Parkstad road project in Limburg, whose costs rose from 200 to about 500 million euro, could be halted or redirected via a directive given the court ruling and the Crisis- and Recovery Act status. The minister repeatedly declined, stating that the project is a provincial competence and that she sees no reason to issue a directive.
The Buitenring Parkstad Limburg project is a provincial project. It is therefore not for me, but for the province of Limburg, to give a judgement on opinions regarding this project.
Het project Buitenring Parkstad Limburg is een provinciaal project. Het is dus niet aan mij, maar aan de provincie Limburg om een oordeel te geven over meningen betreffende dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat het tekort aan mbo-stageplekken overdreven zou zijn

MP Smaling asked the minister whether claims of a shortage of vocational (mbo) internship places were exaggerated, whether SBB's subsidy depends on shortage figures, and how data consistency will be ensured. The minister replied that SBB receives no structural or shortage-linked subsidy, that she trusts SBB's integrity, and that SBB will reflect on past shortage reports in its October stage barometer.
I have asked SBB to look back in the next barometer in October, alongside its outlook on the chance of internships in the future.
Ik heb de SBB gevraagd in de eerstvolgende barometer van oktober a.s. naast een beschouwing over de kans op stage in de toekomst, ook terug te blikken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smaling inzake het bericht dat jonge onderwijzers in grote getale werkloos raken

MP Smaling asked the minister about reports that young primary teachers are losing their jobs and being re-hired on temporary contracts, raising concerns about teacher shortages and loss of young talent. The state secretary answered that hiring and dismissal is the responsibility of school boards, cited Court of Audit data showing the share of flexible contracts falling, and pointed to a 3,000-job plan and a sector plan under consultation.
Hiring and dismissing teachers is the responsibility of the relevant school board.
Het aannemen en ontslaan van leerkrachten is de verantwoordelijkheid van het desbetreffende schoolbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat ontslag van leerkrachten dreigt op honderden basisscholen

MPs Smaling and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether a report that 80% of primary schools must dismiss teachers to stay solvent, with consequences for class sizes and individual attention, was accurate and whether budget cuts threaten education quality. The State Secretary replied that falling pupil numbers make fewer teachers necessary, that class sizes have not risen sharply, that the government is investing in teacher quality and that the Nationaal Onderwijsakkoord is being revived.
It cannot be determined in advance what the effect of fewer remedial teachers, gym teachers and music teachers will be on education quality.
Op voorhand kan niet worden bepaald wat het effect van minder «remedial teachers», gymleraren en muziekdocenten is op de kwaliteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht het bericht dat scholen leerlingen met een zorgvraag weigeren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether schools are refusing students with support needs (e.g. autism) ahead of the 2014 funding change and whether the equalisation of care funds creates perverse incentives. The minister denies the signals, says the Inspectorate is following up on about 100 reports, argues decentralised funding is more efficient, and refuses to suspend equalisation, pointing students to the Equal Treatment Act and the Human Rights Commission.
The inspectorate has made a follow-up appointment with Start Foundation in September to gain more insight into this problem.
De inspectie heeft een vervolgafspraak met Start Foundation gemaakt in september om meer zicht te krijgen op deze problematiek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over thuisonderwijs via geheime constructies

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Smaling asked the state secretary about children receiving home schooling under secret arrangements, including whether contracts with parents impose confidentiality and whether the inspectorate approves them. The state secretary denied the secret-arrangement framing, said the individual handling plans are lawful maatwerk signed by the inspectorate, and pointed to a planned committee debate on truancy.
Agreements made are tailored work and not a blueprint for other pupils.
Gemaakte afspraken zijn maatwerk en geen blauwdruk voor andere leerlingen.

Asks the government to respond in detail before the June 2025 Interparliamentary Kingdom Consultation to the Raad van State report on 70 years of the Kingdom Statute, and to plan a consultation with the countries.
requests the government to respond extensively to the proposals before the IPKO in June 2025
verzoekt de regering voorafgaand aan het IPKO in juni 2025 met een uitgebreide reactie te komen op de voorstellen
Motie van het lid Bruyning c.s. over onderzoeken hoe interdepartementale begrote rijksuitgaven aan Caribisch Nederland inzichtelijker kunnen worden gemaakt
Asks the government to investigate how interdepartmental budgeted national spending on Caribbean Netherlands can be presented more clearly to the House, for example as a syllabus.
requests the government to investigate how interdepartmental budgeted national expenditure on Caribbean Netherlands can be made more transparent
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe interdepartementale begrote rijksuitgaven aan Caribisch Nederland inzichtelijker kunnen worden gemaakt
Motie van het lid White c.s. over een plan van aanpak om het onderwijs en de voor- en naschoolse opvang in Caribisch Nederland te verbeteren
Asks the government to work with the islands on a plan to improve education and out-of-school childcare in Caribbean Netherlands.
requests the government to come, in consultation with the islands, with an action plan to improve education and childcare
verzoekt de regering om in samenspraak met de eilanden te komen met een plan van aanpak om het onderwijs en de voor- en naschoolse opvang te verbeteren
Motie van het lid White c.s. over inventariseren wat er nodig is om tot een ov-netwerk in Caribisch Nederland te komen
Asks the government to inventory, with the islands, what is needed for a public transport network in Caribbean Netherlands and inform the Chamber before the Voorjaarsnota.
requests the government to inventory in consultation with the islands what is needed to achieve a public transport network in Caribbean Netherlands
verzoekt de regering om in samenspraak met de eilanden te inventariseren wat er nodig is om tot een ov-netwerk in Caribisch Nederland te komen
Motie van het lid White c.s. over een plan van aanpak met tijdlijn om de aanbevelingen van de commissie-Thodé uit te voeren
Asks the government to present a concrete action plan with a timeline for implementing the Thodé commission's recommendations on living standards in the Caribbean Netherlands.
requests the government to come, in its cabinet response to the report, with a concrete action plan including a timeline on how the recommendations will be implemented
verzoekt de regering om bij de kabinetsreactie op het rapport met een concreet plan van aanpak inclusief tijdlijn te komen hoe de aanbevelingen uit worden gevoerd
Motie van het lid Bruyning over efficiënter interdepartementaal samenwerken bij zaken die de Caribische landen van het Koninkrijk aangaan
Asks the government to draw up a plan for more efficient interdepartmental cooperation on matters concerning the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
requests the government to draw up a plan in which ministries cooperate interdepartmentally more efficiently
verzoekt de regering om een plan op te stellen waarin de ministeries op een efficiëntere manier interdepartementaal gaan samenwerken
Motie van het lid Bruyning c.s. over onderzoek doen naar het verlenen van expertise en de haalbaarheid van een projectbureau om de eilanden te ondersteunen met het aanspreken van EU-fondsen
Asks the government to study providing expertise and a project bureau to help the BES islands access EU funds.
Asks the government to study providing expertise to the islands and the feasibility of a project bureau.
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek uit te voeren over het verlenen van expertise aan de eilanden en de haalbaarheid van een projectbureau
Motie van het lid White c.s. over samen met de BES-eilanden een structuur voor goede dataverzameling maken op basis waarvan het toekomstig gevormde beleid kan worden bepaald
Motion asks government to build with the BES islands a data-collection structure to inform future policy.
requests the government to create together with the islands a structure in which good data collection is secured
verzoekt de regering om samen met de eilanden een structuur te (laten) maken waarin een goede dataverzameling geborgd wordt
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. over een centrum voor ondernemerschap voor Saba en Sint-Eustatius
Asks the government to arrange a centre for entrepreneurship for Saba and Sint Eustatius, following Bonaire or opening the Bonaire centre to them.
requests the government, following Bonaire, to ensure a centre for entrepreneurship comes for Saba and Sint Eustatius
verzoekt de regering in navolging van Bonaire te bewerkstelligen dat er een centrum voor ondernemerschap komt voor Saba en Sint-Eustatius
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. over onderzoeken wat het effect is van de verhoging van het minimumloon op kleine, lokale mkb-ondernemers en op het vestigingsklimaat op de BES
Asks the government to study the effects of the minimum wage increase on small local businesses and on the business climate in the BES islands, and to report to the Chamber after the summer.
requests the government to investigate the effect of the minimum wage increase on small local SMEs
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken wat het effect is van de verhoging van het minimumloon op kleine, lokale mkb-ondernemers
Motie van het lid White c.s. over voor de drie afzonderlijke eilanden monitoren of de stappen die nu gezet zijn voldoende zijn om het bestaansminimum te bereiken
Asks the government to monitor, island by island, whether steps raising the minimum income on the BES islands are sufficient and to report to the Chamber before the 2025 budget.
requests the government to monitor for the three separate islands whether the steps now taken are sufficient
verzoekt de regering om voor de drie afzonderlijke eilanden te monitoren of de stappen die nu gezet zijn voldoende zijn
Motie van de leden Bruyning en Paternotte over onderzoek naar de wenselijkheid van een uitvoeringstoets gericht op het perspectief van de BES-eilanden
Asks the government to study whether a implementation test focused on the perspective of the BES islands should be applied to laws and regulations.
requests the government to carry out a study into the desirability of an implementation test focused on the perspective of the BES islands in the making of laws and regulations

verzoekt de regering een onderzoek uit te voeren over de wenselijkheid om bij de totstandkoming van wet- en regelgeving een uitvoeringstoets gericht op het perspectief van de BES-eilanden uit te voeren
Motie van het lid Bruyning over het recht op een steunfiguur voor jeugdigen in de wet verankeren
Asks the government to anchor a legal right for young people to a support figure in legislation.
requests the government to anchor the right to a support figure for young people in law
verzoekt de regering om het recht op een steunfiguur voor jeugdigen in de wet te verankeren
Motie van de leden Bruyning en Ceder over bevorderen dat de meldbriefprocedure voor verlenging van kinderbeschermingsmaatregelen niet meer wordt gebruikt
Asks the government to promote ending use of the meldbriefprocedure, which extends child protection measures without an oral hearing and is seen as undermining parents' legal protection.
requests the cabinet to promote that the meldbriefprocedure is no longer used
verzoekt het kabinet te bevorderen dat de meldbriefprocedure niet meer gebruikt gaat worden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de Kamerbrief 'Uitvoering van de motie van het lid Daniëlle Jansen c.s. over de verkoop van nicotineproducten vanaf 2028 voorbehouden aan enkel tabaksspeciaalz

MPs Hertzberger and Bruyning asked why the government will not implement the motion to restrict nicotine product sales to specialist tobacco shops from 2028, and whether compensation or cost-benefit estimates were considered. The Secretary of State answered that without funding a compensation scheme is not feasible and risks court annulment, that the earlier 2030/2032 timeline stands, and that he declines to reconsider the decision.
Because the motion does not provide financial resources, including a compensation scheme in the bill is not feasible.
Omdat de motie niet voorziet in financiële middelen is het opnemen van een compensatieregeling in het wetsvoorstel niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over spoeduithuisplaatsingen door Veilig Thuis zonder rechterlijke toetsing

An MP asks the State Secretary whether Veilig Thuis Oost-Brabant carries out emergency out-of-home placements of children without judicial review or legal representation, and whether this violates Article 8 ECHR and national law. The government replies that voluntary placements with informed consent need no court review, that it sees no ECHR violation, will not order emergency placements to go through a judge, and that existing liability rules suffice, while pointing to a staatscommissie and planned legislation.
I do not share the view that a voluntary out-of-home placement would constitute a serious violation of Article 8 ECHR and the national laws and frameworks.
Ik deel de mening niet dat een vrijwillige uithuisplaatsing een ernstige schending zou vormen van artikel 8 EVRM en de nationale wetten en kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf, Mutluer en Bruyning over de beschikbaarheid van acute hulp voor vrouwen naar aanleiding van de femicide-campagne 'Waar Ben Je'?

MPs asked whether the 24/7 Veilig Thuis chat for femicide signals is available everywhere, how the campaign's effect is monitored, and whether the statutory task should be extended to 24-hour availability. The state secretary answered that Veilig Thuis already has a legal duty to be reachable in acute situations, no national monitoring of the campaign effect exists, a 24/7 chat is being developed, and no change to the statutory task is planned.
Veilig Thuis does have the statutory duty to be reachable and available at all times in situations where immediate performance of its legal tasks is required.
Wel heeft Veilig Thuis de wettelijke taak om te allen tijde bereikbaar en beschikbaar te zijn in situaties waarin onmiddellijk uitvoering van de wettelijke taken geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de onderzoeksjournalistiek van Zembla naar de toename van illegale THC-vapes onder scholieren

Two Nieuw Sociaal Contract MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about rising use of illegal THC and synthetic-cannabinoid (spice) vapes among pupils, including health harms, enforcement, penalties, social media liability and possible bans. The government acknowledges serious concern, reports limited structured data and some local incidents, outlines penalties and enforcement responsibilities, and promises a meldpunt and further EU-level work, but declines a general vape ban as contrary to EU law and gives no answer splitting the questions separately.
This means that a general ban on vapes is in breach of European law.
Dit betekent dat het verbieden van vapes in zijn algemeenheid in strijd is met Europees recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het Handelingsperspectief en veldnorm bij onderbezetting gecertificeerde instellingen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Justice and Security and of Health whether the 'Handelingsperspectief' (a sector-developed emergency protocol for waiting lists at certified youth protection agencies) is legal, whether the Inspectorates were involved, and whether it shields agencies from enforcement and undermines children's rights. The government answers that the Inspectorates were informed but not involved in drafting, that the protocol is not legislation and remains subject to inspection, and that workload has fallen and waiting lists are being monitored.
The inspectorates do act when they find shortcomings at youth protection institutions in tasks the institutions themselves are responsible for and should control.

De inspecties treden wel op als zij bij instellingen in de jeugdbeschermingsketen tekortkomingen constateren op de taken waar de instellingen zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn en zelf grip op behoren te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over structureel falen van GI Stichting Samen Veilig Midden-Nederland (SAVE), rechterlijke ongehoorzaamheid en schending van Europees recht

An MP asked the state secretaries about GI SAVE's placement of a minor in Spain without the Brussels II-ter approval procedure, its deliberate non-compliance with a court-ordered contact arrangement, and whether court rulings are being ignored more broadly. The minister confirmed the rulings, called the non-compliance contrary to the rule of law, said the inspectorate does not register such cases, and pointed to ongoing supervision, sector guidance and the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd without committing to new sanctions or rule changes.
GIs must always implement court rulings, even if the institution disagrees with the ruling.
GI's moeten altijd uitvoering geven aan rechterlijke uitspraken, ook als de instelling het niet eens is met de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over erkenning van foltering in gesloten jeugdzorg, bescherming van kritische rechters en herbezinning op het ketenpartnerschap binnen de jeugdsector

An MP asks whether the government acknowledges possible torture with painful stimuli in closed youth care after the CPT report, whether judges are being pressured to be less critical, and whether provider–judiciary cooperation compromises judicial independence. The Secretary of State answers that the government does not recognise possible torture, says judges are independent and the government will not intervene, and commits to providers strengthening training and oversight of restraint measures.
The cabinet cannot and will not interfere in how judges conduct themselves.
Het kabinet kan en wil zich niet mengen in de opstelling van rechters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over klachten tegen kritische rechters binnen de jeugdsector

MP Bruyning asked whether a child-protection certified institution (Jeugdbescherming Noord) filing complaints against a children's judge and holding talks with the court board undermines judicial independence and rule-of-law norms, and asked about oversight and certification. The minister answered that the court and the institution followed the complaint procedure, the talks did not concern substantive cases, certification is for the KMI and inspectorates, and no new rules or sanctions are planned.
The conversations did not relate to the substantive assessment of cases; appeal is open for that.
De gesprekken hadden geen betrekking op de inhoudelijke beoordeling van zaken, daar staat het hoger beroep voor open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel Trouw waarin de staatssecretaris het opsluiten van jongeren in de gesloten jeugdzorg weer mogelijk wil maken

An MP asked the state secretaries about a Trouw report that the government wants to re-allow night-time locking of youths in closed youth care, and whether this conflicts with commitments to the CPT on reducing restraint. The government answered that the proposed law would allow night-time room confinement only under strict conditions, individual assessment, and existing legal safeguards, and that it rejects claims of policy inconsistency and of undermining Dutch credibility internationally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het kindgesprek naar aanleiding van de podcast 'Scheidszaken' van het NOS Jeugdjournaal

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about child interviews by judges in family and youth cases, following a NOS podcast, including whether child-friendly rooms exist at every court and why hearings are scheduled differently. The State Secretary answered that 20 of 25 court locations have child-friendly rooms, that the judiciary is responsible for court building arrangements under the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie, and that a plan on motion implementation is expected in autumn 2025.
Article 23 of the Judicial Organisation Act provides that responsibility for the organisation and operations of individual courts lies exclusively with the court management.

Artikel 23 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie bepaalt dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de organisatie en bedrijfsvoering van de individuele gerechten exclusief is belegd bij het gerechtsbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van Nispen, Piri en Bruyning over kinderen in de noodopvang

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks-PvdA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about children housed in emergency reception locations, including overcrowding, unsuitable sites, municipal population conditions, schooling delays, repeated relocations and access to youth care. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, acknowledged shortcomings, and pointed to a COA inventory study due in summer 2025 and steps on schooling and relocation.
COA does not keep track of whether a minor asylum seeker is enrolled in a school or regularly attends it.
Het COA houdt niet bij of een minderjarige asielzoeker staat ingeschreven op een school en of het kind de school geregeld bezoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het rapport 'Zorgen over kinderen die wachten op jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering'

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the inspectorates' report on children waiting months for a permanent youth protection worker and on the lack of timely help at certified institutions, questioning oversight, accountability of managers, and publication of court decisions. The government acknowledges the waiting lists, says workload has fallen 26% and the waiting list 29% since December 2022, cites staffing and funding measures, and says legal routes to hold directors accountable already exist, while committing to ongoing monitoring and periodic updates to parliament.
I already regularly inform your House about the number of clients, the waiting lists and the workload in youth protection.
Ik informeer uw Kamer reeds periodiek over het aantal cliënten, de wachtlijsten en de werkdruk in de jeugdbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de veroordeling van Nederland door het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens inzake de zaak Van Slooten (zaaknummer 45644/18)

An MP asks the State Secretary about the European Court of Human Rights ruling that the Netherlands violated the right to family life in the Van Slooten case, where family reunification efforts were abandoned after four months without thorough assessment of the mother's parenting capacity. The State Secretary acknowledges the violation, describes revised guidelines and a reflection committee's recommendations on court-ordered expert reports, and says implications are still being examined with a Council of Europe action plan to follow.
The Netherlands must send the Committee of Ministers an action plan on implementing this ruling within six months of the judgment becoming final.
Nederland moet uiterlijk binnen zes maanden na het definitief worden van de uitspraak een «action plan» over de tenuitvoerlegging van deze uitspraak aan het Comité van Ministers sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over screening in de pleegzorg

An MP asks the State Secretaries about foster-care screening after a court referred questions to the Supreme Court on Youth Act article 5.1, and about inspection findings on the foster provider Enver, which failed most screening norms. The government says it awaits the Supreme Court's ruling before deciding on measures, points to inspection-enforced improvements and a planned review of continuous screening, and states that the youth protection system's oversight is being strengthened.
I am awaiting the Supreme Court's assessment of the preliminary questions before deciding whether to take any measures.
Ik wacht de beoordeling van de prejudiciële vragen aan de Hoge Raad af, voordat ik besluit of ik eventuele maatregelen moet nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, van Nispen, Boswijk, Koops en Bruyning over het uitblijven van investeringen voor het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 2025 spring budget omitted funds for prisons, whether the 23 million euro withdrawal from DJI's equity amounts to a cut, and what the consequences are for staff, early release, unexecuted sentences and pardon requests. The State Secretary confirmed no extra funds were allocated, explained the withdrawal as a legal requirement used to cover other justice costs, and warned of a growing capacity shortfall of around 800 places by 2030, while answering the timing question late.
Without additional investments I cannot realise structural capacity expansions and many necessary renovations cannot be carried out.
Zonder aanvullende investeringen kan ik geen structurele capaciteitsuitbreidingen realiseren en kunnen veel van de noodzakelijke renovaties niet uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de werkwijze van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming in de regio Den Haag

Member Bruyning asked the State Secretary whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming in The Hague gives court advice in custody, access and child-protection cases without reading the files beforehand, and what safeguards apply. The State Secretary answered that the practice, an agreement between the Raad, the Hague court and municipalities for the consultation task, was revised from 1 May 2025 so that the Raad now receives all relevant documents beforehand, and that no independent investigation is needed.
Since 1 May 2025 the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming receives the relevant documents before every hearing.
Sinds 1 mei 2025 ontvangt de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming voorafgaand aan iedere zitting de relevante stukken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bruyning over de uitvoering van jeugdbeschermingsmaatregelen

An MP asks the State Secretary about court rulings finding serious failures by a child-protection agency and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming in youth protection cases, including missing permanent youth protectors, withheld information and ignored court orders, and asks about oversight, sanctions and an evaluation. The State Secretary acknowledges the failures, describes workload reductions and waiting-list figures, refers oversight to the Inspections and certifier, and declines a separate plan of action and some evaluations.
Withholding crucial information violates Article 3.3 of the Youth Act, which obliges the RvdK and the GI to present the relevant facts fully and truthfully in reports or petitions.

Het achterhouden van cruciale informatie is in strijd met artikel 3.3 van de Jeugdwet, waarin is bepaald dat de RvdK en de GI verplicht zijn om in rapportages of verzoekschriften de van belang zijnde feiten volledig en naar waarheid aan te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van de Commissie-Van Ark en de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd

MP Bruyning asked the State Secretary for Health about implementing the Van Ark Commission and Youth Reform Agenda recommendations, including financial risk-sharing between the state and municipalities, the VNG's concerns, planned Youth Act amendments and income-dependent contributions. The State Secretary repeatedly deferred substantive answers, stating that talks with parties are ongoing and that the Chamber will be informed before the 18 June youth policy debate, while listing several bills in preparation.
I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes as soon as possible, and at the latest before the youth policy debate on 18 June.
Over de uitkomsten informeer ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk, uiterlijk voorafgaand aan het debat over het jeugdbeleid op 18 juni a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over non-discriminatie en gelijke behandeling in de jeugdbeschermingsketen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about non-discrimination and equal treatment in the youth protection chain, following an Inspectorate report and a delayed study into discrimination at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming. The government replied that it will address the Inspectorate's findings and the study in a letter on youth protection expected in May, and largely referred back to that answer for each question.
I indicated that the substantive response to the Inspectorate's letter will be included in the next letter on youth protection.
Ik heb daarbij aangegeven dat de inhoudelijke reactie op de brief van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid zal worden opgenomen in de eerstvolgende brief over jeugdbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over kindgesprekken van kinderen bij rechters, naar aanleiding van de podcast ‘Scheidszaken’ van het Jeugdjournaal

An MP asked the State Secretary about how courts hear children in custody and contact cases, following a podcast on child interviews in divorce proceedings. The government answered that child interviews should take place in child-friendly rooms separate from hearings, that most court locations now have such rooms, and that it will talk with the judiciary and the initiators of a letter.
It has been decided that this will also be the case in civil youth cases by 1 October 2025 at the latest.
Besloten is dat dit uiterlijk per 1 oktober 2025 ook het geval zal zijn in de civiele jeugdzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het antwoord op vragen over het bericht 'Kinderen in bedwang gehouden met pijnprikkels, commissie tegen martelen kijkt mee in Nederland'

MP Bruyning asks the state secretaries whether the government accepts system failures leading to incidents in youth care institutions, whether institutional boards should be liable, whether youths can report abuse to police, and whether abuse should carry higher penalties or compensation. The government answers that it cannot eliminate incidents but rejects any tolerance of violence, states that board liability is an exception decided by courts, says it sees no need to expand compensation options, and offers to inquire about a university study on alternatives to closed youth care.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether unlawful conduct has occurred.
In dat geval is het uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of sprake is van onrechtmatig handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de artikelen ‘Jeugdzorg en Rechtsstraat: een systeem in crisis’ en ‘Ouders kunnen bij de kinderrechter niet meer rekenen op een eerlijk proces’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice about press reports alleging inconsistent judicial interpretation in youth-care cases, judges calling themselves 'chain partners', one-sided communication with youth-care bodies via the CORV system, and gaps in hearing rights for parents. The State Secretary largely defended current practice, said judicial independence is protected, acknowledged that parents should have access to all information and committed to discussing the CORV/procedural-communication issue with the judiciary, while pointing to planned legislation.
My starting point is that parents must have all information.
Mijn uitgangspunt is dat ouders moeten beschikken over alle informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koops en Bruyning over de rijdende rechter

MPs Koops and Bruyning asked the State Secretary of Justice whether ending funding for the Zeeland 'rijdende rechter' pilot by Samen Recht Vinden would undermine access to justice and court workload goals. The State Secretary replied that the organisation only received temporary project subsidies under the legal aid renewal programme, never structural funding, but that he would favourably consider a one-time bridging contribution for 2025 and that a regional legal aid network coordinator would be appointed by summer 2025.
At present I am awaiting a subsidy application from Samen Recht Vinden, on the basis of which I will kindly consider whether to grant a one-time bridging contribution in 2025.
Momenteel ben ik in afwachting van een subsidieaanvraag van Samen Recht Vinden naar aanleiding waarvan ik welwillend zal bezien of ik in 2025 nog éénmaal een overbruggingsbijdrage toe zal kennen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Bruyning over het bericht ‘Alarmerende stijging aantal jongeren in gevangenis voor volwassenen: ‘Onwenselijk’'

MP Bruyning asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the rise in young people, many of them pretrial detainees, held in adult prisons because of a shortage of youth detention places, and what would be done about it. The State Secretary confirmed the rise (29 to 308 between 2022 and 2024), attributed it to lack of cell and staff capacity, agreed with the Inspectorate that the situation is undesirable, and promised capacity expansions and a further update in March.
I agree with the Inspectorate that this is an undesirable situation.
Ik ben het met de Inspectie eens dat dit een onwenselijke situatie is.
