Antwoord op van het lid Bruyning over de Kamerbrief Inspectierapport incident pleegmeisje Vlaardingen

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the Vlaardingen foster-care case, the WSS screening of 3,300 files, long waiting lists and court rulings signalling structural child-safety problems in youth protection. The government answers that the case was a calamity with serious shortcomings but not isolated, that WSS found 64 files needing a new safety assessment (now completed), that it cannot compare earlier cases in detail yet, and that it has not itself ordered other certified institutions to conduct safety checks.
It was never our intention to present the calamity as a one-off, exceptional incident.
Het is niet onze bedoeling geweest de calamiteit te presenteren als een incident dat eenmalig en uitzonderlijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel 'Kinderrechten en de toetsende taak van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming'

An MP asks the Minister and State Secretaries whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, a government advisory body, should be stripped of its review role over non-extension of child protection measures in favour of an independent children's judge, citing ECHR Article 6 and a Dutch Juristenblad article. The State Secretary answers that the RvdK's review is lawful and independent, that the judge decides on extensions, that children are heard where possible, and that the current arrangement is not to be changed.
In case of doubt about the existence of grounds for extension, this can be submitted, with the final decision reserved for the judge.
Bij twijfel over het bestaan van gronden voor de verlenging, kan dit worden voorgelegd, waarbij het uiteindelijke besluit is voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het bericht ’Kabinet: gevangenissen vol, gedetineerden drie dagen eerder vrij’

The MP Bruyning asked whether prisoners are released three days early while only some offenders are excluded, whether a priority ranking applies by offence type, and whether weekly reporting is possible. The State Secretary confirmed the early release of three days for end-of-sentence prisoners at certain regimes due to prison overcrowding, stated no ranking by offence type is used, and offered quarterly capacity reports rather than weekly letters.
At the Chamber's request, a quarterly progress report on capacity is sent every three months.
Op verzoek van de Kamer wordt elke drie maanden een voortgangsrapportage over capaciteit gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het niet vervolgen van medewerkers van Woodbrookers naar aanleiding van aangiften van oud-cliënten

An MP asked the state secretaries why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute Woodbrookers staff after former clients filed complaints, and whether painful stimuli and physical force in closed youth care are permissible. The government answered that staff acted within the FMT protocols and the OM found no criminally culpable conduct, that painful stimuli are not permitted under the Jeugdwet, and that a CPT visit and a review of the complaints system are under way.
The OM examined to what extent the staff of the Woodbrookers treatment centre acted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and the protocols then in force relating to the FMT method.

Het OM heeft onderzocht in hoeverre de medewerkers van het behandelcentrum van Woodbrookers hebben gehandeld in overeenstemming met geldende wet- en regelgeving en de toen geldende protocollen die betrekking hadden op de FMT-methode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over een nieuwe Gesloten Jeugdzorginstelling in Friesland

An MP asks the state secretary about a new small closed youth care facility in Drachten, Friesland, and whether it fits the policy to phase out closed youth care, citing past abuses and a critical expert article. The state secretary answers that it is an interim step toward zero closed placements by 2030, a contract with Jeugdhulp Friesland runs to end 2025, and that the municipalities and the Inspectorate oversee quality.
The Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth (IGJ) supervises closed youth care.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) houdt toezicht op de (gesloten) jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel 'Onderzoek naar discriminatie bij Raad voor de Kinderbescherming hapert'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a newspaper report that independent research into discrimination at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming (child protection board) has stalled, and about whether independent research into the childcare benefits affair and child removals is adequate. The government answers that independent inquiries (Inspectie JenV, the Hamer commission, and internal reflection tracks) are underway, explains the delays and the planned scope of the Verwey-Jonker research, and says it will decide on further research once those reports are in.
Independent research is already being carried out.
Er is en wordt reeds onafhankelijk onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruyning en Jansen over het bericht ‘Zorg Curaçao op instorten: 'Rekening is onvermijdelijk voor Nederland'

MPs Bruyning and Jansen asked the State Secretaries about reports that the Curaçao Medical Center faces financial collapse and what it means for the Netherlands, including loans, support, and patient impact. The answers state Curaçao is responsible for healthcare, no request for aid has been received, Curaçao plans an additional ANG 253 million for 2025-2028, and several questions are answered as lacking information.
Healthcare is a country matter and therefore falls under the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Gezondheidszorg is een landsaangelegenheid en valt dus onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over kindgesprekken van kinderen bij rechters, naar aanleiding van de podcast ‘Scheidszaken’ van het Jeugdjournaal

MPs Bruyning asked about child interviews with judges in divorce cases, following a podcast and press reports saying judges have too little time (about 10 minutes) and are not trained for them, and about venues, letters, and information for children. The State Secretary answered that letters and information are standardised, that interviews aim for about 20 minutes in a child-friendly setting, that judges receive training, and that a juridical project group will advise by summer 2025.
The child judge takes the time that is needed.
De kinderrechter neemt de tijd die nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over pleegzorg

An MP asked the government about foster care screening after a case of a 10-year-old girl in Vlaardingen, covering the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming certificate, motives of prospective foster parents, periodic screening, Veilig Thuis procedures, and whether children are interviewed privately. The State Secretary answered each question in detail, describing existing procedures and periodic checks while committing to no new measures.
Ensuring safety is fundamental when placing a foster child in a (new) foster family.
Het borgen van de veiligheid is fundamenteel bij het plaatsen van een pleegkind in een (nieuw) pleeggezin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de rechtsbescherming van ouders en kinderen bij spoedverzoeken aan de kinderrechter

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inadequate legal protection of parents and children in urgent court applications for out-of-home placement, citing an article on procedural shortcomings and ECHR Articles 6 and 8. The minister acknowledged the need for improvement, pointed to a forthcoming bill (contours to Parliament in autumn 2024), an ongoing legal aid pilot to 31 December 2024, and ongoing fact-finding work, but declined to commit to immediate measures.
The contours of the bill will be communicated to the House in the autumn of this year.
Over de contouren van het wetsvoorstel wordt uw Kamer in het najaar van dit jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het onder verscherpt toezicht stellen van de ZIKOS-afdelingen Harreveld en Zetten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Inspectorate's decision to place two closed youth care (ZIKOS) departments under heightened supervision, and about unlawful restraint, suicidal youths, transfers and Woodbrookers. The State Secretary answered that heightened supervision runs six months with extra visits, that the Inspectorate is reflecting on its own supervision and that no further measures to strengthen it are planned.
The Inspectorate decided on its own initiative to reflect on its supervision of the ZIKOS departments.
De IGJ heeft op eigen initiatief besloten te reflecteren op haar toezicht op de ZIKOS-afdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het rapport ‘Eenzaam gesloten’ van Jason Bhugwandass

An MP asked the Minister and State Secretary about the 'Eenzaam gesloten' report on ZIKOS units in closed youth care, rights violations, the Woodbrookers reopening under a new name, and whether closed youth care should be phased out by 2030. The State Secretary answered that closed youth care is being transformed toward small-scale care, that former justice buildings will be divested by agreement with municipalities, that the Inspectorate's supervision is ongoing, and that closed placements remain necessary for a limited group of youths.
Until the inspection reports are published, the IGJ cannot go further into the findings and the supervision.
Tot de openbaarmaking van de inspectierapporten kan de IGJ niet verder ingaan op de bevindingen en het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de toepassing van de meldbriefprocedure en ondertoezichtstellingen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the use of the meldbrief procedure and child protection supervision orders (ondertoezichtstellingen), including the share of supervised children receiving no youth care, regional variation, and why the procedure was dropped without statutory anchoring. The minister gave detailed statistics, said the procedure is being abolished at all courts by 1 July, and explained that the procedure was never meant to be abolished when the legal basis was removed.
On 8 March, at the LOVF meeting, it was decided to abolish the meldbrief procedure at all courts.
Op 8 maart is tijdens de vergadering van het LOVF besloten de meldbriefprocedure bij alle gerechten af te schaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de meldbriefprocedure, die de rechtspraak gebruikt om zittingen te voorkomen als een verlenging van een ondertoezichtstelling of uithuisplaatsing wordt verzocht

MP Bruyning asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the meldbrief procedure, under which courts skip hearings in requests to extend child protection supervision or out-of-home placement, questioning its legal basis, its compliance with ECHR Article 6 and 8, and the effect on parents' access to court. The minister answered that roughly 30% of extension cases are decided without a hearing, that no data exist on whether help was provided, that the legal basis was kept via the Procesreglement, and that an alternative to the procedure is being sought.

The Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF), in consultation with my ministry, has indicated it gives high priority to finding an alternative to the meldbrief procedure in its current form.

Het Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF) heeft in overleg met mijn ministerie aangegeven hoge prioriteit te geven aan het zoeken naar een alternatief voor de meldbriefprocedure in de huidige vorm

m: Motie van het lid Eijsink c.s. over een stappenplan voor de personeelsdossiers
Asks the government to draw up a concrete step plan with timetable to fix Defence personnel files and send it to the House before the 2013 budget.
Requests the government to draw up a concrete step plan with timetable for putting personnel files in order and to send it to the House before the 2013 budget.

verzoekt de regering, inzake het op orde brengen van de personeelsdossiers een concreet stappenplan met bijbehorend tijdschema op te stellen en dit nog voor de begroting 2013 aan de Kamer toe te zenden
Amendement van de leden Leegte en Holtackers over het in het beheerplan rekening houden met de belangen van andere belanghebbenden dan alleen de deelnemers
Amendment requires the management plan for an area-based approach to consider effects on non-participating land, with monitoring and intervention measures.
The plan takes into account the effects of the area-based approach on land that is not part of it
In het plan wordt rekening gehouden met de gevolgen van de gebiedsgerichte aanpak voor terreinen die daarvan geen onderdeel uitmaken
qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Holtackers en Bruins Slot over het artikel ‘Utrecht verbant vieze auto’s uit centrum’

CDA MPs asked the state secretary whether Utrecht may ban older private cars from its centre under an environmental zone, how this relates to the national convenant, Amsterdam's earlier plan, proportionality, and exemptions for residents and low-income groups. The state secretary replied that municipalities are legally competent to create such zones, no national convenant exists for passenger cars, the Utrecht proposal is broadly comparable to Amsterdam's, and Utrecht will weigh air quality against motorists' interests.
Municipalities are legally competent to create environmental zones under the Road Traffic Act 1994.
Gemeenten zijn juridisch bevoegd om in het kader van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 milieuzones in het leven te roepen.
Antwoord vragen Koppejan en Holtackers over de stand van zaken op het gebied van meting van actuele grondwaterstanden

MPs Koppejan and Holtackers asked the state secretaries about recent developments in measuring groundwater levels, the independence of DLO research, the reliability of piezometer data and the NHI model. The government answered that the Alterra report on groundwater measurement is attached, that it sees no societal damage from possible measurement errors, and that screening of piezometers for soil structure is not centrally available and is the responsibility of provinces and water boards.
This detailed information is not centrally registered, and collecting it across a large variety of projects is very labour-intensive.
Deze detailinformatie wordt niet centraal geregistreerd en het verzamelen daarvan bij een grote verscheidenheid aan projecten is zeer arbeidsintensief.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf en Holtackers over het bericht “teruggestuurd oud-papier”

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about reports that China returned contaminated waste paper shipments to the Netherlands, asking about inspections, enforcement, export trends and new policy. The government answered that the containers were verified and sampled, that the enforcement issues stem from a criminal investigation and a court ruling on ILT policy rules, and that no new policy is planned beyond pursuing EU-level harmonisation.

In the criminal investigation referred to in the reporting in question 1, it has been suspected that the company concerned mixed waste paper for export to Asia with other (household) waste and concealed the true nature of the waste.

In het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waar de berichtgeving uit vraag 1 naar verwijst, is het vermoeden gerezen dat het betrokken bedrijf papierafval voor de export naar Azië heeft vermengd met ander (huishoudelijk) afval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Holtackers en Omtzigt over het bericht “Problemen Odfjell zijn er na 30 jaar kennelijk nog steeds”,

MPs Holtackers and Omtzigt asked about news reports on safety problems at Odfjell's Rotterdam tank storage site, including the changing deadline for emptying tanks, past fire-line testing and enforcement, and whether DCMR's oversight will be investigated. The state secretary explained the deadline extension for safety reasons, noted that the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) is investigating, and gave limited information on past live testing, saying the rest should be left to that investigation.
I do not want to obstruct the OVV in gathering information, so I limit my answers to information that is directly available and sufficiently valid.
Ik wil de OVV niet in de weg zitten met het vergaren van informatie, zodat ik de beantwoording van de vragen beperk tot die informatie die direct voor handen is en voldoende valide is.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over mogelijke illegale asbestopslag

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports of possibly illegal asbestos storage at an Enschede demolition firm, including whether the inspectorate had acted and whether abolishing the landfill tax and planned asbestos landfill ban could encourage illegal storage. The state secretary answered that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority, that the inspectorate has no enforcement role here, that no signals link the tax change to illegal storage, and that illegal asbestos storage is not considered a structural problem.
The ILT has no supervisory and enforcement role in this case.
De ILT heeft in deze zaak geen controlerende en handhavende rol.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Holtackers en Knops over de aanbieding energiecontract Veteraneninstituut

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Defence about a commercial energy-contract mailing to veteran-pass holders that carried the Veterans Institute's logo and was co-signed by its director, and whether this was acceptable and how privacy is protected. The Minister answered that the Institute is independent, the mailing costs were borne by the energy company, the commercial action is a less desirable development he will raise with the director, and veterans' data remain private via a separate address file.
The commercial action mentioned in the question is a less desirable development. I will call the director of the Veterans Institute to account for it.
De commerciële actie die in de vraag wordt genoemd, is een minder goede ontwikkeling. Ik zal de directeur van het Veteraneninstituut daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen Knops en Holtackers over averij bij proefvaart rubberboot mariniers

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence Minister about reported damage (broken seats, torn upholstery, a broken windscreen, bent rails) during sea trials of the FRISC rubber boat for the Marines, and whether the supplier would bear repair costs and whether delays affected operations. The minister answered that the defects are being fixed at the supplier's expense under the contract, that eleven vessels have been delivered, that all remaining vessels will be tested before operational use, and that the delays did not impede Marines or Coast Guard operations.
Defence does not accept vessels that have not been tested.
Defensie accepteert geen vaartuigen die niet zijn getest.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf en Holtackers over het terugsturen van afval door Indonesië

MPs Van der Werf and Holtackers asked the state secretary about hazardous waste containers returned by Indonesia, whether their contents matched the export documentation, which substances were found, the Dutch share, responsible companies, the roles of the ministry and Agentschap NL, and whether more containers were involved. The state secretary answered that the 24 Dutch containers, documented as scrap metal under the green list, were exported without a permit under the EVOA; contents will be assessed by the ILT on return, companies may face measures, and no further Dutch containers are signalled.
The contents of the containers will be assessed upon their return to the Netherlands.
De inhoud van de containers wordt bij terugkomst in Nederland beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Holtackers over het artikel “Aannemers geven uitleg – bijeenkomst moet zorgen wegnemen"

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the contractor on the Noordwaard 'Ruimte voor de Rivier' project would bring in external soil despite a planned closed soil balance, and whether thermally cleaned soil is suitable near homes. The state secretary answered that logistics explain the external soil, that Deltares did not draw the conclusions cited, that thermally cleaned soil is acceptable under the soil quality decree, and that after residents' concerns Rijkswaterstaat agreed no such soil will be used in the new dwelling mounds.
To rule out this risk, Rijkswaterstaat, in good consultation with the residents concerned, has decided that no thermally cleaned soil will be applied in the dwelling mounds yet to be built.
Om dit risico uit te sluiten heeft Rijkswaterstaat in goed overleg met betreffende bewoners besloten dat er geen thermisch gereinigde grond zal worden toegepast in de nog aan te leggen terpen.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers over niet uitgereikte onderscheidingen aan Libanon-veteranen

MP Holtackers asked the Defence Minister whether Lebanese decorations for Dutch UNIFIL troops, the 1988 UN Nobel Peace Prize, and the 1983 Bronze Shield award were withheld from veterans, and whether they could be issued or recognised. The minister replied that the Lebanese order went to three officers in 1984 without a general intent to decorate all troops, that no new Dutch medal for the Nobel Prize is planned, and that the Shield was given only to the battalion with the existing Lebanon medal considered sufficient recognition.
I therefore see no reason to expand the decoration system following the award of the Nobel Peace Prize.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om naar aanleiding van de toekenning van de Nobelprijs voor de Vrede het decoratiestelsel uit te breiden.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over het benzeenconcentratie op het meetpunt A15 Botlek

Two MPs from the CDA asked why a brief benzene peak of 75 µg/m³ at the A15 Botlek measuring point on 4 February 2012 was not reported more promptly, whether a company caused it, and what follow-up supervision applies. The state secretary answered that the annual EU limit does not apply to short peaks, that DCMR investigated and linked the peak to a frost-related gas release at an NAM installation, and that SodM as mining supervisor is examining the causes.

Following the benzene peak and the concern it caused, the procedure has been extended: for certain high benzene peaks, such as that of Saturday 4 February, the DCMR publishes a notice on its website as quickly as possible with information about the investigation.

Naar aanleiding van de benzeenpiek en de onrust die dat gaf, is de procedure uitgebreid: bij bepaalde hoge benzeenpieken, zoals die van zaterdag 4 februari, publiceert de DCMR zo snel mogelijk een melding op de website met informatie over het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over het bedrijf Odfjell

MPs Holtackers and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the state secretary about chemical storage firm Odfjell: the 64 inspection violations, details of leaks, why the firm was left out of a quickscan, inspection frequency, whether inspectors avoided the site, and cost recovery. The state secretary answered in detail, giving violation and leak tables and inspection history, declined to publish reports (left to the competent authority), said cost recovery needs a law change, and gave no guarantee of safety.
It is up to the competent authority concerned to make the reports public, observing the rules that apply to publication.
Het is aan het betrokken bevoegd gezag om de rapporten openbaar te maken met in achtneming van de voor openbaarmaking geldende regels.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers over de wateroverlast in Groningen

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about flooding in several Groningen villages, whether it was exceptional, what measures are needed for dikes and water storage, and the effect of German flood measures. The state secretary answered that the situation was a combination of circumstances rather than exceptional, that regional water authorities and provinces are responsible for dikes and storage, a decision on an extra pumping station is expected by mid-2012, and German measures would lower river levels in the Netherlands.
Regional water defences must meet certain standards regarding height, strength and stability.
Regionale waterkeringen dienen te voldoen aan bepaalde normen ten aanzien van hoogte, sterkte en stabiliteit.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Van der Werf over het artikel Asbest-overtreders niet gepakt

CDA MPs asked whether the Labour Inspectorate withheld damaging information about asbestos removal firms from certifying bodies, leading to wrongful certification, and what the cause was. The State Secretary denied any refusal, said a 2009 information-sharing protocol could be improved and will be replaced by a new certification system from 1 February 2012, and announced stricter enforcement and a joint chain approach.
No. In March 2009 the Labour Inspectorate concluded a protocol with the certifying bodies to exchange information mutually on how certified firms function.
Nee. De Arbeidsinspectie heeft in maart 2009 een protocol met de certificerende instellingen gesloten om wederzijds informatie uit te wisselen over het functioneren van de gecertificeerden.
Vragen van het lid Holtackers (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een botel (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

The MP asks whether the minister will cooperate with a hotel boat (botel) proposed in Woudrichem, arguing its effect on river discharge capacity is minimal and that the Beleidslijn grote rivieren should be read less narrowly. The state secretary says talks with the municipality are ongoing, that local initiatives should be treated positively in principle, but that works in the riverbed need a Waterwet permit and the policy rules only allow such uses under strict river-hydraulic conditions.
I am still in discussion with the municipality about these plans.
Over deze plannen ben ik nog in gesprek met de gemeente.

Vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Koopmans en Holtackers (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over begroeiing van de uiterwaarden (ingezonden 23

CDA MPs asked why the cabinet plans to spend 75 million euro on removing vegetation in the river floodplains for flood safety, where the money comes from, whether other financing options were considered, and why a new law rather than existing frameworks is proposed. The state secretary answered that the one-off budget comes from the infrastructure fund, that the Waterwet will be amended to oblige landowners to maintain vegetation so it does not raise water levels, and that the cabinet is following a 2009 parliamentary motion while coordinating with the ministry of Economic Affairs on Natura 2000 aspects.
In my view, owners of land in the floodplains must themselves maintain the vegetation growing on it so that it does not form an unacceptable obstacle to river discharge.
Naar mijn mening dienen rechthebbenden van gronden in de uiterwaarden de daarop groeiende vegetatie zelf zodanig te onderhouden dat deze geen ontoelaatbare belemmering voor de rivierafvoer vormt.
Vragen van het lid Holtackers (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «KNMI weersvoorspelling slaat plank mis, recreant blijft weg» (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether KNMI weather forecasts that wrongly predicted bad weather, deterring visitors from outdoor events like the Nijmegen Four Days March, should be regionalised and event-specific. The state secretary replies that the KNMI gives a general national forecast by law, that regional and event forecasts are for private weather companies, and that regionalised warnings are issued only for safety or extreme weather.
The KNMI issues a general weather report, as stipulated in the Act on the KNMI.
Het KNMI geeft een algemeen weerbericht, zoals is bepaald in de Wet op het KNMI.

qn: Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat ICTRegie mogelijk dreigt te verdwijnen (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether reports that the ICTRegie innovation bureau would be discontinued were accurate, and what considerations justified ending its subsidy amid budget cuts. The minister confirmed the mandate would not be extended after 31 December 2010, citing the final evaluation's finding that structural strengthening of ICT research was not achieved and that conditions for effective coordination were absent.
The mandate of ICTRegie will not be extended after 31 December 2010.
Het mandaat van ICTRegie zal na 31 december 2010 niet worden verlengd.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de kwaliteit van de postbezorging (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether whole neighbourhoods receive late or no post and whether TNT Post is fulfilling its universal service duty, given that the latest quality measurement dates from last year. The minister replies that the internal memo does not prove whole neighbourhoods are affected, that TNT reported 96.4% next-day delivery for 2009 meeting the 95% norm, and that regulator OPTA is investigating and may use its formal powers if needed.
I have asked OPTA to take up the investigation expeditiously and to inform me of the result as soon as possible.
Ik heb OPTA verzocht het onderzoek met voortvarendheid op te pakken en mij zo spoedig mogelijk over het resultaat te informeren.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid Zaken over de mislukte concurrentie in de postsector en de falende postbezorging (ingezonden 17 september

An SP MP asked the ministers whether OPTA's investigation into TNT's postal delivery failures, the 95% next-day norm, and the consequences of market liberalisation would be reported on, and whether liberalisation had failed. The minister said OPTA is investigating and will report, that TNT reports 96.4% next-day delivery for 2009, that OPTA can take formal measures if the norm is missed, and that the government still supports market opening.
OPTA in principle does not make statements about ongoing investigations, including on the further duration of the investigation.
OPTA doet in beginsel geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken, ook niet over de verdere duur van het onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over subsidies van het Europees Sociaal Fonds (ESF) aan TNT ter waarde van meer dan vier miljoen euro (ing

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the content, cost and history of European Social Fund subsidies to TNT, including whether subsidised projects replace permanent staff with flex workers. The minister answered that the ESF projects train hard-to-place job seekers for postal delivery roles, that TNT's reorganisation is separate and staff are offered permanent part-time jobs, and listed ESF subsidies and TNT training projects over the past decade.
From that information it has become clear to me that it is not the case that permanent staff are being replaced by flex workers.
Uit die informatie is mij gebleken dat het niet zo is dat vaste krachten worden vervangen door flexwerkers.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de mogelijke overname van Crucell door Johnson & Johnson (ingezonden 22 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister whether the planned takeover of Leiden biotech firm Crucell by Johnson & Johnson is desirable, whether the state or universities hold shares or received proceeds, what subsidies Crucell received, and how to prevent knowledge and patents leaving the Netherlands. The minister called the takeover a good development, said the government holds no shares and sees no reason for state participation, reported EUR 11.6 million in subsidies for 2003-2009 while withholding WBSO tax details as confidential, and said no knowledge drain is occurring since Crucell will become Johnson & Johnson's vaccine centre.
The government holds no shares in Crucell.
De overheid heeft geen aandelen in Crucell.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, aanvullende vraag over de mogelijke overname van Crucell door Johnson & Johnson (ingezonden 22 september 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the reported 11.9 million euro payout to Crucell's CEO upon takeover by Johnson & Johnson could compromise company interests, and whether this conflicts with the Tang/Irrgang amendment. The minister replied that assessing whether personal financial interest harms company interests is not for her, noting that commissioners and shareholders also judge this and that takeover legislation must be respected.
It is not for me to assess whether, due to a personal financial interest, the company's interest is jeopardised.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of door een persoonlijk financieel belang het bedrijfsbelang in het gedrang komt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de mislukte concurrentie in de post en het gebruik van aanhangwagentjes als postdepot door TNT (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about TNT using trailers in a car park as mobile postal depots, whether post stored there is adequately protected against theft and whether this is decent for workers lacking basic facilities. The minister replied that mobile depots are a temporary fallback agreed with the works council, that about 20 are in use with security features, that OPTA is investigating careful handling of post including this aspect, and that depots are only brief pick-up points where workers spend about 10 minutes.
I have asked OPTA to include the aspect of mobile depots in the investigation.
Ik heb OPTA gevraagd het aspect van mobiele depots mee te nemen in het onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de berichten dat vanwege onderbezetting er regelmatig post blijft staan bij TNT en dat de leiding van TNT sjoemelt met post (ingezonden 30 sep

The MP asks the minister for her reaction to reports that understaffing at TNT leaves mail undelivered and that management manipulates mail, and whether OPTA can include this in its investigation, and whether the market liberalisation has failed. The minister says OPTA is already investigating mail left unattended and the 95% next-day delivery norm, that the management reports are TNT's internal matter, and that the problems have varied causes and she still supports postal market opening.
OPTA has indicated that in its investigation into TNT Post's mail delivery it will possibly also take into account TNT Post not meeting the 95% norm.
OPTA heeft aangegeven in het onderzoek naar de postbezorging door TNT Post het mogelijk door TNT Post niet voldoen aan de 95%-norm mee te zullen nemen.

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over weinig energiebesparing in de Nederlandse energie-intensieve industrie (ingezonden 12 ju

An MP asked the minister why energy-intensive industry saved too little energy despite receiving energy tax discounts, and whether this affects government policy and the tax differentiation. The minister said firms had not clearly broken agreements, acknowledged efficiency lagged expectations, noted a new 2009 agreement and that the 2010 plans are still to be assessed, and declined to change policy or conclude a causal link to tax rates, leaving tax differentiation to a future cabinet.
Should it appear that certain firms do not keep their agreements, they will be removed from the covenant and lose their exemption for energy use above 10 million kWh.
Mocht blijken dat bepaalde bedrijven hun afspraken niet nakomen, dan zullen zij uit het convenant worden gezet en hun vrijstelling voor het energieverbruik boven 10 miljoen kWh verliezen.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het rapport «Convenant Benchmarking Energie-efficiency»: resultaten en vrijstelling

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Housing about a CE Delft report finding that energy-efficiency gains under the Benchmarking covenant lagged behind expectations and that energy-tax exemptions were poorly targeted. The minister partly agrees with the findings, argues firms did not breach their commitments, notes the covenant was replaced by the 2009 ETS agreement, and declines to commit to the report's recommendations pending a new cabinet.
I see no reason in the research, which concerns a covenant that was replaced by new agreements in October 2009, to change government policy on this point.
Ik zie in het onderzoek, dat ziet op een convenant dat inmiddels in oktober 2009 is vervangen door nieuwe afspraken, geen aanleiding om het regeringsbeleid op dit punt te wijzigen.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over uitbuiting door toeleveranciers van C&A en H&M

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of labour exploitation at Indian suppliers of C&A and H&M, including whether the company-certified supplier KPR Mills should be scrutinised more critically, whether the government would engage the retailers and the Indian government, and whether high-risk countries and sectors should be added to a risk list. The reply is only a holding notice: the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because consultation with stakeholders and interdepartmental coordination are still under way, and answers will follow as soon as possible.
Consultation with stakeholders and interdepartmental coordination are still ongoing.
Overleg met belanghebbenden en interdepartementale afstemming zijn nog gaande.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen van gemeenten en provincies om een tweede kerncentrale in B

An MP from GroenLinks asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment about plans by provinces and municipalities (Energy Resources Holding) to build a second nuclear plant at Borssele, raising competition, public subsidy, renewable targets, grid demand and nuclear waste. The government's reply is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because interdepartmental consultation is ongoing, and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
cannot be answered within the set deadline because interdepartmental consultation is ongoing
lopende interdepartementale afstemming niet binnen de daarvoor gestelde termijn kunnen worden beantwoord

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitbuiting van Indiase textielarbeiders door C&A en H&M (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

CDA MPs Ormel and Ferrier asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about reports that Indian textile workers supplying C&A and H&M were paid a fraction of the minimum wage and had wages withheld for dowries, asking for the government's view, pressure on the retailers and Indian authorities, and the role of corporate social responsibility. The government replied only that the questions could not be answered within the usual period because consultations with stakeholders and interdepartmental coordination were still ongoing, and promised answers as soon as possible.
Consultation with stakeholders and interdepartmental coordination are still ongoing.
Overleg met belanghebbenden en interdepartementale afstemming zijn nog gaande.

Vragen van de leden Aptroot en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en Economische Zaken over het artikel «Duopolie op komst in openbaar busvervoer» (ingezonden 18 augustus 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked ministers whether the government assesses the proposed Transdev-Veolia merger in public bus transport, whether the market is closing to smaller entrants, and what the policy is on competition given NS subsidiary Qbuzz. The ministers answered that the NMa is conducting an in-depth review requiring a licence, that the policy is set out in WP2000 and a pending amendment, that NS Internationaal is commercially independent with no subsidy, and that the market remains open to new entrants.
The NMa is currently conducting an in-depth investigation into the consequences of the merger.
De NMa voert momenteel een diepgaand onderzoek uit naar de gevolgen van de fusie.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over proefboringen naar «onconventioneel gas» (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

An MP asks the ministers about shale and coal-seam gas exploration: how many permits exist, the role of EBN, chemical risks to groundwater, US incidents, landscape impact, public opposition and CO2 emissions. The ministers answer that four exploration permits were granted, that chemicals are regulated under REACH and Arbo law with SodM oversight, and that Dutch impacts and energy use cannot be assessed until drilling occurs.
The composition of the chemicals is often a trade secret, because it partly determines the success and effectiveness of fracking.
De samenstelling van de chemicaliën is vaak bedrijfsgeheim, omdat deze mede het succes en de effectiviteit van het «kraken» bepaalt.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat JSF-bedrijven een korting van 245 miljoen euro van de overheid ontvangen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about a press report that JSF industry partners would receive a 245 million euro discount, and whether this breaks the promise that taxpayers would pay nothing. The minister rejected the press framing, explaining the sum combined four unrelated items and that the remaining 52.1 million was offset by cuts in the ministries' budgets, and declined to send the documents, pointing to prior parliamentary information and public WOB disclosure.
I do not recognise the presentation of the matter in the article in question.
Ik herken mij niet in de voorstelling van zaken in het desbetreffende artikel.
Vragen van de leden Eijsink en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Defensie over de herijking van de business case JSF (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

MPs Eijsink and Smeets asked about alleged industry influence on the 2008 recalculation of the JSF business case, why parliament was not informed of the 2008 court action, and the balance of costs and benefits of the MFO repayment arrangement. The ministers answered that the recalculation followed the MFO, parliament was kept informed, the court case was withdrawn without affecting the outcome, and the MFO shortfall is recovered through an agreed levy.
The House has been continuously informed about the relevant outcomes of and follow-up steps in this process.
De Kamer is voortdurend geïnformeerd over de relevante uitkomsten van en de vervolgstappen in dit proces.

Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA), Jansen (SP), Neppérus (VVD) en Samsom (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het waterkrachtproject Borgharen (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Borgharen hydropower project on the Maas, its SDE subsidy eligibility, permit progress and whether the 1 November 2010 SDE deadline could be extended. The minister said the project fits the SDE hydropower criteria, that permits were lagging, and that she is willing to move the hydropower deadline to 31 December 2010 if more time is needed.
I am willing to move the closing date for the hydropower category from 1 November 2010 to 31 December 2010, if it is established that more time is needed to obtain the permits.

Daarom ben ik bereid om de sluitingsdatum voor de categorie waterkracht te verschuiven van 1 november 2010 naar 31 december 2010, indien vast komt te staan dat meer tijd nodig is om de vergunningen rond te krijgen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Dikkers (PvdA) en Veldhoven-Van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de probleme

Five MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil extraction problems in Nigeria, following a Zembla broadcast and an Amnesty International report, and whether the Dutch government will intensify its efforts and respond to a UNEP-related case. The ministers answered that Nederland supports EITI transparency, a human rights fund, and dialogue with Shell and the Nigerian government, will intensify efforts where needed, will contact UNEP's Ogoniland program head, and will await UNEP's report before drawing conclusions.
Where necessary, these efforts will be further intensified.
Waar nodig zullen deze inspanningen verder worden geïntensiveerd.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de mislukte concurrentie in de post en het bericht dat de postzegel duurder wordt (ingezonden 3 september 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why postage stamp prices rise again despite full postal market liberalisation, and whether this shows competition has failed. The minister answered that the 4.5% rise is within the consumer price index cap under the Postal Act 2009, which OPTA has verified, that other postal problems have different causes, and that the government still supports market opening.
OPTA supervises this and has established that the planned tariff change meets the legal requirements.
OPTA ziet hierop toe en heeft geconstateerd dat de voorgenomen tariefswijziging voldoet aan de wettelijke eisen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het Boxmeerse diergeneesmiddelenbedrijf Intervet (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asks the Economics minister whether Intervet's headquarters and research arm may leave the Netherlands after Organon, whether Intervet was raised with Merck's CEO, and what the government will do to keep it and knowledge jobs in the country. The minister says the merger with Merial is undecided, that the Netherlands has been put forward as a headquarters location, and that the government will not intervene in company decisions but will work on a Life Sciences policy and inform parliament via a progress report.
Because of the sale of Intervet to Schering Plough in 2007 and the merger of Merck and Schering Plough, responsibility for these activities and informing stakeholders lies with the Merck group.

Door de verkoop van Intervet aan Schering Plough in 2007 en de fusie van Merck en Schering Plough ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor deze activiteiten en het informeren van de stakeholders bij het Merck concern.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitspraken van de president-commissaris van Organon (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asked ministers whether MSD had formally informed the supervisory board and works council of Organon BioSciences about closing its R&D department in Oss, and how worker participation and collective dismissal rules apply. The minister answered that the Works Councils Act and Civil Code require advice and supervisory board approval, that MSD has postponed its plans to 31 December 2010, and that a taskforce is exploring a Science Park option.
Article 25 of the Works Councils Act (WOR) requires the employer to request advice from the works council on a proposed decision such as the closure of a company.

Artikel 25 van de Wet op de ondernemingsraden (WOR) bepaalt dat de ondernemer verplicht is over een voorgenomen besluit ten aanzien van bijvoorbeeld de sluiting van een bedrijf advies aan te vragen aan de ondernemingsraad.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over steun aan strijd tegen ontslagen bij Organon (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether the government will support the supervisory board and works council of Organon in their fight against layoffs at the company. The minister replies that the government is responsible only for the legal framework, courts test compliance, and the government stays out of direct company relations, while it does work to preserve activities and jobs.
The government plays no role in the direct contacts between a company and its supervisory board or works council.
De overheid speelt geen rol in de directe contacten tussen een onderneming en haar raad van commissarissen of ondernemingsraad.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van Advanta en Bejo Zaden bij kinderarbeid in India (ingezonden 21 j

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked ministers about child labour in Indian vegetable and cotton seed production linked to Dutch firms Advanta and Bejo Zaden, and whether the government would condemn them, act on subsidies, raise the issue bilaterally and in the EU-India trade deal, and investigate the sector. The ministers answered that they expect firms to follow OECD guidelines, that Bejo is taking dialogue and remedial steps and Advanta's Dutch arm does not source from India, and that they see no need for sector-wide agreements or a separate investigation, while committing to raise the issue bilaterally where useful and to pursue human rights provisions in the EU-India agreement.
In our view both companies are using the opportunities they have to contribute to eliminating child labour in their supply chain.
Naar onze mening benutten beide bedrijven de mogelijkheden die zij hebben om bij te dragen aan de uitbanning van kinderarbeid in hun keten.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het artikel «Verlaag het tarief voor analoge kabeltelevisie» (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether OPTA's underspending on its core task of competition promotion, and its court-annulled cable decisions, reflect poorly on the regulator and whether cable operators' network monopoly should be broken. The minister replies that OPTA's overall cuts were balanced, that the underspend was offset by higher market-analysis spending, that OPTA is effective and ranked first in Europe, and that market definition and market power are for the independent regulator to decide.
I want to emphasise first of all that I have no reason to doubt the effectiveness of OPTA's functioning.
Ik wil in de eerste plaats benadrukken dat ik geen aanleiding heb om te twijfelen aan de doeltreffendheid van het functioneren van OPTA.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «EZ stelt energiebeleid bij wegens economie» (ingezonden 30 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that energy policy was being revised, including whether the 2020 CO2 target had been lowered, renewable energy obligations for utilities, nuclear waste, and nuclear energy's role. The minister denied changing the CO2 target, said the cheapest renewable options should be subsidised or obliged, defended keeping nuclear energy open, and left the decision on new nuclear plants to the next cabinet.
It is up to the next cabinet to decide whether or not to allow new nuclear power plants, including the conditions under which this policy should be implemented.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om wel of geen nieuwe kerncentrales toe te staan, inclusief de condities waaronder dit beleid zou moeten worden geëffectueerd.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de onderhandelingsronde over het ACTA-verdrag in Washington van 16 tot 20 augustus 2010 (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

MP Peters (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the August 2010 ACTA negotiation round in Washington, including the topics discussed, the lack of transparency, the possible effects on internet providers, privacy, generic medicines and Dutch law. The minister answered that the negotiation text cannot be published under participants' confidentiality rules, though participants agreed to publish the full text before signature, and that ACTA is not expected to require new Dutch legislation or go beyond the existing EU acquis.
The Netherlands cannot unilaterally break the agreements on limited disclosure, but the Netherlands has always strongly pushed for publication of the draft text.
Nederland kan de afspraken over beperkte openbaarheid helaas niet eenzijdig doorbreken, maar Nederland heeft zich altijd sterk gemaakt voor openbaarmaking van de concept-tekst.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de toezegging van SDE subsidie aan twee offshore windmolenparken van de BARD groep (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the BARD-linked offshore wind projects ZeeEnergie and Buitengaats, granted SDE subsidy, can realistically be built within five years despite no financing, grid connection agreement or bank guarantee, and why the permit-revocation option was not used. The minister answered that the SDE agreements impose fines and bank guarantees on the project companies, that the grid connection is still being arranged, that the feasibility assessment found no reason to doubt the five-year timeline, and promised annual progress updates to parliament.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over een rechterlijke uitspraak inzake de toepassing van de Winkeltijdenwet in Rotterdam (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a Hague appeals court ruling allowing Rotterdam's Alexandrium shops to open every Sunday undermines the Shop Opening Hours Act, and whether the minister will amend the law to close the tourism-exception loophole. The minister answered that courts interpret the law, that the court ruling is authoritative, and that a pending bill to give municipalities more guidance is before the Senate, though the House has no support for changing the law on this point.
It is for the judge to interpret the law.
Het is aan de rechter om de wet uit te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de gebrekkige werking van de toerismebepaling in de Winkeltijdenwet (ingezonden 10 augustus 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Economic Affairs minister how to address the court ruling that let a shop open on Sundays under the tourism clause of the Winkeltijdenwet, whether the amendment is adequate, and what the effects on competition and freedom of contract are. The minister answers that the amendment adds a 'substantial scale' requirement, that the ruling does not create a snowball effect, that no broader change to the law has parliamentary support, and that shop opening remains the retailer's own choice.
Under the bill, there must be autonomous tourism of substantial scale in the municipality.
Op grond van het wetsvoorstel moet er sprake zijn van autonoom toerisme van substantiële omvang in de gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het Boxmeerse diergeneesmiddelenbedrijf Intervet (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

The SP MP Ulenbelt asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the head office and research arm of Intervet (Boxmeer) may leave the Netherlands after Organon, threatening 170 jobs, and what the government is doing to prevent it, including its stance toward Merck and the French Merial, and whether the Chamber will be informed before irreversible decisions. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will take longer than the usual three weeks and will follow in early September 2010, taking recent developments into account.
The reply to the questions of MP Ulenbelt (SP) on Intervet and Organon will take more than the usual 3 weeks.
De beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) over Intervet en Organon ... zal meer dan de gebruikelijke 3 weken in beslag nemen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitspraken van de president-commissaris van Organon (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

Ulenbelt (SP) asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether MSD has informed the Organon supervisory board and works council about closing the R&D unit in Oss, whether works council rights were respected, whether collective dismissal has been filed, and whether a Science Park and works council participation are possible. The minister's interim reply says the answers will take longer than usual and will follow in early September 2010, taking into account recent developments and the Ondernemingskamer hearing.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over steun aan strijd tegen ontslagen bij Organon (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government will support the Supervisory Board and Works Council of Organon in their opposition to the dismissals there. The minister only issues an interim notice that the answers will take longer than usual and will be sent in early September 2010, so the substantive question is not yet answered.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken over een financiële bijdrage van de gemeente Papendrecht voor de komst van een fabriek van Stork Fokker (ingezonden 6 juli 20

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the municipality of Papendrecht's financial contribution, including land and hall lease constructions, to a Stork Fokker JSF parts factory constitutes state aid and whether the factory fits the JSF-testing motion. The minister answered that the municipality autonomously bid, self-assessed the state-aid rules as not applicable, and bears responsibility for its offer, with BZK only coordinating if a notification is needed.
The autonomy of Dutch subnational governments means they are themselves responsible for their offers and for correctly complying with the state-aid rules.
De autonomie van de Nederlandse decentrale overheden maakt dat zij zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun aanbiedingen en de correcte naleving van de staatssteunregels.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de toezegging van SDE subsidie aan twee offshore windmolenparken van de BARD groep (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs about SDE subsidy granted to two offshore wind farms of BARD group despite unclear financing, grid connection and bank guarantees, and about the risk of unused permits and whether the ministry will report on progress. The minister announces a delayed, inter-departmental reply to be sent before the end of the summer recess.
For that reason I am unable to answer these questions by 17 August.
Om die reden lukt het mij niet deze vragen voor 17 augustus aanstaande te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het budget van Nederland Open in Verbinding (NOiV) (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about conflicting press reports on the NOiV (Nederland Open in Verbinding) budget, its yearly figures, and the use of external staff and procurement. The minister explains the budget was raised above the original 5.5 million euro because of needs, gives a yearly budget and spending table, and states that ICTU, which runs the programme, is not part of central government so the 10 percent external-staffing norm does not apply.
ICTU is not part of central government and therefore does not fall under the government norm.
ICTU is geen onderdeel van de rijksoverheid en valt daarmee niet onder de rijksnorm.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over het plan om gasolie op te slaan in Twentse zoutholtes (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked ministers whether the reported plan to store gas oil in Twente salt caverns is factually correct, whether such storage has precedent abroad, whether groundwater is monitored, whether it is legally possible in the Netherlands and whether any permit applications exist. The minister confirmed the facts, described precedent in the US and Germany, said no groundwater monitoring is done abroad, explained the Mijnbouwwet permit and consent framework, and confirmed one permit application by AkzoNobel.
Yes. Oil storage in salt cavities is in principle possible.
Ja. Olieopslag in zoutholtes is in beginsel mogelijk.
Vragen van de leden Elias en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over een nieuwe clausule in de privacyvoorwaarden van Apple (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MPs Elias and Hennis-Plasschaert asked the economics minister whether she knew Apple's new privacy clause allowing collection, use and sale of user location data, and whether anonymised data can be traced to individuals. The minister confirmed awareness, said the CBP may assess lawfulness, and referred the questions to the Ministry of Justice for review by the CBP.
I have therefore referred the issue to the Ministry of Justice.
Ik heb het vraagstuk daarom doorgeleid naar het Ministerie van Justitie
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het betaalgedrag van gemeenten en de openbaarheid van dat betaalgedrag (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

The SP MP Gesthuizen asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why she concludes that publicizing municipal payment behaviour has a positive effect, given that few municipalities responded to MKB Nederland's survey, and whether the government should request payment data itself. The minister replies that the respondents are not reason to doubt representativeness, that the central government lacks authority over municipalities so it will only write to the VNG about transparency and 30-day payment terms, and that suppliers should enforce payment terms through contracts.

However, given the great importance of good payment behaviour and the limited number of participating municipalities, I will, in consultation with the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations, write to the Association of Dutch Municipalities to draw attention to the importance of (more) transparency about and the use of a reasonable payment term.

Wel zal ik – vanwege het grote belang van goed betalingsgedrag en in het licht van het beperkte aantal meewerkende gemeentes – in overleg met de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten per brief attenderen op het belang van (meer) transparantie over en het hanteren van een redelijke betaaltermijn.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische en van Zaken en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de grootschalige ontslagen bij MSD/Organon te Oss (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MPs Hamer and Spekman asked ministers about the mass layoffs at MSD/Organon in Oss, including urgent action to limit damage, short-term help for those losing jobs, UWV anticipation of job seekers, and contact with the municipality of Oss. The government answered that it agrees the job losses are serious, that consultations involving the government and other parties are underway to preserve jobs and knowledge via two working groups, that UWV is closely involved, and that it is not yet clear which employees become redundant.
At this moment it is not yet clear for which employees redundancy will arise.
Op dit moment is nog niet duidelijk voor welke medewerkers boventalligheid ontstaat.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het vertrek van MSD (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government responds to MSD's withdrawal of much of its Oss operations, whether it knew of the plans, what causes lie behind the departure, and what it will do to retain knowledge-intensive jobs and support affected workers. The minister regrets the cuts, reports intensified contacts with MSD and working groups to retain jobs and knowledge, cites the company's own complaints about R&D funding and regulation, and promises to deploy job-placement instruments while stating that the decision was driven mainly by group-level strategy.
The cabinet realises that the plans hit the affected employees hard.
Het kabinet beseft dat de plannen voor de getroffen medewerkers hard aankomen.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over het mogelijk verdwijnen van banen bij het farmaceutisch bedrijf MSD in Oss (ingez

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that MSD in Oss could lose more than half of its 4,500 jobs, including relocation of R&D abroad. The government confirmed R&D moves to the US and an expected loss of about 2,175 jobs in Oss, while production stays, and described efforts with the province, municipality and UWV to support affected workers and explore the European Globalisation Fund.
As a result of these measures, 2,175 of the 4,500 jobs in Oss are expected to be lost, of which 1,000 are in R&D.
Als gevolg van deze maatregelen gaan naar verwachting in Oss 2175 van de 4500 banen verloren, waarvan 1000 banen in R&D.
Vragen van de leden Koppejan, Blanksma-van den heuvel en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het mogelijke massaontslag bij Organon te Oss (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

Three CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about possible mass dismissals at Organon/MSD in Oss, including requests for postponing reorganisation to allow a science park, coordination with local and provincial authorities, and why R&D sites elsewhere in Europe are less affected. The minister replied that two working groups with the government, region, municipality and MSD have started, that R&D consolidation is a global process with a broad shift towards the US, and that MSD has historically viewed the Dutch investment climate positively.
Active use of the government's instruments for innovation and entrepreneurship will explicitly be taken into account.
Actieve inzet van het overheidsinstrumentarium voor innovatie en ondernemerschap zal daarbij nadrukkelijk worden meegenomen.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de berichtgeving dat de Rabobank weigert een rekening te openen voor Vakwerk, de vakbond voor prostituees (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

Green Left MP Braakhuis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she accepts that Rabobank refused a bank account to Vakwerk, the sex workers' union, and what steps will address the resulting unequal treatment in banking. The minister replied that access to primary payment services is essential, that categorical exclusion without individual assessment is undesirable, and that the Dutch banking association agreed to assess applications individually, though incidents may still occur.
A solution in which banks voluntarily accept clients, in compliance with customer due diligence rules, is preferred.
Een oplossing waarbij banken cliënten vrijwillig accepteren – met inachtneming van de regelgeving op het gebied van customer due diligence – heeft de voorkeur.
Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de sluiting van de ASR-vestiging in Woudsend (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

MPs De Rouwe, Van Hijum and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the closure of the ASR office in Woudsend, its employment impact, the government's northern economic strategy, and the status of two shrinkage-related motions. The minister acknowledged the job loss, said the decision was a company strategy matter outside government intervention, pointed to Koers Noord and local responsibility, and reported that the motion inventory is finished and will be sent to parliament.
It is not my role to look for solutions at national level for an individual employment problem such as the one now arising around ASR Woudsend.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om voor een individueel werkgelegenheidsprobleem, zoals dat zich nu voordoet rond ASR Woudsend, op rijksniveau naar oplossingen te zoeken.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Financiën over het overstappen van verzekeraar (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether insurers obstruct customers who want to switch insurer and charge high fees for it. The minister said no studies show consumers face unnecessary difficulty, pointed to industry rules and the NMa's competition oversight, and stated insurers may not block switching or charge unreasonable fees.
I am of the view that consumers may not be made impossible or unnecessarily difficult to switch to another insurer.
Ik ben van mening dat het consumenten niet onmogelijk of onnodig moeilijk gemaakt mag worden om over te stappen naar een andere verzekeraar.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, Bontes en De Roon (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aan te scherpen) sanctieregime

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Shell had halted or resumed gasoline sales to Iran, and whether Shell would receive an exemption under tightened EU sanctions. The government said Shell reported no gasoline sales since October 2009 and that a later report was based on an erroneous port inspection, and it declined to discuss individual companies in the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
The Council will not speak about individual companies.
De Raad zal niet over individuele bedrijven spreken.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, De Roon en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aa

PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of a July 2010 letter from 22 US Congress members urging Shell to end its Iran activities and disclose them to US authorities, and whether it will urge Shell to disclose its Iran activities in the Netherlands too. The ministers answered that they know the letter, that it fits efforts for strict Iran sanctions, that Shell must answer it itself, and that Shell must account transparently to its shareholders while the government supervises compliance with EU and UN sanctions.
Shell is bound by the regulations arising from the relevant UN and European sanctions measures against Iran; it is the government's task to monitor compliance with them.
Shell is gebonden aan de regelgeving die voortvloeit uit de relevante VNVR- en Europese sanctiemaatregelen jegens Iran; het is de taak van de overheid toe te zien op naleving daarvan.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de omgewaaide hoogspanningsmasten tussen Doetinchem en Ulft (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether five collapsed high-voltage pylons near Doetinchem met the new European pylon standard, how many Dutch pylons comply, their age and depreciation period, the share on n-1 routes, the investment needed for replacement, and the timing of replacement. The minister requested postponement of the answers, pending a KEMA investigation ordered by TenneT, and promised answers by the first half of September.
In that context, I would like to request a postponement of the answers.
In dat kader wil ik om uitstel van beantwoording verzoeken.
Vragen van de leden Elias en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over een nieuwe clausule in de privacyvoorwaarden van Apple (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a new clause in Apple's privacy terms allowing collection, use and sale of user location data, and whether anonymised data can be traced back to individuals. The government's reply is only a holding notice stating that answers will take longer than usual due to interdepartmental consultation.
The answer will be submitted to your House as soon as possible.
De beantwoording zal zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht van een ongekend grote ontslaggolf bij MSD in Oss (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Health about reported large job losses at MSD in Oss and whether public investments should be reclaimed. The minister regretted the cuts, said talks with stakeholders were ongoing, noted about 2,175 jobs would be lost by end 2012, and refused to reclaim the subsidy as long as conditions were met.
As long as the conditions under which the subsidy was granted are met, there are no possibilities to reclaim the subsidy.
Zolang voldaan wordt aan de voorwaarden waaronder de subsidie verleend is, zijn er geen mogelijkheden om de subsidie terug te vorderen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt en Van Gerven (beide SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over ontslagen bij MSD in Oss (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would use their influence to prevent or limit job losses at MSD in Oss, meet the company, disclose costs of public support, and intervene with US authorities. The minister replied that government will not intervene in the company's strategic decision, that talks and two working groups are underway to preserve jobs, that cost details of public support are partly confidential, and that the minister has been in contact with MSD leadership including the US CEO.
The government neither wants nor can intervene in the company's strategic decision on the planned efficiency drive, including the sharp downsizing of the Oss site.
De overheid wil en kan niet treden in de strategische beslissing van het bedrijf over de voorgenomen efficiencyslag, waaronder de sterke afslanking van het bedrijf in Oss.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het instellen van een «Geen gezeur aan mijn deur register» (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

MP Braakhuis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she would introduce a 'do not ring the bell' register for door-to-door sales after a survey showed 62.6% of Dutch citizens support one, and why a 'do not call' register is easier to enforce. The minister rejected a statutory register, citing legitimate door-to-door selling, EU Services Directive concerns, harm to local charities, and enforcement difficulties, instead pointing to consumer education, the Deurwijzer, and tougher enforcement powers and higher fines.
I am not in favour of a statutory 'do not ring the bell' register.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een wettelijk Bel-niet-aan-register.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over ongewenste verkoop aan de deur (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister how to respond to a Consumentenautoriteit report that over three million Dutch people encounter door-to-door sales they experience as aggressive or misleading, and whether controls on such sales are adequate given the lack of recordings and supervision compared with telemarketing. The minister rejects aggressive selling, argues existing law and the regulators suffice, plans to expand the regulator's enforcement powers, and launches an information campaign.
However, I will, as I announced in the General Consultation on consumer policy of 8 April, expand the enforcement powers of the Consumer Authority.
Wel zal ik, zoals ik heb aangekondigd in het Algemeen Overleg over het consumentenbeleid van 8 april jl., de handhavingsbevoegdheden van de Consumentenautoriteit uitbreiden.
Vragen van de leden Vos en Timmer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de compensatie van bedrijven die door kartels schade geleden hebben (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

MPs Vos and Timmer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether companies harmed by cartels should be compensated, whether a Dutch whistleblower reward scheme like a UK experiment would be introduced, and whether results of that experiment are known. The minister answered that liable parties should bear damages, pointed to the EU-level approach and the Dutch collective settlement act, said the UK scheme is discretionary and results are not published, and declined to introduce a whistleblower fund.
The OFT does not provide information on the results of this reward system, because recipients of rewards could be identified, endangering their safety and deterring potential informants.
Over de resultaten van dit beloningssysteem verstrekt de OFT geen informatie, omdat daardoor de ontvangers van beloningen achterhaald kunnen worden
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat curatoren van failliete webshops verzuimen deze offline te halen (ingezonden 24 juni 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether curators of bankrupt webshops fail to take them offline, putting consumers' money at risk, and whether curators should be sanctioned and prepaid consumer money refunded. The minister answered that curators may lawfully keep a webshop running with judicial commissioner approval, that the curator is personally liable for consumer losses and must refund prepayments, and pointed consumers to ConsuWijzer and the public insolvency register.
If the curator wishes to keep the bankrupt business running, he does need permission from the judicial commissioner.
Wil de curator de failliete onderneming laten doordraaien, dan heeft hij daarvoor wel toestemming nodig van de rechter-commissaris.
