Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de verkoop van Kamer van Koophandel-gegevens aan Google (ingezonden 24 juni 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why Chamber of Commerce staff were not actively offering the opt-out from sale of business data for commercial purposes, and whether a company-specific block on sales to Google was possible. The minister replied that the Chamber actively informs registrants of the Non Mailing Indicator, that over 25% of new registrants and 10% of existing ones use it, and rejected a selective opt-out menu while noting companies can ask Google to remove their listing.
I do not consider it desirable to present registrants within the opt-out with a kind of selection menu.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk inschrijfplichtigen binnen de «opting out» een soort keuzemenu voor te leggen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van Advanta en Bejo Zaden bij kinderarbeid in India (ingezonden 21 j

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asked ministers about child labour in Indian seed production linked to Dutch seed firms Advanta and Bejo Zaden, and about company due diligence, subsidy consequences, bilateral action, EU trade agreement clauses and further research. The government's answer is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because consultation with stakeholders and interdepartmental coordination are still ongoing, with a promise to reply as soon as possible.

The parliamentary questions from MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Voordewind (ChristenUnie) to the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about the involvement of Advanta and Bejo Zaden in child labour in India (submitted 21 June 2010) cannot unfortunately be answered within the usual period.

De Kamervragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van Advanta en Bejo Zaden bij kinderarbeid in India (ingezonden 21 juni 2010) kunnen helaas niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn beantwoord worden.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dierproeven voor ruimteonderzoek (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether ESA-linked space research involving animal experiments, and claims about monkey experiments on the Mars500 website, were consistent with government statements and the Dutch animal experiments law. The minister answered that Mars500 involves no animal experiments, that the posting was removed at ESA's request, and that Dutch animal experiments are assessed by ethics committees under the law, with the government speaking only for the Dutch situation.
Because the Netherlands is not a contracting party in this, I asked ESA for further information about the Mars500 project.
Omdat Nederland hierin geen contractpartner is, heb ik ESA verzocht om nadere informatie over het Mars500-project.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over toezeggingen aan de Drentse gedeputeerde Klip over het demonstratieproject

An SGP MP asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Housing/Spatial Planning about commitments made to a Drenthe deputy regarding a northern CO2 storage demonstration project, and whether these are conditional on the Barendrecht pilot. The ministers answer that commitments cover communication, provincial participation and administrative consultation, that Barendrecht remains a necessary step and safety is guaranteed, and they decline to reconsider the agreements.
The cabinet committed during the recent consultation with the House not to take steps that would irreversibly lead to CO2 storage at Barendrecht, or strengthen Shell's legal position in this.

Het kabinet heeft tijdens het recente overleg met de Kamer toegezegd geen stappen te zullen zetten die onomkeerbaar leiden tot CO 2 -opslag bij Barendrecht, dan wel de juridische positie van Shell in deze versterken.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de betalingstermijn van gemeenten (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP asked the economic affairs minister about a MKB-Nederland list showing 27 of 158 municipalities missing the 30-day payment target, and whether other municipalities should be asked to disclose their payment terms. The minister answered that central government has no control over municipal payment policy, noted the list has improved to 25 late-paying municipalities, and said the government sees no reason to request disclosure, though it supports revising the EU late-payment directive.
The central government has no control over the payment policy of decentralised authorities.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen zeggenschap over het betalingsbeleid van decentrale overheden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de olieramp in de Golf van Mexico en de mogelijke risico’s verbonden met de o

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked the economics and spatial planning ministers about the Gulf of Mexico oil spill and risks from North Sea oil extraction, including inspections, safety rules, blow-out preventers, cross-border response and whether the government would act on the US investigation. Minister Van der Hoeven answered that a spill of that scale is unlikely in Dutch waters, that existing North Sea safety rules are already standardised and cooperation with other states is in place, and that the government will review the US report's recommendations when available.
Once the results are known I will examine whether there is reason to take further steps to translate the recommendations into the Dutch situation.
Zodra de resultaten bekend zijn zal ik nagaan of er aanleiding toe is om verdere stappen te nemen om de aanbevelingen te vertalen naar de Nederlandse situatie.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over mogelijke windfall profits in de energie-intensieve industrie al

MPs Omtzigt and Spies asked whether a CE Delft study showing windfall profits in energy-intensive industry from free ETS allowances warrants policy changes, and what it means for the EU carbon leakage list and emissions trading design. The minister acknowledged the study, said pass-through of allowance value is plausible, noted allocation to 2012 is fixed, reaffirmed a preference for auctioning and strict carbon leakage criteria, and promised further research while stating the NEa does not monitor windfall profits.
I am of the view that it is good to conduct further research into carbon leakage, so that we are better able to determine which sectors are affected by it.
Ik ben van mening dat het goed is om verder onderzoek te doen naar carbon leakage, opdat we beter in staat zijn vast te stellen welke sectoren hiermee te maken hebben.

Vragen van het lid Vendrik (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over een overeenkomst met Shell omtrent CO2-opslag in Barendrecht (ingezonden 2

Vendrik (GroenLinks) asks the ministers whether a written agreement with Shell on CO2 storage at Barendrecht exists, what compensation the state might owe if storage is dropped, how many documents were published, why an annex lacks signatures and dates, and whether a permit can be granted without a written agreement. The government replies only that interdepartmental consultation prevents answering within the set period, and promises to answer as soon as possible.
The answer will be provided to you as soon as possible.
De beantwoording zal u zo spoedig mogelijk worden aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Spies (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over stroomstoringen op Goeree-Overflakkee (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about frequent power outages on Goeree-Overflakkee, the network's condition, investment timing, compensation for customers and whether grid operator Stedin meets the N-1 reliability standard. The minister answered that the area's outage minutes are high but the network is maintained, that the NMa supervises grid quality, that existing compensation rules suffice, and that Stedin meets N-1 on the high-voltage grid but not in sparsely populated areas like Goeree-Overflakkee.
As part of this supervision, the NMa imposed a binding instruction on Stedin in December 2009
In het kader van dit toezicht heeft de NMa aan Stedin een bindende aanwijzing opgelegd in december 2009
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over implementatie van Europese richtlijnen over consumentenbescherming in Nederland (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

MP Vos (PvdA) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice whether the Netherlands correctly implemented EU Directive 97/7/EC on distance selling against aggressive sales practices, why cold-calling 'cowboys' persist, how Germany's implementation differs, and whether complaint data and transparency should improve. The ministers replied that the Dutch implementation is adequate, that enforcement tools are being strengthened, that complaint information is published via annual reports, and that consumer policy stays at Economic Affairs.
Information provision, for example by ConsuWijzer, plays an important role in warning consumers.
Voorlichting, door bijvoorbeeld ConsuWijzer, vervult een belangrijke rol bij het waarschuwen van consumenten.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Gesthuizen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over de inval van de NMa bij de LHV (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

SP MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the NMa's raid on the LHV, the scope of competition law in GP care, and whether it hampers care chains. The ministers answered that the NMa acts independently under the Mededingingswet, that cooperation is generally allowed while market-sharing and price agreements are not, and that the raid does not harm chain-care development.
The NMa decides independently to carry out a raid.
De NMa besluit zelfstandig tot een inval.
Vragen van de leden Vos en Timmer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de compensatie van bedrijven die door kartels schade geleden hebben (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether companies harmed by cartels should be compensated, whether the government will introduce a compensation scheme following the Commission's 2008 white paper on damages actions, and whether a UK-style whistleblower scheme for cartel tipsters will be considered. The minister replied only that the questions could not be answered within the deadline because not all necessary information had yet been gathered.
The reason for the delay is that not all the information needed to answer the questions has yet been gathered.
De reden voor uitstel is dat nog niet alle informatie die nodig is voor de beantwoording van de vragen verzameld is.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat slimme meters eenvoudig te hacken zijn (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether smart meters can be hacked, what safeguards exist, how customers are legally protected if meters are manipulated, and whether the mandatory rollout is acceptable given these risks. The minister answered that hacking cannot be ruled out entirely, listed technical and procedural safeguards and planned rules, and said customers remain able to claim against the network operator or the hacker and can refuse a smart meter.

Before the rollout of the smart meter starts, a general administrative order will be established under the market model bill (31 374) setting further requirements for the metering equipment, including its security.

Voorafgaand aan de start van de uitrol van de slimme meter zal op grond van het wetsvoorstel marktmodel (31 374) een algemene maatregel van bestuur worden vastgesteld waarin nadere eisen worden gesteld aan de meetinrichting.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Gerkens (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de mislukte 2,6 GHz veiling (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

The SP MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs to respond to reports that the 2.6 GHz spectrum auction was a failure, including doubts that winners would actually build mobile internet and might resell frequencies for profit. The Minister rejected the failure framing, said a light rollout obligation after two years and approval requirements for any resale apply, and argued the auction achieved new entrants and possible future competition.
A light commissioning obligation has been included requiring a network to be built after 2 years.
Er is een lichte ingebruiknameverplichting opgenomen die na 2 jaar verplicht een netwerk aan te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dierproeven voor ruimteonderzoek (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

The MP Ouwehand asks the ministers how photos and information on monkey experiments ended up on the Mars 500 project website, on what basis the government claimed ESA has no interest in animal research, whether the Dutch Animal Experiments Act allows animal experiments for space research, and whether the government will ban such experiments. The minister announces that answers will take longer than usual because information from ESA has not yet been fully gathered and coordinated.

The answer to MP Ouwehand's questions on animal experiments for space research will take more than the usual three weeks, because the information supply from and coordination with the European Space Agency (ESA) has not yet been completed.

De beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Ouwehand over dierproeven voor ruimteonderzoek zal meer dan de gebruikelijke drie weken in beslag nemen, omdat de informatievoorziening van en afstemming met het Europese Ruimtevaart Agentschap (ESA) nog niet is afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het behoud van analoge tv (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

MP Peters asks the economics and culture ministers whether cable operators may force customers from analogue to digital TV, whether other operators plan to stop analogue carriage, how many households are affected, and whether dropping the analogue signal conflicts with the must-carry rule. The minister replies that analogue distribution is inefficient, that the Mediawet 2008 does not oblige cable operators to carry analogue, that Caiway and Rekam will stop analogue carriage (Rekam from 10-10-2010), that affected households are mostly already digital, and that the must-carry minimum is met.
The Mediawet 2008 contains no obligation for a cable company to carry an analogue programme offer.
De Mediawet 2008 bevat geen verplichting voor een kabelbedrijf om een analoog programma-aanbod door te geven.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat CLT-UFA verbiedt dat kabelmaatschappijen Ziggo en UPC signalen van RTL-zenders doorleveren aan concurrerende kabelmaatschappij

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether RTL's (CLT-UFA's) reported contractual ban on Ziggo and UPC passing RTL channels to rival cable operators harms competition, and what the government would do about it. The Minister answered that no such clause exists according to the parties, that RTL as copyright holder must consent to distribution, that the civil court rather than OPTA must decide, and that no further action is needed.
Whether RTL's consent as copyright holder is required will have to be decided by the civil judge.
Over de vraag of de toestemming van RTL als auteursrechthebbende al dan niet vereist is zal de civiele rechter moeten oordelen
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de liberalisering van de postsector en de aangekondigde verkoop van TNT Post (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about EU postal liberalisation, the possible sale or flotation of TNT Post, implications for workers, universal service and state ownership. The minister answers that the 2010 liberalisation deadline stands, that TNT's split or sale is a company matter with the universal service obligation remaining in the Postal Act, and that the state will not take a stake.
It is the responsibility of the State to ensure that the universal postal service is delivered with good quality and at an affordable price.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Staat om te zorgen dat de universele postdienst wordt geleverd met een goede kwaliteit en tegen een betaalbare prijs.
Vragen van het lid Vendrik (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het rapport «The Economic Viability of Nuclear Power in the Netherlands (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asked the economy minister about a report on nuclear power economics, Delta's financial position, the Essent share case and implementation of the Borssele covenant. The minister answered that Delta is pursuing a partner for the project, the court case is separate, and the covenant investments are still being decided through 2014.
The planned transfer of the Evides shares is significant for Delta's future financial position.
De voorgenomen overdracht van de aandelen in Evides is van betekenis voor de toekomstige financiële positie van Delta.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het artikel «TenderNed legt het af tegen concurrentie» (ingezonden 18 februari 2010).

SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article claiming TenderNed, the government's electronic procurement system, is losing out to market competition, and whether it is still needed, who shares the criticism, what consultation took place, when it will be operational and its cost. The minister rejects the article's conclusion, explains the system's development with user groups and a phased rollout (publication in 2011, digital bidding in 2012), and defers the cost question to an earlier answer.
For the answer to this question I refer you to the answer to question 4 as asked by the members Vietsch and Ten Hoopen (CDA).
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar het antwoord op vraag 4 zoals gesteld door de leden Vietsch en Ten Hoopen (CDA).
Vragen van de leden Vietsch en Ten Hoopen (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de hoge kosten van de website voor aanbestedingen van TenderNed (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

MPs Vietsch and Ten Hoopen (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the high costs of the TenderNed public procurement platform, its timeline relative to alternatives such as BrigID and Aanbestedingskalender, what phase three adds, and whether existing systems would be cheaper and faster. The minister answered that TenderNed is a broader integrated system than the alternatives, outlined its phased rollout and costs by period, and said an estimate for upgrading alternatives is not possible due to missing information.

Whether other systems such as Aanbestedingskalender and BrigID also meet these requirements I cannot properly determine, because I have no insight into the scalability, software techniques used, security and data integrity of these systems.

Of andere systemen, zoals Aanbestedingskalender en BrigID, ook aan deze eisen en voorwaarden voldoen, kan ik niet goed vaststellen omdat ik geen inzicht heb in de schaalbaarheid, gebruikte softwaretechnieken, beveiliging en gegevensintegriteit van deze systemen.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over implementatie van Europese richtlijnen over consumentenbescherming in Nederland (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs how EU consumer protection directives, including the distance selling directive against unsolicited goods and aggressive sales practices, are implemented in the Netherlands, and how this compares with Germany, plus questions on complaint transparency and the Consumer Authority's powers. The government replies that the questions cannot be answered within the usual three-week period and that consultation with the parties involved is needed first.
answering these parliamentary questions requires further consultation with the parties involved
beantwoording van deze Kamervragen vergt nader overleg met betrokken partijen
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over misleidende reclame naar aanleiding van een onderhands meegezonden brief (ingezonden 22 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether misleading advertising by OfficeExpert, which resembles an unpaid invoice, is known and whether action will be taken. The government answered that it is aware, points to prevention via the Steunpunt Acquisitiefraude and a Reclame Code Commissie ruling, and says a barrier model with partners is being developed.
Forms of deception such as the letter you provided are undoubtedly undesirable, but are often difficult to prove under criminal law.
Vormen van misleiding zoals de door u verstrekte brief zijn zonder meer ongewenst, maar bij een strafrechtelijke aanpak vaak lastig te bewijzen.

Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over de realisering van gasputten in Alkmaar (ingezonden 6 januari 2010).

MP Verdonk asked why gas wells for the Bergermeer storage project are being drilled in the Loterijlanden nature area rather than the environmentally preferred MOB site, and about earthquake risk, external safety zones and jobs. The minister defended the Loterijlanden choice on cost, drilling waste, shorter works and existing use, and said the external safety contour and job effects are still being reviewed with compensation options.
I see no reason to reject the MIT report, nor the other reports listed in the reference list.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het rapport van MIT te verwerpen, evenmin als de andere rapporten die in de referentielijst worden opgesomd.

Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het feit dat een Nederlandse ondernemer Europese subsidie dreigt mis te lopen door onnodige aanvullende Nederlandse regelgeving en ambtenarij (ing

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister why a Dutch entrepreneur risks losing a European subsidy due to additional Dutch rules and bureaucracy, and whether this is goldplating. The minister replies that the scheme is a Northern Netherlands regional subsidy (IPR 2000) funded partly by EFRO, that no unnecessary national rules were imposed, and that no action is planned because the scheme ends in 2010 for budgetary reasons.
I do not recognise the situation you describe as a problem.
Ik onderken de door u geschetste situatie niet als een probleem.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt , Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Knops (allen CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Defensie over het bericht «Sleetse fabrieken, hightech producten» (ingezonden 22

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether Defence bypassed Koninklijke Ten Cate in awarding a fire-resistant clothing contract to A-industries, which sourced materials in China, and how government will stimulate domestic innovation in procurement. The government answered that the contract was tendered EU-wide under objective, non-discriminatory criteria and that procurement is bound by European law, while noting support instruments for entrepreneurs.
In 2008 the Ministry of Defence tendered the procurement of fire-resistant clothing at European level.
In 2008 heeft het ministerie van Defensie de opdracht voor verwerving van brandwerende kleding Europees aanbesteed.
Vragen van de leden Ten Hoopen en Van Vroonhoven-Kok (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Eneco jaagt Beatrix op kosten» (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

MPs Ten Hoopen and Van Vroonhoven-Kok asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of excessive heating profits by Eneco in The Hague, the speed of the Heat Act, and ways for consumers to reclaim overpayments. The minister disputed the EDO position paper's conclusions, said no excessive profits were established yet pending an NMa study, expected the Heat Act soon, and pointed to complaint and court routes while Almere and Houten litigation continues.
Eneco did not provide the Algemene Rekenkamer with any information about this heat network for the relevant investigation.
Eneco heeft voor het desbetreffende onderzoek geen informatie aan de Algemene Rekenkamer verstrekt met betrekking tot dit warmtenet.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de participatie van de European Space Agency in het Mars 500 project, waarvoor apen de ruimte in worden gestuurd (ingezonden 31 maart 2010)

An MP asked the Economics minister whether ESA participates in the Mars 500 project, whether Dutch funding supports it, and whether animal experiments are involved. The minister confirmed ESA's involvement via the ELIPS programme, said Mars 500 contains no animal experiments and that a separate 2008 Russian monkey study was not part of it, and that ESA has no plans for animal experiments.
Vragen van het lid Ten Hoopen (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Ook ING dwingt korting bij leveranciers af» (ingezonden 18 februari 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether ING Bank's practice of forcing retroactive discounts from suppliers, following a similar case at ABN Amro, reveals a structural abuse of buyer power and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the practice is unpleasant and may be a problem for small suppliers, notes that NMa investigates only with concrete complaints, and promises a consultation on a code of conduct plus studies of civil-law measures, dispute resolution and trade-association litigation, with a letter to parliament before summer.

To assess whether ING Bank has abused its position as a powerful buyer, it must be established which market is concerned, whether ING Bank holds an economic dominant position there, and whether it has abused that position from a competition perspective.
Om te kunnen beoordelen of ING Bank haar positie als machtige inkoper heeft misbruikt, zal moeten worden vastgesteld om welke markt het gaat

Vragen van het lid Gerkens (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de waarschuwing van de Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of ICANN's warning that IPv4 addresses would run out within two years, and about the progress, funding and procurement requirements for IPv6 adoption in the Netherlands. The minister acknowledged the warning, reported that 92% of participating Dutch ISPs support IPv6 but actual use is only about 3%, extended the Task Force funding by a year, commissioned TNO monitoring, and committed to proposing IPv6 for the 'pas toe of leg uit' list.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over onderbrekingen van de stroomvoorziening (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a planned seven-to-eight-hour power cut in Rosmalen during winter, without a substitute supply, is acceptable and whether grid operators' liability limits should be reviewed. The minister answered that no maximum duration criteria exist, that notice requirements were met, that the liability terms passed review, and that Netbeheer Nederland will be asked to stress customer-friendly procedures.
Against this background I will emphasise to Netbeheer Nederland the importance of continued attention among its members to a careful customer process for planned power interruptions.
Ik zal tegen deze achtergrond bij Netbeheer Nederland het belang van voortdurende aandacht bij hun leden voor een zorgvuldig proces naar de klant bij geplande stroomonderbrekingen onderstrepen.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Blanksma-van den Heuvel, Spies (beiden CDA) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het level playing field bij de energie intensieve industrie (ingezo

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the level playing field for energy-intensive industry, including French and German electricity price support, a Norwegian long-term contract scheme, and whether the Netherlands could reduce its vulnerability through energy efficiency programmes. The minister answered that the French regulated tariffs end for industry on 1 July 2010 and are under EU state-aid investigation, that German aid is pending Commission approval, that Norwegian aid is limited to domestic firms under EFTA supervision, and listed existing Dutch measures such as the Schoon en Zuinig programme and innovation schemes.
My ministry's Crash Team on Unfair Competition was set up precisely so that Dutch businesses can easily report market distortions.
Het Crashteam Oneerlijke Concurrentie van mijn ministerie is juist opgericht om het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven op eenvoudige wijze melding te kunnen laten maken van marktverstoringen.
Vragen van de leden Atsma en Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Kosten mobiel bellen stijgen met 30%» (ingezonden 18 maart 2010)

MPs Atsma and Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout asked whether mobile operators billing by whole minutes rather than seconds harms consumers, and whether an EU-style per-second rule should apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that transparency must improve, that consumers can switch contracts, and that domestic competition is sufficient so no EU-style regulation is planned, while negotiating with market parties on clearer tariff information.
No, unlike international roaming traffic, there is sufficient competition for domestic telephone traffic.
Nee, in tegenstelling tot internationaal roaming-verkeer is er voor binnenlands belverkeer voldoende concurrentie.

Vragen van de leden Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over watermaatschappij Viten

MPs from the CDA asked why Vitens charges a fee for paying by acceptgiro, even for periodic bank transfers, and whether this effectively forces customers into direct debit, and asked whether the government would inform businesses about the rules. The minister replied that differentiated payment fees are a commercial choice that must be transparent and not unreasonably burdensome, that competition supervision by the NMa covers abuse of dominance, and that no further information to businesses was deemed necessary.
Nor may businesses force consumers to choose a particular payment method by imposing unreasonably onerous terms.
Ook mogen bedrijven consumenten niet dwingen een bepaalde betaalwijze te kiezen door middel van het stellen van onredelijk bezwarende voorwaarden.
Vragen van de leden Vietsch en Ten Hoopen (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de «signing fee» (ingezonden 2 februari 2010).

MPs Vietsch and Ten Hoopen (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Campina Friesland's 'signing fee' for preferred-supplier status, which lets firms undercut the lowest bid, amounts to 'leuren' and is morally and legally acceptable. The minister acknowledged the fee could burden small firms and that the practice resembles leuren, but said private clients enjoy wide freedom in tendering and the practice is not legally prohibited.
However, private clients have a great deal of freedom regarding the manner of tendering.
Private opdrachtgevers hebben echter een grote mate van vrijheid wat de wijze van aanbesteden betreft.
Vragen van de leden Spies, Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout en Atsma (allen CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Misbruik «bel-me-niet»-register» (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the success of the Bel-me-niet register had led to more door-to-door sales and misuse of register data, and whether a Bel-niet-bij-me-aan register should follow. The minister replied that there were no concrete signs of misuse of the register, pointed to existing colportage rules enforced by the Consumentenautoriteit, and ordered NMa and the Consumentenautoriteit to investigate door-to-door sales in the energy sector, rejecting an extra register for now.

To get a good picture of the problem of door-to-door recruitment in the energy sector, I have asked the NMa and the Consumentenautoriteit to investigate whether there are individual or structural problems in this sector.

Om een goed te beeld te hebben van de problematiek rondom werving door middel van colportage in de energiesector heb ik de NMa en de Consumentenautoriteit gevraagd te onderzoeken of in deze sector sprake is van individuele of structurele problemen.

Vragen van het lid Algra (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over inventarisatie van succesvolle lokale initiatieven, waaronder toeristische activiteiten, in krimpregio’s (Ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asks the Economic Affairs state secretary about the status of an additional inventory of successful local initiatives, including tourism, that could sustain economic activity in shrinking regions, and about tourism prospects there. The minister answers that the inventory is ongoing with results promised by June, that the Rijk has a primarily enabling role, and that regions may propose tourism pilots within the Interbestuurlijk Actieplan.
The inventory is currently underway. I aim to present its results in June, in the form of a guide with examples of successful local initiatives, to the regions and municipalities.

De inventarisatie loopt op dit moment. Ik streef er naar in juni de uitkomsten hiervan in de vorm van een handreiking met voorbeelden van succesvolle lokale initiatieven aan de regio's en gemeenten te kunnen aanbieden.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de reikwijdte van het begrip «toeristisch gebied». (ingezonden 3 maart 2010).

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Van der Vlies (SGP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the Amsterdam court ruling that Amsterdam-Noord cannot be designated a tourist area under the Shop Hours Act relates to the minister's interpretation, and whether the whole city could open on Sundays if the centre counts as autonomous tourism. The minister answered that the municipal council decides on Sunday openings and that the courts review such decisions, and declined to change the scope of the tourist area as the Chamber did not support an amendment to narrow it.
It is for the court to assess whether the decision of the municipal council can stand.
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of het besluit van de gemeenteraad in stand kan blijven.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over het draagvlak voor CO2-opslag (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they had reacted to a Greenpeace poll showing public opposition to CO2 storage, whether the government had recent research on public and local support for CO2 storage, and what consequences should follow from low support. The minister acknowledged public unease and stressed objective information and communication, stated no government-commissioned support research exists, and promised to inform and consult local authorities and residents when concrete projects arise.
When there are concrete plans from initiators for CCS projects, we will consult with local governments, so that we can inform them in good time about the content and status of the plans.
Op het moment dat er sprake is van concrete plannen van initiatiefnemers voor CCS-projecten, zullen wij overleg hebben met de lokale overheden
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over agressieve verkoopmethoden van Pretium Telecom (ingezonden 16 februari 2010).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether Pretium Telecom's subsidiary Suprieur uses aggressive telephone sales tactics, including contacting customers on the Bel-me-niet register and sending pre-call letters that may circumvent the distance-selling cooling-off rules, and what measures would be taken. The minister answered that ConsuWijzer had received some complaints, that OPTA is aware of the signal and has ongoing investigations it cannot discuss, that the legal framework (Telecommunicatiewet, Bel-me-niet register, distance-selling rules, Oneerlijke Handelspraktijken) is adequate, and that the Consumentenautoriteit's enforcement tools will be strengthened.
I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Vragen van het lid Ten Hoopen (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Mkb: zwarte lijst van ABN is schandalig» (ingezonden 26 januari 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether ABN AMRO abused its buyer power by demanding after-the-fact discounts from suppliers, whether SMEs are squeezed by scale growth, and whether the NMa can act against buyer-power abuse. The minister said renegotiating contracts is not prohibited but suppliers may refuse, that NMa action requires concrete complaints, and that a code of conduct and dispute committee on contract compliance is being explored.
Where there are complaints with a concrete indication of such abuse, it is for the NMa to launch investigations into it.
Wanneer er klachten zijn met een concrete aanwijzing van zodanig misbruik, is het aan de NMa om daarnaar onderzoeken in te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Financiën over het achteraf en onder dreiging van het onthouden van toekomstige orders afdwingen van gunstigere inkoopvoorwaarden door ABN

An SP MP asked ministers whether ABN Amro's retroactive demand, under threat of losing future orders, that cleaning suppliers pay 10% of past contract revenue was acceptable, and whether state ownership should prevent such practices. The minister said such renegotiation is not prohibited but suppliers may refuse, and that the state as shareholder does not interfere in operational matters.

I expect all companies to act fairly and honestly in economic terms. There is therefore no reason to impose further requirements on banks and other companies merely because they are owned by the State

Ik verwacht dat alle ondernemingen eerlijk en zuiver economisch handelen. Er is daarom geen aanleiding om nadere eisen te stellen aan banken en andere ondernemingen omdat zij eigendom zijn van de Staat
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over fouten in antwoorden op Kamervragen van het lid De Mos aan de minister van Economische Zaken (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

The MP asks the minister whether her earlier answers on wind energy were wrong, including where the TU Delft report supports the claim of no efficiency losses and who calculated the 31.6% CO2 reduction figure. The minister acknowledges efficiency losses, defends the 31.6% figure as a simple calculation from TU Delft data, and promises a detailed KEMA study to be sent later in spring.
In answering the earlier questions from MP De Mos (submitted on 22 December 2009 under number 2009Z25178) I explicitly stated that efficiency losses do occur.
Ik heb in de beantwoording van de eerdere vragen van het lid De Mos (op 22 december 2009 ingediend onder nummer 2009Z25178 ) expliciet gesteld dat er rendementsverliezen optreden.

Vragen van het lid Van Vroonhoven-Kok (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over oneerlijke concurrentie bij de aanbesteding van postbezorging in gemeenten (ingezonden 11 februari 2010).

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether municipalities set unreasonable conditions in postal delivery tenders that exclude smaller competitors, and what measures will stop this. The minister replies that he is unaware of such exclusion, that municipalities must respect equality, non-discrimination and proportionality principles, that ministry expertise centre PIANOo provides information, and that aggrieved firms can appeal to the courts.
Ultimately it is the court that tests whether municipalities act in breach of the procurement rules.
Het is uiteindelijk de rechter die toetst of gemeenten al dan niet in strijd handelen met de aanbestedingsregels.

Vragen van de leden Vos en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over ondoorzichtige en complexe aanbiedingen van energieleveranciers (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

MPs Vos and Samsom asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether increasingly complex energy supplier offers, which consumers cannot easily check afterwards, should follow a 'what you see is what you get' principle, and whether a standard format or government comparison site is warranted. The minister answered that existing NMa guidelines, the forthcoming Betere Energie Nota, a model contract and private comparison sites address transparency, and saw no reason yet for a government comparison site.
I therefore currently have no reason to offer a comparison site from the government.
Ik heb daarom op dit moment geen reden om van overheidswege een vergelijksingssite aan te bieden.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ten Hoopen (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Weinig echte campussen in Nederland» (ingezonden 12 februari 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Ten Hoopen asked whether four Dutch campuses are of national importance, whether they drive growth and jobs, what came of consultations on a structural campus policy, and for the BCI report with follow-up on its recommendations. The minister confirmed the criteria and the four campuses, acknowledged campuses' general value, reported the February 2010 meeting with the sector, attached the BCI quick-scan report, and said its recommendations will be taken into the regional and innovation policy instruments.
I am sending you the report as an annex to this letter.
Het rapport doe ik u toekomen als bijlage bij dit schrijven.

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Cramer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Finance Minister how they would act on the 'Sustainable Remuneration' guide, whether they would enforce linking at least a third of variable pay in state holdings to sustainability criteria, and what role the ecological footprint plays in listed companies' reporting. The minister replied that the government welcomes sustainable pay, points to the revised corporate governance code and VBDO activity, says sustainability criteria in state holdings should be assessed per company without a fixed 60% long-term share, and leaves the ecological footprint to companies' own choice.
It is up to the companies themselves to make a choice regarding the ecological footprint.
Het is aan de ondernemingen zelf om een eventuele keuze te maken voor de ecologische voetafdruk.

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether Ahava cosmetics, which have a postcode in occupied territory, are imported from the occupied area and whether customs data on origin and importers can be disclosed. The minister answered that no preferential tariff was used, declined to name the importing companies citing customs and tax confidentiality rules, and said customs does not hold data on raw-material origin.

Names and addresses of individual companies that imported certain goods fall under the confidentiality provisions of both Article 15 of Council Regulation (EEC) No. 2913/92 and Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act.
Namen en adressen van individuele bedrijven die bepaalde goederen hebben ingevoerd, vallen onder de geheimhoudingsbepalingen van zowel artikel 15 van de Verordening (EEG) nr. 2913/92 van de Raad

An MP asked the economics ministers about reports of aggressive door-to-door sales by energy companies, whether the government would draw conclusions earlier than May 2010, whether fines should be imposed, and whether commission-based pay should be changed. The minister said supervisors would report by 1 May 2010 on whether the problem is structural and whether existing enforcement suffices, that fines can deter but enforcement choices rest with supervisors, and that the sector bodies were asked to examine commission pay.

I have asked the Consumer Authority and the NMa to inform me by 1 May 2010 of the (preliminary) results and to indicate whether such problems can be adequately addressed with existing enforcement instruments.

Ik heb de Consumentenautoriteit en de NMa gevraagd mij voor 1 mei 2010 te informeren over de (voorlopige) resultaten en aan te geven of dit soort knelpunten met bestaande handhavingsinstrumenten afdoende kan worden aangepakt.

An MP asked the economic affairs minister about repeated power outages at Kropswolde substation, the reliance of users on network operators' explanations, liability terms, and whether an independent investigation body or NMa probe should be set up. The minister answered that outages were limited and largely caused by customers' installations, that reporting duties and NMa oversight are adequate, and declined a new independent research council or a fresh NMa investigation.
To definitively establish the cause of the outages, Enexis has meanwhile installed advanced measuring equipment at the companies concerned.
Om de oorzaak van de storingen definitief vast te stellen, heeft Enexis inmiddels geavanceerde meetapparatuur geplaatst bij de betrokken bedrijven.

An SP MP asks the Economic Affairs ministers for their reaction to the Live Nation/Ticketmaster merger plans affecting their Dutch subsidiaries, the market shares and concentration on those markets, and whether the competition authority NMa will review the merger. The minister declines to comment on the merger decision, says no notification duty exists under Dutch thresholds so the NMa will not review it, and does not provide market share or concentration figures.
Neither the NMa nor I have recent figures on the market shares of Mojo Works B.V. and Ticket Service Nederland B.V. on their respective markets, or precise data on market concentration.

Over recente cijfers over het marktaandeel van Mojo Works B.V. en Ticket Service Nederland B.V. op hun respectievelijke markten, en over precieze gegevens ten aanzien van de concentratiegraad beschikken de NMa en ik niet.

MP Van der Ham asks the economics and foreign affairs ministers about a UK seminar on the Desertec solar-power plan, whether the Netherlands should take a similar initiative, what action was taken on a motion on concentrating solar power, and the role of TenneT after its Transpower takeover. The government answers that a Dutch embassy official attended the seminar, outlines EU-level work on flexible renewable mechanisms and a list of past Dutch activities, and says TenneT has no direct role in the Desertec plan.
The seminar you probably refer to took place on 2 February in London.
Het seminar waar u waarschijnlijk op doelt heeft plaatsgevonden op 2 februari jl. in Londen.

An MP asked whether the minister was concerned that a Waalre supermarket obtained a Sunday opening permit through a staged bowling-style sjoel competition, and whether legislation should let shopkeepers decide Sunday opening themselves. The minister confirmed the permit was granted under the festivity exception, noted the court ruled it was misapplied, and rejected letting individual shopkeepers decide because collective interests must be weighed.
It is for the court to rule on this in individual cases.
Het is aan de rechter om hier in individuele gevallen uitspraak over te doen.

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs how she views supermarkets opening unlicensed on Sundays in Deventer, the resulting unequal playing field, the VNG's and MKB Nederland's calls for local discretion, and whether she will amend the pending Winkeltijdenwet. The minister replies that the Sunday closing rule serves collective interests, that the evening-shop exemption stays unchanged with local discretion within the law, and that the MKB request would increase Sunday opening days and conflicts with the coalition agreement.

I understand that municipalities sometimes have to make difficult choices as a result, but expanding the evening-shop provision is not in line with the aim of the Shop Opening Hours Act that shops be closed on Sundays.

Ik begrijp dat gemeenten hierdoor soms lastige keuzes moeten maken, maar verruiming van de avondwinkelbepaling is niet in lijn met de doelstelling van de Winkeltijdenwet dat winkels op zondag gesloten zijn.

PVV MPs De Mos and Graus asked ministers whether a study claiming wind turbines are pointless, with higher fuel use and CO2 emissions, is accepted, and whether subsidies should stop and backup plant emissions are counted. The minister rejects the study's conclusions, cites a TU Delft report showing CO2 falls when plants throttle down, defends wind subsidies as reducing the cost gap with other renewables, and refuses to end subsidies.
That is why the cabinet has no objection to the level of subsidies for wind energy.
Daarom heeft het kabinet geen bedenking bij de hoogte van de subsidies aan windenergie.

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether cartel fines (kartelboetes) should be made non-deductible for tax, since deductibility weakens their deterrent effect, and whether criminal sanctions would help given that cartel profits can exceed fines. The minister answered that prevention is central to fines, that deductibility may limit deterrence, that the Advocate-General concluded fines are not deductible and legislation would be reviewed if the Supreme Court departs from that advice, and that a bill adding criminal sanctions is planned to strengthen deterrence.
Should the Supreme Court in its ruling depart from the AG's advice, it will be examined whether the legislation needs to be amended.
Mocht de Hoge Raad in zijn uitspraak afwijken van het advies van de AG, dan zal bezien worden of de wetgeving aangepast moet worden.

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether arguments from a newspaper article calling the halving of ING a penalty measure should be included in earlier questions, and how the exceptional financial stability situation should be weighed in the European Commission's market distortion assessment. The ministers answered yes to both questions, stating that financial stability plays no role in assessing market distortion but should be weighed in assessing state aid compatibility with the common market, as the Commission did when approving the ING Alt-A back-up facility.
In our view, this exceptional situation should indeed be taken into account when assessing whether state aid measures are compatible with the common market.
Deze uitzonderlijke situatie dient naar onze mening wel te worden meegewogen bij de beoordeling of staatssteunmaatregelen in overeenstemming zijn met de gemeenschappelijke markt.

Two CDA MPs asked the finance and economic affairs ministers whether EU state-aid and competition policy on banks, as described by Commissioner Kroes, preserves a level playing field, whether ING's criticism is justified, and whether the Commission's decision on ING can be published quickly. The ministers replied that the Commission's approach aims to preserve a level playing field, that its effect cannot yet be assessed, that ING's stricter restructuring is a consequence of its large state aid, and that they pushed for early publication of the decision.
We have worked towards this and expect publication soon.
Wij hebben ons daarvoor ingezet en verwachten spoedig publicatie.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma  over de stop van de bouw van een biobrandstoffabriek door UPM in de Rotterdamse haven

An NSC MP asked the ministers about UPM's decision to abandon a biofuel plant in the Rotterdam port, its impact on the energy transition, and calls for a Deltaplan, a coordination table, conditional subsidies and strategic industrial choices. The minister acknowledged the withdrawal as illustrative of investment-climate problems, pointed to existing cluster approaches and Groene Groei measures, declined a new Deltaplan or coordination table, and promised forthcoming industry and energy-intensive-industry letters to parliament.
An additional coordination table is not a solution to the current problems regarding the absence of investment decisions in the industrial clusters.
Een extra regietafel is geen oplossing voor de huidige problemen ten aanzien van het uitblijven van investeringsbeslissingen in de industrieclusters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Boskalis ziet geen toekomst meer in Nederland: “We moeten niet verzwakt worden door doorgeschoten milieueisen”

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it views Boskalis considering leaving the Netherlands over strict environmental rules, and about the effects of CSRD, CSDDD, WAMCA, EU procurement and export credit policy on Dutch competitiveness. The government answered that it regrets any departure, is working on a business climate pact, supports raising the CSRD threshold but not abolishing it, is awaiting the WAMCA evaluation, and defends Dutch export credit policy as broadly in line with peers.
I aim to have this Pact ready for signing by mid-June.
Ik streef ernaar dit Pact medio juni gereed te hebben voor ondertekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het voornemen van Extinction Rebellion om winkels te bestoken met boterzuur

An MP from FVD asked ministers about Extinction Rebellion's announced plan to disrupt shops with butyric acid, the scope of past XR damage, municipal shifting of costs onto businesses, investigation of XR's structure and funding, equal treatment of demonstrations, and the AIVD/NCTV focus on right-wing versus left-wing extremism. The government called the butyric acid plan unacceptable, declined to compile an overview or damage figures, said municipal mayors decide on demonstration measures, refused to investigate XR, denied unequal treatment, and said the AIVD monitors left-wing extremism but XR's actions are currently seen as activism.
Such an overview cannot be generated.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te genereren.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the government whether public bodies such as the KvK, CBS and RVO will reconsider moving services to US cloud providers, and how exposed data and continuity are to US law and sanctions. The government answered that the Rijksbreed cloud policy already requires weighing market concentration and continuity risks, that some migrations (e.g. Oracle ERP) are being reconsidered and kept within the EEA, and that it is exploring a sovereign government cloud and an ACM review.
For the Parliamentary letter of 22 November 2024, a survey was held among all ministries to obtain an overview of all planned and proposed cloud migrations of government ICT abroad.

Antwoord 4 Rijksbreed Ten behoeve van de Kamerbrief van 22 november 2024 2 is een uitvraag gedaan bij alle departementen ten behoeve van een overzicht van alle geplande en voorgenomen cloudmigraties van overheids-ICT naar het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Dral en Bikkers over het bericht 'Gokken, alcohol, drugs: verslavingsproblemen nemen toe bij noodlijdende ondernemers'

MPs Kisteman, Dral and Bikkers asked the ministers whether the government is aware of rising addiction among distressed entrepreneurs, whether there are regional or sectoral differences, and what measures and municipal support are planned. Minister Karremans answered that addiction among entrepreneurs is not registered separately and no national figures exist, pointed to existing debt-support programmes and municipal efforts, and committed to exploring with municipalities and other partners how support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Yes. I will explore with municipalities, trade organisations and care partners whether, and if so how, support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Ja. Ik ga samen met gemeenten, brancheorganisaties en zorgpartijen verkennen of, en zo ja, hoe de ondersteuning van ondernemers met meervoudige problematiek structureel versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over de berichtgeving rondom de levering van kritieke grondstoffen uit China

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked about China's export licensing requirement on rare earths and magnets, its impact on Dutch industry, the role of the Netherlands Materials Observatory (NMO), and possible copper shortages. The ministers answered that the government was informed only hours before the measure, that companies face delivery delays and uncertainty without quantifying sectoral impact for security and confidentiality reasons, and that the government is raising the issue with the European Commission and working on supply security under the national raw materials strategy.
For security reasons and commercial confidentiality, no further statements can be made about specific Dutch sectors or individual companies most affected by the export control measure.

Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt en bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen nadere uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke Nederlandse sectoren of individuele bedrijven waarop de exportcontrolemaatregel de grootste impact heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de druk op zelfstandige winkeliers en de gevolgen voor ondernemers, consumenten en concurrentie

MP Postma asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about cost pressures on independent shopkeepers, data on closures, support instruments, competition risks, ACM oversight of concentration, and local retail diversity. The minister answers that cost pressures are a given, data on closures is unavailable, existing investment instruments are pointed to, ACM already monitors concentration, and local governments hold responsibility for retail diversity, with dialogue with branches and municipalities continuing.
No, these figures are not available.
Nee, deze cijfers zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bevorderen van steward owned ondernemen in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether steward-ownership legislation and a model-articles approach would be pursued, and whether a survey should be commissioned in the Netherlands. The minister answered that consultations with experts are ongoing, that a decision on follow-up to the motion will come in autumn 2025, and deferred the substantive questions to that later letter.
You will be informed about this in the autumn of 2025.
Hierover zult u in het najaar van 2025 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de verplaatsing van industriële productie uit Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the relocation of industrial production out of the Netherlands, its causes, and possible policy responses. The government acknowledges the pressure on industry from energy costs, competition, grid congestion, nitrogen constraints and policy unpredictability, and points to measures such as extending the IKC-ETS scheme, the IBO on electricity infrastructure, and a forthcoming industry policy letter.
The exact number of industrial production companies that have withdrawn their activities from the Netherlands is not recorded as such.
Het exacte aantal industriële productiebedrijven dat hun activiteiten uit Nederland heeft teruggetrokken wordt niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat Sabic verkoop van Chemelot fabrieken overweegt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government reacts to reports that Sabic is considering selling its European plants including Chemelot, and about nationalisation, consultation with authorities, subsidies and dependencies. The minister declined to comment on unconfirmed reports and company strategy, said talks with Sabic are confidential, and pointed to the Industry letter and a Europe-wide chemicals action plan.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on the business operations and strategy of individual companies.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om in te gaan op de bedrijfsvoering en strategie van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Postma over het artikel ‘ACM nagelt elf dure energieleveranciers aan de schandpaal’

MPs Omtzigt and Postma asked whether eleven energy suppliers charging markedly higher model-contract tariffs than others, as reported by the ACM, implies market abuse or information asymmetry, and whether transparency rules and price caps are needed. The minister answers that tariff differences reflect free price setting and differing cost structures, that the ACM supervises reasonableness and can enforce, that new Energiewet transparency and comparison rules apply from 2026, and that caps and published margins are not considered necessary or desirable.
Detailed price structure and margins concern competitively sensitive information.
Gedetailleerde prijsopbouw en marges betreft concurrentiegevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opkoop van campings en recreatieparken waardoor recreanten moeten wijken

An SP MP asked the government about takeovers of campsites and recreation parks that force long-term residents to leave, including questions on tenant protection, environmental safeguards, Natura 2000 areas and an initiative note 'Red de Camping'. The minister answered that existing tenancy law and the Omgevingswet provide sufficient protection, rejected calls for halting takeovers, and promised a reply to the initiative note and a conversation with affected residents.
No. Recreants can invoke general tenancy law and this provides sufficient protection.
Nee. Recreanten kunnen zich beroepen op het algemeen huurrecht en dit biedt voldoende bescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het screenen van wetenschappers en studenten door hogeronderwijsinstellingen omwille van de nationale veiligheid en wie dit moet bekostigen

An MP asked several ministers whether universities should bear the costs of the proposed screening of researchers and students for national security reasons, and whether this is a shared national responsibility. The minister answered that knowledge security is a cabinet-wide shared responsibility, that funding is partly shifted from Justice and Security to OCW, and that the screening law is a national policy choice, while stating that the government will not provide further legal grounding beyond the existing funding framework.
Yes, universities and colleges are responsible for keeping security in order and mitigating these risks.
Ja, hogescholen en universiteiten dragen verantwoordelijkheid voor het op orde hebben van beveiliging en het mitigeren van deze risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Waveren en Idsinga over de bezorging van overheidspost

MPs Van Waveren and Idsinga asked ministers about the National Ombudsman's warning that late or failed delivery of government post harms citizens. The minister answered that complaint data is kept centrally via PostNL under the Rijksbrede postcontract, that responsibility for mail delivery and legal consequences is shared across departments and courts, and that the ACM study on the postal market will inform further policy.
There is no record within the Ministry of Economic Affairs or the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations of such internal reports.
Er is binnen het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties geen registratie waarin dergelijke interne meldingen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Postma over de ‘crisismodus’ bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs Saris and Postma asked the ministers about the 'crisis mode' at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, including prior engagement, energy costs, subsidies, and possible support for affected workers. The minister answered that the closure is a business decision mainly for the company, described past government efforts to keep production in the Netherlands, listed received support, and declined to commit to visits or EU funding requests until the company clarifies its next steps.
This information is not public and is not known to me.
Deze informatie is niet openbaar en is niet bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over het artikel “Europa hééft wel grondstoffen voor halfgeleiders, maar kan er niet bij”

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Economic Affairs about a newspaper article claiming EU critical-raw-materials partnerships have not proven effective, and how to reduce dependence through local value addition, recycling and concrete targets. The government answered that it is too early to judge the partnerships, stressed reciprocity, circularity and the National Raw Materials Strategy, and said it will study setting national targets once risks are better mapped.
It is a long process, so it is still too early to judge whether MoUs have proven effective.
Het is een lang proces, waardoor het nog te vroeg is te oordelen of MoU’s effectief zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over nieuwe horecaregels in Amsterdam

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would intervene in Amsterdam's new hospitality rules, including discretionary exemptions for late opening, snack bar closing times and possible restrictions on terraces and dancing. The minister replied that municipalities are responsible for their own rules and declined any additional steps beyond the existing cooperation programme with the VNG.
The municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for its own rules and has the best view of their effects.
Gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen regels en heeft het beste zicht op de effecten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Nederland laat kansen liggen en moet Leven Lang Ontwikkelen wél een prioriteit maken'

MP Saris asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs about an article calling for Lifelong Learning to be a priority, covering the labour market tightness summit, productivity, the LLO agenda, personal development budgets and EU flagships. Minister Van Hijum answered substantively on each point, describing the summit, the forthcoming LLO agenda around summer 2025, SLIM subsidies and EU coordination, while stating commitments to send letters but no binding legislative change.
We will send the summit report to the House ahead of the planned committee debate on labour market tightness on 21 May 2025.
Wij sturen het verslag naar de Kamer in de aanloop naar het geplande Commissiedebat arbeidsmarktkrapte van 21 mei 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over financiering van ngo’s, belangenorganisaties en goede doelen

MP Vermeer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs which NGOs, interest groups and charities receive subsidies from the ministry, the criteria, thematic focus, budgets for 2025-2030, subsidies above 100,000 euro, and a per-project table. The minister replied that no specific subsidy overview for these organisations is kept, pointed to public open data and general subsidy criteria, gave aggregate budgets, and said the Uniform Subsidy Framework will be revised by 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'New shipyard for TenneT's German offshore platforms is being built in Spain'

An MP asked whether TenneT's German offshore platform shipyard being built in Spain, financed partly through Dutch state-owned TenneT, conflicts with the Maritime Manufacturing sector agenda and whether Dutch taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the Dutch state holds TenneT Holding indirectly, that the EU tender was awarded on price, quality and delivery time without a Dutch consortium bidding, and that the sector agenda was not a criterion, promising only a Q2 2025 progress letter.
The Siemens Energy and Dragados Offshore consortium awarded the tender for building the shipyard on the basis of various criteria.
Het consortium Siemens Energy en Dragados Offshore heeft de aanbesteding voor de bouw van de werf op basis van verschillende criteria gegund.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over het uitblijven van duurzame investeringen door bedrijven en beleggers

MPs Vijlbrief and Rooderkerk asked whether unclear climate policy is delaying green investment, whether a climate package will be in place this spring, and about the cost of delayed action and government cuts to the green economy. The minister replied that the government is committed to the Climate Act targets, cited grid congestion, CCS capacity and electricity prices as the main reasons for delayed investment, promised clarity in the Klimaatplan and Voorjaarsnota, and deferred several points to the spring budget.
The cabinet has committed in the Coalition Agreement and Government Programme to the existing agreements on the 2030 and 2050 climate targets as formulated in the Climate Act.
Het kabinet heeft zich in het Hoofdlijnenakkoord en het Regeerprogramma gecommitteerd aan de bestaande afspraken voor de klimaatdoelen van 2030 en 2050 zoals geformuleerd in de Klimaatwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de agressieve en misleidende telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen

An MP asked the ministers about aggressive and misleading telephone sales of home batteries, including threatened fees, withdrawal rights, repeat offenders and privacy of phone numbers. The minister answered that the ACM is autonomous and handles enforcement, that consumers keep a 14-day cooling-off right extended if misinformed, that the stricter ban on unsolicited calling applies from 1 July 2026, and that the government will talk with the ACM but cannot urge enforcement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de economische kansen van verduurzaming op Curaçao

Two D66 MPs asked about a Curaçao solar park, EV charging and electric buses, including a 13.2 million euro financing gap and Dutch funding commitments. The minister says Curaçao is responsible for procurement and financing, that Dutch SDE funds cannot be used directly but grid and storage costs may be eligible, and that a feasibility study and a May visit to Curaçao are planned.
It is up to Curaçao to shape the implementation and financing.
Het is aan Curaçao om de uitvoering en financiering vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘ACM wil dat energiebedrijven klanten helpen met nieuw energiecontract’

An MP asked the minister whether energy suppliers should be obliged to help consumers choose suitable contracts, and what powers the ACM has to act against non-transparent suppliers. The minister answered that the new Energy Act strengthens transparency and comparability rules, that the ACM has enforcement powers, and that no additional regulation is needed yet while the new rules are monitored.

The cabinet first wants to see the effects of the new rules (in force from 1 January 2026) in practice for consumers and therefore sees no immediate reason to prescribe additional protection beyond what the Energy Act already provides.

Het kabinet wil eerst bezien wat de effecten zijn van de nieuwe regels (die per 1 januari 2026 van kracht zijn) in de praktijk voor de consument en ziet daarom niet direct aanleiding om, naast hetgeen de Energiewet reeds regelt, extra bescherming voor te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over betaalbare boodschappen door QR-code als onderdeel van de VVD Agenda voor Werkend Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether an English-language label with a QR code linking to Dutch product information should be allowed in supermarkets to lower prices, and asks about EU negotiations, the motion on QR codes, savings estimates and inflation. The minister rejects the QR-code route as a solution to territorial supply constraints, argues Dutch labels must remain, states no savings estimates exist, and promises a letter on inflation.
I have no figures on how many euros an average Dutch household could save per year if an English-language label with a QR code were allowed on supermarket products.

Ik heb geen cijfers over hoeveel euro een gemiddeld Nederlands huishouden naar schatting op jaarbasis kan besparen als een Engelstalig etiket met QR-code op producten in de supermarkt wordt toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht '1,4 miljard pakketjes van buitenlandse webshops naar Nederland: 'Onhoudbaar''

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will respond to supervisors' warnings that the flood of small parcels from Chinese webshops is uncontrollable and that most such goods fail EU rules.
