The minister answered that the government takes the problem seriously, cited EU product rules, the DSA and a Commission e-commerce communication, and committed to lobbying Brussels for an in-depth study and to continued consultation with supervisors.
Given the scale and social importance of this problem, I will continue to actively press for it in Brussels to keep it on the Commission's agenda and develop effective policy.

Gezien de omvang en het maatschappelijke belang van deze problematiek, zal ik mij actief blijven inzetten in Brussel om het probleem op de agenda van de Commissie te behouden en effectief beleid te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman en Van Eijk over de BijzonderBeheer Barometer van PwC (i.v.m. antwoord op vraag 4)

MPs Kisteman and Van Eijk asked the Ministers about PwC's Bijzonder Beheer Barometer, which claims Tax Authority rules (requiring settlements to include all creditors and limiting payment plans to twelve months) make restructuring unworkable for firms. The minister defended the Tax Authority's strict debt-relief policy, said flexibility exists for individual cases, gave no commitment to change the WHOA or policy, and noted the Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden might be extended only if budget becomes available.
The receiver, in principle, pursues a strict deferral and debt-relief policy towards entrepreneurs.
De ontvanger voert ten aanzien van ondernemers in beginsel een stringent uitstel- en kwijtscheldingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat een prijsplafond voor gas wordt overwogen

An MP asked whether the government would support an EU gas price cap, how it views state responsibility for gas security and affordability, the effect of energy taxes, the functioning of the energy emergency fund, and whether gas firms deliberately keep prices high. The minister responded that the Commission has no such proposal, the government is critical of market price caps, gas security is shared with the market, energy taxes are a small part of inflation, the emergency fund reached 110,937 households in 2024, and there is no evidence of deliberate price-raising by the sector.
The government sees no deliberate tactic by the gas sector to keep prices high in order to make more profit.
Het kabinet ziet geen bewuste tactiek van de gassector om de prijzen hoog te houden om zodoende meer winst te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Hogere lonen hoeven inflatievuur niet op te stoken'

An MP asks the government about employee participation (profit-sharing, shares) as a tool against inflation, citing the 2023 Bontenbal/Marijnissen motion and international comparisons. The state secretary replies that the government supports the goals in principle but will not actively stimulate profit-sharing with tax incentives, leaving it to social partners, and only plans a further study of growth-sharing for startups.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to introduce active tax stimulation of financial employee participation through profit-sharing.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens met actieve fiscale stimulering te komen van financiële medewerkersparticipatie via winstdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat Talpa jaarcijfers aan het zicht onttrekt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked whether Talpa's use of the 'Blokker construction' to withhold annual accounts from public view is lawful, and what sanctions and changes are available. The state secretary answers that failing to publish a required subsidiary account breaches the publication duty, that the fine is modest but further civil and personal liability remedies exist, and that no legislative change is planned.
Failing to file the annual accounts is an economic offence.
Het niet deponeren van de jaarrekening is een economisch delict.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie subsidies heeft verstrekt aan milieuorganisaties om specifieke wetgevingsvoorstellen te promoten, zoals de Natuurherstelwet

An MP asked the Dutch ministers whether EU Commission subsidies to environmental NGOs to promote legislation such as the Nature Restoration Law raise transparency concerns, and asked for an overview, conditions, and publication of Dutch subsidies to such groups. The minister denied that Dutch subsidies fund lobbying, declined a full overview and publication of individual subsidy agreements, and stated no changes to subsidy policy are planned.
No. The cabinet does not keep a central overview of all national government subsidies.
Nee. Het kabinet houdt geen centraal overzicht bij van alle rijkssubsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Vermeer over het bericht 'Minister wijst verder onderzoek naar eilanden met zonnepanelen in IJsselmeer definitief van de hand'

MPs Eerdmans and Vermeer asked whether the Wieringerhoek floating solar project in the IJsselmeer can still proceed despite the minister halting it, and whether the Rijk should stop further steps by the province and municipality. The minister answered that no procedures are running, the cabinet refused the Meerlicht B.V. project application, insufficient prospects for permits exist, and the cabinet sees no reason to act on the call to halt local efforts.
Given this, and since the cabinet has already rejected the Meerlicht B.V. application for the project procedure, the cabinet sees no reason at this time to act on your call.

Gezien dit gegeven en het kabinet de aanvraag van Meerlicht B.V. tot toepassing van de projectprocedure reeds heeft afgewezen, ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen aanleiding om gevolg te geven aan uw oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht dat PostNL brievenbussen eerder gaat legen

An MP asked the minister whether PostNL's plan to empty 75% of letterboxes before 17:00 from February 2025 is compatible with the 95%-within-24-hours delivery norm, and whether the ministry was consulted. The minister says the law sets no collection times so ACM may enforce only if other universal-service rules are breached, that PostNL did not seek ministry approval, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before the ACM postal market study and an appraisal to parliament.
To address the concerns of the House, I indeed committed not to take irreversible steps while the ACM's postal market study is still ongoing.
Om aan de zorgen van de Kamer tegemoet te komen heb ik inderdaad toegezegd om geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten terwijl het onderzoek naar de postmarkt van de ACM nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over concurrentievervalsing van de Big Four

An MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about alleged competition distortion by the Big Four accountancy firms, following a complaint by OvRAN to the European Commission and ACM. The minister answers that ACM found no evidence of prohibited conduct, that joint market power is not itself unlawful, and that no further action is planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further action.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om verdere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Teunissen en Stultiens over het rapport 'Takers, not makers'

MPs Dijk, Teunissen and Stultiens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the Oxfam report 'Takers, not makers' on billionaire wealth, inheritance, wealth inequality, tax avoidance, global extraction and wealth taxes. The minister rejected the report's framing, arguing Dutch income inequality is low and stable and wealth inequality has fallen, while pointing to box 3 reform, existing tax measures and a planned review of anti-dividend-stripping options, without committing to higher taxes on wealth or inheritance.
This cabinet is not considering further raising the gift and inheritance tax rates for multi-million euro inheritances.
Dit kabinet overweegt niet de tarieven in schenk- en erfbelasting verder te verhogen voor miljoenenerfenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de uitspraken van de CEO van ASML over het Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat

An MP asked the ministers about ASML's CEO's remarks on the Dutch investment climate, including grid congestion, nitrogen rules, talent shortages, export controls and policy predictability. The minister answered each question, outlining the Beethoven package, grid and talent measures, ministerial committee on nitrogen, and commitments to continued dialogue with ASML.
I am in continuous dialogue with ASML about the measures needed to keep growing and investing in the Netherlands.
Ik ben voortdurend in gesprek met ASML over de maatregelen die nodig zijn om in Nederland te kunnen doorgroeien en doorinvesteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'Hoofdeconoom BNP Paribas: ‘Kom gewoon met een pan-Europees regime voor bedrijven'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a proposal for a pan-European corporate regime (28th regime) to ease cross-border operation in the EU. The minister said the government is broadly positive, supports deepening the single market and capital markets union, sees no added value for mortgages or pensions, and awaits the Commission's proposal.
The cabinet has in principle a positive attitude towards proposals that contribute to cross-border operation, the capital markets union and free movement in the internal market.
Het kabinet heeft in beginsel een positieve grondhouding naar voorstellen die bijdragen aan grensoverschrijdend opereren, de kapitaalmarktunie en het vrije verkeer op de interne markt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Krap zesje voor ondernemersklimaat: 'Het gaat de verkeerde kant op''

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government will act on regulatory burden after reports that the business climate is worsening, and what concrete targets and timelines the Minder Druk Met Regels action programme sets. The minister answered that the government is committed to reducing burden through the action programme, a reduction programme with a ministerial steering group, EU-level efforts, and cooperation with the VNG, while providing few hard numerical targets and no firm deadline beyond the business climate pact due by summer 2025.
The cabinet has included the following objective in the coalition agreement: the cabinet reduces regulatory burden for businesses and makes it easier to comply with rules.
Het kabinet heeft in het regeerprogramma de volgende doelstelling opgenomen: het kabinet dringt regeldruk voor bedrijven terug en maakt het eenvoudiger om aan regels te kunnen voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het beboeten van supermarkten vanwege te veel ongezond voedsel

MPs asked whether supermarkets should be fined for selling too much unhealthy food, whether advertising and pricing can be restricted, and what the costs of removing VAT on healthy food would be. The state secretary said supermarkets bear a responsibility, that concrete agreements and monitoring of healthy-sales shares will be pursued, that a broad ban on food advertising lacks support while child-directed marketing rules are being prepared, that a bonus-malus scheme is doubtful, and that VAT removal on healthy food is rejected as too costly and legally unworkable.
Antwoord op van de leden Martens-America en Kisteman over het bericht ’Kleding SHEIN vol hormoonverstorende stoffen, slippers 325 keer giftiger dan toegestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that SHEIN clothing contained hormone-disrupting substances, how many non-conforming products are sold, what legal basis Dutch and EU authorities have to act, and why enforcement was not intensified before the holidays. The Minister answered that EU market surveillance studies find 85-95% of sampled third-country platform products non-conforming, that the European Commission has exclusive competence over VLOPs like SHEIN under the DSA, and that the government will push for EU-level action and a customs reform, but could not yet provide Productenmeldwijzer report figures and declined to comment on enforcement timing.
As Minister I do not make decisions on the (temporary) intensification of supervision. That is for the supervisory authorities.
Als Minister neem ik geen besluit over de (tijdelijke) intensivering van het toezicht. Dat is aan de toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij subsidieverlening

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Sneller asked about the use of the Bibob Act in subsidy grants by central government, including RVO's practice, data sharing with municipalities, and LBB advice requests. The minister answers that Bibob use is left to each state body and is risk-based, describes the RVO advisory group and ten LBB requests, and promises further evaluation and updates.
Because of the confidentiality duty in the Bibob Act, the LBB only shares figures on advice requests where they cannot be traced back to individual cases.
Het LBB deelt in verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht in de Wet Bibob alleen cijfers over adviesaanvragen als deze cijfers niet te herleiden zijn naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de toepasbaarheid van resultaatfinanciering (zoals Social Impact Bonds) bij het verstrekken van subsidies en opdrachten

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about applying results-based financing such as Social Impact Bonds to subsidies and contracts, including the value of UK evidence, expertise-building, knowledge partnerships, a results fund, legislation like SIPPRA, and results-based subsidies. The minister acknowledged potential benefits and risks, deferred several questions to other ministers, and committed only to considering lessons from experience.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het wegtrekken van talent uit de Verenigde Staten naar aanleiding van de verkiezingswinst van Trump

Two D66 MPs asked how the Netherlands could attract talent leaving the United States after Trump's 2024 election, including whether to introduce a talent visa like the UK's or France's. The government answered that it runs a neutral, inviting knowledge-migrant policy, pointed to existing schemes, outreach and tax facilities, and said a new talent visa was unnecessary.
The cabinet will not speculate about possible policy the next government in the United States will introduce.
Het kabinet gaat niet speculeren over mogelijk beleid dat de volgende regering in de Verenigde Staten gaat invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over “de schimmige telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen”

An MP asked the Minister whether telephone sales of home batteries are shady, the regulatory position on leases and bundled energy contracts, and whether the Energiewet will curb such sales. The Minister answered that the ACM handles enforcement, that existing tools seem sufficient, that new telecom rules will bar unsolicited sales calls to existing customers, and that stakeholders will be consulted.
The cabinet has taken note of the article reporting shady telephone sales of home batteries.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het artikel waarin wordt gesproken over schimmige telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over de tijdige bezorging van rouwpost in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that an undertaker delivered funeral cards himself after PostNL delays, and whether residents' loss of trust in PostNL is desirable. The minister acknowledged delays despite special rules for mourning mail, said the ACM is studying the postal market and a future vision follows in 2025, and described PostNL's calamity protocol, which was used in under 0.2% of cases.
Currently I am having the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) carry out research into the postal market.
Momenteel laat ik de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) onderzoek uitvoeren naar de postmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Van Eijk en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Achteraf betalen kan binnenkort ook in fysieke winkels dankzij nieuwe samenwerking'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about news that buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) would extend to physical shops, and about its effects on young people and indebted consumers. The minister answered that BNPL-in-shops offers minimal social added value with large risks, pointed to the coming CCDII directive, age verification and a sector code, and said a temporary ban is not feasible.
The government therefore finds the announcement to extend BNPL services to physical shops very undesirable.
De aankondiging om BNPL-diensten uit te breiden naar fysieke winkels vindt het kabinet dan ook zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over de artikelen `Energieminister Qatar dreigt gaslevering EU te stoppen` en `Topman Boskalis `verketterd` om kritiek op vestigingsklimaat

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America (VVD) asked the ministers about newspaper reports on Qatar threatening EU gas supply and on criticism of the investment climate, and about the impact of the CSDDD on competitiveness, compliance costs and implementation. The minister answered at length, largely defending the CSDDD and its Dutch implementation, promising ongoing dialogue and business support, and arguing that the Dutch law adds no extra requirements.
The cabinet endorses the goal of reducing regulatory burden, as also included in the coalition programme.
Het kabinet onderschrijft het doel van regeldrukvermindering, zoals ook opgenomen in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de omzeiling van sancties tegen Rusland door net opgerichte bedrijven

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about sanctions evasion against Russia by newly founded small firms, as flagged by a CBS and University of Groningen study, and about due diligence and compliance obligations for exporters. The minister responded that evasion is a government priority, that the expanded anti-circumvention clause and best-efforts and due diligence duties apply, that enforcement data is not yet available, and that a letter on chip manufacturers' compliance was sent on 26 November 2024.
Countering sanctions circumvention is a priority for the cabinet.
Het tegengaan van sanctie-omzeiling is een prioriteit voor het kabinet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het rapport 'Effect van Amerikaanse invoertarieven op de Nederlandse en Europese economie’ van het Centraal Planbureau

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked the ministers about the CPB report on the effects of US import tariffs on the Dutch and European economy, covering sectoral impacts, EU countermeasures, trade diversion, investment relocation, financing, ports and employment. The government answered that the report shows limited but real effects, pointed to existing EU trade instruments and business-support tools, and said it is too early to commit to specific measures on financing or employment.
It is too early to take measures on business financing.
Het is te vroeg om maatregelen te nemen rondom bedrijfsfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht dat Nederland inzet op een bilaterale handelsrelatie met de VS

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands was pursuing a bilateral trade relationship with the US, including contacts with Trump's team, the role of the EU, and the risk of undermining joint EU trade policy. The government answered that it maintains broad stakeholder contacts, that trade policy is an exclusive EU competence while member states may pursue bilateral economic cooperation, and that it will keep coordinating within the EU while strengthening bilateral economic ties with the US.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Kisteman over het bericht 'Statiegeld mogelijk omhoog naar €1 per fles'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a reported possible increase of the deposit on bottles to EUR 1 would burden consumers, harm the environment, dirty streets, and how collection could be improved. The state secretary answered that no increase has been decided yet, the ILT is still reviewing Verpact's studies, an evaluation of the deposit scheme is underway with results due spring 2025, and that ILT has ordered Verpact to create 5,400 extra return points.
At this moment there is not yet any intention to increase the deposit.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een voornemen tot verhoging van het statiegeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht dat scheepsbouwer Damen schepen opknapt die Russisch gas vervoeren

Two MPs from D66 and CDA asked ministers whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's maintenance of Russian LNG-transport vessels breaches EU sanctions and how the government will tighten measures against Russian LNG imports. The ministers answered that sanctions prohibit servicing vessels linked to Russian entities unless they are used to evade sanctions, that enforcement follows signals of breaches, that the Netherlands pushes for an EU roadmap to phase out Russian gas and LNG, and that it will press for stronger measures in the next sanctions package, but they gave no case-specific details.

The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but in general supplying parts and/or carrying out maintenance (technical assistance) to vessels of Russian persons and entities or vessels used in Russia is prohibited.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen, maar in zijn algemeenheid geldt dat het leveren van onderdelen en/of uitvoeren van onderhoud (technische bijstand) aan schepen van Russische personen en entiteiten of schepen die in Rusland gebruikt worden verboden is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Congres VS eist inzage in ASML-export naar China'

An MP asks the government about a US House committee's request to ASML and other chip-equipment makers for details of their China export sales, and about Dutch export-control and sanctions policy. The minister answers that the US request is a matter for ASML, that contacts with US authorities take place but their content is confidential, and that the Netherlands takes its own export-control measures for security reasons.
I will not comment on the content of those conversations for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inhoud van die gesprekken doe ik omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Ceder over het bericht ‘veel kinderen hebben spijt van aankopen in games’

MPs Krul (CDA) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will respond to Unicef research showing many children regret in-game purchases such as loot boxes, whether a ban is needed, and why Belgium could ban them nationally but the Netherlands cannot. The minister answers that the findings are worrying, that the Netherlands is pushing for a loot box ban in the EU Digital Fairness Act (proposal expected late 2025 or early 2026) since EU maximum harmonisation blocks stricter national rules, that Dutch gambling law does not fit loot boxes, and that a national ban is not pursued in favour of EU action.
I do not want to anticipate national legislation, because I expect action to be taken at the European level.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op nationale wetgeving, omdat ik verwacht dat er op Europees niveau actie wordt ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht dat er grote zorgen zijn voor de transportsector door de aankomende grenscontroles

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government had analysed the economic impact of border checks and whether it would meet transport sector representatives about their concerns. The minister said no detailed economic analysis was done because checks would be targeted, that measures were taken to limit impact, and that the government is already in contact with the transport sector.
Therefore no detailed analysis was carried out on the economic consequences of these border checks, and none is planned.
Daarom is er geen gedetailleerde analyse gedaan over de economische gevolgen van genoemde grenscontroles en is deze ook niet voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bontenbal over het potentiële valmeerproject bij de Haringvlietmonding

MPs Grinwis and Bontenbal asked the government about the proposed Delta21 valmeer (storage reservoir) at the Haringvliet mouth, its energy value, flood safety, ecological impact, strategic autonomy, and whether it should be included in the grid security plan and a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answers that the project has potential value as large-scale electricity storage but faces large uncertainties and ecological drawbacks, and commits to a broader cost-benefit comparison of flexibility options and an update of the energy storage roadmap.

As promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (7 November 2024), the cabinet is willing to map the pros and cons of a valmeer project for the energy system, including a comparison with other flexibility applications.

Zoals is toegezegd tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (7 november 2024) is het kabinet bereid om in kaart te brengen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van een valmeerproject voor het energiesysteem, inclusief een vergelijking met andere flexibiliteitstoepassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Kisteman over een  reportage over glazenwassers door het tv-programma Radar

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Kisteman asked about a Radar report on rogue window cleaners, including consumer rights, complaint channels, cash payment, sector knowledge, enforcement and whether the Zaanstad licensing approach should be copied. The minister answered that consumers may be required to pay in cash, that Zaanstad's licensing scheme is a municipal matter, that no further sector study is planned, and that no integrated national enforcement campaign is currently running.
The police have no overviews of the number of reports made over the past two years about window cleaners, because no sector-specific overviews are kept.
Bij politie zijn geen overzichten aanwezig van het aantal meldingen dat de afgelopen twee jaar is gedaan over glazenwassers, omdat geen sectorale overzichten worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht “Vrees voor grote chaos door grenscontroles: ellenlange files en klap voor Nederlandse economie”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Asylum and Migration about fears that border controls would cause traffic chaos and harm the Dutch economy, including impacts on border regions and whether an impact analysis would be made. The government answered that controls will be risk-based rather than systematic, no crossing points will be designated, no speed-limiting measures are planned unless strictly necessary, controls will be coordinated with Germany, and no significant extra costs are expected, but it declined to commit to a formal impact analysis.
The cabinet therefore expects that no significant additional costs will arise from the reintroduction of internal border controls.
Het kabinet verwacht daarom dat er geen significante extra kosten zullen ontstaan vanwege de herinvoering van binnengrenstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de invoering van interne grenscontroles in Nederland

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government about the reintroduction of internal border controls, including costs, justification under EU rules, personnel impact on the Royal Marechaussee, and whether controls will facilitate people smuggling. The minister answered that controls will be risk-based and non-systematic, that no significant extra costs are expected, that irregular migration and secondary flows justify the measure, and that controls are temporary and not expected to increase smuggling.
The cabinet is taking all possible measures to prevent further disruption of the migration system, because this could lead to distressing situations and a greater threat to public order.
Het kabinet neemt alle mogelijke maatregelen om verdere verstoring van het migratiesysteem te voorkomen, omdat dit kan leiden tot schrijnende situaties en een grotere dreiging voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over de Digital Servies Coördinator

Van Houwelingen (FVD) asked about the Digital Services Coordinator role (ACM), its tasks and staffing, whether any trusted flaggers were designated, and for correspondence with the European Commission. The minister confirmed ACM is the coordinator (provisionally designated, pending the implementing act), outlined its tasks and 49 fte budget, said no trusted flaggers yet exist, and declined to release the Commission correspondence citing confidentiality under article 84 DSA and the coordinator's independence.
Article 84 of the Digital Services Regulation provides that information obtained or exchanged under the regulation that falls under professional secrecy may not be made public.
Artikel 84 van de digitaledienstenverordening bepaalt dat informatie die krachtens de verordening is verkregen of uitgewisseld en die onder het beroepsgeheim valt, niet openbaar mag worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Hirsch en Thijssen over het bericht 'Nederlands bedrijfsleven omarmt strengere Europese klimaatregels'

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the CSDDD climate duty for large companies, enforcement resources, business support and level-playing-field concerns. The minister said the Netherlands supports uniform EU implementation, funds supervision via HGIS resources, has ACM test enforceability, and will support companies with guidance while pushing for harmonised implementation abroad.
At the 2024 Spring Decision-Making, HGIS funds were allocated in the BHO budget for implementing and supervising the CSDDD legislation.
Bij Voorjaarsbesluitvorming 2024 zijn er HGIS-middelen gealloceerd op de BHO-begroting voor implementatie van en toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Sneller over marktconcentratie op de schoolboeken- en schoolboekendistributiemarkt

MPs Rooderkerk and Sneller asked about market concentration in the school textbook and distribution market, including market shares, ownership, vendor lock-in, costs and waste of workbooks. The State Secretary gave estimates of concentration (about 77% for the three largest VO publishers, about 80% for the four largest PO publishers, two main distributors per sector), said ACM oversight and a study with EZ are underway, and pointed to SIVON, Edu-V and open learning materials, while declining to give exact market-share data.
The Ministry of OCW does not have specific market shares for individual publishers.
Het Ministerie van OCW beschikt niet over specifieke marktaandelen van afzonderlijke uitgevers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Thijssen over Ebusco

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Ebusco's financial problems, the role of electric buses in climate-neutral public transport, and whether the state should keep such firms afloat. The government answered that emission-free buses are on track for 2030, that support is market-based and not for individual firms, and that it will not comment on a listed company's fortunes.
It is not for the government to support individual companies, but to ensure a level playing field and to pursue policy that promotes innovation and sustainability across the whole sector.

Het is daarbij niet aan de overheid om individuele bedrijven te ondersteunen, maar om te zorgen voor een gelijk speelveld en een beleid te voeren dat innovatie en duurzaamheid bevordert binnen de hele sector.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over het bericht dat Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven die subsidie ontvangen om Oekraïne te helpen met de wederopbouw tegelijkertijd zakendoenin Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Paternotte and Van der Burg asked whether Dutch farm firms receiving Ukraine reconstruction subsidies also trade with Russia, and whether RVO checks this and should exclude such firms. The government says it does not comment on individual firms, that unsanctioned trade with Russia is not currently grounds for exclusion, and that it is studying adding such an exclusion to the Ukraine Partnership Facility subsidy scheme and considering further EU sanctions on agricultural goods.
In addition, the cabinet is examining whether unsanctioned trade with Russia can be added as a ground for exclusion from the subsidy scheme for the Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF).
Daarnaast onderzoekt het kabinet of ongesanctioneerde handel met Rusland als uitsluitingsgrond toegevoegd kan worden aan de subsidieregeling voor de Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het stopzetten van leningen aan bedrijven die zich alleen richten op het oppompen van olie en gas en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe velden

MP Vermeer asked the government whether ING's halt on new loans to pure-play oil and gas exploration companies is allowed, what its economic and financial effects would be, and whether other banks follow. Minister Heinen answered that ING's decision is its own commercial choice, that effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be very limited, that the bank's counterparties are confidential, and that gas remains needed during the transition.
Which parties financial institutions enter into financing relationships with is commercially confidential information.
Met welke partijen financiële instellingen financieringsrelaties aangaan, is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Werkgever ‘mist kans’ met werknemersaandelen: ‘Dit is de manier om werkeneden te laten profiteren van welvaart’

An MP asked whether the government would investigate financial employee participation, including fiscal obstacles, comparisons with the UK and Germany, a national policy plan, and information provision. The Secretary of State answered that the government is positive about such schemes but sees them as a matter for employers and employees, identifies four practical obstacles, denies any current fiscal barrier, and points to the Stichting van de Arbeid process and ongoing startup tax research without committing to new studies or a national plan.
Given the various advantages and disadvantages, it is up to employers and employees to weigh these and see whether financial employee participation offers added value for them.
Gegeven de verschillende voor- en nadelen is het aan werkgevers en werknemers om deze samen te wegen en te kijken of financiële werknemersparticipatie voor hen meerwaarde biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Meerderheid Amsterdammers tegen verkoop van Afval Energie Bedrijf, wethouder noemt runnen afvalverwerking ‘geen kerntaak’'

An SP MP asked ministers about the City of Amsterdam's planned sale of the waste-processing company AEB, public opposition to it, guarantees for public interests, and whether the national government would take a majority stake. The government answered that the municipality handles the sale and has secured public interests through contract conditions, that the national government sees no reason to take a majority stake, and that it will take no steps on the matter.
The national government sees no reason to take a majority stake in AEB.
Het Rijk ziet geen aanleiding om een meerderheidsaandeel te nemen in AEB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het schrappen van het huidige stikstofbeleid

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs which sectors need nitrogen space, how permits can be obtained, and what the economic damage of the nitrogen policy stalemate is. The minister answers that agriculture, housing, mobility, industry and energy need space, that uncertainty delays investments, and that a study on the economic damage is due in early 2025.
In the debate of 4 September, the minister committed to inform the House about this in early 2025.
In het debat van 4 september heeft MLVVN toegezegd de kamer hier begin 2025 over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Kathmann en Inge van Dijk over de opkomst van niet-Europese online marktplaatsen en de impact hiervan op concurrentievermogen, consumentenbescherming en productveiligheid

MPs Thijssen, Kathmann and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the flood of parcels from Chinese online marketplaces, unequal competition, consumer protection and product safety, and asked what the government itself can do. The Minister acknowledges the concerns, points to EU instruments (DSA, DMA, customs reform, Digital Product Passport) and to supervisors' responsibility, and commits to talks with the Consumentenbond and retail associations and to coordination with Germany and at EU level.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the Consumentenbond and the retail industry associations and to inform the House about relevant outcomes.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de Consumentenbond en de retailbrancheverenigingen en de Kamer te informeren over relevante uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over prijzen van supermarkten en benzinestations

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about fuel stations passing down price drops slowly (the 'rockets and feathers' effect), supermarkets apparently aligning prices, and how consumers can be protected against such strategies. The minister acknowledged ACM research showing consumers overpaid 2.2 to 4.8 cents per litre, said the ACM currently cannot target such market failures and is reviewing its instruments, and pointed to a forthcoming letter to Parliament on the matter.
I am therefore currently examining whether the ACM's instruments should be revised.
Ik onderzoek daarom momenteel of het instrumentarium van de ACM moet worden herzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de btw-verhoging op logies

Sneller (D66) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the expected revenue, sector effects, border competition, fiscal neutrality, and the lack of an impact analysis for the VAT increase on accommodation. The State Secretary defends the revenue estimate of 1,110 million euro, rejects claims of large shortfalls and border effects as not quantifiable, and says monitoring and an ex-post evaluation in 2028 will follow.
Immediately after introduction, the cabinet will carry out a first analysis of the short-term impact of these measures.
Direct na invoering zal het kabinet een eerste analyse doen van de korte-termijnimpact van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Nederland wil export ASML naar China verder beperken’

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked whether the government plans to further restrict ASML's exports of chip-making machines to China, which tools and risks are involved, and how businesses are consulted. The minister denies a plan to restrict exports, describes a country-neutral export-control measure that requires licences rather than banning exports, and gives largely general answers, declining to give licence numbers and deferring to ASML on its own impact.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual licences to specific destinations.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele vergunningen naar specifieke bestemmingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over Chinese dreigementen om ASML van Chinese markt te weren

MPs Hirsch and Thijssen asked whether China has threatened to exclude ASML from its market, what the consequences would be, and whether the Netherlands will adopt additional US-style export restrictions. Minister Klever declined to discuss diplomatic contacts or speculate on impacts, stating that Dutch export controls are national security decisions and that further measures would be pursued multilaterally and in EU coordination.
The cabinet cannot go into the content of confidential diplomatic conversations.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de inhoud van vertrouwelijke diplomatieke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de bevoegdheden van de ACM en het beschermen van consumenten voor de gevolgen van marktmacht

An SP MP asked the Economics minister how to respond to ACM warnings that serial small acquisitions ('buy and build') create local market power and harm consumers, and whether the Competition Act should be modernised with a call-in power and a new competition tool. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the government is studying the problem and will send a letter soon, and noted ACM can already act under existing competition law.

For this reason my ministry is examining the possibility of extending the Competition Act with a New Competition Tool, with the aim of formulating remedies after market research specifically aimed at addressing these distortions.
Om die reden onderzoekt mijn ministerie de mogelijkheid om de Mededingingswet uit te breiden met een New Competition Tool, met als doel om na het doen van marktonderzoek remedies te formuleren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over de berichten 'PostNL mag tarieven voor brieven en pakketten volgend jaar verhogen' en 'PostNL neemt twee keer zoveel tijd voor bezorging zakelijke post'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that PostNL may raise stamp and parcel tariffs next year and will take longer to deliver business mail, and about how the ACM sets tariff room, cost allocation and quality. The minister answered that the ACM sets the tariff room by statutory formula, that PostNL allocates universal-service costs under an ACM-approved system, that business mail delivery times are for PostNL and its clients to agree, and that studies due in early 2025 will inform structural postal reforms.
On the basis of these studies I will make policy choices on the future of the postal market and structural measures to be taken.
Op basis hiervan zal ik beleidskeuzes maken over de toekomst van de postmarkt en te nemen structurele maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over het belang van ondernemende vrouwen en migranten

MP White asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will improve access to finance and other conditions for female and migrant entrepreneurs, including Seed Capital scheme criteria, the national MKB financing covenant, and the economic legacy of slavery. The minister answered that existing instruments are open to all entrepreneurs, cited diversity criteria, Code-V and DLiT support, and referred the slavery question to a separate letter.
The national government has a broad range of financing instruments for both the broad and the innovative SME sector (including startups).
De Rijksoverheid heeft een breed instrumentarium voor financiering, voor zowel het brede als het innovatieve mkb (inclusief startups).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Joseph over de berichten ‘ACM-beschuldiging van stilzwijgende kartel zit bank hoog’ en ‘Protestacties lijken ING niet te raken’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ACM findings on tacit collusion and weak competition in the Dutch savings market, including bank share buybacks, savings rates, account fees, cybersecurity costs, liquidity and credit to SMEs. The minister largely accepts the ACM diagnosis, announces studies on unbundling and fee issues, and defers many questions to banks and DNB, declining to act directly on buybacks.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who have no current account with them.
Ik ga onder meer onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het verwijderen van brievenbussen door PostNL

MPs Dijk and Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why PostNL may remove letterboxes, especially outside cities, and how it protects elderly and offline residents, whether it still meets legal distance rules, and whether postal service should be market-based. The minister answered that PostNL may remove boxes within legal distance limits (1 km or 2.5 km), that it must consult consumer and local bodies and respond in writing, that ACM supervises compliance, and that a policy review on postal service improvement is under way.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises this as the regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) houdt hier als toezichthouder toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een mogelijke relatie tussen COVID-19-vaccinaties en oversterfte in Nederland

An MP asked whether the CBS refused to respond to a critical report by Meester and Jacobs on COVID-19 vaccination and excess mortality, and whether the minister would ask the CBS to respond. The minister answered that the CBS has received a proposal for a discussion and will write a short substantive response to the report.
The CBS indicates it will accept this and will also prepare a brief substantive response to the report.
Het CBS geeft aan daarop in te gaan en zal bovendien een korte inhoudelijke reactie op het rapport opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de trend dat Nederlandse banken stoppen met de ondersteuning van contactloos betalen via eigen apps

MPs Six Dijkstra and Zeedijk asked the government about banks such as ING and the Volksbank dropping their own contactless payment apps in favour of Google Pay, and the consequences for privacy, digital sovereignty, and consumer choice. The Minister of Finance answered that banks set their own policy, that supervision of privacy falls under the AVG and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, that the DMA obliges Apple and Google to allow alternative payment apps, and that no general open contactless payment protocol is needed for now.
Banks conduct their own policy and decide for themselves whether they offer contactless payment via their own app or in another way.
Banken voeren hun eigen beleid en bepalen zelf of zij contactloos betalen aanbieden via een eigen app of op een andere manier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gabriëls over het overnemen van de adviezen van de Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond als harde voorwaarde bij de onderhandelingen over de maatwerkafspraken

MPs Thijssen and Gabriëls asked how health of residents and workers is systematically included in the Tata Steel maatwerkafspraak negotiations, and whether the government's commitments go beyond the motion on adopting the Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond advice. The government answers that health is an integral part of the negotiation mandate, that a health paragraph will be included in the Joint Letter of Intent, that the health impact assessment (GER) is delayed and expected in 2025, and that most correspondence cannot be shared because it would harm the state's negotiating position.
Many of the documents and correspondence contain information that could harm the State's negotiating position.
Veel van de documenten en correspondentie bevatten informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat kunnen benadelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk-Raeven en Hertzberger over de Kamerbrief 29338-276 over het Nationaal Versterkingsplan van Micro-chiptalent als reactie op het advies van speciaal gezant microchipindustrie Dhr. H.

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about how the Nationaal Versterkingsplan Microchip-talent allocates funds across regions, including consultation with regions, the Beethoven-motion compliance, selection of regions, training numbers, and whether Twente, Groningen and Limburg receive fair shares. The Minister answered all 17 questions, explaining that regional plans exceeded the budget and failed to show delivery to industry, that allocation follows industry hiring practices concentrated in Brainport, and that revised plans are due by 29 September.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bereiken van de top 5 van de landen met een goede concurrentiepositie

MP Sneller (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the coalition goal of reaching the global top 5 on competitiveness is a concrete, accountable target, how to return to the top 5 of the IMD ranking after Netherlands' sharp drop to ninth, which minister is responsible, and whether a target year will be set. The minister endorsed the goal, said the cabinet will address it in the government programme, and stated that improving the business climate is a shared responsibility of the whole cabinet with the Economic Affairs minister coordinating.
The cabinet will address in the government programme what it considers necessary to improve the business climate so as to return to the top 5 of this ranking.
Het kabinet zal in het regeerprogramma ingaan op wat volgens het kabinet nodig is ter verbetering van het ondernemingsklimaat om terug te keren in de top 5 van deze ranglijst.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schutz over het bericht over een recordaantal grote storingen op het spoor waarbij ProRail waarschuwt voor jarenlange hinder

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the rising number of major rail disruptions and ProRail's warning of years of nuisance, including flexibility of maintenance contracts, ICT, staffing, procurement rules and timelines. The State Secretary answers that ProRail is still analysing the causes, will share its analysis by year-end, and that concrete measures and timelines will be discussed afterwards, while noting new flexible contracts for small-scale maintenance and that EU procurement rules are for the Commission to revise.
Before we discuss specific solutions for the rise in high-impact disruptions, the outcomes of ProRail's analysis will be awaited, which will be shared with IenW by the end of this year.

Voordat we over specifieke oplossingen praten in het kader van de stijging van impactvolle verstoringen, worden de uitkomsten van de analyse van ProRail afgewacht, die voor het einde van dit jaar met IenW wordt gedeeld.
